papers.title: Wavefunctions for Anyon Superconductors
papers.abstract: Anyon superconductivity arises from the condensation of mobile anyons rather than from a conventional Cooper instability, yet a systematic wavefunction description remains lacking. We develop a hierarchy-wavefunction construction for superconducting states derived from parent topological orders and identify their off-diagonal long-range order, condensate charge, chiral central charge, and residual topological order through the plasma analogy and topological field theories. We construct Abelian and non-Abelian examples descending from the semion state, a $ν=2/3$ hierarchy state, the $ν=1/3$ Laughlin state, $ν=1$ integer quantum Hall state, and Pfaffian state. Remarkably, for the semion case, the superconducting many-semion wavefunction is equivalent to a state of fermionized anyons filling two effective Landau levels, recovering Laughlin's original construction of semion superconductor. Finally, we show that hierarchy wavefunctions emerge naturally in the dilute, long-distance limit of the anyon-Hilbert-space formulation, which applies to ideal Chern bands and moiré bands of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$. Our results establish a unified wavefunction-level framework linking anyon condensation, superconducting order, and topological field theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“wavefunction construction”“topological field theories”“plasma analogy”等理论概念，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：任意子超导体（anyon superconductors），具体包括由半子态（semion state）、ν=2/3层级态、ν=1/3 Laughlin态、ν=1整数量子霍尔态及Pfaffian态等母体拓扑序衍生出的超导态；并涉及理想Chern带和扭曲双层MoTe₂的moiré带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了任意子超导态的层级波函数构造方案，证明该波函数具有离域长程有序（off-diagonal long-range order），并揭示了凝聚电荷、手性中心荷及残余拓扑序等性质。特别地，半子超导多体波函数等价于费米化任意子填充两个有效朗道能级的态，重现了Laughlin对半子超导体的原始构造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了任意子超导态的层级波函数构造方案，证明该波函数具有离域长程有序（off-diagonal long-range order），并揭示了凝聚电荷、手性中心荷及残余拓扑序等性质。特别地，半子超导多体波函数等价于费米化任意子填充两个有效朗道能级的态，重现了Laughlin对半子超导体的原始构造。；创新点：首次为任意子超导态提供了系统的波函数级描述，将任意子凝聚、超导序与拓扑场论统一在同一框架内；并揭示了半子超导波函数与费米化任意子填充朗道能级之间的等价关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：层级波函数构造（hierarchy-wavefunction construction）、等离子体类比（plasma analogy）、拓扑场论（topological field theories），以及任意子希尔伯特空间形式（anyon-Hilbert-space formulation）的稀薄长距离极限分析。

papers.title: Reciprocity can halve what a mechanical network can learn
papers.abstract: Tunable mechanical networks are being developed as materials that learn in place. Capacity is estimated by counting tunable parameters against target constraints, ignoring Maxwell-Betti reciprocity, the symmetry every passive, linear elastic network obeys by construction. When p degrees of freedom are both driven and read out, every reachable response block lies in a subspace of codimension p(p-1)/2, whatever the size, topology and stiffnesses; at full overlap nearly half the target space is unreachable. The consequence for training is a number: any learning rule leaves an error at least the norm of the target's antisymmetric part on the shared degrees of freedom, computable before training, and positive definiteness adds an orthogonal second term. A second-order optimiser with the exact Jacobian reaches that floor within 1% in 143 of 144 runs, a bond-local contrastive rule within 0.1% in 22 of 24, and odd couplings restore the lost directions at the price of an external torque source: the network becomes active. Prescribed-displacement drives obey a companion law we prove. The symmetry is classical; its consequence on a fixed graph with finitely many tunable stiffnesses at partial overlap is new. For a published robotic metamaterial it shows that no symmetric positive-definite stiffness matrix meets both targets in the linear model their deposited data integrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要以数学推导（codimension、子空间、定理证明）和数值训练模拟为主，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：可调机械网络（tunable mechanical networks），即作为“原位学习材料”的被动线性弹性网络，以及其刚度矩阵的对称性（Maxwell-Betti互易性）对学习容量的限制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由于被动线性弹性网络必然满足Maxwell-Betti互易对称性，当p个自由度同时被驱动和读出时，所有可达响应块位于余维数为p(p-1)/2的子空间中；在完全重叠情形下，近一半的目标空间不可达。任何学习规则在共享自由度上的误差至少等于目标反对称部分的范数，该下限可在训练前计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由于被动线性弹性网络必然满足Maxwell-Betti互易对称性，当p个自由度同时被驱动和读出时，所有可达响应块位于余维数为p(p-1)/2的子空间中；在完全重叠情形下，近一半的目标空间不可达。任何学习规则在共享自由度上的误差至少等于目标反对称部分的范数，该下限可在训练前计算。；创新点：Maxwell-Betti互易性本身是经典结论，但将其对“固定图、有限个可调刚度、部分重叠”情形下学习容量的定量影响（余维数公式与误差下限）推导出来是新的；此外证明了规定位移驱动满足伴随定律，并指出奇数耦合（有源项）可恢复丢失方向但需外部力矩源。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（子空间维数计数、互易性约束的线性代数分析）；数值训练模拟（二阶优化器使用精确雅可比矩阵，以及键局域对比学习规则）；对已发表的机器人超材料数据进行了线性模型验证。

papers.title: A Superconducting Peierls Instability
papers.abstract: The Peierls instability is a foundational mechanism in condensed matter physics, showing how the electron--phonon interaction can transform a simple metal into an insulating state with a new lattice periodicity. In a one-dimensional (1D) metal the Peierls instability follows from the enhanced electronic response at wavevector $Q=2k_F$ (connecting the Fermi points) producing a Kohn anomaly: a softening of the phonon mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates the tell-tale Peierls periodic lattice distortion and charge-density wave (CDW) that gaps the electronic spectrum. Here we show an analogous instability at the edge of a two-dimensional (2D) superconductor, where a dispersing Andreev bound state (ABS) hosts Bogoliubov Fermi points at $\pm k_c$. The enhanced quasiparticle response at the connecting wavevector $Q=2k_c$ couples directly to pairing-fluctuations and produces a superconducting Kohn anomaly: a softening of a pairing mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates an edge pair-density wave (PDW) that gaps the ABS. We refer to this as a superconducting Peierls instability and identify the boundary quasiparticle structure that enables it. As a concrete realization, we consider a square-lattice extended Hubbard model whose mixed-symmetry $s+d+ip$ state hosts a dispersing ABS with zero-energy crossings at finite edge momenta. Using self-consistent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) calculations we show that the order parameter develops an edge PDW, with the wavevector set by the superconducting Kohn anomaly, that gaps the ABS crossings. Our results identify a novel mechanism for spontaneous translation-symmetry breaking in a superconductor. As this superconducting Peierls mechanism does not require an extensive zero-energy flat band or topologically protected edge states, it may apply broadly to unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“self-consistent Bogoliubov–de Gennes (BdG) calculations”，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：二维超导体边缘的准粒子态，具体为具有混合对称性 \(s+d+ip\) 的方形晶格扩展 Hubbard 模型中的色散 Andreev 束缚态（ABS），以及其 Bogoliubov Fermi 点结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维超导体边缘，色散 ABS 的 Bogoliubov Fermi 点之间的准粒子响应会软化配对模式，形成“超导 Kohn 异常”；该模式凝聚后产生边缘配对密度波（PDW），从而打开 ABS 的能隙——这是一种全新的自发平移对称性破缺机制，称为“超导 Peierls 不稳定性”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维超导体边缘，色散 ABS 的 Bogoliubov Fermi 点之间的准粒子响应会软化配对模式，形成“超导 Kohn 异常”；该模式凝聚后产生边缘配对密度波（PDW），从而打开 ABS 的能隙——这是一种全新的自发平移对称性破缺机制，称为“超导 Peierls 不稳定性”。；创新点：提出了一种不依赖零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态的超导 Peierls 机制，为非常规超导体中自发平移对称性破缺提供了普适的新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽 Bogoliubov–de Gennes（BdG）方程对方形晶格扩展 Hubbard 模型进行数值求解，分析混合对称性 \(s+d+ip\) 超导态边缘的序参量空间调制。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Concentration Inequalities: Controlling Uncertainty in Finite-Time and Small-Sample Thermodynamic Inference
papers.abstract: We derive nonasymptotic upper bounds on the probability that a generalized current of a geometrically ergodic diffusion observed for any amount of time, or its sample mean over any arbitrary sample size, deviates from the stationary mean by more than any given amount. The concentration-of-measure behavior of generalized currents is universally governed by the relaxation time of the underlying dynamics, the locally observed dissipation rate, and the intrinsic local fluctuations of the observable. We uncover stark qualitative and quantitative differences in fluctuations in and out of thermodynamic equilibrium. We further obtain refined inverse thermodynamic uncertainty relations, bounding the variance of generalized currents from above. We construct nonasymptotic confidence intervals for controlling uncertainty in thermodynamic inference from small data, i.e., from short trajectories and small samples, and provide the first quantitative answer to when a trajectory is sufficiently long and a sample is sufficiently large. As an illustration, we apply our results to currents observed on a two-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process in and out of equilibrium and show how they can be used to rigorously detect broken detailed balance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive nonasymptotic upper bounds”“theoretical framework”“inequalities”等数学推导性表述，无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：广义流（generalized current）在有限时间与小样本条件下的热力学推断问题，具体应用于二维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程在平衡与非平衡态下的流涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 广义流的浓度行为（即偏离稳态均值的概率上界）由动力学弛豫时间、局域耗散率和可观测量固有局域涨落共同普适控制；平衡态与非平衡态下的涨落存在显著定性与定量差异。此外，作者获得了改进的逆热力学不确定关系，并首次定量回答了“轨迹多长、样本多大才足够”的问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：广义流的浓度行为（即偏离稳态均值的概率上界）由动力学弛豫时间、局域耗散率和可观测量固有局域涨落共同普适控制；平衡态与非平衡态下的涨落存在显著定性与定量差异。此外，作者获得了改进的逆热力学不确定关系，并首次定量回答了“轨迹多长、样本多大才足够”的问题。；创新点：首次给出有限时间轨迹与小样本条件下热力学推断不确定性的非渐近定量控制，并提供了检测破缺细致平衡（broken detailed balance）的严格判据。摘要未突出说明与已有浓度不等式工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用非渐近（nonasymptotic）概率浓度不等式推导，基于几何遍历扩散过程的数学框架；结合逆热力学不确定关系（inverse thermodynamic uncertainty relations）构造置信区间，用于小样本热力学推断。

papers.title: Non-uniform quantum geometry stabilizes generalized Wigner crystals
papers.abstract: Moiré materials host fractional Chern insulators and electron crystals in close proximity, but the mechanism selecting between them remains an open question. We address this competition in Chern bands with ideal but momentum-dependent quantum geometry -- Aharonov-Casher bands. We present an ansatz wave function for generalized Wigner crystals and, by comparing its energy to that of the competing Laughlin-like state, map out the phase diagram at filling fraction $ν=1/m$ as a function of the degree of geometric non-uniformity. Our work identifies quantum geometry-controlled zero point fluctuations of the charge density of the generalized Wigner crystal as the mechanism controlling its relative stability, implying a kind of quantum Lindemann criterion for the crystal-liquid phase boundary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“ansatz wave function”“comparing its energy”“phase diagram”等理论建模与能量比较关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：摩尔材料中的Chern能带（Aharonov-Casher能带），具体研究广义维格纳晶体与分数量子霍尔（Laughlin型）态之间的竞争，以及量子几何非均匀性对填充因子ν=1/m下相选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子几何的非均匀性通过控制广义维格纳晶体电荷密度的零点涨落来稳定该晶体相，从而决定其与Laughlin型态的相对稳定性；该机制可表述为一种“量子Lindemann判据”用于晶体-液体相边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子几何的非均匀性通过控制广义维格纳晶体电荷密度的零点涨落来稳定该晶体相，从而决定其与Laughlin型态的相对稳定性；该机制可表述为一种“量子Lindemann判据”用于晶体-液体相边界。；创新点：首次将量子几何的非均匀性（而非仅其均匀部分，如Berry曲率）作为控制广义维格纳晶体稳定性的关键参数，并提出量子几何驱动的零点涨落机制作为晶体-液体相变的判据。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于理想但动量依赖的量子几何（Aharonov-Casher能带）构造广义维格纳晶体的变分波函数（ansatz），并将其能量与竞争的Laughlin型态能量进行比较，从而绘制ν=1/m填充下的相图。摘要未提及数值方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）的具体细节。

papers.title: HyperDet Wavefunction: A Phase-Agnostic Ansatz for Strongly Correlated Systems
papers.abstract: Describing competing phases of strongly correlated systems often requires trial wave functions built from phase-specific assumptions. We propose the \emph{hyperdeterminant (HyperDet) wavefunction} as a phase-agnostic ansatz for both bosonic and fermionic quantum many-body systems exhibiting spontaneous symmetry-breaking order, fractionalization, and/or topological order with anyonic excitations. The HyperDet structure emerges naturally by fusing auxiliary fermionic parton Slater determinants into physical orbitals through a fully learnable \emph{fusion tensor} $\mathcal F$. Optimized using variational Monte Carlo, a single HyperDet architecture can achieve exceptionally high overlaps $\geq 99.9\%$ with exact-diagonalization ground states throughout the entire fractional Chern insulator phase in both bosonic and fermionic models, and across their nearby competing phases. We introduce the singular-value spectrum of the \emph{bipartite fusion matrix} as a structural diagnostic of fusion tensor, and find that its redistribution tracks many-body phase transitions without computing phase-specific observables. The optimized fusion tensor also encodes the parton-level topological data: it reproduces the parton Chern numbers expected for the bosonic and fermionic FCI states, completing their field-theory descriptions and the resulting topological order. Its intrinsic gauge structure further determines whether physical symmetries admit virtual lifts and, when faithful lifts exist, extracts their projective class; for the bosonic FCI, this recovers the expected parton translation fractionalization. We thus anticipate the HyperDet wavefunction to be a promising variational platform for both accurate ground-state searches and phase-diagram explorations across strongly correlated phases, and for providing interpretable theoretical insights from parton-level microscopics to field-theory descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：提出新的变分波函数形式（ansatz）、使用变分蒙特卡洛（variational Monte Carlo）优化、与精确对角化（exact diagonalization）结果对比。；研究对象：强关联量子多体系统，具体包括玻色子和费米子模型中的分数量子霍尔/分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）相及其邻近竞争相，涉及自发对称性破缺、分数化、任意子激发和拓扑序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种与具体相无关（phase-agnostic）的“超行列式（HyperDet）波函数”，仅用单一架构即可在玻色子和费米子FCI相全域及其邻近竞争相中达到≥99.9%的基态保真度；其融合张量的奇异值谱重分布可无观测量的追踪多体相变，且融合张量本身编码了部分子拓扑数据（Chern数、投影对称性类）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种与具体相无关（phase-agnostic）的“超行列式（HyperDet）波函数”，仅用单一架构即可在玻色子和费米子FCI相全域及其邻近竞争相中达到≥99.9%的基态保真度；其融合张量的奇异值谱重分布可无观测量的追踪多体相变，且融合张量本身编码了部分子拓扑数据（Chern数、投影对称性类）。；创新点：提出一种不依赖特定相假设的普适变分ansatz，可同时覆盖对称性破缺、分数化和拓扑有序相；首次将融合张量的奇异值谱作为无需相特定观测量的相变诊断工具；证明优化后的融合张量可直接提取部分子级拓扑数据（Chern数、投影量子数），桥接微观部分子图像与场论描述。（摘要未突出说明与具体已有波函数（如Gutzwiller投影、DMRG等）的性能对比细节。）
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：将辅助费米子部分子（parton）Slater行列式通过可学习的“融合张量”$\mathcal F$融合为物理轨道，形成HyperDet波函数；数值方法：变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）优化；验证手段：与精确对角化（ED）基态比较保真度；结构诊断：对二分融合矩阵做奇异值分解（SVD），分析其奇异值谱。

papers.title: Strengthened Silicate Glasses by Residual Stress: Depth of Compression and Surface Flaws Stability Conditions
papers.abstract: The application of silicate glasses in severe service environments requires a precise evaluation of structural strength under mechanical loads and surface tribological conditions. Because glass strength is governed by surface flaws and microcracks rather than being an intrinsic material property, residual surface compression fields, balanced by interior tensile zones, are widely implemented to inhibit flaw opening. Rather than relying on conventional allowable stress criteria to establish product acceptance, this study adopts a fracture mechanics framework based on the stress intensity factor KI and fundamental material limits: the critical stress intensity factor KIC for rapid fracture and the threshold stress intensity factor KIth for time-delayed static fatigue failure. Using the Weight Function Method (WFM), KI is evaluated across generic surface flaw depths for two-dimensional continuous (2D-Continuous) surface cracks subjected to non-uniform internal residual stress fields and external loads. Flaw stability criteria are established for both zero-risk and moderate-risk design methodologies. Finally, the interaction and superposition of externally applied mechanical and thermal stresses with internal residual stress fields are evaluated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：采用断裂力学框架、应力强度因子KI、权函数法（WFM）进行理论分析与计算。；研究对象：受残余应力强化的硅酸盐玻璃，具体关注表面裂纹/微裂纹在非均匀残余应力场及外加载荷下的断裂行为与稳定性条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于应力强度因子KI与材料固有极限（KIC和KIth），建立了表面裂纹在残余压应力场中的稳定性判据，并给出了零风险与中等风险两种设计方法下的裂纹深度与稳定性条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于应力强度因子KI与材料固有极限（KIC和KIth），建立了表面裂纹在残余压应力场中的稳定性判据，并给出了零风险与中等风险两种设计方法下的裂纹深度与稳定性条件。；创新点：摒弃传统许用应力准则，改用基于KI与材料固有断裂极限的断裂力学框架来评估含残余应力玻璃的结构强度，并系统分析了外部机械/热应力与内部残余应力场的叠加效应。摘要未突出说明与以往断裂力学分析的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用权函数法（Weight Function Method, WFM）计算二维连续表面裂纹在非均匀内部残余应力场及外部载荷作用下的应力强度因子KI；结合临界应力强度因子KIC（快速断裂）与阈值应力强度因子KIth（延迟静疲劳失效）建立失效判据。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics of two-dimensional electrons due to scattering by disorder
papers.abstract: The hydrodynamic regime of electron transport, induced by fast inter-electron collisions, was discovered in high-quality nanostructures in recent ten years. However, signs of hydrodynamic transport, primarily, the giant negative magnetoresistance, were observed even at very low temperatures, when electron-electron scattering is too weak to affect the transport. To address this puzzle, here we develop a theory of mixed, hydrodynamic and non-Markovian, magnetotransport of two-dimensional electrons at zero temperature in samples with weak but still important disorder. Namely, we account for both the memory effects at electron scattering by localized defects in magnetic field and an unconventional viscosity effect due to electron scattering by defects in bulk and by rough sample edges. Solution of the model yields a strong negative magnetoresistance, which exhibits at zero magnetic field a sharp maximum in narrower samples or a blunt maximum in wider samples. This and other our results explain various properties of the giant negative magnetoresistance observed on ultra-high-quality GaAs quantum wells, thereby we apparently reveal the nature of low-temperature magnetotransport in these systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“develop a theory”“Solution of the model”等表述，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：二维电子系统中的磁输运现象，具体为超高质量GaAs量子阱中在极低温下观测到的巨负磁电阻效应，以及无序散射（局域缺陷、粗糙边缘）与电子间碰撞共同作用下的流体动力学输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温度、弱无序二维电子系统中，同时考虑非马尔可夫记忆效应（磁场中局域缺陷散射）与非常规黏度效应（体缺陷及粗糙边缘散射）后，模型可产生强负磁电阻；该负磁电阻在零磁场下于窄样品中呈尖锐极大值、在宽样品中呈平缓极大值，从而解释了超高质量GaAs量子阱中巨负磁电阻的低温性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温度、弱无序二维电子系统中，同时考虑非马尔可夫记忆效应（磁场中局域缺陷散射）与非常规黏度效应（体缺陷及粗糙边缘散射）后，模型可产生强负磁电阻；该负磁电阻在零磁场下于窄样品中呈尖锐极大值、在宽样品中呈平缓极大值，从而解释了超高质量GaAs量子阱中巨负磁电阻的低温性质。；创新点：首次在零温度且电子-电子散射不足以主导输运的条件下，将非马尔可夫记忆效应与非常规黏度效应统一纳入二维电子磁输运理论，从而为极低温下巨负磁电阻这一此前难以解释的“谜题”提供了理论机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析/数值求解：构建混合流体动力学与非马尔可夫磁输运模型，同时纳入两类散射机制——局域缺陷散射的记忆效应（磁场相关）以及缺陷与粗糙边缘引起的黏度效应，并求解该模型以获得磁电阻行为。

papers.title: Extrinsic orbital Edelstein effect from asymmetric scattering
papers.abstract: The generation and manipulation of orbital angular momentum (OAM) by an external electric field constitute one of the central themes of orbitronics. In particular, the electrically induced nonequilibrium OAM polarization, known as the orbital Edelstein effect (OEE), has attracted considerable attention in recent years. While the intrinsic band-geometric mechanism and the role of conventional symmetric impurity scattering in the OEE are well understood, the contribution from disorder-induced asymmetric scattering remains unclear. Here, we develop a semiclassical theory that separates the OEE into intrinsic, Drude, side-jump, and third- and fourth-order skew-scattering channels. Unlike the Drude channel, the intrinsic, side-jump, and skew-scattering responses survive only in systems with broken time-reversal symmetry. We find that in a magnetized Rashba two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), these disorder-induced mechanisms can substantially exceed the intrinsic contribution. Remarkably, we find that for a system with Rashba coupling of $1$ $eV Å$, the orbital magnetization is about one order of magnitude larger than the spin magnetization for the chosen parameters, highlighting the crucial role of orbital degrees of freedom in the Edelstein effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a semiclassical theory”（发展半经典理论），属于理论推导与分析。；研究对象：轨道电子学（orbitronics）中的轨道埃德尔斯坦效应（orbital Edelstein effect, OEE），具体体系为磁化 Rashba 二维电子气（magnetized Rashba 2DEG）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁化 Rashba 二维电子气中，由无序引起的非对称散射（侧跳与斜散射）机制对轨道埃德尔斯坦效应的贡献可显著超过本征（能带几何）贡献；在 Rashba 耦合强度为 1 eV Å 时，轨道磁化比自旋磁化大约一个数量级，表明轨道自由度在埃德尔斯坦效应中起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁化 Rashba 二维电子气中，由无序引起的非对称散射（侧跳与斜散射）机制对轨道埃德尔斯坦效应的贡献可显著超过本征（能带几何）贡献；在 Rashba 耦合强度为 1 eV Å 时，轨道磁化比自旋磁化大约一个数量级，表明轨道自由度在埃德尔斯坦效应中起关键作用。；创新点：首次系统区分并定量分析了无序诱导的非对称散射（侧跳与高阶斜散射）对轨道埃德尔斯坦效应的贡献，发现这些机制可远超本征贡献，并揭示了轨道磁化在 Rashba 体系中相对于自旋磁化的主导地位。（摘要未突出说明与具体实验或材料的对比。）
papers.method_zh: 半经典输运理论（semiclassical theory），将 OEE 分解为本征（intrinsic）、Drude、侧跳（side-jump）以及三阶和四阶斜散射（skew-scattering）通道，并分析各通道对时间反演对称性破缺的依赖。

papers.title: Effective Hamiltonian description on monitored Majorana chains: correlated power-law hoppings and unconventional entanglement scaling
papers.abstract: We investigate the structures of effective Hamiltonians governing monitored dynamics of a one-dimensional Majorana chain through the Lyapunov spectral analysis. We focus on a gapless phase characterized by finite-size scalings different from those in conventional critical and/or frustration-free systems; the spectral gap closing faster than $1/L$ but slower than $1/L^2$ and the entanglement entropy growing as $[\ln(L)]^2$ with $L$ being the system size. We find that the corresponding effective Hamiltonians have random long-range power-law hoppings with nontrivial magnitude correlations, rather than being independently and identically distributed. To elucidate the role of these non-Gaussian correlations, we construct random power-law hopping models that capture the essential features of the effective Hamiltonians. The spectral gaps of the constructed models decay faster than $1/L$ but slower than $1/L^2$. We find that, in the absence of hopping correlations, the ground-state entanglement exhibits $\ln(L)$ scaling. In the presence of correlations, by contrast, the entanglement entropy is enhanced and its system-size dependence is consistent with $[\ln(L)]^2$ scaling over the system sizes studied. These results suggest that correlations among long-range hopping magnitudes are responsible for the entanglement scaling that seldom appears in ground states of conventional isolated quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Lyapunov spectral analysis”“effective Hamiltonians”“constructed models”等理论分析与数值建模关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维Majorana链的受监测动力学（monitored dynamics）及其有效哈密顿量，重点研究无间隙相中的有限尺寸标度行为与纠缠熵增长规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 受监测Majorana链的有效哈密顿量具有带非平凡幅度关联的随机长程幂律跳跃，而非独立同分布；这些跳跃幅度之间的关联是导致纠缠熵呈现[ln(L)]²标度的关键因素，该标度在常规孤立量子系统的基态中极为罕见。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：受监测Majorana链的有效哈密顿量具有带非平凡幅度关联的随机长程幂律跳跃，而非独立同分布；这些跳跃幅度之间的关联是导致纠缠熵呈现[ln(L)]²标度的关键因素，该标度在常规孤立量子系统的基态中极为罕见。；创新点：首次揭示受监测Majorana链有效哈密顿量中长程跳跃幅度之间存在非高斯关联，并证明这些关联直接导致非常规的[ln(L)]²纠缠熵标度——该标度在无关联随机模型中仅表现为ln(L)标度，从而将纠缠标度的反常行为归因于跳跃关联而非单纯的长程性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Lyapunov谱分析方法提取受监测动力学的有效哈密顿量；构建随机幂律跳跃模型（含/不含跳跃关联）进行对比，通过数值计算谱隙与基态纠缠熵的有限尺寸标度。

papers.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Compositionally Complex (Gd/Ho/Er/Dy)2Zr2O7 Thin Film Combinatorial Library
papers.abstract: High-throughput synthesis and characterization of novel ceramic materials with improved thermomechanical properties and phase stability are needed to accelerate the discovery of next-generation thermal barrier materials. A combinatorial thin film material library of (GdDyHoEr)2Zr2O7 were created via combinatorial magnetron reactive sputtering with rare-earth/zirconium alloy targets. Structural, chemical, and thermal property characterization mapping across the four component composition space was performed and correlated with thermal transport measurements. Steady state thermoreflectance mapping identifies a pronounced minimum in thermal conductivity within the Dy/Gd-rich quadrant. This minimum does not coincide with either the equiatomic composition or the region predicted to exhibit maximum cation size disorder. Instead, it corresponds to the largest experimentally observed lattice parameter, despite deviating from Vegard-like chemical averaging, and is independent of grain size and whole-pattern microstrain. These observations suggest that the way the fluorite lattice accommodates compositional complexity, rather than cation size disorder alone, provides a more informative descriptor of thermal transport. Overall, this work establishes a high-throughput workflow for combinatorial thin-film synthesis and multimodal characterization, enabling the rapid identification of previously inaccessible structure-property relationships in compositionally complex ceramics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“high-throughput synthesis”“combinatorial magnetron reactive sputtering”“characterization mapping”“thermoreflectance mapping”等实验合成与表征关键词。；研究对象：成分复杂的稀土锆酸盐陶瓷薄膜（Gd/Dy/Ho/Er）₂Zr₂O₇，属于烧绿石/萤石结构体系，关注其热导率与结构-性能关系，面向热障涂层材料应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Dy/Gd富集象限中观测到热导率的显著最小值，该最小值既不对应等原子成分，也不对应最大阳离子尺寸无序区域，而是对应实验观测到的最大晶格常数（尽管偏离Vegard化学平均），且与晶粒尺寸和微应变无关。这表明萤石晶格容纳成分复杂性的方式（而非单纯阳离子尺寸无序）是热输运的更有效描述符。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Dy/Gd富集象限中观测到热导率的显著最小值，该最小值既不对应等原子成分，也不对应最大阳离子尺寸无序区域，而是对应实验观测到的最大晶格常数（尽管偏离Vegard化学平均），且与晶粒尺寸和微应变无关。这表明萤石晶格容纳成分复杂性的方式（而非单纯阳离子尺寸无序）是热输运的更有效描述符。；创新点：建立了组合薄膜合成与多模态表征的高通量工作流程，能够快速识别成分复杂陶瓷中此前难以获取的结构-性能关系；首次指出晶格对成分复杂性的“容纳方式”（以最大实验晶格常数为标志）比阳离子尺寸无序更能预测热导率极值位置。
papers.method_zh: 组合磁控反应溅射（使用稀土/锆合金靶材）制备薄膜组合库；结构表征（X射线衍射等，摘要未明确具体技术名称）；化学组分表征（摘要未明确具体技术名称）；稳态热反射法（steady state thermoreflectance）进行热输运测量并绘制成分-性能图谱；结合晶格参数、晶粒尺寸和微应变分析。

papers.title: Topological Mixing and Braiding Universality in Polar Active Matter
papers.abstract: Connecting the autonomous kinematics of active matter to its emergent macroscopic transport is constrained by the requirement for high-resolution Eulerian velocity fields. Here, we use confined bacterial suspensions as a model active fluid, mapping the sparse Lagrangian trajectories of fluorescent spy cells into (2+1)-dimensional geometric braids that directly encode the spatiotemporal entanglement of the flow. We use the finite-time braiding exponent (FTBE) as a proxy to quantify the topological entropy and chaotic mixing of confined bacterial suspensions. In moderately confined wet systems, we find that hydrodynamic coupling drives a structural transition from a dilute active gas to coherent vortices, and ultimately to active turbulence, revealing three distinct density-dependent regimes of topological mixing. Conversely, truncating the hydrodynamic screening length via extreme confinement drives the system toward a dry active matter limit. In this limit, dense in-plane steric collisions suppress irreducible entanglement and substantially reduce the FTBE at high particle densities. By evaluating the topological complexity generated per encounter, we reveal a transition from a discrete geometric encounter regime to an areal escape mechanism. Finally, we establish a square-root scaling between the FTBE and the effective diffusivity, placing the self-sustained mixing of active fluids into the pathline braiding universality class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论/数据分析结合）。判断依据关键词：confined bacterial suspensions（实验体系）、mapping Lagrangian trajectories into geometric braids（数据分析方法）、finite-time braiding exponent（理论/拓扑工具）。；研究对象：受限细菌悬浮液作为模型活性流体，研究其拓扑混合、混沌输运及活性湍流中的纠缠结构，涵盖从湿活性物质到干活性物质极限的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等受限湿体系中，流体动力学耦合驱动体系经历从稀薄活性气体到相干涡旋、再到活性湍流的结构转变，呈现三个密度依赖的拓扑混合区；在极端受限（干活性极限）下，高密度面内碰撞抑制不可约纠缠并显著降低有限时间编织指数（FTBE）。此外，FTBE与有效扩散系数满足平方根标度关系，表明活性流体自维持混合属于路径线编织普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等受限湿体系中，流体动力学耦合驱动体系经历从稀薄活性气体到相干涡旋、再到活性湍流的结构转变，呈现三个密度依赖的拓扑混合区；在极端受限（干活性极限）下，高密度面内碰撞抑制不可约纠缠并显著降低有限时间编织指数（FTBE）。此外，FTBE与有效扩散系数满足平方根标度关系，表明活性流体自维持混合属于路径线编织普适类。；创新点：首次将编织拓扑方法（FTBE）应用于活性物质实验轨迹，建立从离散几何碰撞到面逃逸机制的转变判据，并将活性流体混合行为归入路径线编织普适类。摘要未突出说明与传统拓扑混合度量（如有限时间李雅普诺夫指数）相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用荧光示踪细胞获取稀疏拉格朗日轨迹，将其映射为(2+1)维几何编织；理论上采用有限时间编织指数（FTBE）量化拓扑熵与混沌混合强度，并通过改变受限程度调控流体动力学屏蔽长度以探索干/湿极限。

papers.title: Mechanistic Framework for Multicomponent Nanoparticle Assembly: Predicting RNA-lipid and PEI-DNA nanoparticle assembly
papers.abstract: The assembly of multicomponent nanoparticles is often kinetically controlled and exhibits strong pathway dependence. Transport, solvent exchange, nucleation/growth, and collision-driven coalescence together determine not only ensemble-averaged properties but also particle-to-particle compositional heterogeneity. Here, we present a computational modeling framework for predicting nanoparticle property distributions by coupling processing conditions, early-stage self-assembly physics, and molecular chemical details with kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations. The framework combines (i) mixing conditions with solvent-exchange-mediated particle initialization and growth, and (ii) kMC simulations that resolve stochastic collision histories, electrostatics-controlled coalescence, and composition at the level of individual particles. Applied to mRNA lipid nanoparticles, the model predicts size-loading correlations and provides insight into how processing-dependent assembly pathways lead to heterogeneous payload distributions. The kMC simulations further provide merging lineage histories, which explain the emergence of log-normal volume and payload distributions through multiplicative particle-growth pathways. The same framework is also applied to PEI-DNA polyelectrolytic complexation, yielding single-particle-resolved DNA-PEI stoichiometry distributions. The framework and its open-source implementation, FormLNP, provide a process-aware route to predicting and controlling single-particle property distributions across a broad range of multicomponent nanoparticle systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：computational modeling framework、kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations、open-source implementation。；研究对象：多组分纳米颗粒的自组装过程，具体包括mRNA脂质纳米颗粒（RNA-lipid nanoparticles）和PEI-DNA聚电解质复合物（polyelectrolytic complexation）两类体系，关注其粒径分布、载荷分布及颗粒间组成异质性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架通过耦合加工条件、早期自组装物理和分子化学细节，能够预测多组分纳米颗粒的单颗粒性质分布，并揭示对数正态体积与载荷分布源于乘法式颗粒生长路径（碰撞驱动的聚并历史）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架通过耦合加工条件、早期自组装物理和分子化学细节，能够预测多组分纳米颗粒的单颗粒性质分布，并揭示对数正态体积与载荷分布源于乘法式颗粒生长路径（碰撞驱动的聚并历史）。；创新点：提出了一个将加工条件、早期自组装物理与分子化学细节统一纳入kMC模拟的通用计算框架，能够解析单颗粒分辨的组成异质性（如DNA-PEI化学计量比分布），并给出颗粒合并谱系历史以解释对数正态分布的涌现机制。摘要未突出说明与已有模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟，耦合（i）混合条件与溶剂交换介导的颗粒初始化及生长，以及（ii）解析随机碰撞历史、静电控制的聚并和单颗粒水平组成的随机模拟。框架以开源软件FormLNP形式提供。

papers.title: Hierarchical automation of scanning probe microscopy through agentic orchestration and algorithmic control
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in agentic artificial intelligence enable scientific systems to interpret open-ended objectives, combine heterogeneous information, invoke specialized tools, and revise experimental strategies as evidence accumulates. However, physical experimentation also contains many tasks for which agentic reasoning provides little advantage and can reduce reliability. Quantitative analysis, optimization, spatial targeting, validation, and instrument execution are often better posed as deterministic or algorithmic operations with explicit objectives and verifiable outputs. Here, we introduce a hierarchical architecture for autonomous experimentation that separates these roles. Agentic components interpret scientific intent, construct task-dependent experimental representations, evaluate accumulated evidence, and select high-level actions, whereas deterministic algorithms perform numerical analysis, coordinate selection, validation, and physical execution. We implement this architecture in piezoresponse force microscopy. Starting from a broad scientific question concerning the relation between local domain structure and polarization switching, the system constructs spatial descriptors from multichannel imaging, selects and analyzes local hysteresis measurements, adapts the spectroscopy waveform, and terminates the experiment when additional measurements cease to provide new evidence. The autonomous trajectory also identifies a confounding relationship between polarization state and domain-wall proximity and recognizes that the requested contrast is not independently represented within the available field of view. These results demonstrate a route toward scientific autonomy in which agents determine what evidence is required while algorithms determine how that evidence is acquired reproducibly and within validated physical constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+算法/架构设计）。判断依据：摘要涉及“piezoresponse force microscopy”物理实验实现，同时提出“hierarchical architecture”“agentic orchestration”“deterministic algorithms”等自主实验控制架构与算法设计。；研究对象：扫描探针显微镜（SPM）的自主化运行，具体体系为压电响应力显微镜（PFM），研究物理现象为局域铁电畴结构与极化翻转（polarization switching）之间的关系，以及极化态与畴壁邻近度之间的混淆关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种将智能体（agentic）推理与确定性算法分离的分层自主实验架构，并在PFM中实现从科学问题出发、自主构建空间描述符、选择并分析局域滞回测量、自适应调整谱学波形、直至证据饱和后自动终止实验的完整闭环。系统还自主识别出极化态与畴壁邻近度之间的混淆关系，并发现所请求的对比度在可用视场内并非独立表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种将智能体（agentic）推理与确定性算法分离的分层自主实验架构，并在PFM中实现从科学问题出发、自主构建空间描述符、选择并分析局域滞回测量、自适应调整谱学波形、直至证据饱和后自动终止实验的完整闭环。系统还自主识别出极化态与畴壁邻近度之间的混淆关系，并发现所请求的对比度在可用视场内并非独立表征。；创新点：将自主实验中的“智能决策”与“确定性执行”明确分层，避免智能体推理介入本应算法化的定量分析与仪器控制环节，从而在提升自主性的同时保证可重复性与物理约束有效性。摘要未突出说明与已有自主实验框架（如贝叶斯优化、主动学习）的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用压电响应力显微镜（PFM），包括多通道成像、局域滞回（hysteresis）谱学测量与谱学波形自适应调整。架构上采用分层控制：智能体组件负责科学意图解析、实验表征构建、证据评估与高层动作选择；确定性算法负责数值分析、坐标选择、验证与物理执行。

papers.title: Quenched complexity of marginal states in the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin glass
papers.abstract: In the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model the exponentially many metastable states are marginal, so counting them requires breaking the BRST supersymmetry or a two-group replica Ansatz. For four decades this complexity was known only in the annealed approximation, which is unstable at low free energy and predicts states below the Parisi equilibrium free energy. We compute it quenched, with one step of replica symmetry breaking. It leaves the annealed curve where it becomes unstable and vanishes next to the full-RSB equilibrium free energy: the lowest marginal states are thus plausibly the equilibrium states themselves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及模型理论计算、BRST超对称、replica对称性破缺等理论概念，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：Sherrington–Kirkpatrick（SK）自旋玻璃模型中的亚稳态（marginal states）及其复杂性（complexity，即态数目的指数增长率）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者在一步复制对称破缺（1RSB）框架下完成了对边缘态复杂性的淬火（quenched）计算，结果表明该淬火复杂性曲线在退火近似失稳处脱离退火曲线，并在全复制对称破缺（full-RSB）平衡自由能附近消失，暗示最低边缘态很可能就是平衡态本身。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者在一步复制对称破缺（1RSB）框架下完成了对边缘态复杂性的淬火（quenched）计算，结果表明该淬火复杂性曲线在退火近似失稳处脱离退火曲线，并在全复制对称破缺（full-RSB）平衡自由能附近消失，暗示最低边缘态很可能就是平衡态本身。；创新点：首次实现了SK模型中边缘态复杂性的淬火计算（此前四十年来仅有退火近似结果，且退火近似在低自由能区域不稳定并预言低于Parisi平衡自由能的态），修正了退火近似的失效行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：BRST超对称破缺或两组复制（two-group replica）Ansatz；具体采用一步复制对称破缺（1RSB）方案进行淬火平均计算，并与退火（annealed）近似结果对比。

papers.title: Designing corrugated surfaces to guide colloidal self-assembly
papers.abstract: The self-assembly of colloidal particles enables the creation of structured materials with programmable functionalities; however, controlling interaction specificity and aggregate morphology in a reversible and scalable manner remains a major challenge. Here, we investigate the selective depletion-induced self-assembly of 3D-printed flat polygonal colloids, where nanoscale surface topography is engineered through precise modeling in two-photon polymerization. By designing anisotropic lateral surfaces, we direct specific interactions that govern aggregate morphology, yielding dimers, chains, zigzag, and honeycomb structures depending on the surface configuration. The specificity of interaction is tuned by varying the length scale of the topographic surfaces, the depletant concentration and the ionic strength of the solution, revealing a transition from selective to non-selective aggregation regimes. The relative placement of lateral interacting surfaces on the colloids enables assembly into aggregates spanning a broad range of sizes, while tuning the interaction strength selectively stabilizes distinct structural motifs. We demonstrate this interplay between geometric arrangement and interaction energy experimentally and corroborate through both theory and simulations for specifically hexagonal shaped colloids. This study establishes a versatile framework for programming colloidal interactions via micro-architectural design, offering new routes for fabricating reconfigurable and functional soft materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以理论与模拟）。判断依据关键词：experimentally、theory and simulations、3D-printed、two-photon polymerization。；研究对象：三维打印的扁平多边形胶体颗粒（如六边形胶体），以及通过纳米级表面形貌工程调控的耗散力诱导自组装行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在扁平多边形胶体侧面设计各向异性的纳米级表面起伏（corrugated surfaces），可以精确控制颗粒间的选择性相互作用，从而引导形成二聚体、链状、之字形和蜂窝状等多种聚集形态；相互作用特异性可通过表面起伏长度尺度、耗散剂浓度和离子强度进行连续调节，实现从选择性到非选择性聚集的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在扁平多边形胶体侧面设计各向异性的纳米级表面起伏（corrugated surfaces），可以精确控制颗粒间的选择性相互作用，从而引导形成二聚体、链状、之字形和蜂窝状等多种聚集形态；相互作用特异性可通过表面起伏长度尺度、耗散剂浓度和离子强度进行连续调节，实现从选择性到非选择性聚集的转变。；创新点：提出了一种通过微米/纳米尺度几何形貌设计（而非化学修饰）来编程胶体相互作用特异性的通用框架，将表面拓扑工程与耗散力自组装相结合，为可重构软材料的制备提供了新途径。摘要未明确说明该工作与具体已有工作的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双光子聚合三维打印制备具有精确表面形貌的扁平多边形胶体，结合耗散剂浓度和离子强度调控进行自组装实验观测；理论上辅以理论建模和数值模拟（针对六边形胶体体系）验证实验现象。

papers.title: Evolution of electron spin resonance through a metallic quantum critical phase diagram
papers.abstract: In the heavy-fermion metal YbRh2Si2, quantum criticality at a suppressed antiferromagnetic order is governed by the interplay of local magnetic moments and itinerant conduction electrons. We demonstrate how this can be investigated by a new experimental approach that enables the observation of electron spin resonance (ESR) across a broad range of frequencies and fields at very low temperatures. This allowed us to cover a large part of the phase diagram from the paramagnetic Fermi-liquid phase to the phase with antiferromagnetic order and including the quantum-critical regime. Both the ESR g-factor and the linewidth present distinct behaviors in these three regimes, providing further insight into the physics across a quantum critical point. Notably, when cooling down at a field directly towards the quantum critical point, both g-factor and linewidth continuously decrease. Furthermore, we observe a very good matching of the g-factor behavior upon field-tuning and temperature-tuning towards the quantum-critical point. We analyze and discuss the results in the context of present theories on ESR in strongly correlated electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“new experimental approach”“observation of electron spin resonance (ESR)”“we observe”等实验性表述。；研究对象：重费米子金属 YbRh2Si2，具体研究其被抑制的反铁磁序附近的量子临界性，以及局域磁矩与巡游传导电子相互作用主导的量子临界相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过新型ESR实验手段，在极低温下覆盖了从顺磁费米液体到反铁磁有序相再到量子临界区的宽范围相图，发现ESR g因子和线宽在三个区域呈现截然不同的行为；在直接冷却向量子临界点时，g因子和线宽均持续减小，且场调谐与温度调谐向量子临界点的g因子行为高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过新型ESR实验手段，在极低温下覆盖了从顺磁费米液体到反铁磁有序相再到量子临界区的宽范围相图，发现ESR g因子和线宽在三个区域呈现截然不同的行为；在直接冷却向量子临界点时，g因子和线宽均持续减小，且场调谐与温度调谐向量子临界点的g因子行为高度吻合。；创新点：实现了在极低温下跨越宽频率和磁场范围对ESR的观测，从而首次能够覆盖从顺磁费米液体到反铁磁有序相再到量子临界区的完整相图，并揭示g因子与线宽在三个区域中的不同演化规律。摘要未突出说明与已有ESR研究相比的其他具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 极低温、宽频率和宽磁场范围内的电子自旋共振（ESR）测量，用于系统扫描相图的不同区域。

papers.title: Boundary- and Screening-Induced Bubbly Phases in Autophoretic Active Matter
papers.abstract: Spatial confinement and chemical screening fundamentally reshape the non-equilibrium phase behavior of autophoretic active particles. Here, we present a systematic study mapping the collective dynamics of self-propelled particles governed by chemo-attractive translational forces ($μ_t < 0$) and chemo-repulsive rotational torques ($μ_r > 0$) across varying screening parameters $κ$, torque magnitudes $μ_r$, and boundary condition coefficients $Λ^c$. Beyond standard chemotactic macro-phase separation and dynamic clustering, we report the emergence of novel boundary- and screening-induced bubbly phases, classified into boiling and bursting bubbles. Using a metric triad of steady-state cluster fraction $\langle S \rangle$, temporal fluctuation magnitude $σ_S$, and coordination number $\langle Q \rangle$, we draw phase diagrams to demarcate phases for no-flux boundaries ($Λ^c = 1$) and chemically permeable interfaces ($Λ^c = 0$) . Increasing chemical screening ($κ$) systematically suppresses long-range attraction, driving sequential phase transitions from macro-scale collapse toward bubbly states, dynamic micro-clusters, and homogeneous gas phases, while simultaneously inducing aggregate shape anisotropy. These findings provide predictive design rules for controlling active assembly and transport in microfluidic environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“systematic study mapping”“phase diagrams”“metric triad”等系统性数值模拟与相图构建关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：自泳活性粒子（autophoretic active particles）体系，具体为受化学吸引平移力（μ_t < 0）与化学排斥旋转力矩（μ_r > 0）驱动的自推进粒子，在空间受限与化学筛选作用下的非平衡集体相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标准趋化宏观相分离与动态团簇之外，发现了由边界条件与化学筛选诱导的新型“气泡相”（bubbly phases），分为沸腾型（boiling）与爆裂型（bursting）两类；增大化学筛选强度κ会抑制长程吸引，驱动体系从宏观塌缩依次经历气泡态、动态微团簇直至均匀气相的连续相变，并伴随聚集体形状各向异性增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标准趋化宏观相分离与动态团簇之外，发现了由边界条件与化学筛选诱导的新型“气泡相”（bubbly phases），分为沸腾型（boiling）与爆裂型（bursting）两类；增大化学筛选强度κ会抑制长程吸引，驱动体系从宏观塌缩依次经历气泡态、动态微团簇直至均匀气相的连续相变，并伴随聚集体形状各向异性增强。；创新点：首次系统揭示边界条件（无通量 vs 化学可渗透）与化学筛选共同诱导的两类新型气泡相（沸腾与爆裂），并建立基于三度量指标的完整相图，为微流控环境中活性组装与输运提供预测性设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟与相图分析。采用稳态团簇分数⟨S⟩、时间涨落幅度σ_S、配位数⟨Q⟩构成的三元度量指标，系统扫描筛选参数κ、力矩强度μ_r及边界条件系数Λ^c（分别考察无通量边界Λ^c=1与化学可渗透界面Λ^c=0），绘制相图划分不同相区。

papers.title: Strongly anisotropic non-Kramers electron spin as a quantum coherence probe of angular fluctuations
papers.abstract: Strongly anisotropic non-Kramers rare-earth ions combine giant longitudinal g-factors with a vanishing transverse component imposed by time-reversal symmetry, a combination that makes their spin transitions exquisitely sensitive to the orientation of the applied magnetic field. We show that this sensitivity carries a dual identity: it is simultaneously an overlooked decoherence channel and the basis for a spin-coherence-based angular probe. Using pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance at X-band, we report the first measurements of the quantum coherence of Tb$^{3+}$ in a native-doped CaWO$_4$ crystal (15 ppb) and map the Hahn-echo coherence time $T_2$ as a function of temperature (2 to 10 K) and resonant field ($10^3$ to $10^4$ G). A parameter-free model combining spin-lattice relaxation, instantaneous diffusion and spectral diffusion from all independently quantified impurities overestimates $T_2$ by an order of magnitude at low temperature and wrongly predicts the field dependence of $T_2$, inconsistent with the observed monotonic decrease of $T_2$ with $B_r$. A two-parameter extension, including dynamical angular fluctuations of the crystal axis, reproduces the full dataset across multiple setups and laboratories. Two controlled experiments nominally identical except for different mechanical configuration of the setup establish the mechanical origin of the dominant contribution. The two-parameter extension corresponds to an angular amplitude noise spectral density of overall order 36 n°/$\sqrt{Hz}$ from global external vibrations (ranging from 10 to 66 n°/$\sqrt{Hz}$ depending on the exact setup mechanical configuration) estimated at $\sim$ 2.5 kHz plus a temperature-dependent contribution assumed to come from local phonon-driven angular jitter. It identifies and highlights a decoherence pathway of practical relevance to any anisotropic solid-state spin system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用X波段脉冲电子顺磁共振”“报告首次测量”“两个受控实验”等实验关键词，并包含与理论模型的对比。；研究对象：天然掺杂CaWO₄晶体中的Tb³⁺离子（非Kramers稀土离子，浓度15 ppb），以及其自旋量子相干性对晶体轴角度涨落的敏感性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Tb³⁺自旋的强各向异性使其量子相干时间T₂对晶体轴的角度涨落极其敏感；这种角度涨落（主要来自外部机械振动，约36 n°/√Hz量级）是一个此前被忽视的退相干通道，也是基于自旋相干的角度探测手段的基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Tb³⁺自旋的强各向异性使其量子相干时间T₂对晶体轴的角度涨落极其敏感；这种角度涨落（主要来自外部机械振动，约36 n°/√Hz量级）是一个此前被忽视的退相干通道，也是基于自旋相干的角度探测手段的基础。；创新点：首次测量了CaWO₄中Tb³⁺的量子相干性，并揭示强各向异性非Kramers离子中“角度涨落”作为普遍退相干通道的机制——该机制对任何各向异性固态自旋体系具有实际意义。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: X波段脉冲电子顺磁共振（EPR），测量Hahn回波相干时间T₂随温度（2–10 K）和共振磁场（10³–10⁴ G）的变化；结合无参数模型（含自旋-晶格弛豫、瞬时扩散和谱扩散）与两参数扩展模型（引入动力学角度涨落）进行对比分析；并设计了两组仅机械构型不同的受控实验以验证振动来源。

papers.title: Three-observable measurement of the critical velocity in a paraxial superfluid of light flowing past a mobile impurity
papers.abstract: We report the measurement of the critical velocity of a paraxial superfluid of light flowing past a mobile impurity, realized using a dual-wavelength optical scheme in a warm vapor of $^{87}\text{Rb}$. The superflow is two-dimensional by nature, while the impurity features a highly repulsive potential, a large tunable radius, and a finite mass. The critical velocity is evaluated by simultaneously monitoring three complementary observables: the number of vortices nucleated in the wake of the impurity, the hydrodynamic force exerted on it, and its displacement velocity relative to the flow. These independent methods yield consistent values for the critical velocity, which remain systematically below the Landau criterion and decrease with the impurity radius, in qualitative agreement with theoretical expectations. Our results demonstrate the reliability of these combined diagnostics, establishing paraxial superfluids of light as a versatile platform for exploring the impurity problem in quantum hydrodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We report the measurement”“realized using”“evaluated by simultaneously monitoring”等表述，属于实验测量工作。；研究对象：二维傍轴光超流体（paraxial superfluid of light）中流动经过一个可移动杂质（mobile impurity）时的临界速度现象。实验体系为$^{87}$Rb热原子蒸气中的双波长光学方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三种互补观测量（尾流中涡旋数、作用在杂质上的水动力、杂质相对流动的位移速度）同时测量，得到一致的临界速度值；该值系统低于Landau判据，并随杂质半径增大而减小，与理论预期定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三种互补观测量（尾流中涡旋数、作用在杂质上的水动力、杂质相对流动的位移速度）同时测量，得到一致的临界速度值；该值系统低于Landau判据，并随杂质半径增大而减小，与理论预期定性一致。；创新点：首次在傍轴光超流体中利用三种独立观测量联合诊断临界速度，验证了这些组合诊断的可靠性，并将该体系确立为研究量子流体力学中杂质问题的多功能平台。摘要未突出说明与已有光超流体实验相比的具体技术突破。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双波长光学方案在$^{87}$Rb热蒸气中实现二维傍轴光超流体，杂质具有强排斥势、大且可调的半径及有限质量。临界速度通过同时监测三个观测量获得：尾流涡旋数目、水动力、杂质位移速度。

papers.title: Electromechanical Domain Wall Propagation in Dielectric Elastomers: An Exact Geometric Resolution via Conformal Mapping
papers.abstract: The localized electromechanical phase transition in dielectric elastomers involves complex moving boundaries and severe electrostatic fringe fields driven by high-curvature interfaces. Traditional phenomenological models fundamentally underestimate the configurational forces by completely ignoring the in-plane electric field components and geometric singularities. Here, we present a asymptotically exact geometric framework to resolve the domain wall propagation. By mapping the highly deformed current configuration to a regular parametric strip via conformal mapping, the field singularities are algebraically eliminated. An exact integration by parts directly translates the higher-order geometric metric into a rigorous topological mass term, projecting the global conformal electrostatics into a non-linear $σ$-model Lagrangian density. Incorporating the Gent strain-stiffening model, the continuous translation symmetry yields a Hamiltonian first integral. Eigenvalue analysis and Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) bound calculations prove that the domain wall emerges strictly as an asymmetric heteroclinic orbit connecting two saddle points. This geometric resolution provides exact analytical scalings for the localized interface energy, domain wall thickness, and asymptotic decay lengths, eliminating all phenomenological parameters and offering a deterministic paradigm for geometric instabilities in active soft matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“asymptotically exact geometric framework”“conformal mapping”“Lagrangian density”“BPS bound calculations”等纯理论推导与解析分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：介电弹性体中的局域机电相变与畴壁（domain wall）传播问题，具体关注高曲率界面引起的静电边缘场和移动边界下的几何不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共形映射将高度变形的电流构型映射为规则参数条带，可精确消除场奇异性，并证明畴壁严格表现为连接两个鞍点的不对称异宿轨道（heteroclinic orbit），从而给出界面能、畴壁厚度及渐近衰减长度的精确解析标度，完全消除唯象参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共形映射将高度变形的电流构型映射为规则参数条带，可精确消除场奇异性，并证明畴壁严格表现为连接两个鞍点的不对称异宿轨道（heteroclinic orbit），从而给出界面能、畴壁厚度及渐近衰减长度的精确解析标度，完全消除唯象参数。；创新点：传统唯象模型完全忽略面内电场分量和几何奇异性，从而从根本上低估构型力；本工作首次提供渐近精确的几何框架，将高阶几何度量严格转化为拓扑质量项，实现无唯象参数的确定性解析解，为活性软物质中的几何不稳定性提供范式。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为共形映射 + 非线性σ模型：将全局共形静电学投影为非线性σ模型拉格朗日密度，结合Gent应变硬化模型，利用连续平移对称性得到哈密顿第一积分；通过本征值分析和Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield（BPS）界计算证明畴壁解的拓扑性质。

papers.title: Hierarchy of topological superconductivity generated via heterostructures of unconventional $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: A theoretical framework is proposed to engineer both first and second-order topological superconducting phases in a two-dimensional (2D) heterostructure, consisting of a quantum spin Hall insulator (QSHI) and an unconventional $p$-wave magnet in presence of proximity-induced $s$-wave superconducting pairing. Our analysis establishes that the transitions between the trivial and topological superconducting (TSC) phases can be regulated though the parameters of $p$-wave magnet. Presence of chiral symmetry leads to the characterization of both types of TSC phases by the respective invariants, one-dimensional winding number and quadrupolar winding number. These results are supplemented by an analytical effective low-energy edge theory that yields a deeper insight into the emergence of the different topological phases of the system. Bulk pairing analysis reveals the competition between the effective $(p_x+p_y)$ and $(p_x+ip_y)$ type pairings that are governed by the intrinsic spin-orbit coupling inherited to the QSHI and spin-split bands of the $p$-wave magnet, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“theoretical framework”“analytical effective low-energy edge theory”“analysis”等关键词，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：二维异质结体系，由量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（QSHI）与非传统p波磁体构成，并引入邻近效应诱导的s波超导配对。研究聚焦于该体系中一阶与二阶拓扑超导相的产生与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该异质结体系可实现一阶与二阶拓扑超导相，且平庸与拓扑超导相之间的转变可通过p波磁体的参数进行调控；体系中的手征对称性允许用一维绕数（winding number）和四极绕数（quadrupolar winding number）分别表征两类拓扑超导相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该异质结体系可实现一阶与二阶拓扑超导相，且平庸与拓扑超导相之间的转变可通过p波磁体的参数进行调控；体系中的手征对称性允许用一维绕数（winding number）和四极绕数（quadrupolar winding number）分别表征两类拓扑超导相。；创新点：提出利用非传统p波磁体与QSHI的异质结构造并调控一阶和二阶拓扑超导相的统一理论框架，并通过体态配对分析阐明了两种有效配对通道的竞争机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：基于对称性分析的拓扑不变量计算（一维绕数与四极绕数）、解析有效低能边缘理论（edge theory），以及体态配对分析（bulk pairing analysis），用于揭示有效(p_x+p_y)型与(p_x+ip_y)型配对之间的竞争关系。

papers.title: Experimentally constrained modeling of the Pockels response of KNbO3 and KTaNbO3
papers.abstract: The soft-mode of electro-optic (EO) metal-oxide perovskites plays a critical role in determining their Pockels responses. This is the case of potassium tantalate niobate (KTN), which exhibits an intrinsic Pockels response 2.5 times larger than that of state-of-the-art barium titanate (BTO), highlighting its potential for high-performance EO applications. By combining ab initio calculations at the density-functional theory level and far-IR measurements, we reveal that the harmonic approximation combined with semi-local exchange-correlation functionals fails to accurately capture the soft transverse optical (TO) Slater mode of both potassium niobate and KTN, which dominates the technologically relevant r51 Pockels coefficient. Replacing the calculated mode frequency with its measured value provides an experimentally constrained approach that substantially improves the predicted Pockels response. For that purpose, the previously unreported TO Slater-mode frequency of KTN is extracted from far-IR reflectivity measurements. The results emphasize the potential of KTN-based EO modulators as an alternative to standard lithium niobate and BTO technologies, with a potentially lower energy consumption and device footprint.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：ab initio calculations（第一性原理计算）、far-IR measurements（远红外测量）、far-IR reflectivity measurements（远红外反射率测量）。；研究对象：电光氧化物钙钛矿材料铌酸钾（KNbO₃）和钽铌酸钾（KTN，KTaNbO₃），具体研究其Pockels电光响应及主导该响应的软TO Slater模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谐波近似结合半局域交换关联泛函无法准确描述KNbO₃和KTN中软TO Slater模的频率，而用实验测量值替换计算值可显著改善Pockels系数的预测精度；KTN的固有Pockels响应比钛酸钡（BTO）大2.5倍，有望成为低能耗、小尺寸的电光调制器替代材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谐波近似结合半局域交换关联泛函无法准确描述KNbO₃和KTN中软TO Slater模的频率，而用实验测量值替换计算值可显著改善Pockels系数的预测精度；KTN的固有Pockels响应比钛酸钡（BTO）大2.5倍，有望成为低能耗、小尺寸的电光调制器替代材料。；创新点：提出“实验约束建模”策略——将计算得到的软模频率替换为实验测量值，从而大幅提升Pockels响应的预测准确性；首次报道了KTN的TO Slater模频率。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）级别的第一性原理计算（采用谐波近似和半局域交换关联泛函）；远红外反射率测量（用于提取KTN此前未报道的TO Slater模频率，并约束理论计算）。

papers.title: Performance of Nanoring-based Transparent Conductors: a Computational Investigation
papers.abstract: Metallic nanoring networks can serve as promising flexible transparent electrodes. These materials are crucial components in a wide range of applications, including solar cells, touchscreens and displays. In this work, a computational investigation considers in detail (i) the electrical conductance and optical performance of nanoring networks and (ii) the breakdown of these networks due to electrical damage. The electrical resistance of both the nanorings and the contacts between the rings (junctions) is taken into account. In part (i), the effects of 5 parameters on the electrical sheet resistance and optical transparency are presented. It is shown that several parameter combinations achieve better performance in comparison to indium tin oxide, currently the most widely used transparent electrode. In part (ii), due to electrical damage, the nanoring systems display the formation of a crack, running parallel to the vertical terminals, where a voltage difference is applied. The network degradation is measured by its sheet resistance, and a universal effect is observed: networks with varying filling factors exhibit the same degradation profile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“computational investigation”。；研究对象：金属纳米环网络（metallic nanoring networks），用作柔性透明电极材料；研究其导电性、光学透过性以及电损伤导致的网络断裂行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米环网络在多种参数组合下，其电学薄层电阻与光学透明性可优于目前最广泛使用的透明电极材料氧化铟锡（ITO）；在电损伤过程中，不同填充因子的网络表现出**普适的退化曲线**（相同的电阻退化轮廓）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米环网络在多种参数组合下，其电学薄层电阻与光学透明性可优于目前最广泛使用的透明电极材料氧化铟锡（ITO）；在电损伤过程中，不同填充因子的网络表现出**普适的退化曲线**（相同的电阻退化轮廓）。；创新点：首次系统性地对纳米环网络的电学与光学性能进行多参数计算优化，并揭示了电损伤退化行为的普适性（与填充因子无关）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 计算模拟方法，具体手段摘要未明确说明（未提及具体算法或软件）。研究中系统考察了5个参数对薄层电阻和光学透明度的影响，并模拟了电压作用下裂纹沿垂直方向扩展导致的网络退化过程。

papers.title: Tunable Chern superconductivity of PtBi$_2$ in slab geometry
papers.abstract: Recent experiments indicate that PtBi$_2$ is a Weyl semimetal whose surfaces become topological superconductors with i-wave gap symmetry at low temperature. The bulk hosts 12 Weyl cones while in the superconducting state each of the two surfaces hosts in addition 6 Majorana cones. We study a simplified model in a slab geometry, where the finite thickness gaps out the bulk Weyl cones and leaves the surface Majorana cones as the low-energy degrees of freedom. We identify two competing mechanisms that gap these cones: inter-cone hybridization opens a trivial gap, whereas a Zeeman field opens a nontrivial one. In the nontrivial regime, chiral Majorana edge modes connect the gapped cones. We determine their wavefunction profile and relate it to the momentum-space distribution of the cones. Mapping out the phase diagram, we find both trivial and nontrivial regions in the quasi-two-dimensional limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We study a simplified model”“We identify”“We determine”“Mapping out the phase diagram”等理论建模与分析表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：PtBi₂ 在有限厚度（slab）几何结构中的超导态，具体关注其表面拓扑超导性、Majorana 锥以及可调谐的 Chern 超导行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 slab 几何中，体态 Weyl 锥被有限厚度能隙消除，表面 Majorana 锥成为低能自由度；锥间杂化打开平庸能隙，而 Zeeman 场打开非平庸能隙，在非平庸区域出现连接被能隙化锥的手性 Majorana 边缘模，准二维极限下相图同时包含平庸与非平庸区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 slab 几何中，体态 Weyl 锥被有限厚度能隙消除，表面 Majorana 锥成为低能自由度；锥间杂化打开平庸能隙，而 Zeeman 场打开非平庸能隙，在非平庸区域出现连接被能隙化锥的手性 Majorana 边缘模，准二维极限下相图同时包含平庸与非平庸区域。；创新点：在 slab 几何中系统研究 PtBi₂ 表面 Majorana 锥的竞争能隙机制，建立了平庸与非平庸 Chern 超导相图，并将边缘模波函数与锥在动量空间的分布联系起来。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析/数值分析：采用简化的 slab 几何模型，通过有限厚度效应消除体态 Weyl 锥，分析表面 Majorana 锥的两种竞争能隙机制（锥间杂化与 Zeeman 场），计算边缘模波函数并绘制相图。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚对角化或连续模型求解）。

papers.title: Equivalence classes of finite-time transitions in optimal control and non-equilibrium relaxation
papers.abstract: We present a theory for the optimal control of stochastic systems in structured environments, represented by penalty terms in the cost functional. We show that such control problems generically feature sharp finite-time transitions associated with a qualitative change in the control strategy at a critical time. Starting from an overdamped Langevin equation and a quadratic cost functional, we show that all resulting problems fall into three canonical equivalence classes (parabolic, hyperbolic, and elliptic), distinguished by the sign of the determinant of the control Hamiltonian. For each class, we obtain the optimal protocol, the cost function, and the critical time in closed form, and show that the transition exhibits features of a continuous phase transition at mean-field level. We then establish a mapping between the optimal control cost and the large-deviation rate function governing non-equilibrium relaxation after a potential quench. The mapping covers the parabolic and hyperbolic classes, while the elliptic class has no simple relaxation counterpart. This correspondence implies that recently discovered finite-time dynamical phase transitions, which are exponentially costly to sample directly, are accessible through ordinary averages over optimally controlled trajectories. To validate our theoretical findings, we report three experiments with optically trapped colloidal particles: a control transition for the mean stochastic work, and the finite-time dynamical phase transitions in free diffusion and in harmonic relaxation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确给出“We present a theory”“We show”“We establish a mapping”等理论推导表述，同时末尾报告了“three experiments with optically trapped colloidal particles”，属于理论为主、实验为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：随机系统（过阻尼朗之万动力学）在结构化环境中的最优控制问题，以及非平衡弛豫中的有限时间动力学相变。具体体系为光镊束缚的胶体粒子（自由扩散和谐波势弛豫）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有此类最优控制问题可归为三类规范等价类（抛物型、双曲型、椭圆型），由控制哈密顿量行列式符号区分；最优控制代价与非平衡弛豫的大偏差率函数之间存在映射关系，使得原本指数级难以直接采样的有限时间动力学相变可通过最优控制轨迹的普通平均来观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有此类最优控制问题可归为三类规范等价类（抛物型、双曲型、椭圆型），由控制哈密顿量行列式符号区分；最优控制代价与非平衡弛豫的大偏差率函数之间存在映射关系，使得原本指数级难以直接采样的有限时间动力学相变可通过最优控制轨迹的普通平均来观测。；创新点：建立了最优控制问题与有限时间动力学相变之间的普适等价类分类（抛物/双曲/椭圆），并首次提出通过最优控制轨迹的普通平均来间接观测指数级难以直接采样的动力学相变，且用胶体实验验证了该对应关系。摘要未突出说明与已有最优控制或相变理论的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：过阻尼朗之万方程 + 二次型代价泛函的最优控制理论，控制哈密顿量分类分析，闭式求解最优协议、代价函数和临界时间，平均场级连续相变分析，以及最优控制代价与大偏差率函数的映射。实验手段：光镊捕获胶体粒子，测量平均随机功的控制转变、自由扩散和谐波弛豫中的有限时间动力学相变。

papers.title: Universal Driven Critical Dynamics of Entanglement Entropy
papers.abstract: The Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) and finite-time scaling (FTS) provide a foundational framework for driven critical dynamics, yet their predictive power has been largely confined to local observables. Here, we establish a universal finite-time scaling theory for the nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum entanglement. Using unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we investigate the corner entanglement entropy of (2+1)-dimensional interacting Dirac fermions driven from ordered phases toward a quantum critical point. We find that the corner entanglement accurately obeys a universal driven scaling governed by the driving rate and system size, persisting whether the initial ordered state is fully gapped or hosts gapless Goldstone modes. Crucially, this dynamical entanglement exhibits a logarithmic dependence on the driving rate, from which the universal corner coefficient of the underlying conformal field theory can be robustly extracted far from equilibrium. These results generalize the KZM from local observables to the intrinsic nonlocal quantum information measures, offering a practical blueprint for characterizing quantum criticality and entanglement on programmable quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations”（无偏量子蒙特卡洛模拟）以及建立“universal finite-time scaling theory”（普适有限时间标度理论）。；研究对象：(2+1)维相互作用狄拉克费米子体系，具体研究其从有序相被驱动至量子临界点过程中的量子纠缠动力学，尤其是角部纠缠熵（corner entanglement entropy）的非平衡行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠熵的动力学行为服从一种由驱动速率和系统尺寸控制的普适有限时间标度，且该动力学纠缠熵对驱动速率呈对数依赖，由此可在远离平衡态时稳健提取底层共形场论的普适角系数（corner coefficient）。这标志着Kibble-Zurek机制从局域观测量推广到了非局域的量子信息度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠熵的动力学行为服从一种由驱动速率和系统尺寸控制的普适有限时间标度，且该动力学纠缠熵对驱动速率呈对数依赖，由此可在远离平衡态时稳健提取底层共形场论的普适角系数（corner coefficient）。这标志着Kibble-Zurek机制从局域观测量推广到了非局域的量子信息度量。；创新点：首次将Kibble-Zurek机制和有限时间标度的普适框架从局域观测量推广到非局域的量子纠缠（纠缠熵），并证明即使在远离平衡态的驱动过程中，仍可提取平衡态共形场论普适数据（角系数）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用无偏量子蒙特卡洛（unbiased quantum Monte Carlo）模拟，计算(2+1)维相互作用狄拉克费米子从有序相（包括完全带隙相和含无能隙Goldstone模的有序相）向量子临界点驱动过程中的角部纠缠熵，并结合有限时间标度（finite-time scaling）理论框架进行分析。

papers.title: Design Principles for Reproducible Networks
papers.abstract: From protein complexes to electronic circuits, many natural and engineered systems function only if assembled in an exact, reproducible fashion. The structure of each of these systems can be understood as a network, yet network science lacks the mechanisms to consistently reproduce exact topologies, focusing instead on generating network ensembles. We introduce the framework of network design where we encode the local constraints obeyed by a system's building blocks in a design set, and derive the Unigraphical Design Theorem, which determines when these constraints guarantee reproducible assembly into a unique structure, a process we call unigraphical assembly. For systems whose design sets do not specify a unique outcome, we identify guided assembly as a second route to reproducibility, in which temporal ordering decomposes construction into unigraphical steps. Applying these results to 3,618 reproducible systems, including protein complexes, molecules, and robots, we classify those that undergo unigraphical assembly and those that require guided assembly. We further identify a diversity-redundancy boundary that explains how systems trade component variety for structurally interchangeable parts while retaining unique assembly. Finally, we experimentally test the theory using 3D-printed components to re-engineer generative construction sets into systems that assemble unigraphically into prescribed topologies. Network design thus reframes reproducibility as a mathematically testable property of real networks, opening a route to the rational engineering of complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提出“引入网络设计框架”“推导Unigraphical Design Theorem”等理论工作，同时包含“用3D打印组件进行实验测试”的实验验证部分，属于理论与实验结合的混合类型。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是网络系统，具体包括蛋白质复合物、分子、电子电路、机器人等自然与人工系统，关注其结构能否被精确、可重复地组装。核心物理/数学问题是：在何种局部约束（设计集）下，系统能唯一确定地组装成单一拓扑结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文建立了“网络设计”框架，提出Unigraphical Design Theorem，该定理判定当构建模块的局部约束（设计集）满足何种条件时，系统能可重复地组装成唯一结构（即“单图组装”）。对于不满足唯一性条件的系统，论文提出“引导组装”作为第二条可重复性路径，并通过对3,618个真实系统（蛋白质复合物、分子、机器人）的分类，识别出多样性-冗余度边界，解释了系统如何在保持唯一组装的同时权衡组件多样性与结构可互换性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文建立了“网络设计”框架，提出Unigraphical Design Theorem，该定理判定当构建模块的局部约束（设计集）满足何种条件时，系统能可重复地组装成唯一结构（即“单图组装”）。对于不满足唯一性条件的系统，论文提出“引导组装”作为第二条可重复性路径，并通过对3,618个真实系统（蛋白质复合物、分子、机器人）的分类，识别出多样性-冗余度边界，解释了系统如何在保持唯一组装的同时权衡组件多样性与结构可互换性。；创新点：将网络科学从“生成网络系综”的范式转向“精确复现单一拓扑”的框架，首次将“可重复性”定义为网络的可数学检验性质，并提供了判定定理（Unigraphical Design Theorem）以及将非唯一系统改造为唯一组装系统的实验验证路径。摘要未突出说明与具体凝聚态物理体系的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架方面：引入“设计集”（编码构建模块的局部约束）概念，推导Unigraphical Design Theorem，区分“单图组装”与“引导组装”两条可重复性路径。数据分析方面：对3,618个可重复系统（蛋白质复合物、分子、机器人）进行分类统计，识别多样性-冗余度边界。实验验证方面：使用3D打印组件重新设计生成性构建集，将系统改造为能单图组装成预定拓扑的结构。

papers.title: The Casimir free energy of peptide films on a silicon substrate: Impact of dielectric-to-metal transition in silicon and nanoparticles in peptide
papers.abstract: Using the Lifshitz theory of the van der Waals and Casimir forces, we calculate the Casimir free energy of thin peptide films deposited on silicon substrates. The Casimir free energy is found as a function of film thickness for different fractions of water in the film, in the presence of either nonmagnetic or magnetic nanoparticles, and under the impact of irradiation of a silicon substrate with laser pulses or dopants resulting in the dielectric-to-metal phase transition. It is shown that for a dielectric silicon there is the borderline value of the film thickness, such that the Casimir free energy is negative and contributes to the film stability for thicker films, but is positive and makes the film less stable for thinner ones. According to our results, the borderline value of peptide film thickness decreases with increasing volume fractions of water and in the film. This decrease is more pronounced for the magnetic nanoparticles and becomes stronger with increasing their radius. The borderline value of peptide film thickness is found as a function of the fraction of water in the film. If the silicon substrate is in metallic state, the Casimir free energy of peptide coating is always positive, which makes it less stable. Possible applications of the obtained results in organic electronics and biomedicine are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Lifshitz theory”进行理论计算，无实验数据或实验方法描述。；研究对象：沉积在硅衬底上的肽薄膜体系，具体研究其Casimir自由能随膜厚、含水量、纳米颗粒（非磁性/磁性）以及硅衬底介电-金属相变（由激光脉冲或掺杂诱导）的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于介电态硅衬底，存在一个临界膜厚：较厚膜时Casimir自由能为负（稳定薄膜），较薄膜时为正（不稳定）；若硅衬底处于金属态，Casimir自由能始终为正，使薄膜稳定性降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于介电态硅衬底，存在一个临界膜厚：较厚膜时Casimir自由能为负（稳定薄膜），较薄膜时为正（不稳定）；若硅衬底处于金属态，Casimir自由能始终为正，使薄膜稳定性降低。；创新点：首次系统研究了硅衬底介电-金属相变（通过激光或掺杂）对肽膜Casimir自由能符号及稳定性的影响，并考察了磁性/非磁性纳米颗粒及含水量对临界膜厚的调控作用。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lifshitz理论计算van der Waals和Casimir力，数值计算Casimir自由能作为膜厚、水体积分数、纳米颗粒类型及半径、以及硅衬底介电-金属相变状态的函数。

papers.title: Tailoring Mechanical and Acoustic Properties of Liquid-Filled Elastomers as Reusable Ultrasound Couplants
papers.abstract: Couplants are indispensable for ultrasound-based applications to ensure seamless propagation of the acoustic waves between the transducer and targets. Existing hydro/oil-based gel couplants provide excellent acoustic coupling but are single-use and therefore not suitable for emerging applications such as wearable health monitoring, ultrasound-based biometric devices, and prolonged sonodynamic therapy. Alternatively, polymer-based solid couplants have been explored as reusable solutions but generally fail to simultaneously provide effective mechanical conformability and efficient acoustic transmission. Here, we propose an innovative composite material design based on a silicone elastomer matrix, in which mechanical and acoustic properties are tailored independently through the microencapsulation of diols and triols. An emulsion-based material formulation strategy is employed to produce a family of high-liquid droplet content elastomeric composites containing up to 75 volume fraction (%) of liquid. A robust material formulation strategy is established that enables independent parametric control over the resulting mechanical and acoustic properties. A specific composition containing 70 % glycerol has been identified and explored for biomedical applications, exhibiting mechanical softness comparable to that of skin and acoustic properties matching those of soft tissues. The material has been integrated into a functional ultrasound characterization device, demonstrating structural homogeneity and applicability of the proposed couplant. Furthermore, the composites exhibit mechanical conformability to stiff substrates with surface irregularities, making them also promising candidates for industrial applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了材料制备（emulsion-based material formulation strategy）、性能表征（mechanical and acoustic properties）以及器件集成（integrated into a functional ultrasound characterization device），属于实验研究。；研究对象：液滴填充弹性体复合材料（liquid-filled elastomers），具体为硅酮弹性体（silicone elastomer）基体中微胶囊化封装二醇（diols）和三醇（triols）形成的复合材料，含液量最高达75 vol%。其中一种含70%甘油的特定组分被用于生物医学超声耦合应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微胶囊化封装不同液体（二醇/三醇），可在硅酮弹性体基体中独立调控力学柔顺性和声学传输性能，实现一种可重复使用、兼具皮肤级柔软度和软组织匹配声学特性的超声耦合材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微胶囊化封装不同液体（二醇/三醇），可在硅酮弹性体基体中独立调控力学柔顺性和声学传输性能，实现一种可重复使用、兼具皮肤级柔软度和软组织匹配声学特性的超声耦合材料。；创新点：提出了一种将力学柔顺性与声学传输效率解耦设计的复合材料策略——通过微胶囊化不同羟基液体（二醇/三醇）在弹性体基体中独立调控两类性能，克服了传统固体聚合物耦合剂无法同时兼顾机械适形性和高效声传输的瓶颈，且材料可重复使用，适用于可穿戴健康监测等新兴场景。
papers.method_zh: 乳液基材料配方策略（emulsion-based material formulation strategy），通过改变封装液体的种类和含量（最高75 vol%）实现力学与声学性能的参数化独立调控；对特定组分（70%甘油）进行了力学（柔软度）和声学（声速/阻抗匹配）表征，并将其集成到功能性超声表征装置中验证结构均匀性和实用性。

papers.title: Unravelling the Li-Haldane Conjecture with the Projected Ensemble
papers.abstract: The entanglement spectra of fractional quantum Hall states contain universal fingerprints of their underlying topological order, as posited by the Li-Haldane conjecture. In this work, we uncover a finer universal structure within the entanglement spectra unravelled by projective measurements. Concretely, we study the projected ensemble of fractional quantum Hall states, defined as the collection of quantum states on a subsystem conditioned on measurement outcomes of its complement. We find that this ensemble exhibits a hidden hierarchy inside the Li-Haldane edge manifold: by conditioning on measurement outcomes, the entanglement spectrum's support is split into measurement-dependent sectors whose ranks we demonstrate are fixed by conformal field theory counting, an observation we dub the measurement-resolved Li-Haldane conjecture. For the non-Abelian Moore-Read state, this hierarchy is particularly rich: each parity-resolved edge manifold contains internal subspaces whose dimensions reproduce the conformal field theory counting of the opposite-parity sector. This structure persists even in realistic Coulomb-interacting ground states, establishing the projected ensemble as a sharp new probe of topological order beyond what the entanglement spectrum alone can detect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“conjecture”（猜想）、“conformal field theory counting”（共形场论计数）等理论概念，且未提及任何实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔态（fractional quantum Hall states），特别是非阿贝尔Moore-Read态，以及其纠缠谱在投影测量下的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过投影测量，纠缠谱的支撑被分解为依赖于测量结果的扇区，其秩由共形场论计数决定（即“测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想”）；对于Moore-Read态，每个宇称分辨的边缘流形内部还包含维度与相反宇称扇区共形场论计数一致的子空间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过投影测量，纠缠谱的支撑被分解为依赖于测量结果的扇区，其秩由共形场论计数决定（即“测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想”）；对于Moore-Read态，每个宇称分辨的边缘流形内部还包含维度与相反宇称扇区共形场论计数一致的子空间。；创新点：在Li-Haldane边缘流形内部发现了由投影测量揭示的隐藏层级结构，将纠缠谱的测量分辨行为与拓扑序的精细分类联系起来，提出了比传统纠缠谱更灵敏的拓扑序探针。摘要未突出说明与已有投影系综研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为投影系综（projected ensemble）方法，结合Li-Haldane猜想与共形场论（CFT）计数分析；同时考察了库仑相互作用基态（Coulomb-interacting ground states）以验证结构的普适性。

papers.title: Peeling threshold for removal of an adhered elastic sheet by a shear flow
papers.abstract: Fluid shear can induce detachment of a thin elastic sheet adhered to a flat substrate. This peeling process is important in a variety of environmental and technological systems. The condition for peeling depends on: the shear rate $\dotγ$, the fluid viscosity $η$, the length of the detached portion of the sheet $L$, the bending rigidity $B$ and the adhesion energy $Γ$. What are the laws governing the detachment? We address this question experimentally in the regime of intermediate adhesion, using macroscopic sheets bonded to a substrate and immersed in a shear cell containing a viscous fluid. The experiments indicate a critical shear rate for peeling of the order of $\dotγ \sim B/(ηL^3)$. This threshold is, unexpectedly, independent of adhesion. We rationalise this result by applying Griffith's fracture theory to optical measurement data of the shape of the sheet, under conditions of freely moving peeling front or clamped boundary. The results indicate that the large curvature of the sheet for $\dotγ \sim B/(ηL^3)$ yields a nearly diverging strain energy release rate at this threshold. This approximate divergence in turn yields a peeling threshold that depends at most weakly on $Γ$, confirming a theory that was proposed recently (Salussolia et al., J. Mech. Phys. Solids, 2020, 134). Among other applications, our work provides a quantitative formula that can aid the production at scale of 2D materials such as graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论分析）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally”“experiments indicate”，并结合Griffith断裂理论进行解释。；研究对象：粘附在平坦基底上的薄弹性片在剪切流作用下的剥离（peeling）过程，属于软物质/弹性力学与流体力学交叉的界面粘附问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验测得剥离的临界剪切率约为 $\dotγ \sim B/(\eta L^3)$，且该阈值出乎意料地与粘附能 $Γ$ 无关；其物理根源在于该剪切率下薄片的大曲率导致应变能释放率近似发散，从而使剥离阈值对 $Γ$ 的依赖至多极弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验测得剥离的临界剪切率约为 $\dotγ \sim B/(\eta L^3)$，且该阈值出乎意料地与粘附能 $Γ$ 无关；其物理根源在于该剪切率下薄片的大曲率导致应变能释放率近似发散，从而使剥离阈值对 $Γ$ 的依赖至多极弱。；创新点：实验上首次在中等粘附区间系统验证了近期理论预测（Salussolia et al., JMPS 2020）——即剥离阈值主要由弯曲刚度与流体粘性决定而非粘附能；并给出了可用于二维材料（如石墨烯）规模化生产的定量公式。
papers.method_zh: 宏观弹性片粘附于基底并浸入含粘性流体的剪切流变仪（shear cell）中，测量不同剪切率下的剥离行为；利用光学测量获取薄片形状，并结合Griffith断裂理论分析应变能释放率，同时考虑剥离前沿自由移动与夹持边界两种条件。

papers.title: Exciton multipolarity controls coherent and squeezed phonons in van der Waals heterostructures
papers.abstract: Photoexcitation-driven changes in the electronic distribution displace atoms, generating coherent phonons on ultrafast timescales. Two-dimensional (2D) materials and their heterostructures offer a powerful platform for engineering these phonons. Yet, despite the widespread observation of photoexcited coherent phonons, a design principle for controlling their character remains elusive. Here, using detailed atomistic simulations of multilayers of alternating MoSe$_2$ and WSe$_2$, we reveal exciton multipolarity as a design principle for tuning photoinduced phonons from coherent to squeezed. These phonons are interlayer breathing modes, with dipolar excitons coupling linearly to generate coherent states and quadrupolar excitons coupling quadratically to produce squeezed states. Moreover, an out-of-plane electric field enables switch-like control, converting quadrupolar excitons into dipolar excitons and switching the phonon state from squeezed to coherent. For example, in trilayer WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$, the photoexcited 1.04-THz breathing mode switches from a squeezed state at zero field to a coherent state under an applied vertical field. Experimentally, these phonon states can be directly probed by ultrafast X-ray or electron diffraction and indirectly through transient reflectivity. Our results open new avenues for ultrafast control of lattice and electronic dynamics on picosecond timescales, with implications for THz quantum phononics, nanophotonic technologies, and quantum-noise-limited sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要提到“detailed atomistic simulations”，属于原子级模拟研究。；研究对象：MoSe₂/WSe₂ 交替堆叠的范德华多层异质结，具体包括三层 WSe₂/MoSe₂/WSe₂ 体系；物理现象为光激发产生的相干声子（层间呼吸模）及其从相干态到压缩态的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子的多极性（偶极 vs 四极）决定了光致层间呼吸声子的量子态：偶极激子线性耦合产生相干态，四极激子二次耦合产生压缩态；外加垂直电场可将四极激子转化为偶极激子，从而将声子从压缩态切换为相干态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子的多极性（偶极 vs 四极）决定了光致层间呼吸声子的量子态：偶极激子线性耦合产生相干态，四极激子二次耦合产生压缩态；外加垂直电场可将四极激子转化为偶极激子，从而将声子从压缩态切换为相干态。；创新点：首次提出“激子多极性”作为调控光致声子量子态（相干 vs 压缩）的设计原则，并展示了垂直电场实现声子态可切换的类开关控制，为太赫兹量子声子学提供新思路。摘要未突出说明与具体实验技术的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 原子级模拟（atomistic simulations），具体方法细节摘要未明确说明（未提及 DFT、MD 或含时方法等具体框架）；涉及对多层 MoSe₂/WSe₂ 异质结中光激发激子-声子耦合的模拟，并计算了电场调控下的声子态变化。

papers.title: Simultaneous measurements of enzyme propagation and biopolymer mobility elucidate the directional degradation of a dense biopolymer matrix
papers.abstract: Enzymatic degradation of biopolymers underpins critical processes in biotechnological applications and natural processes, such as food digestion and cancer development, yet the interplay between enzyme propagation in a dense substrate and substrate degradation remains unresolved. It remains especially unclear whether degradation of a dense matrix facilitates or impedes enzyme propagation. We simultaneously track with spatiotemporal resolution unidirectional enzyme diffusion and biopolymer degradation in a model system. We demonstrate that enzyme diffusion is decoupled from catalytic activity, while the degradation front progression is dictated by enzyme diffusion, reaction kinetics and slow enzyme deactivation. These findings establish a quantitative framework to optimize enzymatic processes for applications in biomedicine, biomass valorization, and nanotechnology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“simultaneously track with spatiotemporal resolution”（同时以时空分辨率追踪），属于直接测量实验。；研究对象：致密生物聚合物基质中的酶促降解过程，具体关注酶在致密底物中的单向扩散（unidirectional enzyme diffusion）与生物聚合物降解前沿推进之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 酶在致密基质中的扩散与催化活性是解耦的（decoupled），而降解前沿的推进由酶扩散、反应动力学和缓慢的酶失活共同决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：酶在致密基质中的扩散与催化活性是解耦的（decoupled），而降解前沿的推进由酶扩散、反应动力学和缓慢的酶失活共同决定。；创新点：首次在同一模型体系中同时、实时地测量酶扩散与基质降解，直接回答了“致密基质的降解究竟是促进还是阻碍酶传播”这一此前悬而未决的问题，并建立了包含酶失活因素的定量描述框架。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为具有时空分辨率的同步追踪测量，同时记录酶的单向扩散过程与生物聚合物的降解过程。摘要未明确说明具体的光学/显微技术名称（如荧光显微术、单分子追踪等）。

papers.title: Heesch Nodal Lines in Inadmissible Achiral Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Recently, a new class of Weyl semimetals in antiferromagnets named Heesch Weyl semimetals was discovered, which have inadmissible chiral magnetic point group symmetries (inadmissible magnetic point groups are incompatible with ferromagnetic order) and distinctive surface Fermi arcs. In Heesch Weyl semimetals, the Weyl points are pinned at high symmetry momenta with two-dimensional irreducible corepresentations in the Brillouin zone. As the Weyl points are pinned, the Weyl points with opposite topological charges cannot emerge or be brought together for creation and annihilation as in conventional Weyl semimetals. In this work, we show that when mirror or rotoinversion symmetries are restored so that the point group becomes achiral, long doubly degenerate lines connecting Weyl points with opposite topological charges emerge. We call these lines the Heesch nodal lines (HNLs) and their host materials the Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets. HNLs result in a large number of two-dimensional massless Dirac cones for planes intercepting the HNLs in the Brillouin zone. Moreover, a large subset of the HNL antiferromagnets has the special property that the lowest nonvanishing order of the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect starts with the third order. First-principles calculations on representative collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnets, such as MnTe, CrSb, and Mn$_3$GaN, confirm our predictions on the presence of HNLs. When the inadmissible symmetry is broken by strain, the double degeneracy of the HNLs is lifted and the associated massless Dirac cones are gapped out, providing a route to realizing sizable anomalous Hall effects in antiferromagnetic crystals. We conclude that all inadmissible antiferromagnets without parity-time symmetry are topological. They are either Heesch Weyl antiferromagnets or Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中出现“We show that”“First-principles calculations”等理论推导与计算关键词。；研究对象：反铁磁材料中的拓扑电子结构，具体涉及Heesch Weyl半金属、Heesch nodal line（HNL）反铁磁体，以及代表性材料MnTe、CrSb、Mn₃GaN（包括共线与非共线反铁磁构型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当镜面或旋转反演对称性恢复使磁点群变为非手性时，反铁磁体中会涌现连接相反拓扑荷Weyl点的长双重简并节线（Heesch nodal lines, HNLs），这些节线在布里渊区中产生大量二维无质量狄拉克锥；且所有无宇称-时间对称性的不可容许反铁磁体均为拓扑的，要么是Heesch Weyl反铁磁体，要么是Heesch nodal line反铁磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当镜面或旋转反演对称性恢复使磁点群变为非手性时，反铁磁体中会涌现连接相反拓扑荷Weyl点的长双重简并节线（Heesch nodal lines, HNLs），这些节线在布里渊区中产生大量二维无质量狄拉克锥；且所有无宇称-时间对称性的不可容许反铁磁体均为拓扑的，要么是Heesch Weyl反铁磁体，要么是Heesch nodal line反铁磁体。；创新点：首次提出“Heesch nodal line”这一新概念，揭示了不可容许非手性反铁磁体中由对称性恢复导致的节线拓扑态，并指出这类材料中非线性反常霍尔效应的最低非零阶为三阶——这一特性在以往拓扑材料研究中未被系统讨论。
papers.method_zh: 理论对称性分析（基于不可容许磁点群与二维不可约共表示）结合第一性原理计算，对MnTe、CrSb、Mn₃GaN等代表性材料进行验证；还考虑了应变对对称性破缺的影响。

papers.title: Ground-State Phase Diagram, Higher-Winding Topology, and Lifshitz Criticality in an Anisotropic Four-Spin XX Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum critical and topological properties of a spin-$1/2$ XX chain with anisotropic four-spin cluster interactions in a transverse magnetic field. The interplay of exchange anisotropy, cluster interactions, and the external field produces a rich phase diagram with multiple gapped topological phases and distinct quantum critical boundaries.
