We identify several Lifshitz-type transitions arising from reconstructions of the low-energy Fermi-point structure, including an unconventional multicritical point where distinct critical branches intersect and the momentum-space topology undergoes a singular reorganization. In the isotropic limit, a conventional Lifshitz transition emerges through the merging and annihilation of Fermi points, revealing distinct mechanisms of Fermi-point reconstruction within the same model. The gapped phases are characterized by quantized winding numbers $ν=0,\pm1,-2,$ and $\pm3$, with the higher-winding phases induced by the extended cluster interactions. The $ν=\pm3$ phases exhibit a richer topological structure than conventional short-range Kitaev-type chains and are separated from other sectors by field- and interaction-driven gap closings. These topological distinctions are further reflected in characteristic degeneracy patterns of the lowest levels of the bulk entanglement spectrum. Our results demonstrate that anisotropic multispin interactions provide a versatile route to realizing higher-winding topological phases and unconventional multicriticality in one-dimensional quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“量子临界与拓扑性质”“相图”“动量空间拓扑”等理论概念，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法。；研究对象：一维自旋-1/2 XX链，含各向异性四自旋团簇相互作用，置于横向磁场中。具体物理现象包括：量子临界、拓扑相变、Lifshitz转变、费米点重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在交换各向异性、团簇相互作用与外场共同作用下，展现出多个有能隙拓扑相（缠绕数ν=0, ±1, −2, ±3）及多种量子临界边界；其中ν=±3相具有比常规短程Kitaev型链更丰富的拓扑结构。此外，发现了一种非常规多临界点，不同临界分支在此相交并发生动量空间拓扑的奇异重组。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在交换各向异性、团簇相互作用与外场共同作用下，展现出多个有能隙拓扑相（缠绕数ν=0, ±1, −2, ±3）及多种量子临界边界；其中ν=±3相具有比常规短程Kitaev型链更丰富的拓扑结构。此外，发现了一种非常规多临界点，不同临界分支在此相交并发生动量空间拓扑的奇异重组。；创新点：首次在各向异性四自旋XX链中实现高阶缠绕数（ν=±3）拓扑相，并揭示同一模型内两种不同的费米点重构机制（各向异性情形下的多临界点奇异重组 vs 各向同性极限下的费米点合并湮灭）。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：低能费米点结构分析（用于识别Lifshitz型转变）、动量空间拓扑表征（计算量子化缠绕数ν）、体纠缠谱最低能级简并模式分析（用于区分拓扑相）。摘要未明确说明是否使用精确对角化、玻色化或DMRG等具体技术手段。

papers.title: Coherent interaction of WS$_2$ and quasi-2D perovskite excitons over micrometer distances via a cavity field
papers.abstract: The coherent coupling of cavity-confined photons and excitonic matter resonances leads to the formation of cavity polaritons, hybrid light-matter quasi-particles. If multiple exciton resonances couple to the same photonic mode, the resulting polariton constitutes a coherent interaction between matter resonances that can be spatially separated without any direct electronic coupling. In this work, we demonstrate the formation of such a coherent coupling at room temperature using an open optical cavity containing two distinct van der Waals materials - monolayer WS2 and layered quasi-2D halide perovskites (HaPs) - separated by $1.5 μ\rm m$. The system forms three polariton branches, with the middle branch possessing nearly equal fractions of both excitons and the photonic mode. White-light reflectivity and luminescence measurements are in good agreement with simulations using a coupled harmonic oscillator and a microscopic Wannier-Hopfield framework. Our results lay the foundation to combine highly complementary degrees of freedom in 2D materials in an in-situ tunable fashion to enable new polaritonic functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate the formation”“White-light reflectivity and luminescence measurements”，属于实验测量与模拟结合的工作。；研究对象：由单层WS₂与层状准二维卤化物钙钛矿（HaPs）两种范德华材料构成的开放光学微腔体系，研究其激子与腔光子的相干耦合，以及两种空间分离的激子共振通过腔场产生的间接相干相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，两种空间相距1.5 μm的不同激子材料通过同一腔模实现了相干耦合，形成三个极化激元分支，其中间分支同时具有接近相等的两种激子成分和光子成分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，两种空间相距1.5 μm的不同激子材料通过同一腔模实现了相干耦合，形成三个极化激元分支，其中间分支同时具有接近相等的两种激子成分和光子成分。；创新点：在室温下利用开放腔实现两种不同范德华材料（WS₂与准二维钙钛矿）激子之间跨越微米距离的相干耦合，无需直接的电子耦合，且系统具有原位可调性，为结合不同二维材料互补自由度提供了平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用开放光学微腔，进行白光反射谱和发光谱测量；理论上采用耦合谐振子模型以及微观Wannier-Hopfield框架进行模拟，并与实验数据对比。

papers.title: Ion-Engineered Insulator-to-Semiconductor Transition in Natural 2D Biotite
papers.abstract: Naturally occurring layered silicates offer an abundant yet unexplored class of 2D materials, but their insulating nature limits their functional utility. Here, we demonstrate a chemical strategy that transforms liquid-phase-exfoliated biotite nanosheets into a tunable 2D semiconductor through controlled NaOH treatment. The resulting insulator-to-semiconductor transition originates from Na incorporation, defect generation, and local structural reconstruction while largely preserving the layered framework. Structural and chemical analyses reveal lattice distortion, interlayer reorganization, hydroxylation, and partial Na+-K+ exchange, establishing the origin of the electronic restructuring. This transformation broadens the optical response, shifting the approximately 221 nm absorption toward approximately 280 and 975 nm, reducing the optical bandgap from approximately 5.2 to 3.2-3.5 eV, and introducing low-energy transitions at approximately 1.12-1.17 eV. Electrical measurements reveal nonlinear transport with currents reaching close to 10 microA, demonstrating activated carrier conduction. Ultrafast transient absorption reveals pronounced excited-state absorption, with carrier cooling (0.16-0.38 ps) followed by fast (35-60 ps) and long-lived (336-491 ps) relaxation associated with trap-mediated recombination. Fluence-dependent dynamics reveal a hot-phonon bottleneck at elevated carrier densities. Together with density functional theory calculations, these results establish chemical defect and ion engineering as a powerful route for converting naturally abundant layered minerals into electronically tunable 2D materials for emerging optoelectronic and ultrafast photonic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含密度泛函理论计算辅助）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述化学处理、结构/化学分析、电学测量、超快瞬态吸收等实验手段，并提及“together with density functional theory calculations”。；研究对象：天然层状硅酸盐矿物——黑云母（biotite），经液相剥离得到二维纳米片，并通过NaOH处理实现绝缘体到半导体的转变。核心物理现象为离子工程驱动的电子结构重构与绝缘体-半导体相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可控NaOH处理，液相剥离的黑云母纳米片可实现绝缘体到可调半导体的转变，其机制为Na⁺掺入、缺陷产生及局部结构重构（含Na⁺-K⁺部分交换），同时基本保持层状框架。该转变将光学带隙从约5.2 eV降至3.2–3.5 eV，并引入约1.12–1.17 eV的低能跃迁，电学测量显示非线性输运（电流接近10 μA），表明激活型载流子导电。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可控NaOH处理，液相剥离的黑云母纳米片可实现绝缘体到可调半导体的转变，其机制为Na⁺掺入、缺陷产生及局部结构重构（含Na⁺-K⁺部分交换），同时基本保持层状框架。该转变将光学带隙从约5.2 eV降至3.2–3.5 eV，并引入约1.12–1.17 eV的低能跃迁，电学测量显示非线性输运（电流接近10 μA），表明激活型载流子导电。；创新点：首次将天然丰富且绝缘的层状硅酸盐矿物（黑云母）通过化学缺陷与离子工程转化为电子结构可调的二维半导体，为利用天然矿物构建光电子与超快光子器件提供了新路径。摘要未突出说明与具体已有二维材料（如TMDC）的性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 液相剥离制备纳米片；NaOH化学处理；结构/化学分析（揭示晶格畸变、层间重组、羟基化、Na⁺-K⁺交换）；光学吸收谱（带隙与吸收边表征）；电学输运测量（非线性I-V，激活导电）；超快瞬态吸收光谱（载流子冷却0.16–0.38 ps，快弛豫35–60 ps，长寿命336–491 ps，以及高载流子密度下的热声子瓶颈效应）；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算辅助解释。

papers.title: Real-space Floquet topology written by the orbital angular momentum of light
papers.abstract: Floquet engineering usually treats light as a uniform control field that changes the topology of an entire driven material. Here we show that structured light carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) enables a different regime, in which topology is written directly in real space. For ultrathin topological insulator films, circularly polarized Laguerre--Gaussian beams generate a radial Floquet mass whose sign changes define a topological annulus bounded by two concentric chiral ring modes. The transition is helicity selective: below a thickness-dependent critical frequency, left-circularly polarized light drives mass inversion, whereas right-circularly polarized light increases the gap and leaves the film trivial. Independently, the OAM quantum number shifts and reshapes the annulus without changing the frequency, intensity, or helicity. In the decoupled-surfaces limit, the same mechanism produces a purely Floquet-induced topological mass and a vortex-core zero mode. These results identify photon OAM as a control parameter for nonequilibrium topology and provide a route to programmable topological landscapes in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that”“Here we show”等理论推导性表述，并讨论机制与极限情形，未提及实验或数值计算方法。；研究对象：超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜在携带轨道角动量（OAM）的圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束（即结构光）驱动下的非平衡拓扑性质，具体关注实空间中的Floquet拓扑结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 携带OAM的结构光可在实空间中直接写入拓扑结构：在超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束产生径向Floquet质量，其符号变化定义了一个由两个同心手性环模包围的拓扑环带；该转变具有螺旋度选择性，且OAM量子数可独立调控环带的形状与位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：携带OAM的结构光可在实空间中直接写入拓扑结构：在超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束产生径向Floquet质量，其符号变化定义了一个由两个同心手性环模包围的拓扑环带；该转变具有螺旋度选择性，且OAM量子数可独立调控环带的形状与位置。；创新点：将光子OAM确立为非平衡拓扑的控制参数，实现了从“均匀全场调控拓扑”到“实空间直接写入拓扑”的范式转变，为在量子材料中可编程构建拓扑景观提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于Floquet工程方法，具体处理圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束驱动的超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜，分析厚度依赖的临界频率、螺旋度选择性、OAM量子数效应，并考察退耦合表面极限下的纯Floquet诱导拓扑质量与涡旋芯零模。

papers.title: Generalized s-d model for Wannier-Mott excitons in layered magnetic semiconductors
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of excitons coupled to the magnetic order, and the consequent strong magneto-optic responses, in some van der Waals magnetic semiconductors has triggered intense activity at the interface of magnetism and semiconductor optics. Here, we present an analytically tractable minimal model that describes magnetic order, electrons, holes, and excitons within a unified framework, thereby capturing a wide range of phenomena. It treats the magnetic order and itinerant carriers to be comprised by distinct electronic orbitals that are mutually coupled via orbital-dependent onsite exchange, similar to the treatment of metallic magnets using an s-d model. Investigating CrSBr bilayer as a case study, we benchmark our model and its predictions against recent experimental and ab-initio results finding good agreement as well as new insights enabled by the model's simplicity. Examining the optical selection rules, we find the conservation of a quantum number formed from a combination of spin and layer pseudospin to be a useful guiding principle, even in noncollinear magnetic configurations. Our analysis finds a series of bright and dark excitonic states in such layered A-type antiferromagnets. The presented framework should be valuable in achieving intuitive understanding of recently discovered excitonic phenomena and guiding the discovery of other excitonic states in layered magnetic semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytically tractable minimal model”“theoretical framework”“model”等关键词，属于理论建模研究。；研究对象：层状磁性半导体中的Wannier-Mott激子，具体以CrSBr双层作为案例研究，关注磁有序与激子耦合导致的磁光响应现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个统一描述磁有序、电子、空穴和激子的最小解析模型，并发现层状A型反铁磁体中存在一系列亮激子和暗激子态；光学选择定则可由自旋与层赝自旋组合成的量子数守恒来理解，即使在非共线磁构型下也成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个统一描述磁有序、电子、空穴和激子的最小解析模型，并发现层状A型反铁磁体中存在一系列亮激子和暗激子态；光学选择定则可由自旋与层赝自旋组合成的量子数守恒来理解，即使在非共线磁构型下也成立。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：用最小解析模型在统一框架内同时描述磁序、载流子和激子，并揭示自旋-层赝自旋组合量子数作为光学选择定则的守恒量，为理解层状磁半导体中的激子现象提供了直观理论工具。
papers.method_zh: 构建广义s-d模型：将磁有序与巡游载流子视为不同电子轨道，通过轨道依赖的格点内交换耦合相互关联（类比金属磁体的s-d模型）；以CrSBr双层为例，将模型预测与近期实验和从头算结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Multimodal and Multiscale Interrogation of a Mechanically Tough Glass Forming Copper-Based Metal-Organic Framework
papers.abstract: A copper-based metal-organic framework, Cu(Im)2, was synthesized using a sol-gel process and subsequently melt-quenched into glass upon heating above 240 °C. In this paper, we present a multimodal, multiscale interrogation of the MOF nanocrystals and the resulting glasses. Structural characterization using X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and electron microscopy was performed to understand the morphology and size of the synthesized nanocrystals and glasses. Thermogravimetric analysis and differential scanning calorimetry were employed to understand the melting process of the crystals to form the glass. Synchrotron pair distribution function analysis was performed to verify that the framework structure is maintained upon melting, and nearfield infrared nanospectroscopy provided insight into the local chemical structure of the materials. The mechanical characterization via nanoindentation revealed that the resulting glasses exhibit an appreciably high elastic modulus (~10 GPa) and the highest fracture toughness (K_1c ~ 0.5 MPa m^1/2) yet reported for MOF glasses. This development is central to the emerging field of MOF-based materials processing and shaping, while upholding mechanical robustness and resistance to cracking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：synthesized（合成）、structural characterization（结构表征）、mechanical characterization（力学表征）、nanoindentation（纳米压痕）等实验手段。；研究对象：铜基MOF玻璃材料Cu(Im)₂（铜-咪唑金属有机框架），具体研究其纳米晶体及熔融淬火形成的玻璃态，以及该玻璃的力学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cu(Im)₂经熔融淬火形成的MOF玻璃具有约10 GPa的高弹性模量，且断裂韧性（K₁c ≈ 0.5 MPa·m^1/2）是目前已报道MOF玻璃中最高的，兼具机械坚固性和抗开裂能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cu(Im)₂经熔融淬火形成的MOF玻璃具有约10 GPa的高弹性模量，且断裂韧性（K₁c ≈ 0.5 MPa·m^1/2）是目前已报道MOF玻璃中最高的，兼具机械坚固性和抗开裂能力。；创新点：首次对MOF玻璃实现多模态、多尺度的综合表征，并报道了迄今最高的MOF玻璃断裂韧性，为MOF材料在保持机械鲁棒性的前提下进行加工成型提供了关键进展。
papers.method_zh: 溶胶-凝胶法合成Cu(Im)₂纳米晶体，加热至240 °C以上熔融淬火成玻璃；X射线衍射、原子力显微镜、电子显微镜表征形貌与尺寸；热重分析和差示扫描量热法研究熔化过程；同步辐射对分布函数（PDF）分析验证熔融后框架结构保持；近场红外纳米光谱（nano-FTIR）探测局域化学结构；纳米压痕测试力学性能。

papers.title: Gd-4f Exchange Splitting and Mo-4d Crystal-Field Redistribution in Gd/W Co-doped La2Mo2O9: A DFT+U Study
papers.abstract: La2Mo2O9 (LAMOX) is a promising oxide-ion conductor for intermediate-temperature solid oxide fuel cells, but its practical application is limited by a first-order monoclinic-to-cubic (alpha to beta) phase transition. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of pristine La2Mo2O9 and the Gd/W co-doped composition La1.6Gd0.4Mo1.7W0.3O9 using spin-polarized density functional theory with an on-site Hubbard correction for the localized Gd-4f states. The projected density of states reveals that pristine La2Mo2O9 is an O-2p/Mo-4d charge-transfer oxide in which La contributes negligibly near the band edges. Gd/W co-doping introduces a strongly exchange-split Gd-4f manifold with a majority-minority separation of approximately 1011 eV, substantially redistributes the Mo-4d electronic states through a threefold increase in crystal-field splitting, and reduces the O-2p contribution near the valence-band maximum from 78% to 66%. These electronic signatures are consistent with the experimentally observed lattice contraction, MoO Raman-mode softening, and the non-monotonic evolution of oxide-ion conductivity across the co-doped series. In particular, the pronounced crystal-field splitting and localized Gd magnetism at the highest doping level provide a microscopic electronic explanation for the observed suppression of ionic conductivity. The present results establish an atomistic electronic-structure framework for understanding dopant-induced phase stabilization and oxide- ion transport in Gd/W co-doped LAMOX electrolytes, providing design principles for improved solid oxide fuel cell materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“spin-polarized density functional theory with an on-site Hubbard correction”（自旋极化DFT+U）进行电子结构计算。；研究对象：La2Mo2O9（LAMOX）氧化物离子导体及其Gd/W共掺杂体系La1.6Gd0.4Mo1.7W0.3O9，重点关注掺杂诱导的电子结构变化及其与α→β相变和离子电导率演化的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Gd/W共掺杂在带隙中引入强交换劈裂的Gd-4f能级（多数/少数自旋分离约10–11 eV），同时使Mo-4d晶场劈裂增大三倍，并降低价带顶处O-2p态占比（78%→66%）；最高掺杂水平下增强的晶场劈裂和局域Gd磁性为离子电导率被抑制提供了微观电子学解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Gd/W共掺杂在带隙中引入强交换劈裂的Gd-4f能级（多数/少数自旋分离约10–11 eV），同时使Mo-4d晶场劈裂增大三倍，并降低价带顶处O-2p态占比（78%→66%）；最高掺杂水平下增强的晶场劈裂和局域Gd磁性为离子电导率被抑制提供了微观电子学解释。；创新点：首次从原子级电子结构层面建立了Gd/W共掺杂LAMOX体系中掺杂诱导相稳定化与氧化物离子输运之间的微观机制框架，将晶场劈裂增强和Gd局域磁性直接关联到实验观测的电导率非单调变化。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）加Hubbard U修正（DFT+U），针对局域Gd-4f态施加在位库仑修正；通过投影态密度（projected density of states）分析各轨道贡献。

papers.title: Fermi-Point Topology Determines Emergent Conformal Criticality in Extended Quantum Spin Chains
papers.abstract: Quantum criticality in one-dimensional quantum systems is characterized by emergent conformal field theories (CFTs), whose central charge counts independent gapless degrees of freedom. Establishing a microscopic connection between this universal conformal structure and the momentum-space topology of the underlying quasiparticle spectrum remains challenging. Here, we uncover a direct correspondence between Fermi-point topology, conformal criticality, and quantum entanglement in an extended quantum spin chain with competing cluster interactions, exchange anisotropy, and a transverse magnetic field. We show that interaction- and field-driven Lifshitz transitions generate conformal critical phases with effective central charges $c_{\rm eff}=1/2$, $1$, $3/2$, $2$, and $3$, including a multicritical point where Ising and Luttinger-liquid sectors coexist. Importantly, the central charge is not determined simply by the number of lattice gap closings or Fermi points, but by the number and conformal content of independent low-energy continuum sectors after accounting for lattice symmetries, reciprocal-lattice identifications, and mode equivalences. Thus, Lifshitz transitions may leave the conformal anomaly unchanged or modify the central charge depending on whether spectral reconstruction generates new independent continuum sectors. Real- and momentum-space entanglement spectra provide complementary microscopic signatures, revealing both the conformal content and momentum-space organization of critical modes. Our results establish a microscopic framework linking Fermi-point topology to emergent CFTs and show how interaction-driven spectral reconstruction can generate higher-central-charge criticality and unconventional multicritical behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“establishing a microscopic connection”“uncover a direct correspondence”“show that”等理论推导性表述，以及“entanglement spectra”等数值计算特征，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维扩展量子自旋链，包含竞争性cluster相互作用、交换各向异性以及横向磁场；具体关注其量子临界性、Fermi-point拓扑、共形场论（CFT）与量子纠缠之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该自旋链中由相互作用和磁场驱动的Lifshitz转变可产生有效中心荷为 c_eff = 1/2、1、3/2、2 和 3 的共形临界相，并包含一个Ising与Luttinger液体扇区共存的多临界点；中心荷并非由晶格能隙闭合点数或Fermi点数简单决定，而是由考虑晶格对称性、倒格矢等同性和模式等价性后独立低能连续扇区的数目及其共形内容决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该自旋链中由相互作用和磁场驱动的Lifshitz转变可产生有效中心荷为 c_eff = 1/2、1、3/2、2 和 3 的共形临界相，并包含一个Ising与Luttinger液体扇区共存的多临界点；中心荷并非由晶格能隙闭合点数或Fermi点数简单决定，而是由考虑晶格对称性、倒格矢等同性和模式等价性后独立低能连续扇区的数目及其共形内容决定。；创新点：建立了Fermi-point拓扑与涌现共形临界性之间的微观对应关系，揭示了Lifshitz转变对中心荷的影响取决于谱重构是否产生新的独立连续扇区——即Lifshitz转变可能不改变共形反常，也可能改变中心荷；并展示了相互作用驱动的谱重构可产生更高中心荷的临界性和非常规多临界行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：利用动量空间Fermi-point拓扑分析、低能连续场论描述（共形场论框架），以及实空间和动量空间的纠缠谱计算来表征临界模式及其共形内容。

papers.title: Hidden Magnetic Octupolar Order driven by Spin-Orbit coupling in KFeF$_3$
papers.abstract: Phase transitions are typically driven by symmetry-breaking structural distortions that lift electronic degeneracies, yet in some cases, these transitions may be driven by a hidden order without conventional structural signatures. Here, we demonstrate that the 3$d$ perovskite, KFeF$_3$, hosts such a hidden instability. Using a combination of high-resolution powder diffraction, magnetometry, symmetry-based analysis and first principles calculations, we reveal that while the 90 K cubic to rhombohedral transition arises from conventional magnetostriction accompanying antiferromagnetic order, a second transition at 40 K lowers the symmetry to monoclinic without any detectable Jahn-Teller distortion or translational symmetry-breaking. Symmetry-based Landau analysis supports a hidden zone centered magnetic octupole order parameter, whose improper coupling accounts for the weak ferromagnetism and pronounced symmetry-breaking strain. Density functional calculations show that spin-orbit coupling suppresses the competing Jahn-Teller instability, and thereby favors higher rank magnetic multipolar degrees of freedom. These findings establish KFeF$_3$ as a model system in which the competing energy scales between spin-orbit coupling and orbital degeneracy result in the emergence of hidden, multipolar order. We show that the control of such magnetic, multipolar order could, in principle, provide a route to induce altermagnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“高分辨粉末衍射、磁测量”等实验手段，同时包含“对称性分析、第一性原理计算”等理论与计算方法。；研究对象：3d 钙钛矿材料 KFeF₃，具体研究其 90 K 立方-菱方结构相变与 40 K 菱方-单斜相变背后的磁性序与多极序物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: KFeF₃ 在 40 K 处发生无常规结构畸变（无 Jahn-Teller 畸变、无平移对称性破缺）的隐藏相变，其序参量为以布里渊区中心为特征的磁八极序；自旋-轨道耦合抑制了竞争的 Jahn-Teller 不稳定性，从而促成高阶磁多极序的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：KFeF₃ 在 40 K 处发生无常规结构畸变（无 Jahn-Teller 畸变、无平移对称性破缺）的隐藏相变，其序参量为以布里渊区中心为特征的磁八极序；自旋-轨道耦合抑制了竞争的 Jahn-Teller 不稳定性，从而促成高阶磁多极序的出现。；创新点：首次在 3d 钙钛矿体系中揭示由自旋-轨道耦合驱动的隐藏磁八极序，并证明该多极序可通过非本征耦合产生弱铁磁性与显著对称性破缺应变；同时指出控制此类磁多极序原则上可作为诱导交错磁性（altermagnetism）的途径。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨粉末衍射、磁化率/磁矩测量、基于对称性的 Landau 理论分析、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算（用于评估自旋-轨道耦合效应）。

papers.title: Weak-coupling theory of half-metals and other fractional metallic phases in biased doped Bernal bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: The paper presents a theoretical study of many-body electronic phases in doped and electrically biased Bernal-stacked (AB) bilayer graphene. We develop a variational mean-field theory with no fitted parameters. For the electron-electron interaction, we employ a parameter-free random-phase approximation to model the short-range screened Coulomb repulsion. The remaining long-range Coulomb potential energy is dictated by the geometry of the sample, behaving as a parallel-plate capacitor. We formulate the theory directly in terms of the experimentally controlled displacement field $\frak D$ rather than the interaction-renormalized interlayer potential difference. It makes our theory better suited for direct comparison with experiment. The resulting phase diagram is quite rich. It hosts several fractional-metal states connected by first- and second-order transitions. At higher bias and doping, three distinct fractional metallic states emerge. We classify these phases by the number of doped sectors and the symmetry of the order parameters. Our results - obtained without any parameter fitting - reproduce key qualitative and quantitative features of recent experiments. This includes the energy scale associated with the loss of fractional metallic order. At lower bias and doping, the model stabilizes a broad spectrum of fractional-metal phases with more exotic symmetry-breaking patterns. This suggests that further experimental exploration of the latter regime is warranted.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical study”“variational mean-field theory”“no fitted parameters”。；研究对象：掺杂且施加垂直电场（偏置）的Bernal堆叠（AB）双层石墨烯中的多体电子相，特别是分数金属态（fractional metallic phases）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在偏置和掺杂参数空间中，该体系存在丰富的分数金属相图，包含多个由一级和二级相变连接的分数金属态；在高偏置和高掺杂区出现三种不同的分数金属态，在低偏置和低掺杂区则稳定存在更多具有奇特对称性破缺模式的分数金属相。理论结果无需参数拟合即可复现近期实验的关键定性和定量特征，包括分数金属序消失的能量尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在偏置和掺杂参数空间中，该体系存在丰富的分数金属相图，包含多个由一级和二级相变连接的分数金属态；在高偏置和高掺杂区出现三种不同的分数金属态，在低偏置和低掺杂区则稳定存在更多具有奇特对称性破缺模式的分数金属相。理论结果无需参数拟合即可复现近期实验的关键定性和定量特征，包括分数金属序消失的能量尺度。；创新点：理论直接以实验可控的位移场 \(\frak D\) 为控制变量，而非相互作用重整化后的层间势差，使其更适合与实验直接对比；且整个计算无需任何参数拟合即可复现实验关键特征。摘要未突出说明其他相对于已有理论工作的新意。
papers.method_zh: 无拟合参数的变分平均场理论；电子-电子相互作用采用无参数随机相位近似（RPA）描述短程屏蔽库仑排斥，长程库仑势能由样品几何（平行板电容器模型）决定；理论直接以实验可控的位移场 \(\frak D\) 而非相互作用重整化后的层间势差为变量表述。

papers.title: Finite-temperature mass gap and quench dynamics of mobile impurities in a Fermi gas
papers.abstract: Recently, a mass-gap description of mobile impurities in a Fermi gas was introduced, which connects Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe for static impurities to the quasiparticle picture of Fermi polarons through a recoil-induced energy gap in the fermionic dispersion. That description, however, was restricted to zero temperature and did not address dynamics. Here we generalize the mass-gap model to finite temperature by combining the Lee--Low--Pines transformation with a self-consistent Hartree--Fock decoupling of the recoil-induced interaction, and we study the quench dynamics within this framework using the functional-determinant approach. At finite temperature the effective mass gap obeys the self-consistency equation $Δ(T)=2U_F\tanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T]$, with $U_F=k_F^2/2M$ and $M$ the impurity mass. This equation admits a nonzero solution below the characteristic temperature $T^*=U_F/(2k_B)$ and closes as $(T^*-T)^{1/2}$. We identify this closing as the mean-field signature of the thermal melting of the polaron and molecule quasiparticles. Computing the Ramsey response $S(t)$ after a sudden quench of the impurity--fermion interaction, we find that its long-time oscillations---quantum beats between the bound and in-gap states---disappear precisely above $T^*$. Our work ties the thermodynamic and dynamical fingerprints of polaron formation to a single temperature-dependent mean-field parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“generalize the mass-gap model”“self-consistent Hartree–Fock decoupling”“functional-determinant approach”等理论方法，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：费米气体中的移动杂质（即费米极化子体系），具体关注其有限温度下的质量间隙（mass gap）以及相互作用突然淬灭后的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度下有效质量间隙满足自洽方程 Δ(T)=2U_F tanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T]，该方程在特征温度 T*=U_F/(2k_B) 以下存在非零解，并以 (T*−T)^{1/2} 的方式闭合；这一闭合被识别为极化子和分子准粒子热熔化的平均场标志。相应地，Ramsey 响应 S(t) 的长时振荡（束缚态与隙内态之间的量子拍）恰好在该温度以上消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度下有效质量间隙满足自洽方程 Δ(T)=2U_F tanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T]，该方程在特征温度 T*=U_F/(2k_B) 以下存在非零解，并以 (T*−T)^{1/2} 的方式闭合；这一闭合被识别为极化子和分子准粒子热熔化的平均场标志。相应地，Ramsey 响应 S(t) 的长时振荡（束缚态与隙内态之间的量子拍）恰好在该温度以上消失。；创新点：将此前仅限于零温且不涉及动力学的质量间隙描述推广到有限温度，并首次在该框架内研究淬火动力学，从而把极化子形成的热力学与动力学特征统一归结为一个温度依赖的平均场参数。
papers.method_zh: 将 Lee–Low–Pines 变换与自洽 Hartree–Fock 退耦相结合，推广质量间隙模型至有限温度；随后利用泛函行列式方法（functional-determinant approach）研究淬火动力学。

papers.title: Low-Frequency Charge Noise in Bilayer Graphene Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Bilayer graphene (BLG) quantum dots (QDs) are a promising platform for semiconductor qubits. However, the low-frequency charge noise that may ultimately limit coherence has remained largely unexplored. Here, we systematically characterize charge noise in gate-defined BLG QDs using transport-based noise spectroscopy. We extract a median amplitude of $ S_μ^{1/2} (1~\text{Hz}) = 1.16~μ\text{eV}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$, placing BLG well within the range reported for established semiconductor quantum-dot platforms. Across variations in charge occupation, confinement, source-drain bias, and charge-sensor operating conditions, neither the noise amplitude nor the spectral dependence shows a reproducible trend in electrostatic tuning, indicating that we extracted the intrinsic semiconductor noise. Consistent noise levels are further observed in double QDs and confirmed using an independent superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout. Extending the study to BLG devices incorporating transition metal dichalcogenide layers reveals no measurable charge noise increase in weakly proximitized QDs. These results validate BLG as a viable platform for coherent quantum information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“transport-based noise spectroscopy”“systematically characterize”“confirmed using an independent superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout”等实验测量手段。；研究对象：双层石墨烯（BLG）量子点（QDs）中的低频电荷噪声，包括单量子点、双量子点以及引入过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDC）层的弱近邻化器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在栅极定义的BLG量子点中，提取到电荷噪声幅度中位数为 S_μ^{1/2}(1 Hz) = 1.16 μeV/√Hz，与已成熟半导体量子点平台相当；且噪声幅度和频谱依赖在多种静电调谐条件下均无系统性变化，表明测得的为内禀半导体噪声。弱近邻化TMDC层未引入可测量的电荷噪声增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在栅极定义的BLG量子点中，提取到电荷噪声幅度中位数为 S_μ^{1/2}(1 Hz) = 1.16 μeV/√Hz，与已成熟半导体量子点平台相当；且噪声幅度和频谱依赖在多种静电调谐条件下均无系统性变化，表明测得的为内禀半导体噪声。弱近邻化TMDC层未引入可测量的电荷噪声增加。；创新点：首次系统表征了栅极定义BLG量子点中的低频电荷噪声，证明其噪声水平与成熟半导体量子点平台相当，并验证了BLG作为相干量子信息处理平台的可行性；同时首次考察了TMDC近邻化对BLG量子点电荷噪声的影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于输运的噪声谱学（transport-based noise spectroscopy）测量低频电荷噪声；使用超导谐振腔色散读出（superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout）作为独立验证手段；通过改变电荷占据数、限制势、源漏偏压和电荷传感器工作条件进行系统静电调谐扫描。

papers.title: Pseudospectral Methods and Critical Phenomena
papers.abstract: We employ pseudospectral methods to solve the homogeneous Ornstein-Zernike (OZ) equation for a model fluid in the vicinity of the critical point. Focusing on the Mean-Spherical Approximation (MSA) as a closure to the OZ equation, we obtain numerical estimates for the critical exponents $η$, $δ$ and $γ$ for a system of hard-core Yukawa particles both in two and three dimensions. The three-dimensional MSA exponents are already well-known from an analytic solution and are recovered by our numerical methods. The two-dimensional exponents are a new output of this work. The pseudospectral method allows for rapid and highly accurate solution of liquid-state integral equation theories, and enables calculations on truely infinite domains, as needed for highly correlated states. In addition, we analyse the standard Picard iteration scheme and propose a variation of it which provides increased stability and speed of convergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“pseudospectral methods”（赝谱方法）、“solve the homogeneous Ornstein-Zernike equation”（求解OZ方程）、“numerical estimates”（数值估计）。；研究对象：硬核Yukawa粒子流体在临界点附近的行为，具体研究其在二维和三维体系中的临界现象（临界指数η、δ、γ）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用赝谱方法求解OZ方程并结合MSA闭合关系，在三维体系中成功复现了已知的解析MSA临界指数，并首次给出了二维体系的MSA临界指数数值估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用赝谱方法求解OZ方程并结合MSA闭合关系，在三维体系中成功复现了已知的解析MSA临界指数，并首次给出了二维体系的MSA临界指数数值估计。；创新点：将赝谱方法应用于液体态积分方程理论，使其能够在真正无限域上进行计算（适用于强关联临界态），并首次获得二维硬核Yukawa流体的MSA临界指数；此外提出了改进的Picard迭代方案。
papers.method_zh: 赝谱方法（pseudospectral methods）求解均匀Ornstein-Zernike积分方程，采用平均球近似（MSA）作为闭合关系；同时分析了标准Picard迭代方案，并提出了一种改进的迭代变体以提高稳定性和收敛速度。

papers.title: Spectral properties of deterministic matrices multiplied by rotationally invariant random non-Hermitian ensembles
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study spectral properties of multiplicative deformations of non-Hermitian random matrices. We consider matrices of the form $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}$, where $\mathbf{A}$ is a deterministic $N\times N$ matrix (not necessarily Hermitian) and $\mathbf{B}$ is a rotationally invariant random matrix. We show that, as $N\to\infty$, the boundary of the complex eigenvalue distribution of $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}$ is governed by simple equations involving the $\mathcal{R}_1$ and $\mathcal{R}_2$ transforms of $\mathbf{B}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用数学推导与渐近分析（“as \(N\to\infty\)”），无实验或数值模拟描述。；研究对象：非厄米随机矩阵的乘法变形，具体为确定性矩阵 \(\mathbf{A}\) 与旋转不变随机矩阵 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的乘积 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}\) 的复平面本征值分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大矩阵极限下，\(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}\) 的复本征值分布边界由涉及 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换的简单方程决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大矩阵极限下，\(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}\) 的复本征值分布边界由涉及 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换的简单方程决定。；创新点：将确定性矩阵与非厄米旋转不变随机矩阵的乘法变形谱边界问题，归结为仅依赖 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换的简洁方程，推广了已有对厄米或单一随机矩阵情形的处理。摘要未突出说明与具体物理体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 随机矩阵理论中的自由概率/自由卷积框架，利用 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换（非厄米版本的 R 变换）刻画乘法变形后的谱边界。摘要未提及具体数值算法或实验手段。

papers.title: Frenkel line of Yukawa fluids within the self-consistent relaxation theory
papers.abstract: For a simple model fluid, the Yukawa fluid, the condition for dynamic crossover, known as the Frenkel line, is defined. The condition is related to the fact that the roton minimum in the dispersion relation of longitudinal acoustic-like excitations exists only when the collective vibrational dynamics of particles dominates in the liquid. Based on the self-consistent relaxation theory for the Yukawa fluid, thermodynamic states are determined in which the roton minimum disappears. The obtained values of the state parameters for the Frenkel line are consistent with the results of studies in which the position of this line on the phase diagram of the Yukawa fluid was determined using molecular dynamics simulations. It is shown that the Frenkel line in this system can be determined directly from the structural characteristic -- the static structure factor. A physical interpretation of the roton minimum frequency for the simple liquids near the Frenkel line is proposed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“基于自洽弛豫理论（self-consistent relaxation theory）”，并对比分子动力学模拟结果，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：Yukawa流体（简单模型流体）中的Frenkel线，即液体动力学交叉（从类固体集体振动主导到类气体扩散主导）的边界条件，以及纵声学激发色散关系中roton极小值的消失行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Yukawa流体的相图中，Frenkel线对应roton极小值消失的热力学状态；该线的位置可通过静态结构因子直接确定，且与分子动力学模拟结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Yukawa流体的相图中，Frenkel线对应roton极小值消失的热力学状态；该线的位置可通过静态结构因子直接确定，且与分子动力学模拟结果一致。；创新点：提出Frenkel线可直接由静态结构因子这一结构特征确定，无需依赖动力学量；并对Frenkel线附近简单液体中roton极小值频率给出了物理诠释。摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽弛豫理论（self-consistent relaxation theory）分析Yukawa流体的纵声学激发色散关系，确定roton极小值存在的热力学条件；并与已有分子动力学模拟结果进行对比验证。摘要未提及具体数值方法细节。

papers.title: Patterned Substrates Unlock Self-Electrophoretic Phenomenon in Active Janus Microswimmers
papers.abstract: Inert colloids half-coated with platinum (Pt) are a standard model of chemically powered active particles, yet the microscopic origins of their propulsion in hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) remain difficult to dissect experimentally. Whereas self-diffusiophoresis was the prevailing theory, self-electrophoresis has been more recently suggested as the main mechanism of propulsion. According to the latter mechanism, the pole-to-equator Pt-thickness gradient produced by directional metal deposition is sufficient to create anodic and cathodic regions on the metal cap and thereby generate an electric field sustained by H2O2 decomposition. Enhancing self-propulsion performance of such particles thus requires precise control over the Pt thickness distribution, which is currently not achievable with standard methods (e.g. evaporation or sputtering). Here, we propose a method to fabricate Janus active particles by assembling silica microspheres on patterned substrates containing spherical grooves whose depth and spacing set the degree of particle coating while simultaneously suppressing proximity-led defects (Pt bridges). The resulting particles exhibit a tunable platinum-thickness contrast, as verified by Focused-Ion-Beam cross-sections. In 2.5% H2O2, our results suggest that this control can significantly increase propulsion efficiency, while providing evidence indirectly supporting the hypothesis that self-electrophoresis is the dominant mechanism. These results demonstrate that our patterned-substrate route can enhance control over the catalyst deposition and enable novel Janus morphologies, allowing for more precise engineering of active colloids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“我们提出一种制造方法”“Focused-Ion-Beam截面验证”“在2.5% H2O2中的结果”等实验手段与观测。；研究对象：半包覆铂（Pt）的二氧化硅（SiO₂）胶体微球构成的Janus活性微泳者，在过氧化氢（H₂O₂）燃料中的自电泳推进现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在具有球形凹槽的图案化基底上组装二氧化硅微球，可实现对铂镀层厚度对比度的可调控制，从而显著提高微泳者在2.5% H₂O₂中的推进效率；该结果间接支持自电泳（self-electrophoresis）为主动力机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在具有球形凹槽的图案化基底上组装二氧化硅微球，可实现对铂镀层厚度对比度的可调控制，从而显著提高微泳者在2.5% H₂O₂中的推进效率；该结果间接支持自电泳（self-electrophoresis）为主动力机制。；创新点：提出一种超越传统蒸发或溅射方法的图案化基底路线，能够精确调控Janus颗粒上铂的厚度分布（极到赤道的梯度），实现新型Janus形貌，并首次在实验中通过该控制间接验证自电泳主导机制。摘要未突出说明与标准方法制备颗粒的直接定量性能对比数据。
papers.method_zh: 图案化基底辅助组装法（利用球形凹槽的深度与间距控制颗粒包覆程度并抑制铂桥缺陷）；聚焦离子束（FIB）截面表征铂厚度分布；在2.5% H₂O₂中测量推进效率。

papers.title: Charge Regulated conformational properties of polyelectrolyte near an oppositely charged nanoparticle
papers.abstract: Customizing the surface characteristics and stimuli-responsive behavior of nanoparticles with polyelectrolytes ushers in a new era across many aspects of our lives, ranging from advanced diagnostics to practical applications. Here, using hybrid CR Monte Carlo/ molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate how charge regulation can play a crucial role in shaping the adsorption dynamics of polyelectrolyte (PE) on oppositely charged nanoparticle (NP). We systematically investigate the influence of salt density, and polymer chain length on the PE-NP interaction. To complement CR results, we also perform molecular simulations under constant charge conditions. At high salt concentrations, CR enhances the adsorption of PE onto the NP surface, leading to a rapid decrease in the radius of gyration of PE; conversely, CC promotes the extended conformation of PE. No clear effect of PE length is observed at either low or high salt concentrations, whereas in CC simulations, the PE relaxes faster on the NP in the case of short chains. Furthermore, By comparing these results, we demonstrate that the MSD of PE follows a more direct path during adsorption implying a ballistic motion, whereas in the CC case, it exhibits subdiffusive behavior and delayed adsorption in both low and high salt density. Our findings indicates that 'tunable CR' is a robust strategy for controlling nanoparticle stability and interaction within a complex biochemical cues.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用“hybrid CR Monte Carlo/ molecular dynamics simulations”（混合电荷调节蒙特卡洛/分子动力学模拟），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：聚电解质（PE）与带相反电荷的纳米颗粒（NP）之间的吸附动力学，具体关注电荷调节（charge regulation, CR）效应、盐浓度和聚合物链长对PE-NP相互作用及构象的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高盐浓度下，电荷调节（CR）增强聚电解质在纳米颗粒表面的吸附，使PE回旋半径快速减小；而恒定电荷（CC）条件则促进PE的伸展构象。CR条件下PE的均方位移（MSD）呈弹道运动特征，而CC条件下呈次扩散行为并延迟吸附。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高盐浓度下，电荷调节（CR）增强聚电解质在纳米颗粒表面的吸附，使PE回旋半径快速减小；而恒定电荷（CC）条件则促进PE的伸展构象。CR条件下PE的均方位移（MSD）呈弹道运动特征，而CC条件下呈次扩散行为并延迟吸附。；创新点：首次将电荷调节（CR）效应纳入PE-NP吸附动力学的模拟研究，系统揭示了CR与CC条件下吸附路径和动力学行为的本质差异，提出“可调CR”可作为控制纳米颗粒稳定性和相互作用的策略。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合电荷调节蒙特卡洛/分子动力学（CR Monte Carlo/MD）模拟，并与恒定电荷（CC）条件下的分子模拟进行对比。系统扫描了盐密度和聚合物链长两个参数。

papers.title: High-Throughput Computational Discovery of Inverted Resistive Switching in Two-Dimensional Materials
papers.abstract: Atomristors, non-volatile resistive switching devices based on two-dimensional (2D) monolayers, are promising building blocks for energy-efficient memory and neuromorphic computing. However, their design remains restricted to a few materials such as MoS2 and h-BN, limiting functional diversity and design flexibility. Here, a high-throughput computational framework combining density functional theory, machine-learning molecular dynamics, and quantum transport simulations screens about 2,900 exfoliable monolayers for vacancy-mediated resistive switching, identifying 17 thermally stable candidates in two mechanistically distinct classes. In Class 1 monolayers, such as GaS, Au adsorption at the native vacancy introduces conducting states, switching the insulating monolayer from a high- to a low-resistance state (HRS-to-LRS). Class 2 monolayers, comprising ionically bonded metal oxyhalides and nitrohalides such as BiOCl, exhibit previously unreported inverted switching. Vacancy-released electrons delocalize and push the Fermi level into the conduction band, placing the device natively in the LRS; Au adsorption re-localizes these carriers and returns the Fermi level to the gap, driving LRS-to-HRS switching. Quantum transport simulations confirm both mechanisms, while migration-barrier calculations identify the electrode-2D separation as a key parameter governing Au migration and the resistance window. These findings expand the atomristor landscape and establish complementary switching as a design paradigm for multifunctional memory and neuromorphic hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“high-throughput computational framework”“density functional theory”“machine-learning molecular dynamics”“quantum transport simulations”。；研究对象：二维单层材料中的原子级忆阻器（atomristors），具体为约2,900种可剥离单层中由空位介导的阻变行为，涵盖GaS、BiOCl等候选材料，以及两种不同机制的阻变过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量筛选识别出17种热稳定候选材料，分为两类阻变机制：第一类（如GaS）为传统的高阻态到低阻态（HRS-to-LRS）切换；第二类（如BiOCl）表现出此前未报道的“反向阻变”（inverted switching），即器件天然处于低阻态，Au吸附后驱动LRS-to-HRS切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量筛选识别出17种热稳定候选材料，分为两类阻变机制：第一类（如GaS）为传统的高阻态到低阻态（HRS-to-LRS）切换；第二类（如BiOCl）表现出此前未报道的“反向阻变”（inverted switching），即器件天然处于低阻态，Au吸附后驱动LRS-to-HRS切换。；创新点：首次通过高通量计算系统筛选二维材料中的空位介导阻变行为，发现并建立了“互补型阻变”（complementary switching）这一新设计范式，扩展了原子忆阻器的材料体系与功能多样性。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、机器学习分子动力学（machine-learning molecular dynamics）、量子输运模拟（quantum transport simulations），以及迁移势垒计算（migration-barrier calculations）。

papers.title: SALTED: a symmetry-adapted machine-learning program for predicting electron-densities in molecules and materials
papers.abstract: SALTED provides an open-source Python package for machine learning the quantum-mechanical electron density, $n(\mathbf{r})$, in molecular and condensed-phase systems based on input atomic coordinates and species. The program adopts a linear atom-centered decomposition of the electron density, which makes it highly transferable across diverse atomistic configurations sharing similar chemical environments. Because of this representation choice, SALTED is naturally interfaced with state-of-the-art electronic-structure programs based on atomic orbitals, namely CP2K, FHI-aims, and PySCF, from which reference electron-density data can be generated and used to train a model. The learning algorithm is based on a symmetry-adapted extension of Gaussian process regression, making SALTED especially efficient in small-data regimes. Thanks to the implementation of vector-field kernel functions, SALTED can also learn the first-order response of the electron density to applied electric fields, $\partial n(\mathbf{r})/\partial \mathbf{E}$. The application of SALTED within computational workflows has already shown its utility in a wide variety of contexts, including the calculation of polarization vectors and polarizability tensors, the accurate evaluation of Coulomb forces in QM/MM molecular-dynamics simulations, and electronic-structure studies of large-scale 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine learning”“Gaussian process regression”“Python package”“open-source”，属于计算方法的开发与实现。；研究对象：分子与凝聚态体系中的量子力学电子密度 \( n(\mathbf{r}) \)，以及其对外加电场的线性响应 \( \partial n(\mathbf{r})/\partial \mathbf{E} \)。具体应用场景包括分子、QM/MM 体系及二维材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出某一具体物理体系的新物理结论，核心贡献在于提供了一个基于对称自适应高斯过程回归的、可迁移的电子密度机器学习预测程序 SALTED，并展示了其在极化、QM/MM 力计算及大尺度二维材料电子结构研究中的实用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出某一具体物理体系的新物理结论，核心贡献在于提供了一个基于对称自适应高斯过程回归的、可迁移的电子密度机器学习预测程序 SALTED，并展示了其在极化、QM/MM 力计算及大尺度二维材料电子结构研究中的实用性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有工作的具体创新点，但可归纳为：将对称自适应高斯过程回归扩展至电子密度及其电场响应预测，并实现为开源 Python 包，且天然兼容主流原子轨道基组电子结构程序，在小数据 regime 下具有高效性。
papers.method_zh: 对称自适应高斯过程回归（symmetry-adapted Gaussian process regression）；线性原子中心分解（linear atom-centered decomposition）表示电子密度；矢量场核函数（vector-field kernel functions）用于学习密度对外电场的响应；与基于原子轨道的电子结构程序 CP2K、FHI-aims、PySCF 接口对接以生成参考数据。

papers.title: Heterogeneous collapse in thermoresponsive copolymer microgels varying molar composition
papers.abstract: Understanding the internal architecture of copolymer microgels is crucial for establishing how nanoscale polymer organization controls their stimuli-responsive behavior. Here we focus on thermoresponsive P(N-isopropylacrylamide-co-N-isopropyl-methacrylamide), P(NIPAM-co-NIPMAM), microgels with varying mole fraction of the components, synthesized via radical precipitation polymerization, and we demonstrate that changes in their volume phase transition and equilibrium swelling are governed by composition-dependent internal heterogeneity. Comparison between small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) with isotopic labeling and monomer-resolved simulations show a block-like monomer distribution of the two components. SANS analysis reveals a universal maximum in the polymer mesh correlation length near the transition, evidencing coexistence of collapsed NIPAM-rich and swollen domains. The correlation length increases with increasing NIPMAM content, with a maximum for 75 mol \% NIPMAM, implying sparse collapsed regions within the network and thus a large degree of heterogeneity induced by the presence of an increasingly large fraction of intercalated, non-collapsing PNIPMAM. The maximum heterogeneity correlates with the equilibrium swelling ratio, indicating that collapsed microgels retain a structural memory of the transition and present a less-compliant structure in response to temperature variations. Overall, these insights highlight a complex effect of the block-like monomer distribution on the responsive properties of copolymer microgels with different compositions, thus providing a design rule for tailoring responsive colloids for functional soft materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与模拟混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) with isotopic labeling”（实验手段）与“monomer-resolved simulations”（模拟方法）相结合。；研究对象：热响应共聚物微凝胶，具体为P(NIPAM-co-NIPMAM)（聚(N-异丙基丙烯酰胺-co-N-异丙基甲基丙烯酰胺)），研究其不同摩尔组成下的体积相变、平衡溶胀行为及内部异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共聚物微凝胶的体积相变与平衡溶胀行为由其组成依赖的内部异质性控制：两种单体呈类嵌段分布，相变附近聚合物网格关联长度出现普适最大值，且该最大值随NIPMAM含量增加而增大（75 mol% NIPMAM时最大），表明网络内存在稀疏塌缩区域与高度异质性；最大异质性与平衡溶胀比相关，说明塌缩微凝胶保留了转变的结构记忆，对温度变化响应更不柔顺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共聚物微凝胶的体积相变与平衡溶胀行为由其组成依赖的内部异质性控制：两种单体呈类嵌段分布，相变附近聚合物网格关联长度出现普适最大值，且该最大值随NIPMAM含量增加而增大（75 mol% NIPMAM时最大），表明网络内存在稀疏塌缩区域与高度异质性；最大异质性与平衡溶胀比相关，说明塌缩微凝胶保留了转变的结构记忆，对温度变化响应更不柔顺。；创新点：揭示了类嵌段单体分布对共聚物微凝胶响应性质的复杂影响，建立了组成依赖的内部异质性（稀疏塌缩区域）与体积相变及溶胀行为之间的定量关联，为设计功能性软材料中的响应性胶体提供了设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 采用自由基沉淀聚合合成不同摩尔组成的共聚物微凝胶；使用同位素标记的小角中子散射（SANS）实验表征内部结构；结合单体分辨模拟（monomer-resolved simulations）进行对比分析；通过SANS提取聚合物网格关联长度，并关联平衡溶胀比。

papers.title: Sample-specific rectification-like response in a boundary-driven exclusion process
papers.abstract: We investigate the current response of a boundary-driven symmetric exclusion process with quenched site disorder. Hard-core particles hop symmetrically on a one-dimensional lattice with site-dependent rates and are injected and removed at the boundaries by two reservoirs of different densities. We approximate the steady-state density profile using a Galerkin projection at linear order and a mean-field closure at higher orders, and thereby obtain the current as a nonlinear function of the reservoir density difference. At linear order in the reservoir density difference, the current-response coefficient depends on the mean reservoir density $ρ$, in contrast to the homogeneous case. Through the linear-response relation, this dependence leads to an equilibrium current-fluctuation coefficient that is asymmetric under $ρ\rightarrow 1-ρ$. Beyond linear response, nonzero even-order current contributions break the antisymmetry of the current under reversal of the reservoir density difference, producing rectification-like behavior in individual disorder realizations. We further show that spatial-reflection symmetry of the equilibrium density profile rules out such behavior, so broken spatial-reflection symmetry of the profile is a necessary condition for rectification-like behavior. Within the present approximation, we further find that, for continuously distributed site disorder, rectification-like behavior occurs arbitrarily close to equilibrium for almost every disorder realization. At the ensemble level, however, the disorder-averaged current remains antisymmetric because the disorder ensemble is invariant under spatial reflection. These results provide a mechanism for rectification-like transport arising from sample-specific spatial heterogeneity rather than from an explicitly imposed directional asymmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中使用了“Galerkin projection”“mean-field closure”等近似方法，属于解析与数值结合的理论建模研究。；研究对象：一维边界驱动对称排斥过程（symmetric exclusion process）中的粒子输运，具体为具有淬火无序（quenched site disorder）的硬核粒子系统，粒子在两端由不同密度储库注入和移除。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单个无序实现中，电流对储库密度差的反向响应不再反对称，出现类似整流（rectification-like）的行为；该行为源于平衡密度剖面的空间反射对称性破缺，而非外加的方向性不对称。在系综平均层面，由于无序系综具有空间反射不变性，平均电流仍保持反对称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单个无序实现中，电流对储库密度差的反向响应不再反对称，出现类似整流（rectification-like）的行为；该行为源于平衡密度剖面的空间反射对称性破缺，而非外加的方向性不对称。在系综平均层面，由于无序系综具有空间反射不变性，平均电流仍保持反对称。；创新点：揭示了“样品特异性”的空间无序（而非显式方向不对称）即可在近平衡条件下诱导类整流输运响应，并指出空间反射对称性破缺是必要条件；同时澄清了单样品行为与系综平均行为之间的差异。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Galerkin投影在储库密度差的一阶线性阶近似稳态密度剖面，并在高阶用平均场闭合（mean-field closure）求解；通过线性响应关系分析平衡电流涨落系数，并解析讨论空间反射对称性对整流行为的约束。

papers.title: Spectral Function Method and Janus Quantum Numbers in Quasiperiodic Systems
papers.abstract: The absence of translational symmetry in quasiperiodic systems invalidates conventional band theory, posing the central challenge in the field. Building upon the incommensurate energy band (IEB) concept, we establish a unified spectral theory for quasiperiodic systems by introducing two key advances. First, we develop an efficient spectral function method that calculates $A(k,ω)$ using a small truncated Hamiltonian matrix, bypassing full diagonalization. It converges via a distinctive successive locking of energy moments, yielding exact thermodynamic-limit results without finite-size scaling. Second, we introduce that quasiperiodic eigenstates possess Janus quantum numbers: a single eigenstate, continuously tracked across localization transitions, carries dual labels in momentum and real space, which naturally reduce to the familiar Bloch momentum and band index in the commensurate limit. Together with IEB, these advances constitute a ``band theory'' for quasiperiodic systems, enabling us to define, compute, and label states with the same facility as in periodic ones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“建立统一谱理论”“发展谱函数方法”“引入Janus量子数”等理论框架构建与概念提出，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：准周期系统（quasiperiodic systems），具体关注其电子能带结构、本征态标记与局域化转变中的态追踪问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准周期本征态具有“Janus量子数”——单个本征态在动量空间和实空间携带双重标签，在公度极限下自然还原为布洛赫动量与能带指标；结合非公度能带（IEB）概念，可为准周期系统建立类似周期系统的“能带理论”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准周期本征态具有“Janus量子数”——单个本征态在动量空间和实空间携带双重标签，在公度极限下自然还原为布洛赫动量与能带指标；结合非公度能带（IEB）概念，可为准周期系统建立类似周期系统的“能带理论”。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：首次提出Janus量子数概念，并建立无需有限尺寸标度的谱函数计算方法，使准周期系统能带定义、计算与态标记达到与周期系统同等的便利性）。
papers.method_zh: 谱函数方法（spectral function method）：利用小型截断哈密顿矩阵直接计算A(k,ω)，避免全对角化；通过能量矩的逐级锁定实现收敛，无需有限尺寸标度即可获得热力学极限精确结果。

papers.title: Magnetic Couplings in Half-Filled Bipartite Graphs
papers.abstract: We break from perturbative frameworks to establish a non-perturbative generalization of magnetic exchange rules in half-filled bipartite networks. While historical models remain strictly tied to the debatable perturbation approach in the dilute limit and require the absence of zero-energy modes, our universal mechanism governs exchange interactions across arbitrary bipartite graphs. By bypassing traditional expansion bottlenecks, this framework provides an analytical predictive tool for magnetism in complex lattices, offering key design principles to engineer stable, long-range order in next-generation 2D spintronic devices
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要强调“非微扰推广”“解析预测工具”“理论框架”，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：半填充二分图（half-filled bipartite graphs）网络中的磁交换相互作用与磁性有序，面向二维自旋电子学器件中的长程磁有序设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了一种非微扰的普适磁交换规则，适用于任意二分图，无需依赖传统微扰展开的稀极限条件，也无需排除零能模，从而为复杂晶格中的磁性提供了解析预测工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了一种非微扰的普适磁交换规则，适用于任意二分图，无需依赖传统微扰展开的稀极限条件，也无需排除零能模，从而为复杂晶格中的磁性提供了解析预测工具。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：首次将磁交换规则推广到非微扰、任意二分图情形，摆脱了历史模型对微扰方法和零能模缺失的严格限制）。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰理论框架，突破传统微扰展开（如基于稀极限的微扰磁交换模型）的瓶颈，对任意二分图进行解析推导。

papers.title: Near-surface colloidal dynamics in jammed and slipping microgel suspensions
papers.abstract: Jammed suspensions of soft microgel particles may exhibit slippage along smooth boundaries. Owing to their expected sub-micrometric dimensions, direct observations of dynamics within the near-surface layers supposed to be responsible for this slippage have been difficult to achieve. Here, we use total internal reflection fluorescence microscopy (TIRFM) to observe nanoparticle dynamics near glass/microgel-suspension interfaces. Indicating near-wall dynamic heterogeneity, velocity profiles for suspensions are nonlinear. These profiles tend to a constant slippage velocity at submicrometric distances from the wall, consistent with macroscopic wall slip measurements. Furthermore, nanoscale particle altitude distributions are strongly dependent on the slip velocity, revealing a dynamically-mediated and nanoscale particle-organisation effect. The collected observations give support for the existence of near-wall heterogeneity as a dominant mechanism contributing to microgel wall slip. Our work also opens new perspectives for the study of particle dynamics and organisation in complex interfacial environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用TIRFM进行直接观测，涉及实验测量（速度剖面、粒子高度分布）。；研究对象：微凝胶（microgel）堵塞悬浮液在光滑玻璃界面附近的近表面动力学，特别是壁面滑移（wall slip）现象及其近壁粒子运动与组织行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 近壁速度剖面呈非线性，且在亚微米尺度趋于恒定滑移速度，与宏观壁滑移测量一致；纳米尺度粒子高度分布强烈依赖于滑移速度，表明存在动态介导的纳米级粒子组织效应，支持近壁异质性作为微凝胶壁滑移主导机制的观点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：近壁速度剖面呈非线性，且在亚微米尺度趋于恒定滑移速度，与宏观壁滑移测量一致；纳米尺度粒子高度分布强烈依赖于滑移速度，表明存在动态介导的纳米级粒子组织效应，支持近壁异质性作为微凝胶壁滑移主导机制的观点。；创新点：首次利用TIRFM实现对近表面层（亚微米尺度）粒子动力学的直接观测，揭示了近壁动态异质性及滑移速度依赖的纳米级粒子组织效应，为微凝胶壁滑移机制提供了直接实验证据。（摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异）
papers.method_zh: 全内反射荧光显微镜（TIRFM），用于观测玻璃/微凝胶悬浮液界面附近的纳米粒子动力学；结合宏观壁滑移测量进行对照。

papers.title: Non-Resonant Impulsively Stimulated Raman Scattering by a Terahertz Field: a Case Study of 1T-TaS2
papers.abstract: Time-domain ultrafast and nonlinear terahertz spectroscopy techniques are recently applied to many condensed matter systems for investigating their collective excitations. In centrosymmetric systems, these collective modes are typically Raman-active and therefore do not couple directly to the terahertz electric field. The mechanism by which light-matter interaction realizes in these studies has not been explicitly discussed in detail. In this work, we perform terahertz pump - optical probe and terahertz third harmonic generation investigations on 1T-TaS2, a material exhibiting a rich charge-density-wave (CDW) phase diagram including the commensurate, nearly-commensurate and incommensurate CDW phases. The transition between these distinct states leaves a clear signature on the dynamical Raman response. We investigate how the Raman-active phonons couple to a broadband monocycle terahertz field as well as a narrowband multicycle terahertz field. Our results indicate that a modified impulsively stimulated Raman scattering mechanism involving two-photon absorption, also known as non-resonant Raman scattering, underlies the coherent excitation and observation of the lattice modes. These results are relevant for future spectroscopy investigation and coherent control of collective modes using low-energy terahertz field as well as cavity electrodynamical dressing of solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“terahertz pump - optical probe”和“terahertz third harmonic generation investigations”，属于超快非线性太赫兹光谱实验。；研究对象：1T-TaS2，一种具有丰富电荷密度波（CDW）相图（公度、近公度、非公度CDW相）的层状材料，重点研究其拉曼活性声子模式与太赫兹场的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在1T-TaS2中，宽带单周期和窄带多周期太赫兹场激发拉曼活性晶格模式的机制是修正的受激拉曼散射（涉及双光子吸收，即非共振拉曼散射），而非直接的太赫兹-声子耦合。CDW相变在动力学拉曼响应上留下清晰特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在1T-TaS2中，宽带单周期和窄带多周期太赫兹场激发拉曼活性晶格模式的机制是修正的受激拉曼散射（涉及双光子吸收，即非共振拉曼散射），而非直接的太赫兹-声子耦合。CDW相变在动力学拉曼响应上留下清晰特征。；创新点：首次明确阐述了中心对称体系中拉曼活性集体模式与太赫兹场耦合的微观机制——非共振受激拉曼散射（经双光子吸收过程），为利用低能太赫兹场和腔电动力学调控固体集体模式提供了物理基础。摘要未突出说明与以往具体实验的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹泵浦-光学探针光谱（terahertz pump - optical probe）和太赫兹三次谐波产生（THz third harmonic generation）实验，对比宽带单周期与窄带多周期太赫兹脉冲激发下的声子响应。

papers.title: Orbital-Free DFT-Assisted Machine-Learned Molecular Dynamics for Electric-Field-Driven Ionic Transport
papers.abstract: We propose an orbital-free density functional theory (OFDFT)-assisted machine-learned molecular dynamics method in which field-independent interatomic forces are evaluated using a machine-learned potential and atomic charges that depend on the local environment are obtained from OFDFT calculations. The atomic charges obtained by Bader partitioning of the OFDFT electron density are multiplied by the electric-field vector and added to the forces from the machine-learned potential. This approach enables molecular dynamics simulations under an electric field at a lower computational cost than Kohn-Sham DFT (KSDFT)-based molecular dynamics. As a proof of concept, the method was applied to beta-Li3PS4 bulk and an S8/Li3PS4 heterostructure under periodic boundary conditions. For Li3PS4 bulk, OFDFT yielded Li charges and a total charge of the PS4 unit consistent with those obtained using KSDFT. In the heterostructure, Li ions migrated from the Li3PS4 region into the S-rich region within a simulation time of approximately 170 ps. Accompanying this migration, the mean Bader charge of the S atoms that initially formed S8 rings changed from nearly neutral to negative. A comparison with KSDFT for a representative interfacial structure also confirmed that the negative charging of the S atoms upon the arrival of Li and the magnitude of the Li charges were qualitatively reproduced. These results demonstrate the possibility of treating field-driven ionic transport and changes in interfacial charge states using a universal machine-learned potential without training an additional material-specific charge-prediction model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“machine-learned molecular dynamics”“OFDFT calculations”“molecular dynamics simulations”等计算模拟方法关键词。；研究对象：电场驱动下的离子输运现象，具体材料体系为β-Li₃PS₄体相材料以及S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构（固态电解质/硫界面体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于无轨道密度泛函理论（OFDFT）辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法，能够在较低计算成本下模拟电场驱动的离子迁移。在S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构中，Li离子在约170 ps内从Li₃PS₄区域迁移至富S区域，同时伴随S原子Bader电荷由近中性变为负值，表明该方法可定性重现界面电荷态变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于无轨道密度泛函理论（OFDFT）辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法，能够在较低计算成本下模拟电场驱动的离子迁移。在S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构中，Li离子在约170 ps内从Li₃PS₄区域迁移至富S区域，同时伴随S原子Bader电荷由近中性变为负值，表明该方法可定性重现界面电荷态变化。；创新点：该方法无需针对特定材料额外训练电荷预测模型，即可利用通用机器学习势处理电场驱动的离子输运及界面电荷态变化，相比KSDFT基分子动力学大幅降低了计算成本。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用OFDFT辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法：场无关的原子间作用力由机器学习势计算，依赖于局域环境的原子电荷由OFDFT计算获得（通过对OFDFT电子密度进行Bader划分得到原子电荷），将电荷乘以电场矢量后叠加到机器学习势给出的力上。在周期性边界条件下对β-Li₃PS₄体相和S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构进行了模拟，并与Kohn-Sham DFT（KSDFT）结果进行了对比验证。

papers.title: Electron-phonon coupled hydrodynamics in semimetal TaAs_2
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic corrections to diffusive transport can arise when momentum-conserving collisions between quasiparticles become prominent, and they have been documented for both electrons and phonons. An emerging frontier topic is coupled electron-phonon (e-ph) hydrodynamics. Here, through electrical and thermal transport measurements on TaAs2 crystals with different impurity levels, we document the emergence of an e-ph bifluid in the temperature window of 5 to 15 K. Within this range, the lattice thermal conductivity exhibits a faster-than-T^3 temperature dependence, as a consequence of non-monotonic and purity-dependent phonon mean free paths, a signature of phonon Poiseuille flow. However, strong e-ph coupling impedes the emergence of a ballistic regime. This is corroborated by the observation of quantum oscillations in the lattice thermal conductivity. Prominent phonon-mediated momentum exchange between electrons amplifies the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law and yields a two-order-of-magnitude discrepancy between quantum and transport lifetimes, a signature of electron hydrodynamics in semimetals. Our results imply that in semimetals with optimized e-ph coupling, thanks to matching between the cryogenic phonon wave?length and the Fermi wavelength, momentum and energy flow between the electron and phonon reservoirs as frequently as within each reservoir.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“通过电学和热输运测量”（electrical and thermal transport measurements），并描述了具体的实验观测现象（如晶格热导率、量子振荡）。；研究对象：半金属二砷化钽（TaAs₂）晶体，具体研究其在不同杂质浓度下的电子-声子耦合流体动力学（coupled electron-phonon hydrodynamics）行为，以及5至15 K温区内的双流体（bifluid）输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在5至15 K温区内，TaAs₂中出现了电子-声子耦合双流体行为：声子表现出泊肃叶流（Poiseuille flow）特征（晶格热导率呈快于T³的温度依赖），而强电子-声子耦合抑制了弹道输运的出现，同时增强了Wiedemann-Franz定律的破坏，并导致量子寿命与输运寿命相差两个数量级，这是半金属中电子流体动力学的标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在5至15 K温区内，TaAs₂中出现了电子-声子耦合双流体行为：声子表现出泊肃叶流（Poiseuille flow）特征（晶格热导率呈快于T³的温度依赖），而强电子-声子耦合抑制了弹道输运的出现，同时增强了Wiedemann-Franz定律的破坏，并导致量子寿命与输运寿命相差两个数量级，这是半金属中电子流体动力学的标志。；创新点：该工作首次在实验上记录了半金属TaAs₂中电子-声子耦合双流体（e-ph bifluid）的涌现，并指出在低温下声子波长与费米波长匹配时，优化的电子-声子耦合可使动量与能量在电子和声子库之间的交换频率与库内交换相当。摘要未突出说明与理论模型的定量对比或对具体耦合机制的微观解释。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为电输运和热输运测量（electrical and thermal transport measurements），研究对象为具有不同杂质水平的TaAs₂单晶样品。通过分析晶格热导率的温度依赖、非单调且依赖纯度的声子平均自由程，以及晶格热导率中的量子振荡来得出结论。

papers.title: Competing lattice structures induced by Sn substitution in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: Understanding the effect of chemical substitution on competing phases of kagome metals is crucial for disentangling the interplay between local structural distortions and electronic instabilities. In \cvs, Sn substitution strongly modifies the electronic phase diagram, yet the microscopic mechanism driving this remains unclear. Here, we combine $^{121}$Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements and density functional theory calculations to investigate the atomic-scale effects of Sn substitution in CsV$_3$Sb$_{5-x}$Sn$_x$. At low Sn concentrations, the observed satellite NQR peaks exhibit signatures of local structural distortion induced by Sn substitution, qualitatively consistent with our computational analysis. These impurity-induced features persist across the entire experimentally investigated doping range, up to $x$ = 0.65, and remain observable up to room temperature. For $x=1$, the fully doped idealized case, the estimated dynamical instabilities of the kagome lattice suggest the stabilization of two nearly energy-degenerate equilibrium structures characterized by V-trimers, distinguished by a zero- or $π$-phase shift between adjacent layers along the $c$-axis. Together, these results show that Sn substitution drives a complex interplay between local impurity-induced distortions and competing structural instabilities in vanadium-based kagome compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：结合了 \(^{121}\)Sb 核四极共振（NQR）测量与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：笼目（kagome）金属 CsV\(_3\)Sb\(_5\) 中 Sn 替代 V/Sb 位（CsV\(_3\)Sb\(_{5-x}\)Sn\(_x\)）引起的局域结构畸变与竞争性晶格不稳定性，以及电子相图的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sn 替代在低浓度下诱导局域结构畸变（卫星 NQR 峰），该畸变在高达 x=0.65 及室温下仍存在；在完全掺杂（x=1）的理想情形下，笼目晶格存在两种近简并的平衡结构（V-三聚体，层间沿 c 轴呈 0 或 π 相位差），表明 Sn 替代驱动了杂质诱导畸变与竞争性结构不稳定性之间的复杂相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sn 替代在低浓度下诱导局域结构畸变（卫星 NQR 峰），该畸变在高达 x=0.65 及室温下仍存在；在完全掺杂（x=1）的理想情形下，笼目晶格存在两种近简并的平衡结构（V-三聚体，层间沿 c 轴呈 0 或 π 相位差），表明 Sn 替代驱动了杂质诱导畸变与竞争性结构不稳定性之间的复杂相互作用。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上揭示 Sn 替代在 CsV\(_3\)Sb\(_5\) 中诱导的局域结构畸变特征（NQR 卫星峰），并预测完全掺杂极限下两种能量近简并的 V-三聚体结构（层间相位差 0 或 π），为理解化学替代与笼目晶格电子/结构不稳定性竞争提供了微观图像。摘要未突出说明与先前仅关注电子相图宏观变化的研究相比的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用 \(^{121}\)Sb 核四极共振（NQR）谱学；理论上采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，包括对晶格动力学不稳定性的分析（估计声子不稳定性以判断平衡结构）。

papers.title: Interplay of B-Site Off-Centering and Molecular Orientations in the Mixed Hybrid Perovskite MAGe1xSnxI3
papers.abstract: B-site mixing is a common strategy for tuning properties of halide perovskites. In the lead-free system MAGe1-xSn_xI3, it brings tilting and off-centering into competition. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential, we map the structural behavior across the full composition range. MAGeI3 exhibits strong polar B-site off-centering that remains nearly constant up to the cubic transition, together with methylammonium (MA) orientational order that weakens progressively on heating. By contrast, MASnI3 combines octahedral tilting with weaker, predominantly antipolar off-centering. Ge-like behavior persists upon alloying and gives way to Sn-like behavior only beyond roughly 65 % Sn. In the high-temperature phases, the B-site cations remain locally off-centered but directionally disordered. On the Ge-rich side, the distorted inorganic framework biases the soft MA orientational landscape toward a restricted set of preferred directions. This coupling shows how the composition of the inorganic sublattice can tune molecular ordering in lead-free hybrid perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“large-scale molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential”（机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：无铅混合卤化物钙钛矿 MAGe₁₋ₓSnₓI₃（MA = 甲基铵），重点关注其全组分范围内B位（Ge/Sn）偏心位移与MA分子取向之间的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MAGeI₃表现出强极性B位偏心且几乎不随升温衰减，而MASnI₃则表现为八面体倾斜与较弱、主要为反极性的偏心；Ge类行为在合金中持续存在，直到Sn含量超过约65%才转变为Sn类行为。高温相中B位阳离子仍局域偏心但方向无序，且富Ge侧畸变无机框架会将软MA取向景观限制在少数优选方向上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MAGeI₃表现出强极性B位偏心且几乎不随升温衰减，而MASnI₃则表现为八面体倾斜与较弱、主要为反极性的偏心；Ge类行为在合金中持续存在，直到Sn含量超过约65%才转变为Sn类行为。高温相中B位阳离子仍局域偏心但方向无序，且富Ge侧畸变无机框架会将软MA取向景观限制在少数优选方向上。；创新点：揭示了无机亚晶格B位偏心类型（极性vs反极性）与有机MA分子取向序之间的耦合机制，表明通过调控无机骨架组分可实现对无铅杂化钙钛矿中有机分子取向有序性的调节。摘要未突出说明与以往计算工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子间势（machine-learned interatomic potential）驱动的大规模分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，覆盖全组分范围的结构行为映射。

papers.title: Exact Scaling Laws and Non-Hermitian Topological Phase Transitions of Active Continuum on Hyperbolic Manifolds
papers.abstract: The macroscopic collective motion of active continuum on curved manifolds is conventionally addressed through perturbative dynamic renormalization or finite-element simulations, often obscuring the underlying geometric mechanisms. Here, an exact algebraic framework is established to reformulate the active phase transition on hyperbolic spaces $\mathbb{H}^2$. By rigorously expanding the covariant Navier-Stokes-like equations and applying the Weitzenböck identity, we derive the exact critical threshold $α_c = \frac{5}{4}Dκ^2$ for macroscopic polarization, which is dictated by the geometric mass gap of the Hodge-de Rham Laplacian. We strictly define the parameter subspace $α= 2Dκ^2$ where the topological free energy reaches the Bogomolny-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) limit. This enables the reduction of the complex velocity field to Blaschke products via Möbius gauge symmetry. The flat-space limit ($κ\to 0$) exactly degenerates to the topological phase of the classical O(2) model, demonstrating that the constant negative curvature acts as an un-perturbative infrared regularization for non-linear amplitude saturation. Furthermore, mapping the non-variational active convective modes onto the defect translational zero-modes yields an intrinsically non-reciprocal interaction matrix. By analytically extending the singular integral operator of the dynamically condensed defect ring, we identify a macroscopic second-order exceptional point (EP2) characterized by a strictly algebraic dynamic scaling law $τ\sim |Δν|^{-1/2}$. This closed-form theoretical paradigm provides exact solutions for geometric frustration and non-Hermitian topology in soft mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact algebraic framework、rigorously expanding、derive、theoretical paradigm。；研究对象：双曲流形（\(\mathbb{H}^2\)）上活性连续介质的宏观集体运动与拓扑相变，涉及非厄米拓扑、几何阻挫与软物质力学中的极化有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出宏观极化序的精确临界阈值 \(\alpha_c = \frac{5}{4}D\kappa^2\)，由 Hodge-de Rham 拉普拉斯算符的几何质量隙决定；并识别出动力学凝聚缺陷环上的宏观二阶奇异点（EP2），其动力学标度律严格为 \(\tau \sim |\Delta\nu|^{-1/2}\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出宏观极化序的精确临界阈值 \(\alpha_c = \frac{5}{4}D\kappa^2\)，由 Hodge-de Rham 拉普拉斯算符的几何质量隙决定；并识别出动力学凝聚缺陷环上的宏观二阶奇异点（EP2），其动力学标度律严格为 \(\tau \sim |\Delta\nu|^{-1/2}\)。；创新点：建立了双曲空间上活性相变的精确代数框架，取代了传统的微扰动态重整化或有限元模拟；揭示了常负曲率作为非线性振幅饱和的非微扰红外正则化机制；将非变分活性对流模式映射为缺陷平移零模，从而在软物质体系中实现了非厄米拓扑相变的闭式解析描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用协变 Navier-Stokes 类方程的严格展开，结合 Weitzenböck 恒等式；利用 Möbius 规范对称性将复速度场约化为 Blaschke 乘积；通过解析延拓奇异积分算子分析缺陷环的凝聚模式，并构造非互易相互作用矩阵。

papers.title: Such stuff as magic is made on: compact operator algebra, stabilizer polytope and the structure of reduced density matrices in a Kitaev spin liquid
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body systems exhibit rich and complex behaviour. Magic has recently emerged as a powerful new diagnostic for probing such systems, complementing other key features such as many-body entanglement. Here, starting from an investigation of the onset of magic within subsystems of a larger many-body quantum system, we show that intricate structures emerge which shed important light on the underlying many-body physics. Focusing on the Kitaev honeycomb model, we first identify the temperature below which local subsystems acquire magic. Remarkably, we find that the optimal magic witnesses active at the onset of magic reveal compact operator spaces that continue to capture the local thermal states throughout their subsequent evolution. For the six-site hexagonal marginal, this connection can be made stronger: the same operator space emerges independently from the symmetries of the local marginal and forms the symmetry-resolved plaquette algebra. When these symmetries are realized exactly, the local state lies entirely within this algebra and the reduced robustness of magic is equal to the full robustness of magic. The same reduced description can also be applied to other local quantum resources, which we illustrate using genuine multipartite entanglement. Furthermore, the operator spaces possess a rich algebraic structure in the form of finite-dimensional Euclidean Jordan algebras, with a natural interpretation in terms of bond and bond-cycle operators. Our general methodology therefore show how the onset of local magic can reveal a compact, physically meaningful operator structure underlying the finite-temperature Kitaev spin liquid, and opens up a new avenue towards reduced descriptions of quantum resources in many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于理论分析（operator algebra、stabilizer polytope、reduced density matrices），未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：Kitaev蜂巢模型（Kitaev honeycomb model）中的量子多体系统，具体研究其有限温度下局域子系统的“magic”（非稳定子资源）及其背后的算子代数结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Kitaev自旋液体中，局域子系统开始获得magic的温度以下，最优magic witness所揭示的紧致算子空间能持续描述后续局域热态；对于六位六边形边缘态，该算子空间与局域边缘的对称性导出的plaquette代数一致，且当对称性精确实现时，局域态的约化magic鲁棒性等于完整magic鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Kitaev自旋液体中，局域子系统开始获得magic的温度以下，最优magic witness所揭示的紧致算子空间能持续描述后续局域热态；对于六位六边形边缘态，该算子空间与局域边缘的对称性导出的plaquette代数一致，且当对称性精确实现时，局域态的约化magic鲁棒性等于完整magic鲁棒性。；创新点：首次展示局域magic的出现可揭示有限温度Kitaev自旋液体中紧致且物理上有意义的算子结构，为多体系统中量子资源的约化描述开辟新途径；摘要未突出说明与已有magic研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：magic（非稳定子资源）度量与witness分析、约化密度矩阵的结构分析、算子代数（有限维欧几里得Jordan代数）分类、对称性分辨的plaquette代数构造，以及将约化描述推广至多体纠缠等其它量子资源。

papers.title: Built-In Electric Field Modulation of Spontaneous Magnetism and Thermospin Transport in Boron-Nitrogen Doped Zigzag Graphene Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Zigzag-edged graphene nanoribbons (ZGNRs) host large magnetic moments at two zigzag edges due to spontaneous magnetism, whose ground state is antiferromagnetically coupled spin-order edge state (AF state). In this paper, the spontaneous magnetism and thermoelectricity of ZGNRs with periodic substituted doping of boron and nitrogen atoms along the axial direction are investigated by first principle calculation. The doping induces an internal electric field, which modulates the magnetic moments at the two zigzag edges and the band structure with spin splitting. For varying doping configuration, the ground state could be AF state, ferromagnetically coupled spin-order edge state (FM state), or degenerated pair of AF and FM states. External transversal static electric field can further modulate the magnetic moments and the band structure. By designing the doping configuration and the external field, pure thermal spin current with the absence of thermal charge current can be generated at room temperature, which can be switched on and off by flipping the magnetic configuration between AF and FM states. Thus, the doped ZGNRs can be applied as prototype devices for spin-caloritronic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first principle calculation”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：硼氮周期性替代掺杂的锯齿型石墨烯纳米带（ZGNRs），具体研究其自发磁性、内建电场效应以及热自旋输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼氮掺杂在ZGNRs中引入内建电场，可调控两条锯齿边缘的磁矩和自旋劈裂的能带结构；通过设计掺杂构型和外加横向电场，可在室温下产生纯热自旋电流（无热电荷电流），并可通过翻转磁构型（AF↔FM）实现该自旋电流的开关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼氮掺杂在ZGNRs中引入内建电场，可调控两条锯齿边缘的磁矩和自旋劈裂的能带结构；通过设计掺杂构型和外加横向电场，可在室温下产生纯热自旋电流（无热电荷电流），并可通过翻转磁构型（AF↔FM）实现该自旋电流的开关。；创新点：提出利用周期性硼氮共掺杂在ZGNRs中构建内建电场，实现对自发磁性（AF/FM基态）和热自旋输运的协同调控，并展示了在室温下实现可开关的纯热自旋电流的自旋-热电子学原型器件方案。摘要未突出说明与以往掺杂研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论，摘要未明确具体泛函或软件，如VASP、SIESTA等未说明）。

papers.title: Granular Rods Fall Faster in Denser Obstacle Fields
papers.abstract: How particle shape affects transport through obstacle fields under external driving is a fundamental question in nonequilibrium physics. We simulate a dissipative rod falling under gravity through randomly placed fixed obstacles. As the obstacle density increases, the mean descent speed decreases, increases, and then decreases again before trapping. The rod can therefore fall faster in a denser obstacle field. Scaling arguments based on collision rates and rod geometry explain all three regimes, their crossovers, and the mean fall distance before trapping. These results reveal nonmonotonic driven transport arising from particle anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“simulate”（模拟）、“scaling arguments”（标度论证）等关键词，属于数值模拟结合理论分析。；研究对象：受重力驱动、在随机固定障碍物场中下落的耗散性颗粒杆（granular rods）。研究的是颗粒各向异性对障碍物场中驱动输运行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着障碍物密度增加，杆的平均下落速度呈现“减小—增大—再减小”的非单调变化，即在更密的障碍物场中杆反而可能下落得更快。该现象源于颗粒形状各向异性导致的非单调驱动输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着障碍物密度增加，杆的平均下落速度呈现“减小—增大—再减小”的非单调变化，即在更密的障碍物场中杆反而可能下落得更快。该现象源于颗粒形状各向异性导致的非单调驱动输运。；创新点：揭示了颗粒各向异性（杆状形状）在障碍物场中引发非单调驱动输运的机制，并通过标度理论统一解释了三个输运区间、交叉行为及被捕获前的平均下落距离。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比或潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟方法，模拟了耗散性杆状颗粒在重力作用下穿过随机放置的固定障碍物的过程。通过改变障碍物密度，统计平均下落速度及下落距离；并基于碰撞率和杆几何形状建立标度论证（scaling arguments）来解释不同输运区间及其交叉行为。

papers.title: Studying line defect at Deconfined Quantum Criticality via fuzzy sphere regularization
papers.abstract: The interplay between bulk critical fluctuations and nontrivial topology can enrich defect physics and give rise to novel defect universality classes. Understanding the fate of such defects therefore constitutes an important open problem. In this work, we studied a particularly simple setting: a (0+1)-dimensional pinning-field defect coupled to a (2+1)-dimensional deconfined quantum critical bulk. Using the fuzzy-sphere regularization, we numerically investigated the defect operator spectrum and extracted several universal quantities characterizing the defect conformal fixed point, including the scaling dimensions of defect-changing(creating) operators and the defect \(g\)-function. These results establish the first numerical characterization of line-defect conformal data at deconfined quantum criticality and may stimulate further investigations of defect critical phenomena in topological quantum critical matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值研究文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“fuzzy-sphere regularization”和“numerically investigated”，属于数值计算方法。；研究对象：(2+1)维去禁闭量子临界（Deconfined Quantum Criticality, DQC）体态中耦合的(0+1)维钉扎场缺陷，即一条线缺陷（line defect）嵌入二维量子临界体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过模糊球正则化数值计算，首次获得了去禁闭量子临界点处线缺陷的共形数据，包括缺陷改变（产生）算符的标度维数和缺陷g函数，建立了该体系中线缺陷共形不动点的首个数值表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过模糊球正则化数值计算，首次获得了去禁闭量子临界点处线缺陷的共形数据，包括缺陷改变（产生）算符的标度维数和缺陷g函数，建立了该体系中线缺陷共形不动点的首个数值表征。；创新点：首次对去禁闭量子临界性中的线缺陷共形数据进行了数值表征，填补了体临界涨落与拓扑缺陷相互作用这一开放问题的数值空白。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 模糊球正则化（fuzzy-sphere regularization）数值方法，用于模拟(2+1)维DQC体态并提取缺陷算符谱及普适量。

papers.title: Universal scaling of fluctuations and correlations across the superfluid transition
papers.abstract: The critical behavior of a system near a continuous phase transition is commonly characterized by power laws and a set of universal critical exponents. Yet universality at phase transitions has even more fundamental manifestations. It dictates that all observables follow universal scaling functions, which may extend beyond simple power laws. Furthermore, microscopic details are captured entirely by only two system-specific scale factors, that rescale any measured quantity onto its universal form. In this work, we report the experimental validation of this prediction in ultracold lattice Bose gases undergoing the superfluid transition. We extract the scale factors by collapsing the order-parameter cumulants measured at varying entropies. We show that these factors specify scaling functions governing both the order-parameter distribution and two-point correlations. By measuring these scaling functions, we also determine three critical exponents $β$, $γ$ and $ν$. Our results provide an experimental demonstration that universal scaling is simultaneously obeyed by multiple observables in a quantum many-body system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental validation”“ultracold lattice Bose gases”“we extract the scale factors by collapsing the order-parameter cumulants measured”，属于冷原子实验研究。；研究对象：超冷晶格玻色气体在超流相变附近的临界行为，具体为三维均匀（或近均匀）晶格玻色体系中的量子相变与普适标度性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验验证了在超流相变附近，多个可观测量（序参量分布与两点关联函数）同时遵循由仅两个系统特定标度因子决定的普适标度函数，并由此测定了三个临界指数β、γ和ν。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验验证了在超流相变附近，多个可观测量（序参量分布与两点关联函数）同时遵循由仅两个系统特定标度因子决定的普适标度函数，并由此测定了三个临界指数β、γ和ν。；创新点：首次在量子多体系统中实验演示了多个不同可观测量（序参量分布与关联函数）同时满足普适标度函数，且仅需两个体系特定标度因子即可统一描述，超越了以往仅验证幂律临界指数的层面。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 超冷原子光晶格实验：通过改变熵（温度）驱动体系跨越超流相变，测量序参量累积量（cumulants）并利用数据塌缩（collapse）提取标度因子，进而测量序参量分布和两点关联函数的标度形式，拟合得到临界指数。

papers.title: Computing stable configurations of confined smectic liquid crystals with a deep variational framework
papers.abstract: Smectic liquid crystals are layered liquid-crystalline phases characterized by orientational order and periodic density modulation. Although their structures can be modeled using continuum theories, computing stable configurations remains challenging in complex geometries, particularly when the high-frequency density modulations associated with smectic layering should be resolved. We propose a deep variational framework (DVF) for computing these configurations within the modified Landau--de Gennes model, in which the coupled orientational and positional order parameters are represented on a regular reference domain while physical confinement is incorporated through coordinate mappings. A warmup penalty mitigates the spectral bias of neural networks toward smooth, nonlayered fields, enabling robust recovery of oscillatory smectic states. Comparisons with a neural-network baseline and finite-difference relaxation demonstrate the essential role of this penalty and the numerical stability of the resulting layered states. The DVF reproduces experimentally established smectic-A defect structures and layer morphologies across diverse confinement geometries and further predicts a chevron-like smectic-C state in a tangent-anchored sphere. Together, these results demonstrate the applicability of the DVF to computing stable smectic configurations across experimentally relevant confinement geometries and anchoring conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：deep variational framework、computing、modeling、finite-difference relaxation。；研究对象：受限几何中的近晶相液晶（smectic liquid crystals），具体包括近晶A（smectic-A）缺陷结构和近晶C（smectic-C）层状形态，涉及不同锚定条件（如切向锚定球体）下的稳定构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种深度变分框架（DVF），通过引入“预热惩罚”（warmup penalty）克服神经网络对光滑非层状场的谱偏置，能够稳定计算受限近晶液晶的振荡层状态，并复现实验已知的近晶A缺陷结构，同时预测了切向锚定球体中类似人字纹（chevron-like）的近晶C态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种深度变分框架（DVF），通过引入“预热惩罚”（warmup penalty）克服神经网络对光滑非层状场的谱偏置，能够稳定计算受限近晶液晶的振荡层状态，并复现实验已知的近晶A缺陷结构，同时预测了切向锚定球体中类似人字纹（chevron-like）的近晶C态。；创新点：首次将深度变分框架与预热惩罚结合，用于解决近晶液晶中高频密度调制与复杂几何受限耦合的稳定构型计算难题；该方法能处理多种实验相关受限几何与锚定条件，并预测了新的近晶C层状形态（摘要未突出说明是否为首个此类预测，但明确为“进一步预测”）。
papers.method_zh: 基于修正的Landau–de Gennes连续统模型，采用深度变分框架（DVF）：序参量（取向序与位置序）定义在规则参考域上，通过坐标映射引入物理受限几何；使用神经网络表示场变量，并加入warmup penalty以促进高频层状结构的恢复。对比方法包括神经网络基线和有限差分弛豫。

papers.title: Doping dependence of local moments in infinite layer nickelates
papers.abstract: The infinite layer nickelates are notable for their lack of long-range antiferromagnetic ordering, in contrast to the parent compounds of the superconducting cuprates. Instead, the nickelates show evidence of short-range glassy behavior in both the undoped and optimally-doped regimes, implying that local electronic moments exist independent of superconductivity. However, the systematic doping-dependent magnetic behavior is not yet fully resolved, and characterizing it could uncover the relationship between local moments and the superconducting dome. In this work, we use muon spin rotation ($μ$SR) on a (La,Sr)NiO$_2$ doping series from the undoped parent compound, through the superconducting dome, to the over-doped normal state (Sr substitution 0% $\leq$ x $\leq$ 25%) to probe the magnetic ground state and the temperature-dependent static and dynamic behavior. We find that local moments experience spin freezing into a glassy state at temperatures on the order of a few tens of kelvin regardless of the doping level. We also observe a subtle destabilization of the glassy state with increased hole doping.
