These observations suggest that magnetism and superconductivity are largely decoupled phenomena with indirect interactions described in a multi-orbital framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用muon spin rotation（μSR）实验技术对掺杂系列样品进行测量。；研究对象：无限层镍氧化物（La,Sr）NiO₂，掺杂系列从未掺杂母体（x=0%）经超导穹顶区到过掺杂正常态（x=25%），研究其局域磁矩的掺杂依赖行为及磁基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域磁矩在所有掺杂水平下均在几十开尔文温度尺度进入玻璃态自旋冻结，且空穴掺杂会轻微削弱该玻璃态稳定性。这表明镍氧化物中的磁性与超导性在很大程度上是退耦的，二者仅通过多轨道框架中的间接相互作用关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域磁矩在所有掺杂水平下均在几十开尔文温度尺度进入玻璃态自旋冻结，且空穴掺杂会轻微削弱该玻璃态稳定性。这表明镍氧化物中的磁性与超导性在很大程度上是退耦的，二者仅通过多轨道框架中的间接相互作用关联。；创新点：首次系统性地对无限层镍氧化物从母体到过掺杂的完整掺杂系列进行μSR研究，揭示了局域磁矩玻璃态冻结温度几乎不随掺杂变化，并定量刻画了玻璃态随空穴掺杂的轻微失稳，为理解磁性与超导穹顶的关系提供了直接的实验约束。（摘要未突出说明更具体的创新细节）
papers.method_zh: 零场/弱场μSR（muon spin rotation/relaxation）技术，用于探测磁基态以及随温度变化的静态与动态磁行为；样品为（La,Sr）NiO₂系列单晶或薄膜（摘要未明确样品形态）。

papers.title: Polaron Self-Trapping Rates from First Principles
papers.abstract: Polaron formation, also known as self-trapping, is a process akin to nonradiative carrier capture at point defects or impurities. In this work, we develop the formalism to determine how long it takes to form a small hole or electron polaron from first principles. We employ an accurate, fully first-principles approach based on a Koopmans compliant hybrid functional. The self-trapping rate is the product of two components: the nonradiative capture coefficient, which we evaluate using a one-dimensional approximation, and the maximum density of polaron sites, whose physics we elucidate based on finite-size interactions present in supercells. We apply our methodology to several technologically relevant materials known to host hole polarons, Ga$_2$O$_3$, Al$_2$O$_3$, BeO, KBr, MgO, NaCl, SiO$_2$, SnO$_2$, TiO$_2$, and ZnO, and to an electron polaron in rutile TiO$_2$. We also study an emerging semiconductor, rutile GeO$_2$, where we find that polaron formation could hamper $p$-type conductivity. The calculated self-trapping lifetimes span 7 orders of magnitude, from $10^{-1}$ to $10^6$~ps, in agreement with experiments where available, and providing detailed insight into the dynamics of carrier localization and relaxation in solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop the formalism”“fully first-principles approach”“evaluate using a one-dimensional approximation”，属于第一性原理计算与理论建模研究。；研究对象：多种材料中的极化子（小极化子）自陷（self-trapping）动力学过程，具体包括空穴极化子材料：Ga₂O₃、Al₂O₃、BeO、KBr、MgO、NaCl、SiO₂、SnO₂、TiO₂、ZnO，以及金红石TiO₂中的电子极化子；还研究了新兴半导体金红石GeO₂中的极化子形成对p型导电性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了从第一性原理计算极化子自陷速率（寿命）的完整形式体系，发现不同材料中自陷寿命跨越7个数量级（10⁻¹至10⁶ ps），与实验（如有）吻合；并预测金红石GeO₂中极化子形成可能阻碍其p型导电。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了从第一性原理计算极化子自陷速率（寿命）的完整形式体系，发现不同材料中自陷寿命跨越7个数量级（10⁻¹至10⁶ ps），与实验（如有）吻合；并预测金红石GeO₂中极化子形成可能阻碍其p型导电。；创新点：首次从第一性原理系统计算极化子自陷的时间尺度（速率），而非仅判断其热力学稳定性；将自陷速率分解为俘获系数与位点密度两个物理清晰的分量，并阐明超胞有限尺寸效应对位点密度的作用。摘要未突出说明与以往极化子理论（如小极化子跃迁速率或形变势理论）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于Koopmans兼容杂化泛函的精确第一性原理方法；自陷速率分解为两部分：非辐射俘获系数（采用一维近似计算）与极化子位点最大密度（基于超胞中有限尺寸相互作用理解其物理）。

papers.title: Grain boundary evolution in nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Grain boundary evolution is a key dynamical process that enables structural rearrangements in nanoparticles and drives them towards low energy configurations. Grain boundaries can also enhance catalytic properties, making it important to understand the elementary processes underlying their evolution for grain boundary engineering in nanoparticles. Compared with bulk materials, nanoparticles have additional rotational and translational degrees of freedom, can accommodate structural changes through shape relaxation, and grain boundaries terminate at free surfaces. However, the atomic-scale mechanisms of GB evolution under these less constrained conditions remain comparatively less understood than in bulk materials. Here, using atomistic simulations, we focus on low energy $\Sigma3$ (coherent twin boundary) and $\Sigma11$ grain boundaries, which are among the persistent compact GB structures that emerge during nanoparticle structural evolution. We identify two fundamental atomic displacements, column shift (C) and screw shift (S), that recur during the evolution of these grain boundaries and their junctions. These displacements occur through different atomic pathways and combine in different ways to generate grain boundary migration, structural transformations, and junction evolution. In particular, the same initial and final grain boundary configurations can be connected through different atomic pathways, and a column shift can occur either as a full shift or through disconnection kinks. C and S remain identifiable even when the grain boundary character changes, for example during a $\Sigma11$ to $\Sigma3$ transformation. An understanding of these elementary GB processes can help identify strategies to control grain boundary evolution and thereby engineer GB structures in nanoparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using atomistic simulations”（原子级模拟）。；研究对象：纳米颗粒中的晶界演化，具体聚焦于低能Σ3（共格孪晶界）和Σ11晶界及其交汇结构，以及它们在纳米颗粒受限/自由表面条件下的原子尺度运动机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出两种反复出现的基本原子位移模式——柱位移（C）和螺旋位移（S），它们通过不同原子路径组合，驱动晶界迁移、结构转变及晶界交汇演化；同一初末晶界构型可通过不同原子路径连接，且C和S在晶界类型改变（如Σ11→Σ3转变）时仍保持可辨识性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出两种反复出现的基本原子位移模式——柱位移（C）和螺旋位移（S），它们通过不同原子路径组合，驱动晶界迁移、结构转变及晶界交汇演化；同一初末晶界构型可通过不同原子路径连接，且C和S在晶界类型改变（如Σ11→Σ3转变）时仍保持可辨识性。；创新点：相较于块体材料，揭示了纳米颗粒在具有额外旋转/平移自由度、形状弛豫及晶界终止于自由表面的“弱约束”条件下，晶界演化的基本原子机制（C和S位移及其组合方式），为纳米颗粒晶界工程提供原子尺度控制策略。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或理论框架的对比创新。
papers.method_zh: 原子级模拟（atomistic simulations），具体方法类型（如分子动力学、蒙特卡洛或静力学计算）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Symmetry-breaking line defects embedded to a 3D $O(N)$ critical bulk
papers.abstract: While spontaneous breaking of a discrete symmetry in one-dimensional classical systems with short-range interactions is absent, it is expected that a line defect embedded in a bulk criticality exhibits a stable discrete symmetry spontaneous breaking. Here, we investigate the behavior of a pinning-field line defect immersed in a 3D bulk that remains tuned to the $O(N)$ Wilson-Fisher critical point. Employing the fuzzy sphere technique, we provide convincing evidence of the existence of stable defect conformal fixed points, and we demonstrate their renormalization group stability by showing no relevant operator and less effective degrees of freedom than that at bulk fixed point via $g$-function. Moreover, we investigate the defect domain wall operator for various $N$, and we identify that it becomes irrelevance for $N\gtrsim 3$ but it is relevant for $N<3$.These evidence indicate that a one-dimensional defect coupled to a critical bulk cannot support a stable symmetry spontaneously broken defect fixed point due to domain wall proliferation for $N<3$ Wilson-Fisher universality, while in the case of $N \gtrsim 3$ a symmetry broken defect is possible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“fuzzy sphere technique”（数值方法）、“renormalization group stability”（重整化群理论）、“conformal fixed points”（共形不动点）等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：嵌入三维 $O(N)$ Wilson-Fisher 临界体态中的一维线缺陷（pinning-field line defect），研究其对称性自发破缺行为及缺陷共形场论性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于 $N<3$ 的 Wilson-Fisher 普适类，一维缺陷因畴壁算符相关（relevant）而无法支持稳定的对称性自发破缺缺陷不动点；而对于 $N\gtrsim 3$，畴壁算符变为无关（irrelevant），对称性破缺的缺陷态可以稳定存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于 $N<3$ 的 Wilson-Fisher 普适类，一维缺陷因畴壁算符相关（relevant）而无法支持稳定的对称性自发破缺缺陷不动点；而对于 $N\gtrsim 3$，畴壁算符变为无关（irrelevant），对称性破缺的缺陷态可以稳定存在。；创新点：首次在三维 $O(N)$ 临界体态中系统证明线缺陷存在稳定的共形不动点，并揭示了缺陷畴壁算符的相关性随 $N$ 的临界转变（$N=3$ 附近），从而厘清了一维缺陷能否支持对称性自发破缺的普适条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用模糊球（fuzzy sphere）数值技术，模拟嵌入三维临界体态的线缺陷；通过计算 $g$-函数判断缺陷不动点的重整化群稳定性（是否存在相关算符、有效自由度是否少于体态不动点）；并分析不同 $N$ 值下缺陷畴壁算符的标度维度。

papers.title: Resolving the Magnetic Ground-State Controversy in RuO2 through A Flat Magnetic Energy Landscape
papers.abstract: Rutile RuO2 is a prominent candidate for altermagnetism, yet its magnetic ground state remains highly controversial, with experiments reporting either a nonmagnetic state or altermagnetic order. Here, we develop a generalized environment-dependent spin-lattice framework that unifies localized Heisenberg exchange, itinerant Stoner magnetism via Landau spin fluctuations, and spin-orbit-coupling-mediated spin-lattice interactions. Parameterized from a high-throughput first-principles database using machine-learning and solved by large-scale Monte Carlo simulations, the framework reveals an exceptionally flat magnetic energy landscape in RuO2, where the nonmagnetic state lies nearly degenerate with multiple altermagnetic configurations. We find that material perturbations, exemplified by intrinsic defects, select distinct magnetic ground states primarily by modifying the localized Heisenberg exchange, with perturbation-induced itinerant Stoner polarization provides an essential secondary contribution. Spin-orbit coupling controls the orientation and stability of the Néel vector, but does not determine the emergence of long-range magnetic order. These results provide a unified explanation for the conflicting experimental observations and establish a general microscopic framework for understanding how material perturbations select competing magnetic ground states in systems with nearly flat magnetic energy landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“develop a generalized framework”“machine-learning”“large-scale Monte Carlo simulations”“first-principles database”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算与理论建模研究。；研究对象：金红石结构RuO₂（rutile RuO₂）的磁性基态争议，具体涉及非磁态与交错磁（altermagnetic）序之间的竞争，以及缺陷、自旋-轨道耦合等扰动对磁性基态选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RuO₂具有异常平坦的磁性能量景观，非磁态与多种交错磁构型近乎简并；材料扰动（如本征缺陷）主要通过改变局域Heisenberg交换作用来选择不同的磁性基态，而自旋-轨道耦合仅控制Néel矢量的取向与稳定性，并不决定长程磁有序的出现。该结果统一解释了实验中相互矛盾的观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RuO₂具有异常平坦的磁性能量景观，非磁态与多种交错磁构型近乎简并；材料扰动（如本征缺陷）主要通过改变局域Heisenberg交换作用来选择不同的磁性基态，而自旋-轨道耦合仅控制Néel矢量的取向与稳定性，并不决定长程磁有序的出现。该结果统一解释了实验中相互矛盾的观测。；创新点：提出了一个统一的微观框架，能够解释在近乎平坦磁性能量景观体系中材料扰动如何选择竞争性磁性基态，从而解决了RuO₂磁性基态的实验争议。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 构建了广义环境依赖的自旋-晶格框架，统一描述局域Heisenberg交换、通过Landau自旋涨落描述的巡游Stoner磁性，以及自旋-轨道耦合介导的自旋-晶格相互作用；参数来源于高通量第一性原理数据库，采用机器学习拟合，并用大规模蒙特卡洛模拟求解。

papers.title: Moiré-induced altermagnetism from nonmagnetic constituents
papers.abstract: We propose a mechanism for nonmagnetic materials to develop altermagnetic order by moiré interference with nonmagnetic substrate, which is driven by structural relaxation and spontaneous twirls in moiré domain walls of lattice-mismatched moiré square lattices. When doped with one electron per moiré domain, a correlated insulating gap is opened by electron interaction. Depending on the location of the moiré potential minima, the moiré bands can show d-wave or g-wave altermagnetic splitting. The former can be enhanced by a finite twist angle; the latter is sensitive to strains that drive a transition to d-wave.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We propose a mechanism”“can show”“can be enhanced”等理论推导与预言性表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法。；研究对象：非磁性材料与晶格失配的非磁性衬底构成的莫尔超晶格体系，具体为莫尔方格（moiré square lattices）中的结构弛豫与畴壁自发扭转，以及由此产生的交错磁（altermagnetic）序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种仅由非磁性组分通过莫尔干涉产生交错磁序的机制：在每莫尔畴掺杂一个电子时，电子相互作用打开关联绝缘能隙，且根据莫尔势能最小值的位置，莫尔能带可呈现d波或g波交错磁劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种仅由非磁性组分通过莫尔干涉产生交错磁序的机制：在每莫尔畴掺杂一个电子时，电子相互作用打开关联绝缘能隙，且根据莫尔势能最小值的位置，莫尔能带可呈现d波或g波交错磁劈裂。；创新点：首次提出无需任何磁性元素或磁性衬底，仅依靠莫尔超晶格的结构弛豫与畴壁自发扭转即可在非磁性材料中诱导交错磁序；并预言了可调控的d波/g波交错磁劈裂及其对转角与应变的响应。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法（如模型哈密顿量、平均场、精确对角化等），仅提及“电子相互作用”“能带劈裂”等概念，具体手段摘要未说明。

papers.title: A Strategy Toward Room Temperature Topological Hall Effect via Local Moment Magnetism
papers.abstract: Topological spin textures in local moment systems hold great promise for technological applications due to their large magnetic moments, strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC), and high tunability. Finding new spin textures that are stable near room temperature is paramount to maximizing their potential for applications. Here, we provide a strategy for realizing topological spin textures at high temperatures by identifying rare earth ($R$) magnets ordering at or near room temperature. We demonstrate the feasibility of this strategy in one of these magnets, hexagonal Gd$_5$Pb$_3$, which orders at $T_C$ = 285 K. The indication for topological spin textures comes from topological Hall effect (THE), which, in Gd$_5$Pb$_3$, occurs between $T$ = 100 - 200 K, an order of magnitude higher temperature than in other reported $R$-based systems. Our results present an opportunity to explore the role of SOC, anisotropic exchange, geometric frustration, and magnetic interactions in stabilizing topological spin textures, and provide a pathway toward realizing them near room temperature in $R$-based magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了在具体材料中观测到拓扑霍尔效应（THE），并给出了温度区间等实验现象。；研究对象：稀土（R）基磁性材料，具体为六方结构的 Gd₅Pb₃ 化合物，其磁有序温度 T_C = 285 K。研究聚焦于该体系中高温稳定的拓扑自旋织构及其输运表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种在稀土基磁体中实现近室温拓扑自旋织构的策略，并在 Gd₅Pb₃ 中观测到拓扑霍尔效应，其出现温度区间（100–200 K）比其他已报道的稀土基体系高出一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种在稀土基磁体中实现近室温拓扑自旋织构的策略，并在 Gd₅Pb₃ 中观测到拓扑霍尔效应，其出现温度区间（100–200 K）比其他已报道的稀土基体系高出一个数量级。；创新点：首次在稀土基体系中实现远高于以往报道温度的拓扑霍尔效应（100–200 K），并提出通过选择近室温磁有序的稀土磁体来寻找高温拓扑自旋织构的通用策略，为探索 SOC、各向异性交换、几何阻挫等机制在稳定拓扑自旋织构中的作用提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如输运测量、中子散射、磁化测量等），仅明确提及通过拓扑霍尔效应（THE）作为拓扑自旋织构的判据。具体测量技术细节摘要未给出。

papers.title: Optimal Control of Periodic Nonequilibrium Mechanochemical Systems via Automatic Differentiation
papers.abstract: Biological molecular machines are mesoscopic systems that act repeatedly and periodically to perform important cellular tasks while contending with strong fluctuations and operating in an overdamped regime. Optimal control theory is a tool that can be used to understand the design principles behind efficient operation of these machines; however, most studies on optimal control of classical mesoscopic systems have focused on control problems that do not repeat periodically. Here, we automatically differentiate Fokker-Planck simulations to design efficient nonequilibrium control strategies for simple models of periodic molecular machines with and without explicit changes in the machine's chemical state. The designed protocols and theoretical analysis provide insight into the design principles governing efficient driving in these nonequilibrium systems. Designed control protocols should seek to reduce mechanical heat by rotating the entire angular probability distribution at a constant speed without changing its shape, and should reduce chemical heat by reducing the proportion of chemical transitions with large heat.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“自动微分Fokker-Planck模拟”“设计控制策略”“理论分析”。；研究对象：周期性非平衡机械化学系统，具体为生物分子机器的简化模型（含或不含化学态显式变化），工作在过阻尼、强涨落环境下的介观尺度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高效驱动周期性分子机器的设计原则：应通过整体旋转角概率分布（保持形状不变、匀速转动）来减少机械热；应通过降低具有大热的化学跃迁比例来减少化学热。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高效驱动周期性分子机器的设计原则：应通过整体旋转角概率分布（保持形状不变、匀速转动）来减少机械热；应通过降低具有大热的化学跃迁比例来减少化学热。；创新点：将最优控制研究从非周期性经典介观系统拓展到周期性重复工作的分子机器，并同时考虑机械与化学自由度（含化学态变化的模型）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用自动微分技术对Fokker-Planck方程的数值模拟进行梯度计算，从而优化非平衡控制协议（最优控制方法）。

papers.title: Thermal history controls the optoelectronic response of lead halide perovskites through structure and dynamics
papers.abstract: Lead halide perovskites are promising optoelectronic materials for photovoltaics, light emission and detection. Their efficiencies in PV now approach the detailed-balance limit, leaving stability as the principal barrier. The intrinsic instabilities studied to date centre on ionic motion within a fixed, homogeneous lattice. Here we identify a further source of intrinsic structural instability, hidden in the lattice dynamics. Mapping caesium, methylammonium and formamidinium-based compositions with Cl, Br, I and mixed X-sites through all accessible phases, using single crystal X-ray and neutron diffuse scattering, machine-learning-assisted molecular dynamics, a phenomenological octahedral tilt model and hyperspectral photoluminescence, we find that nearly every composition hosts equilibrium local structural fluctuations: dynamic nanodomains of correlated octahedral tilts, a few nanometres in size, that locally break the crystallographic symmetry. Three complementary levers control them. The A-site cation sets their symmetry, shape and anisotropy, from sparse, isotropic and tetragonal in formamidinium-based compositions to dense, anisotropic and orthorhombic in nominally cubic caesium-based ones, the most locally disordered we studied. The halide controls the dynamic disorder and the phase-transition sequence. Thermal history is the third: different ramp rates drive nominally identical compositions into distinct crystallographic phases, each with its own hidden local order. In MAPbI3, the heating rate alone changes the photoluminescence quantum efficiency across the phase transition. Because these transitions lie within device operating ranges, from terrestrial thermal cycling to the extremes of space, thermal history may shape the local structure, and hence the optoelectronic response, throughout fabrication and operation, establishing it as a design variable alongside composition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“single crystal X-ray and neutron diffuse scattering”（实验）、“machine-learning-assisted molecular dynamics”（计算模拟）、“phenomenological octahedral tilt model”（理论建模）以及“hyperspectral photoluminescence”（实验）。；研究对象：铅卤钙钛矿（lead halide perovskites），涵盖Cs、MA、FA三种A位阳离子与Cl、Br、I及混合X位组合，研究其局域结构涨落（动态纳米畴的八面体倾斜）及其对光电响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 几乎所有铅卤钙钛矿组成中都存在平衡态局域结构涨落——尺寸为数纳米的动态八面体倾斜纳米畴，它们局域地破缺晶体学对称性；热历史（升温速率）可驱动名义上相同的组分进入不同晶相，从而改变其局域有序性和光电性质（如MAPbI₃的发光量子效率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：几乎所有铅卤钙钛矿组成中都存在平衡态局域结构涨落——尺寸为数纳米的动态八面体倾斜纳米畴，它们局域地破缺晶体学对称性；热历史（升温速率）可驱动名义上相同的组分进入不同晶相，从而改变其局域有序性和光电性质（如MAPbI₃的发光量子效率）。；创新点：首次揭示“热历史”作为独立于化学组分的第三调控杠杆，可通过控制隐藏的局域倾斜序来影响器件工作温度范围内的光电响应，将热历史确立为与组分并列的设计变量。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线与中子漫散射、机器学习辅助分子动力学（ML-MD）、唯象八面体倾斜模型、高光谱光致发光（hyperspectral PL）测量，并结合不同升温速率的温度循环实验。

papers.title: Generative Nested Sampling of Atomistic Thermodynamic Landscapes
papers.abstract: Nested sampling (NS) resolves the thermodynamics of an atomistic system from a single simulation, but its practical reach is limited by the Markov-chain updates needed to decorrelate walkers within each likelihood-constrained ensemble. Flow-based NS has removed this bottleneck for gravitational-wave (GW) inference, yet its transfer to atomistic systems is not merely a change of application. Comparing a GW150914-like binary-black-hole likelihood with an eight-particle two-dimensional Lennard-Jones (LJ) system of comparable dimensionality, we show that the two landscapes differ fundamentally: atomistic multimodality is discrete and combinatorial, generated by particle permutations separated by hard collision walls, and its coordinate coupling is dense and collective, whereas the GW posterior exhibits smooth degeneracies and localized parameter coupling. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce NS-Flows: a single conditional normalizing flow, conditioned on the NS energy bound and trained on a sliding window of recent live sets, that replaces MCMC by direct parallel draws corrected by importance-weighted rejection resampling. Live sets supply data self-consistently, allowing flow training without structured priors or a pre-existing dataset. For LJ disks in PBC, the algorithm reduces energy evaluations by over two orders of magnitude and wall-clock time by roughly one third, an advantage that becomes increasingly favorable as the cost of the potential grows. The flow's generation efficiency further acts as a physical diagnostic: it varies non-monotonically along the annealing trajectory, is lowest in the dense disordered regime, and is quantitatively captured by the constrained ensemble's internal mode complexity together with target drift across the training window, identifying liquid-like ensembles, rather than prior-target separation, as the hard case for current flow architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：nested sampling、normalizing flow、算法、模拟。；研究对象：原子系统的热力学景观，具体以二维Lennard-Jones（LJ）粒子体系（八粒子、周期性边界条件）为测试对象，并与引力波（GW）推断（GW150914-like双黑洞）进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原子系统的多模态性源于粒子置换导致的离散组合结构，且坐标耦合密集而集体，与引力波后验的平滑简并和局域耦合本质不同；提出的NS-Flows算法（条件归一化流替代MCMC）可将LJ体系的能量评估次数降低两个数量级以上，墙钟时间缩短约三分之一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原子系统的多模态性源于粒子置换导致的离散组合结构，且坐标耦合密集而集体，与引力波后验的平滑简并和局域耦合本质不同；提出的NS-Flows算法（条件归一化流替代MCMC）可将LJ体系的能量评估次数降低两个数量级以上，墙钟时间缩短约三分之一。；创新点：将流式嵌套抽样从引力波推断推广到原子体系，并指出这不是简单应用迁移——通过景观诊断揭示原子体系与GW后验的差异；引入自洽的流训练方案（无需结构化先验或预存数据集），并将流的生成效率作为物理诊断工具，识别出致密无序液态系综是当前流架构的难点。
papers.method_zh: 嵌套抽样（Nested Sampling, NS）结合条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flow），流模型以NS能量界为条件，在滑动窗口的近期live sets上训练，并用重要性加权拒绝重采样进行直接并行采样；对比了LJ体系与引力波似然景观的维度与结构。

papers.title: Accelerating stochastic processes through nonequilibrium driving: Thermodynamic constraints on the maximum speed-up
papers.abstract: We derive a new set of bounds controlling the speed-up of the survival rate of trajectory-dependent observables induced by the application of a perturbation. Via the study of survival probabilities in two different contexts, continuous-time Markov jump processes and overdamped diffusions, we obtain different fashions of the bound on the achievable boost. These bounds, obtained by a nonlinear response theory of constrained path probabilities, are explicitly linked to thermodynamics. For arbitrary time-dependent survival rates, we find a linear bound that depends on both the perturbation strength and the entropy production rate prior to the perturbation. For rare processes characterized by a constant survival rate, the bound is exponential and is determined by the excess heat generated by the perturbation. We exemplify the inequalities on two prototypical model systems, namely, a unicyclic network and forced diffusion in a bistable potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive bounds、nonlinear response theory、thermodynamic constraints。；研究对象：非平衡驱动对随机过程（连续时间马尔可夫跳跃过程与过阻尼扩散）中轨迹依赖可观测量存活率加速的物理限制，属于随机热力学/非平衡统计物理范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一组新的不等式，约束了外加微扰对轨迹依赖可观测量存活率的加速上限：对任意时变存活率，加速存在线性上界，取决于微扰强度与微扰前的熵产生率；对恒定存活率的稀有过程，上界为指数形式，由微扰产生的过量热决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一组新的不等式，约束了外加微扰对轨迹依赖可观测量存活率的加速上限：对任意时变存活率，加速存在线性上界，取决于微扰强度与微扰前的熵产生率；对恒定存活率的稀有过程，上界为指数形式，由微扰产生的过量热决定。；创新点：首次将轨迹依赖可观测量存活率的加速上限与热力学量（熵产生率、过量热）显式关联，并区分了线性与指数两种不同形式的界限。摘要未突出说明与既有加速界限（如热力学不确定性关系类结果）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用约束路径概率的非线性响应理论，分别针对连续时间马尔可夫跳跃过程和过阻尼扩散两种随机动力学框架推导加速界限，并在单环网络和双稳态势阱中的受迫扩散两个原型模型上验证不等式。

papers.title: An Ultrathin Laterally Conductive Mesh Interphase Enables Spatially Extended Zinc Deposition for Aqueous Zinc Batteries
papers.abstract: Zn metal anodes often suffer from nonuniform interfacial reactions during cycling, resulting in uneven deposition and dendrite growth. Existing artificial interphases can mitigate side reactions or regulate nucleation, but rarely achieve regulation of the interfacial electron/field distribution to sustain uniform deposition at the evolving Zn/electrolyte interface. Here, we develop an Au mesh interphase (AuMI), an ultrathin two-dimensional Au aerogel network that couples lateral electron redistribution with open pathways for ions. During Zn plating/stripping, the conductive AuMI distributes electron transport across the Zn surface, while its porous mesh preserves Zn$^{2+}$ access, enabling more uniform interfacial reactions. Experiments and simulations show that AuMI homogenizes the interfacial electric field and current distribution, promotes more uniform Zn plating/stripping, and limits dendrite growth. As a result, this regulated interfacial reaction mode enables AuMI Zn symmetric cells to operate stably for 3000 h at 1 mA cm$^{-2}$/1 mAh cm$^{-2}$ and for 1100 h at 10 mA cm$^{-2}$/10 mAh cm$^{-2}$, while AuMI Zn||NVO (NaV$_3$O$_8$\cdot$1.5H$_2$O) full cells retain 80.8 % capacity after over 5000 cycles at 1 A g$^{-1}$. These findings highlight the importance of combining ultrathin architecture, lateral electron transport, and open Zn2+ access in artificial interphases for stable aqueous Zn metal anodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含模拟辅助）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Experiments and simulations show...”，属于实验与模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：水系锌离子电池中的锌金属负极，具体为一种超薄二维金气凝胶网络（Au mesh interphase, AuMI）人工界面层，以及其调控的Zn/电解质界面沉积行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AuMI通过横向电子再分布与开放离子通道的耦合，均匀化了界面电场和电流分布，从而实现了更均匀的锌沉积/剥离并抑制枝晶生长，显著提升了锌对称电池和全电池的循环稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AuMI通过横向电子再分布与开放离子通道的耦合，均匀化了界面电场和电流分布，从而实现了更均匀的锌沉积/剥离并抑制枝晶生长，显著提升了锌对称电池和全电池的循环稳定性。；创新点：不同于以往人工界面层仅抑制副反应或调控成核，AuMI首次实现了对界面电子/电场分布的主动调控，且其超薄多孔结构同时保证了横向电子传输和Zn²⁺的开放通道，从而在动态演化的Zn/电解质界面上维持均匀沉积。摘要未突出说明与传统界面层在厚度或制备工艺上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了超薄二维Au气凝胶网络（AuMI）作为人工界面层；表征手段包括电化学测试（对称电池循环、全电池测试）以及模拟（界面电场和电流分布模拟）。摘要未明确说明具体模拟方法（如有限元等）或详细表征技术（如SEM、XRD等）。

papers.title: Topological Boundary States and the Edge Chain in Semi-Infinite Two-Dimensional Insulators
papers.abstract: We show that it is possible to compute the adiabatically protected edge and corner states of semi-infinite, two-dimensional, topological insulators by considering the first layer of lattice sites, what we call the "edge chain," independently from the bulk. We start by accepting this claim as an ansatz, then, using the Shemesh theorem, we show that the edge states one finds using our procedure are adiabatically protected, provided we restrict ourselves to adiabatic evolutions that do not break chiral symmetry. We show explicit examples of our method in a 2D extension of the SSH model, the SSH3 model, the Haldane model and the Breathing Kagome Lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We show that it is possible to compute”“using the Shemesh theorem”“adiabatically protected”等理论推导与证明性表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：半无限二维拓扑绝缘体中的拓扑边界态（边缘态与角态），具体体系包括二维SSH模型的扩展、SSH3模型、Haldane模型以及呼吸Kagome晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过仅考虑第一层晶格位点（即“边缘链”）并独立于体态进行处理，可以计算出半无限二维拓扑绝缘体中受绝热保护的边缘态和角态；在保持手征对称性的绝热演化下，该方法得到的边缘态是绝热受保护的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过仅考虑第一层晶格位点（即“边缘链”）并独立于体态进行处理，可以计算出半无限二维拓扑绝缘体中受绝热保护的边缘态和角态；在保持手征对称性的绝热演化下，该方法得到的边缘态是绝热受保护的。；创新点：提出了一种将半无限二维拓扑绝缘体的边界态计算简化为仅处理第一层晶格（边缘链）的新方法，并利用Shemesh定理给出了绝热保护性的严格论证，而非依赖传统的体-边对应或数值对角化全体系。摘要未突出说明与已有边界态计算方法（如缠绕数、边界格林函数等）的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：以“边缘链独立于体态”为ansatz（假设），利用Shemesh定理证明所得边缘态的绝热保护性，并限制在手征对称性不被破坏的绝热演化条件下。通过多个具体模型（SSH3、Haldane、呼吸Kagome等）给出显式示例验证。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetism-altered plasmon dynamics
papers.abstract: The interaction between plasmons and magnons is a long-sought phenomenon with implications for fundamental physics and spintronics applications. In three-dimensional systems, this coupling is suppressed by the large mismatch in energy scales, but two-dimensional (2D) plasmons with gapless dispersion can overlap with magnons over a broad spectral range. Despite numerous theoretical predictions, experimental observation of magnon-plasmon interaction has remained elusive. In this work, we study a first-of-its-kind hybrid plasmon-magnon platform based on 2D materials. By deploying scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) with terahertz radiation, we image propagating plasmon wavepackets at a graphene/NiPS$_3$ interface and track their dynamics across the antiferromagnetic transition of NiPS$_3$. We observe a clear renormalization of the plasmon-polariton dispersion concurrent with the onset of antiferromagnetic order. With complementary Raman scattering and nano-terahertz spectroscopy, we unveil spectral weight redistribution and dielectric screening changes, potentially associated with the multi-magnon continuum, as the underlying mechanism. These results provide solid evidence of coupling between plasmon and antiferromagnetic order, marking a cornerstone for a potential platform for hybrid magnon-plasmon interactions in 2D materials, opening avenues for coherent spin-plasmon devices and tunable terahertz spintronic components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要明确提到使用散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）、拉曼散射和纳米太赫兹光谱等实验手段进行测量与成像。；研究对象：石墨烯/NiPS₃异质界面上的二维等离激元（plasmon）与NiPS₃反铁磁序之间的耦合现象，具体关注等离激元波包在反铁磁相变前后的动力学变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NiPS₃进入反铁磁有序态的同时，石墨烯/NiPS₃界面上的等离激元-极化激元色散发生明显重整化，表明等离激元与反铁磁序之间存在耦合，为二维材料中混合磁振子-等离激元相互作用提供了实验证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NiPS₃进入反铁磁有序态的同时，石墨烯/NiPS₃界面上的等离激元-极化激元色散发生明显重整化，表明等离激元与反铁磁序之间存在耦合，为二维材料中混合磁振子-等离激元相互作用提供了实验证据。；创新点：首次在基于二维材料的混合等离激元-磁振子平台上实验观测到等离激元与反铁磁序的耦合效应，突破了此前三维体系中因能量尺度失配而难以实现耦合的限制，为相干自旋-等离激元器件和可调太赫兹自旋电子学元件提供了潜在平台。
papers.method_zh: 散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）结合太赫兹辐射成像传播中的等离激元波包；辅以互补的拉曼散射和纳米太赫兹光谱，用于揭示光谱权重转移和介电屏蔽变化。

papers.title: Death by mutants: unusual multicritical dynamics in a two-species model for absorbing state transitions
papers.abstract: We explore the phases and active-to-absorbing state phase transitions (AAPT) in a two-species model, where the species A and its mutant B are {\em asymmetrically} or {\em nonreciprocally} coupled. We identify a multicritical point that connects the global absorbing state of both the species and its mutant, with a uniform active state. The critical dynamics at this multicritical point is studied within the lowest order perturbation theory. This asymmetric coupling between species A and mutant B leads to unequal and distinct upper critical dimensions $d_c^A$ and $d_c^B$ respectively for A and B dynamics. We show that the multicritical point in this model is characterised by an unusual breakdown of scale-invariance by fluctuation-induced logarithmic modulations with power law behaviour of the order parameter and correlation lengths of the species A at all dimensions $d<d_c^A$. Above $d_c^A$, conventional scale-invariance is restored. The dynamics of the mutant species B belongs to the DP universality class with an upper critical dimension of $d_c^B=4$
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“最低阶微扰理论”“上临界维度”等理论物理术语，且未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：两物种（物种A及其突变体B）非互易/不对称耦合的活性-吸收态相变（AAPT）模型，重点研究多临界点处的临界动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型的多临界点处出现反常的标度不变性破缺：在维度d < d_c^A时，物种A的序参量和关联长度呈现由涨落诱导的对数调制乘幂律行为；仅在d > d_c^A时恢复常规标度不变性。突变体B的动力学属于DP普适类，其上临界维度为d_c^B = 4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型的多临界点处出现反常的标度不变性破缺：在维度d < d_c^A时，物种A的序参量和关联长度呈现由涨落诱导的对数调制乘幂律行为；仅在d > d_c^A时恢复常规标度不变性。突变体B的动力学属于DP普适类，其上临界维度为d_c^B = 4。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：不对称耦合导致A和B具有不同且不相等的上临界维度，从而在多临界点产生维度依赖的标度破缺行为——这在标准DP类相变中是不出现的。
papers.method_zh: 最低阶微扰理论（lowest order perturbation theory），结合对两物种各自上临界维度（d_c^A与d_c^B）的解析分析。

papers.title: Large deviations for linear regressions
papers.abstract: Linear regression is one of the simplest and most widely used tools to learn patterns from data: it fits a set of coefficients so that a linear combination of predictors best matches observed responses. The quality of the fit is measured by the residual sum of squares, the total squared mismatch between predictions and data, whose minimum defines the training loss. We consider Gaussian design and noise, with teacher coefficients independently drawn from a general distribution $p(β)$, and a general class of separable regularizers, including Ridge and Lasso. Using the zero-temperature replica method, we compute analytically the large-deviation statistics of the minimum training loss for large numbers $P$ of predictors and $N$ of observations, with $r=P/N$ fixed. The rate function we compute governs rare sample-to-sample fluctuations of the optimal loss. Extensive numerical simulations are in excellent agreement with our theory and clearly show a pronounced deviation from the Gaussian regime of typical fluctuations in the tails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟验证）。判断依据：关键词“zero-temperature replica method”“compute analytically”“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：线性回归模型中的训练损失（最小残差平方和）的统计性质，具体为在高斯设计矩阵与高斯噪声下、教师系数服从一般分布、正则化项为可分形式（含Ridge与Lasso）的回归问题。属于统计学习理论/随机矩阵理论交叉领域，非特定凝聚态材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在预测变量数P与观测数N同阶（r=P/N固定）的大规模极限下，最小训练损失的稀有涨落（大偏差）由非高斯速率函数控制，其尾部行为显著偏离典型涨落的高斯统计。理论速率函数与数值模拟高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在预测变量数P与观测数N同阶（r=P/N固定）的大规模极限下，最小训练损失的稀有涨落（大偏差）由非高斯速率函数控制，其尾部行为显著偏离典型涨落的高斯统计。理论速率函数与数值模拟高度一致。；创新点：将大偏差理论（而非仅典型涨落）引入线性回归训练损失的有限样本统计，并处理了一般教师分布与一般可分正则化（统一涵盖Ridge与Lasso）的框架。
papers.method_zh: 零温复制方法（zero-temperature replica method）解析计算大偏差速率函数；辅以大规模数值模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: Critical scaling and soft granular rheology of frictionless non-Brownian suspensions across jamming
papers.abstract: We carry out 3D computer simulations to study suspension rheology across the jamming transition for deformable non-Brownian frictionless particles. The simulations are carried out at constant shear rates and suspension densities ($\dotγ , φ$), for polydisperse spherical particles. The suspension is probed at densities in the neighbourhood of the jamming point $φ_c$ , as well as across much wider density ranges. We carry out critical scaling analysis of our close-to-jamming data and confirm that shear-driven jamming is a second-order critical phenomenon requiring strong corrections on shear. We build maps of the local strain rate exponent to classify flow regimes and examine the effect of the corrections on the suspension rheology. Further, using the critical scaling jamming density, we carry out soft granular rheological scaling over the wider density range, demonstrating an excellent data collapse. The soft granular rheology relations are able to predict our data over almost the entire dynamical and density range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“3D computer simulations”（三维计算机模拟）。；研究对象：无摩擦非布朗可变形球形颗粒悬浮液，重点研究其在堵塞转变（jamming transition）附近的流变学行为，属于软物质/颗粒物理中的堵塞相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 剪切驱动的堵塞是一个需要强剪切修正的二阶临界现象；利用临界标度得到的堵塞密度，软颗粒流变学标度关系能在几乎整个动力学和密度范围内实现优异的数据塌缩，从而预测悬浮液流变行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：剪切驱动的堵塞是一个需要强剪切修正的二阶临界现象；利用临界标度得到的堵塞密度，软颗粒流变学标度关系能在几乎整个动力学和密度范围内实现优异的数据塌缩，从而预测悬浮液流变行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 三维计算机模拟，采用恒定剪切速率（γ̇）和恒定悬浮液密度（φ）条件，对多分散球形颗粒进行模拟；在堵塞点φ_c附近及更宽密度范围内进行探测，并实施临界标度分析（critical scaling analysis）以及软颗粒流变学标度（soft granular rheological scaling）。

papers.title: Deterministic nanofabrication for engineering nanowire quantum dot devices
papers.abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are a leading platform for realising bright, wavelength-tunable sources of single and entangled photon pairs for photonic quantum technologies. Site-selected nanowire quantum dots (NWQDs) are a promising platform for fabricating such photonic devices in a scalable manner. However, implementing additional structures around the photonic nanowire while maintaining its vertical growth geometry has remained a challenge. In this work, we develop a deterministic pick-and-place technique to conduct a vertical-to-vertical transfer of NWQDs from the growth substrate to arbitrary templates. Using this transfer technique, we enhance the photon extraction efficiency to 75% by implementing a bottom gold mirror and tune the emission wavelength by 3.6 GHz via implementing electrostatic gates around the QD. Importantly, we measure low-multiphoton probability (g^(2)(0) = 0.002) and high indistinguishability (>80% for +/-100 ps) of the QD emission after the transfer process, yielding high-quality devices. These results demonstrate the repeatability and versatility of the developed transfer technique, which is an enabling step towards scalable single and entangled photon sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验流程（pick-and-place转移技术）、器件制备（金镜、静电门）及光学测量（g^(2)(0)、不可分辨度）。；研究对象：半导体纳米线量子点（NWQDs），具体为从生长衬底转移至任意模板的垂直结构量子点光子器件，用于单光子与纠缠光子对发射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种确定性拾取-放置转移技术，实现纳米线量子点的垂直-垂直转移，并在此基础上集成底部金镜与静电门，使光子提取效率达75%、发射波长可调3.6 GHz，同时保持高质量单光子发射（g^(2)(0)=0.002，不可分辨度>80%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种确定性拾取-放置转移技术，实现纳米线量子点的垂直-垂直转移，并在此基础上集成底部金镜与静电门，使光子提取效率达75%、发射波长可调3.6 GHz，同时保持高质量单光子发射（g^(2)(0)=0.002，不可分辨度>80%）。；创新点：首次在保持纳米线垂直生长几何的前提下，通过转移技术在其周围集成额外结构（金镜与静电门），克服了传统原位加工难以在垂直纳米线周围添加结构的挑战，且转移后器件性能保持高质量，展示了可扩展单光子源制备的重复性与通用性。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：确定性pick-and-place纳米转移技术（垂直-垂直转移）、底部金镜集成、静电门调控、光子提取效率测量、二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)测量及Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉（用于不可分辨度测量）。

papers.title: Orbital current rectifier and linear magnon Edelstein effect in $p$-wave antialtermagnets
papers.abstract: We show that $p$-wave magnets efficiently generate magnetization via a linear thermal Edelstein effect arising from the orbital magnetic moments of their magnons. Furthermore, they can generate perfectly nonreciprocal orbital currents through a purely even-order nonlinear response. This makes them promising candidates for orbital-current rectification. Because these transport phenomena originate from the orbital magnetic moment of magnons, they connect magnonics and orbitronics. More generally, we find that odd-parity-wave magnets with coplanar ground states host magnons with zero spin magnetic moment. Instead the magnons carry a collinear, out-of-plane orbital magnetic moment, realizing an orbital version of antialtermagnetism. We establish these general results using symmetry arguments and demonstrate them explicitly for a coplanar ground state with the minimal number of sublattices, inspired by the ground state of CeNiAsO. Our conclusions hold both in absence and presence of spin-orbit coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We show、symmetry arguments、demonstrate explicitly（理论推导与对称性分析）。；研究对象：p波反交变磁体（p-wave antialtermagnets）中的磁振子（magnon）及其轨道磁矩，具体以具有最小子格数的共面基态体系（受CeNiAsO基态启发）为例，涉及磁振子学（magnonics）与轨道电子学（orbitronics）交叉的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: p波磁体可通过磁振子的轨道磁矩产生线性的热Edelstein效应（线性磁振子Edelstein效应）实现高效磁化；同时可通过纯偶数阶非线性响应产生完全非互易的轨道电流，从而实现轨道电流整流。此外，具有共面基态的奇宇称波磁体中的磁振子携带零自旋磁矩，但携带共线面外轨道磁矩，构成轨道版的反交变磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：p波磁体可通过磁振子的轨道磁矩产生线性的热Edelstein效应（线性磁振子Edelstein效应）实现高效磁化；同时可通过纯偶数阶非线性响应产生完全非互易的轨道电流，从而实现轨道电流整流。此外，具有共面基态的奇宇称波磁体中的磁振子携带零自旋磁矩，但携带共线面外轨道磁矩，构成轨道版的反交变磁性。；创新点：首次将磁振子的轨道磁矩与反交变磁性（antialtermagnetism）联系起来，提出“轨道反交变磁性”概念，并揭示p波磁体可作为轨道电流整流器的候选材料，从而在磁振子学与轨道电子学之间建立桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 对称性论证（symmetry arguments）结合显式模型演示——针对具有最小子格数的共面基态（受CeNiAsO基态启发）进行具体计算；结论在有无自旋-轨道耦合两种情况下均成立。

papers.title: Flux noise without flux tunability in superconducting qubits
papers.abstract: Flux noise is unanimously recognised as a leading dephasing mechanism for flux-tunable superconducting qubits. However, our microscopic understanding remains incomplete, and basic effects like Faraday's law of induction have only very recently come into focus. Based on a quantum geometric description of the Faraday effect, we provide an in-depth derivation of the coupling of generic magnetic sources to thin film superconducting structures, under appropriate consideration of the device geometry. We apply the resulting framework to time-varying magnetic dipoles, describing surface or substrate spins, as well as current-carrying flux lines. We show that flux noise not only affects dephasing, but also provides a fundamental limit for the qubit quality factor - notably, even when the qubit contains no loops and is thus nominally not flux-tunable. Assuming surface spins as the origin for universal flux noise, we expect that this quality factor limit might be reached in the near term. For flux lines, we formulate a minimal safety distance to conserve the qubit performance, potentially constraining the scale-up of quantum hardware. This distance is boosted in the presence of large capacitor wings typical for transmons, due to a lensing of the electromotive field which is largely independent of Meissner screening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum geometric description、in-depth derivation、framework。；研究对象：超导量子比特中的磁通噪声（flux noise），特别是薄膜超导结构（如transmon）与磁性源（表面/衬底自旋、载流磁通线）的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁通噪声不仅导致退相干，还会对量子比特的品质因子（quality factor）构成根本性限制——即使量子比特不含环路、名义上不可磁通调谐（non-flux-tunable）也是如此。若表面自旋是普适磁通噪声的来源，该品质因子极限可能在近期被达到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁通噪声不仅导致退相干，还会对量子比特的品质因子（quality factor）构成根本性限制——即使量子比特不含环路、名义上不可磁通调谐（non-flux-tunable）也是如此。若表面自旋是普适磁通噪声的来源，该品质因子极限可能在近期被达到。；创新点：首次系统论证了磁通噪声对不可磁通调谐超导量子比特品质因子的根本限制；发现transmon的大电容翼板会对电动势场产生“透镜”效应（lensing），从而增大磁通线的安全距离要求，该效应基本独立于迈斯纳屏蔽。摘要未突出说明与以往微观模型的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于法拉第效应的量子几何描述，推导了通用磁性源与薄膜超导结构的耦合理论框架，并考虑了器件几何结构的影响。将该框架应用于时变磁偶极子（描述表面/衬底自旋）和载流磁通线两种情况。

papers.title: Interplay between Isomerization and Spin Crossover in 1D Fe-Indigo Coordination Polymers on Ag substrates
papers.abstract: Spin-crossover (SCO) compounds offer a route to switchable molecular functionality in reduced dimensions. However, one-dimensional (1D) SCO chains, which offer the possibility to study ligand fields other than the paradigmatic octahedral field, remain comparatively little studied. Here, we use first-principles density functional theory (DFT+$U$) to investigate Fe-indigo coordination-polymer chains synthesized experimentally on Ag(111) and Ag(100) substrates. These display a rich interplay between changes in ligand field (isomerization) and spin crossover. On-surface isomerization on Ag(111) interconverts (N,O)-chelated \textit{trans} configuration and (N,N)-/(O,O)-chelated \textit{cis} configurations at the Fe centers. The lowest-energy \textit{trans} and \textit{cis} solutions on Ag(111) have different spin configurations over the interval $0.66<U<3.00$~eV. At the reference value $U=1$~eV, the preferred \textit{trans} solution is the mixed LS--LS--HS configuration, whereas the preferred \textit{cis} solution is LS--LS--LS. The experimentally observed preference for \textit{cis} chains on Ag(111) and \textit{trans} chains on Ag(100) is reproduced for the range $0.88<U<3.75$~eV. To interpret these results, toy models and spin-resolved Fe $3d$ projected densities of states are used, while freestanding-chain calculations reveal a strain-sensitive LS--HS competition. These results provide a microscopic explanation for isomerization-controlled spin-state switching in a 1D coordination polymer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“first-principles density functional theory (DFT+$U$)”“toy models”“projected densities of states”等第一性原理计算与模型分析手段，未提及实验测量数据。；研究对象：在Ag(111)和Ag(100)衬底上合成的Fe-靛蓝一维配位聚合物链，重点研究其配体场异构化（trans/cis构型转变）与自旋交叉（SCO）之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ag(111)上，表面诱导的异构化使Fe中心在(N,O)-螯合trans构型与(N,N)-/(O,O)-螯合cis构型之间转换，且最低能量的trans与cis解具有不同的自旋构型（如U=1 eV时trans为混合LS–LS–HS，cis为LS–LS–LS）；计算在0.88<U<3.75 eV范围内复现了实验观察到的Ag(111)偏好cis链、Ag(100)偏好trans链，从而从微观上解释了异构化控制的自旋态切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ag(111)上，表面诱导的异构化使Fe中心在(N,O)-螯合trans构型与(N,N)-/(O,O)-螯合cis构型之间转换，且最低能量的trans与cis解具有不同的自旋构型（如U=1 eV时trans为混合LS–LS–HS，cis为LS–LS–LS）；计算在0.88<U<3.75 eV范围内复现了实验观察到的Ag(111)偏好cis链、Ag(100)偏好trans链，从而从微观上解释了异构化控制的自旋态切换。；创新点：首次在理论上揭示一维SCO配位聚合物中配体场异构化与自旋交叉的耦合机制，并解释了衬底依赖的构型选择性（Ag(111) vs Ag(100)），为超出八面体配位场的一维SCO体系提供了微观图像。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT+$U$第一性原理计算（U值扫描区间0.66–3.75 eV），结合自旋分辨的Fe 3d投影态密度分析，并构建toy models进行解释；同时进行自由站立链（freestanding-chain）计算以研究应变对LS–HS竞争的影响。

papers.title: Tuning Andreev reflection and conductance in proximitized nanowires through the spin-orbit field direction
papers.abstract: We investigate the Andreev reflection (AR) and the nonlinear conductance in a normal-superconductor junction realized with a proximitized semiconductor nanowire exposed to a magnetic field along its axis. We show that, while at zero energy the AR coefficient is determined by the topological phase of the superconducting side of the junction, at finite energy the AR is strongly affected by the directions of the Rashba spin-orbit field characterizing the normal and the proximitized sides. The tunability of the AR and the nonlinear conductance as a function of the spin-orbit misalignment angle is particularly pronounced when the proximitized side is in the topologically trivial phase. The spin-orbit field direction is revealed to be an efficient knob to control the electron transport through the hybrid junction, realizing an electrically widely tunable device. The implementation in realistic setups is discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We investigate”“We show”等表述，讨论理论模型（Andreev反射系数、非线性电导）及参数调控，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：由半导体纳米线构成的正常-超导（N-S）结，其中纳米线被邻近效应诱导超导（proximitized），并沿轴向施加磁场。核心物理现象为Andreev反射（AR）和非线性电导，以及Rashba自旋轨道场方向对输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零能量下，AR系数由超导侧的拓扑相决定；在有限能量下，AR强烈依赖于正常侧和邻近超导侧Rashba自旋轨道场方向的相对夹角。当邻近侧处于拓扑平庸相时，AR和非线性电导对自旋轨道失配角尤为敏感，该角度可作为高效调控电子输运的旋钮。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零能量下，AR系数由超导侧的拓扑相决定；在有限能量下，AR强烈依赖于正常侧和邻近超导侧Rashba自旋轨道场方向的相对夹角。当邻近侧处于拓扑平庸相时，AR和非线性电导对自旋轨道失配角尤为敏感，该角度可作为高效调控电子输运的旋钮。；创新点：揭示自旋轨道场方向（而非仅其强度）可作为独立调控旋钮，实现对混合结输运特性的电学宽范围调谐，尤其在拓扑平庸相中效果显著。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于正常-超导结的散射/输运框架，计算Andreev反射系数与非线性电导随自旋轨道失配角的变化。摘要未明确说明具体技术（如散射矩阵、格林函数或数值方法），也未提及材料参数细节。

papers.title: Microscopically exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model
papers.abstract: We derive an exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model, i.e. inverse-square interacting bosons on a line, from microscopic first principles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“derive an exact transport equation ... from microscopic first principles”，属于从第一性原理出发的解析推导。；研究对象：量子 Calogero 模型，即一维直线上具有反平方（inverse-square）相互作用的玻色子体系。摘要未明确说明具体材料或实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从微观第一性原理出发，严格推导出了量子 Calogero 模型的精确输运方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从微观第一性原理出发，严格推导出了量子 Calogero 模型的精确输运方程。；创新点：该输运方程是“精确的”（exact），且推导完全基于微观第一性原理，而非唯象或近似假设。摘要未突出说明与已有输运理论（如玻尔兹曼方程）的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导，基于微观第一性原理（microscopic first principles）的解析方法。摘要未给出具体技术细节（如是否使用 Bethe ansatz、流体力学映射或代数方法）。

papers.title: Direct Validation of Superconductivity through Contact-Free Detection of Persistent Supercurrents Using Room-Temperature Quantum Magnetometry
papers.abstract: The accelerated emergence of new materials is driving the search for high temperature superconductors, but rapid experimental validation remains a critical bottleneck, particularly for microscopic samples under high pressure. Here, we demonstrate one-step direct superconductivity validation through room-temperature, contact-free detection of remnant supercurrents. The technique utilizes a cryogen-free optically pumped atomic magnetometer to detect the temperature-dependent magnetic field produced by supercurrents of a superconductor. The superconducting transition is directly identified by the abrupt disappearance of magnetic field from the remnant supercurrent above the transition temperature and the reversal of the supercurrent direction upon reversing the applied magnetic field. Validated on YBCO microcrystals and REBCO tape, this technique detects pico-Tesla magnetic fields from supercurrents induced by the ambient Earth's magnetic field in a millimeter-sized REBCO square disk, as well as from sub-100 micrometer YBCO microcrystals compatible with high-pressure diamond anvil cells. The use of a ferrite flux guide enables sensitive detection from centimeter-scale distances. Requiring no electrical contacts, magnetic coils, or integrated magnetic sensors, this non-invasive, room-temperature platform offers a scalable approach for high-throughput screening and validation of superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了实际测量技术（原子磁力计）、实验验证材料（YBCO微晶、REBCO带材）以及磁场检测过程。；研究对象：超导材料（YBCO微晶、REBCO带材及毫米尺寸REBCO方片），以及超导转变的快速验证方法——通过无接触检测剩余超电流的磁场信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用室温、无接触的量子磁力计，通过检测超电流产生的温度依赖磁场，可直接一步验证超导电性：超导转变表现为剩余超电流磁场在转变温度以上的突然消失，且反转外加磁场时超电流方向随之反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用室温、无接触的量子磁力计，通过检测超电流产生的温度依赖磁场，可直接一步验证超导电性：超导转变表现为剩余超电流磁场在转变温度以上的突然消失，且反转外加磁场时超电流方向随之反转。；创新点：实现了对高压金刚石压砧兼容的亚100微米微晶及毫米尺寸样品的室温、无接触、一步式超导直接验证，无需低温、电接触或集成传感器，为高通量超导筛选提供了可扩展平台。摘要未突出说明与其他验证方法（如输运测量、磁化率测量）的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用无制冷剂的光泵浦原子磁力计，在室温下无接触检测超导样品中剩余超电流产生的皮特斯拉级磁场；使用铁氧体磁通导引器实现厘米级距离的灵敏检测；实验在环境地磁场中诱导超电流，无需电接触、磁线圈或集成磁传感器。

papers.title: IDMate: Window-resolved self-consistent-field proposal screening with finite-temperature response bounds
papers.abstract: We introduce IDMate, a Kohn--Sham framework for screening approximate self-consistent-field (SCF) states with a finite-temperature response bound and deterministic reference-map recovery. A charge-neutral factorization separates electronic conditioning from mixer amplification, while fixed-point-preserving rank-one interventions test their roles in the linearized dynamics. For a fixed Hamiltonian, exact electron number, and temperature, strong convexity of the Mermin free-energy functional yields an a posteriori density-matrix bound in a selected spectral window. Across $3{,}586$ stress trials, $1{,}942$ proposals were accepted and none exceeded the window criterion. Under trial independence, the one-sided $95\%$ zero-event upper bound is $8.4\times10^{-4}$; treating the 70 correlated ladders as independent units gives $4.2\times10^{-2}$ per ladder. In three reference configurations, the integrated screening rule replaced ten reference-map evaluations, reproduced the reference-scoring trajectories, and satisfied every terminal comparison criterion. Window and full-space deviations differ by six to eleven orders of magnitude; full-space distance classifies the window decisions with a descriptive pooled AUC of $0.694$ (row-bootstrap $95\%$ interval $[0.544,\,0.831]$). A predefined cross-lineage work model does not meet its acceptance criterion, and serial proposal construction makes the production implementation $7.87$ times as costly under the predefined charged-cost accounting as its all-reference counterfactual. IDMate establishes a rigorous exact-trace window bound, a tested accept-or-recover rule, and explicit full-space and implementation targets for net acceleration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：Kohn–Sham framework、self-consistent-field (SCF) states、linearized dynamics、Mermin free-energy functional、a posteriori density-matrix bound。；研究对象：Kohn–Sham 自洽场（SCF）迭代的数值收敛问题，具体为对近似 SCF 态进行筛选与参考映射恢复的算法框架（IDMate），不针对特定材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: IDMate 在有限温度下建立了严格的迹窗口密度矩阵误差界，并在 3,586 次应力测试中所有被接受的提议均未超出窗口判据；其集成筛选规则可替代多次参考映射评估并满足所有终端比较判据，但预定义的跨谱系工作模型未达到接受标准，且串行提议构建使生产实现成本为全参考反事实的 7.87 倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：IDMate 在有限温度下建立了严格的迹窗口密度矩阵误差界，并在 3,586 次应力测试中所有被接受的提议均未超出窗口判据；其集成筛选规则可替代多次参考映射评估并满足所有终端比较判据，但预定义的跨谱系工作模型未达到接受标准，且串行提议构建使生产实现成本为全参考反事实的 7.87 倍。；创新点：提出了一个严格的精确迹窗口误差界（exact-trace window bound），并给出经过测试的“接受或恢复”规则；同时明确指出了全空间距离与窗口决策之间的统计关联（描述性 pooled AUC 0.694），以及净加速所需的全空间与实现层面的改进目标。摘要未突出说明与传统 SCF 加速方法（如 Pulay 混合、ADIIS）的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: Kohn–Sham 密度泛函理论框架；有限温度 Mermin 自由能泛函的强凸性推导后验误差界；电荷中性分解（将电子条件化与混合器放大分离）；保不动点的一阶秩干预；固定点保留的参考映射恢复；统计检验（零事件单侧 95% 上限、行自助法 AUC 区间）；预定义成本核算模型。

papers.title: Valley polarization dependence of candidate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in monolayer graphene
papers.abstract: We investigate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (EDFQH) states in monolayer graphene, focusing on the experimentally observed filling fractions $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Owing to the approximate SU(4) symmetry arising from spin and valley degrees of freedom, graphene hosts a rich variety of multi-component fractional quantum Hall states with different polarization configurations. Using the Chern-Simons composite fermion framework for SU(4) systems, we construct candidate variational wave functions corresponding to distinct spin, valley, and mixed polarization states. The ground-state energies of these states are evaluated numerically using the Coulomb interaction in spherical geometry. By comparing energies across different polarization sectors, we identify the energetically favored configurations at $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Our variational energy comparison suggests that the energetically favored candidate states correspond to multi-component correlated quantum Hall liquids. Within the restricted family of trial states considered here, these states differ from a simple composite-fermion Fermi-sea description. These findings provide insight into the role of valley polarization and SU(4) symmetry in stabilizing even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用Chern-Simons复合费米子框架构建变分波函数，并进行数值能量计算。；研究对象：单层石墨烯中偶分母分数量子霍尔态，具体关注实验观测到的填充因子ν=1/2和ν=1/4，以及自旋与谷自由度带来的SU(4)对称性对多分量态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ν=1/2和ν=1/4处，能量上有利的候选态为多分量关联量子霍尔液体，而非简单的复合费米子费米海描述；谷极化构型对稳定这些偶分母态起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ν=1/2和ν=1/4处，能量上有利的候选态为多分量关联量子霍尔液体，而非简单的复合费米子费米海描述；谷极化构型对稳定这些偶分母态起关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Chern-Simons复合费米子理论框架构建SU(4)对称体系的多分量变分波函数（涵盖不同自旋、谷及混合极化构型），并在球面几何下用库仑相互作用数值计算各态基态能量，通过跨极化扇区能量比较确定最优构型。

papers.title: Battery open-circuit voltage is not purely chemical
papers.abstract: Open-circuit-voltage (OCV) curves are commonly treated as intrinsic chemical properties of electrode materials. However, this view is incomplete. In ion-insertion batteries, OCV also depends on mechanical state and microstructure. Using finite-element simulations and asymptotic analysis, we show that particle swelling and external loads promote particle--particle contact that generates compressive stresses, shifting the inserted-ion chemical potential. The OCV correction is nonlinear, follows Hertzian contact scaling, and depends on particle arrangement. Identical materials can therefore exhibit different OCV curves in different electrode microstructures. Furthermore, in full cells, electrodes are mechanically coupled through the common stack stress. Thus, cell OCV is a chemo-mechanical property of the entire battery architecture, not chemistry alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“finite-element simulations and asymptotic analysis”（有限元模拟与渐近分析）。；研究对象：离子嵌入型电池（ion-insertion batteries）中电极材料的开路电压（OCV）与力学状态、微观结构之间的耦合关系，具体涉及颗粒溶胀、颗粒间接触应力及全电池堆叠应力对嵌入离子化学势的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电池开路电压并非纯化学属性，而是依赖于电极的力学状态和微观结构：颗粒溶胀与外载荷导致的颗粒间接触压应力会改变嵌入离子的化学势，使OCV产生非线性修正（遵循赫兹接触标度），且该修正随颗粒排列方式变化。因此，相同材料在不同电极微结构中可呈现不同OCV曲线；在全电池中，电极通过共同堆叠应力机械耦合，使电池OCV成为整个电池架构的化学-力学性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电池开路电压并非纯化学属性，而是依赖于电极的力学状态和微观结构：颗粒溶胀与外载荷导致的颗粒间接触压应力会改变嵌入离子的化学势，使OCV产生非线性修正（遵循赫兹接触标度），且该修正随颗粒排列方式变化。因此，相同材料在不同电极微结构中可呈现不同OCV曲线；在全电池中，电极通过共同堆叠应力机械耦合，使电池OCV成为整个电池架构的化学-力学性质。；创新点：突破了将OCV视为电极材料固有化学性质的传统观点，明确提出并定量论证了OCV对力学状态和微结构的依赖，以及全电池中电极间通过堆叠应力产生的机械耦合对OCV的影响。摘要未突出说明与具体实验数据的对比或对特定材料体系的定量预测。
papers.method_zh: 有限元模拟（finite-element simulations）与渐近分析（asymptotic analysis），用于分析颗粒接触应力与化学势修正的定量关系及标度行为。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate for Oxygen Vacancy Dynamics in epitaxial $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$ on Si memristors via Dynamic Spectral Optimization
papers.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a promising framework for modeling semiconductor devices, yet standard architectures struggle with severe numerical stiffness and multiscale spatial discrepancies inherent to oxide heterostructures. Here, we demonstrate a cascaded PINN architecture coupled with a custom second-order Chebyshev second kind polynomial spectral optimizer (DSO V2 Hybrid) to model ion-electronic drift-diffusion transport in Pt/SrTiO$_3$/Si memristive heterostructures across a 20 nm STO film on a 380 $μ$m Si substrate. By isolating potential, carrier density, and vacancy transport into four sequentially trained sub-neural-networks, our model circumvents condition numbers exceeding $10^{16}$ without operator splitting. The trained surrogate reproduces experimental conductive-AFM current-voltage hysteresis ($R^2 > 0.96$) while ensuring strict Poisson consistency across continuous space. Compared to conventional finite-element solvers (e.g., COMSOL), the PINN surrogate enables differentiable inverse parameter estimation and linear time inference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs)、modeling、simulation、surrogate。；研究对象：Pt/SrTiO₃/Si 忆阻异质结构中的氧空位动力学与离子-电子漂移-扩散输运现象，具体为外延 SrTiO₃（20 nm）薄膜生长在 380 μm Si 衬底上的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 级联 PINN 架构结合自定义 Chebyshev 谱优化器（DSO V2 Hybrid）能够有效模拟 Pt/SrTiO₃/Si 忆阻异质结构中的离子-电子输运，绕过条件数超过 10¹⁶ 的数值刚性难题，复现实验导电 AFM 电流-电压滞回曲线（R² > 0.96），并保证连续空间上的严格 Poisson 自洽性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：级联 PINN 架构结合自定义 Chebyshev 谱优化器（DSO V2 Hybrid）能够有效模拟 Pt/SrTiO₃/Si 忆阻异质结构中的离子-电子输运，绕过条件数超过 10¹⁶ 的数值刚性难题，复现实验导电 AFM 电流-电压滞回曲线（R² > 0.96），并保证连续空间上的严格 Poisson 自洽性。；创新点：通过级联子网络划分物理量，避免了算子分裂即可绕过极端条件数（>10¹⁶）的数值刚性；相比传统有限元方法，PINN 代理模型支持可微分的逆参数估计和线性时间推理。摘要未突出说明与以往 PINN 工作的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用级联（cascaded）物理信息神经网络（PINN）架构，将电势、载流子密度和空位输运分别隔离到四个顺序训练的子神经网络中；配合自定义的二阶 Chebyshev 第二类多项式谱优化器（DSO V2 Hybrid）进行训练。与传统有限元求解器（如 COMSOL）对比验证性能。

papers.title: Constituent-Tagged Transfer Linking Cluster Dynamics to Static Scaling
papers.abstract: Clusters that merge and split have no unique genealogy. Tracking the host size of a conserved constituent defines $q_*$ by $\langle(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}\rangle=1$, with $q_*\ne0$. Across coupled map networks, coagulation-fragmentation dynamics, and Vicsek systems, $q_*\simeqα-2$ without fitting, where $c(s)\propto s^{-α}$ on the same size window. Radius scans locate the known Vicsek interaction radius and recover an independently specified clustering scale in experimental active rods. Local scale covariance yields the relation, while a tent map counterexample shows when reducing the stationary balance at each parent size to one moment fails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：coupled map networks、coagulation-fragmentation dynamics、Vicsek systems、tent map counterexample（数值模拟与理论分析结合）。；研究对象：团簇合并与分裂动力学系统，包括耦合映射网络、凝聚-碎裂过程、Vicsek 活性粒子系统，以及实验活性杆体系中的团簇尺度标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多种团簇动力学系统中，守恒组分的宿主尺寸比满足 ⟨(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}⟩=1 定义的非零指数 q_*，且无需拟合地满足 q_* ≃ α−2，其中 c(s) ∝ s^{−α} 为同一尺寸窗口内的稳态团簇尺寸分布。该关系源于局部尺度协变性，可用于定位相互作用半径或标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多种团簇动力学系统中，守恒组分的宿主尺寸比满足 ⟨(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}⟩=1 定义的非零指数 q_*，且无需拟合地满足 q_* ≃ α−2，其中 c(s) ∝ s^{−α} 为同一尺寸窗口内的稳态团簇尺寸分布。该关系源于局部尺度协变性，可用于定位相互作用半径或标度。；创新点：提出一种不依赖拟合的普适关系 q_* = α−2，将团簇动力学的时间演化（宿主尺寸比矩）与静态标度指数直接关联，并展示其可用于无先验信息地确定相互作用尺度；同时明确指出了该约化失效的反例条件。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过耦合映射网络、凝聚-碎裂动力学和 Vicsek 模型的数值模拟，结合半径扫描方法；并用实验活性杆数据验证标度恢复能力；以 tent map 作为反例检验理论适用边界。理论框架为局部尺度协变性与稳态矩平衡约化。

papers.title: Decoherence-controlled collective criticality in a two-dimensional quantum Stag Hunt
papers.abstract: Physical decoherence can preserve the microscopic strategic neutrality condition of a quantum game while changing the thermodynamic regime of the corresponding interacting population. We demonstrate this for an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (\textit{EWL}) Stag Hunt embedded as independent nearest neighbor encounters on a square lattice. For the restricted strategies $\mathsf{Q}=i\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathsf{D}=i\mathbb{Y}$, noisy two-player payoff matrices are determined for phase damping, depolarization, and amplitude damping and mapped exactly to channel dependent Ising parameters $\mathfrak{J}(Γ,p)$ and $\mathfrak{H}(Γ,p)$. Phase damping and depolarization show the clearest contrast: they share the same microscopic neutrality branch $\mathfrak{H}=0$, while only depolarization suppresses the interaction as $(1-p)^2$. At $β=1$, this produces an exact depolarization-driven square-lattice critical point at $p_{*}\approx 0.233460\ldots$, whereas phase damping remains in the ordered coexistence regime along the same neutrality branch. Monte Carlo finite size scaling is consistent with two-dimensional Ising criticality and distinguishes field driven coexistence below $p_{*}$ from a smooth crossover above it. Amplitude damping additionally reveals a strong dependence on channel placement: the post-strategy neutrality branch reaches $Γ=0$ at $p=1/3$ and then disappears. Resource negativity further shows that microscopic two-qubit entanglement and collective interaction strength are distinct quantities. The resulting extended lattice remains an ordinary classical Ising system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：mapped exactly、Monte Carlo finite size scaling、理论模型分析。；研究对象：二维方格上嵌入的EWL量子Stag Hunt博弈，作为独立最近邻相互作用的多体统计系统，重点研究退相干（phase damping、depolarization、amplitude damping）对其集体临界行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退相干可以保持量子博弈的微观策略中性条件，但会改变相互作用群体的热力学相态：depolarization在β=1时驱动精确的二维方格临界点（p*≈0.233460），而phase damping沿同一中性分支仍处于有序共存区；amplitude damping则强烈依赖信道位置，在p=1/3处使中性分支消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退相干可以保持量子博弈的微观策略中性条件，但会改变相互作用群体的热力学相态：depolarization在β=1时驱动精确的二维方格临界点（p*≈0.233460），而phase damping沿同一中性分支仍处于有序共存区；amplitude damping则强烈依赖信道位置，在p=1/3处使中性分支消失。；创新点：首次证明退相干类型（而非仅强度）可控制量子博弈嵌入多体系统后的集体临界行为，并揭示微观两比特纠缠与集体相互作用强度是相互独立的量；同时指出扩展晶格整体仍是普通经典Ising系统。摘要未突出说明与已有博弈-统计物理映射工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 将含噪声的两玩家收益矩阵精确映射为信道依赖的Ising参数𝔍(Γ,p)和𝔇(Γ,p)，结合Monte Carlo有限尺寸标度分析验证二维Ising临界性，并用资源负性（resource negativity）量化微观纠缠。

papers.title: FrOGS: Discrete Neural Sampler for Independent Alloy Configurations Across Chemical Conditions
papers.abstract: Predicting the thermodynamic properties of an alloy requires sampling its configurations across many chemical conditions and recovering free energies on a common absolute scale. Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is the standard tool, but it requires separate simulations at different conditions, and auxiliary free-energy methods such as thermodynamic integration are used to place results on a common absolute scale. Modern discrete neural samplers typically use reverse KL divergence as the objective and can be mode-seeking or biased. We present Free energy Offering Generative Sampler (FrOGS), a hybrid discrete neural sampler that couples an autoregressive model to a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) to be trained jointly under a single shared loss. FrOGS draws i.i.d. configurations, returns an unbiased estimate of the partition function, and gives consistent estimates of thermodynamic observables. We train a single model across a wide range of chemical conditions to produce estimates on a common absolute free-energy scale. FrOGS matches exact finite-size results on the 2D Ising model and reference phase diagrams for AgPd and CuAu, without mode collapse. We additionally compare to SEGAL, a published autoregressive baseline, and find that only FrOGS recovers the stability range of the CuAu$_3$ phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及离散神经采样器、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛、自由能估计等计算方法，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：合金体系的热力学性质预测，具体包括二维Ising模型、AgPd和CuAu合金（含CuAu₃相）的相图与自由能计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种混合离散神经采样器FrOGS，能够在多种化学条件下以单一模型获得绝对自由能尺度上无偏且一致的热力学量估计，并成功复现AgPd和CuAu参考相图，且未出现模式坍缩；相比之下，基线方法SEGAL无法恢复CuAu₃相的稳定区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种混合离散神经采样器FrOGS，能够在多种化学条件下以单一模型获得绝对自由能尺度上无偏且一致的热力学量估计，并成功复现AgPd和CuAu参考相图，且未出现模式坍缩；相比之下，基线方法SEGAL无法恢复CuAu₃相的稳定区间。；创新点：首次将自回归模型与CTMC结合为统一可训练的离散神经采样器，实现跨化学条件的单模型绝对自由能标定，并能在有限尺寸精确结果和参考相图上验证无偏性与一致性，克服了传统MCMC需分条件模拟及辅助热力学积分的问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 将自回归模型与连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）耦合，在单一共享损失函数下联合训练；采用逆向KL散度之外的训练目标以克服模式寻求偏差；通过采样独立同分布构型并给出配分函数的无偏估计来计算热力学观测量。摘要未明确说明具体的第一性原理或势函数细节。

papers.title: A Unified Description of Dirac-Cone Anisotropies in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: Anisotropies in two-dimensional materials are responsible for a variety of effects that significantly modify their physical properties. In this paper, we present a covariant modification of the Dirac equation that incorporates anisotropies into the effective low-energy description around the Dirac point. The model is constructed by analogy with a Lorentz-violating extension of the Standard Model of elementary particles and yields a (2+1)-dimensional framework describing physical effects such as shifted, tilted, and distorted Dirac cones through its free parameters. The proposed model thus provides a general and unified framework in which distinct anisotropy-induced modifications of the Dirac spectrum and their combinations can be systematically characterized. We further apply the model to strained graphene and show that its effective parameters can be quantitatively extracted from first-principles electronic band structures while retaining a direct geometrical interpretation. These results establish a connection between the microscopic electronic structure and a material-independent effective description of anisotropic two-dimensional Dirac systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“covariant modification of the Dirac equation”“theoretical framework”“model”，属于理论建模与第一性原理计算结合的类型。；研究对象：二维材料中狄拉克锥的各向异性，具体包括倾斜、平移和畸变的狄拉克锥；并以应变石墨烯作为具体应用实例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个协变形式的狄拉克方程修正框架，可统一描述二维狄拉克体系中由各向异性引起的多种能谱修正（如锥体平移、倾斜和畸变），并证明该框架的有效参数可从第一性原理能带中定量提取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个协变形式的狄拉克方程修正框架，可统一描述二维狄拉克体系中由各向异性引起的多种能谱修正（如锥体平移、倾斜和畸变），并证明该框架的有效参数可从第一性原理能带中定量提取。；创新点：提供了一个统一且与材料无关的协变框架，能够系统表征不同类型的狄拉克锥各向异性及其组合效应，并建立了微观电子结构与有效描述之间的定量联系。摘要未突出说明与以往各向异性模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：类比粒子物理标准模型中的洛伦兹对称性破缺扩展，构建(2+1)维有效低能模型；结合第一性原理电子能带计算（摘要中提及“first-principles electronic band structures”）提取模型参数。

papers.title: Dipolar order across Bravais lattice space: classification, spin waves, and a four-attractor phase diagram
papers.abstract: Every crystal is a Bravais lattice decorated by a basis, so the dipolar ordering of the fourteen Bravais lattices is the natural starting point for any systematic theory of dipolar magnetism in three dimensions. We determine it here in a single common framework: the interaction tensor is Ewald-summed, the classical ground state is obtained by minimising the lowest Luttinger--Tisza band over the entire Brillouin zone, and the linear spin-wave spectrum with its zero-point corrections is computed for every lattice whose order is collinear. Three results emerge that are not properties of individual lattices but of the landscape. First, two structural principles --- the exact tracelessness of the dipolar tensor in three dimensions, and its identical vanishing at $\mathbf k=0$ for every cubic-symmetric lattice --- explain the ordering type, the absence of first-order cubic anisotropy, and the systematics of the zero-point moment reduction. Second, exactly one lattice defeats the Luttinger--Tisza construction: for face-centred orthorhombic the optimal eigenvector is not circular, the single-$\mathbf k$ state is a spin-density wave of non-constant length, and the tabulated energy is a strict lower bound; direct supercell minimisation gives the true ground state. Third, optimising each family over its free metric parameters collapses the whole of Bravais space onto only \emph{four} attractors, with body-centred tetragonal the global optimum and a single interior optimum at rhombohedral $α=62.42^\circ$ lying below face-centred cubic. Three independent published benchmarks are reproduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Ewald-summed、Luttinger–Tisza band、linear spin-wave spectrum、supercell minimisation。；研究对象：三维空间中十四种Bravais晶格上的偶极（dipolar）磁有序问题，即经典偶极相互作用下各晶格的基态磁结构、自旋波谱及零点量子修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偶极张量的无迹性及立方对称晶格在k=0处张量恒为零这两条结构原理，统一解释了各晶格的序类型、立方各向异性缺失及零点矩缩减规律；面心正交晶格是唯一使Luttinger–Tisza方法失效的晶格（单k态为非等长自旋密度波）；对自由度量参数优化后，整个Bravais晶格空间仅坍缩为四个吸引子，其中体心四方为全局最优，菱方α=62.42°处存在一个低于面心立方的内部最优。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偶极张量的无迹性及立方对称晶格在k=0处张量恒为零这两条结构原理，统一解释了各晶格的序类型、立方各向异性缺失及零点矩缩减规律；面心正交晶格是唯一使Luttinger–Tisza方法失效的晶格（单k态为非等长自旋密度波）；对自由度量参数优化后，整个Bravais晶格空间仅坍缩为四个吸引子，其中体心四方为全局最优，菱方α=62.42°处存在一个低于面心立方的内部最优。；创新点：首次在单一统一框架内系统覆盖全部十四种Bravais晶格的偶极序；揭示出两个不依赖具体晶格、而属于整个晶格“景观”的结构原理；发现Bravais空间可坍缩为仅四个吸引子的相图结构。摘要未突出说明与以往单晶格或少数晶格研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 统一框架下对十四种Bravais晶格进行：Ewald求和的偶极相互作用张量；通过最小化整个布里渊区内最低Luttinger–Tisza能带获得经典基态；对所有共线序晶格计算线性自旋波谱及零点修正；对面心正交晶格采用直接超胞最小化以获取真实基态；对每个晶格族在自由度量参数空间内做优化。

papers.title: Classical dipolar Heisenberg models on the Archimedean and Laves lattices
papers.abstract: We study classical Heisenberg spins interacting through the dipole--dipole interaction on the eleven Archimedean and eight Laves planar lattices at canonical geometry, which reduce to fifteen distinct vertex sets. For each lattice we compute the Fourier-space interaction matrix $\Am(\bk)$, extract the Luttinger--Tisza ordering wave vector $\bk_{0}$, determine the classical ground state by unconstrained minimization on the commensurate magnetic cell, and evaluate the linearized spin-wave dispersion $\varepsilon_{i}(\bk)$ along the high-symmetry path of the (magnetic) Brillouin zone together with the Holstein--Primakoff moment reduction. The ground states fall into three classes: five are collinear, two are non-collinear at angles commensurate with the lattice symmetry, and eight cant at transcendental angles, which we determine to thirty digits. Across the family, failure of the Luttinger--Tisza strong condition coincides exactly with the appearance of incommensurate canting, with no exceptions in either direction. Truncating the interaction range shows that whether a lattice cants is fixed by the local coordination geometry, whereas the value of the canting angle is set by the long-range tail. The quantum corrections are governed by the magnon spectrum through the size of the magnetic basis and are uncorrelated with frustration, so that the frustration and fluctuation classifications are independent; the corner-sharing lattices host the narrowest low-energy branches. The results constitute a spectral atlas of dipolar Heisenberg systems on the full family of $1$-uniform planar tilings and their duals, and provide predictions for inelastic neutron scattering in materials whose magnetic ions occupy Archimedean or Laves lattices, and for artificial arrays of dipolar-coupled nanomagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“compute”“extract”“determine”“evaluate”等计算动词，以及“linearized spin-wave dispersion”“Holstein–Primakoff moment reduction”等理论方法关键词，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：经典偶极海森伯自旋系统，具体为偶极-偶极相互作用下的经典海森伯自旋，分布在十一种阿基米德平面晶格和八种Laves平面晶格上（共十五种不同的顶点集合），属于1-均匀平面铺砌及其对偶晶格的全族。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该族晶格的基态分为三类：五种共线、两种非共线（角度与晶格对称性相称）、八种以超越角度倾斜（计算至30位精度）。Luttinger–Tisza强条件的失效与不相称倾斜的出现完全一一对应，无一例外；倾斜与否由局域配位几何决定，而倾斜角大小由长程尾部决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该族晶格的基态分为三类：五种共线、两种非共线（角度与晶格对称性相称）、八种以超越角度倾斜（计算至30位精度）。Luttinger–Tisza强条件的失效与不相称倾斜的出现完全一一对应，无一例外；倾斜与否由局域配位几何决定，而倾斜角大小由长程尾部决定。；创新点：首次对完整的1-均匀平面铺砌及其对偶晶格家族（阿基米德+Laves晶格）建立了偶极海森伯系统的“谱图集”，系统揭示了倾斜与否由局域几何决定而倾斜角由长程尾部决定这一分离机制，并证明阻挫与涨落分类相互独立。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 对每种晶格计算傅里叶空间相互作用矩阵A(k)，提取Luttinger–Tisza有序波矢k₀，在相称磁胞上进行无约束最小化确定经典基态，沿（磁）布里渊区高对称路径计算线性化自旋波色散εᵢ(k)，并评估Holstein–Primakoff磁矩缩减。还通过截断相互作用范围来区分局域与长程效应。

papers.title: Graphene-enabled dynamic H-J switching of dipole-dipole coupling
papers.abstract: Environmental modification of dipole interactions has long been explored in energy transport. Here we consider the effects of a tunable graphene monolayer upon nearly H-type or J-type molecular aggregates, concentrating on the inversion of one type of coupling to the other. Modelling the graphene as being deposited on a metallic substrate, we find that as the surface conductivity of the graphene is varied, there is a corresponding change in the parameter region over which coupling inversion is predicted. This provides a route towards observing the predicted coupling inversion in a real system by dynamically changing the surface conductivity during a single run of an experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Modelling”“parameter region”“predicted”等理论建模与预测性表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：石墨烯单层调控下近H型或近J型分子聚集体的偶极-偶极相互作用，重点研究两种耦合类型之间的相互转换（H↔J切换）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当石墨烯沉积在金属衬底上时，通过调节石墨烯的表面电导率，可以改变偶极耦合发生H型到J型（或反之）反转所对应的参数区域，从而为在单次实验过程中动态实现耦合反转提供了可行途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当石墨烯沉积在金属衬底上时，通过调节石墨烯的表面电导率，可以改变偶极耦合发生H型到J型（或反之）反转所对应的参数区域，从而为在单次实验过程中动态实现耦合反转提供了可行途径。；创新点：提出利用石墨烯表面电导率的动态可调性，在单次实验运行中实时切换H/J耦合类型，为在真实体系中观测此前理论预测的耦合反转提供了可操作的实验路径。摘要未突出说明与以往环境修饰偶极相互作用研究相比的其他理论新意。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将石墨烯视为沉积在金属衬底上的可调导电层，通过改变其表面电导率来研究其对分子聚集体偶极相互作用的环境修饰效应。摘要未明确说明具体计算框架（如量子主方程、格林函数等）。

papers.title: Quantum thermalization achieves optimal approximate quantum error correction
papers.abstract: Quantum thermalization explains how an isolated many-body system naturally evolves towards a thermal state, rendering information about the initial conditions inaccessible to local measurements. This is precisely the mechanism utilized in quantum error correction, where information is protected by design through a nonlocal encoding. In this work, we leverage this connection to port the rigorous framework of (approximate) quantum error correction to the study of quantum thermalization. Treating typical late-time states as codewords, we characterize the error-correcting properties of generic thermalizing dynamics. We numerically uncover a universal relationship between the encoding rate, distance, and thermal entropy density of the emergent code. At infinite temperature, this universal curve saturates the quantum Singleton bound, achieving the same optimal limit as Haar-random codes. At finite temperature, we introduce a code family based on the Scrooge ensemble, the natural thermal analogue of the Haar ensemble, and prove it saturates the entropic quantum Singleton bound, establishing this family as optimal within entropic constraints. Our extracted universal curve independently saturates this same bound, revealing that finite-temperature thermalization is itself optimal. Finally, we show how conserved quantities limit the error-correcting behavior of thermalization: codewords with differing energies, or other conserved charges, leak only classical information, and correctability persists until the difference reaches the scale of thermal fluctuations. Our results reveal a universal optimal coding structure in thermalizing dynamics, while introducing new optimal codes that achieve fundamental limits of approximate quantum error correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“rigorous framework”“prove”“numerically uncover”等理论推导与数值分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：量子多体系统的热化动力学，以及其与（近似）量子纠错码之间的映射关系。具体涉及无限温度与有限温度下的典型热化态、Scrooge系综码族，以及守恒量对纠错行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 典型热化动力学在晚期时间自然涌现出近似量子纠错码结构，其编码率、距离与热熵密度之间存在普适关系；该普适曲线在无限温度下饱和量子Singleton界，在有限温度下饱和熵量子Singleton界，表明热化本身即达到最优纠错极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：典型热化动力学在晚期时间自然涌现出近似量子纠错码结构，其编码率、距离与热熵密度之间存在普适关系；该普适曲线在无限温度下饱和量子Singleton界，在有限温度下饱和熵量子Singleton界，表明热化本身即达到最优纠错极限。；创新点：首次将近似量子纠错的严格框架系统移植到量子热化研究中，揭示热化动力学本身具有普适最优编码结构；引入Scrooge系综作为有限温度下的最优码族，并证明其达到熵约束下的基本极限；同时阐明了守恒量（如能量）如何将纠错能力限制为仅保护量子信息免受热涨落尺度内的扰动。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架与数值模拟相结合：将热化晚期态视为码字，借用（近似）量子纠错的形式化框架；数值上提取典型热化动力学的编码参数并拟合普适曲线；理论上构造基于Scrooge系综（热化版本的Haar系综）的码族，并证明其满足熵量子Singleton界。

papers.title: Non-Abelian string melting and thermalization in an open lattice gauge theory
papers.abstract: Open-system lattice gauge theory (LGT) has so far been developed predominantly in Abelian settings, leaving open how genuinely non-Abelian gauge structure reshapes dissipative real-time dynamics. Here, we study a $1+1$D SU(2) Yang--Mills LGT with dynamical matter coupled to a thermal scalar environment through a gauge-preserving Lindblad evolution, which we solve using tensor networks. Starting from a quark--antiquark pair connected by a chromoelectric flux string, we find that the thermal medium melts the string by delocalizing the color charges and screening the flux; on resonance, this dissipative melting competes with and delays coherent string breaking. The thermalization time is non-monotonic in the environment coupling, decreasing through environment-assisted transport at weak dissipation before increasing in a quantum-Zeno regime. In the strong-dephasing limit, a Schrieffer--Wolff expansion maps the dynamics to a classical exclusion process and yields the Liouvillian thermalization time analytically. Beyond these generic open-system effects, the non-Abelian matter structure produces a systematic mesonic bias in the steady state, while the thermalization time decreases with temperature, in contrast to the Abelian Schwinger model trend and in qualitative agreement with pNRQCD studies of the quark--gluon plasma. These results establish a gauge-preserving framework for thermalization and string dynamics in open non-Abelian lattice gauge theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Lindblad evolution、tensor networks、Schrieffer–Wolff expansion、analytical solution。；研究对象：1+1维 SU(2) Yang–Mills 晶格规范理论（非阿贝尔开系统），包含动态物质场并与热标量环境耦合，研究色通量弦的耗散熔化与热化动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热环境通过退局域化色荷并屏蔽色通量使弦熔化；在共振条件下，耗散熔化与相干弦断裂竞争并延缓后者。热化时间随环境耦合非单调变化（弱耗散时先减小，量子芝诺区增大），且随温度升高而减小——与阿贝尔 Schwinger 模型趋势相反，与 pNRQCD 对夸克-胶子等离子体的研究定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热环境通过退局域化色荷并屏蔽色通量使弦熔化；在共振条件下，耗散熔化与相干弦断裂竞争并延缓后者。热化时间随环境耦合非单调变化（弱耗散时先减小，量子芝诺区增大），且随温度升高而减小——与阿贝尔 Schwinger 模型趋势相反，与 pNRQCD 对夸克-胶子等离子体的研究定性一致。；创新点：首次在非阿贝尔（SU(2)）开系统晶格规范理论中建立规范保持的耗散框架，揭示非阿贝尔规范结构对热化与弦动力学的独特影响（如稳态中的介子偏向、温度依赖趋势与阿贝尔模型的差异）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用规范保持的 Lindblad 主方程描述开系统演化，用张量网络（tensor networks）数值求解；在强退相极限下通过 Schrieffer–Wolff 展开将动力学映射为经典排斥过程，并解析求得 Liouvillian 热化时间。

papers.title: Real-Time String Dynamics in $3+1$D Lattice Quantum Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Understanding real-time string dynamics in three spatial dimensions is essential for connecting quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories (LGTs) to the physical dimensionality of QED and QCD, where transverse fluctuations and competing local processes proliferate. We present the first real-time simulations of string breaking in $3+1$D lattice quantum electrodynamics. Using tree tensor networks, we simulate the quench dynamics of electric flux strings in a $3\!+\!1$D U(1) LGT with dynamical matter. At strong coupling, the string breaks resonantly at a sharp resonance condition of mass and gauge couplings, converting electric energy into matter--antimatter pairs that screen the static charges. Off resonance, we classify all competing channels---pair production, string deformations and extensions, and flux loops---whose multiplicity, extensive for pair production and flux loops, depletes the string sector even far from resonance. A channel-resolved perturbation theory quantitatively reproduces these dynamics and their Fourier spectrum. Our results establish diagnostics and benchmarks for upcoming quantum simulators of higher-dimensional LGTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用树张量网络进行实时模拟”，属于数值计算方法。；研究对象：3+1维（三维空间+一维时间）格点量子电动力学（U(1) LGT）中的电通量弦（electric flux string）及其断裂动力学，包含动态物质场（dynamical matter）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合条件下，弦在质量与规范耦合满足尖锐共振条件时发生共振断裂，将电能转化为屏蔽静态电荷的物质—反物质对；远离共振时，多种竞争通道（粒子对产生、弦形变与延伸、磁通环）会耗尽弦扇区，即使远离共振也不例外。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合条件下，弦在质量与规范耦合满足尖锐共振条件时发生共振断裂，将电能转化为屏蔽静态电荷的物质—反物质对；远离共振时，多种竞争通道（粒子对产生、弦形变与延伸、磁通环）会耗尽弦扇区，即使远离共振也不例外。；创新点：首次在3+1维格点QED中实现弦断裂的实时模拟，此前相关工作多限于低维（如1+1D或2+1D）；建立了面向高维格点规范理论量子模拟器的诊断工具与基准测试。
papers.method_zh: 树张量网络（tree tensor networks）实时模拟；通道分辨的微扰理论（channel-resolved perturbation theory）用于定量复现动力学及其傅里叶谱。

papers.title: A simple derivation of the zero-temperature BCS functional from the reduced BCS Hamiltonian
papers.abstract: We consider a grand-canonical reduced BCS Hamiltonian on the full fermionic Fock space with an attractive pairing interaction supported in an energy shell around the Fermi surface. For fixed chemical potential, we prove that the exact finite-volume ground-state energy differs from the minimum of the corresponding finite-volume BCS functional by a volume-independent error. As a consequence, the BCS variational principle is exact for the ground-state energy density in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“prove”“exact”“variational principle”等数学严格证明类关键词，属于数学物理/严格分析方向。；研究对象：约化BCS哈密顿量（reduced BCS Hamiltonian）描述的超导配对系统，具体为全费米子Fock空间上、具有费米面附近能量壳层内吸引配对相互作用的巨正则系综。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定化学势下，有限体积的精确基态能量与相应有限体积BCS泛函的最小值之差是一个与体积无关的常数误差；因此，在热力学极限下，BCS变分原理对基态能量密度是精确的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定化学势下，有限体积的精确基态能量与相应有限体积BCS泛函的最小值之差是一个与体积无关的常数误差；因此，在热力学极限下，BCS变分原理对基态能量密度是精确的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于给出了BCS泛函在零温下精确性的一个“简单推导”（标题明示），且误差估计不依赖于体积，这比以往仅讨论热力学极限下渐近相等的结果更强。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格的数学分析框架：从巨正则约化BCS哈密顿量出发，通过有限体积基态能量与BCS泛函极小值的比较，证明误差项与体积无关，并利用热力学极限推导能量密度的精确性。

papers.title: Cutting corners: exciting and magical bounds from the cusp bootstrap
papers.abstract: An illuminating probe of the dynamics of a line defect is the global geometry of its worldline. For a conformal line defect in a conformal field theory, sharp corners in the worldline, i.e. cusps, host dynamical degrees of freedom characterized in part by a spectrum of scaling dimensions, called cusp anomalous dimensions. We present various general bounds on cusp anomalous dimensions following from unitarity and cutting-and-gluing consistency of different defect geometries. We first establish, for cusps involving conjugate defects, that level crossings upon varying the cusp angle are forbidden between the lightest singlet cusp and any non-singlet cusp, proving that singlet cusps are the lightest.
