Then, we study line defects arranged in a rectangular geometry, which are subject to bootstrap constraints reminiscent of the spinless modular bootstrap. We find an analytic ``magic" functional that produces an optimal and universal lower bound on the dimension of a right angle bare cusp in terms of the universal defect Casimir energy between the corresponding defect and its conjugate in flat space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“bootstrap”（自举）、“unitarity”（幺正性）、“bounds”（界限）等关键词，属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：共形场论（CFT）中的共形线缺陷（conformal line defect）。具体关注的是缺陷世界线（worldline）上的尖角（cusp）几何，以及由尖角所承载的动力学自由度——尖角反常维度（cusp anomalous dimensions）的谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作证明了两个主要结论：1）对于涉及共轭缺陷的尖角，在改变尖角角度时，最轻的单态（singlet）尖角与任何非单态尖角之间禁止发生能级交叉，从而证明单态尖角总是最轻的；2）在矩形几何排列的线缺陷中，通过一个解析的“魔法”泛函（magic functional），得到了直角裸尖角（right angle bare cusp）维度的最优且普适的下界，该下界由对应缺陷与其共轭在平直空间中的普适缺陷卡西米尔能（defect Casimir energy）决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作证明了两个主要结论：1）对于涉及共轭缺陷的尖角，在改变尖角角度时，最轻的单态（singlet）尖角与任何非单态尖角之间禁止发生能级交叉，从而证明单态尖角总是最轻的；2）在矩形几何排列的线缺陷中，通过一个解析的“魔法”泛函（magic functional），得到了直角裸尖角（right angle bare cusp）维度的最优且普适的下界，该下界由对应缺陷与其共轭在平直空间中的普适缺陷卡西米尔能（defect Casimir energy）决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：首次将尖角反常维度的约束问题与模自举（modular bootstrap）的形式建立类比，并发现了能够给出解析最优下界的“魔法”泛函，这为缺陷共形场论中的谱约束提供了全新的技术工具。
papers.method_zh: 采用共形自举（conformal bootstrap）方法，具体结合了“切割与粘合”（cutting-and-gluing）一致性条件，对不同的缺陷几何构型施加幺正性约束。其中对矩形几何的分析使用了与无自旋模自举（spinless modular bootstrap）类似的自举约束，并构造了解析的线性泛函（即“魔法”泛函）来推导最优界限。

papers.title: Discrete time crystals in disordered anisotropic Heisenberg chains
papers.abstract: A discrete time crystal is an out-of-equilibrium phase of matter characterized by the spontaneous breaking of discrete time-translation symmetry. Using extensive numerical simulations based on matrix-product-state methods, we provide evidence for discrete time-crystalline behavior in strongly disordered spin chains with Heisenberg interactions, including the isotropic point, subject to periodic driving. Starting from a many-body localized regime, we observe that rotations induced by delta kicks produce a pronounced subharmonic response at half the drive frequency in spin observables. We investigate the stability of this response against rotation-angle errors through entanglement entropy, quantum Fisher information, short-range spin correlations, and restricted-control ergotropy. Increasing the rotation error reveals an intermediate dynamical regime separating the time-crystalline and Floquet-localized responses. In this regime, most observables exhibit signatures of weakly correlated dynamics reminiscent of Anderson localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“extensive numerical simulations based on matrix-product-state methods”（基于矩阵乘积态的大规模数值模拟）。；研究对象：强无序海森堡自旋链（包括各向同性点）在周期性驱动下的离散时间晶体（discrete time crystal）行为，属于非平衡量子多体物态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强无序海森堡自旋链中，从多体局域化（MBL）态出发施加周期性的δ-kick旋转脉冲，可观察到自旋观测量在驱动频率一半处的显著次谐波响应，即离散时间晶体行为；增大旋转角误差后，系统进入一个介于时间晶体与Floquet局域化之间的中间动力学区域，该区域表现出类似Anderson局域化的弱关联动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强无序海森堡自旋链中，从多体局域化（MBL）态出发施加周期性的δ-kick旋转脉冲，可观察到自旋观测量在驱动频率一半处的显著次谐波响应，即离散时间晶体行为；增大旋转角误差后，系统进入一个介于时间晶体与Floquet局域化之间的中间动力学区域，该区域表现出类似Anderson局域化的弱关联动力学特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于：在包含各向同性点的强无序海森堡链中系统研究了时间晶体的稳定性，并利用多种量子信息与热力学量（如量子Fisher信息、ergotropy）刻画了旋转误差诱导的中间动力学区域。
papers.method_zh: 矩阵乘积态（MPS）方法的大规模数值模拟；用于表征响应的观测量包括纠缠熵、量子Fisher信息、短程自旋关联以及受限控制遍历能（restricted-control ergotropy）。

papers.title: Cusped Defects: Cusp Operator Expansion, Conformal Properties and Bootstrap Applications
papers.abstract: We analyze general properties of cusped defect lines embedded in generic conformal field theories (CFTs). We prove that suitably defined cusp scaling operators transform like primary operators under general conformal transformations. We show that, via the cusp operator expansion (COE), defects of general shape can be expanded in a basis of cusped defects. These findings are checked and exemplified in the case of the localized magnetic field defect. Finally, we derive analytic constraints on dynamical cusp data by making use of a crossing equation, and discuss possible numerical bootstrap applications of our results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We prove”“We show”“analytic constraints”“bootstrap applications”等理论推导与形式化分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：嵌入一般共形场论（CFTs）中的带尖角缺陷线（cusped defect lines），并具体以局域磁场缺陷（localized magnetic field defect）为例进行验证。属于共形场论中缺陷算符与共形几何性质的研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了适当定义的尖角标度算符（cusp scaling operators）在一般共形变换下具有初级算符（primary operators）的变换性质；并建立了尖角算符展开（COE），使得任意形状的缺陷可在一组尖角缺陷基上展开。此外，通过交叉方程推导出动力学尖角数据的解析约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了适当定义的尖角标度算符（cusp scaling operators）在一般共形变换下具有初级算符（primary operators）的变换性质；并建立了尖角算符展开（COE），使得任意形状的缺陷可在一组尖角缺陷基上展开。此外，通过交叉方程推导出动力学尖角数据的解析约束。；创新点：首次系统性地建立了尖角缺陷线的共形算符展开框架，并证明其标度算符具有初级算符性质，为任意形状缺陷的共形场论描述提供了统一基础；同时给出了动力学尖角数据的解析约束，为未来数值自举研究开辟了途径。摘要未突出说明与已有缺陷展开（如直线缺陷或光滑缺陷展开）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为共形场论（CFT）中的缺陷算符形式化方法，具体包括：定义并证明尖角标度算符的共形协变性质、建立尖角算符展开（COE）、利用交叉方程（crossing equation）推导解析约束，并讨论数值共形自举（numerical bootstrap）的潜在应用。

papers.title: Spin-to-polarization mapping with a coherent quantum dot-cavity receiver
papers.abstract: Coherent light-matter interfaces controllably modifying the state of a photon upon interaction with a stationary qubit are a key resource for implementing deterministic entangling gates for optical quantum technologies. This requires a one-to-one mapping between the state of the scattered photon and that of the embedded qubit. Here, we present an experimental signature of such a bijection by leveraging the spin-induced Kerr rotation present in a low-noise charged quantum dot-micropillar cavity device. Through time-resolved polarization measurements, we project the electron spin to one of its eigenstates with $95\pm2\%$ fidelity with a single reflected photon detection, and follow the subsequent spin relaxation through the detection of a second reflected photon. We demonstrate that, after a transient regime governed by the trion radiative lifetime, two orthogonal polarization states can be produced, each associated to a given spin eigenstate. While the current results are limited by a timescale competition between electron spin relaxation and trion radiative lifetime, they could be improved using hole spins displaying increased relaxation times. Our work paves the way towards deterministic logic gates exploiting this one-to-one mapping between a spin and the polarization of a scattered photon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here, we present an experimental signature...”，并描述了“time-resolved polarization measurements”等具体实验测量手段。；研究对象：一种低噪声的带电量子点-微柱腔（charged quantum dot-micropillar cavity）器件。研究的核心物理现象是电子自旋与反射单光子偏振态之间的确定性映射关系（即自旋诱导的Kerr旋转效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了单个反射光子与电子自旋态之间存在一一对应的双射关系：通过探测单个反射光子，可以将电子自旋投影到其本征态上，保真度达到95±2%；并且，在瞬态过程之后，两个正交的偏振态可以分别对应两个自旋本征态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了单个反射光子与电子自旋态之间存在一一对应的双射关系：通过探测单个反射光子，可以将电子自旋投影到其本征态上，保真度达到95±2%；并且，在瞬态过程之后，两个正交的偏振态可以分别对应两个自旋本征态。；创新点：首次在实验上展示了这种基于自旋诱导Kerr旋转的、单个散射光子偏振态与固态电子自旋态之间的确定性一一映射（双射）关系，为未来实现基于该映射的确定性量子逻辑门铺平了道路。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为时间分辨的偏振光学测量。具体而言，利用低噪声带电量子点-微柱腔中的自旋诱导Kerr旋转，通过探测单个反射光子来投影电子自旋态，并通过探测第二个反射光子来跟踪随后的自旋弛豫过程。

papers.title: The conductivity matrix at the topological phase transition
papers.abstract: For a general class of two-dimensional non-interacting semi-metallic electron systems on a lattice, we derive an explicit formula for the whole conductivity matrix, by using Euclidean many-body formalism. The semi-metallic phase takes place whenever two Bloch bands touch at the Fermi energy with conical intersections and generally occurs at the transition between distinct integer quantum Hall phases. Unlike the longitudinal conductivity (which depends solely on the shape of the cones at the Fermi level), the transverse conductivity is remarkably determined both by the conical structures of the bands and by the nature of the two nearby topological phases. Generically, in the semi-metallic state, neither the longitudinal nor the transverse conductivities are quantized in integer multiples of a universal conductivity quantum; however, universality of the conductivity matrix is restored under the assumption of emergent rotational symmetry of the linearized Hamiltonian at the Fermi points. Using our formula, we compute the conductivity matrix for several physically relevant models of quantum Hall fluids at the topological phase transition, exhibiting cases where the transverse conductivity is quantized in half-integer multiples of $e^2/h$ and cases where it depends continuously on an external strain parameter, thus shedding light on its universality or non-universality features.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：derive an explicit formula、Euclidean many-body formalism、non-interacting semi-metallic electron systems。；研究对象：二维无相互作用半金属电子晶格系统，具体关注拓扑相变点（即两个布洛赫带在费米能处锥形相交）处的电导率矩阵行为，以及量子霍尔流体在拓扑相变处的输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出半金属态下完整电导率矩阵的显式公式，发现纵向电导率仅由费米能处锥形结构决定，而横向电导率同时由锥形结构和邻近两个拓扑相的性质决定；在无额外对称性时电导率矩阵不量子化，但在费米点处线性化哈密顿量具有涌现旋转对称性时恢复普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出半金属态下完整电导率矩阵的显式公式，发现纵向电导率仅由费米能处锥形结构决定，而横向电导率同时由锥形结构和邻近两个拓扑相的性质决定；在无额外对称性时电导率矩阵不量子化，但在费米点处线性化哈密顿量具有涌现旋转对称性时恢复普适性。；创新点：首次给出了拓扑相变点处完整电导率矩阵（而非仅纵向或仅横向分量）的普适解析公式，并系统揭示了横向电导率在半金属态下既可能出现半整数 $e^2/h$ 量子化、也可能连续依赖于外部应变参数的非普适行为，澄清了电导率矩阵普适性的条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用欧几里得多体形式论（Euclidean many-body formalism）对一般二维晶格半金属系统进行解析推导，得到电导率矩阵的显式表达式，并将其应用于多个量子霍尔流体在拓扑相变处的具体物理模型。

papers.title: Fractalizing spacetime: Floquet codes with fractonic excitations that are immobile in space and time
papers.abstract: We generalize fractalization, a procedure for the construction of fracton models, from space to spacetime. We apply spacetime fractalization to construct fracton floquet codes with syndrome excitations that have limited mobility in space and time. This extends the notion of fracton order to intrinsically dynamical quantum phases of matter that are inequivalent to static fracton phases. We find spacetime type-II fracton floquet codes which have no topological excitations that are mobile in space or time. These codes exhibit an extreme form of quantum discrete time crystal order with response periods that scale exponentially in their linear system sizes. In this context, the no-strings rule that characterizes type-II fractons leads to a superlinear scaling of the floquet code fault-distance with time, potentially lowering the time overhead required for quantum error correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“generalize fractalization”“construct fracton floquet codes”等理论构造性描述，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：分形化（fractalization）时空中的Floquet码，具体为具有分形子（fracton）激发且激发在空间和时间上均不可动的量子纠错码，属于 intrinsically dynamical 的量子物相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将分形化从空间推广到时空，构造出“时空II型分形Floquet码”，其拓扑激发在空间和时间上均不可移动，展现出极端的量子离散时间晶体序，其响应周期随系统线性尺寸呈指数增长；同时，II型分形子的“无弦规则”导致Floquet码的容错距离随时间的超线性增长，可能降低量子纠错所需的时间开销。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将分形化从空间推广到时空，构造出“时空II型分形Floquet码”，其拓扑激发在空间和时间上均不可移动，展现出极端的量子离散时间晶体序，其响应周期随系统线性尺寸呈指数增长；同时，II型分形子的“无弦规则”导致Floquet码的容错距离随时间的超线性增长，可能降低量子纠错所需的时间开销。；创新点：将分形化从纯空间构造推广到时空，从而将分形子序扩展到本质上动态的量子物相，并证明此类动态相不等价于静态分形相；首次构造出时空II型分形Floquet码，其激发在空间和时间上均完全不可动，并揭示其与极端离散时间晶体序及超线性容错距离的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为分形化（fractalization）过程的时空推广，用于构造Floquet码；分析其激发（syndrome excitations）的时空迁移性、拓扑激发分类、离散时间晶体响应周期标度，以及容错距离（fault-distance）随时间的标度行为。

papers.title: Modeling Tissue Detachment and Rupture Using an Extended Vertex Model with T2-inverse Transitions
papers.abstract: The vertex model is widely used to describe the mechanics of epithelial tissues, but its conventional formulation assumes that all cells remain tightly packed and always share edges with their neighbors, making it difficult to represent local detachment or gap formation. Here, we propose a minimal extension of the vertex model that enables cell detachment by introducing a new topological transformation, T2-inverse, which acts as the inverse of the classical T2 transition. When the imbalance of forces acting on a vertex, quantified by a tension metric $T$, exceeds a threshold, the T2-inverse splits the vertex into multiple vertices and creates a closed polygon that is incorporated as a pseudo-cell. This operation allows the model to represent the emergence and propagation of local detachment events. Using this framework, we simulate the stretching of a cell sheet and show that force-induced local detachments can accumulate to produce macroscopic tissue rupture. These results demonstrate that the proposed model extends the capability of the vertex model to describe tissue-level breakdown processes, including detachment and tearing, and provides a foundation for studying a broader class of epithelial mechanical phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“vertex model”“simulate”“topological transformation”等建模与模拟关键词，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：上皮组织的力学行为，具体为细胞片层在拉伸过程中的局部脱离（detachment）与宏观组织断裂（rupture）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在传统顶点模型中引入T2逆变换（T2-inverse），可以模拟细胞间的局部脱离事件，且力诱导的局部脱离在拉伸下可累积并导致宏观的组织撕裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在传统顶点模型中引入T2逆变换（T2-inverse），可以模拟细胞间的局部脱离事件，且力诱导的局部脱离在拉伸下可累积并导致宏观的组织撕裂。；创新点：传统顶点模型假设细胞始终紧密排列并共享边界，无法描述局部脱离或间隙形成。本工作首次引入T2逆变换作为拓扑操作，使顶点模型能够自然表征细胞脱离、间隙产生与传播，并将模型能力扩展到组织层面的破坏过程（如撕裂）。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 扩展的顶点模型（Extended Vertex Model），核心创新是引入一种新的拓扑变换——T2-inverse，作为经典T2变换的逆操作。当作用在顶点上的力不平衡程度（由张力度量T量化）超过阈值时，该变换将一个顶点分裂为多个顶点，并生成一个闭合多边形作为“伪细胞”（pseudo-cell），从而表征局部脱离。

papers.title: BU-MBAR: A hybrid solution strategy for the MBAR equations
papers.abstract: The multi-state Bennett acceptance ratio (MBAR) equations combine the data collected under different thermodynamic conditions in a statistically optimal way. Due to their practical importance, several solution strategies have been devised to optimize the convergence of the resulting set of coupled equations. However, even with graphics processing unit (GPU) acceleration, the convergence of these methods can still be either unstable or slow. We propose a new approach where the equations are interpreted as the limit of infinitesimal bin width of the respective weighted histogram analysis method (WHAM). In the proposed binned-to-unbinned MBAR (BU-MBAR) method, the bin width is adapted dynamically to ensure a stable and efficient convergence to the asymptotic solution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“solution strategies”、“equations”、“convergence”等关键词，核心是提出一种新的数值求解算法，而非实验测量。；研究对象：多态Bennett接受比（MBAR）方程。这是一个用于统计力学和自由能计算的数学框架，其物理背景是结合不同热力学条件下的模拟或实验数据，属于计算统计物理范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为BU-MBAR的新求解策略，通过将MBAR方程视为无限小bin宽下加权直方图分析（WHAM）的极限，并动态调整bin宽，实现了比现有方法（包括GPU加速方法）更稳定且更高效的收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为BU-MBAR的新求解策略，通过将MBAR方程视为无限小bin宽下加权直方图分析（WHAM）的极限，并动态调整bin宽，实现了比现有方法（包括GPU加速方法）更稳定且更高效的收敛。；创新点：提出了一种全新的求解视角（将MBAR与WHAM在极限情况下联系起来），并引入动态自适应bin宽策略，以解决现有求解器在GPU加速下仍可能出现的收敛不稳定或速度慢的问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值算法设计。具体而言，作者将MBAR方程重新解释为WHAM在bin宽趋近于零时的极限形式，并在此基础上开发了一种“分箱到无分箱”（binned-to-unbinned）的迭代求解方案，其中bin宽在迭代过程中自适应变化，以保证收敛到渐近解。

papers.title: Internal geometries regulate the symmetry of defect configurations in cell populations confined to domains with a negative Euler characteristic
papers.abstract: Nematic order of confined cell populations plays an important role in determining cell alignment and stable configurations of topological defects, which are related to various biomechanical phenomena. Topological charges (or winding numbers) of topological defects strictly depend on the Euler characteristic of the confining domain, which has typically been non-negative in studies focused on domains without internal obstacles. However, biological tissues often surround two or more internal obstacles or holes, which inherently generate defects with negative charges. To understand the mechanical interaction between cellular tissue and obstacles, it is necessary to elucidate the geometrical effects of obstacles on cell alignment and defects with negative charges. Here, we investigate how cell populations achieve stable defect configurations of two -1/2 defects in a triply connected domain. First, we present experimental observations of C2C12 myoblasts confined by two circular obstacles of varying diameter, demonstrating that two $-1/2$ defects are the most frequent configuration when the obstacles are sufficiently large. Second, to theoretically validate these experimental observations, we perform systematic stability analyses of defect configurations using an explicit expression of cell alignment and numerical minimization of the Frank elastic energy. Our numerical calculations reveal that the most stable configuration shifts continuously from a horizontal, through off-axis, to a vertical configuration as the obstacle size increases. In addition, the experimentally observed defect positions agreed with these theoretical predictions to within 60 $μ$m. These findings suggest that obstacle sizes control the symmetry of cell alignment, providing insights into how geometric and topological constraints can generate complex force patterns during morphogenesis or organ movements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“experimental observations of C2C12 myoblasts”和“numerical minimization of the Frank elastic energy”等关键词。；研究对象：受限在负欧拉示性数（三连通）域内的细胞群体，具体为C2C12成肌细胞围绕两个圆形障碍物的向列相排列行为，以及由此产生的拓扑缺陷（两个-1/2缺陷）的稳定构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个圆形障碍物足够大时，细胞群体中最常见的缺陷构型为两个-1/2缺陷；随着障碍物尺寸增大，最稳定缺陷构型从水平、经离轴、连续过渡到垂直排列，表明障碍物尺寸可调控细胞排列的对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个圆形障碍物足够大时，细胞群体中最常见的缺陷构型为两个-1/2缺陷；随着障碍物尺寸增大，最稳定缺陷构型从水平、经离轴、连续过渡到垂直排列，表明障碍物尺寸可调控细胞排列的对称性。；创新点：以往研究多聚焦于无内部障碍（欧拉示性数非负）的域，本文首次系统研究具有负欧拉示性数（含两个内部孔洞）的域中细胞排列与负电荷缺陷的几何效应，揭示了障碍物尺寸对缺陷构型对称性的调控机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：将C2C12成肌细胞限制在两个不同直径的圆形障碍物构成的域内进行培养观察，统计缺陷构型频率。理论上：利用细胞排列的显式表达式进行缺陷构型的系统稳定性分析，并对Frank弹性能进行数值最小化计算。

papers.title: Revealing Many-Body Phases at finite temperatures through Quantum Coherence Distribution
papers.abstract: We introduce a diagnostic framework based on the full probability distribution of quantum coherence to probe single-particle and many-body phases at finite temperature. We first apply this approach to the localization transition in the non-interacting Aubry-André model and then extend the analysis to its interacting counterpart, whose phase diagram is substantially richer. We show that the moments of the coherence distribution provide clear signatures of quantum phase transitions and capture the emergence of many-body phases. More importantly, we find that the entropy of the coherence distribution emerges as an even more powerful indicator, retaining clear signatures of the underlying quantum phases while remaining remarkably robust against increasing thermal fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“diagnostic framework”“probability distribution”“moments”“entropy”等理论分析工具，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：有限温度下的单粒子与多体量子相，具体包括无相互作用Aubry-André模型中的局域化相变，以及其相互作用对应体系中的多体相（如多体局域化等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子相干性的全概率分布及其矩（moments）能清晰标记量子相变并捕捉多体相的出现；更重要的是，相干性分布的熵（entropy）是更强有力的判据，在热涨落增强时仍能保留底层量子相的清晰特征，具有显著鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子相干性的全概率分布及其矩（moments）能清晰标记量子相变并捕捉多体相的出现；更重要的是，相干性分布的熵（entropy）是更强有力的判据，在热涨落增强时仍能保留底层量子相的清晰特征，具有显著鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将量子相干性的全概率分布（而非仅平均值）作为有限温度下探测单粒子和多体相的诊断工具，并发现分布熵对热涨落具有特殊鲁棒性。摘要未突出说明与其他相干性度量或序参量的系统对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子相干性全概率分布的诊断框架，计算分布的各阶矩以及分布熵，用于表征有限温度下的量子相。具体数值方法（如精确对角化、DMRG等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Relativistic transformation of temperature for exotic cosmological fluids
papers.abstract: We study the relativistic transformation of temperature for effective cosmological fluids with negative pressure within a covariant thermodynamic framework. The Lorentz transformation of temperature is derived for barotropic fluids with $p=wρ$ and for the (generalized) Chaplygin gas with $p=-A/ρ^α$. For barotropic fluids with constant negative equation-of-state parameter, we show that negative pressure suppresses the growth of temperature under relativistic boosts. In contrast, the Chaplygin gas exhibits a qualitatively different behavior due to its density-dependent pressure, leading to a monotonic increase of the transformed temperature with velocity. The dependence of the relativistic temperature on the relative velocity and background energy density is illustrated through representative examples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“covariant thermodynamic framework”（协变热力学框架）进行推导，属于理论分析。；研究对象：具有负压力的有效宇宙学流体（effective cosmological fluids），具体包括重子（barotropic）流体（状态方程 p=wρ）和（广义）Chaplygin 气体（p=-A/ρ^α）中的相对论温度变换问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于具有恒定负状态方程参数的barotropic流体，负压力会抑制温度在相对论性推动（boost）下的增长；而Chaplygin气体因其密度依赖的压力，表现出定性不同的行为——变换后的温度随速度单调增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于具有恒定负状态方程参数的barotropic流体，负压力会抑制温度在相对论性推动（boost）下的增长；而Chaplygin气体因其密度依赖的压力，表现出定性不同的行为——变换后的温度随速度单调增加。；创新点：首次在协变热力学框架下系统比较了负压barotropic流体与Chaplygin气体在相对论温度变换上的定性差异，揭示了压力对温度随速度增长行为的调控作用。摘要未突出说明与以往宇宙学温度变换研究的更具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用协变热力学框架（covariant thermodynamic framework），推导了Lorentz变换下温度的形式，针对两类具体状态方程（p=wρ 与 p=-A/ρ^α）进行解析计算，并通过代表性例子展示温度对相对速度和背景能量密度的依赖。

papers.title: The stealthiest particle configurations in 8 and 24 dimensions
papers.abstract: We show that the $E_8$ and Leech lattices generate the stealthiest isometry-invariant, locally square-integrable point processes of intensity $1$ in $\mathbb{R}^8$ and $\mathbb{R}^{24}$, respectively, and that they are the unique stealthiest processes. We also apply the proof technique to sphere packing and energy minimization, and we construct a $20$-dimensional periodic configuration that is stealthier than any known $20$-dimensional lattice with the same particle density. This periodic configuration is a formal dual of Vardy's $20$-dimensional sphere packing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数学证明（“We show that...”）、构造（“we construct...”）以及形式对偶（“formal dual”）等理论概念，未提及实验或具体计算模拟。；研究对象：高维空间（8维和24维）中的点过程与粒子构型，具体涉及E₈格、Leech格、球堆积（sphere packing）以及20维周期构型。属于数学物理与凝聚态理论交叉领域，关注粒子排列的“隐身性”（stealthiness）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: E₈格和Leech格分别是8维和24维中强度为1的等距不变、局部平方可积点过程里“最隐身”（stealthiest）的构型，且是唯一的最隐身过程。此外，构造了一个20维周期构型，其隐身性优于任何已知同密度20维格点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：E₈格和Leech格分别是8维和24维中强度为1的等距不变、局部平方可积点过程里“最隐身”（stealthiest）的构型，且是唯一的最隐身过程。此外，构造了一个20维周期构型，其隐身性优于任何已知同密度20维格点。；创新点：首次证明E₈和Leech格在隐身性上的全局唯一最优性；将证明技术推广到球堆积与能量最小化；构造了20维非格点周期构型，打破了同维度格点在隐身性上的已知最优记录。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体数学工具，但涉及等距不变点过程理论、局部平方可积条件、形式对偶（formal duality）概念，以及将证明技术推广至球堆积和能量最小化问题。具体技术细节（如变分法、傅里叶分析等）摘要未展开。

papers.title: Optimal control theory for measured quantum Schrödinger bridges
papers.abstract: Schrödinger bridges and entropic optimal transport are usually formulated as stochastic interpolation problems between initial and final probability distributions. In their computational form, the bridge potentials are obtained by Sinkhorn or iterative proportional fitting, and are often regarded as auxiliary scaling functions. We show that for continuously monitored quantum systems, these potentials acquire a direct measurement-theoretic meaning. The mathematical structure of conditional quantum trajectory theory induces a Fokker--Planck equation on quantum state space. Conditioning this diffusion on a terminal distribution or a terminal measurement effect produces a Doob/Sinkhorn potential whose directional derivative along a unitary control vector field is the imaginary part of a generalized weak value. The same construction connects the Schrödinger-bridge viewpoint to the optimal-path framework for continuously monitored trajectories: the backward bridge potential plays the role of an effect-like costate, and its weak-value directional derivative gives the local control signal. By specifying the desired endpoint distribution, the induced drift produced by the Schrödinger bridge solution is the control solution that minimizes the quadratic cost feedback law, guiding the distribution to its desired endpoint. We quantify the control score of the available control Hamiltonian as a logarithmic directional derivative of the bridge potential, or an imaginary weak value. Three explicit examples identify weak measurement as a natural entropic regularization mechanism for quantum state transport and gives a route from Sinkhorn scaling to quantum feedback and Hamiltonian control synthesis for practical optimal control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“mathematical structure”“Fokker--Planck equation”“optimal control theory”等理论推导与框架构建，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：连续监测的量子系统（continuously monitored quantum systems），具体关注其量子态空间上的条件量子轨迹、Schrödinger桥与熵最优输运问题，以及量子反馈控制与哈密顿控制合成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续监测量子系统中，Schrödinger桥的势函数具有直接的测量理论含义：其沿酉控制矢量场的方向导数等于广义弱值的虚部，从而将Sinkhorn缩放与量子反馈控制、哈密顿控制合成联系起来，并指出弱测量可作为量子态输运的一种自然熵正则化机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续监测量子系统中，Schrödinger桥的势函数具有直接的测量理论含义：其沿酉控制矢量场的方向导数等于广义弱值的虚部，从而将Sinkhorn缩放与量子反馈控制、哈密顿控制合成联系起来，并指出弱测量可作为量子态输运的一种自然熵正则化机制。；创新点：首次将Schrödinger桥势函数赋予直接测量理论意义（而非仅视为辅助缩放函数），并建立其方向导数与广义弱值虚部之间的等价关系，从而为从Sinkhorn缩放通向量子反馈控制与哈密顿控制合成提供了统一理论路径。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：结合条件量子轨迹理论、Fokker--Planck方程、Doob/Schrödinger桥构造、Sinkhorn/迭代比例拟合、最优控制理论（含二次代价反馈律）以及广义弱值分析。摘要未提及具体数值算法或实验手段。

papers.title: Non-Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Quantum Sensors for Quantum Parameter Estimation
papers.abstract: Non-KAM (Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser) systems, when subjected to weak time-dependent perturbations, exhibit an abrupt transition to classical chaos through the breakdown of invariant phase-space tori. We showcase the utilization of non-KAM systems in the quantum regime as quantum sensors, leveraging their sensitivity at \textit{resonances}. Quantum Fisher information (QFI) is a central quantity in quantum parameter estimation theory that measures how much information a quantum state contains about an unknown parameter that is encoded into it. In other words, it quantifies the sensitivity of a quantum state to small changes in that parameter. In this work, through numerical analysis in conjunction with analytical results, we study the performance of the non-KAM systems for quantum sensing applications by computing the QFI. We find that the growth of the QFI is remarkably enhanced when the resonance condition is satisfied. For frequency estimation under Floquet unitary encodings, we derive a transport bound: if the mean excitation number grows as $\langle\hat n(t)\rangle\sim t^α$, the QFI obeys $I(t)\lesssim t^{2α+2}$. The quantum kicked harmonic oscillator, a paradigmatic non-KAM system, realizes the full hierarchy: localized dynamics ($α=0$) yield quadratic growth, delocalized diffusion along stochastic webs ($α=1$) yields quartic growth, and translationally invariant resonances ($α=2$) saturate the bound with anomalous hexic growth, $I(t)\sim t^{6}$, established analytically at resonance $R=2$ and numerically at $R=4$. The enhancement stems from resonance-induced translational symmetry rather than exponential instability, identifying non-KAM resonances as a metrological resource distinct from chaos-assisted and criticality-based sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“numerical analysis in conjunction with analytical results”（数值分析与解析结果相结合），未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：非KAM（Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser）量子系统，具体以量子 kicked harmonic oscillator（量子 kicked 谐振子）为范例，研究其在量子参数估计（quantum parameter estimation）中的传感性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非KAM系统在满足共振条件时，量子Fisher信息（QFI）的增长被显著增强；在Floquet幺正编码下，若平均激发数按 ⟨n̂(t)⟩∼t^α 增长，则QFI满足上界 I(t)≲t^{2α+2}。量子kicked谐振子可实现完整层级：局域化（α=0）给出二次增长，随机网上的退局域扩散（α=1）给出四次增长，平移不变共振（α=2）饱和该上界，呈现反常的六次增长 I(t)∼t^6（共振R=2处解析确立，R=4处数值验证）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非KAM系统在满足共振条件时，量子Fisher信息（QFI）的增长被显著增强；在Floquet幺正编码下，若平均激发数按 ⟨n̂(t)⟩∼t^α 增长，则QFI满足上界 I(t)≲t^{2α+2}。量子kicked谐振子可实现完整层级：局域化（α=0）给出二次增长，随机网上的退局域扩散（α=1）给出四次增长，平移不变共振（α=2）饱和该上界，呈现反常的六次增长 I(t)∼t^6（共振R=2处解析确立，R=4处数值验证）。；创新点：将非KAM系统的共振敏感性确立为一种区别于混沌辅助传感和临界性传感的计量学资源——其增强机制源于共振诱导的平移对称性，而非指数不稳定性。摘要未突出说明与其他传感方案的直接对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 数值分析结合解析推导。具体包括：计算量子Fisher信息（QFI）以量化参数估计灵敏度；推导频率估计在Floquet幺正编码下的输运上界；对量子kicked谐振子在共振条件（R=2解析、R=4数值）下进行QFI增长标度分析。

papers.title: Robust Hamiltonian engineering with subensemble control
papers.abstract: We present a robust protocol to reshape interactions in a spin ensemble based on global control pulse sequences applied to multiple subensembles in parallel. This setting arises naturally from ensembles of solid-state defects or multi-species atomic arrays. We show that it is provably computationally hard to find pulse sequences that simultaneously engineer interactions both within and between subensembles. Despite its formal hardness, we identify a set of necessary or sufficient conditions under which one can synthesize a target Hamiltonian from the native one. Moreover, we introduce efficient numerical strategies for designing pulse sequences that engineer target Hamiltonians robust against common control imperfections. As a specific application, we discuss the robust generation of two-mode spin squeezing in dual-species atomic ensembles, which is a challenging task without subensemble control. Our results provide a practical toolbox to design novel quantum simulation and sensing experiments with minimal control overhead.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：protocol、provably computationally hard、numerical strategies、synthesize a target Hamiltonian。；研究对象：自旋系综中的相互作用重塑，具体涉及固态缺陷系综或多物种原子阵列中的子系综（subensemble）控制，以及双物种原子系综中的双模自旋压缩。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于全局控制脉冲序列的鲁棒协议，可在多个子系综并行控制下重塑自旋系综的相互作用；尽管同时调控子系综内与子系综间的相互作用在计算上被证明是困难的，但作者找到了可合成目标哈密顿量的必要或充分条件，并展示了该方案可鲁棒地产生双模自旋压缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于全局控制脉冲序列的鲁棒协议，可在多个子系综并行控制下重塑自旋系综的相互作用；尽管同时调控子系综内与子系综间的相互作用在计算上被证明是困难的，但作者找到了可合成目标哈密顿量的必要或充分条件，并展示了该方案可鲁棒地产生双模自旋压缩。；创新点：首次在子系综并行控制的框架下系统研究了哈密顿量工程的鲁棒性，并证明了该问题的计算复杂性；同时给出了在最小控制开销下实现双模自旋压缩这一此前难以实现任务的实用工具箱。摘要未突出说明与已有哈密顿量工程方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值优化相结合：形式化证明了脉冲序列设计的计算复杂性（hardness），推导了目标哈密顿量可合成的必要/充分条件，并引入了针对常见控制缺陷具有鲁棒性的高效数值脉冲序列设计策略。

papers.title: Reactive calcium carbonate precipitation from an atomic cluster expansion potential and enhanced sampling
papers.abstract: Calcium carbonate formation from aqueous solution is central to biomineralization and to carbon sequestration through mineral carbonation. At near-neutral pH, the process is highly reactive, with proton transfer mediating the interconversion between carbonate species. Most atomistic simulations to date either treat carbonate speciation as fixed or consider proton transfer only in small clusters. Here, we combine an ab initio trained atomic cluster expansion (ACE) machine-learning potential for molecular dynamics with enhanced sampling to enable reactive simulations of the early stages of calcium carbonate precipitation at previously inaccessible length and time scales. We study proton transfer and carbonate speciation in ion pairs and triplets, as well as in the collective aggregation of many ions. Our simulations with few ions show that ion association provides a favorable pathway for proton transfer, facilitating interconversion between carbonate, bicarbonate, and carbonic acid. In many-ion systems, proton transfer occurs spontaneously alongside aggregation, and we observe significant changes in the coordination environments as species evolve during the simulations. These results show that ion aggregation and chemical reactivity can be strongly coupled during the early stages of nucleation from solution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“atomic cluster expansion (ACE) machine-learning potential for molecular dynamics”和“enhanced sampling”，属于基于机器学习势的分子动力学模拟研究。；研究对象：水溶液中碳酸钙（CaCO₃）的早期成核过程，具体包括离子对、离子三聚体及多离子聚集体系中的质子转移与碳酸盐物种（碳酸根、碳酸氢根、碳酸）之间的相互转化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子缔合为质子转移提供了有利路径，促进碳酸盐物种间的相互转化；在多离子体系中，质子转移与离子聚集自发耦合发生，表明溶液成核早期阶段离子聚集与化学反应性可强烈关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子缔合为质子转移提供了有利路径，促进碳酸盐物种间的相互转化；在多离子体系中，质子转移与离子聚集自发耦合发生，表明溶液成核早期阶段离子聚集与化学反应性可强烈关联。；创新点：首次将ACE机器学习势与增强采样结合，实现了对碳酸钙早期成核过程中质子转移与碳酸盐物种动态转化的反应性模拟，突破了以往模拟中要么固定碳酸盐物种、要么仅在极小团簇中考虑质子转移的限制。
papers.method_zh: 采用从头算（ab initio）训练的原子团簇展开（ACE）机器学习势进行分子动力学模拟，并结合增强采样（enhanced sampling）技术，以在以往不可及的长度和时间尺度上模拟反应性碳酸钙沉淀过程。

papers.title: Nanoscale magnetometry via collective many-body dynamics in diamond
papers.abstract: Many-body dynamics constitutes a promising approach for creating correlations between quantum particles which can be used for applications in sensing and metrology. However, utilizing this potential for substantial gains in practical settings is a challenging task with only a very few applications realized to date. Here, we demonstrate an approach to nanoscale magnetic sensing enabled by strongly interacting electronic spins in a room temperature solid. By coherently controlling collective many-body dynamics of a dipolar ensemble of $\sim 10^4$ nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond with pulsed magnetic field gradients, we demonstrate practical metrological gain up to $7.9(2)\,\mathrm{dB}$ for magnetic signal detection and $8.8(3)\,\mathrm{dB}$ for magnetic noise sensing, fully accounting for experimental overheads. Finally, we combine these methods to demonstrate a momentum-space-resolved sensing modality that enables detection of spatially correlated magnetic noise at continuously tunable length scales down to 50 nanometers. These observations open the door toward practical applications of interaction-enhanced quantum sensors for nanoscale biological imaging and material characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“pulsed magnetic field gradients”“measurement”等实验关键词，且给出了明确的实验增益数值。；研究对象：室温固体中由约10⁴个金刚石氮-空位（NV）色心组成的偶极相互作用电子自旋系综，以及基于其多体动力学实现的纳米尺度磁传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相干控制强相互作用的NV自旋系综的多体动力学，实现了磁信号检测7.9(2) dB和磁噪声传感8.8(3) dB的实际计量增益（已计入实验开销），并展示了可连续调谐至50纳米长度尺度的动量空间分辨传感模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相干控制强相互作用的NV自旋系综的多体动力学，实现了磁信号检测7.9(2) dB和磁噪声传感8.8(3) dB的实际计量增益（已计入实验开销），并展示了可连续调谐至50纳米长度尺度的动量空间分辨传感模式。；创新点：首次在室温固态体系中利用强相互作用电子自旋的集体多体动力学实现实际计量增益（而非仅理论预测），并展示了可调谐至50纳米尺度的动量空间分辨磁噪声传感能力，为相互作用增强的量子传感器在生物成像和材料表征中的实际应用开辟了途径。
papers.method_zh: 利用脉冲磁场梯度对金刚石中偶极耦合NV色心系综进行相干控制，驱动集体多体动力学；采用磁信号检测和磁噪声传感两种计量方案，并组合实现动量空间分辨的磁噪声探测。摘要未明确说明具体的光学探测技术细节（如ODMR或自旋回声序列的具体形式）。

papers.title: Estimating the asymptotics of integer partitions in intermediate dimensions ($d = 3,4,5,6$)
papers.abstract: It was recently shown by Yeliussizov \cite{Yeliussizov} that integer partitions in dimensions $d \geq 7$ asymptotically grow strictly faster than MacMahon numbers. As MacMahon numbers match with integer partitions in dimensions $d = 1,2$, the comparison of asymptotics of integer partitions with MacMahon numbers in intermediate dimensions ($d = 3,4,5,6$) is an open question. In this work, we perform Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations till $N=15000$ by using adaptive weight learning followed by conventional MCMC steps to numerically estimate the asymptotics of integer partitions in these intermediate dimensions. We numerically establish that in these intermediate dimensions, partitions asymptotically grow faster than MacMahon numbers. More specifically, assuming that the limits exist, we show: $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-3/4}\log p_3(n) = 1.8196 \pm 0.0019$, $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-4/5}\log p_4(n) = 1.7215 \pm 0.0045$, $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-5/6}\log p_5(n) = 1.6521 \pm 0.0059$, and $\lim_{n\to\infty}\log n^{-6/7}p_6(n) = 1.652 \pm 0.021$ for partitions in dimensions $d=3,4,5,$ and $6$ respectively. These numbers are all larger than MacMahon leading order asymptotic coefficients of $1.7898, 1.6614, 1.5737,$ and $1.509$ respectively. Additionally, we also find estimates for some of the sub-leading asymptotic terms in $\log p_d(n)$ in each of the dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations”以及“数值估计”（numerically estimate）。；研究对象：数学物理中的组合学问题——高维整数分拆（integer partitions in dimensions d）的渐近增长行为。具体聚焦于中间维度（d = 3, 4, 5, 6）的分拆数 p_d(n) 的对数渐近性质。摘要未涉及具体凝聚态材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数值模拟，作者发现在中间维度（d = 3, 4, 5, 6）下，整数分拆的渐近增长率严格快于 MacMahon 数的对应渐近系数。具体给出了各维度的对数分拆数主项系数（如 d=3 时为 1.8196 ± 0.0019），这些数值均大于 MacMahon 系数的对应值（如 d=3 时为 1.7898）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数值模拟，作者发现在中间维度（d = 3, 4, 5, 6）下，整数分拆的渐近增长率严格快于 MacMahon 数的对应渐近系数。具体给出了各维度的对数分拆数主项系数（如 d=3 时为 1.8196 ± 0.0019），这些数值均大于 MacMahon 系数的对应值（如 d=3 时为 1.7898）。；创新点：该工作填补了此前已知结果（d ≥ 7 时增长率快于 MacMahon 数，d = 1,2 时与 MacMahon 数一致）之间的空白，首次针对中间维度（d = 3,4,5,6）给出了数值证据，表明这些维度下分拆增长率同样超过 MacMahon 数。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用自适应权重学习（adaptive weight learning）结合传统马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）步骤进行数值模拟，模拟规模达到 N = 15000。通过拟合数值数据来估计 log p_d(n) 的渐近展开系数，包括主项及部分次主导项。

papers.title: Holographic zeros and poles from apparent singularities
papers.abstract: We study general holographic fluctuation equations with apparent singularities, and the associated spectral functions. We consider the regime where an apparent singularity approaches the boundary, for which the near-boundary behavior of solutions can be determined via an inner/outer matching type of calculation. Depending on properties of the equation, we find that the merging of an apparent singularity with the boundary may generate either a zero or a pole for the corresponding spectral function. Our results also indicate that the recently introduced holographic product formula still applies in the presence of apparent singularities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“holographic fluctuation equations”“spectral functions”“inner/outer matching type of calculation”等理论推导与解析分析关键词。；研究对象：全息对偶框架下的涨落方程及其谱函数，具体关注具有“表观奇点”（apparent singularities）的方程在边界附近的解析行为。摘要未明确指定具体凝聚态体系，属于全息方法在强关联系统中的应用范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当表观奇点与边界合并时，根据方程性质的不同，对应的谱函数可能产生零点或极点；此外，近期提出的全息乘积公式在存在表观奇点的情况下仍然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当表观奇点与边界合并时，根据方程性质的不同，对应的谱函数可能产生零点或极点；此外，近期提出的全息乘积公式在存在表观奇点的情况下仍然成立。；创新点：首次系统分析了表观奇点与边界合并对谱函数零点/极点结构的影响，并验证了全息乘积公式在该情形下的普适性。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或材料的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶（AdS/CFT）框架，通过内/外匹配（inner/outer matching）类型的渐近分析，研究表观奇点趋近边界时解的近边界行为，并据此推导谱函数的解析结构。

papers.title: Computing with qLDPC Codes by Climbing the Chain Map Hierarchy
papers.abstract: We develop a framework for logical computation with qLDPC codes that places logical Pauli, Clifford, and non-Clifford operations on the same footing. This brings the simple homological description of Pauli logicals to the patchwork landscape of logical Clifford and non-Clifford operations, providing a tool for the discovery of new logical gates. In particular, we define the chain map hierarchy: a family of chain complexes whose homology classes encode logical unitary and code surgery operations at any level of the Clifford hierarchy, precisely analogous to the chain complex description of Pauli logicals. Consequently, intuition for Pauli logicals can be leveraged to discover new logical operations on qLDPC codes. For instance, the familiar ability to deform Pauli logicals with stabilizers---i.e. boundaries of the chain complex---becomes a way to search for constant-depth unitary implementations of (non-)Clifford logical gates. Using this strategy, we discover constant-depth unitary implementations of the full logical Clifford group on any number of blocks of the 2D toric code, including within a single block, and addressable logical CCZ gates on any triple of logical qubits on any number of blocks of the 3D toric code. Beyond manifold codes, we find addressable non-Clifford gates on codes with many encoded qubits. The chain map hierarchy naturally encompasses and extends other constructions of logical gadgets, for instance providing a universal parameterization of cup products. As such, our work provides a unified, useful, and intuitive language for computing with qLDPC codes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“framework”“chain complexes”“homology classes”等数学理论工具，以及“discover”逻辑门操作，属于量子纠错与量子计算的理论研究。；研究对象：量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码上的逻辑计算，特别是逻辑Pauli、Clifford和非Clifford操作，以及2D/3D环面码（toric code）等流形码上的逻辑门实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“链映射层级”（chain map hierarchy）框架，将逻辑Pauli、Clifford和非Clifford操作统一在同调描述中，并据此发现了2D环面码上任意块数（含单块内）完整逻辑Clifford群的常深度幺正实现，以及3D环面码上任意三重逻辑量子比特上的可寻址逻辑CCZ门。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“链映射层级”（chain map hierarchy）框架，将逻辑Pauli、Clifford和非Clifford操作统一在同调描述中，并据此发现了2D环面码上任意块数（含单块内）完整逻辑Clifford群的常深度幺正实现，以及3D环面码上任意三重逻辑量子比特上的可寻址逻辑CCZ门。；创新点：首次将逻辑Pauli操作的简单同调描述推广到Clifford和非Clifford逻辑操作，建立了统一的链映射层级语言；利用稳定子形变搜索常深度非Clifford逻辑门，发现了环面码上新的逻辑门实现，并提供了杯积（cup product）的普适参数化。摘要未突出说明与其他具体构造方案的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用代数拓扑与同调代数方法，具体包括链复形、同调类、链映射层级、稳定子形变（即链复形边界）搜索策略，以及常深度幺正电路构造。摘要未提及数值模拟或具体算法实现细节。

papers.title: Buckling Prediction for Nonlinear Elastic Beams with Soft Inclusions
papers.abstract: We develop an efficient and accurate multiscale computational framework for predicting the buckling and post-buckling behaviour of elastic beams containing periodically distributed soft inclusions. The framework extends our previous multiscale, patch, computational homogenisation for linear elasticity by incorporating nonlinearity, and thus enables accurate prediction of both the buckling onset and the subsequent post-buckling response. Microscale computations are performed only within a sparse set of small subdomains (patches), while the macroscale behaviour is recovered through a proven patch-coupling algorithm. The scheme is assessed through quarter- and half-domain patch computations for beams with inclusion-to-matrix Young's modulus ratios ranging from 0.001 to 1. The results show that reducing the inclusion stiffness lowers both the critical buckling strain and the critical buckling stress, indicating an increased susceptibility to instability, while producing a milder post-buckling response with smaller transverse deflections and stress drops. Eigenvalue analysis of the Jacobian matrix accurately predicts the onset of instability and the corresponding critical strain and stress. Bifurcation diagrams of the nonlinear buckled configurations under compressive loading, and a quantitative analysis of the effect of the interpolation order on the predicted buckling and post-buckling responses, are also presented. Comparisons with full-domain simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework accurately predicts both the buckling threshold and the post-buckling behaviour while substantially reducing the computational cost. The methodology is readily extendable to heterogeneous beams, plates, shells, and other engineering structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“multiscale computational framework”“microscale computations”“eigenvalue analysis”等关键词，属于计算/数值模拟研究。；研究对象：含周期性软夹杂的非线性弹性梁，具体研究其在压缩载荷下的屈曲（buckling）与后屈曲（post-buckling）行为，夹杂与基体杨氏模量比范围为0.001至1。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 降低夹杂刚度会同时降低临界屈曲应变和临界屈曲应力（即更易失稳），但后屈曲响应更平缓，横向挠度和应力降更小；所提出的多尺度框架能准确预测屈曲阈值及后屈曲行为，同时大幅降低计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：降低夹杂刚度会同时降低临界屈曲应变和临界屈曲应力（即更易失稳），但后屈曲响应更平缓，横向挠度和应力降更小；所提出的多尺度框架能准确预测屈曲阈值及后屈曲行为，同时大幅降低计算成本。；创新点：将先前针对线弹性材料的patch计算均匀化方法扩展至非线性领域，从而能同时预测屈曲起始与后屈曲响应；该方法可推广至异质梁、板、壳及其他工程结构。摘要未突出说明与已有非线性屈曲计算方法相比的其他具体创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用多尺度“patch”计算均匀化框架，在稀疏小域（patches）内进行微观尺度计算，通过patch耦合算法恢复宏观行为；对Jacobian矩阵进行特征值分析以预测失稳起始及临界应变/应力；绘制分叉图分析非线性屈曲构型；与全域模拟对比验证精度，并分析插值阶数的影响。

papers.title: Unraveling the PFAS helix: A statistical approach
papers.abstract: The extreme persistence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in the environment is rooted in their three-dimensional molecular conformation. The helical twist adopted by perfluoroalkyl chains due to hyperconjugation involving their recalcitrant C-F bonds governs their resistance to degradation, yet a quantitative, continuous metric for helicity has remained absent. Here we introduce a data-driven framework that quantifies backbone helicity using three statistical descriptors: void-state (binary occupancy) spatial autocorrelations, local backbone principal component analysis, and persistent homology. We further validate each statistical descriptor against geometric dihedral benchmarks and DFT-calculated Vibrational Circular Dichroism (VCD) spectra. The framework is initially established on a homologous series of perfluorocarboxylic acids (FC2 through FC16) and their hydrogenated analogues, then extended across perfluorosulfonic acids, fluorotelomer alcohols, polyfluoroalkyl hexanoic acid analogues, and longer-chain PFOA and PFOS analogues. Agreement between statistical, geometric, and spectroscopic definitions of helicity is established for PFCAs and extended to structurally distinct subfamilies, including PFOA analogues of varying fluorine content and perfluorosulfonic acids, demonstrating that the descriptors are robust to changes in headgroup chemistry and fluorine substitution pattern. The framework provides a chemistry-agnostic toolset for incorporating backbone conformation into predictive models of PFAS environmental fate and degradation reactivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“data-driven framework”“DFT-calculated Vibrational Circular Dichroism (VCD) spectra”“statistical descriptors”等，以计算模拟与统计分析为主，未涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的分子骨架螺旋构象（helical twist），具体包括全氟羧酸（FC2–FC16）、全氟磺酸、氟调聚醇、多氟己酸类似物以及更长链的PFOA和PFOS类似物。物理现象为全氟烷基链因C–F键超共轭效应而采取的螺旋扭转及其与降解抗性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作提出了一套基于统计描述符的量化框架，能够连续、定量地描述PFAS骨架的螺旋性，并证明这些描述符与几何二面角基准及DFT计算的VCD光谱在多种PFAS亚家族中一致，且对头基化学和氟取代模式具有鲁棒性，从而为将骨架构象纳入PFAS环境归趋与降解反应性预测提供了工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作提出了一套基于统计描述符的量化框架，能够连续、定量地描述PFAS骨架的螺旋性，并证明这些描述符与几何二面角基准及DFT计算的VCD光谱在多种PFAS亚家族中一致，且对头基化学和氟取代模式具有鲁棒性，从而为将骨架构象纳入PFAS环境归趋与降解反应性预测提供了工具。；创新点：首次为PFAS全氟烷基链的螺旋性提供了定量、连续且化学无关（chemistry-agnostic）的统计度量指标，填补了此前缺乏连续螺旋性度量的空白，并系统验证了该度量在不同头基化学和氟取代模式下的稳健性。
papers.method_zh: 采用三种统计描述符：1）空态（二元占据）空间自相关；2）局部骨架主成分分析（PCA）；3）持久同调（persistent homology）。每种描述符均与几何二面角基准及DFT计算的振动圆二色（VCD）光谱进行交叉验证。框架先在直链全氟羧酸同系物及其氢化类似物上建立，再推广至其他PFAS亚家族。

papers.title: Repairing PBE-Spurious Metallicity for HSE06-Level Screening of 2D Photocatalysts for Green Hydrogen Production
papers.abstract: Semilocal PBE calculations can remove viable photocatalysts before screening by labeling narrow-gap semiconductors as metals. We address this failure mode in the Computational 2D Materials Database (C2DB) by combining leakage-aware repair of PBE-spurious metallicity with HSE06--PBE $Δ$-learning. Stage~I classifies HSE06-unknown PBE metals using structural, chemical, magnetic, and stability descriptors, while excluding HSE06/GW quantities and PBE electronic shortcuts. Stage~II learns $E_g^{HSE} - E_g^{PBE}$ for the corrected insulating population. The curated XGBoost regressor reconstructs HSE06 gaps with a mean absolute error of 0.108~eV ($R^2=0.989$), compared with 1.036~eV for raw PBE. The Stage~I classifier is used only for triage because the labeled true-metal class contains 29 materials; its best holdout performance gives 87.5\% accuracy, 0.286 true-metal recall, and 0.643 balanced accuracy. The corrected pH~0 electronic screen yields 10 strict and 29 initial relaxed green-hydrogen photocatalyst candidates. Four strict and 18 relaxed candidates would fail the same 1.6--2.8~eV gap window at the PBE level. Targeted VASP HSE06 calculations for six ML-predicted compounds give material-level MAEs of 0.417, 0.182, and 0.110~eV for the C2DB-native, Magpie+structural, and curated models, respectively; \feat{1AgBr-1} shifts above the upper gap cutoff, leaving 28 retained relaxed candidates. The workflow shows that high-fidelity correction must be evaluated by candidate membership, not only by global regression error.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数据库（C2DB）、机器学习模型（XGBoost）、DFT计算（PBE、HSE06、GW）及VASP计算，均为计算/数据驱动方法。；研究对象：二维光催化材料，用于绿色制氢；具体关注C2DB数据库中因PBE半局域泛函误差被误判为金属的窄带隙半导体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合“泄漏感知修复”与HSE06–PBE Δ-学习，可有效修复PBE对二维光催化剂的虚假金属性误判，使带隙预测精度从PBE的MAE 1.036 eV提升至0.108 eV，并筛选出28个保留的放宽绿色制氢光催化剂候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合“泄漏感知修复”与HSE06–PBE Δ-学习，可有效修复PBE对二维光催化剂的虚假金属性误判，使带隙预测精度从PBE的MAE 1.036 eV提升至0.108 eV，并筛选出28个保留的放宽绿色制氢光催化剂候选材料。；创新点：针对PBE将窄带隙半导体误判为金属这一筛选失效模式，提出“泄漏感知修复”策略，将分类器仅用于分流（triage）而非最终判定；强调高保真修正需以候选材料成员资格（而非仅全局回归误差）为评估标准。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 两阶段机器学习工作流：Stage I使用结构、化学、磁性及稳定性描述符（排除HSE06/GW量和PBE电子结构捷径）对HSE06未知的PBE金属进行分类；Stage II对修正后的绝缘体群体学习HSE06与PBE带隙差（Δ-学习）。采用XGBoost回归器，并辅以VASP HSE06验证计算。比较了C2DB原生、Magpie+结构及精选三种特征模型。

papers.title: Relaxation effects on Hartree-Fock ground states in twisted bilayer graphene at even integer fillings
papers.abstract: A standard approach for studying magic angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG)'s correlated electronic phase diagram is to project the Coulomb interaction down to effective models only involving electrons in single-particle flat bands and some nearby remote bands. We provide a novel systematic derivation of a single-particle continuum model of MATBG's single-particle properties which incorporates structural relaxation while remaining in the Lagrangian frame. We project the Coulomb interactions down to electrons occupying the flat bands of this model and compute the Hartree-Fock many-body ground states at fillings $ν= \pm 2$. We find that incorporating relaxation effects drives the model into a semi-metallic phase at $- 2$ because of particle-hole asymmetry in the relaxed model's single-particle dispersion and because the flat band wavefunctions become more concentrated leading to an enhanced Hartree potential. Our results corroborate recent ab initio density functional theory studies which also found semi-metallic phases at $-2$. We discuss potential explanations for why such phases have not been seen in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“systematic derivation”“compute the Hartree-Fock many-body ground states”等理论推导与数值计算关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）在偶数整数填充（ν = ±2）下的关联电子基态，特别是结构弛豫对其单粒子性质与多体基态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ν = -2填充下，考虑结构弛豫效应后，模型进入半金属相，而非实验上通常预期的关联绝缘相。该结果与近期从头算密度泛函理论（DFT）研究一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ν = -2填充下，考虑结构弛豫效应后，模型进入半金属相，而非实验上通常预期的关联绝缘相。该结果与近期从头算密度泛函理论（DFT）研究一致。；创新点：提供了一种在拉格朗日坐标系中系统纳入结构弛豫的单粒子连续模型推导方法，并首次在该框架下评估弛豫效应对Hartree-Fock基态的影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 在拉格朗日框架下系统推导了包含结构弛豫的MATBG单粒子连续模型；将库仑相互作用投影到该模型的平带子空间；采用Hartree-Fock方法计算ν = ±2填充下的多体基态。

papers.title: First Principle Analysis of the Magnetism and Electronic Structure of Fe2XSi (X=Ti, V)
papers.abstract: The electronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of Fe2XSi, where X is titanium (Ti) and vanadium (V), are investigated using computational methods. Volume optimization reveals that the ground state of Fe2TiSi is a nonmagnetic narrow-band gap semiconductor, and that of Fe2VSi is a ferrimagnetic metal. The negative formation energies of both materials confirm the stability of their crystal structures. Mechanical properties confirm the static stability of the crystal structure and suggest that the titanium compound is ductile; however, the vanadium material is brittle. Density of states and band structure studies confirm the nonmagnetic semiconducting nature with an indirect band gap at Γ and X for the titanium material and the ferrimagnetic-metallic nature of the vanadium material. Electronic and magnetic properties of the materials were investigated with applied tension (negative pressure) and compression (positive pressure) to the crystal structure. The pressure study on Fe2TiSi shows a tunable band gap and a possible semiconductor-metal transition, and Fe2VSi shows a tunable magnetic moment and a possible low-spin/high-spin magnetic transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“computational methods”“First Principle Analysis”“Density of states and band structure studies”等关键词。；研究对象：Heusler合金体系Fe₂XSi（X=Ti, V）的电子结构、磁性与力学性质，以及外加压力（拉伸与压缩）对其电子和磁性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe₂TiSi为无磁窄带隙半导体（Γ与X点间间接带隙），Fe₂VSi为亚铁磁金属；两者形成能均为负，结构稳定。压力可调控Fe₂TiSi的带隙并可能诱导半导体-金属转变，对Fe₂VSi可调控磁矩并可能诱导低自旋/高自旋磁转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe₂TiSi为无磁窄带隙半导体（Γ与X点间间接带隙），Fe₂VSi为亚铁磁金属；两者形成能均为负，结构稳定。压力可调控Fe₂TiSi的带隙并可能诱导半导体-金属转变，对Fe₂VSi可调控磁矩并可能诱导低自旋/高自旋磁转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论），包括体积优化、形成能计算、力学性质（弹性常数）分析、态密度与能带结构计算，以及对晶体结构施加负压（拉伸）和正压（压缩）的模拟研究。

papers.title: AlterSeeK-Path: Systematic construction of generalized band-structure paths for displaying altermagnetic spin splitting
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic materials exhibit spin splitting in their electronic band structures while maintaining zero net magnetization. However, conventional high-symmetry k-paths generally hide this splitting because they follow symmetry lines that in most cases enforce spin degeneracy. We present AlterSeeK-Path, an open-source Python tool that systematically constructs generalized band-structure paths for collinear altermagnets. The method selects the centroid of the conventional irreducible wedge used in routine band-structure calculations as the representative general k-point, maps it to a spin-flip-related partner, and inserts paired segments through these points into the standard high-symmetry path; these segments systematically sample the interior of the irreducible wedge. We demonstrate the construction for all 54 three-dimensional combinations of extended Bravais lattice type and spin Laue group across the six crystal systems that support collinear altermagnetism, and for the 12 two-dimensional cases spanning the four compatible two-dimensional Bravais lattices. Representative band structures are shown for the distinct lattice/path cases. With AlterSeeK-Path, these band structures can be constructed with essentially the same effort as conventional band structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Python tool”“systematically constructs”“demonstrate the construction”，属于计算方法开发与验证，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：交替磁体（altermagnets）的电子能带结构，具体关注其自旋劈裂（spin splitting）在常规高对称k路径中被隐藏的问题。研究对象涵盖三维54种（扩展布拉伐格子类型×自旋Laue群组合）及二维12种（四种二维布拉伐格子）共线交替磁体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种系统化构建广义能带路径的方法，使得交替磁体的自旋劈裂能够在能带图中被直接展示，且构建成本与常规能带计算基本相同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种系统化构建广义能带路径的方法，使得交替磁体的自旋劈裂能够在能带图中被直接展示，且构建成本与常规能带计算基本相同。；创新点：首次提出针对交替磁体自旋劈裂的系统化广义能带路径构建方案，解决了常规高对称路径因对称性约束而强制自旋简并、无法显示交替磁劈裂的问题。该方法以开源工具形式提供，且构建成本与常规能带路径相当。
papers.method_zh: 开发了开源Python工具AlterSeeK-Path。方法核心步骤为：选取常规能带计算所用不可约布里渊区楔形（irreducible wedge）的质心作为代表性一般k点，将其映射到自旋翻转（spin-flip）关联的伙伴k点，并将这对k点之间的线段插入标准高对称路径中，从而系统采样楔形内部区域。论文对所有支持共线交替磁性的三维晶体系统（54种组合）和二维情况（12种）进行了路径构建演示，并展示了代表性能带结构。

papers.title: Emergence of the magnetic octupole Rashba-Edelstein effect from spin-orbit entanglement
papers.abstract: Magnetic multipoles have attracted growing interest as order parameters and dynamical degrees of freedom in unconventional magnets, yet it remains unclear how broadly they can emerge as active electronic degrees of freedom. Here, we show that spin-orbit-entangled multiorbital states can host magnetic octupole (MO) degrees of freedom. In Rashba systems, this gives rise to an MO Rashba texture accompanying the J-Rashba texture. Remarkably, spin-orbital entanglement can realize a pure-MO limit in which the spin and orbital-angular-momentum textures vanish while the MO texture remains finite. An applied electric field converts this texture into a nonequilibrium MO polarization through an MO Rashba-Edelstein effect. Around the pure-MO regime, the MO Edelstein response dominates over the conventional spin response, showing that multipolar responses need not be small corrections to dipolar spin physics. Our results establish an interface-based route for electrically generating nonequilibrium multipolar magnetic polarization in spin-orbit-coupled systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“we show that”“can realize”“our results establish”等理论推导与预言性表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算细节。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合的多轨道电子体系，具体聚焦于Rashba系统中的磁八极（MO）自由度及其电场响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态可承载磁八极自由度，在Rashba系统中形成伴随J-Rashba纹理的MO Rashba纹理；在纯MO极限下，自旋与轨道角动量纹理消失而MO纹理仍存，电场可经MO Rashba-Edelstein效应产生非平衡MO极化，且该响应在纯MO附近可超越传统自旋响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态可承载磁八极自由度，在Rashba系统中形成伴随J-Rashba纹理的MO Rashba纹理；在纯MO极限下，自旋与轨道角动量纹理消失而MO纹理仍存，电场可经MO Rashba-Edelstein效应产生非平衡MO极化，且该响应在纯MO附近可超越传统自旋响应。；创新点：首次提出磁八极可作为主动电子自由度在Rashba系统中产生可电控的非平衡多极极化，并证明多极响应不必是偶极自旋物理的小修正，开辟了基于界面的多极磁性电学调控新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道模型与Rashba系统对称性分析，推导MO纹理与电场诱导的MO极化响应（摘要未明确说明具体形式如k·p微扰或群论方法）。

papers.title: Systematic display of the spin splitting in band structures of representative altermagnetic crystals
papers.abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. We report the band structure and symmetry analysis for MnTe, CrSb, SmFeO3, ScCrO3, LaMnO3, TlCrO3, HoFeO3, InCrO3 and DyFeO3. This result clearly demonstrates the advantage of this novel method for displaying the spin splitting of collinear altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“band structure and symmetry analysis”（能带结构与对称性分析），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：多种共线交错磁（altermagnetic）晶体材料，包括MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3，研究其能带结构中的自旋劈裂特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种在布里渊区一般k点路径上绘制能带结构的新方法，能够系统展示共线交错磁体特有的自旋劈裂；而传统沿高对称点/线绘制能带的方法在许多情况下完全无法显示这种劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种在布里渊区一般k点路径上绘制能带结构的新方法，能够系统展示共线交错磁体特有的自旋劈裂；而传统沿高对称点/线绘制能带的方法在许多情况下完全无法显示这种劈裂。；创新点：首次提出用采样一般k点（而非高对称点）的能带绘图方式来展示交错磁自旋劈裂，解决了传统能带绘图可能完全遗漏交错磁自旋劈裂的问题，并在九种材料中系统验证了该方法的优势。
papers.method_zh: 能带结构计算与对称性分析（具体计算方法如DFT等，摘要未明确说明）；对比了传统高对称路径绘图与新提出的“一般k点采样路径”绘图方法。

papers.title: Relating solute interactions to interfacial properties
papers.abstract: Liquid interfaces are both ubiquitous and also critically important for many commercial products, modern technologies, biological processes, and environmental phenomena. The properties of these interfaces can depend quite sensitively upon the composition of the bulk liquid phase. In this work, we develop a dilute solution theory (DST) for the influence of dilute cosolutes upon the interface between coexisting liquid and vapor phases. We employ a grand canonical perturbation theory to rigorously relate the interfacial free energy to the concentration of the liquid solution. We leverage a corresponding Gibbs ensemble to treat liquid-vapor coexistence and to eliminate the contribution of the bulk phases from this free energy. We express the coefficients of the resulting expansion in terms of microscopic partition functions. By treating solute-solute interactions to lowest order, we distinguish between the intrinsic and effective interfacial preferences of solutes. While the former reflects only solute-solvent interactions, the latter depends upon the solution composition and reflects the influence of solute-solute interactions. We assess this DST with molecular dynamics simulations of binary and ternary mixtures of Lennard-Jones spheres. These simulations demonstrate that DST accurately models the interfacial properties of these systems up to relatively high concentrations. Moreover, the simulations illustrate the impact of attractive solute-solute interactions in converting weak intrinsic surfactants into weak effective depletants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章，辅以分子动力学模拟验证。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a dilute solution theory (DST)”“grand canonical perturbation theory”，属于理论推导；同时“assess this DST with molecular dynamics simulations”表明包含计算模拟验证，因此为理论+计算的混合类型。；研究对象：液-汽共存界面，具体为稀溶质（二元和三元Lennard-Jones球混合物）对液体-蒸气界面性质的影响，包括界面自由能、溶质的表面活性/耗尽行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 溶质-溶质相互作用可将弱的内在表面活性剂转变为弱的有效耗尽剂（depletant），即溶质的有效界面偏好依赖于溶液组成，而不仅取决于其与溶剂的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：溶质-溶质相互作用可将弱的内在表面活性剂转变为弱的有效耗尽剂（depletant），即溶质的有效界面偏好依赖于溶液组成，而不仅取决于其与溶剂的相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：通过将溶质-溶质相互作用纳入最低阶处理，严格区分了溶质的“内在”界面偏好（仅由溶质-溶剂相互作用决定）与“有效”界面偏好（依赖溶液组成并受溶质-溶质相互作用影响），并系统验证了该理论在较高浓度下的适用性。
papers.method_zh: 采用巨正则系综微扰理论（grand canonical perturbation theory）推导稀溶液理论（DST），将界面自由能展开为溶液浓度的函数，并用对应的Gibbs系综处理液-汽共存以扣除体相贡献；系数以微观配分函数表达。随后用Lennard-Jones球的二元和三元混合物的分子动力学（MD）模拟验证该理论的准确性。

papers.title: Magnetoelectric Phase Transition and Axion Dynamics
papers.abstract: Magnetoelectric phase transitions have been experimentally studied, but no macroscopic theory has been proposed to explain their dynamical origin. In this work, we assume that the axion quasiparticle with frequency undergoes a condensation like process. We show that these magnetoelectric phase transitions can be described within a Ginzbur Landau framework by introducing a coupled dynamic parameter, the axion angle, which is proportional to the magnetoelectric coeffcient. We derive relations between the static axion angle, the axion frequency, and the phase transition temperature for different magnetoelectric materials, respectively, and compare these calculations with existing experimental results. We also connect the artificially designed Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction with the axion condensate like process, so that the relation between the static axion angle and the experimentally measured frequency shift can be obtained.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提出“no macroscopic theory has been proposed”，并采用Ginzburg-Landau框架进行理论描述，属于唯象理论建模。；研究对象：磁电相变及其动力学起源，具体涉及磁电材料中的轴子（axion）准粒子凝聚过程，以及人工设计的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁电相变可被描述为轴子准粒子的凝聚过程，在Ginzburg-Landau框架下引入与磁电系数成正比的动态参数——轴子角，即可统一描述此类相变；并建立了静态轴子角、轴子频率与相变温度之间的定量关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁电相变可被描述为轴子准粒子的凝聚过程，在Ginzburg-Landau框架下引入与磁电系数成正比的动态参数——轴子角，即可统一描述此类相变；并建立了静态轴子角、轴子频率与相变温度之间的定量关系。；创新点：首次提出磁电相变的宏观动力学理论（此前仅有实验研究而无宏观理论解释），将轴子准粒子凝聚过程与磁电相变统一在Ginzburg-Landau框架内，并建立了与实验可测物理量（相变温度、频移）的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ginzburg-Landau唯象理论框架，引入耦合动态参数（轴子角）描述相变；推导静态轴子角、轴子频率与相变温度的关系式，并与已有实验结果进行对比；将人工Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与轴子凝聚过程建立联系，从而获得静态轴子角与实验可测频移的关系。

papers.title: Understanding Graphene-Perovskite Interactions: From Flake Chemistry to Crystallisation and Solar Cell Performance
papers.abstract: Graphene-derivatives are widely employed materials to improve bulk and interface properties of metal-halide perovskite devices. Yet the implications of their flake chemistry and interactions with the perovskite precursors remain unclear. Here, we show that pristine graphene flakes (GF) and more conventional graphene oxide flakes (GOF) are not interchangeable. Density functional theory calculations reveal that GOF interacts more strongly with the perovskite lattice but induces larger structural distortions, stronger interfacial polarisation, and localised gap states. In contrast, GF forms comparatively non-disruptive contacts, a response retained across a wide compositional range. Machine-learning atomistic simulations further show that GF contacts both Pb- and I-containing regions of solvated perovskite nanocrystals, with a strong solvent dependency. Solution spectroscopic characterization indicates that GF additives serve as scaffold for preorganised Pb/I-containing precursors, favouring film crystallisation. In this sense, GF enhances solar cell performance across perovskite compositions, but particularly those facing a more challenging crystallisation. In mixed Sn-Pb perovskite solar cells, GF raises the champion power-conversion efficiency from 21.5\% to 23.7\% with improved storage stability. These results establish pristine GF as a chemically defined additive and connect its atomic-scale interactions with precursor organisation, crystallisation, device performance, and stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Density functional theory calculations”“Machine-learning atomistic simulations”等计算手段，以及“Solution spectroscopic characterization”“solar cell performance”等实验表征与器件测试。；研究对象：石墨烯衍生物（原始石墨烯薄片 GF 与氧化石墨烯薄片 GOF）与金属卤化物钙钛矿（含混合 Sn-Pb 钙钛矿）之间的界面相互作用，及其对钙钛矿前驱体组织、薄膜结晶和太阳能电池性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始石墨烯薄片（GF）与氧化石墨烯薄片（GOF）在钙钛矿体系中不可互换：GOF 与钙钛矿晶格作用更强但引起更大结构畸变和界面极化，而 GF 形成非破坏性接触，可作为 Pb/I 前驱体的预组织支架促进结晶，从而提升钙钛矿太阳能电池效率（混合 Sn-Pb 体系冠军效率从 21.5% 提升至 23.7%）并改善存储稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始石墨烯薄片（GF）与氧化石墨烯薄片（GOF）在钙钛矿体系中不可互换：GOF 与钙钛矿晶格作用更强但引起更大结构畸变和界面极化，而 GF 形成非破坏性接触，可作为 Pb/I 前驱体的预组织支架促进结晶，从而提升钙钛矿太阳能电池效率（混合 Sn-Pb 体系冠军效率从 21.5% 提升至 23.7%）并改善存储稳定性。；创新点：首次系统揭示原始石墨烯薄片（GF）与氧化石墨烯薄片（GOF）在钙钛矿体系中不可互换的化学本质，将 GF 的原子尺度相互作用与其对前驱体预组织、薄膜结晶、器件效率和稳定性的影响建立直接关联，确立 GF 作为一种化学定义明确的添加剂。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算（用于评估 GF/GOF 与钙钛矿晶格的相互作用、结构畸变、界面极化和局域隙态）；机器学习原子模拟（用于研究 GF 与溶剂化钙钛矿纳米晶中 Pb/I 区域的接触及溶剂依赖性）；溶液光谱表征（用于分析前驱体组织）；钙钛矿太阳能电池器件制备与效率/稳定性测试。

papers.title: QArray+: A physics-informed GPU-accelerated simulator for quantum dot arrays
papers.abstract: Semiconductor quantum-dot arrays are a compelling platform for scalable quantum technologies, yet their practical operation is hindered by the complexity of tuning large-scale devices. Existing automation tools rely on simplified physical models---such as constant-capacitance approximations and equilibrium Hubbard models---which assume instantaneous relaxation to a steady state. These frameworks fail in experimentally critical regimes where measurement rates exceed tunneling dynamics, necessitating more sophisticated non-equilibrium control strategies. To bridge this gap, we introduce QArray+, an extension of the QArray framework that incorporates gate-dependent tunnel coupling and a quantum open-system description of dissipative processes. This approach enables the unified simulation of coherent interdot charge-state hybridization and the non-equilibrium latching dynamics essential for training robust machine-learning models for automated device operation. Implemented in JAX with GPU acceleration, QArray+ scales across GPUs and multi-node systems. For example, a charge stability diagram for a 100X100 grid of gate voltages over 64 dots can be computed in $\sim0.17\,\mathrm{s}$ on multiple GPUs. Since interdot interactions are short-ranged and the corresponding tuning corrections are local, simulations at these scales capture the physics relevant to even larger devices. These capabilities support high-throughput dataset generation for automated device tuning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述开发了GPU加速模拟器（QArray+），基于物理模型进行数值模拟，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：半导体量子点阵列（quantum-dot arrays），具体关注其电荷态调控、相干隧穿耦合与非平衡动力学过程，面向大规模器件自动调谐应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: QArray+通过引入栅极依赖的隧穿耦合和量子开放系统耗散描述，能够统一模拟相干电荷态杂化与非平衡锁存（latching）动力学，弥补了现有简化模型在测量速率超过隧穿动力学时失效的缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：QArray+通过引入栅极依赖的隧穿耦合和量子开放系统耗散描述，能够统一模拟相干电荷态杂化与非平衡锁存（latching）动力学，弥补了现有简化模型在测量速率超过隧穿动力学时失效的缺陷。；创新点：首次在量子点阵列模拟中同时纳入栅极依赖隧穿耦合与非平衡耗散过程，实现相干杂化与锁存动力学的统一模拟；利用JAX实现高效GPU并行，可在约0.17秒内计算64个点、100×100栅压网格的电荷稳定性图，支持大规模数据集生成以训练自动调谐机器学习模型。
papers.method_zh: 基于物理的数值模拟：扩展QArray框架，加入栅极依赖隧穿耦合和开放量子系统耗散模型；采用JAX实现GPU加速，支持多GPU和多节点并行计算。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如张量网络、量子主方程等）的细节。

papers.title: Twist as a Mechanical Switch for Reconfigurable Stacking in h-BN
papers.abstract: Twistronics of layered materials has emerged as a highly active field due to its profound implications for quantum electronics and materials engineering. However, the controllable manipulation of interlayer stacking remains a significant experimental challenge. Here, the homogeneous contact between hexagonal boron nitride layers is shown to be reproducibly switched between two distinct stable stacking configurations via an externally applied torque. Combining experiments and computational modelling, we identify the stacking order of these stable states as the commensurate AA and AB modes. These two states are associated with different rotational torque maxima, exhibiting an asymmetry ratio of 0.7, and distinct dynamics as a function of the twist angle. Moreover, the peak torque values scale linearly with contact area, highlighting the dominant role of edge elasticity in the twisting process. Given that the AA and AB stacking modes correspond to different out-of-plane electric polarization states, our findings offer a pathway for reconfigurable nano- and micro-electromechanical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算建模）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Combining experiments and computational modelling”。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（h-BN）同质层间接触体系，具体研究外加扭矩调控下双层h-BN的堆叠构型切换行为及其力学与电学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过外加扭矩，可在h-BN层间可重复地实现AA与AB两种稳定堆叠构型之间的机械切换；两种构型对应不同的旋转扭矩峰值（不对称比0.7）和随扭转角变化的动力学行为，且峰值扭矩与接触面积呈线性关系，表明边缘弹性主导扭转过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过外加扭矩，可在h-BN层间可重复地实现AA与AB两种稳定堆叠构型之间的机械切换；两种构型对应不同的旋转扭矩峰值（不对称比0.7）和随扭转角变化的动力学行为，且峰值扭矩与接触面积呈线性关系，表明边缘弹性主导扭转过程。；创新点：首次展示利用“扭转”作为机械开关，在h-BN中实现两种稳定堆叠构型（AA与AB）的可逆、可重复切换，且两种构型对应不同的面外电极化状态，为可重构纳/微机电系统提供了新机制。（摘要未突出说明与以往扭转电子学工作的具体差异。）
papers.method_zh: 实验上施加外部扭矩实现层间堆叠切换并测量扭矩-角度响应；计算上采用建模方法（摘要未具体说明方法名称，如DFT或分子动力学等）识别稳定态的堆叠序（AA与AB模式），并分析扭矩峰值与接触面积的标度关系。

papers.title: Optimal-work feedback on particles with activity --- gliding on active fluctuations using positional information
papers.abstract: We study the minimum-work feedback control of particles subject to active fluctuations. Considering an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle confined by a moving harmonic trap, we derive exact optimal protocols following an initial position measurement. Our results show that nonequilibrium correlations between position and active fluctuations allow work extraction from the activity based on positional information only, i.e., without directly measuring the active degree of freedom, which was the focus of earlier literature. We find that depending on the persistence time, activity can either facilitate or impede transport relative to passive systems. Surprisingly, unlike feedback schemes based on direct measurements of the active fluctuations, positional feedback remains energetically advantageous even in the limit of infinitely persistent activity. Our results provide design principles for information engines and optimal control strategies operating in active environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。摘要中明确提到“derive exact optimal protocols”，属于解析理论推导，无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：受活性噪声驱动的粒子（active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle），被移动谐振子势阱约束，研究基于初始位置测量的最小功反馈控制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅利用位置信息即可从活性涨落中提取功，无需直接测量活性自由度；且当活性持久时间趋于无穷时，基于位置的反馈仍具有能量优势，而基于直接测量活性涨落的反馈方案则不具备这一优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅利用位置信息即可从活性涨落中提取功，无需直接测量活性自由度；且当活性持久时间趋于无穷时，基于位置的反馈仍具有能量优势，而基于直接测量活性涨落的反馈方案则不具备这一优势。；创新点：以往文献聚焦于直接测量活性自由度（活性涨落）的反馈方案，本工作证明仅凭位置测量即可利用位置与活性涨落之间的非平衡关联实现功提取，并揭示了持久时间对输运促进/阻碍作用的非单调影响。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导最优反馈协议：对活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子在移动谐振子势阱中的动力学，求解给定初始位置测量条件下的最小功精确最优协议。

papers.title: From Goldene to Noblene: exhaustive enumeration of the ordered Au-Ag-Cu monolayer alloys
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional metals became a laboratory reality with the isolation of Goldene, a gold sheet one atom thick released by chemical exfoliation, which raises the question of what alloying can achieve on the same close-packed lattice. Here we combine an exhaustive enumeration of derivative superstructures with density functional theory to map the ordered Au-Ag-Cu monolayer alloys, relaxing every symmetry-inequivalent arrangement up to four atoms per cell and extending the set with larger cells selected by a fitted model. We find that the arrangement of the atoms, and not their proportion, controls the mixing energy, since the spread among the orderings of a single composition is several times the step between neighboring compositions, one composition spans more than 50~meV/atom between two arrangements of the same three atoms, and at two compositions the arrangement decides the sign. The energetics is carried by a competition between Au-Cu contacts, which bind, and Ag-Cu contacts, which do not, and bulk enthalpies computed under the same protocol show that this chemistry is not uniformly rescaled in two dimensions, since Au-Cu orders more strongly in the monolayer than in the crystal while the other two weaken. A pair model completed by an elastic size-mismatch term reproduces the computed energies to a few meV/atom and returns a composition landscape whose convex hull no balanced ternary composition reaches. One equimolar ordering, which we name Noblene, is the only structure in which every atom is surrounded exclusively by unlike species, and it is dynamically stable and metallic, and carries a Poisson's ratio above one half, higher than that of any of the three pure monolayers. Since Noblene sits on the lattice that Goldene already realizes, the route that produced Goldene is a plausible starting point for its synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“结合穷举枚举与密度泛函理论（DFT）”，并涉及“拟合模型”与“计算能量”，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：Au-Ag-Cu 三元单层合金的有序结构，具体为在密排（close-packed）晶格上形成的二维金属合金单层，其母体为实验上已剥离成功的单原子厚金片（Goldene）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Au-Ag-Cu 单层合金中，原子排列方式（而非组分比例）主导混合能；其中一种等摩尔有序结构（命名为 Noblene）是唯一所有原子均被异种原子包围的结构，具有动态稳定性、金属性，且泊松比超过 0.5，高于三种纯金属单层。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Au-Ag-Cu 单层合金中，原子排列方式（而非组分比例）主导混合能；其中一种等摩尔有序结构（命名为 Noblene）是唯一所有原子均被异种原子包围的结构，具有动态稳定性、金属性，且泊松比超过 0.5，高于三种纯金属单层。；创新点：首次系统性地穷举映射 Au-Ag-Cu 三元单层合金的有序相图，揭示了二维限域下原子排列对混合能的决定性作用（同一组分不同排列的能量差可达 50 meV/atom 以上，甚至改变混合能符号）；发现二维与三维体相中 Au-Cu、Ag-Cu 相互作用的化学趋势并非均匀缩放；并预言了具有超低泊松比（>0.5）的稳定有序结构 Noblene，且指出其合成路线可借鉴 Goldene 的化学剥离方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用穷举枚举（exhaustive enumeration）衍生超结构的方法，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）对所有对称不等价排列（每原胞最多 4 个原子）进行结构弛豫与能量计算；对更大原胞结构，则用拟合模型筛选后补充计算。此外，还构建了由成对相互作用模型加上弹性尺寸失配项组成的经验模型，用于复现 DFT 能量并绘制组分-能量凸包图。

papers.title: Response of a Model Glass to Athermal Quasistatic Pinching
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate the mechanical response of amorphous solids to localized force dipoles, referred to as pinching, using athermal quasistatic simulations of model glasses with varying degrees of stability. We employ a control parameter, the imposed extension, corresponding to the increase in rest length between the two pinched particles relative to their initial separation. Increasing this extension allows us to continuously tune the system from the elastic to the plastic regime. For small extensions, the response remains elastic. In this regime, the displacement field induced by pinching is well described by linear elasticity and exhibits a long-range power-law decay consistent with dipolar forcing. Averaged responses display anisotropic, quadrupolar-like patterns, with quantitative agreement between simulations and analytical predictions. This continuum description remains valid down to particle-scale distances. As the imposed extension increases, the response becomes plastic. Pinching can then trigger either localized or system-spanning rearrangements, depending on glass stability. Well-annealed glasses exhibit localized plastic events, whereas poorly annealed systems display delocalized cascades. We introduce a method to extract the principal axis of plastic deformation and analyze the associated displacement fields and plastic activity. Overall, our results demonstrate that pinching provides a minimal local probe of amorphous solids. The resulting response, governed by both glass stability and imposed extension, offers insight into the interplay between elasticity, elementary rearrangements, and the emergence of collective plasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically investigate”“athermal quasistatic simulations of model glasses”。；研究对象：非晶固体（模型玻璃）在局域力偶（pinching，即对两个粒子施加反向拉伸）作用下的力学响应，重点关注不同稳定性（退火程度）玻璃的弹性—塑性转变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 小拉伸下玻璃对局域力偶的响应为弹性，位移场符合线性弹性理论的偶极长程幂律衰减；增大拉伸后响应进入塑性区，稳定玻璃发生局域塑性事件，而不稳定玻璃则出现系统尺度的级联重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：小拉伸下玻璃对局域力偶的响应为弹性，位移场符合线性弹性理论的偶极长程幂律衰减；增大拉伸后响应进入塑性区，稳定玻璃发生局域塑性事件，而不稳定玻璃则出现系统尺度的级联重排。；创新点：首次系统性地将“局域力偶（pinching）”作为非晶固体的最小局域力学探针，揭示了玻璃稳定性与外加形变共同决定响应从弹性到局域塑性再到集体级联的完整图景；并展示了连续弹性描述在粒子尺度下仍然有效。摘要未突出说明与其他局域探针（如局域剪切、点缺陷）相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用无热准静态（athermal quasistatic）剪切/加载模拟，对模型玻璃施加局域力偶（pinching），以两粒子间静止长度的增加量作为控制参数，连续调节系统从弹性到塑性区；并与线性弹性理论解析预测进行定量对比；提出提取塑性变形主轴的方法来分析位移场和塑性活动。

papers.title: Topological Lithography via External Field: Creating Topological States Anywhere Beyond the Edge
papers.abstract: Topological insulators (TIs), recognized for their robust boundary states and unconventional phase transitions, have emerged as one of the most impactful discoveries in recent decades, attracting considerable interest across diverse fields. However, conventional TIs require topological contrasts between adjacent bulk regions, typically achieved by distinct symmetries, which limits their flexibility and broader applicability. In this work, we introduce a "lithography" approach to inducing topological states by applying external fields in time-reversal-symmetric systems. These states transcend the conventional bulk topology design paradigm and offer exceptional tunability: they can exist at geometric edges, within the bulk, or even be induced remotely. Because the external field is highly controllable, the induced states are programmable, reconfigurable, and can be easily tailored into desirable patterns. Theoretically, we demonstrate that the external field modifies the Jackiw-Rebbi mechanism, inducing a real-space topological transition characterized by a local topological marker (LTM). We further establish an extended valley bulk-edge correspondence, which explains both the conventional scenario and our findings. Our results, validated across mechanical, electronic, and acoustic platforms, highlight the broad applicability of this approach to various systems. This work not only advances the theory of topology but also enhances the diversity, tunability, and practical implementation of topological states and materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含多平台数值/实验验证）。判断依据关键词：theoretically demonstrate、validated across mechanical, electronic, and acoustic platforms。；研究对象：时间反演对称系统中由外部场诱导的拓扑态，涵盖力学、电子和声学平台中的拓扑边界态与体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加外部场可在时间反演对称系统中任意位置（几何边缘、体内部、甚至远程区域）诱导出可编程、可重构的拓扑态，突破了传统拓扑绝缘体依赖相邻体区域间对称性对比的设计范式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加外部场可在时间反演对称系统中任意位置（几何边缘、体内部、甚至远程区域）诱导出可编程、可重构的拓扑态，突破了传统拓扑绝缘体依赖相邻体区域间对称性对比的设计范式。；创新点：提出“拓扑光刻”（topological lithography）概念，利用高度可控的外部场实现拓扑态的任意空间图案化，使拓扑态不再局限于几何边缘或依赖体拓扑对比，显著提升拓扑态的可调性与可编程性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为修正的Jackiw-Rebbi机制，引入实空间拓扑转变并定义局域拓扑标记（LTM）；建立了扩展的谷体-边界对应关系（extended valley bulk-edge correspondence）。验证平台包括力学、电子和声学系统（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法或实验技术细节）。

papers.title: Electronic Structure and Superconductivity in La$_{1.55}$Sr$_{0.45}$CuO$_4$/La$_2$CuO$_4$ Artificial High-$T_c$ Superlattices Probed by Hard and Soft X-ray Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In La$_{1.55}$Sr$_{0.45}$CuO$_4$/La$_2$CuO$_4$ (LSCO/LCO) artificial high-$T_c$ superlattices (AHTS), grown by quantum material design, the superconducting dome can be tuned by varying the geometric ratio $L/d$, where $L$ is the LCO layer thickness and $d$ is the superlattice nanoscale period. Here, we combine hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES) and polarization-dependent soft X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to probe how the electronic structure evolves across the $L/d$-tuned superconducting dome. We observe systematic chemical-potential evolution across the series, together with enhanced spectral weight near the Fermi level, enhanced local and non-local screening signatures, and increased in-plane orbital polarization near the top of the dome. Together, these spectroscopic signatures provide insight into the emergence of Fano-Feshbach resonant superconductivity in the LSCO/LCO AHTS series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES)”和“polarization-dependent soft X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS)”等实验手段。；研究对象：人工设计的高温超导超晶格 La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄（LSCO/LCO），重点研究其电子结构随几何参数 L/d（L 为 LCO 层厚度，d 为超晶格纳米周期）调制的超导穹顶的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 LSCO/LCO 人工高温超导超晶格中，随着 L/d 调制的超导穹顶接近顶部，体系表现出系统的化学势移动、费米能级附近谱权重增强、局域与非局域屏蔽特征增强，以及面内轨道极化增大。这些光谱特征共同揭示了该体系中 Fano-Feshbach 共振超导机制的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 LSCO/LCO 人工高温超导超晶格中，随着 L/d 调制的超导穹顶接近顶部，体系表现出系统的化学势移动、费米能级附近谱权重增强、局域与非局域屏蔽特征增强，以及面内轨道极化增大。这些光谱特征共同揭示了该体系中 Fano-Feshbach 共振超导机制的出现。；创新点：首次将 HAXPES 与偏振依赖 XAS 相结合，系统追踪 L/d 调制的超导穹顶中电子结构（化学势、谱权重、屏蔽效应、轨道极化）的连续演化，并将这些光谱特征与 Fano-Feshbach 共振超导机制联系起来。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 硬 X 射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）和偏振依赖的软 X 射线吸收谱（XAS），用于探测电子结构随超导穹顶调制的演化。

papers.title: Liquid-liquid phase transitions in dipolar liquids. Insights into Supercooled Water
papers.abstract: Dipolar liquids combine two coupled degrees of freedom, translational and dipolar.
