Intriguingly, these two sectors can reside in distinct thermodynamic states, with the state of one sector possibly favoring a specific state of the other. The onset of ferroelectric order in dipolar liquids is an example of this mutual stabilization. Since this coupling is often encoded in interaction potentials, projecting out one sector to derive an effective interaction for the other can uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying this phenomenon. A coarse-grained theory in which the distance between nearest-neighbor particles depends on their dipolar interaction through a density-dependent mechanical compliance shows that a ferroelectric transition can trigger a liquid-liquid transition. It also predicts a first-order liquid-liquid transition in the paraelectric phase that can in turn induce ferroelectric ordering. The anisotropic dipolar-dependent soft-core interaction is shown to lead to an effective Jagla-like isotropic two-length-scale interaction, known to support liquid-liquid phase transitions. Here, however, the two-length-scale pattern depends on density and dipolar configuration, becoming sensitive to dipolar order. Analysis of supercooled TIP4P/Ice water numerical simulations shows that first-coordination-shell features of pair correlation functions are sensitive to dipolar interaction, supporting the coarse-grained theory foundations. Comparison of low- and high-density liquid water reveals enhanced spatial anisotropy of the first coordination shell in the low-density liquid, with increased effective excluded volume, showing that the liquid-liquid transition involves structural changes within the first shell, beyond reorganization of the interstitial region and tetrahedral order. These findings point to a role for dipolar interactions in supercooled water liquid-liquid phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟分析）。判断依据：摘要提及“coarse-grained theory”（粗粒化理论）、“numerical simulations”（数值模拟），属于理论建模与模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：偶极液体（dipolar liquids）中的液-液相变，以及其与过冷水（supercooled water，以TIP4P/Ice模型为代表）液-液相变的关联。具体关注平动与偶极取向两个自由度之间的耦合，以及铁电序与液-液相变的相互触发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偶极液体的铁电转变可以触发液-液相变，反之，顺电相中的一级液-液相变也可诱导铁电有序。在过冷水中，低密度液体相比高密度液体，其第一配位壳层表现出更强的空间各向异性和更大的有效排除体积，表明液-液相变涉及第一壳层内的结构变化，而不仅仅是四面体序或间隙区重组。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偶极液体的铁电转变可以触发液-液相变，反之，顺电相中的一级液-液相变也可诱导铁电有序。在过冷水中，低密度液体相比高密度液体，其第一配位壳层表现出更强的空间各向异性和更大的有效排除体积，表明液-液相变涉及第一壳层内的结构变化，而不仅仅是四面体序或间隙区重组。；创新点：提出偶极相互作用通过密度依赖的柔度机制产生有效的各向同性Jagla型双尺度相互作用，且该双尺度模式依赖于密度和偶极构型（即对偶极序敏感），从而将铁电序与液-液相变统一在同一个理论框架内。摘要未突出说明与已有液-液相变理论（如纯Jagla模型）相比的其他新意。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为粗粒化理论，其中最近邻粒子间距通过密度依赖的力学柔度（mechanical compliance）与偶极相互作用耦合。数值模拟采用TIP4P/Ice水模型的分子动力学模拟，分析对关联函数的第一配位壳层特征。摘要未明确说明具体模拟软件或采样方法。

papers.title: Survival in a partially reactive wedge
papers.abstract: We investigate the power-law decay of the survival probability of a Brownian particle diffusing in an infinite planar wedge whose two sides are partially reactive and described by Robin boundary conditions. We employ matched asymptotic analysis to relate the long-time asymptotics to a stationary harmonic Robin problem near the apex. This approach determines the persistence exponent for arbitrary opening angles and yields the prefactor explicitly for the family of wedges with $α=π/n$ ($n=1,2,\ldots$). A simple extension of the apex prefactor to arbitrary angles is conjectured and supported numerically. This asymptotic behavior describes the crossover to the well-known result for perfectly absorbing wedges. As immediate applications, we also deduce the long-time behavior of the probability density function of the boundary local time on wedge sides, as well as the probability density function of the associated first-crossing time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“matched asymptotic analysis”（匹配渐近分析）、“persistence exponent”（持续指数）等理论推导关键词，且无实验或数值模拟方法描述。；研究对象：布朗粒子在无限平面楔形区域中的扩散与存活问题，楔形两侧为部分反应边界（Robin边界条件）。属于随机过程/扩散动力学理论，非具体材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 布朗粒子在部分反应楔形中的存活概率随时间呈幂律衰减，其持续指数由楔角决定；对于α=π/n（n=1,2,…）的楔形族，可显式给出衰减前因子，并推测了任意角度的前因子表达式（经数值支持）。该结果在极限情况下过渡到完全吸收楔形的已知结论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：布朗粒子在部分反应楔形中的存活概率随时间呈幂律衰减，其持续指数由楔角决定；对于α=π/n（n=1,2,…）的楔形族，可显式给出衰减前因子，并推测了任意角度的前因子表达式（经数值支持）。该结果在极限情况下过渡到完全吸收楔形的已知结论。；创新点：首次将部分反应（Robin）边界条件下的楔形存活问题与顶点处调和Robin问题建立联系，给出了任意楔角的持续指数及特定楔角族的显式前因子；并推广到边界局部时间概率密度和首次穿越时间分布的长时间行为。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异点。
papers.method_zh: 匹配渐近分析（matched asymptotic analysis），将长时间渐近行为归结为顶点附近的稳态调和Robin问题；结合数值验证（用于支持对任意角度的前因子猜想）。

papers.title: XPCS-Echo and broad relaxation measurements using a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme
papers.abstract: Echoes observed in the intensity-intensity autocorrelation functions [$g_2(q, τ)$] is a powerful method for probing nonaffine deformations and yielding behavior of soft viscoelastic materials subjected to an oscillatory shear. Multispeckle X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) measurements of large number of echoes with high time resolution impose severe constraints in terms of the computational hardware and potential degradation of the sample. These issues are alleviated by implementing a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme in which the highest resolution frames or bunches centered at the echo peaks. In addition, by placing the bunches in an aperiodic Fibonacci sequence, $g_2(q, τ)$ over a long time span can be measured with orders of magnitude lesser number of frames. The performance of these XPCS acquisition schemes is demonstrated using slowly relaxing model colloidal suspensions. Furthermore, an analytical expression is provided for the quantitative description of full $g_2(q, τ)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验测量方案（XPCS测量）和实验演示（使用模型胶体悬浮液）。；研究对象：软粘弹性材料在振荡剪切下的非仿射形变和屈服行为，具体通过X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS）测量胶体悬浮液的强度-强度自相关函数g₂(q, τ)中的“回声”（echoes）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于束团模式（bunch-mode）的数据采集方案，可在高时间分辨率下测量大量回声，同时大幅减少计算硬件需求和样品损伤；通过非周期斐波那契序列放置束团，可用少数个数量级的帧数测量长时间跨度的g₂(q, τ)，并给出了完整g₂(q, τ)的解析表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于束团模式（bunch-mode）的数据采集方案，可在高时间分辨率下测量大量回声，同时大幅减少计算硬件需求和样品损伤；通过非周期斐波那契序列放置束团，可用少数个数量级的帧数测量长时间跨度的g₂(q, τ)，并给出了完整g₂(q, τ)的解析表达式。；创新点：提出束团模式XPCS采集方案，将高时间分辨率测量集中在回声峰附近，并利用斐波那契序列实现长时间跨度测量，显著降低帧数和计算/样品损伤负担；同时给出完整g₂(q, τ)的定量解析描述。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用多散斑X射线光子相关光谱（multispeckle XPCS），结合束团模式数据采集方案：在回声峰中心采集最高时间分辨率的帧（束团），并将束团按非周期斐波那契序列排列以覆盖长时间范围。模型体系为缓慢松弛的胶体悬浮液。理论上提供了描述完整g₂(q, τ)的解析表达式。

papers.title: Dynamical stabilisation of a quantum fluid using a single topological defect
papers.abstract: The size and shape of a quantum fluid in equilibrium is strongly influenced by the inter-particle interactions. In the attractive interaction regime, atomic quantum fluids ultimately collapse in a violent process that expels most of the particles from the macroscopically occupied state. Here, we use a quantum fluid of light in propagating geometry as an analogue to a two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) with large attractive interactions to show that non-trivial topology significantly alters the dynamical behaviour of the collapse, enhancing the BEC stability and delaying the collapse time by an order of magnitude. We measure direct experimental signatures of topology affecting quantum hydrodynamics, unveiling the inherent competition between attractive nonlinearities, that lead to the collapse, and the preservation of topological charge from a multi-charged vortex. We fully characterise the collapse process in coordinate space and the eventual `solitonification' of the system and connect it to the mode structure of the excitation spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论分析）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“we measure direct experimental signatures”，同时包含对激发谱模式结构的理论连接。；研究对象：传播几何中的量子光流体，作为具有大吸引相互作用的二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的类比体系；核心物理现象为吸引相互作用诱导的坍缩动力学，以及多电荷涡旋（拓扑缺陷）对该过程的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非平凡拓扑（多电荷涡旋）显著改变量子流体的坍缩动力学行为，将坍缩时间延迟约一个数量级，从而增强BEC稳定性；实验揭示了吸引非线性（驱动坍缩）与拓扑荷守恒之间的竞争，并完整表征了坍缩过程及最终的“孤子化”（solitonification）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非平凡拓扑（多电荷涡旋）显著改变量子流体的坍缩动力学行为，将坍缩时间延迟约一个数量级，从而增强BEC稳定性；实验揭示了吸引非线性（驱动坍缩）与拓扑荷守恒之间的竞争，并完整表征了坍缩过程及最终的“孤子化”（solitonification）。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观测到拓扑荷对量子流体坍缩动力学的显著影响（延迟坍缩时间一个数量级），将拓扑保护机制引入吸引BEC的稳定性调控，并建立了坍缩过程与激发谱模结构之间的关联。摘要未突出说明与以往拓扑缺陷研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用传播几何中的量子光流体平台（光子BEC类比体系），通过注入多电荷涡旋构造拓扑缺陷，实时测量坍缩过程的坐标空间动力学；理论上结合激发谱的模结构分析，将坍缩动力学与模式演化联系起来。摘要未明确说明具体的光学实验技术细节（如泵浦方式、成像手段等）。

papers.title: Spin Hall Magnetoresistance in Antiferromagnetic Insulators
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnetic materials promise improved performance for spintronic applications, as they are robust against external magnetic field perturbations and allow for faster magnetization dynamics compared to ferromagnets. The direct observation of the antiferromagnetic state, however, is challenging due to the absence of a macroscopic magnetization. We show that the spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) is a versatile tool to probe the antiferromagnetic spin structure via simple electrical transport experiments by investigating the easy-plane antiferromagnetic insulators alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite) and NiO in bilayer heterostructures with a Pt heavy-metal top electrode. While rotating an external magnetic field in three orthogonal planes, we record the longitudinal and the transverse resistivities of Pt and observe characteristic resistivity modulations consistent with the SMR effect. We analyze both their amplitude and phase and compare the data to the results from a prototypical collinear ferrimagnetic Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayer. The observed magnetic field dependence is explained in a comprehensive model, based on two magnetic sublattices and taking into account magnetic field-induced modifications of the domain structure. Our results show that the SMR effect allows to readout the spin configuration and to investigate magnetoelastic effects in antiferromagnetic multi-domain materials. We demonstrate that the SMR amplitude scales with the sum of the absolute sublattice magnetizations in ferrimagnetic and antiferromagnetic materials. In alpha-Fe2O3/Pt bilayers, we find an unexpectedly large SMR amplitude of 2.5E-3, twice as high as for prototype Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayers, making the system particularly interesting for room-temperature antiferromagnetic spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“electrical transport experiments”“record the longitudinal and the transverse resistivities”，属于输运测量实验。；研究对象：易面型反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）和NiO与重金属Pt构成的 bilayer 异质结，研究其中的自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）效应及其对反铁磁自旋结构的探测能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SMR 效应可通过简单的电输运实验有效读出反铁磁绝缘体的自旋结构；在α-Fe2O3/Pt 双层中观察到异常大的 SMR 振幅（2.5×10⁻³），约为原型铁磁绝缘体 Y₃Fe₅O₁₂/Pt 的两倍，表明该体系在室温反铁磁自旋电子学中具有应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SMR 效应可通过简单的电输运实验有效读出反铁磁绝缘体的自旋结构；在α-Fe2O3/Pt 双层中观察到异常大的 SMR 振幅（2.5×10⁻³），约为原型铁磁绝缘体 Y₃Fe₅O₁₂/Pt 的两倍，表明该体系在室温反铁磁自旋电子学中具有应用潜力。；创新点：首次将 SMR 系统性地应用于易面型反铁磁绝缘体（α-Fe₂O₃ 和 NiO）的自旋结构探测，并揭示 SMR 振幅与铁磁/反铁磁材料中两个子晶格磁化强度绝对值之和成正比；发现 α-Fe₂O₃/Pt 中 SMR 振幅异常大，且该方法可用于研究反铁磁多畴材料中的磁弹效应。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，在三个正交平面内旋转外磁场，同时测量 Pt 层的纵向和横向电阻率，记录与 SMR 效应一致的特征性电阻调制；将振幅和相位与 Y₃Fe₅O₁₂/Pt 双层的结果对比；理论分析采用基于两个磁子晶格的综合模型，并考虑磁场对磁畴结构的修正。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal Magnon Hanle Effect in Antiferromagnetic $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$
papers.abstract: The precession of the magnon pseudospin about the equilibrium pseudofield, the latter capturing the nature of magnonic eigenexcitations in an antiferromagnet, gives rise to the magnon Hanle effect. Its realization via electrically injected and detected spin transport in an antiferromagnetic insulator demonstrates its high potential for devices and as a convenient probe for magnon eigenmodes and the underlying spin interactions in the antiferromagnet. Here, we observe a non-reciprocity in the Hanle signal measured in alpha-Fe2O3 using two spatially separated Pt electrodes as spin injector and detector. Interchanging their roles alters the detected magnon spin signal. The recorded difference depends on the applied magnetic field and reverses sign when the signal passes its nominal maximum at the so-called compensation field. Our findings unlock the high potential of antiferromagnetic magnonics towards the realization of electronics-inspired phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we observe”“measured”“Pt electrodes as spin injector and detector”等实验描述。；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe₂O₃中的非互易磁振子Hanle效应，具体为通过两个空间分离的Pt电极进行电注入与电检测的自旋输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在α-Fe₂O₃中观测到Hanle信号的非互易性：交换两个Pt电极（注入与检测角色互换）会改变检测到的磁振子自旋信号，且该差异随外加磁场变化，并在补偿场（信号标称最大值处）发生符号反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在α-Fe₂O₃中观测到Hanle信号的非互易性：交换两个Pt电极（注入与检测角色互换）会改变检测到的磁振子自旋信号，且该差异随外加磁场变化，并在补偿场（信号标称最大值处）发生符号反转。；创新点：首次在反铁磁磁振子体系中观测到Hanle信号的非互易性，并揭示其与补偿场的关联，表明反铁磁磁振子学可实现类电子学（electronics-inspired）的非互易现象。摘要未突出说明与理论模型的定量对比或微观机制推导。
papers.method_zh: 电自旋注入与检测输运实验：使用两个空间分离的Pt电极分别作为自旋注入器和检测器，通过互换其角色测量Hanle信号，并扫描外加磁场。

papers.title: Colossal reversible conductivity switching by room-temperature oxygen-vacancy ordering in Aurivillius oxide films
papers.abstract: Oxygen vacancies are central to the functionality of oxides, yet they typically exist as randomly distributed point defects, limiting the ability to precisely manipulate their collective behavior. Here, we report the room-temperature formation of a long-range-ordered oxygen-vacancy superstructure in single-crystalline Aurivillius-phase Bi2WO6 thin films via a mild nitrogen-plasma treatment. This structural transformation unlocks a colossal, reversible modulation of electrical conductivity by more than nine orders of magnitude, accompanied by a striking optical transition from transparent to black. Atomic-resolution imaging and spectroscopy reveal that the vacancies selectively order within the perovskite-like tungsten oxide layers, forming a coherent defect lattice that is absent in the pristine film. Oxygen-plasma treatment removes the vacancy superstructure and restores the initial state, whereas subsequent nitrogen-plasma treatment reconstructs it, enabling repeatable room-temperature switching between distinct structural, electronic and optical states. The phenomenon is also observed in another Aurivillius member, Bi2MoO6, suggesting its generality across the Aurivillius family. These findings establish a new paradigm for atomic-scale defect engineering - using gentle plasma chemistry to construct ordered defect lattices, opening avenues for reversible property modulation in complex oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“氮等离子体处理”“氧等离子体处理”“原子级成像与光谱”“电导率测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：Aurivillius相单晶Bi2WO6薄膜（以及另一成员Bi2MoO6）中的氧空位有序化现象及其对电学、光学性质的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过室温氮等离子体处理，可在Bi2WO6薄膜中形成长程有序的氧空位超结构，实现超过九个数量级的可逆电导率巨变，并伴随从透明到黑色的光学转变；氧等离子体处理可逆地消除该超结构，实现室温可重复的物态切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过室温氮等离子体处理，可在Bi2WO6薄膜中形成长程有序的氧空位超结构，实现超过九个数量级的可逆电导率巨变，并伴随从透明到黑色的光学转变；氧等离子体处理可逆地消除该超结构，实现室温可重复的物态切换。；创新点：首次在室温下通过温和等离子体化学手段在Aurivillius氧化物中构建长程有序的氧空位缺陷晶格，而非传统随机分布的点缺陷，实现可逆、巨幅（>9个数量级）的电导率开关，并展示该现象在Aurivillius家族中的普适性（Bi2MoO6中也观察到）。摘要未突出说明与以往缺陷工程工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 温和氮等离子体处理（诱导氧空位有序化）、氧等离子体处理（恢复初始态）、原子级分辨成像与光谱（如STEM/EDS/EELS类技术，摘要未给出具体名称）、电导率测量、光学透射/吸收表征。

papers.title: Pure FENE Bond Potential for Soft Matter and Biological Simulations: Theory, HOOMD-blue Implementation, and Applications to Polymer, Colloidal, and Membrane Systems
papers.abstract: The finitely extensible nonlinear elastic (FENE) potential is widely used as a bonded interaction in coarse-grained simulations of polymers, soft matter, colloids, and biological systems. In the classical Kremer--Grest framework, FENE bonding is combined with a short-range Weeks--Chandler--Andersen (WCA) interaction to provide finite bond extensibility together with excluded-volume repulsion. Although this combination is highly successful, it intrinsically couples bonded elasticity to the nonbonded interaction, limiting the ability to independently control these two contributions. Here, we introduce a standalone FENE bond potential in HOOMD-blue in which finite bond extensibility is implemented independently of the choice of nonbonded interaction. This formulation allows the same FENE bond potential to be combined with WCA, Lennard--Jones, or other pair interactions without modifying the bonded interaction itself. We demonstrate the utility of the standalone formulation in coarse-grained polymer chains, colloidal networks, and mesh-based biological membrane models. Across these systems, Pure FENE bonding without short-range excluded-volume stabilization produces pronounced structural contraction, whereas the addition of WCA repulsion suppresses this collapse and preserves finite, spatially extended structures. These results demonstrate that separating finite bond extensibility from steric interactions provides independent control over local bond mechanics and collective structural organization. The standalone FENE formulation therefore provides a modular framework for coarse-grained simulations in which molecular connectivity and nonbonded interactions represent distinct physical mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“HOOMD-blue implementation”（模拟实现）、“coarse-grained simulations”（粗粒化模拟），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：软物质与生物体系中的粗粒化模型，具体包括聚合物链、胶体网络和基于网格的生物膜模型。核心物理对象是FENE键合势（有限可延展非线性弹性势）及其与空间排斥相互作用的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将FENE键合势从非键合相互作用中独立出来（Pure FENE）后，若不加短程排斥稳定化，体系会出现显著的结构收缩；而加入WCA排斥势可抑制这种塌缩，保持有限的空间延展结构。这表明有限键延展性与空间排斥的分离，能实现对局域键力学与集体结构组织的独立调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将FENE键合势从非键合相互作用中独立出来（Pure FENE）后，若不加短程排斥稳定化，体系会出现显著的结构收缩；而加入WCA排斥势可抑制这种塌缩，保持有限的空间延展结构。这表明有限键延展性与空间排斥的分离，能实现对局域键力学与集体结构组织的独立调控。；创新点：突破了经典Kremer-Grest框架中FENE键合必须与WCA排斥耦合使用的限制，首次在HOOMD-blue中实现了可独立于非键合相互作用选择的FENE键合势，为粗粒化模拟提供了模块化框架，使分子连接性与非键合相互作用可作为独立物理机制分别调控。
papers.method_zh: 在HOOMD-blue分子动力学模拟软件中实现独立的Pure FENE键合势，并将其分别与WCA、Lennard-Jones等不同对势组合，应用于聚合物链、胶体网络和膜模型的粗粒化模拟中，对比有无WCA排斥时的结构差异。

papers.title: Thermodynamic optimization of thermal landscapes and energy barriers in a Brownian heat engine
papers.abstract: Spatial temperature fields in Brownian heat engines are commonly prescribed \emph{a priori}, and the resulting transport and thermodynamic properties are then calculated. Here we formulate the complementary inverse-design problem: determining the temperature profile and barrier height that optimize a chosen thermodynamic objective. We consider an overdamped Brownian particle in a symmetric triangular periodic potential under a constant opposing load and derive the exact stationary current and probability density for an arbitrary bounded temperature field, $\Tc\le T(x)\le\Th$. In the quasistatic limit, the efficiency becomes an exact functional of two inverse-temperature integrals over the uphill and downhill branches. Its rigorous global maximum under the pointwise temperature bounds is $η_{\max}=1-\Tc/\Th$, attained uniquely, up to sets of measure zero, by the hot-uphill/cold-downhill piecewise-constant profile. At finite current, however, the optimization changes qualitatively because the current is determined jointly by the cycle affinity and a nonlocal transport resistance. We derive the exact functional gradient and the corresponding box-constrained optimality conditions, showing that the current- or power-maximizing profile generally differs from the quasistatic efficiency optimum. For any prescribed temperature field, the current-maximizing barrier satisfies an exact balance between the marginal gain in thermal rectification and the marginal increase in transport resistance, with the characteristic estimate $U_0^*\simeq T_{\rm act}$, where $T_{\rm act}^{-1}=(2/L)\int_0^{L/2}\dd x/T(x)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“formulate the complementary inverse-design problem”“derive the exact stationary current”“rigorous global maximum”等表述，属于解析理论与优化分析。；研究对象：布朗热机中的空间温度场与势垒高度优化问题，具体为过阻尼布朗粒子在对称三角周期势中、受恒定反向负载作用下的输运与热力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准静态极限下，效率的全局最大值为 η_max = 1 − Tc/Th，由“热上坡/冷下坡”的分段常数温度分布唯一（测度意义下）实现；但在有限电流下，电流或功率最优的温度分布与准静态效率最优不同，且电流最大化的势垒高度满足 U0* ≈ Tact 的标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准静态极限下，效率的全局最大值为 η_max = 1 − Tc/Th，由“热上坡/冷下坡”的分段常数温度分布唯一（测度意义下）实现；但在有限电流下，电流或功率最优的温度分布与准静态效率最优不同，且电流最大化的势垒高度满足 U0* ≈ Tact 的标度关系。；创新点：将布朗热机研究中通常“先给定温度场再计算输运”的正问题，反转为“以热力学目标优化温度分布与势垒高度”的逆设计问题，并给出严格的全局最优解及有限电流下的定性变化规律。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论方法：对任意有界温度场 Tc ≤ T(x) ≤ Th，精确求解过阻尼朗之万方程对应的稳态电流与概率密度；在准静态极限下将效率化为两个逆温度积分的泛函；对有限电流情形推导精确泛函梯度，并建立箱约束下的最优性条件。

papers.title: The Universal Role of Fragility on the Yielding Transition of Active Glass under Oscillatory Shear
papers.abstract: The yielding transition marks the onset of irreversible plastic deformation in amorphous solids and plays a central role in determining the mechanical stability and failure of metallic glasses, colloidal suspensions, and biological assemblies. Despite extensive research, the microscopic factors governing the nature of yielding, particularly the transition between brittle and ductile mechanical responses, remain poorly understood. Recent studies have identified kinetic fragility as a key parameter governing yielding in passive glasses; whether this connection persists in active glasses remains open. Here, using molecular dynamics simulations of a Kob-Andersen glass former doped with Run-and-Tumble (RTP) active particles under oscillatory shear, we show that activity systematically reduces kinetic fragility and consequently alters the mechanical response. The common yield point $γ_c$ decreases monotonically with activity and exhibits a power-law dependence on the Arrhenius activation barrier. Increasing activity suppresses the dependence of the yield strain on thermal history and transforms the response from brittle-like to increasingly ductile, with smoother stress relaxation and reduced stress discontinuities. The timescale to reach steady state near yielding retains a critical power-law divergence, indicating that activity does not alter the underlying critical character of the transition. Active glasses also develop broader, more diffuse shear bands. Our results establish kinetic fragility as a unifying parameter governing yielding in both passive and active glasses and demonstrate that activity offers a powerful route to tune the mechanical response of amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：主动玻璃（active glass）在振荡剪切下的屈服转变（yielding transition），具体体系为掺杂了Run-and-Tumble（RTP）活性粒子的Kob-Andersen玻璃形成体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性（activity）系统地降低了玻璃体系的动力学脆度（kinetic fragility），从而将屈服响应从脆性转变为延性；屈服点γ_c随活性单调下降，并与Arrhenius活化势垒呈幂律关系。动力学脆度被确立为统一描述被动与主动玻璃屈服的普适参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性（activity）系统地降低了玻璃体系的动力学脆度（kinetic fragility），从而将屈服响应从脆性转变为延性；屈服点γ_c随活性单调下降，并与Arrhenius活化势垒呈幂律关系。动力学脆度被确立为统一描述被动与主动玻璃屈服的普适参数。；创新点：首次将动力学脆度这一概念从被动玻璃推广到主动玻璃，证明活性可通过调节脆度来统一调控屈服行为（脆性-延性转变），并表明活性是调控非晶材料力学响应的有效途径。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，具体为对Kob-Andersen玻璃形成体掺杂Run-and-Tumble（RTP）活性粒子，施加振荡剪切（oscillatory shear），分析屈服应变、应力松弛、剪切带形貌及接近屈服时的弛豫时间标度。

papers.title: Multivariate hyperdensity functional theory for inhomogeneous equilibrium fluids: From first principles to simulation-based machine learning
papers.abstract: Hyperdensity functional theory facilitates the investigation of the equilibrium behavior of a general order parameter or statistical mechanical observable in spatially inhomogeneous classical many-body systems. The approach is based on applying the exact Mermin-Evans classical density functional mapping to an extended ensemble. Here we present the multivariate generalization for investigating simultaneously the properties and interrelations of several different hyperobservables of choice. The resulting framework gives rise to a systematic characterization and prediction scheme for general many-body phenomena. All pertinent equilibrium averages, variances, and covariances constitute universal density functionals, as we demonstrate explicitly. Associated one-body hyperfluctuation profiles quantify the degree of correlation of the local density with first- and second-order combinations of hyperobservables. These multivariate hyperfluctuation profiles are accessible in many-body simulations and they satisfy exact hyper-Ornstein-Zernike equations, which we derive from the minimization principle in the extended multivariate ensemble. The formal structure of the theory integrates naturally with supervised machine learning, which renders all hyperdensity functionals accessible in practice via training of neural networks on simulation data. We demonstrate all salient techniques using the illustrative case of clustering in confined hard rod fluids, thereby choosing the total number of particles and the largest cluster size as the representative hyperobservables of interest. Our numerical methodology enables the efficient and successful prediction of all statistical quantities induced by the chosen hyperobservables, which we verify via comparison to test data and which we attribute to the tight interplay of first-principles and machine-learning concepts that our general approach combines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算/机器学习模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要中出现“exact Mermin-Evans classical density functional mapping”“minimization principle”“supervised machine learning”“simulation data”等关键词，核心为理论推导结合模拟数据训练。；研究对象：非均匀平衡流体的多体统计力学，具体演示体系为受限硬棒流体中的团簇化现象，选取的总粒子数和最大团簇尺寸作为超观测量（hyperobservables）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了多变量超密度泛函理论（multivariate hyperdensity functional theory），证明所有相关的平衡平均值、方差和协方差均为普适密度泛函，并推导出精确的多变量超Ornstein-Zernike方程；通过神经网络训练模拟数据可高效预测所选超观测量诱导的全部统计量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了多变量超密度泛函理论（multivariate hyperdensity functional theory），证明所有相关的平衡平均值、方差和协方差均为普适密度泛函，并推导出精确的多变量超Ornstein-Zernike方程；通过神经网络训练模拟数据可高效预测所选超观测量诱导的全部统计量。；创新点：将单变量超密度泛函理论推广到多变量情形，可同时研究多个超观测量的性质及其相互关联；首次将多变量超密度泛函形式与监督式机器学习自然整合，使所有超密度泛函在实际中可通过模拟数据训练神经网络获得，并验证了首性原理与机器学习概念的紧密结合。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为经典密度泛函理论的精确映射推广到扩展系综（extended ensemble），结合多变量变分极小化原理推导超Ornstein-Zernike方程；数值方法为监督式机器学习（神经网络训练），训练数据来自多体模拟（受限硬棒流体的团簇统计）。

papers.title: Memory-driven Topological Defects and Unconventional Long-Range Order
papers.abstract: We investigate many-body systems with time-delayed self-interactions mediated by a memory-feedback mechanism. We show that such temporal interactions generate non-equilibrium orders and unique topological defects absent in equilibrium-specifically, helical vortices wherein opposite vorticities propagate in reverse directions along domain walls. In one dimension, memory feedback stabilizes true long-range order against weak noise, thereby circumventing the Mermin-Wagner theorem and resulting in an unconventional finite-temperature phase transition with a dynamical exponent $z = 4$. Physical realizations of these memory-driven non-equilibrium systems using active mechatronic metamaterials has also been proposed. These results demonstrate engineered temporal interactions as a powerful paradigm for non-equilibrium many-body physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟与实验提案）。判断依据：摘要关键词为“We investigate”、“We show”、“has also been proposed”，核心内容为理论预言与机制分析，并附带实验实现方案。；研究对象：具有时间延迟自相互作用（memory-feedback mechanism）的多体系统，即由记忆反馈驱动的非平衡多体系统。具体物理现象包括非平衡序、拓扑缺陷（螺旋涡旋）以及一维系统中的有限温度长程有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 记忆反馈的时间相互作用可产生平衡态中不存在的拓扑缺陷——螺旋涡旋（helical vortices），其中相反涡度沿畴壁反向传播；在一维系统中，该机制可稳定真正的长程有序，从而规避 Mermin-Wagner 定理，并导致具有动力学指数 z = 4 的非常规有限温度相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：记忆反馈的时间相互作用可产生平衡态中不存在的拓扑缺陷——螺旋涡旋（helical vortices），其中相反涡度沿畴壁反向传播；在一维系统中，该机制可稳定真正的长程有序，从而规避 Mermin-Wagner 定理，并导致具有动力学指数 z = 4 的非常规有限温度相变。；创新点：首次提出“记忆驱动”的时间相互作用作为非平衡多体物理的新范式，具体创新包括：(1) 预言了平衡态中不存在的螺旋涡旋拓扑缺陷及其反常传播方向；(2) 证明记忆反馈可在一维系统中规避 Mermin-Wagner 定理，实现真正的长程有序，并给出非常规的动力学指数 z = 4；(3) 提供了用主动机电超材料实现该机制的可行途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值方法（摘要未明确说明具体数值技术）；采用记忆反馈机制建模时间延迟自相互作用；通过噪声扰动下的稳定性分析研究一维长程有序；提出了基于主动机电超材料（active mechatronic metamaterials）的物理实现方案。

papers.title: Magnetic-Field-Calibration-Free Determination of the Hyperfine Constant $A$ in Ultracold Fermi gases of $^{40}$K
papers.abstract: Hyperfine constant $A$ is a key parameter of the hyperfine structure and underpins precision spectroscopy and metrology. In this Letter, we develop a magnetic-field-calibration-free method for determining the ground-state hyperfine constant $A$ in an ultracold $^{40}$K Fermi gas by utilizing a pair of magnetically insensitive ("clock") transitions. This overcomes the stringent magnetic-field calibration requirements of conventional methods. We measure the transition frequency between these two magnetically insensitive transitions with Hz-level resolution over a range of magnetic fields, and obtain the ground-state hyperfine constant $A = -h\times 285.730536(2)\,\mathrm{MHz}$, corresponding to an absolute uncertainty of about $2\,\mathrm{Hz}$. Our value reduces the uncertainty by nearly three orders of magnitude compared with previous determinations, providing a substantially improved reference for high-precision spectroscopy and metrology with $^{40}$K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we develop”“we measure”，属于实验测量工作。；研究对象：超冷⁴⁰K费米气体中的基态超精细常数A，具体涉及磁不敏感（“时钟”）跃迁的频谱测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用一对磁不敏感跃迁，实现了无需磁场标定的基态超精细常数A测量，得到A = -h × 285.730536(2) MHz，绝对不确定度约2 Hz，比此前测定值降低了近三个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用一对磁不敏感跃迁，实现了无需磁场标定的基态超精细常数A测量，得到A = -h × 285.730536(2) MHz，绝对不确定度约2 Hz，比此前测定值降低了近三个数量级。；创新点：提出并实现了“免磁场标定”的超精细常数测定方案，利用磁不敏感跃迁对消除磁场校准误差，将A的测量不确定度较以往结果压缩约三个数量级。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超冷⁴⁰K费米气体，选取一对对磁场不敏感的“时钟”跃迁，在多个磁场值下以Hz级分辨率测量两跃迁之间的频率差，从而直接提取超精细常数A，避免了传统方法对磁场标定的依赖。

papers.title: Direct Observation of the Zigzag Edge States of a Supramolecular Diatomic Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: Lattice geometry plays a fundamental role in the behavior of Bloch electrons in a crystal. The diatomic Kagome lattice, an extension of the honeycomb and Kagome lattices, is predicted to give rise to emergent and topological phenomena, but its experimental investigation has been limited thus far. Here, we fabricate a diatomic Kagome lattice through self-assembly of a triptycene derivative with phenazine moieties (Trip-Phz)---a $\mathrm{C_3}$-symmetric, non-planar $π$-conjugated molecule. Our scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) observations show that Trip-Phz forms a highly ordered diatomic Kagome lattice terminated by zigzag-type edges on the Pb(111) surface. Combined STM measurements and tight-binding calculations provide direct evidence for the existence of the edge states that correspond to those of graphene. These states are topological edge states dictated by the quantization of the Zak phase and the bulk-edge correspondence.This work reveals an ideal platform for exploring quantum materials with unique lattice geometries using supramolecular technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合紧束缚计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) observations”“tight-binding calculations”。；研究对象：由三蝶烯衍生物（含吩嗪基团，Trip-Phz）在Pb(111)表面自组装形成的双原子Kagome晶格，及其锯齿型边界态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Trip-Phz自组装的双原子Kagome晶格中，直接观测到与石墨烯锯齿边界态对应的拓扑边界态，该边界态由Zak相位量子化及体-边对应原理决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Trip-Phz自组装的双原子Kagome晶格中，直接观测到与石墨烯锯齿边界态对应的拓扑边界态，该边界态由Zak相位量子化及体-边对应原理决定。；创新点：首次在实验上构建并直接观测双原子Kagome晶格的锯齿型边界态，证实其拓扑起源（Zak相位与体-边对应），并展示了利用超分子自组装技术实现特殊晶格几何量子材料的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实验观测分子自组装结构及边界态；结合紧束缚模型计算进行对比验证。

papers.title: All-dry processing of 3C-SiC nanomechanical string resonators for extreme aspect ratios and high intrinsic quality factor
papers.abstract: Conventional fabrication of suspended nanomechanical resonators typically relies on wet-chemical process steps and critical point drying, which can compromise sample yield and cleanliness. Here, we present an all-dry fabrication process for strongly stressed 3C-SiC nanomechanical string resonators that entirely avoids wet-chemical etching and cleaning. Using a negative-tone electron-beam resist as an etch mask and a three-step reactive-ion etching process for both structuring and release, we achieve high fabrication yield, clean suspended structures, and extreme aspect ratios of 8.500. We perform full mechanical characterization of the resulting doubly-clamped nanostring resonators, and establish a benchmark intrinsic quality factor for dissipation-diluted 3C-SiC of Qintr = 4.200.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述具体制备工艺（电子束光刻、反应离子刻蚀）和机械表征，属于实验研究。；研究对象：3C-SiC（立方碳化硅）纳米机械弦线谐振器，重点研究其高应力悬浮结构、极大长宽比及本征品质因数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全干法工艺成功制备了3C-SiC纳米弦线谐振器，实现极高长宽比（8,500）和清洁悬浮结构，并测得耗散稀释下的本征品质因数Q_intr = 4,200，为3C-SiC材料体系树立了基准值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全干法工艺成功制备了3C-SiC纳米弦线谐振器，实现极高长宽比（8,500）和清洁悬浮结构，并测得耗散稀释下的本征品质因数Q_intr = 4,200，为3C-SiC材料体系树立了基准值。；创新点：首次实现完全无湿法步骤的3C-SiC纳米谐振器制备，规避了传统湿法工艺导致的产率损失和表面污染问题，同时达到极端的8,500长宽比，并建立了该材料耗散稀释本征品质因数的性能基准。
papers.method_zh: 全干法微纳加工：采用负性电子束光刻胶作为刻蚀掩模，结合三步反应离子刻蚀（RIE）完成结构定义与释放，完全避免湿化学刻蚀和临界点干燥；随后对双端固支纳米弦线进行完整机械表征。

papers.title: A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
papers.abstract: We present a real-space formulation of DFT for extended systems in which localized Wannier-like functions are constructed directly from localized Gaussian basis functions without explicitly computing canonical Bloch-like states during the self-consistent cycle. Building on the formalism of Pederson and Lin [Phys. Rev. B \textbf{35}, 2273 (1987)], a variational set of Wannier-like functions is generated self-consistently within a finite Wannier domain and used to construct the charge density, electrostatic potential, and per cell total energy of the extended system. The occupied space can be determined entirely from the Wannier-like functions. Electronic band structures can be recovered in a post-processing step by solving the full Hamiltonian in a Bloch-like basis constructed from Gaussian orbitals. A key feature of the method is that it can incorporate combined translation--rotation, or screw, symmetries, enabling efficient simulations of chiral and helical systems with finite twist angles at essentially the same computational cost as systems described by pure translational symmetry. The approach is validated through calculations on linear and twisted $\mathrm{{-}C{\equiv}C{-}}$ and $\mathrm{{-}Li{-}F{-}}$ chains, as well as graphene, where total energies and band structures show excellent agreement with reference periodic calculations. To illustrate the ability of the method to treat three-dimensional systems, it is further applied to AA graphite, in which carbon atoms in adjacent graphene layers are aligned directly above one another, as well as helically stacked AA graphite structures. The Wannier-first framework provides a practical route for treating extended systems with nontrivial translational, rotational, and screw symmetries, and provides a natural foundation for the implementation of orbital-dependent functionals such as the Perdew--Zunger self-interaction correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“real-space formulation of DFT”“self-consistent cycle”“calculations”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算方法开发与验证。；研究对象：扩展手性体系（chiral and helical systems），具体包括线性及扭转的 −C≡C− 链、−Li−F− 链、石墨烯（二维体系），以及 AA 堆垛石墨和螺旋堆垛 AA 石墨（三维体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种“Wannier-first”实空间 DFT 方法，可在不自洽循环中显式构造布洛赫态的情况下，直接从局域高斯基函数构建 Wannier-like 函数，从而以与纯平移对称体系几乎相同的计算成本处理具有有限扭转角的螺旋/手性体系；在测试体系中总能量和能带与参考周期计算高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种“Wannier-first”实空间 DFT 方法，可在不自洽循环中显式构造布洛赫态的情况下，直接从局域高斯基函数构建 Wannier-like 函数，从而以与纯平移对称体系几乎相同的计算成本处理具有有限扭转角的螺旋/手性体系；在测试体系中总能量和能带与参考周期计算高度一致。；创新点：提出“Wannier-first”策略——不显式计算布洛赫态而直接构建 Wannier-like 函数，并首次将该框架推广至包含螺旋对称性的手性/螺旋扩展体系，使有限扭转角体系的模拟成本与纯平移体系相当。摘要未突出说明与已有 Wannier 方法在具体数值实现上的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Pederson 和 Lin 的实空间 DFT 形式（Phys. Rev. B 35, 2273 (1987)），在有限 Wannier 域内自洽生成变分的 Wannier-like 函数，用于构造电荷密度、静电势和每原胞总能量；占据空间完全由 Wannier-like 函数确定。能带结构在后处理步骤中通过由高斯轨道构造的 Bloch-like 基求解完整哈密顿量获得。方法可纳入平移–旋转（螺旋）对称性。验证计算采用局域高斯基函数，并提及与 Perdew–Zunger 自相互作用修正的兼容性。

papers.title: Branching stochastic mechanics. II. Relative localization and collective poles from Bohm/Fisher feedback
papers.abstract: Paper I introduced branching stochastic mechanics (BSM) by lifting the Schrödinger-Nagasawa pair to reciprocal forward and backward branching fields. Their centered connected kernel $C_{\rm FB}=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_Fψ_B]$ carries the organized reciprocal sector, where $\mathbb E_ω$ denotes expectation over branching-noise realizations, with $ρ_{\rm BSM}=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)$ on the anticorrelated branch. Here we develop the stochastic field theory of the Bohm/Fisher feedback that acts on this connected sector. Starting from the multiplicative branching covariance of BSM, a Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) formulation and a causal two-loop two-particle-irreducible (2PI) closure are used to determine response and correlation functions self-consistently. The free connected theory exhibits secular growth and ultraviolet accumulation, whereas the dressed theory develops a finite relative screening length. A reduced numerical evolution shows bounded formation of this localized sector, and a self-similar Fisher construction defines the saturated information velocity $c_\star$. A Born-Oppenheimer separation then distinguishes internal relative organization from collective propagation. Restoring the complete frequency structure gives two fixed-$q$ pole families: a gapless difference branch and a gapped sum branch. The infrared velocity of the difference branch approaches $c_\star$ at saturation. The common cone and the projected sum-sector gap are then formulated as additional fixed-point matching conditions for the collective theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中大量出现“stochastic field theory”（随机场论）、“MSRJD formulation”（MSRJD形式）、“2PI closure”（2PI闭合）等理论推导术语，且未提及任何实验或具体数值模拟细节（除“reduced numerical evolution”作为理论验证外）。；研究对象：该论文研究的是“分支随机力学”（Branching Stochastic Mechanics, BSM）这一理论框架下的物理现象，具体聚焦于由Bohm/Fisher反馈机制驱动的相对局域化（relative localization）和集体极点（collective poles）行为。研究对象并非特定材料，而是一种广义的量子随机过程及其场论描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文表明，在BSM的连通扇区中，通过Bohm/Fisher反馈的自洽处理，自由理论中的长期发散（secular growth）和紫外累积问题被消除，系统形成具有有限相对屏蔽长度（relative screening length）的局域化结构。该结构在饱和时定义了一个信息速度 \( c_\star \)，并导致两个固定动量（fixed-\(q\)）的极点族：一个无能隙的差分支和一个有能隙的和分支。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文表明，在BSM的连通扇区中，通过Bohm/Fisher反馈的自洽处理，自由理论中的长期发散（secular growth）和紫外累积问题被消除，系统形成具有有限相对屏蔽长度（relative screening length）的局域化结构。该结构在饱和时定义了一个信息速度 \( c_\star \)，并导致两个固定动量（fixed-\(q\)）的极点族：一个无能隙的差分支和一个有能隙的和分支。；创新点：该工作将Bohm/Fisher反馈机制引入BSM的连通扇区，并利用高级场论工具（MSRJD+2PI）解决了自由理论中的发散问题，建立了相对局域化与集体传播之间的自洽联系。摘要未突出说明其与Paper I之外其他工作的具体差异，但“摘要未明确说明”其相对于更广泛已有研究的独特优势。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用理论推导方法，具体包括：1）基于BSM的乘法分支协方差，建立Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de Dominicis（MSRJD）路径积分形式；2）采用因果的双圈二粒子不可约（2PI）闭合方案自洽求解响应函数和关联函数；3）通过约化数值演化验证局域化扇区的有界形成；4）利用自相似Fisher构造定义饱和信息速度；5）采用Born-Oppenheimer近似分离内部相对组织与集体传播。

papers.title: Disorder-driven competing magnetic interactions and glassy magnetic behavior in quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe
papers.abstract: In this combined experimental and theoretical study, we investigate the role of disorder in governing the magnetic ground state of the quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe. In the FeRuMnZ (Z = Ga, Si) series, chemical substitution modifies atomic ordering and electronic structure, resulting in distinct magnetic ground states. Motivated by this, we extend the series to FeRuMnGe. X-ray diffraction reveals B2-type antisite disorder, where Fe--Ru and Mn--Ge intermix. Theoretical calculations show that such disorder modifies exchange interactions, leading to competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings, and drives the system from half-metallic to metallic. Magnetic measurements reveal competing interactions, giving rise to a cluster-glass state coexisting with long-range magnetic order. The absence of a thermodynamic signature at $T_f$, together with ac susceptibility and relaxation measurements, supports the presence of short-range magnetic interactions and a glassy magnetic state. The compound exhibits an enhanced magnetic response below $\sim 161$ K and a maximum magnetization of $\sim 1.64~μ_B$/f.u. at 5 T. Overall, this work establishes a direct correlation between antisite disorder, competing exchange interactions, and glassy magnetism in quaternary Heusler alloys. Combined experimental results and theoretical calculations reveal that disorder drives the system from an AFM-dominated state in FeRuMnSi to an FM-dominated state in FeRuMnGe, providing deeper insight into the role of the extent of disorder in governing the magnetic properties of QHAs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and theoretical study”，包含X射线衍射、磁性测量等实验手段，以及理论计算。；研究对象：四元Heusler合金FeRuMnGe，具体关注B2型反位无序（Fe–Ru和Mn–Ge互混）对磁基态的影响，以及无序驱动的竞争磁相互作用与玻璃态磁性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反位无序改变了交换相互作用，导致铁磁与反铁磁耦合竞争，使体系从半金属转变为金属，并形成团簇玻璃态与长程磁序共存的状态；无序将体系从FeRuMnSi中的反铁磁主导态驱动至FeRuMnGe中的铁磁主导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反位无序改变了交换相互作用，导致铁磁与反铁磁耦合竞争，使体系从半金属转变为金属，并形成团簇玻璃态与长程磁序共存的状态；无序将体系从FeRuMnSi中的反铁磁主导态驱动至FeRuMnGe中的铁磁主导态。；创新点：建立了四元Heusler合金中反位无序、竞争交换相互作用与玻璃态磁性之间的直接关联，并通过对比FeRuMnSi与FeRuMnGe揭示了无序程度对磁性质（AFM主导→FM主导）的调控作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：X射线衍射（确定B2型反位无序）、磁性测量（包括交流磁化率、弛豫测量、热力学比热测量以检测T_f处热力学特征）。理论方面：电子结构计算（用于分析无序对交换相互作用和电子态的影响，判断半金属到金属的转变）。

papers.title: 'pySNOW': a Python Suite for the NanO-World
papers.abstract: In computational materials science, numerical simulations are indispensable tools for revealing atomic-scale processes. For building blocks of the nanoworld, such as nanoparticles and nanoalloys, atomistic simulations provide detailed insight into their behaviour under diverse conditions. These simulations enable the study of formation and growth mechanisms, transport phenomena, chemophysical stability, and chemical reactions, including catalytic processes. To unravel the complex structure--property relationships that characterise nanoobjects, it is crucial to develop robust and insightful representations of their atomistic structure at global and local scales. Such descriptions enhance our understanding of nanoparticle behaviour and play a key role in guiding their rational design in silico for targeted applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件方法文章。依据：摘要强调“numerical simulations”“atomistic simulations”，且标题明确为“Python Suite”（软件套件），属于计算工具开发类工作。；研究对象：纳米世界的基本构筑单元——纳米颗粒与纳米合金（nanoparticles and nanoalloys），关注其原子级结构、形成与生长机制、输运现象、化学物理稳定性及催化等化学反应过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出具体物理结论，核心贡献在于提出了一套用于纳米物体原子结构表征的软件框架，旨在通过全局与局域尺度的结构描述符揭示纳米物体的“结构—性质”关系，从而支持理性设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出具体物理结论，核心贡献在于提出了一套用于纳米物体原子结构表征的软件框架，旨在通过全局与局域尺度的结构描述符揭示纳米物体的“结构—性质”关系，从而支持理性设计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但可推断其新意在于提供一套专门面向纳米颗粒/纳米合金的、兼顾全局与局域结构表征的Python工具，以弥合原子模拟与结构—性质关系解析之间的鸿沟。
papers.method_zh: 开发了名为“pySNOW”的Python软件套件，具体算法细节（如描述符类型、势函数接口、机器学习方法等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Spin wave freezing in Re/Co/Pt multilayers
papers.abstract: The phenomenon of spin wave (SW) freezing occurs in the Damon-Eshbach mode in thin film magnetic systems, when SW phase and group velocities both go to zero, and the wave ceases to oscillate and move, preserving its shape as a domain structure pattern. This effect is related to the spin reorientation transition, where the magnetization configuration changes between the homogeneous in-plane state and domain structure with the out-of-plane magnetization component state. Here, we study the SW freezing effect in [Re/Co/Pt]$_{20}$ magnetic multilayers, induced by varying the in-plane external magnetic field. The studies were performed on nanostructures with the quality factor $Q$ (ratio of uniaxial anisotropy to demagnetization energies) greater and smaller than one. Domain structures with an out-of-plane magnetization component were observed in these multilayers. The critical field, visible as the saturation field $H_s^{||}$ in the parallel static magnetization curve measured by superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID), is also manifested in the field-dependent vector-network-analyzer ferromagnetic resonance (VNA-FMR) experiment, which measures the homogeneous magnetization oscillations. Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) spectra, recorded for several values of wave vectors and several field values, probed the field-evolution of the dispersion relation. Micromagnetic simulations allow one to obtain a full dispersion, in good agreement with VNA-FMR and BLS results. Around $H_s^{||}$ the simulated dispersion relations approach the conditions for SW freezing. Below $H_s^{||}$ low and high frequency VNA-FMR modes are related to magnetization oscillations inside domain walls and within domains, respectively. The experimental results of static and dynamic behavior, together with micromagnetic simulations, create an overall consistent picture of the investigated multilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。关键词：VNA-FMR、BLS、SQUID（实验手段），micromagnetic simulations（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：[Re/Co/Pt]₂₀ 磁性多层膜中的自旋波冻结现象（spin wave freezing），以及伴随的自旋重取向转变和磁畴结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 [Re/Co/Pt]₂₀ 多层膜中，通过调节面内磁场可诱导自旋波冻结效应；当外场接近平行饱和场 H_s^∥ 时，色散关系趋于满足自旋波冻结条件（相速度与群速度同时为零），且低于该场时观测到与畴壁内和畴内磁化振荡对应的两个 VNA-FMR 模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 [Re/Co/Pt]₂₀ 多层膜中，通过调节面内磁场可诱导自旋波冻结效应；当外场接近平行饱和场 H_s^∥ 时，色散关系趋于满足自旋波冻结条件（相速度与群速度同时为零），且低于该场时观测到与畴壁内和畴内磁化振荡对应的两个 VNA-FMR 模式。；创新点：在质量因子 Q 大于和小于 1 的两种 [Re/Co/Pt] 多层膜纳米结构中系统研究了自旋波冻结效应，并通过实验（静态+动态）与微磁模拟的一致性构建了完整物理图像。摘要未突出说明与以往自旋波冻结研究的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: SQUID 测量平行静态磁化曲线（确定饱和场 H_s^∥）；矢量网络分析仪铁磁共振（VNA-FMR）测量均匀磁化振荡的场依赖行为；布里渊光散射（BLS）在不同波矢和磁场下探测色散关系的场演化；微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）获得完整色散并与实验对比。

papers.title: Prominent Dimensional Effects on High-order Harmonic Generation in Strongly Correlated Electron Systems
papers.abstract: Dimensionality strongly affects elementary excitations in correlated quantum materials, yet its impact on extreme nonlinear optical responses remains largely unexplored. Here, we combine high-harmonic generation (HHG) experiments on quasi-one-dimensional SrCuO$_2$ and quasi-two-dimensional Pr$_2$CuO$_4$ with nonequilibrium simulations of Hubbard models. We find a pronounced dimensional contrast: SrCuO$_2$ exhibits a robust plateau-like high-harmonic spectrum with weak temperature dependence, whereas Pr$_2$CuO$_4$ shows a monotonic decrease in harmonic yield and strong thermal suppression, especially at higher harmonics. The simulations qualitatively reproduce these trends and identify dimensionality-dependent doublon--holon dephasing, governed by spin--charge coupling, as their microscopic origin. These results establish dimensionality and spin--charge coupling as key control parameters for extreme nonlinear optical responses in correlated insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“HHG experiments on…”（实验）与“nonequilibrium simulations of Hubbard models”（非平衡Hubbard模型模拟）。；研究对象：准一维强关联铜氧化物 SrCuO₂ 与准二维铜氧化物 Pr₂CuO₄ 中的高次谐波产生（HHG）现象，以及维度对极端非线性光学响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 维度显著影响强关联电子体系的高次谐波发射：准一维 SrCuO₂ 呈现平台状谐波谱且对温度不敏感，而准二维 Pr₂CuO₄ 的谐波产率随谐波阶次单调下降且受温度强烈抑制。模拟表明其微观机制为维度依赖的、由自旋-电荷耦合主导的双占据-空穴（doublon-holon）退相干过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：维度显著影响强关联电子体系的高次谐波发射：准一维 SrCuO₂ 呈现平台状谐波谱且对温度不敏感，而准二维 Pr₂CuO₄ 的谐波产率随谐波阶次单调下降且受温度强烈抑制。模拟表明其微观机制为维度依赖的、由自旋-电荷耦合主导的双占据-空穴（doublon-holon）退相干过程。；创新点：首次将维度效应与自旋-电荷耦合确立为强关联绝缘体中极端非线性光学响应的关键调控参数，揭示了维度如何通过影响准粒子退相干来改变高次谐波谱形与温度依赖行为。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高次谐波产生（HHG）光谱测量；理论上对Hubbard模型进行非平衡态数值模拟（摘要未明确具体数值方法，如是否使用td-DMRG或精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Impedance in Periodically Driven Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract: We study the time-dependent currents arising in periodically driven stochastic systems. In the linear regime of small driving, a closed expression is obtained for the impedance/admittance associated with these currents. This expression leads directly to an interpretation in terms of an equivalent electrical circuit. For a stochastic system with $N$ states, the electrical circuit consists of precisely $N$ parallel branches, with each branch comprising a resistor and a capacitor in series. The low- and high-frequency limits of these currents are calculated, and the results are generalized to more general current expressions. We demonstrate our findings across several archetypal settings, illustrating the potential to detect specific broken symmetries or the graph topology associated with the stochastic process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“closed expression is obtained”“we study”等理论推导表述，且无实验手段描述。；研究对象：周期性驱动随机系统中的时间相关电流，属于非平衡统计物理与随机热力学范畴，具体涉及线性响应区的阻抗/导纳行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在小驱动线性区，周期性驱动随机系统的电流可严格对应到一个等效电路：对N态随机系统，该电路恰由N条并联支路构成，每条支路为电阻与电容串联；并给出了电流的低频与高频极限表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在小驱动线性区，周期性驱动随机系统的电流可严格对应到一个等效电路：对N态随机系统，该电路恰由N条并联支路构成，每条支路为电阻与电容串联；并给出了电流的低频与高频极限表达式。；创新点：将随机系统的频率响应直接映射为具体且结构明确的等效电路（N条并联RC串联支路），并指出该电路结构可用于探测随机过程中特定的对称性破缺或图拓扑性质。摘要未突出说明与以往阻抗理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导：基于线性响应理论，对周期性驱动随机系统推导阻抗/导纳的闭合表达式，并推广到更一般的电流表达式；通过若干典型模型（archetypal settings）进行演示验证。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Electric Toroidal Dipole and Intrinsic Longitudinal Spin Transport
papers.abstract: Electric toroidal dipoles (ETDs) characterize ferroaxial order, yet their bulk definition in periodic crystals has remained elusive because conventional multipole operators involve the ill-defined position operator. Here we formulate a thermodynamic ETD by coupling a spatially varying electric field to the relativistic spin-induced electric polarization. The resulting expression is gauge invariant and provides a bulk order parameter for ferroaxial phases. We further establish a direct relation between the chemical-potential derivative of the ETD and the intrinsic longitudinal spin conductivity in insulating systems. To demonstrate the formulation, we construct a minimal ferroaxial extension of the Kane--Mele model. The ETD becomes finite exclusively in the ferroaxial phase and is strongly enhanced near a small band gap, accompanied by a sizable longitudinal spin current. Our results establish a thermodynamic theory of ETDs in crystalline solids and identify the longitudinal spin conductivity as a direct transport manifestation of ferroaxial order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“formulate”“gauge invariant”“establish a direct relation”等理论推导性表述，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：凝聚态晶体中的电极化涡旋偶极（Electric Toroidal Dipole, ETD）及其对应的铁环序（ferroaxial order），以及与之关联的纵向自旋输运现象。具体模型体系为Kane–Mele模型的铁环扩展版本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作给出了周期晶体中电极化涡旋偶极的规范不变热力学定义，可作为铁环相的整体序参量；并证明在绝缘体中，ETD对化学势的导数直接等于本征纵向自旋电导率，从而将纵向自旋流确立为铁环序的直接输运体现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作给出了周期晶体中电极化涡旋偶极的规范不变热力学定义，可作为铁环相的整体序参量；并证明在绝缘体中，ETD对化学势的导数直接等于本征纵向自旋电导率，从而将纵向自旋流确立为铁环序的直接输运体现。；创新点：首次给出了周期晶体中电极化涡旋偶极的规范不变体定义（此前因位置算符不适定而缺失），并建立了铁环序与纵向自旋输运之间的直接理论联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过将空间变化的电场耦合到相对论自旋诱导的电极化来构造热力学ETD；模型计算：构建了Kane–Mele模型的铁环扩展最小模型，用于数值验证ETD在铁环相中的行为及其与自旋电导的关系。

papers.title: Chemical pressure and vacancies in crystals under nonhydrostatic stress
papers.abstract: Inhomogeneous stress is a driving force for diffusion of vacancies in crystals. The other way around a non-uniform distribution of vacancies induces stress. The accepted theory of composition-stress coupling in crystals is Larché-Cahn (LC) theory. Composition is defined in terms of the population of lattice sites with a limit of one-particle per site. Coupling is modelled by adding a compositional strain term to the elastic strain in the constitutive relation for stress. An alternative mechanism, proposed here, is letting the site binding energy vary with spatial (deformed) density. This generates a chemical pressure adding to the elastic stress. The governing equations for this model are derived using non-equilibrium continuum thermodynamic methods. The gradient of the chemical pressure has a dual function acting both as the drift force for migration and as an effective internal one body force in the Cauchy equation for the elastic stress. The practical evaluation presented in the paper is restricted to equilibrium properties. We examine the effect of externally applied non-hydrostatic stress, either in the form of surface tractions or a one-body force density (gravitation). The model system is a one component crystal with a fixed number of lattice sites. The number of particles can be variable but is always smaller than the number of lattice sites. The linear elastic response is modelled by the standard Lamé stress tensor. The results for systems deformed by surface tractions are in qualitative agreement with LC theory allowing for differences in the expression for the elastic moduli. Deviations are more serious for the crystal deformed by gravitation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“非平衡连续介质热力学方法”推导方程，提出新理论模型，无实验或数值计算内容。；研究对象：晶体中空位（vacancies）在非静水应力（nonhydrostatic stress）下的扩散与应力耦合问题，具体为单组分晶体（晶格位点数固定，粒子数可变且少于位点数）在表面牵引力或单体力密度（如重力）作用下的平衡性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种替代Larché-Cahn（LC）理论的新机制：让位点结合能随空间（变形后）密度变化，从而产生附加于弹性应力的化学压力。该化学压力的梯度同时充当空位迁移的漂移力和Cauchy方程中的有效内单体力。在表面牵引力变形下，该模型与LC理论定性一致（仅弹性模量表达式有差异）；但在重力变形下偏差更严重。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种替代Larché-Cahn（LC）理论的新机制：让位点结合能随空间（变形后）密度变化，从而产生附加于弹性应力的化学压力。该化学压力的梯度同时充当空位迁移的漂移力和Cauchy方程中的有效内单体力。在表面牵引力变形下，该模型与LC理论定性一致（仅弹性模量表达式有差异）；但在重力变形下偏差更严重。；创新点：提出“位点结合能随空间密度变化”这一新的组分-应力耦合机制，替代LC理论中在应力本构关系中添加组分应变项的做法，并揭示化学压力梯度的双重功能（漂移力+内体力）。摘要未突出说明与实验或数值模拟的对比。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡连续介质热力学方法（non-equilibrium continuum thermodynamic methods）推导控制方程；线性弹性响应采用标准Lamé应力张量建模；分析限于平衡性质，考察外加强制非静水应力（表面牵引力或重力）下的效应。

papers.title: Rank-Selective Optical Tomography of Higher-Wave Altermagnetism
papers.abstract: Identifying the spatial rank of higher-wave altermagnetic order optically is challenging because local electric-dipole response does not uniquely resolve distinct continuum harmonics. We show that finite photon momentum turns one-photon spin-resolved absorption into a rank-selective tomography. For the planar $|m|=\ell$ sector of an even-parity $\ell$-wave component, a joint Fourier projection in polarization and momentum angle isolates $\mathcal T_\ell\proptoη_\ell q^{\ell-2}$, yielding the hierarchy $d:q^0$, $g:q^2$, and $i:q^4$; phase changes track rotations of the selected magnetic harmonic. A Ward-consistent finite-$q$ microscopic calculation reproduces these powers without imposing them. Although discrete crystal symmetry can generate lower-order local aliases, they are orthogonal to the selected momentum harmonic and cannot contaminate it below $q^{\ell-2}$. In MnTe, whose nonrelativistic parent order is three-dimensional $g$ wave while spin--orbit coupling lowers the exact relativistic spin-momentum-locking symmetry, first-principles calculations show that more than $99.9\%$ of the Fourier power of the Néel-projected $A$-region spin-energy contrast remains in the parent $g$-wave-derived $m=3$ harmonic. Structured near fields place the required momentum window within experimental reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“微观计算”“第一性原理计算”，并涉及对称性分析与理论推导，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：高波（higher-wave）交替磁性（altermagnetism）材料，具体以MnTe为例，研究其g波（ℓ=2，|m|=3）交替磁有序的光学探测问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限光子动量可将单光子自旋分辨吸收转化为“秩选择性断层扫描”，实现对高波交替磁序空间秩（rank）的直接光学分辨；在MnTe中，超过99.9%的傅里叶功率保留在母体g波衍生的m=3谐波中，低阶局域混叠不会污染所选动量谐波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限光子动量可将单光子自旋分辨吸收转化为“秩选择性断层扫描”，实现对高波交替磁序空间秩（rank）的直接光学分辨；在MnTe中，超过99.9%的傅里叶功率保留在母体g波衍生的m=3谐波中，低阶局域混叠不会污染所选动量谐波。；创新点：提出利用光子动量作为额外自由度，通过偏振与动量角的联合傅里叶投影实现交替磁序谐波秩的选择性分辨，克服了局域电偶极响应无法区分不同连续谐波的困难；并证明晶体对称性产生的低阶局域混叠与所选动量谐波正交，不会干扰探测。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有限光子动量下的自旋分辨光学吸收理论，结合Ward恒等式一致的有限q微观计算；对MnTe采用第一性原理计算（具体泛函类型摘要未明确说明），并利用结构近场（structured near fields）分析动量窗口的可达性。

papers.title: Direct observation of flat bands in near-magic-angle twisted bilayer CVD graphene
papers.abstract: Advances in chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth have driven graphene crystal quality to unprecedented levels, yet it is still unknown whether this route can realize the fragile flat-band and correlated states of the magic-angle (MA) twisted bilayer graphene (TBG). Here, we report on the experimental observation by room-temperature nano-angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (nano-ARPES) of flat bands in a TBG sample close to the MA, assembled via a grow-and-stack protocol based on low-pressure CVD of graphene on copper. Our study indicates electronic bands fully comparable to those measured in exfoliation-based samples and determines the size of the largest near-MA domain to be compatible with electronic transport experiments, motivating further experiments on flat band physics in CVD-graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental observation”“nano-ARPES”“assembled via a grow-and-stack protocol”等实验手段与样品制备描述。；研究对象：近魔角（near-magic-angle）扭转双层石墨烯（TBG），具体为基于铜上低压CVD生长石墨烯、通过“生长-堆叠”工艺组装的样品。关注其平带（flat bands）电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下利用纳米角分辨光电子能谱（nano-ARPES）直接观测到近魔角CVD扭转双层石墨烯中的平带，其电子能带与基于机械剥离法制备的样品完全可比，且最大近魔角畴区尺寸与电子输运实验兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下利用纳米角分辨光电子能谱（nano-ARPES）直接观测到近魔角CVD扭转双层石墨烯中的平带，其电子能带与基于机械剥离法制备的样品完全可比，且最大近魔角畴区尺寸与电子输运实验兼容。；创新点：首次在CVD生长的扭转双层石墨烯中直接观测到近魔角平带，证明CVD路线也能实现此前仅在剥离样品中观察到的脆弱平带电子结构，并确认其畴区尺寸足以支撑输运实验。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 室温nano-ARPES（纳米角分辨光电子能谱）；样品制备采用低压CVD石墨烯在铜上的生长及后续堆叠（grow-and-stack）工艺。

papers.title: Molecular-dynamics-based modal analysis of heat transport in quasi-one-dimensional systems from a symmetry-adapted perspective
papers.abstract: Detailed analysis of thermal conductivity results obtained from molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories conventionally relies on knowledge of the harmonic vibrational modes of the system. Such is the case in methods like Green--Kubo modal analysis (GKMA) and homogeneous nonequilibrium modal analysis (HNEMA). This approach faces several shortcomings that become especially important when dealing with nanostructures. Chief among them is scalability, followed by the ambiguity associated to the degeneracy of the large vibrational subspaces defined by a common translational wave number k. We propose an alternative for quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) systems: we construct the modal basis for the decomposition of the thermal conductivity from line-group projection operators, so that every projected component carries well-defined symmetry labels (including rotational information and parities) and the decomposition is unique at the level of irreducible representations (irreps). Applying the idea to a (10,0)-(20,0) WS2-MoS2 double-walled nanotube (DWNT) described by a neuroevolution potential (NEP), we find that at 300 K both HNEMA and GKMA yield statistically consistent total conductivities and allow the identification of several prominent symmetry-adapted conduction channels. The GKMA pair matrix shows that within-block and same-channel cross-k terms account for 75.6% of the total conductivity, while cross-channel correlations contribute 24.4%.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确基于分子动力学（MD）轨迹、模态分析、神经进化势（NEP）等计算模拟方法。；研究对象：准一维（quasi-1D）系统中的热输运，具体材料为(10,0)-(20,0) WS₂-MoS₂双壁纳米管（DWNT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从线群（line-group）投影算子构造的对称适配模态基，可对热导率进行唯一且带明确对称性标签（含转动信息和宇称）的不可约表示分解。在300 K下，HNEMA与GKMA两种方法给出统计一致的总热导率，并识别出多个显著的对称适配导热通道；GKMA配对矩阵显示，块内及同通道交叉k项贡献总热导率的75.6%，跨通道关联贡献24.4%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从线群（line-group）投影算子构造的对称适配模态基，可对热导率进行唯一且带明确对称性标签（含转动信息和宇称）的不可约表示分解。在300 K下，HNEMA与GKMA两种方法给出统计一致的总热导率，并识别出多个显著的对称适配导热通道；GKMA配对矩阵显示，块内及同通道交叉k项贡献总热导率的75.6%，跨通道关联贡献24.4%。；创新点：针对准一维系统，提出用线群投影算子替代传统简正振动模态基进行热导率分解，解决了传统方法在大振动子空间简并性上的模糊性，并使得分解在不可约表示层面具有唯一性，同时每个投影分量携带明确的对称性标签（含转动信息和宇称）。
papers.method_zh: 基于分子动力学（MD）轨迹的模态分析，具体包括Green-Kubo模态分析（GKMA）和均匀非平衡模态分析（HNEMA）；采用线群投影算子构造对称适配的模态基；体系由神经进化势（NEP）描述。

papers.title: Magneto-Structural Coupling Enables Cryogenic Cation Redistribution in a Spinel Oxide
papers.abstract: Ionic transport in oxides is generally frozen at cryogenic temperatures, where thermal energy lies far below typical cation-migration barriers. Neutron powder diffraction reveals progressive Fe/Mg redistribution between tetrahedral (A) and octahedral (B) sites in the spinel Mg0.5Fe0.5TiFeO4 upon cooling from 200 K to 5 K. A-site Fe occupancy increases toward near completion at 5 K within Rietveld resolution, while Ti remains on the B site. This exchange coincides with complex magnetic correlations rather than a classical thermally activated window. Low-temperature magnetostrictive volume changes indicate strong spin-lattice coupling, but do not identify magnetostriction as the sole thermodynamic driver. Room-temperature high-pressure X-ray diffraction produces the opposite occupancy trend, showing that volume contraction alone cannot explain the cryogenic site exchange. These results point to magneto-structural free-energy minimization as a plausible mechanism for unlocking cryogenic cation mobility in a correlated spinel oxide.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了中子粉末衍射、高压X射线衍射等实验手段，并描述了观测到的实验现象。；研究对象：尖晶石氧化物 Mg₀.₅Fe₀.₅TiFeO₄ 中四面体（A）位与八面体（B）位之间 Fe/Mg 阳离子的低温再分布现象，以及其与磁结构耦合的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在从 200 K 冷却至 5 K 的过程中，该尖晶石氧化物中发生了显著的 Fe/Mg 位点交换（A 位 Fe 占据率趋于饱和），这种低温离子迁移并非由热激活主导，而是与磁有序及磁-结构耦合引起的自由能最小化密切相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在从 200 K 冷却至 5 K 的过程中，该尖晶石氧化物中发生了显著的 Fe/Mg 位点交换（A 位 Fe 占据率趋于饱和），这种低温离子迁移并非由热激活主导，而是与磁有序及磁-结构耦合引起的自由能最小化密切相关。；创新点：首次在低温（5 K）下观测到尖晶石氧化物中显著的阳离子位点再分布，并指出磁-结构自由能最小化（而非单纯的热激活或体积收缩）是解锁低温阳离子迁移的可能机制。摘要未突出说明该工作与具体理论模型的对比或潜在应用方向。
papers.method_zh: 变温中子粉末衍射（200 K–5 K，用于追踪阳离子占位与磁结构）；室温高压 X 射线衍射（用于对比体积效应）；Rietveld 精修（用于定量占位率）；通过低温磁致伸缩体积变化分析自旋-晶格耦合强度。

papers.title: Collective Cell Fluidity Controls Active Prestress Transmission in Cell-Extracellular-Matrix Tissues
papers.abstract: Tissues are active composites in which multicellular collectives and extracellular matrices mechanically reorganize one another. We develop a three-dimensional micromechanical model that couples deformable, rearranging cell clusters to a disordered network of semiflexible fibers through a dynamic, force-generating interface. Cell clusters are represented as solid-like or fluid-like vertex-model spheroids and coupled to the matrix by passive or contractile linkers renewed as the cluster boundary reorganizes. Matched intact, voided, and passive-linker controls separate cavity formation, interfacial tethering, and active loading. At small strain, passive tethering provides modest reinforcement, whereas active contraction prestresses and strongly stiffens the matrix. Solid-like clusters preserve coherent force transmission and exhibit an excess modulus scaling approximately as $|σ|^{1.4}$ across changes in activity, cluster size, and cluster number. Fluid-like clusters undergo greater interfacial renewal, producing weaker and nonmonotonic coupling between prestress and stiffness. Increasing cluster number produces collective stiffening when prestressed regions become connected through sufficiently persistent interfaces. At large strain, both solid-like and fluid-like systems approach the corresponding voided-network response as the residual fiber backbone becomes mechanically dominant. Thus, cell-generated prestress controls macroscopic stiffness only together with the organization and persistence of its transmission across the cell-matrix interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a three-dimensional micromechanical model”，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：细胞-细胞外基质（cell-extracellular-matrix）组织复合材料，具体为可变形、可重排的细胞团簇与半柔性纤维无序网络通过动态力生成界面耦合的活性体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞产生的活性预应力对组织宏观刚度的调控并非仅取决于预应力大小，而是依赖于细胞-基质界面上力传递的组织方式与持续性：固态细胞团簇可保持连贯力传递并产生约|σ|^1.4的超额模量标度，而液态团簇因界面更新更频繁导致预应力-刚度耦合更弱且非单调。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞产生的活性预应力对组织宏观刚度的调控并非仅取决于预应力大小，而是依赖于细胞-基质界面上力传递的组织方式与持续性：固态细胞团簇可保持连贯力传递并产生约|σ|^1.4的超额模量标度，而液态团簇因界面更新更频繁导致预应力-刚度耦合更弱且非单调。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于同时考虑细胞团簇的固态/液态可重排特性与动态界面连接子的更新，系统区分了活性收缩、被动锚定和空腔形成对组织力学响应的独立贡献，并揭示了预应力-刚度关系的非普适性依赖于界面传递的持续性。
papers.method_zh: 三维微力学模型：将细胞团簇表示为固态或液态顶点模型（vertex-model）球体，基质为半柔性纤维无序网络，二者通过被动或收缩性连接子（linkers）动态耦合；通过完整、空洞及被动连接子对照实验分离空腔形成、界面锚定与活性加载的贡献。

papers.title: Effect of reactive targets on diffusive transport with intermittent restarts
papers.abstract: We study search processes in a complex environment using the strategy of stochastic resetting. A common occurrence in these environments is targets with finite reactivity. Stochastic resetting has emerged as a powerful mechanism for optimizing search processes by curtailing long, unproductive excursions inherent to diffusive dynamics. Most theoretical studies, however, assume perfectly absorbing targets -- an idealization that overlooks the finite reactivity commonly encountered in realistic chemical and biological systems. In this work, we investigate the interplay between stochastic resetting and finite-target reactivity in reaction - diffusion processes. Considering a one-dimensional system with multiple reactive targets, we demonstrated that the target reactivity modifies the optimization landscape. We uncover distinct regimes in which resetting enhances transport efficiency towards specific targets based on their chemical kinetics. As a consequence, the optimal resetting rate becomes intrinsically reactivity dependent. Our results identify target reactivity as a crucial control parameter governing stochastic transport and provide insights into reaction-diffusion processes in complex media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We investigate”“We demonstrate”等理论推导性表述，且未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：一维反应-扩散系统中的随机搜索过程，具体为具有有限反应活性的多个靶点与随机重置（stochastic resetting）策略之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 靶点的有限反应活性会显著改变随机重置对输运效率的优化景观，导致存在不同参数区间，其中重置对不同化学动力学特性的靶点分别起增强或削弱输运的作用；最优重置率因此本质上依赖于靶点反应活性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：靶点的有限反应活性会显著改变随机重置对输运效率的优化景观，导致存在不同参数区间，其中重置对不同化学动力学特性的靶点分别起增强或削弱输运的作用；最优重置率因此本质上依赖于靶点反应活性。；创新点：突破了以往理论研究中普遍假设的“完全吸收靶点”理想化，首次系统揭示有限靶点反应活性与随机重置之间的耦合效应，并将靶点反应活性确立为调控随机输运的关键参数。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于随机重置策略下的反应-扩散方程，在一维多靶点系统中解析或半解析地研究有限反应性边界条件下的平均搜索时间与输运效率。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具（如Fokker-Planck方程、首次通过时间理论等）。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium corrections to conserved Ising criticality in scalar active matter: Ward identities, spectrum, and long crossovers
papers.abstract: Active scalar field theories break detailed balance in two physically distinct ways: through a field-dependent noise-to-mobility ratio $Θ(φ)=D(φ)/M(φ)$, and through the gradient activity of Active Model~B+. We classify the resulting perturbations of the conserved Wilson-Fisher fixed point in three dimensions. Working from the Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De~Dominicis (MSRJD) action, a functional renormalization-group (FRG) calculation shows that the transport sector has a block-triangular stability matrix whose leading odd mode has $y_{Θ_1}=-Δ_φ$, while quotienting the gradient sector by its detailed-balance-preserving tangent leaves a chemical and a current-like mode. Two smooth regulators give $y_{Θ_1}\simeq-0.52$, $y_J\simeq-0.56$ and $y_{\rm ch}\simeq-0.89$. The translation Ward identity represents the current operator by a stress-tensor divergence modulo chemical gradients; conservation and causality then make the active stability matrix triangular to all loop orders, and an explicit two-loop calculation in $d=4-ε$ finds no additional contact counterterm. The two slowest modes are separated only by the Ising anomalous dimension, $y_J-y_{Θ_1}=-η$. This relation is a dimension count that holds provided neither operator acquires a further contact anomaly, a condition we establish within the present truncation for $\mathcal O_Θ$ and verify through two loops for $\mathcal O_J$; under it the $d=3$ reference Ising value gives $y_{Θ_1}\simeq-0.5181$ and $y_J\simeq-0.5544$. We derive the parity-resolved finite-size scaling of this near degeneracy, identify block observables that separate the two modes, and show that when the current amplitude dominates the crossover scale lies far beyond any accessible system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：MSRJD作用量、泛函重整化群（FRG）计算、ε展开、Ward恒等式推导等关键词。；研究对象：活性标量场理论（Active Model B+）中守恒Ising临界性的非平衡修正，具体研究三维中守恒Wilson-Fisher不动点受两类细致平衡破缺扰动（场依赖噪声-迁移率比Θ(φ)与梯度活性）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性输运扇区的稳定性矩阵呈块三角结构，两个最慢模式（电流型模式与Θ₁模式）的本征值仅相差Ising反常维度η（y_J − y_Θ₁ = −η），且当电流振幅占主导时交叉尺度远超任何可及系统尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性输运扇区的稳定性矩阵呈块三角结构，两个最慢模式（电流型模式与Θ₁模式）的本征值仅相差Ising反常维度η（y_J − y_Θ₁ = −η），且当电流振幅占主导时交叉尺度远超任何可及系统尺寸。；创新点：首次对活性标量场中两类细致平衡破缺扰动在守恒Wilson-Fisher不动点处进行系统分类，证明活性稳定性矩阵在全圈阶下呈三角结构（基于Ward恒等式），并建立了两个最慢模式近简并关系y_J − y_Θ₁ = −η及其维度计数解释；摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De Dominicis（MSRJD）作用量，采用泛函重整化群（FRG）计算（两种光滑截断），并结合d=4−ε展开进行显式两圈计算；利用平移Ward恒等式将电流算符表示为应力张量散度模化学梯度，推导守恒性与因果性导致的三角结构；还进行了宇称分辨的有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: Room-temperature local strain control of moiré excitons in MoS$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices in heterobilayers of atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a versatile platform for exploring quantum many-body physics as they can trap excitons, leading to the formation of quantized moiré exciton states. However, such moiré excitons have been predominantly studied at cryogenic temperatures, which severely limits their practical applications. Here, we demonstrate room-temperature activation and control of moiré excitons in MoS$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers using local strain engineering. Applying mechanical strain with a modified atomic force microscopy tip, we observe a series of resonances attributed to interlayer exciton states confined in the moiré potential. Power-dependent photoluminescence measurements elucidate the population dynamics of the moiré exciton states, while controlled local strain enables continuous tuning of their emission wavelength to the center of the second telecom window. We provide a theoretical model that captures all experimentally observed features, including the unconventional spectral shape of the moiré exciton emission. Our findings establish local tip-induced strain as a powerful tool for the on-demand manipulation of moiré excitons, paving the way for room-temperature quantum excitonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论建模）。判断依据：摘要描述实验观测（施加机械应变、光致发光测量），并辅以理论模型解释实验现象。；研究对象：MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中的莫尔激子，具体为室温下通过局域应变调控的层间激子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械应变，可在室温下激活并调控 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中的莫尔激子，实现其发射波长连续调谐至第二电信窗口中心，并建立了能解释所有实验特征（包括非常规光谱线形）的理论模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械应变，可在室温下激活并调控 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中的莫尔激子，实现其发射波长连续调谐至第二电信窗口中心，并建立了能解释所有实验特征（包括非常规光谱线形）的理论模型。；创新点：首次在室温下实现莫尔激子的激活与局域应变调控（此前莫尔激子研究主要局限于低温），并展示了局域针尖应变作为按需操控莫尔激子的工具，为室温量子激子器件铺路。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用改性原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械应变；通过功率依赖的光致发光（PL）谱测量研究莫尔激子态的布居动力学；理论上构建模型以解释实验观测到的光谱特征。

papers.title: In silico design of magnonic lasing in constricted waveguides
papers.abstract: Analogue black-hole systems have been proposed in various physical platforms, including magnetic materials, offering rich physics and promising applications such as wave lasing. However, their practical realization and characterization remain largely unexplored. Here, we present an in silico study of magnonic black-hole phenomena in constricted ferromagnetic waveguides driven by spin-polarized currents. Using micromagnetic simulations with a two-dimensional Poisson solver to obtain realistic current-density profiles, we demonstrate the formation of a double-hole cavity bounded by analogue event horizons, enabling resonant spin-wave amplification. We characterize the resonances as a function of magnetic and geometric parameters and identify the corresponding spin-wave modes. We further show that gradual tapers enhance transmission by suppressing spin-wave reflections, while interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction can mimic the current-induced Doppler shift, substantially reducing the critical current density required for applications and, consequently, Joule heating. Finally, we demonstrate a spin-wave laser in which thermally excited spin waves undergo selective amplification and coherent emission at well-defined resonance frequencies. These results provide design principles for magnonic analogues of gravitational systems and point toward their potential for advanced spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“in silico study”（计算机模拟研究）、“micromagnetic simulations”（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：收缩型铁磁波导（constricted ferromagnetic waveguides）中的磁子（自旋波）黑洞现象，以及由自旋极化电流驱动的磁子激射（magnonic lasing）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在收缩型铁磁波导中，自旋极化电流可形成由模拟事件视界（analogue event horizons）包围的双黑洞腔（double-hole cavity），实现自旋波的共振放大；通过优化几何结构和利用界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，可显著降低临界电流密度，最终实现热激发自旋波的选择性放大和相干发射，即自旋波激光器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在收缩型铁磁波导中，自旋极化电流可形成由模拟事件视界（analogue event horizons）包围的双黑洞腔（double-hole cavity），实现自旋波的共振放大；通过优化几何结构和利用界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，可显著降低临界电流密度，最终实现热激发自旋波的选择性放大和相干发射，即自旋波激光器。；创新点：首次在收缩波导体系中通过微磁模拟系统展示了磁子黑洞双腔的形成与共振放大机制，并提出利用界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用模拟电流诱导的多普勒频移，从而大幅降低临界电流密度和焦耳热——这一策略在摘要中作为关键设计原则被突出强调。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），并结合二维泊松方程求解器（two-dimensional Poisson solver）以获得真实的电流密度分布。系统扫描了磁学参数和几何参数以表征共振模式。

papers.title: Ferroelastic domain switching by ultrafast photoinduced strain
papers.abstract: The crystal lattice underpins the fundamental properties of condensed matter, with ferroic order emerging sensitively from atomic coordination. Manipulating the lattic therefore promises a direct way to switch ferroics between their states. Infrared excitation provides an efficient pathway to drive lattice motion and generate transient crystal deformations and strains. Ferroelastics constitute a uniquely direct platform for such control, their order parameter being strain itself. However, whether ultrafast laser-induced lattice distortions can switch ferroelastic order remains unknown. Here we use ultrafast pump-probe microscopy to demonstrate that a single high-amplitude infrared pulse induces strain within the first nanosecond, followed by ferroelastic domain switching several nanoseconds later. The spatial distribution follows that expected from the photoinduced strain field, while their temporal evolution is closely coupled to the strain dynamics. Our observations identify transient strain as the driving field for ferroelastic switching and suggest a general lattice-mediated pathway for controlling ferroic order using infrared light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“ultrafast pump-probe microscopy”（超快泵浦-探测显微术），并描述了实验观测的时间演化过程。；研究对象：铁弹体（ferroelastic）材料中的铁弹畴（ferroelastic domain）及其超快光致应变驱动的畴切换现象。具体材料体系摘要未明确说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个高幅度红外脉冲可在第一个纳秒内诱导晶格应变，并在数纳秒后引发铁弹畴切换；光致应变场是驱动铁弹畴切换的直接物理场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个高幅度红外脉冲可在第一个纳秒内诱导晶格应变，并在数纳秒后引发铁弹畴切换；光致应变场是驱动铁弹畴切换的直接物理场。；创新点：首次实验证明超快激光诱导的瞬态晶格畸变（而非直接热效应或电子激发）能够切换铁弹有序态，提出了一种通过红外光控制铁性有序的普适晶格介导路径。摘要未突出说明与已有铁弹切换研究（如应力或电场驱动）的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 超快泵浦-探测光学显微术（ultrafast pump-probe microscopy），用于同时测量光致应变的空间分布与时间演化，并关联畴切换动力学。

papers.title: Quantum Structural Renormalization and Anharmonic Stabilization of Superconductivity in P4/mmm YScH8
papers.abstract: The recent synthesis of P4/mmm-YScH$_{8}$ at 191.7 GPa with a superconducting critical temperature Tc of 113 K has attracted considerable interest in the study of ternary superhydrides. Here we systematically evaluate the effects of quantum and anharmonic motion of ions in P4/mmm-YScH$_{8}$ using the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA). We find that these effects renormalize the crystal structure and lower the dynamical stability threshold pressure from $\sim$140 GPa to $\sim$84 GPa, a reduction of about 40%. Furthermore, neglecting these effects causes a significant overestimation of the $T_{c}$, for instance by $\sim$20 K at 190 GPa. Our prediction of $T_{c}$ at 190 GPa is 113 K ($μ^{*}$= 0.13), close to the experimental observation. Analysis of the phonon density of states and Eliashberg spectral function further reveals site-dependent contributions to superconductivity. These results establish that a consistent treatment of nuclear quantum motion and anharmonicity is essential for accurately predicting superconductivity in compressed ternary hydrides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA)”这一理论计算方法，并系统评估量子与非谐效应，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：三元超氢化物 P4/mmm-YScH₈，具体关注其在高压下的晶体结构、动力学稳定性以及超导电性（Tc）的预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子量子运动与非谐效应会显著重正化晶体结构，将动力学稳定压力阈值从约140 GPa降至约84 GPa（降低约40%）；忽略这些效应会严重高估Tc（在190 GPa下约高估20 K），而考虑这些效应后预测的Tc为113 K（μ*=0.13），与实验观测一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子量子运动与非谐效应会显著重正化晶体结构，将动力学稳定压力阈值从约140 GPa降至约84 GPa（降低约40%）；忽略这些效应会严重高估Tc（在190 GPa下约高估20 K），而考虑这些效应后预测的Tc为113 K（μ*=0.13），与实验观测一致。；创新点：首次在P4/mmm-YScH₈中系统揭示核量子运动与非谐效应对结构稳定性和超导Tc的关键影响，证明在压缩三元氢化物中必须一致处理这些效应才能准确预测超导电性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 随机自洽谐波近似（SSCHA），用于处理核量子运动与非谐效应；结合声子态密度和Eliashberg谱函数分析，进行超导临界温度（Tc）的预测（采用μ*=0.13）。

papers.title: Vitrification-Devitrification Enables Tunable Photonic and Gas Sorption Properties of Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks
papers.abstract: Zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF) glasses represent an emerging family of melt-quenched glasses, which exhibit immense potential for applications in gas separation, energy storage, and optics. However, their intrinsic porosity remains elusive due to the inherent challenges in resolving their disordered atomistic structures. Here, we systematically investigate the porosity of ZIF-4 and ZIF-62 crystals and their corresponding glasses. CO2 sorption at 195 K enables quantitative assessment of microporosity in both crystalline and glassy states, allowing the accessible micropore volume of the ZIF glasses to be determined. Moreover, establishing a direct relationship between photonic properties and structural porosity in Zn-based ZIF glasses remains challenging. Here we demonstrate striking broadband blue-light emission from ZIF-4 glass annealed under optimized conditions. A pronounced red shift is observed when increasing the annealing temperature above the glass transition temperature. By correlating the evolution of photoluminescence with structural porosity, we reveal the interplay between the photonic and gas sorption properties of ZIF glasses. These findings provide new insights into the structure-property relationships of ZIF glasses and offer a pathway toward the rational design of multifunctional MOF glasses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中提及CO₂吸附实验、光致发光测量以及玻璃退火处理等实验手段。；研究对象：沸石咪唑酯骨架（ZIF）材料，具体为ZIF-4和ZIF-62的晶体及其熔融淬火玻璃态，关注其微孔性、气体吸附性能与光子（发光）性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过CO₂吸附定量测定了ZIF玻璃的可及微孔体积；在优化条件下退火的ZIF-4玻璃表现出宽带蓝光发射，且随退火温度升高（超过玻璃化转变温度）出现显著红移，揭示了ZIF玻璃中光子性质与结构孔隙率之间的关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过CO₂吸附定量测定了ZIF玻璃的可及微孔体积；在优化条件下退火的ZIF-4玻璃表现出宽带蓝光发射，且随退火温度升高（超过玻璃化转变温度）出现显著红移，揭示了ZIF玻璃中光子性质与结构孔隙率之间的关联。；创新点：首次在ZIF玻璃中建立光致发光演化与结构孔隙率之间的直接关联，展示了玻璃化-去玻璃化过程对光子与气体吸附性能的可调性，为多功能MOF玻璃的理性设计提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 低温（195 K）CO₂吸附实验用于定量评估晶体与玻璃态的微孔率；对ZIF-4玻璃进行不同温度（高于玻璃化转变温度）的退火处理，并结合光致发光光谱表征其发光行为；将发光演化与结构孔隙率变化进行关联分析。

papers.title: Anomalous Superfluid Response in Altermagnetic Superconductors
papers.abstract: We report on the emergence of the anomalous (paramagnetic) superfluid response in altermagnetic superconductors at arbitrary impurity concentrations. Due to anisotropic gapless superconductivity, altermagnetic superconductors with an out-of-plane Zeeman field display an anisotropic paramagnetic Meissner effect. The effect is strongest for parallel altermagnetic and Zeeman exchange field vectors and in the clean sample. The presence of nonmagnetic impurities leads to isotropisation and, consequently, weakens the effect; however, the paramagnetic response sustains intermediate amounts of impurities in the system. As demonstrated in recent experiments, microwave superfluid stiffness measurements can serve as a sensitive probe of gapless superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We report on the emergence...”描述理论预言，涉及“arbitrary impurity concentrations”的理论处理，以及“microwave superfluid stiffness measurements”作为实验建议，但本身为理论分析。；研究对象：交错磁超导体（altermagnetic superconductors）中的超流体响应，特别是存在面外塞曼场（out-of-plane Zeeman field）时出现的反常（顺磁）迈斯纳效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交错磁超导体在任意杂质浓度下均可出现反常（顺磁）超流体响应，表现为各向异性的顺磁迈斯纳效应；该效应在交错磁与塞曼交换场平行且样品干净时最强，非磁杂质会使其各向同性化并削弱该效应，但中等杂质浓度下顺磁响应仍然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交错磁超导体在任意杂质浓度下均可出现反常（顺磁）超流体响应，表现为各向异性的顺磁迈斯纳效应；该效应在交错磁与塞曼交换场平行且样品干净时最强，非磁杂质会使其各向同性化并削弱该效应，但中等杂质浓度下顺磁响应仍然存在。；创新点：首次预言交错磁超导体中在任意杂质浓度下均存在反常顺磁超流体响应，并指出该效应可通过微波超流体刚度测量进行灵敏探测，为无隙超导电性提供实验探针。（摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比差异。）
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于各向异性无隙超导电性（anisotropic gapless superconductivity）的框架，考察杂质浓度对超流体响应的影响（摘要未明确说明具体方法，如是否使用自洽玻恩近似或T矩阵方法，但涉及“任意杂质浓度”的处理）。
