papers.title: Vortex-core Majorana coupling to a chiral edge in a $p_x+ip_y$ superconductor: Nonmonotonic spectral reorganization and coherent fermion-parity dynamics
papers.abstract: We study how vortex--edge coupling reorganizes the low-energy sector of a finite two-dimensional \(p_x+ip_y\) superconducting disk as a function of the vortex--boundary separation \(d\) and examine what this reorganization implies for the parity memory associated with a prescribed vortex-core Majorana wave packet, a resource relevant to Majorana-based quantum operations. Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations reveal nonmonotonic core--edge reorganization of the lowest positive-energy finite-disk eigenstate, with particularly rapid variation near \(d\simeq7ξ\), where \(ξ\) is the coherence length. To separate this eigenstate reorganization from the spectral representation of a prescribed state, we rigidly translate a centered-vortex core-reference packet to each fixed vortex position, restrict it to the target disk, and project it, without intermediate normalization, onto the particle-hole-complete low-energy subspace. For \(Δ_0/E_F=0.36\) and disk radius \(R=30ξ\), the resulting retained norm exceeds \(0.98\) at all six sampled separations, \(4.25\leq d/ξ\leq8.25\), while, depending on \(d\), the spectral measure is concentrated near zero energy, fragmented over several low-energy levels, or dominated by finite-energy weight. Correspondingly, the signed parity correlator displays slow temporal variation, rapid coherent dephasing, or sign-changing oscillations, with possible finite-size recurrences at later times. Thus a large retained norm does not by itself imply spectral concentration or persistent parity memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Bogoliubov–de Gennes calculations”，属于基于模型哈密顿量的数值计算研究，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：有限二维 \(p_x+ip_y\) 超导圆盘中的涡旋—手性边缘耦合体系，具体关注涡旋芯马约拉纳波包与边缘态之间的低能谱重组，以及由此导致的费米子宇称记忆动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 涡旋—边缘分离距离 \(d\) 的变化会引起最低正能本征态的非单调重组，尤其在 \(d\simeq 7\xi\) 附近变化剧烈；即使投影保留范数超过 0.98，谱权重仍可能分散于多个低能级或集中于有限能量，因此大的保留范数并不保证谱集中或持久的宇称记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：涡旋—边缘分离距离 \(d\) 的变化会引起最低正能本征态的非单调重组，尤其在 \(d\simeq 7\xi\) 附近变化剧烈；即使投影保留范数超过 0.98，谱权重仍可能分散于多个低能级或集中于有限能量，因此大的保留范数并不保证谱集中或持久的宇称记忆。；创新点：将“本征态重组”与“指定态的谱表示”明确分离，通过刚性平移投影方法定量评估涡旋芯马约拉纳波包在涡旋—边缘耦合下的谱集中度与宇称记忆保持能力，揭示了保留范数大并不等同于谱集中或宇称记忆持久的反直觉结论。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Bogoliubov–de Gennes（BdG）方程对有限尺寸 \(p_x+ip_y\) 超导圆盘进行数值对角化；通过刚性平移中心涡旋参考波包至固定涡旋位置，限制到目标圆盘后投影到粒子—空穴完备的低能子空间（不做中间归一化），分析谱权重分布与宇称关联函数的时间演化。

papers.title: Linker Functionalization and pH Tuning Enhance Solar-Driven Catalytic CO$_2$ Reduction in MOF-5
papers.abstract: The wide band gap of metal-organic framework (MOF) 5 constrains its use in photocatalytic carbon dioxide (CO$_2$) reduction despite its high porosity and favorable mass-transport properties. Adopting a state-of-the-art first-principles approach, we systematically investigate the effects of volumetric strain, metal-node substitution, linker functionalization, and pH control as knobs to improve the CO$_2$ photocatalytic ability of MOF-5. Strain and metal-node substitution negligibly affect the gap, whereas linker functionalization narrows it into the visible range via in-gap states while preserving reduction-side alignment at pH = 0. The resulting reduction energetics are strongly sensitive to both linker functionalization and pH. Halogenated and hydroxylated frameworks provide access primarily to HCOOH, CO, and HCHO under alkaline conditions, principally with the Mg and Zn nodes, whereas COOH functionalization offers the broadest thermodynamic accessibility across the full CO$_2$ reduction sequence. NH$_2$ retains thermodynamic feasibility for all target reduction pathways but with larger overpotentials, while NO$_2$ generally yields unfavorable reduction energetics. Crucially, within the COOH series, the choice of the metal node tunes the fundamental gap by over 1 eV with only minor changes in the reduction overpotentials, placing Sr- and Ba-based architectures as the most favorable ones for broad product selectivity with visible-light excitation. Linker functionalization substantially reduces the spatial overlap of the frontier states, promoting photoinduced charge separation. Taken together, these results establish linker functionalization and solution pH as complementary design levers for independently tuning light absorption and CO$_2$-reduction energetics in MOF-5, establishing a rational and viable route for designing efficient MOF-based photocatalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles approach”（第一性原理方法），属于基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算研究。；研究对象：MOF-5（金属有机框架材料）及其衍生物，具体研究其作为光催化剂用于CO₂还原反应时的电子结构与热力学性质，涉及体积应变、金属节点取代（Mg、Zn、Sr、Ba等）、连接基官能化（卤素、羟基、COOH、NH₂、NO₂）以及溶液pH值对催化性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 连接基官能化可将MOF-5的带隙从宽禁带窄化至可见光范围，同时保持CO₂还原侧的能带对齐；官能化种类与pH值共同决定还原产物的热力学可行性，其中COOH官能化配合Sr/Ba金属节点在可见光激发下具有最宽的产物选择性窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：连接基官能化可将MOF-5的带隙从宽禁带窄化至可见光范围，同时保持CO₂还原侧的能带对齐；官能化种类与pH值共同决定还原产物的热力学可行性，其中COOH官能化配合Sr/Ba金属节点在可见光激发下具有最宽的产物选择性窗口。；创新点：首次系统性地将连接基官能化与溶液pH作为两个独立的设计旋钮，实现对MOF-5光吸收范围与CO₂还原热力学的解耦调控；发现COOH官能化系列中金属节点选择可调谐带隙超过1 eV而几乎不影响还原过电位，为理性设计MOF基光催化剂提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），具体包括：对体积应变、金属节点取代、连接基官能化及pH条件进行系统扫描；计算带隙、能带对齐（还原侧）、还原过电位、前线轨道空间重叠（用于评估光生电荷分离）。摘要未明确说明具体泛函类型（如PBE、HSE06等）或是否含范德华修正。

papers.title: Decoding Oxygen K-edge Fingerprints of NCM-811 Degradation via Ab Initio Many-Body Theory and High-Throughput Screening of Crystal Proxies
papers.abstract: The degradation of LiNi$_{0.8}$Co$_{0.1}$Mn$_{0.1}$O$_2$ (NCM-811) in Li-ion batteries produces complex transition-metal oxides and binary phases that fundamentally limit cathode performance. While identifying these degradation products via X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is essential for mitigating electrochemical performance loss, interpretation remains challenging due to the structural complexity of real-world samples. In this work, we present an integrated theoretical-experimental framework combining high-resolution oxygen K-edge XAS with \textit{ab initio} simulations based on many-body perturbation theory and high-throughput screening from density functional theory. We first evaluate the spectroscopic fingerprints of eight layered, spinel, and nominal rock-salt reference oxides, identifying discrepancies between the idealized single-crystal bulk phase and experimental spectra. Using high-throughput screening to analyze the oxygen $p$-projected density of states of 38 distinct polymorphs of NiO, CoO, and MnO, we propose that the spectral differences can emerge, among other factors, from a structural ensemble of local variations represented here by simplified structural proxies. Our work establishes a viable and rigorous computational pathway to interpret the complex landscape of degraded battery materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“high-resolution oxygen K-edge XAS”（实验手段）与“ab initio simulations based on many-body perturbation theory and high-throughput screening from density functional theory”（理论计算方法）。；研究对象：锂离子电池正极材料LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂（NCM-811）的退化产物，具体包括其退化过程中产生的过渡金属氧化物（NiO、CoO、MnO）及其多种多晶型物，以及层状、尖晶石和名义岩盐结构的参考氧化物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对比理想单晶体相与实验光谱，发现NCM-811退化产物的氧K边XAS光谱差异可能源于多种局部结构变体的集合（以简化结构代理物表示），而非单一理想晶体相。该工作建立了从计算角度解读退化电池材料复杂光谱景观的可行途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对比理想单晶体相与实验光谱，发现NCM-811退化产物的氧K边XAS光谱差异可能源于多种局部结构变体的集合（以简化结构代理物表示），而非单一理想晶体相。该工作建立了从计算角度解读退化电池材料复杂光谱景观的可行途径。；创新点：将高通量晶体结构筛选与多体微扰理论光谱模拟相结合，用简化的结构代理物（structural proxies）来表征真实退化样品中复杂的局部结构变化，从而弥合理想单晶计算与实验光谱之间的差距。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 1）高分辨率氧K边X射线吸收光谱（XAS）；2）基于多体微扰理论的从头算模拟（ab initio many-body perturbation theory）；3）基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的高通量筛选，用于分析38种NiO、CoO、MnO多晶型物的氧p投影态密度（oxygen p-projected density of states）。

papers.title: The Locality Cost of Fully Flat Hopf Insulators
papers.abstract: Hopf topology permits a strictly finite-range Hamiltonian with one exactly flat topological band. We prove, however, that extending flatness to the complete two-band spectrum necessarily sacrifices strict locality or the gap: any gapped, Hermitian, translationally invariant two-band Hamiltonian with strictly finite-range hopping and two exactly flat bands has vanishing Hopf invariant. Equivalently, within this two-band setting, a Hopf band admits no compactly supported, translation-covariant, orthonormal Wannier generator. For factorized one-flat-band Hopf parents, the unavoidable partner dispersion equals the Gram symbol of translated compact localized states and encodes their nonorthogonality. Full flattening converts this dispersion into exponentially decaying but infinitely supported hopping. Model-independent bounds provide a sufficient criterion for finite-range approximants to retain the Hopf phase. An explicit model yields the axial decay length $ξ_z/a=1/\ln 2$, parameter-free hopping tails, and residual bandwidths testable in circuit and photonic lattices. Hopf topology therefore does not prohibit a flat band but forces the locality--flatness cost to appear as either partner-band dispersion or nonlocal hopping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We prove”“model-independent bounds”“explicit model”等理论推导与模型构建关键词。；研究对象：Hopf绝缘体中的完全平坦能带问题，具体为二维两带Hopf拓扑系统，以及其紧致局域态（compact localized states）与Wannier生成元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有严格有限程跃迁和两条完全平坦能带的平移不变两带哈密顿量中，Hopf不变量必然为零；即Hopf拓扑带无法同时满足完全平坦、严格局域跃迁和能隙存在这三个条件，必须牺牲其中之一（表现为伙伴带色散或非局域跃迁）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有严格有限程跃迁和两条完全平坦能带的平移不变两带哈密顿量中，Hopf不变量必然为零；即Hopf拓扑带无法同时满足完全平坦、严格局域跃迁和能隙存在这三个条件，必须牺牲其中之一（表现为伙伴带色散或非局域跃迁）。；创新点：首次严格证明了在完整两带谱中“完全平坦”与“严格局域”不可兼得（除非Hopf拓扑消失），并将这一代价定量化为伙伴带色散或指数衰减的非局域跃迁；提供了可直接在电路和光子晶格中检验的具体模型预言。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与解析建模：利用平移协变Wannier生成元的紧支撑性质证明Hopf不变量的消失；通过因子化单平坦带Hopf母哈密顿量分析伙伴带色散与Gram符号的关系；构造显式模型给出无参数的跃迁尾部衰减长度ξ_z/a=1/ln 2，并给出模型无关的有限程近似保持Hopf相的充分判据。

papers.title: Charge-Transfer Electronic Structure of NiX$_2$ (X = S, Se)
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic structures of NiS$_2$ and NiSe$_2$ using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT). A realistic electronic structure within DFT+DMFT was determined by optimizing the double-counting correction to reproduce experimental valence-band photoemission spectra. The validity of the present model is further confirmed by its successful description of the Ni 2$p$ core-level photoemission and Ni $L$-edge x-ray absorption spectra of NiS$_2$. Our results reveal a smaller charge-transfer energy than previously assumed, resulting in substantial ligand-to-Ni charge transfer and a reduced Ni local moment. We clarify how the relative position and interaction between the Ni upper Hubbard band and the antibonding chalcogen-dimer states shape the evolution of the low-energy electronic structure across the NiS$_{2-x}$Se$_x$ series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT)”，属于第一性原理多体计算方法。；研究对象：NiS₂和NiSe₂（以及NiS₂₋ₓSeₓ系列）的电荷转移电子结构，重点关注Ni 3d与硫族二聚体态之间的相互作用及低能电子结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DFT+DMFT计算揭示NiX₂（X = S, Se）的电荷转移能比此前认为的更小，导致显著的配体→Ni电荷转移和减小的Ni局域磁矩；Ni上Hubbard带与反键硫族二聚体态的相对位置和相互作用决定了NiS₂₋ₓSeₓ系列低能电子结构的演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DFT+DMFT计算揭示NiX₂（X = S, Se）的电荷转移能比此前认为的更小，导致显著的配体→Ni电荷转移和减小的Ni局域磁矩；Ni上Hubbard带与反键硫族二聚体态的相对位置和相互作用决定了NiS₂₋ₓSeₓ系列低能电子结构的演化。；创新点：通过系统优化双计数修正获得与多种光谱实验定量一致的现实电子结构，并修正了此前对电荷转移能的估计，澄清了NiS₂₋ₓSeₓ系列中上Hubbard带与硫族二聚体反键态的相互作用如何驱动电子结构演化。
papers.method_zh: DFT+DMFT（密度泛函理论+动力学平均场理论），通过优化双计数修正以复现实验价带光电子谱，并进一步用Ni 2p芯级光电子谱和Ni L边X射线吸收谱验证模型有效性。

papers.title: EuIn2Sb2: epitaxially stabilized axion insulator candidate with strong spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: Eu triangular lattice layer compounds described by the general formula EuA2X2 have attracted growing attention due to a wide range of layered crystal structures and corresponding magnetic topological phases, arising from the coexistence of large Eu magnetic moments and energetically inverted A and X bands. Among the EuA2X2 family, EuIn2Sb2 has been predicted to host robust axion insulator and higher-order topological insulator states by stronger spin-orbit coupling but has not been experimentally realized, including the structural identification. Here we report the epitaxial stabilization of EuIn2Sb2 by adopting the molecular beam epitaxy technique. Structural characterization reveals that EuIn2Sb2 films are based on a unique In-on-In stacking, forming a new trilayer structure distinct from previously predicted structures in the EuA2X2 family. In addition to the in-plane antiferromagnetic ordering at TN=10.5K, the stronger spin-orbit coupling and enhanced In-In hybridization in EuIn2Sb2 make it an ideal candidate of axion insulator and higher-order topological insulator phases. These results establish EuIn2Sb2 as a new member of the EuA2X2 family and offer an advanced platform for exploring these magnetic topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“molecular beam epitaxy technique”（分子束外延）、“Structural characterization”（结构表征）等实验手段。；研究对象：EuIn2Sb2薄膜——一种EuA2X2家族的新型层状化合物，属于磁性拓扑材料体系，具体关注其作为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体候选材料的物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子束外延技术成功实现了EuIn2Sb2的外延稳定生长，发现其具有独特的In-on-In堆叠形成的新型三层结构（不同于该家族此前预测的结构），并在TN=10.5K处表现出面内反铁磁有序。该材料因更强的自旋轨道耦合和增强的In-In杂化，成为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体的理想候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子束外延技术成功实现了EuIn2Sb2的外延稳定生长，发现其具有独特的In-on-In堆叠形成的新型三层结构（不同于该家族此前预测的结构），并在TN=10.5K处表现出面内反铁磁有序。该材料因更强的自旋轨道耦合和增强的In-In杂化，成为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体的理想候选材料。；创新点：首次实验实现了EuIn2Sb2的外延稳定生长并完成结构鉴定（此前该材料仅停留在理论预测阶段，尚未被实验实现）；发现了一种与EuA2X2家族此前预测结构不同的新型三层结构（In-on-In堆叠），确立了EuIn2Sb2作为该家族新成员的地位。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长技术；结构表征手段（摘要未具体说明使用何种表征工具，如RHEED、XRD或STEM等）；磁性测量（用于确定TN=10.5K的面内反铁磁有序）。

papers.title: Persistence and emergence of quantum defects through pressure-induced phase changes
papers.abstract: Extreme pressures can transform materials and their properties, but probing these in-situ is made challenging by the small sample volumes and access requirements demanded by diamond anvil cells. Quantum defects offer a route to local measurements under such conditions, yet their sensing performance can be dictated by pressure-induced changes in their own host material. On the other hand, pressure may also be harnessed as a tool to engineer and stabilize new quantum defects with emergent functionalities. Here, we demonstrate both aspects within a unified platform based on optically active spin-pair defects in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). As robust quantum sensors under pressure, these spin-1/2 systems retain pressure-independent spin resonances up to 20 GPa while maintaining or even enhancing their optical emission, in stark contrast to the spin-1 boron-vacancy centre in the same material. Simultaneously, we show that compression acts as a means of quantum defect engineering: the starting hBN undergoes an irreversible transformation into wurtzite boron nitride (wBN), during which the defect landscape is reconfigured. Spin-pair sensors are seen to persist across this structural transition, however, depending on the starting material we also observe new, highly fluorescent defects in the wBN phase. These results establish spin-pair defects in boron nitride as pressure-resilient quantum sensors while highlighting high pressure itself as a versatile pathway for creating and tuning quantum emitters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“demonstrate”“observed”“probe”“measurements”等实验性关键词，且涉及金刚石对顶砧（diamond anvil cells）等实验装置。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的光学活性自旋对（spin-pair）量子缺陷，以及压力诱导的hBN→纤锌矿氮化硼（wBN）结构相变过程中缺陷的演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋对缺陷（自旋1/2体系）在高达20 GPa压力下保持压力无关的自旋共振且光学发射不衰减甚至增强，是优异的耐压量子传感器；同时，压力可作为一种缺陷工程手段，在hBN不可逆转变为wBN的过程中重构缺陷景观，并可能产生新型高荧光缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋对缺陷（自旋1/2体系）在高达20 GPa压力下保持压力无关的自旋共振且光学发射不衰减甚至增强，是优异的耐压量子传感器；同时，压力可作为一种缺陷工程手段，在hBN不可逆转变为wBN的过程中重构缺陷景观，并可能产生新型高荧光缺陷。；创新点：首次在同一平台上同时展示量子缺陷的耐压传感性能与压力诱导缺陷工程：一方面证明自旋对缺陷比自旋1硼空位中心具有更强的压力鲁棒性；另一方面揭示高压本身可作为创造和调控新型量子发射体的通用途径。摘要未突出说明与已有高压缺陷研究的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 高压原位光学与自旋测量：利用金刚石对顶砧（DAC）产生高压，结合光致发光（PL）和光探测磁共振（ODMR）等手段表征缺陷的光学发射与自旋共振特性，并与同材料中的自旋1硼空位中心进行对比。

papers.title: Complete Topological Classification with P and T Symmetries: Revealing a Topological Invariant Invisible to K-Theory
papers.abstract: The K-theoretic framework provides a complete topological classification of the tenfold symmetry classes and has been generalized to incorporate crystalline symmetries. Here, we show that this classification is incomplete even in the elementary case of spinless systems possessing both P and T symmetries. We obtain the complete classification through a first-principles analysis of the topological classes of P- and T-symmetric bands, namely, by classifying the corresponding symmetric clutching data. We identify a topological invariant that is invisible from the K-theoretic perspective when the occupied states at each inversion-invariant momentum have uniformly positive or uniformly negative parity. In special cases, such as when all inversion-invariant momenta have uniformly positive parity, this invariant can be interpreted as the second Stiefel--Whitney class or the Euler number defined over an inversion fundamental domain, namely, half of the Brillouin zone. Our work not only reveals a new topological invariant that cannot be determined from the parity spectra at inversion-invariant momenta under P and T symmetries, but also demonstrates the existence of crystalline topological phases that are absent from the K-theoretic classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“first-principles analysis”“classifying”“K-theoretic framework”等理论分类与数学结构分析关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：具有P（空间反演）和T（时间反演）对称性的无自旋（spinless）电子能带系统，具体关注其拓扑分类问题，尤其是占据态在反演不变动量点上的宇称结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: K-理论框架对同时具有P和T对称性的无自旋系统的拓扑分类是不完备的；作者通过对称性clutching数据的完整分类，发现了一个K-理论无法捕捉的拓扑不变量，该不变量在占据态宇称为均匀正或均匀负时出现，并可能对应第二Stiefel-Whitney类或Euler数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：K-理论框架对同时具有P和T对称性的无自旋系统的拓扑分类是不完备的；作者通过对称性clutching数据的完整分类，发现了一个K-理论无法捕捉的拓扑不变量，该不变量在占据态宇称为均匀正或均匀负时出现，并可能对应第二Stiefel-Whitney类或Euler数。；创新点：揭示了K-理论分类在P和T对称无自旋系统中的不完整性，证明存在K-理论分类所遗漏的晶体拓扑相；该新拓扑不变量无法仅由反演不变动量点上的宇称谱确定。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为拓扑能带分类的数学方法，具体包括：对P-和T-对称能带的拓扑类进行第一性原理分析，即对相应的对称clutching数据进行分类；利用反演基本域（半个布里渊区）上的第二Stiefel-Whitney类或Euler数来诠释新不变量。

papers.title: Bell inequality violation with momentum-entangled massive particles
papers.abstract: Bell's theorem revealed the fundamental incompatibility between the predictions of quantum mechanics and local realism. Bell inequality violations have since demonstrated quantum nonlocality using photons and internal states of massive particles, but never using their motional states. Here we report the first Bell inequality violation in the motional states of massive particles. Using momentum-entangled pairs of metastable helium atoms manipulated by matter-wave interferometry, we measure a Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) Bell parameter of $S = 2.52 \pm 0.17$, violating the CHSH-Bell inequality ($S \le 2$). Our work completes a long-standing objective in quantum atom optics by extending Bell tests from internal quantum variables to the external degrees of freedom of massive particles, opening a new regime for exploring quantum nonlocality in matter waves and for investigating the interplay between quantum mechanics and gravity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确报告了实验测量结果（“we measure a CHSH-Bell parameter of S = 2.52 ± 0.17”），并描述了具体的实验操控手段（matter-wave interferometry）。；研究对象：动量纠缠的亚稳态氦原子对（massive particles，即大质量粒子）的质心运动（motional states）自由度。具体物理现象为：利用物质波干涉实现的大质量粒子动量纠缠态中的贝尔不等式违背。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在大质量粒子的运动学（动量）自由度上观测到贝尔不等式违背，测得CHSH参数 S = 2.52 ± 0.17，明确违反局域实在论界限（S ≤ 2）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在大质量粒子的运动学（动量）自由度上观测到贝尔不等式违背，测得CHSH参数 S = 2.52 ± 0.17，明确违反局域实在论界限（S ≤ 2）。；创新点：将贝尔不等式的检验从光子或大质量粒子的内部量子态（如自旋、偏振）首次拓展到大质量粒子的外部运动自由度（动量），完成了量子原子光学中长期追求的目标，并为探索物质波中的量子非定域性以及量子力学与引力相互作用的新机制开辟了途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用物质波干涉仪（matter-wave interferometry）操控动量纠缠的亚稳态氦原子对，测量其CHSH型贝尔参数。摘要未明确说明具体的干涉仪构型（如是否使用布拉格衍射或拉曼脉冲等），也未提及具体的探测与符合计数方案。

papers.title: Symmetry-enforced third-order nonlinear thermal Hall effects in altermagnets
papers.abstract: Thermal Hall effect (THE) is a powerful probe of material properties, even in insulators. Here we investigate the thermal response of altermagnets by developing a theory on Berry curvature driven nonlinear THE from both electrons and magnons. We identify symmetry conditions under which the third-order THE dominates while linear and second-order contributions vanish. Notably, d-wave and i-wave altermagnets with out-of-plane Neel order satisfy these conditions, whereas in-plane order yields a dominant linear THE. Using KV2Se2O (a d-wave altermagnetic metal) and MnF2 (an altermagnetic insulator) as concrete examples, we show nonzero third-order nonlinear THE from electrons and magnons, respectively, both exhibiting a pi-periodic dependence on the direction of temperature gradient. These symmetry-guaranteed Berry curvature phenomena provide a diagnostic for altermagnetism in candidate materials and enable determination of the Neel vector orientation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“developing a theory”“symmetry conditions”“symmetry-guaranteed”，属于理论分析与对称性论证。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中的非线性热霍尔效应，具体涉及电子和磁振子（magnons）两种载流子，并以d波交变磁金属KV₂Se₂O和交变磁绝缘体MnF₂为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有面外Néel序的d波和i波交变磁体中，三阶非线性热霍尔效应占主导，而线性和二阶贡献为零；该三阶效应随温度梯度方向呈π周期性变化，可用于诊断交变磁性并确定Néel矢量取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有面外Néel序的d波和i波交变磁体中，三阶非线性热霍尔效应占主导，而线性和二阶贡献为零；该三阶效应随温度梯度方向呈π周期性变化，可用于诊断交变磁性并确定Néel矢量取向。；创新点：首次从对称性角度系统阐明交变磁体中三阶非线性热霍尔效应的主导条件，并指出其可作为探测交变磁序和Néel矢量方向的普适诊断工具。摘要未突出说明与以往非线性热霍尔理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Berry曲率驱动的非线性输运理论框架，分别对电子和磁振子贡献进行对称性分析与计算；结合具体材料KV₂Se₂O和MnF₂进行实例验证。摘要未明确说明具体的第一性原理计算方法或数值技术细节。

papers.title: Machine-learning screening and first-principles lattice dynamics resolve the most stable structure of NaCa(BH$_4$)$_3$ from a data-driven candidate search
papers.abstract: Equimolar NaCa(BH$_4$)$_3$ offers a theoretical hydrogen capacity of 11.24 wt.% and a decomposition enthalpy expected to fall between those of NaBH$_4$ and Ca(BH$_4$)$_2$, but it has never been prepared and no crystal structure has been reported. Predictions for it have so far been built within the perovskite family that its heavier homologues adopt. Here that assumption is removed. Six candidate frameworks were assembled from three independent sources --- experimentally determined ABX$_3$ borohydrides, a distorted perovskite from data-driven structure prediction, and an unbiased search over a structural database in which all 2238 generated candidates were relaxed with none excluded --- and at fixed charge-neutral composition the cation arrangement of every framework was enumerated exhaustively, 420 decorations reducing to 118 symmetry-inequivalent configurations, screened with a machine-learning potential and settled from first principles. The most stable structure is not a perovskite. It is a monoclinic framework of space group Cm, reached only by the unrestricted search, at $-$4.185640 eV/atom, 7.67 meV/atom below the best framework available beforehand; two chemically unrelated donor prototypes converge on it to 0.076 meV/atom, and its ordered cation arrangement is the ground state of its own series. Its phonon spectrum carries no imaginary mode at any wavevector the supercell resolves exactly and its relaxed-ion elastic tensor is positive definite, whereas the orthorhombic perovskite candidate is unstable to $-$2.401 THz. That contrast supplies a physical reason for the reported failure to obtain this composition in perovskite form, and the simulated diffraction pattern reported here identifies the predicted framework by seven reflections that neither parent phase nor the competing framework produces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learning screening、first-principles lattice dynamics、data-driven structure prediction、DFT（隐含于“first principles”）、phonon spectrum、elastic tensor。；研究对象：等摩尔比的复合硼氢化物 NaCa(BH₄)₃，一种尚未被实验合成、无已知晶体结构的潜在储氢材料（理论氢容量 11.24 wt.%）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NaCa(BH₄)₃ 最稳定的晶体结构并非其较重同系物所采用的钙钛矿构型，而是一种单斜 Cm 空间群框架，能量比此前最优的钙钛矿候选结构低 7.67 meV/atom；该结构动力学和力学稳定，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在 −2.401 THz 的虚频，解释了为何该组成难以以钙钛矿形式合成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NaCa(BH₄)₃ 最稳定的晶体结构并非其较重同系物所采用的钙钛矿构型，而是一种单斜 Cm 空间群框架，能量比此前最优的钙钛矿候选结构低 7.67 meV/atom；该结构动力学和力学稳定，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在 −2.401 THz 的虚频，解释了为何该组成难以以钙钛矿形式合成。；创新点：突破了以往仅限钙钛矿家族的结构假设，采用无偏的数据驱动候选搜索，发现最稳定结构是非钙钛矿的单斜 Cm 框架；并通过声子虚频对比给出了该组成无法以钙钛矿形式合成的物理原因。摘要未明确说明机器学习势的具体形式或第一性原理计算所用的泛函/软件。
papers.method_zh: 1) 从三个独立来源构建六种候选框架（实验已知 ABX₃ 硼氢化物、数据驱动结构预测的畸变钙钛矿、对结构数据库的无偏搜索，共 2238 个候选全部弛豫）；2) 对固定电荷中性组成下所有框架的阳离子排列进行穷举（420 种装饰简并为 118 种对称不等价构型）；3) 用机器学习势（machine-learning potential）筛选，再用第一性原理（first-principles）方法最终确定能量；4) 计算声子谱（phonon spectrum）和弛豫离子弹性张量（relaxed-ion elastic tensor）验证稳定性；5) 模拟 X 射线衍射图谱用于实验识别。

papers.title: Observation of g-wave altermagnetic multipole
papers.abstract: Over the past few years, altermagnets have emerged as a new class of collinear magnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, offering novel opportunities for spintronics beyond conventional magnets. Rather than from net magnetization, as in ferromagnets, the unconventional time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets originates from antiferroic magnetic dipoles locked to higher-order multipoles. Here we report the direct visualization of a $g$-wave altermagnetic multipole in the canonical altermagnet CrSb. Combining high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction with valence electron density (VED) analysis, we uncover a pronounced directional anisotropy of the VED distribution alternating between Cr sublattices. This evidences the antiferroic order of electric hexadecapoles predicted in $g$-wave altermagnets. Its coexistence with antiferroic magnetic dipoles induces ferroic magnetic multipoles, as probed by polarized neutron diffraction. We further identify a microscopic model of altermagnetism that directly relates the $g$-wave multipole and the $g$-wave spin splitting. Through direct observation and quantification of multipoles, this study provides a real-space fingerprint of altermagnetism and establishes a general probe of hidden multipole order in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“direct visualization”“high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction”“polarized neutron diffraction”等实验手段，并结合了VED分析。；研究对象：典型交错磁体（altermagnet）CrSb，具体研究其g波交错磁多极（g-wave altermagnetic multipole）及其与电子密度分布、磁多极序的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高能同步辐射X射线衍射和价电子密度（VED）分析，直接观测到CrSb中Cr子晶格间VED分布的显著方向各向异性，证实了g波交错磁体中预测的电极十六极（electric hexadecapole）的反铁有序；该有序与反铁磁偶极共存，诱导出铁性磁多极，并通过极化中子衍射得到验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高能同步辐射X射线衍射和价电子密度（VED）分析，直接观测到CrSb中Cr子晶格间VED分布的显著方向各向异性，证实了g波交错磁体中预测的电极十六极（electric hexadecapole）的反铁有序；该有序与反铁磁偶极共存，诱导出铁性磁多极，并通过极化中子衍射得到验证。；创新点：首次在实空间直接观测并量化了g波交错磁多极，为交错磁性提供了实空间指纹，并建立了一种探测量子材料中隐藏多极序的通用方法。
papers.method_zh: 高能同步辐射X射线衍射（结合价电子密度VED分析）、极化中子衍射，以及构建联系g波多极与g波自旋劈裂的微观模型。

papers.title: Non-Additivity of Microwave-Shielded Interactions between Dipolar Molecules
papers.abstract: Theoretical models of the effective interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules typically rely on the assumption of pairwise additivity. In this work, we test the validity of this pairwise approximation by evaluating the exact many-body potential energy for configurations of three and four molecules. We demonstrate that this approximation fails for molecule configurations in the plane of the circularly polarized microwave field. In these planar geometries, many-body effects significantly increase the depth of the attractive potential well and shift the position of the repulsive barrier. Although out-of-plane interactions in three-dimensional arrangements weaken this non-additivity, the effective interactions between microwave-shielded dipoles are not a simple sum of pair interactions. In particular, their attractive well, crucial for self-bound clusters, can only be described by the full many-body potential energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Theoretical models”“evaluating the exact many-body potential energy”，属于理论计算与分析。；研究对象：微波屏蔽（microwave-shielded）的极性分子体系，具体研究三分子和四分子构型中的有效相互作用，以及该相互作用是否满足两两可加性（pairwise additivity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微波屏蔽偶极分子之间的有效相互作用不满足两两可加性假设。在圆偏振微波场平面内的构型中，多体效应显著加深了吸引势阱的深度并移动了排斥势垒的位置；即使在三维排列中，非可加性虽被削弱，但有效相互作用仍不能简单视为两两相互作用之和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微波屏蔽偶极分子之间的有效相互作用不满足两两可加性假设。在圆偏振微波场平面内的构型中，多体效应显著加深了吸引势阱的深度并移动了排斥势垒的位置；即使在三维排列中，非可加性虽被削弱，但有效相互作用仍不能简单视为两两相互作用之和。；创新点：首次直接检验了微波屏蔽极性分子相互作用中两两可加性近似的有效性，并明确指出该近似在平面构型中失效，强调自束缚团簇的吸引势阱必须依赖完整多体势能描述。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 通过精确计算三分子和四分子构型的完整多体势能面（exact many-body potential energy），并与基于两两可加性假设的理论模型结果进行对比，检验该近似的有效性。

papers.title: Interaction effects on Andreev states from an electromagnetic environment
papers.abstract: Here we present a detailed theoretical investigation of the environment-induced interaction correction to the ground states and addition energies in a short superconducting junction. We derive general formulas for these corrections linking them to the frequency-dependent admittance of the junction and the environment impedance. We specify two environmental models: that of an external impedance and the Mattis-Bardeen model. In both cases we assume $G_Q Z \ll 1$, where $G_Q$ is the conductance quantum and $Z$ the typical environmental resistance. While an expectation is that the typical scale of the relative correction is of the order $G_Q Z$, we have found that in many cases the dimensionless scale $L G_Q Δ$ provides a better estimation, where $Δ$ is the superconducting energy gap and $L$ an external inductance. We discuss the logarithmic renormalizations of the energies by low- and high-frequency phase fluctuations and single out a non-superconducting contribution related to the renormalization of transmission eigenvalues. We investigate in detail the peculiarities of the corrections at: i. small phases, where the interaction causes a current jump, ii. Andreev bound state energies close to the gap edge, iii. Andreev bound state energies close to Fermi level. In all these cases the correction may become comparable with the unperturbed energy, even for $G_Q Z \ll 1$, and we briefly sketch non-perturbative models relevant for the situations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“present a detailed theoretical investigation”，并推导了一般公式，属于理论分析。；研究对象：短超导结中的Andreev束缚态，以及电磁环境（外部阻抗、Mattis-Bardeen模型）对这些态的能量和附加能的相互作用修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境诱导的相互作用对Andreev态能量和附加能的相对修正，其典型尺度并非总是预期的$G_Q Z$，在许多情况下由无量纲参数$L G_Q \Delta$更准确地描述；在小相位、能隙边缘及费米能级附近等特殊情形下，即使$G_Q Z \ll 1$，修正也可能与未扰动能同量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境诱导的相互作用对Andreev态能量和附加能的相对修正，其典型尺度并非总是预期的$G_Q Z$，在许多情况下由无量纲参数$L G_Q \Delta$更准确地描述；在小相位、能隙边缘及费米能级附近等特殊情形下，即使$G_Q Z \ll 1$，修正也可能与未扰动能同量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但指出发现了比预期$G_Q Z$更准确的修正尺度$L G_Q \Delta$，并系统分析了三种特殊情形（小相位、能隙边缘、费米能级附近）下修正可能变得显著甚至非微扰的行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将修正量通过结的频率依赖导纳和环境阻抗的一般公式联系起来；针对外部阻抗和Mattis-Bardeen两种环境模型，在$G_Q Z \ll 1$条件下进行微扰分析，并讨论低/高频相位涨落导致的能量对数重整化，以及透射本征值重整化相关的非超导贡献。

papers.title: Microscopic dynamics of contagion using active Brownian particles: universal scaling and propagation controlled by protection
papers.abstract: Understanding how individual protection and population density influence epidemic spreading remains a central challenge in epidemiology. While classical compartmental models successfully describe the temporal evolution of epidemics, they do not explicitly account for the microscopic motion and spatial organisation of individuals. Here, we investigate contagion dynamics using an agent-based model of Active Brownian Particles (ABPs), where self-propelled agents interact through local contact and a prescribed fraction of the population is protected. By systematically varying the protected-agent fraction and the population density, we identify two distinct contagion regimes separated by a crossover protection of approximately $30\%$. Below this threshold, the maximum contagion rate follows the universal scaling $ν_{\mathrm{max}}\proptoφ^{1/2}$, indicating that disease transmission is governed primarily by frequency of encounters. Above the threshold, universal scaling is lost and protection becomes the dominant mechanism controlling epidemic spreading, with the strongest suppression occurring in low-density populations. These results demonstrate that microscopic active-matter models provide a powerful framework for investigating epidemic dynamics beyond the assumptions of well-mixed population models and reveal how spatial organisation and individual protection jointly determine contagion dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“agent-based model”（基于个体的模型）、“Active Brownian Particles”（活性布朗粒子）模拟，属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：传染病传播的微观动力学，具体为活性布朗粒子体系中个体保护比例与人口密度对疫情传播的影响。这是一个统计物理/软物质与流行病学交叉的模型体系，而非特定化合物或材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当保护个体比例低于约30%时，最大传染率满足普适标度 ν_max ∝ φ^(1/2)，传播由相遇频率主导；高于该阈值后，普适标度失效，保护机制成为控制传播的主导因素，且在低密度人群中抑制效果最强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当保护个体比例低于约30%时，最大传染率满足普适标度 ν_max ∝ φ^(1/2)，传播由相遇频率主导；高于该阈值后，普适标度失效，保护机制成为控制传播的主导因素，且在低密度人群中抑制效果最强。；创新点：将活性物质（active matter）的微观运动模型引入流行病传播研究，突破了经典房室模型（compartmental models）中“充分混合”（well-mixed）假设的局限，揭示了空间组织与个体保护共同决定传播动力学的机制。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 基于活性布朗粒子（ABPs）的个体模型（agent-based simulation）：自驱动粒子通过局域接触相互作用，设定一定比例的保护个体，系统改变保护比例和人口密度，统计传染率等动力学量。

papers.title: Machine Learning Local Potentials for Accelerated Electron-Phonon Interactions Calculations within the Projector Augmented-Wave Framework
papers.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions govern carrier dynamics, transport, and many optical and quantum phenomena in solids, but finite-displacement calculations within the projector augmented-wave (PAW) framework require up to 6N self-consistent supercell calculations for an N-atom system, making them costly for large, low-symmetry, and disordered materials. We introduce MLLocP, a machine learning strategy that learns the self-consistent local potential on real-space grids and supplies its displacement derivatives to the evaluation of all-electron PAW electron-phonon matrix elements. Analysis of the PAW decomposition identifies the local-potential contribution as a natural target for machine learning, while the remaining PAW quantities are retained within the established VASP/PHELEL framework. Using targeted grid-point sampling and feature-diversity selection for efficient model training, we validate MLLocP for elemental Cu, polar BAs, and chemically disordered Cu3Au. The learned potentials and their resulting displacement derivatives closely reproduce direct density functional theory calculations, yielding transport coefficients within approximately 3.5% for BAs mobility, 8% for Cu conductivity, and 11% for Cu3Au conductivity. For the 32-atom Cu3Au special quasirandom structure, using 40 sampled configurations reduces the number of self-consistent calculations by about fivefold relative to the 192 displaced structures required directly; using 20 or 10 configurations increases the acceleration to approximately 10- and 20-fold, with conductivity errors of 14.3% and 18.6%, respectively. MLLocP thus provides a scalable route to PAW electron-phonon calculations in complex materials while preserving the underlying all-electron formalism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning strategy、density functional theory calculations、self-consistent supercell calculations。；研究对象：电子-声子相互作用及其驱动的输运性质，具体材料包括元素Cu、极性半导体BAs以及化学无序合金Cu3Au（32原子特殊准随机结构）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出机器学习策略MLLocP，通过学习实空间网格上的自洽局域势及其位移导数，可在投影缀加波（PAW）框架内以远少于直接有限位移法的自洽计算次数，高精度地获得电子-声子矩阵元与输运系数（BAs迁移率误差约3.5%，Cu电导率误差约8%，Cu3Au电导率误差约11%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出机器学习策略MLLocP，通过学习实空间网格上的自洽局域势及其位移导数，可在投影缀加波（PAW）框架内以远少于直接有限位移法的自洽计算次数，高精度地获得电子-声子矩阵元与输运系数（BAs迁移率误差约3.5%，Cu电导率误差约8%，Cu3Au电导率误差约11%）。；创新点：首次将机器学习局域势及其位移导数引入PAW全电子电子-声子计算流程，在保持全电子形式不变的前提下大幅减少自洽超胞计算数量（对32原子Cu3Au，用40个采样构型可将自洽计算量减少约5倍，用10个构型可加速约20倍），为复杂、低对称、无序材料的PAW电子-声子计算提供了可扩展路径。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习（MLLocP）结合PAW框架下的VASP/PHELEC代码；对PAW分解进行分析，将局域势贡献作为机器学习目标，其余PAW量保留在既有框架中；采用目标网格点采样与特征多样性选择进行高效模型训练；通过有限位移法直接DFT计算作为基准验证。

papers.title: Morphology and Dynamics of Self-interstitial Clusters in Irradiated Nickel
papers.abstract: Self-interstitial atom (SIA) clustering is a key early step in radiation damage evolution in face-centered cubic (FCC) metals, governing defect transport, recombination, and the long-term microstructural response of irradiated alloys. We combine molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and high-speed (>1000 frames/s) in situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM) to investigate the structure, energetics, and migration dynamics of SIA clusters in FCC Ni. MD simulations show that interstitials initially form disordered dumbbell clusters that evolve into either sessile Frank loops or glissile perfect (prismatic) loops; the latter progressively reorganize into compact ordered configurations with increasing mobility. Direct construction of both loop types over a wide size range, validated against MD-relaxed structures, shows that perfect loops are thermodynamically favored over Frank loops for cluster sizes N greater than or equal to 14, where N is the number of SIAs, with the energetic advantage increasing with cluster size. Nevertheless, substantial kinetic barriers allow Frank loops to persist as metastable defects. For perfect loops, diffusion coefficients computed over N = 16 to 400 reveal a nearly size-independent migration barrier of approximately 0.02 eV, while the diffusion prefactor decreases approximately as N^(-0.54). Trajectory analysis reveals a non-rigid, row-wise relay mechanism in which the number of participating atoms increases systematically with loop size, accounting for much of the observed prefactor scaling. Sub-millisecond in situ TEM observations reveal intermittent loop motion at velocities higher than previously observed but still several orders of magnitude below the intrinsic mobilities predicted by MD, indicating migration through a heterogeneous energy landscape of mobile and pinned states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：分子动力学（MD）模拟与高速原位透射电子显微镜（TEM）实验相结合。；研究对象：面心立方（FCC）金属镍（Ni）中辐照产生的自间隙原子（SIA）团簇的结构、能量学与迁移动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MD模拟表明，Ni中SIA团簇初始为无序哑铃构型，随后演化为非平衡的Frank环或可滑移的完美（棱柱）环；当团簇尺寸N≥14时完美环在热力学上更稳定，但其迁移受约0.02 eV的近尺寸无关势垒控制，且扩散前因子随尺寸近似按N^(-0.54)衰减。原位TEM观测显示环的间歇性运动速度远低于MD预测的本征迁移率，表明实际迁移受异质能量景观（移动态与钉扎态）调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MD模拟表明，Ni中SIA团簇初始为无序哑铃构型，随后演化为非平衡的Frank环或可滑移的完美（棱柱）环；当团簇尺寸N≥14时完美环在热力学上更稳定，但其迁移受约0.02 eV的近尺寸无关势垒控制，且扩散前因子随尺寸近似按N^(-0.54)衰减。原位TEM观测显示环的间歇性运动速度远低于MD预测的本征迁移率，表明实际迁移受异质能量景观（移动态与钉扎态）调控。；创新点：首次将MD预测的SIA团簇本征迁移率与亚毫秒时间分辨的原位TEM观测直接对比，揭示两者之间数量级的差异并归因于异质能量景观；同时系统给出了完美环扩散前因子随尺寸的标度关系（N^(-0.54)）及其微观机制（行间接力式非刚性迁移）。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟（用于结构演化、能量比较、扩散系数计算与轨迹分析）；高速原位透射电子显微镜（TEM，>1000帧/秒，亚毫秒时间分辨）观测环运动。MD中直接构建两种环类型并在宽尺寸范围内与弛豫结构对照验证。

papers.title: Molecular spin qubits in a van der Waals bottle
papers.abstract: Advancing quantum information technologies requires qubits whose coherence can be precisely engineered. Among the qubit platforms in development, molecular spin qubits (MSQs) stand out for their atomic scale tunability and chemical specificity, making them powerful candidates for sensing, simulation, and information processing. However, integrating MSQs into solid-state architectures without degrading their coherence remains a central challenge. Here, we introduce van der Waals (vdW) confinement within two-dimensional materials as a strategy for stabilizing quantum states in MSQs by engineering their local electronic, vibrational, and symmetry environments. Using cobaltocene as a model system, we show that confinement within vdW SnS2 and CdPS3 single crystals reorganizes the single-ion energy landscape and slows spin-lattice relaxation by over two orders of magnitude relative to unconfined cobaltocene. The confined MSQs adopt deterministic orientations and self-assemble into ordered, atomically precise superlattices, establishing vdW confinement as a pathway for integrating MSQs into functional quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we introduce”“we show”“confinement within vdW SnS2 and CdPS3 single crystals”等表述，涉及实际材料制备与测量（如自旋-晶格弛豫时间测量）。；研究对象：分子自旋量子比特（MSQs），具体以钴茂（cobaltocene）为模型体系，将其限域在二维范德华材料SnS2和CdPS3单晶的层间“范德华瓶”中，研究其电子结构、振动环境与自旋相干/弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将钴茂分子限域于二维范德华晶体层间，可重构其单离子能级景观，并使自旋-晶格弛豫速率比未限域钴茂减慢两个数量级以上；限域后的分子自旋量子比特呈现确定取向并自组装成原子级精确的超晶格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将钴茂分子限域于二维范德华晶体层间，可重构其单离子能级景观，并使自旋-晶格弛豫速率比未限域钴茂减慢两个数量级以上；限域后的分子自旋量子比特呈现确定取向并自组装成原子级精确的超晶格。；创新点：首次提出并验证了“二维材料范德华限域”作为稳定分子自旋量子比特量子态的策略，通过工程化局域电子、振动与对称性环境，在不牺牲相干性的前提下将MSQs集成到固态有序超晶格中，解决了MSQs固态集成中相干性退化的核心难题。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如EPR、磁化率、光谱等），仅提及通过范德华限域实现单晶内分子嵌入，并测量了自旋-晶格弛豫时间（对比限域前后）。具体表征技术（如X射线衍射、电子顺磁共振、拉曼光谱等）摘要未列出。

papers.title: Magnons in Metallic Altermagnetic $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$
papers.abstract: We investigate the spin excitation in altermagnetic vanadium oxyselenides, focusing on the metallic quasi-two-dimensional compound $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$. Using a fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations, we compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation and extract the magnon dispersion relation. We show that the altermagnetic symmetry leads to characteristic degeneracies and directional splittings in both the electronic bands and the magnon spectra along high-symmetry paths of the Brillouin zone. The metallic $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$ exhibits finite magnon linewidths arising from the coupling to the particle-hole continuum. Furthermore, by fixing the magnitude of the wave vector and varying its in-plane direction, we uncover a pronounced angular dependence of the magnon energies and lifetimes, with complementary damping behavior between the two magnon branches. Upon including spin-orbit coupling, the system exhibits an out-of-plane easy c-axis anisotropy, which opens a magnon gap of approximately 6 meV at the $Γ$-point, possibly rendering the magnetic order stable at room temperature. Our results demonstrate that altermagnetism controls not only the dispersion but also the anisotropic decay of spin excitations, highlighting altermagnetic metals as promising platforms for directionally selective magnon transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要提及“fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations”“compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation”，属于第一性原理结合模型计算。；研究对象：金属准二维交错磁（altermagnetic）钒氧硒化合物 KV₂Se₂O，具体研究其磁振子（自旋激发）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交错磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱沿高对称路径出现特征性简并和方向性劈裂；金属性 KV₂Se₂O 的磁振子具有有限线宽（源于粒子-空穴连续谱耦合），且磁振子能量与寿命表现出显著的面内角度依赖，两支磁振子分支的阻尼行为互补。加入自旋-轨道耦合后，体系呈现面外易 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，可能使磁有序在室温下稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交错磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱沿高对称路径出现特征性简并和方向性劈裂；金属性 KV₂Se₂O 的磁振子具有有限线宽（源于粒子-空穴连续谱耦合），且磁振子能量与寿命表现出显著的面内角度依赖，两支磁振子分支的阻尼行为互补。加入自旋-轨道耦合后，体系呈现面外易 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，可能使磁有序在室温下稳定。；创新点：首次揭示在交错磁金属中，交错磁对称性不仅控制磁振子色散，还控制自旋激发各向异性的衰减（方向选择性阻尼），表明交错磁金属可作为方向选择性磁振子输运的候选平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于从头计算（ab initio）导出的费米子哈密顿量，在随机相位近似（RPA）框架下计算横向自旋磁化率，提取磁振子色散关系；并进一步考虑自旋-轨道耦合效应。

papers.title: Symmetry-selective nonrelativistic spin splitting in antiferromagnets driven by coherent phonons
papers.abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) enables magnetization-free spin polarization for ultrafast spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that coherent phonons can dynamically induce and control NRSS in collinear AFMs. Excitation of $Γ$-point infrared-active phonons lifts the spin degeneracy of the ground state, while the residual sublattice-connecting symmetries determine the momentum-space form of the induced splitting. Because the relevant infrared modes couple to orthogonal in-plane light polarizations, distinct spin-split phases can be selectively activated by the polarization of the driving field. Using first-principles calculations for MnPS$_3$, we show that a mode that breaks all sublattice-connecting symmetries induces an $s$-wave spin-split state with $Δ(Γ)\neq0$, whereas a symmetry-distinct mode that preserves a sublattice-connecting mirror symmetry generates a $d$-wave altermagnetic state with $Δ(Γ)=0$. In both cases, the spin splitting grows linearly with the phonon amplitude and reverses the induced spin polarization when the displacement is reversed. Our results establish coherent lattice driving as a direct, polarization- and mode-selective route to dynamically induce distinct NRSS phases in AFMs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：共线反铁磁材料MnPS₃中的非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）现象，以及由相干声子（coherent phonons）动态诱导和调控该自旋劈裂的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共线反铁磁体中，激发Γ点红外活性声子可以动态诱导并控制非相对论自旋劈裂：不同对称性的红外声子模式分别产生s波自旋劈裂态（Δ(Γ)≠0）和d波交错磁（altermagnetic）态（Δ(Γ)=0），且劈裂大小随声子振幅线性变化，位移反向时自旋极化随之反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共线反铁磁体中，激发Γ点红外活性声子可以动态诱导并控制非相对论自旋劈裂：不同对称性的红外声子模式分别产生s波自旋劈裂态（Δ(Γ)≠0）和d波交错磁（altermagnetic）态（Δ(Γ)=0），且劈裂大小随声子振幅线性变化，位移反向时自旋极化随之反转。；创新点：首次提出利用相干声子作为直接、偏振和模式选择性的手段，在反铁磁体中动态诱导不同对称性类型的NRSS相（s波与d波），实现了无需磁化即可通过光场偏振选择性调控自旋劈裂的途径。摘要未突出说明与已有声子驱动自旋劈裂工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体针对MnPS₃材料进行声子模式对称性分析与电子结构计算。

papers.title: Kelvin-Helmholtz instability in annular superfluids across the UFG-BCS crossover
papers.abstract: We investigate the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability of counter-rotating annular Fermi superfluids using time-dependent superfluid density functional theory. When the two initially separated superflows merge, a necklace of quantized vortices forms at their interface and subsequently becomes unstable. We extract mode-resolved instability growth rates and study their dependence on relative flow velocity, interaction strength, and temperature across the strongly interacting unitary regime and the weakly attractive BCS regime. In the unitary gas and moderate BCS regimes, the growth rates remain qualitatively consistent with the point-vortex model, though systematically at or above its predictions, with no significant dependence on interaction strength or temperature up to approximately $0.3 T_c$. Deeper in the BCS regime, the dynamics change qualitatively: boundary-generated antivortices proliferate faster than the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability itself, destroying the initial vortex necklace before the instability can fully develop. These results provide a microscopic benchmark for Kelvin-Helmholtz dynamics in fermionic superfluids and help constrain possible explanations of the existing experiment-theory discrepancy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“time-dependent superfluid density functional theory”（含时超流体密度泛函理论）进行数值研究。；研究对象：环形费米超流体中的Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性，具体覆盖从强相互作用的幺正（unitary）区到弱吸引BCS区的交叉区域，涉及反向旋转双超流合并时界面涡旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在幺正气体和中等BCS区，Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性增长率与点涡模型定性一致但系统性偏高，且对相互作用强度和温度（至约0.3 Tc）不敏感；深入BCS区后，边界产生的反涡旋增殖快于不稳定性本身，在涡旋项链完全发展前即将其破坏，动力学发生定性改变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在幺正气体和中等BCS区，Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性增长率与点涡模型定性一致但系统性偏高，且对相互作用强度和温度（至约0.3 Tc）不敏感；深入BCS区后，边界产生的反涡旋增殖快于不稳定性本身，在涡旋项链完全发展前即将其破坏，动力学发生定性改变。；创新点：为费米超流体中的Kelvin-Helmholtz动力学提供了微观基准计算，可用于约束和检验现有实验与理论之间差异的可能解释。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 含时超流体密度泛函理论（time-dependent superfluid density functional theory），提取模式分辨的不稳定性增长率，并系统扫描相对流速、相互作用强度和温度三个参数。

papers.title: Tuning Boron-Vacancy Qubit Coherence through Layer Number in hBN
papers.abstract:
The negatively charged boron vacancy ($\VB$) in hexagonal boron nitride (\hBN{}) was the first optically addressable spin qubit identified inside a van der Waals crystal, allowing atomically defined placement relative to a target. Its coherence in bulk \hBN{} is limited by the boron nuclei of the layers flanking the defect plane, which a thin flake removes. Here, we use a generalized cluster-correlation expansion with an extended central-spin block to calculate the Hahn-echo coherence time of $\VB$ in h$^{11}$B$^{15}$N as a function of layer number. Our results show that $T_2$ rises from $199
s$ in the bulk limit to $653
s$ in a monolayer, a factor of $3.3$ that is already saturated at three layers and that a sublattice decomposition attributes entirely to boron. The enhancement is confined to low field, is insensitive to stacking registry and twist angle, and requires alignment to within about two degrees, an onset we reproduce with no free parameters. Under dynamical decoupling, a $1/e$ threshold returns $206
s$ for every thickness, but this is a zero of the first-shell modulation rather than a decay: measured without a threshold, the layer contrast survives and reaches a factor of $170$. Layer number thus emerges as a design parameter for $\VB$-based sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“calculate”“generalized cluster-correlation expansion”“sublattice decomposition”等理论计算方法关键词，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（\(V_B^-\)）自旋缺陷，具体研究其Hahn回波相干时间（\(T_2\)）随hBN层数（从体材料到单层）的变化规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: \(V_B^-\)的\(T_2\)随层数减少而显著增强：从体材料极限的199 ns提升至单层的653 ns（提升3.3倍），且该增强在3层时已饱和；层数对比度在动力学去耦下可达170倍，表明层数可作为\(V_B^-\)量子传感的设计参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：\(V_B^-\)的\(T_2\)随层数减少而显著增强：从体材料极限的199 ns提升至单层的653 ns（提升3.3倍），且该增强在3层时已饱和；层数对比度在动力学去耦下可达170倍，表明层数可作为\(V_B^-\)量子传感的设计参数。；创新点：首次从理论上系统揭示层数可作为调控\(V_B^-\)相干性的设计参数，并定量给出层数依赖的\(T_2\)增强因子（3.3倍）及其饱和层数（3层）；此外，发现层数对比度在动力学去耦下可达到170倍这一显著效应，且该增强对堆垛方式不敏感但对角度对准敏感（约2°以内），这些结论均无需自由参数即可复现。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义团簇关联展开（generalized cluster-correlation expansion）方法，并引入扩展的中心自旋块（extended central-spin block），对h\(^{11}\)B\(^{15}\)N中\(V_B^-\)的Hahn回波相干时间进行数值计算；同时使用子晶格分解（sublattice decomposition）分析不同核自旋（硼/氮）对退相干的贡献。

papers.title: Evolution from Kitaev to XXZ spin chains via distortion: Application to BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$
papers.abstract: BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$ is a prototypical spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain antiferromagnet that provides a unique platform for studying field-induced quantum magnetism. Under a transverse magnetic field, it exhibits unusual magnetic properties, including an anomalous staggered magnetization and a pronounced anisotropy of the critical field with respect to the in-plane field direction. While these phenomena have been attributed phenomenologically to a site-dependent anisotropic $g$-tensor, a recent microscopic theory has shown that spin-orbit coupling naturally generates bond-dependent Heisenberg, Kitaev, and $Γ$ exchange interactions. Here, we unify these two pictures by extending the microscopic theory to incorporate distortions of the CoO$_6$ octahedra. We show that the distortions not only generate the site-dependent anisotropic $g$-tensor but also renormalize the staggered exchange interactions through a distortion-induced contribution that partially compensates the Kitaev-derived staggered term. Using point-charge calculations to estimate the $g$-tensor of BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$, we demonstrate that the strong anisotropy of the critical field originates from the combined effects of the modified exchange interactions and the anisotropic $g$-tensor. Our work provides a unified microscopic framework for understanding the magnetic anisotropy of spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“微观理论”“点电荷计算”“统一微观框架”，未涉及实验测量手段。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合的伊辛链反铁磁体 BaCo₂V₂O₈，具体关注其在横向磁场下的量子磁性行为，包括交错磁化与临界场的面内各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CoO₆ 八面体畸变不仅产生位点依赖的各向异性 g 张量，还通过畸变诱导的交换贡献部分补偿 Kitaev 来源的交错项，从而统一解释了 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 临界场的强各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CoO₆ 八面体畸变不仅产生位点依赖的各向异性 g 张量，还通过畸变诱导的交换贡献部分补偿 Kitaev 来源的交错项，从而统一解释了 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 临界场的强各向异性。；创新点：将此前唯象的位点依赖 g 张量图像与基于自旋-轨道耦合的键依赖交换（Heisenberg、Kitaev、Γ）微观理论统一起来，首次将八面体畸变同时纳入 g 张量与交错交换相互作用的微观推导中。
papers.method_zh: 扩展微观自旋-轨道耦合理论以纳入 CoO₆ 八面体畸变；采用点电荷模型估算 g 张量；结合修正后的交换相互作用与各向异性 g 张量分析临界场各向异性。

papers.title: Piston-Like Information Engine II: Boundary-Controlled Optimum in Active Matter
papers.abstract: Information engines convert information into extractable work through measurements and feedback. We realize an engine that employs information to compress a gas of self-propelled bristle bots. Its work per measurement, $\bar{W}$, is controlled by the size of the detection region $Δx$ and the probability $p_1$ that this region is vacant. In thermal systems, $\bar{W}$ follows the universal form $-p_1 \ln p_1$, whereas the active engine shows a qualitatively modified relation. As particle density increases, the maximum of $\bar{W}(Δx)$ switches between two distinct operating regimes. Notably, this transition is also found in the solutions that maximize power output for finite-time cycles with dynamics affected by dry friction. We attribute this nonequilibrium feature to the accumulation of active particles near the boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：We realize an engine，实验构建了由自驱动 bristle bots 组成的气体系统）。；研究对象：活性物质（self-propelled bristle bots 气体）中的信息引擎，具体研究其每步测量可提取功 $\bar{W}$ 与探测区域尺寸 $\Delta x$ 及空置概率 $p_1$ 的关系，以及粒子密度对最优工作点的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性信息引擎的 $\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 关系偏离热系统的普适形式 $-p_1 \ln p_1$；随着粒子密度增加，$\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 的最大值在两种不同工作模式之间切换，该转变源于活性粒子在边界附近的累积。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性信息引擎的 $\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 关系偏离热系统的普适形式 $-p_1 \ln p_1$；随着粒子密度增加，$\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 的最大值在两种不同工作模式之间切换，该转变源于活性粒子在边界附近的累积。；创新点：首次在活性物质信息引擎中观察到 $\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 最大值随密度发生模式切换，并将该非平衡特征归因于边界处活性粒子的累积效应；该转变与含干摩擦的有限时间循环功率最优解中的转变一致，提示了活性信息引擎与摩擦受限动力学的深层联系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用自驱动 bristle bots 构建活性气体，通过测量与反馈循环实现信息压缩；理论上结合有限时间循环的功率最大化求解（涉及干摩擦动力学），并与热系统结果对比。

papers.title: Phase synchronization of fish schools through spatial gaps
papers.abstract: We investigate how sensory coupling mediates phase coherence between spatially separated, confined active systems. Using two fish schools separated by a water-filled transparent gap, we isolate vision as the primary interaction channel. Under boundary confinement, each school's center-of-mass heading exhibits noisy bistable dynamics, spontaneously switching between two antiparallel directions along the partition wall. Turning events in one school bias the orientation of the other, driving distance-dependent phase synchronization. We model this behavior using two coupled stochastic bistable oscillators whose exact solution quantitatively reproduces the empirical results. Our work establishes a precise connection between nonequilibrium active systems and coupled stochastic oscillators, offering insight into boundary-spanning information transfer in living collectives.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论建模结合的混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“empirical results”（实验观测）与“model this behavior”（理论建模），并给出“exact solution”（精确求解）。；研究对象：两条被透明水间隙隔开、受边界约束的鱼群。物理现象为：鱼群质心朝向的噪声双稳态动力学，以及通过视觉通道介导的跨空间间隙的相位同步行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个空间分离的受限鱼群通过视觉耦合实现距离依赖的相位同步；该行为可由两个耦合随机双稳态振子的精确解定量复现，从而在非平衡活性系统与耦合随机振子之间建立了精确对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个空间分离的受限鱼群通过视觉耦合实现距离依赖的相位同步；该行为可由两个耦合随机双稳态振子的精确解定量复现，从而在非平衡活性系统与耦合随机振子之间建立了精确对应关系。；创新点：首次在真实活性物质（鱼群）体系中，通过空间间隙隔离非视觉通道，定量证明其集体动力学可精确映射为耦合随机双稳态振子，为边界跨越的信息传递提供了可解析的物理模型。摘要未突出说明与以往活性物质同步研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：将两个鱼群置于边界约束环境中，中间用水填充的透明间隙隔开，以隔离视觉作为主要相互作用通道，观测各鱼群质心朝向的自发翻转事件及跨间隙的相互影响。理论上：构建两个耦合随机双稳态振子模型，并给出其精确解，用于定量拟合实验数据。

papers.title: A Spatial Localizer for Constituent-Resolved Exciton Wannier Functions
papers.abstract: The internal electron-hole structure of excitons influences optical and electric-field responses. Exciton Wannier functions have recently provided a local real-space representation of exciton bands. Because excitons are composite quasiparticles, these Wannier functions can be characterized by both their center-of-mass location and the internal electron-hole dipole. Resolving this internal structure in real space requires simultaneously locating the constituent electron and hole coordinates. However, the projected electron and hole position operators generally do not commute, so simultaneous diagonalization of these positions is impossible: their noncommutativity precludes a common eigenbasis and imposes a state-dependent lower bound on the joint spread. Existing approaches localize a single average coordinate or a specific constituent coordinate, but generally do not construct a common exciton Wannier basis that maximally localizes both constituent coordinates. Here, we construct an ``exciton spatial localizer'': a single Hermitian operator that embeds the constituent position operators within a Clifford-algebra structure and returns exciton Wannier functions, maximally localized in their electron and hole coordinates simultaneously. Our formulation is ansatz-free, gauge-invariant, and applies to the generic multiband case. In an interacting bilayer model with an isolated group of exciton bands, we show that reflection and time-reversal symmetries, or other nonsymmorphic symmetries detailed herein, enforce a pointwise traceless but nonzero quantum geometric dipole matrix, which manifests in symmetry-related pairs of exciton Wannier functions with equal and opposite internal electron-hole dipoles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、formulation、gauge-invariant、theory framework。；研究对象：激子（exciton）的实空间Wannier函数表示，具体关注激子作为复合准粒子时其内部电子-空穴偶极结构的空间局域化问题；模型体系为相互作用的双层模型（interacting bilayer model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了一个“激子空间局域化算符”（exciton spatial localizer），可在同一组激子Wannier基中同时最大化局域化电子和空穴坐标；在具有反射、时间反演或非辛对称性的双层模型中，该算符给出非零且逐点无迹的量子几何偶极矩阵，表现为对称关联的激子Wannier函数对具有等大反向的内部电子-空穴偶极。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了一个“激子空间局域化算符”（exciton spatial localizer），可在同一组激子Wannier基中同时最大化局域化电子和空穴坐标；在具有反射、时间反演或非辛对称性的双层模型中，该算符给出非零且逐点无迹的量子几何偶极矩阵，表现为对称关联的激子Wannier函数对具有等大反向的内部电子-空穴偶极。；创新点：现有方法只能局域化单一平均坐标或单一组分坐标，本文首次构造一个统一算符，使得电子和空穴坐标能在同一组激子Wannier函数中被同时最大化局域化，且无需预先假设函数形式、保持规范不变性。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造方法：将组分位置算符嵌入Clifford代数结构，构造单一Hermitian算符；方法为无拟设（ansatz-free）、规范不变（gauge-invariant），适用于一般多带情形；在相互作用双层模型中结合对称性分析（反射、时间反演、非辛对称性）进行验证。

papers.title: Low-Temperature Transport in Li-Ion Battery EC/EMC/FEC Electrolytes: Molecular Dynamics and Machine-Learning Modeling
papers.abstract: Low-temperature operation imposes severe limitations on lithium-ion transport in battery electrolytes, yet the coupled effects of solvent composition and fluorinated additives in the cold-temperature regime remain insufficiently resolved. Here, we combine classical molecular dynamics (MD) and machine learning (ML) to investigate 1 M LiPF$_6$ electrolytes containing ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and EC/EMC (3:7), with 0-10 mol% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), from 298 to 233 K. MD simulations quantify Li$^+$ self-diffusion, Nernst-Einstein (NE) and Green-Kubo (GK) conductivities and local coordination, while Gaussian-process surrogates model conductivity across composition and temperature. Cooling produces a pronounced transport penalty, particularly in EMC-containing electrolytes, whose GK conductivity decreases by more than 98% at 233 K, compared with approximately 90% in EC-rich systems. Li$^+$ self-diffusion activation energies are 0.49-0.54 eV for EMC-containing systems and 0.27-0.29 eV for EC-based systems. Within the EC family, 0-2 mol% FEC gives comparable cold-temperature transport, whereas 5-10 mol% FEC shows lower conductivity retention at the coldest simulated temperature. The analyzed coordination channels remain solvent dominated, while direct Li$^+$-FEC coordination is not quantified in the present RDF set.The Gaussian-process surrogates achieve composition-disjoint cross-validated RMSE values of 0.56 and 0.57 mS cm$^{-1}$ for NE and GK conductivity. Within the simulated liquid-state trajectories, temperature and host-solvent composition dominate the bulk-transport response, with FEC acting as a secondary modifier.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“classical molecular dynamics (MD) and machine learning (ML)”“Gaussian-process surrogates”等计算方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：锂离子电池电解液体系：1 M LiPF₆，含碳酸乙烯酯（EC）、碳酸甲乙酯（EMC）及EC/EMC（3:7）混合溶剂，并添加0–10 mol%氟代碳酸乙烯酯（FEC），研究温度范围298–233 K下的锂离子输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 降温对含EMC电解质的离子电导率惩罚极为显著（233 K时Green-Kubo电导率下降超过98%，而富EC体系约下降90%）；FEC在低温下仅起次要调节作用，5–10 mol% FEC在最低模拟温度下反而导致更低的电导率保持率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：降温对含EMC电解质的离子电导率惩罚极为显著（233 K时Green-Kubo电导率下降超过98%，而富EC体系约下降90%）；FEC在低温下仅起次要调节作用，5–10 mol% FEC在最低模拟温度下反而导致更低的电导率保持率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于系统扫描了FEC含量（0–10 mol%）与温度（298–233 K）的耦合效应对不同溶剂基底（纯EC、纯EMC、EC/EMC 3:7）中锂离子输运的影响，并引入机器学习代理模型实现组分-温度空间的电导率高效预测。
papers.method_zh: 经典分子动力学（MD）模拟，用于计算Li⁺自扩散系数、Nernst-Einstein（NE）电导率、Green-Kubo（GK）电导率及局域配位结构；高斯过程（Gaussian-process）机器学习代理模型用于跨组分与温度的电导率预测；交叉验证评估模型精度（NE与GK电导率的RMSE分别为0.56和0.57 mS cm⁻¹）。

papers.title: HiPoly: a hierarchical polymer-native AI framework for property prediction and generative design
papers.abstract: Polymeric materials are central to modern technologies, with applications ranging from energy to health and transportation. Although AI has made significant advances in materials discovery, the hierarchical structure of polymers across multiple length scales makes them inherently difficult to represent in a unified and physically meaningful way. Here we introduce HiPoly, a polymer-native AI framework that processes complete polymer descriptions through a three-level hierarchical graph architecture built on the G2RINS representation. HiPoly encodes stochastic inter-monomer connectivity, composition, and molecular weight directly within its architecture, using physically motivated design principles that mirror the multi-scale nature of polymeric systems. The framework establishes an end-to-end AI-driven workflow from experimental formulation data to property prediction, generative molecular design, and physics-based validation through molecular simulations, all unified by a single polymer representation. We demonstrate state-of-the-art prediction accuracy for thermophysical properties of multi-component polymer systems, with ablation studies confirming that each hierarchical design choice contributes independently to model performance. As an example, the generative design pathway is applied here to the discovery of sustainable alternatives to persistent fluorinated polymers, where it is possible to identify and independently validate PFAS-free candidates with target surface-energy properties. This work demonstrates how polymer-native AI can accelerate discovery by linking representation, prediction, and design across complex polymer chemistries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/人工智能方法文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“AI framework”“graph architecture”“molecular simulations”“generative design”等关键词，属于计算与机器学习驱动的材料设计研究。；研究对象：高分子（聚合物）材料体系，具体包括多组分聚合物体系的热物理性质预测，以及可持续替代含氟聚合物（PFAS-free）的候选材料设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HiPoly框架通过三级层次图架构（基于G2RINS表示）统一编码聚合物的随机链间连接、组成和分子量，实现了多组分聚合物热物理性质的最先进预测精度，并成功设计出具有目标表面能性质的无PFAS可持续替代候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HiPoly框架通过三级层次图架构（基于G2RINS表示）统一编码聚合物的随机链间连接、组成和分子量，实现了多组分聚合物热物理性质的最先进预测精度，并成功设计出具有目标表面能性质的无PFAS可持续替代候选材料。；创新点：提出了一个“聚合物原生”的统一AI框架，将随机链间连接性、组成和分子量直接编码进网络架构中，实现从实验配方数据到性质预测、生成设计及物理验证的端到端流程，且所有环节共享同一聚合物表示。摘要未突出说明与其他AI材料框架的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 构建了聚合物原生的三级层次图神经网络框架（HiPoly），基于G2RINS表示；采用消融实验验证各层次设计贡献；生成式分子设计路径结合分子模拟进行物理验证。摘要未明确说明具体模拟方法（如MD或DFT的细节）。

papers.title: Effective quasiparticle conserving Lindbladians in the thermodynamic limit
papers.abstract: Open quantum many-body systems are commonly described by Lindblad master equations, yet the treatment of Lindbladian operators in the thermodynamic limit remains a major challenge. We develop a framework for constructing effective quasiparticle-conserving Lindbladian operators directly in the thermodynamic limit. Our approach extends continuous similarity transformations to non-Hermitian open quantum systems and enables the systematic block diagonalization of Lindbladians with respect to the quasiparticle (qp) number. We formulate two complementary methods. The first, projective continuous similarity transformations (pcst++), generalizes perturbative continuous unitary transformations to Lindblad operators so that a linked-cluster expansion allows us to obtain high-order series expansions of the infinite system. The second, deepCST, extends directly evaluated enhanced perturbative continuous unitary transformations by combining the same qp-conserving generator with a perturbative truncation scheme that yields non-perturbative effective Lindbladian operators directly in thermodynamic limit. We apply pcst++ and deepCST to the dissipative transverse-field Ising chain with local dissipation. We focus on the low-Ising regime. We purify the Lindbladian by splitting each spin into two sites. A spin flip then corresponds to two qps. We derive and analyze the effective, qp-conserving Lindbladian in the sectors with zero to two qps. We show how the Ising interaction renormalizes the decay rates of elementary spin-flip excitations and provides the microscopic mechanism for a competition between coherent interactions and dissipation. Our work establishes perturbative and non-perturbative continuous similarity transformations as a versatile tool for deriving effective qp pictures of open quantum many-body systems in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确涉及“Lindblad主方程”“连续相似变换”“级数展开”等理论框架，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：开放量子多体系统，具体为热力学极限下的耗散横场Ising链（dissipative transverse-field Ising chain），并关注其低Ising区（low-Ising regime）的准粒子激发行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了在热力学极限下直接构造准粒子数守恒的有效Lindblad算符的框架，并揭示了Ising相互作用会重整化自旋翻转激发的衰减率，从而为相干相互作用与耗散之间的竞争提供了微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了在热力学极限下直接构造准粒子数守恒的有效Lindblad算符的框架，并揭示了Ising相互作用会重整化自旋翻转激发的衰减率，从而为相干相互作用与耗散之间的竞争提供了微观机制。；创新点：首次将连续相似变换系统地推广到非厄米Lindblad算符，并实现了在热力学极限下直接构造准粒子守恒的有效Lindblad算符，同时提供了微扰（pcst++）与非微扰（deepCST）两种互补途径。摘要未突出说明与已有开放系统重整化方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论方法：将连续相似变换（continuous similarity transformations）推广至非厄米开放量子系统，提出两种互补方法——(1) 投影连续相似变换（pcst++），推广微扰连续幺正变换并结合链式簇展开获得高阶级数；(2) deepCST，结合同一准粒子守恒生成元与微扰截断方案，直接得到热力学极限下的非微扰有效Lindblad算符。具体应用中，通过将每个自旋劈裂为两个格点来纯化Lindbladian，使自旋翻转对应两个准粒子。

papers.title: A viscoelastic theory for ultrasound-induced intracellular streaming
papers.abstract: Ultrasound is increasingly used to control biological cells, but its multiple physical effects, including radiation force, streaming, heating, and cavitation, require theoretical frameworks that can quantify their relative strengths. Here we develop a semi-analytical model to predict flow patterns and energy distributions of ultrasound-induced intracellular streaming. Cells are modeled as viscoelastic droplets immersed in a fluid with different viscoelastic properties. For this geometry, the momentum equation with an Oldroyd-B constitutive law is solved using a perturbation expansion commonly applied in acoustofluidics. The resulting equations for the different orders of the expansion are solved using partial wave expansion and explicit integration. We investigate our model for a range of parameters which is relevant both for synthetic polymer and for protein solutions. We find a series of flow reversals that we can connect to the distribution of energy into the different modes. We also consider density and compressibility contrasts, which shift these transitions and introduce new ones. Finally, we discuss the potential biological relevance of our mathematical results for cellular sensing and signaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“semi-analytical model”“perturbation expansion”“partial wave expansion”等理论建模与解析求解关键词。；研究对象：超声诱导的细胞内流（intracellular streaming），具体为浸没在具有不同黏弹性质流体中的黏弹性液滴（细胞模型），涵盖合成聚合物与蛋白质溶液相关的参数范围。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模型预测出一系列流动反转（flow reversals），其出现与能量在不同模式间的分布直接相关；密度和可压缩性对比度会移动这些反转点并引入新的反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模型预测出一系列流动反转（flow reversals），其出现与能量在不同模式间的分布直接相关；密度和可压缩性对比度会移动这些反转点并引入新的反转。；创新点：首次针对超声诱导的细胞内流建立半解析黏弹性理论框架，可量化辐射力、流、热、空化等物理效应的相对强度，并系统揭示流动反转与模式能量分布之间的关联，同时考察密度/可压缩性对比度的影响。摘要未突出说明与具体实验数据的对比验证。
papers.method_zh: 采用Oldroyd-B本构方程的动量方程，结合声流控中常用的微扰展开（分阶求解），各阶方程通过分波展开（partial wave expansion）和显式积分求解；模型为半解析（semi-analytical）。

papers.title: Exceptional Topological Signatures of Non-Hermitian Photonic Hopf-Link Braids
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian physics endows the non-Abelian systems with exceptional topology characterized by non-commutative braid patterns. Interplay of distinct competing sources of non-Hermiticity may induce novel topological effects. Here, we provide a generalized Hatano-Nelson model with higher-order nonreciprocal hoppings, non-Abelian gauge fields, and staggered gain-loss processes showing the exceptional topological structure of the Hopf-link braids that undergoes a EP-mediated topological phase transition. We demonstrate that mixing multiple nonreciprocal channels drives the system into highly intricate, nested complex energy Hopf-link braids and expands the topological landscape up to higher-order braiding sectors. Furthermore, utilizing biorthogonal eigenvector tracking, we map the structural evolution of the exceptional phase boundaries via the maximum Petermann factor in the phase angle parameter planes. We show that the gain-loss non-Hermiticity drives a topological crossover where the extended exceptional contours constrict into isolated regimes. The demonstration of EP-mediated topological phase transition of Hopf-link braids and the associated rich exceptional phase portraits may offer new physical insights with promising applications in robust, fault-tolerant communication channels and quantum computing platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提供模型（generalized Hatano-Nelson model）、演示（demonstrate）、映射（mapping）、理论框架（biorthogonal eigenvector tracking）。；研究对象：非厄米光子体系中的Hopf-link辫状结构（Hopf-link braids），具体基于含高阶非互易跃迁、非阿贝尔规范场和交错增益-损耗过程的广义Hatano-Nelson模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多种非互易通道的混合驱动系统形成高度嵌套的复能量Hopf-link辫状结构，并经历由奇异点（EP）介导的拓扑相变；增益-损耗非厄米性驱动拓扑交叉，使扩展的奇异轮廓收缩为孤立区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多种非互易通道的混合驱动系统形成高度嵌套的复能量Hopf-link辫状结构，并经历由奇异点（EP）介导的拓扑相变；增益-损耗非厄米性驱动拓扑交叉，使扩展的奇异轮廓收缩为孤立区域。；创新点：首次在非厄米Hopf-link辫状体系中展示EP介导的拓扑相变，并将拓扑景观扩展到高阶辫群扇区；揭示了增益-损耗与高阶非互易跃迁竞争导致的奇异轮廓从扩展连续态到孤立区域的拓扑交叉行为。摘要未突出说明与具体光子实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值分析：构建广义Hatano-Nelson模型（含高阶非互易跃迁、非阿贝尔规范场、交错增益-损耗），利用双正交本征矢量追踪（biorthogonal eigenvector tracking）和最大Petermann因子（maximum Petermann factor）在相位角参数平面中映射奇异相边界的结构演化。

papers.title: Universal fingerprint of topological defect cores
papers.abstract: Topological defects are ubiquitous in physics, arising from condensed matter physics to the early universe. Although there exist many universal scaling laws for correlations between topological defects, such as Porod scaling, the fingerprint of topological defect cores has remained largely unexplored. Here, we discover a universal scaling law in the region $k>1/ξ$, where $ξ$ is the healing length of the topological defects, taking the scaling of the form factor $S_f \propto k^{-(d+p+2)}$, where $d$ is the spatial dimension and $p$ is the defect codimension. We analytically prove that this exponent originates from a universal V-shaped cusp at the defect core and is independent of the underlying system and dynamics. Numerical simulations verify this scaling law in four typical frameworks: the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau and Gross-Pitaevskii equations in the weak-coupling regime, the gauge/gravity duality model in the strong-coupling regime, and the Klein-Gordon equation in the Friedmann-Robertson-Walker background in cosmology. Our work provides a new probe for studying topological defects in systems ranging from superconductors to cosmological phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically prove”（解析证明）以及“Numerical simulations verify”（数值模拟验证），属于理论推导结合数值计算的研究。；研究对象：拓扑缺陷（如涡旋、畴壁等）核心区域的普适标度行为，涵盖从凝聚态物理（超导体、超流体）到宇宙学相变（Friedmann-Robertson-Walker背景下的Klein-Gordon方程）的多种体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在波矢区域 \( k > 1/\xi \)（\(\xi\) 为拓扑缺陷的愈合长度）内，拓扑缺陷核心的结构因子满足普适标度律 \( S_f \propto k^{-(d+p+2)} \)，其中 \( d \) 为空间维度，\( p \) 为缺陷余维数。该指数源于缺陷核心处普适的V形尖点结构，与具体体系和动力学无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在波矢区域 \( k > 1/\xi \)（\(\xi\) 为拓扑缺陷的愈合长度）内，拓扑缺陷核心的结构因子满足普适标度律 \( S_f \propto k^{-(d+p+2)} \)，其中 \( d \) 为空间维度，\( p \) 为缺陷余维数。该指数源于缺陷核心处普适的V形尖点结构，与具体体系和动力学无关。；创新点：首次揭示了拓扑缺陷核心区域（而非缺陷间关联）的普适标度指纹，并证明该标度律的指数仅由空间维度和缺陷余维数决定，不依赖具体微观模型或耦合强度，为从超导体到宇宙学相变等不同尺度系统中探测拓扑缺陷提供了新的普适探针。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导结合数值模拟。具体验证了四种框架：弱耦合区的含时Ginzburg-Landau方程和Gross-Pitaevskii方程、强耦合区的规范/引力对偶模型（gauge/gravity duality）、以及宇宙学背景（Friedmann-Robertson-Walker度规）下的Klein-Gordon方程。

papers.title: Generalised Random Parking for Trapeziums on a Strip
papers.abstract: In this article, we study a generalisation of Rényi's car-parking problem in which isosceles trapeziums are sequentially deposited on a strip. We derive an explicit formula for the parking constant in terms of the lengths of the two bases, recovering the classical rectangular and triangular models as special cases. We further obtain quantitative finite-size asymptotics for both the expected number and the variance of deposited trapeziums, with convergence rates that depend explicitly on the geometry of the deposited particle. In particular, although the recursive construction involves two different substrate geometries, their variances have the same leading asymptotic density. Finally, we show that the parking constant depends non-monotonically on the ratio of the two base lengths and possesses a unique minimiser, so that the least efficient shape is a genuine trapezium rather than a triangle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we study a generalisation”、“we derive an explicit formula”、“we obtain quantitative finite-size asymptotics”等表述，属于典型的数学物理与统计物理理论推导。；研究对象：Rényi 随机停车问题（Rényi's car-parking problem）的推广模型。具体研究的是在一条有限宽度的条带（strip）上，随机顺序、不可重叠地沉积等腰梯形（isosceles trapeziums）的随机填充过程。该模型属于随机几何与统计力学的交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了梯形停车常数（parking constant）的显式公式，该公式依赖于梯形上下底的长度。此外，发现该停车常数随梯形两底长度之比的变化呈非单调趋势，并存在唯一的最小值，表明填充效率最低的形状是真正的梯形而非三角形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了梯形停车常数（parking constant）的显式公式，该公式依赖于梯形上下底的长度。此外，发现该停车常数随梯形两底长度之比的变化呈非单调趋势，并存在唯一的最小值，表明填充效率最低的形状是真正的梯形而非三角形。；创新点：1. 将经典的矩形和三角形随机停车模型统一为梯形模型的特例，并给出了统一的显式公式；2. 揭示了停车常数对梯形形状参数的非单调依赖关系，并证明了存在一个非平凡的（非三角形）最优最小化形状；3. 发现尽管递归构造涉及两种不同的基底几何，但最终沉积数量的方差具有相同的前导渐近密度。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与解析分析。具体包括：将经典的 Rényi 问题推广至梯形几何，通过递归构造（recursive construction）方法求解停车常数；利用概率论与组合数学工具推导了沉积梯形数量的期望值与方差的有限尺寸渐近行为（finite-size asymptotics），并给出了依赖于粒子几何形状的收敛速率。

papers.title: Precise spectral asymptotics, exponential localization, and spectral gap estimates for the three-boson lattice Schrödinger operator
papers.abstract: We study the three-boson Schrodinger operator on the two-dimensional integer lattice with pairwise contact interactions. First, we obtain precise asymptotics of the two bound states below the essential spectrum at zero total quasimomentum in the strong-coupling limit mu to infinity: the ground state energy is -3 mu + 6 + O(1/mu), and the first excited state energy is - mu + C + O(1/mu), where C = 4 - delta approximately 3.96458, with delta determined by the transcendental equation b0(delta) = 1/(1+delta) involving the lattice Green's function. The associated spectral gap is 2 mu + O(1). Second, using the discrete Agmon comparison method and the Paley-Wiener theorem, we establish exponential localization of the ground-state wavefunction with a logarithmic upper bound on the decay rate alpha(mu) at most ln(3 mu) + O(1/mu), reflecting the bounded nature of the lattice dispersion; the sharp asymptotic rate is conjectured. Third, at quasimomentum pi, the parity symmetry is preserved, but the odd quadratic form becomes positive definite with a unique eigenvalue of order 1/mu that never reaches the Birman-Schwinger threshold, so the odd subspace yields only a virtual level. The even subspace supports exactly one bound state with energy -2 mu + 6 + 8/mu + O(1/mu^2), and the spectral gap to the essential spectrum is mu - 2 - 8/mu + O(1/mu^2). The reduction from two bound states at zero to one at pi preserves the total spectral flow and is a lattice-specific phenomenon. Our approach uses an invariant subspace decomposition of the Birman-Schwinger operator and the Krein-Rutman theorem to guarantee uniqueness and strict positivity of the ground state. These results have direct implications for quantum simulation of few-boson systems in optical lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学推导（渐近展开、Agmon比较方法、Paley-Wiener定理）、算子谱分析（Birman-Schwinger算子、Krein-Rutman定理），无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：二维整数格点上的三玻色子薛定谔算子，具有成对接触相互作用，对应光晶格中少玻色子量子模拟体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合极限下精确给出了零总准动量处两个束缚态能量及谱隙的渐近展开；在准动量π处，奇子空间仅产生虚能级，偶子空间支持唯一束缚态，束缚态数目从零动量处的两个减少到π处的一个，保持总谱流不变，这是晶格特有的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合极限下精确给出了零总准动量处两个束缚态能量及谱隙的渐近展开；在准动量π处，奇子空间仅产生虚能级，偶子空间支持唯一束缚态，束缚态数目从零动量处的两个减少到π处的一个，保持总谱流不变，这是晶格特有的现象。；创新点：首次给出三玻色子晶格算子在强耦合极限下束缚态能量的精确渐近展开（含超越方程确定的常数δ≈0.03542）；揭示了从零动量到π动量束缚态数目减少但谱流守恒的晶格特有机制；建立了基态波函数指数局域化衰减率的上界ln(3μ)+O(1/μ)，反映晶格色散的有界性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：不变子空间分解的Birman-Schwinger算子方法、Krein-Rutman定理（保证基态唯一性与严格正性）、离散Agmon比较方法、Paley-Wiener定理（用于指数局域化估计）、格点格林函数与超越方程分析。

papers.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), which is known to steer deep neural networks toward invariant sets that correspond to simpler subnetworks. How this steering unfolds over time remains poorly understood. We answer this by modeling the stochastic gradient flow (SGF) as a percolation process, in which architectural symmetries force subnetworks to merge in discrete simultaneous blocks rather than one at a time. These structural transitions register as variance spikes in a macroscopic order parameter, echoing physical phase transitions. We further show this trapping mechanism and its associated scaling cascade extend to Adam and AdamW under an explicit heavy-tailed noise model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：modeling、stochastic gradient flow、percolation process、scaling cascade、explicit heavy-tailed noise model。；研究对象：深度神经网络中随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体（Adam、AdamW）的训练动力学，具体物理现象为优化过程中子网络合并的逾渗（percolation）动力学与方差级联（variance cascades）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SGD的随机梯度流可被建模为逾渗过程，其中架构对称性迫使子网络以离散同步块而非逐个方式合并，这些结构转变在宏观序参量上表现为方差尖峰，类似于物理相变；该捕获机制及其标度级联在重尾噪声模型下同样适用于Adam和AdamW。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SGD的随机梯度流可被建模为逾渗过程，其中架构对称性迫使子网络以离散同步块而非逐个方式合并，这些结构转变在宏观序参量上表现为方差尖峰，类似于物理相变；该捕获机制及其标度级联在重尾噪声模型下同样适用于Adam和AdamW。；创新点：首次将优化动力学与逾渗理论及离散标度不变性（discrete scale invariance）联系起来，揭示了子网络合并的离散分块机制及其对应的方差尖峰相变特征，并统一了SGD与Adam/AdamW在该框架下的行为。摘要未突出说明与以往优化动力学研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模方法：将随机梯度流（SGF）映射为逾渗过程，利用架构对称性分析子网络合并的离散同步性，并通过宏观序参量的方差行为表征结构转变；同时引入显式重尾噪声模型推广至Adam/AdamW优化器。

papers.title: Implementation of quantum gates by Floquet analysis of kicked quantum system
papers.abstract: Precise control of multi-qubit architectures remains a critical bottleneck in superconducting quantum processors. In this work, we investigate the synthesis of high-fidelity quantum operations and state transfer protocols within an extended superconducting linear chain, scaling from three to seven sites. Using Floquet theory, we model the periodic drive as a train of delta-like pulses, mapping the quantum control problem onto quasi-energy resonance conditions. Combining the Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff expansion with Floquet spectral decomposition, we analytically identify optimal driving parameters, refined via the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES). In the three-qubit architecture, this enables high-fidelity synthesis of the iSWAP gate. Extending to a seven-site chain, we implement periodic trains of finite-width Gaussian pulses to activate distinct double-excitation transport channels with ultra-short gate durations t_gate (~170 ns). This achieves a clear scale separation from energy-relaxation times (T1) typical of fixed-frequency transmon devices with tunable couplers, such as IBM Quantum hardware. Finally, we benchmark stability under realistic imperfections, revealing a heightened sensitivity to static parameter disorder at the sub-percent level (eta ~ 10^-3) driven by spectral crowding, and discuss how closed-loop topologies could mitigate this constraint. This framework bridges time-periodic control theory and practical quantum gate engineering.
