papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Floquet理论”“Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff展开”“Floquet谱分解”等解析理论工具，并结合“CMA-ES”数值优化算法，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：超导量子处理器中的多量子比特线性链（规模从3个到7个站点），具体为固定频率transmon器件与可调耦合器构成的体系，研究其周期驱动下的量子门合成与态传输协议。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Floquet分析将周期脉冲驱动映射为准能量共振条件，在3量子比特体系中实现了高保真度iSWAP门；在7站点链中利用有限宽度高斯脉冲序列激活双激发输运通道，实现了超短门时间（约170 ns），与典型能量弛豫时间T1形成清晰的时间尺度分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Floquet分析将周期脉冲驱动映射为准能量共振条件，在3量子比特体系中实现了高保真度iSWAP门；在7站点链中利用有限宽度高斯脉冲序列激活双激发输运通道，实现了超短门时间（约170 ns），与典型能量弛豫时间T1形成清晰的时间尺度分离。；创新点：将时间周期控制理论（Floquet分析）与实用量子门工程直接对接，在扩展超导链（最多7站点）中实现了超短门时间（~170 ns）的双激发输运通道激活，并系统揭示了亚百分之一静态无序下由谱拥挤导致的敏感性，提出闭环拓扑作为缓解方案。摘要未突出说明与已有Floquet控制方案相比的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Floquet理论（将周期驱动建模为δ函数脉冲序列），结合Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff展开与Floquet谱分解进行解析参数识别，再通过协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）数值优化驱动参数。稳定性分析采用静态参数无序（η~10⁻³）下的基准测试。

papers.title: Heat transfer problem of a dense gas described by the Enskog equation with a modification of the Enskog factor
papers.abstract: Heat transfer in a dense gas between two parallel plates is studied for assessing the quantitative difference of two variants of the Enskog equation, i.e., the original Enskog equation and the Enskog equation with a modified Enskog factor recently proposed in Phys. Rev. E \textbf{111}, 065108 (2025). The main advantage of the latter is that the H theorem, which is lacking in the former, has been established. The influence of the modification is assessed by comparing the macroscopic quantities in details. It is found that the influence of this modification is quite limited in the density, temperature, and heat flow vector. However, the influence on the stress tensor is visible in some severe setting of parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要涉及Enskog方程的两种变体（理论框架）以及通过比较宏观量进行的定量评估（计算分析）。；研究对象：稠密气体在平行板之间的热传递问题，具体针对原始Enskog方程与修正Enskog因子版本的Enskog方程之间的定量差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 修正Enskog因子对密度、温度和热流矢量的影响非常有限，但在某些严苛参数条件下，对应力张量的影响是可见的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：修正Enskog因子对密度、温度和热流矢量的影响非常有限，但在某些严苛参数条件下，对应力张量的影响是可见的。；创新点：评估了最近提出的修正Enskog因子版本（该版本弥补了原始Enskog方程缺乏H定理的缺陷）对实际热传递问题求解结果的影响程度。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于Enskog方程的动力学理论求解，比较原始Enskog方程与修正Enskog因子版本（后者在Phys. Rev. E 111, 065108 (2025)中提出，具有H定理）在平行板热传递问题中的宏观量差异。

papers.title: Trypanosome motility in blood and particle suspensions
papers.abstract: Motile microorganisms often navigate crowded and structurally complex environments, where surrounding obstacles can strongly influence locomotion. The bloodstream form of the flagellate parasite Trypanosoma brucei circulates in blood, a dense suspension of red blood cells (RBCs), yet the physical mechanisms governing its locomotion under such conditions remain poorly understood because direct experimental observations are challenging. Here, we combine numerical simulations with in vitro experiments to investigate trypanosome motility in concentrated RBC suspensions and in suspensions of spherical colloidal particles. Simulations reveal that the parasite swimming speed increases by up to $50\%$ at RBC volume fractions comparable to those in blood. To identify the origin of this enhancement, we perform controlled studies in colloidal suspensions with particles of different sizes. We find that suspended particles substantially increase the anisotropy between the perpendicular and parallel friction coefficients acting on the beating flagellum, thereby enhancing propulsion. This effect is most pronounced when the suspended particles are comparable to or smaller than the characteristic wavelength of the flagellar beat. Experiments with microparticle suspensions confirm an increase in trypanosome propulsion with increasing particle concentration, in qualitative agreement with the simulations. Our results uncover a general physical mechanism by which concentrated particle suspensions can enhance flagellar-beat-driven locomotion and suggest that the densely crowded, particulate environment of blood may facilitate trypanosome propulsion. These findings provide new insight into trypanosome motility in the bloodstream and may apply broadly to other flagellated microswimmers in complex suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（数值模拟 + 体外实验）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combine numerical simulations with in vitro experiments”。；研究对象：布氏锥虫（Trypanosoma brucei）血流形态在浓密红细胞悬浮液及球形胶体颗粒悬浮液中的游动行为，聚焦鞭毛驱动 locomotion 在颗粒密集环境中的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在红细胞体积分数接近血液生理水平时，寄生虫游动速度可提升高达50%；该增强源于悬浮颗粒增大鞭毛垂直与平行摩擦系数的各向异性，从而增强推进力，且当颗粒尺寸接近或小于鞭毛拍击特征波长时效应最显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在红细胞体积分数接近血液生理水平时，寄生虫游动速度可提升高达50%；该增强源于悬浮颗粒增大鞭毛垂直与平行摩擦系数的各向异性，从而增强推进力，且当颗粒尺寸接近或小于鞭毛拍击特征波长时效应最显著。；创新点：揭示了一个普适物理机制——浓密颗粒悬浮液可通过增强摩擦各向异性来提升鞭毛驱动的游动能力，并首次提出血液的颗粒密集环境可能实际上有利于锥虫推进，而非单纯阻碍其运动。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（模拟锥虫在浓密红细胞悬浮液及不同尺寸胶体颗粒悬浮液中的游动）；体外实验（使用微粒悬浮液测量锥虫推进力随颗粒浓度的变化）。

papers.title: Memory as an Energy Landscape---Hopfield
papers.abstract: This chapter reconstructs the Hopfield network as a physical theory of memory rather than merely an early neural-network algorithm. It begins with the problem as it stood before 1982-threshold logic, Hebbian association, correlation memories, and recurrent binary networks-and isolates what Hopfield's synthesis added: a dynamical definition of content-addressable memory, a symmetric recurrent architecture with a Lyapunov function, a Hebbian embedding of patterns in its couplings, and a physical account of basins, robustness, and graceful degradation. The binary and graded-response energy functions are derived in full, together with the signal-crosstalk decomposition governing pattern stability, the mean-field theory of retrieval at extensive load, and the zero-temperature retrieval spinodal at (alpha 0.138) established by Amit, Gutfreund, and Sompolinsky. The energy-based program is then followed through analog optimization networks, polynomial dense associative memories, exponential interactions, and modern continuous Hopfield updates, including the precise conditions under which the update becomes scaled dot-product attention. Throughout, capacity claims are tied to their disorder ensemble, scaling limit, and success criterion, showing why numerically different storage limits need not conflict. A closing assessment distinguishes established results from surviving principles, assumption-bound limitations, and open problems, treating the Hopfield network as an effective theory whose symmetry, locality, and point-neuron assumptions delimit its biological reach. Fixed-seed numerical experiments expose the mechanisms discussed but do not substitute for analytical results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“重构为物理理论”、“推导”、“理论框架”等关键词，属于对既有模型的物理原理进行系统梳理与理论分析。；研究对象：Hopfield神经网络，将其作为一种“记忆的物理理论”（即能量景观）进行研究。摘要未明确说明具体凝聚态材料或量子系统，而是聚焦于该网络模型本身及其与统计物理（如自旋玻璃、平均场理论）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Hopfield网络的核心贡献在于将联想记忆定义为一种由对称递归架构和Lyapunov函数（能量函数）控制的动力学过程，其存储模式对应于能量景观中的吸引子。该理论在有限负载（α≈0.138）下存在零温检索旋节线，且其更新规则在特定条件下可退化为缩放点积注意力机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Hopfield网络的核心贡献在于将联想记忆定义为一种由对称递归架构和Lyapunov函数（能量函数）控制的动力学过程，其存储模式对应于能量景观中的吸引子。该理论在有限负载（α≈0.138）下存在零温检索旋节线，且其更新规则在特定条件下可退化为缩放点积注意力机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明单一新发现，而是强调其创新在于“重构”——将Hopfield网络从早期算法提升为一种具有明确适用边界（对称性、局域性、点神经元假设）的有效物理理论，并系统澄清了不同存储容量数值之间看似矛盾的原因（通过区分无序系综、标度极限和成功判据）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值实验相结合。具体包括：完整推导二元与连续响应能量函数；信号-串扰分解分析；平均场理论（用于高负载检索）；零温旋节线分析（引用Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky结果）；以及固定随机种子的数值模拟（用于展示机制，但不替代解析结果）。

papers.title: Neural Logic, Invariance, and the Retina---McCulloch and Pitts
papers.abstract: This chapter reconstructs the McCulloch-Pitts program as a physics of neural computation rather than the familiar cartoon of a binary neuron. The 1943 logical calculus is developed in both directions: given a net, characterize the propositions realized by its activity; given an admissible logical expression, construct a net that realizes it. We recover the original distinction between thresholded excitatory summation and absolute inhibitory veto-one the weighted-threshold form cannot preserve for arbitrarily large excitatory inputs-and read unit-time delay as the physical realization of logical depth. Recurrence is treated exactly: an autonomous, deterministic network of finitely many binary units has a finite state space, so every trajectory eventually enters a periodic orbit-a fact about finite-state dynamics, not unbounded Turing computation. A single threshold element realizes only linearly separable Boolean functions, whereas finite feedforward networks of them synthesize any Boolean function on a finite domain. We then follows McCulloch and Pitts beyond threshold logic. The 1945 heterarchy paper turns cyclic preference into an obstruction to representation by a scalar utility. The 1947 work on universals asks how a physical network can identify inputs related by nuisance transformations, developed here via group averaging and feedback canonicalization. The 1959 frog-retina study makes the adequate-stimulus question experimental, revealing parallel invariant operations before the brain proper. Spike-triggered analysis shows how a nonlinearly driven neuron can have a vanishing first-order average while second-order statistics recover its hidden selectivity: methodological failure can masquerade as physiological absence. Modern mathematical tools are used without projecting their notation onto the historical papers, and limitations of the idealization are stated explicitly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/历史重构文章。关键词：reconstructs、logical calculus、mathematical tools、theoretical framework。；研究对象：McCulloch-Pitts 神经网络理论的历史与物理内涵，特别是视网膜神经计算、有限状态动力学、线性可分性、群平均与反馈规范化等概念。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: McCulloch-Pitts 纲领应被理解为神经计算的物理学：有限二元网络的所有轨迹最终进入周期轨道；单个阈值单元只能实现线性可分布尔函数，而有限前馈网络可综合任意有限域布尔函数；非线性驱动的神经元可具有零一阶平均响应，但二阶统计量可恢复其隐藏选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：McCulloch-Pitts 纲领应被理解为神经计算的物理学：有限二元网络的所有轨迹最终进入周期轨道；单个阈值单元只能实现线性可分布尔函数，而有限前馈网络可综合任意有限域布尔函数；非线性驱动的神经元可具有零一阶平均响应，但二阶统计量可恢复其隐藏选择性。；创新点：将 McCulloch-Pitts 纲领从“二元神经元”的简化卡通形象还原为神经计算的物理学，明确区分阈值兴奋求和与绝对抑制否决的不可约性，并指出方法论失败可能伪装成生理学缺失这一认识论陷阱。摘要未突出说明与传统科学史或计算神经科学解释的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 对 1943–1959 年间 McCulloch-Pitts 系列论文进行数学重构，使用现代工具（有限状态动力学、线性可分性分析、群平均、反馈规范化、spike-triggered 分析）但不将现代符号投射到历史文本上。

papers.title: Multidimensional Light Detection with Symmetry-engineered Heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Miniaturised multidimensional light detection, encompassing full-Stokes polarimetry and spectroscopy in ultracompact footprints, is attracting growing interest for its potential to capture a comprehensive set of light properties in portable platforms. Although significant progress has been made in miniaturised schemes for independent polarisation and spectral detection, achieving simultaneous high-dimensional light detection remains an outstanding challenge that limits their development toward full integration. We overcome this limitation by breaking the rotational and inversion symmetries in a symmetry-engineered van der Waals heterojunction to realise an ultracompact multidimensional photodetector. The dual symmetry breaking gives rise to non-trivial quantum geometric and topological features, enabling simultaneous broadband polarisation- and spectrum-resolved light detection, in contrast to previous van der Waals material-based devices, which could detect only one of these modalities. Our device, with an effective area of only 10 micron x 10 micron, reconstructs full-Stokes polarisation with overall root-mean-square errors below 0.05 and resolves spectral peaks separated by 0.4 nm, capabilities not previously achieved in single-pixel detectors. By unifying high-fidelity polarimetry and sub-nanometre spectroscopy in a single electrically tunable junction, our work eliminates the need for cascaded detection architectures and establishes a foundation for multidimensional detector arrays for integrated photonics, quantum information processing, and precision imaging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述器件制备与实测性能（如“reconstructs full-Stokes polarisation with overall root-mean-square errors below 0.05”），属于实验验证。；研究对象：对称性工程化的范德华异质结（van der Waals heterojunction），用于实现超紧凑多维光探测（同时覆盖全斯托克斯偏振测量与光谱分辨）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时打破旋转对称性和反演对称性，在单个10 μm × 10 μm的异质结器件中实现了宽带偏振分辨与光谱分辨的同步光探测，全斯托克斯偏振重建误差低于0.05，光谱分辨能力达0.4 nm。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时打破旋转对称性和反演对称性，在单个10 μm × 10 μm的异质结器件中实现了宽带偏振分辨与光谱分辨的同步光探测，全斯托克斯偏振重建误差低于0.05，光谱分辨能力达0.4 nm。；创新点：首次在单一范德华器件中同时实现偏振与光谱两种高维光探测模态，此前同类器件只能探测其中一种；且无需级联探测架构，在单像素尺度上达到亚纳米光谱分辨与高保真全斯托克斯偏振测量。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料体系与制备/表征手段（如材料种类、堆叠方式、测量光路等），仅提及“对称性工程化的范德华异质结”与“电学可调结”。具体实验技术细节摘要未给出。

papers.title: Renormalization group and long-range conditional mutual information in hierarchical models
papers.abstract: A departure of a mixed quantum state from a local Gibbs description is generally invisible to local observables but can be detected by the conditional mutual information (CMI). Here we study the relationship between the renormalization group (RG) and CMI, and in particular, how RG constrains CMI. We first show that the CMI between nonadjacent regions $A$ and $C$, conditioned on the buffer region $B$, is UV-finite whenever the state admits a locally reversible RG with a fixed on-site Hilbert space dimension. We then study two hierarchical models that have long-range CMI and yet admit a simple RG description. The first model has a divergent Markov length at every temperature $0<T<\infty$ but nevertheless flows to an infinite-temperature product state under RG. The second model satisfies the local Markov condition while violating the global one and is stable against weak noise. At the critical noise strength, the two-point CMI decays only polynomially as a function of the system size, while the two-point mutual information vanishes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization group（重整化群）、conditional mutual information（条件互信息）、hierarchical models（层级模型）。；研究对象：混合量子态与局域 Gibbs 描述的偏离，具体研究重整化群（RG）与条件互信息（CMI）之间的关系，以及两个具有长程 CMI 的层级模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了当态具有局域可逆 RG 且格点希尔伯特空间维数固定时，非相邻区域间的 CMI 是紫外有限的；同时构造了两个层级模型，它们具有长程 CMI 但仍有简单 RG 描述，其中一个模型在临界噪声强度下两体 CMI 随系统尺寸多项式衰减，而两体互信息为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了当态具有局域可逆 RG 且格点希尔伯特空间维数固定时，非相邻区域间的 CMI 是紫外有限的；同时构造了两个层级模型，它们具有长程 CMI 但仍有简单 RG 描述，其中一个模型在临界噪声强度下两体 CMI 随系统尺寸多项式衰减，而两体互信息为零。；创新点：首次系统建立 RG 对 CMI 的约束关系，并展示了长程 CMI 与简单 RG 描述可以共存；揭示了局域 Markov 条件与全局 Markov 条件可分离满足的模型行为。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括局域可逆重整化群（locally reversible RG）的构造与性质分析，以及层级模型（hierarchical models）的解析研究；涉及 Markov 长度、局域/全局 Markov 条件、噪声稳定性等概念的分析。

papers.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization of Composite Functions for Image-Based Inverse Problems in Materials Characterization
papers.abstract: Estimating physical parameters from scientific images is a common inverse problem in materials characterization that often relies on expensive physics-based simulations. In electron microscopy, specimen thickness and crystal mistilt are critical parameters that govern how electrons scatter through the sample, and therefore the accuracy of any atomic-scale structure recovered from it. They are commonly inferred by matching experimental position-averaged convergent-beam electron diffraction (PACBED) patterns to simulated ones, but grid searches scale poorly and neural-network methods require extensive pretraining that may not transfer to new conditions. Here, we propose scalable Bayesian optimization of composite functions (SBOCF), a simulation-efficient method that exploits the known composite structure of the image-matching objective and the intermediate information contained in simulated images. By representing PACBED images with patch-level summaries and two correction terms, SBOCF preserves the original pixel-wise objective while reducing the number of modeled outputs from 24,649 to 11. Under a budget of 50 simulator evaluations, SBOCF outperformed standard Bayesian optimization with expected improvement on synthetic SrTiO3 benchmarks with thick and thin specimens, reducing the median final SSE by up to 290x in the thick-sample case. On experimental data, SBOCF produced parameter estimates consistent with previously reported values without task-specific pretraining. For a simulated mistilted specimen, using the SBOCF estimates in a downstream ptychographic reconstruction recovered sharp atoms that were otherwise blurred. These results establish SBOCF as a promising approach for inverse problems involving expensive simulators and high-dimensional structured outputs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：提出新算法（SBOCF），基于模拟与实验数据验证，无新实验手段。；研究对象：材料表征中的逆问题，具体为电子显微学中从PACBED图像反演样品厚度与晶体倾转角（mistilt），以SrTiO3为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的SBOCF方法在极少模拟预算（50次）下，比标准贝叶斯优化降低最终SSE最多达290倍（厚样品情形），且无需任务特定预训练即可在实验数据上给出与文献一致参数，并能改善下游叠层衍射重建的原子清晰度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的SBOCF方法在极少模拟预算（50次）下，比标准贝叶斯优化降低最终SSE最多达290倍（厚样品情形），且无需任务特定预训练即可在实验数据上给出与文献一致参数，并能改善下游叠层衍射重建的原子清晰度。；创新点：利用图像匹配目标已知的复合结构及模拟图像中的中间信息，将高维像素级目标压缩为极低维（11维）表示，实现模拟高效优化，避免网格搜索的低效和神经网络预训练的可迁移性问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 可扩展复合函数贝叶斯优化（SBOCF）：利用图像匹配目标的复合结构，将PACBED图像用patch级摘要加两个修正项表示，把输出维度从24,649降至11；与标准贝叶斯优化（EI采集函数）对比；在合成SrTiO3基准和实验数据上验证，并用于模拟倾转样品的叠层衍射重建下游任务。

papers.title: Maximal-velocity deficit under a finite-support constraint in hard-wall half-line continuous-time quantum walk
papers.abstract: Continuous-time quantum walks on a lattice spread ballistically and converge to a limiting distribution for the rescaled position. On the hard-wall half line the boundary reflects the walker but does not change the bulk dispersion, so the ballistic front remains set by the maximal group velocity. We ask how close one can get to this front when the initial state is constrained to occupy only the first $M$ sites. We show that optimizing the moment-generating function of the limiting-velocity distribution over this finite-support class reduces to the principal eigenvalue of an explicit $M\times M$ Hermitian matrix, which yields the optimal state by direct diagonalization. For large $M$, a near-front scaling limit produces a continuum description that controls the entire peak region. In particular, the maximal mean drift approaches the front with an inverse-square deficit in $M$ and a constant prefactor $π^2/4$. Numerical results verify both the finite-$M$ spectral formulation and the predicted scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuous-time quantum walk、optimizing、spectral formulation、scaling limit。；研究对象：硬墙半直线（hard-wall half-line）上的一维连续时间量子行走，特别是有限支撑初始态（仅占据前 M 个格点）下的弹道传播前沿行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在初始态仅占据前 M 个格点的约束下，量子行走的最大平均漂移速度逼近弹道前沿，其速度亏损（deficit）随 M 增大按 M 的平方反比衰减，且常数前因子为 π²/4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在初始态仅占据前 M 个格点的约束下，量子行走的最大平均漂移速度逼近弹道前沿，其速度亏损（deficit）随 M 增大按 M 的平方反比衰减，且常数前因子为 π²/4。；创新点：首次在有限支撑约束下系统研究量子行走对弹道前沿的可达性，建立了从有限 M 谱问题到大 M 连续标度极限的完整理论框架，并精确给出逆平方亏损的普适常数 π²/4。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算结合。具体包括：将极限速度分布的矩生成函数优化问题转化为显式 M×M 厄米矩阵的主特征值问题；通过直接对角化获得最优初始态；对大 M 采用近前沿标度极限得到连续统描述，并验证标度律。

papers.title: Universal scaling and protocol-dependent amplitude in hybrid quantum walks
papers.abstract: Quantum walks spread ballistically but become diffusive with classical admixture. We compare two hybrid walks using identical quantum and classical steps at the same classical-step rate but ordered differently in time. Any nonzero admixture yields diffusion. Near the quantum limit, both diffusion coefficients have first-order poles, but their amplitudes differ by about a factor of two. The coherence timescale sets the pole order, while temporal organization sets the amplitude. We expect our analytical framework to apply broadly to quantum--classical hybrid systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论解析框架（analytical framework）、扩散系数（diffusion coefficients）的极点行为，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：量子-经典混合量子行走（hybrid quantum walks），即由量子步与经典步按不同时间顺序组合而成的离散时间随机行走系统，关注其扩散行为与相干性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任何非零经典混合比例都会使量子行走从弹道扩散转变为普通扩散；在量子极限附近，两种混合行走的扩散系数均呈现一阶极点，但极点振幅相差约两倍——该振幅差异由量子步与经典步的时间排列顺序决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任何非零经典混合比例都会使量子行走从弹道扩散转变为普通扩散；在量子极限附近，两种混合行走的扩散系数均呈现一阶极点，但极点振幅相差约两倍——该振幅差异由量子步与经典步的时间排列顺序决定。；创新点：揭示了量子-经典混合系统中扩散系数的普适标度行为（极点阶数由相干时间决定），并首次指出时间排序（而非仅混合比例）可定量改变扩散振幅，提出该框架可推广至一般量子-经典混合系统。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的关联。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论框架：对比两种混合行走（量子步与经典步比例相同但时间排序不同），分析扩散系数在量子极限附近的极点结构，并引入相干时间尺度（coherence timescale）作为极点阶数的控制参数。

papers.title: Yielded-region connectivity governs the onset of gravity-driven spreading in elastoviscoplastic drops
papers.abstract: The physical mechanisms controlling the onset of gravity-driven spreading of elastoviscoplastic drops remain unclear because yielding, elastic deformation, and viscous dissipation can occur simultaneously in different regions of the material. To isolate these mechanisms, we perform direct numerical simulations of large axisymmetric drops resting on a thin precursor layer of the same material. Each drop is first equilibrated under gravity, $g$, before being subjected to an additional constant downward acceleration of varying magnitude. The drop rheology is described by the Saramito--Herschel--Bulkley model. Once the rate of deformation becomes negligible under the enhanced forcing, the additional acceleration is removed and the drop is allowed to relax again under gravity alone, enabling the global deformation to be separated into recoverable and unrecoverable components. We find that spreading does not occur simply because some portion of the material yields locally. At low imposed accelerations, yielded regions remain confined within a predominantly solid-like viscoelastic matrix, and the resulting deformation is mostly recoverable. Appreciable spreading is observed when these yielded regions connect to form a continuous fluidised pathway from the drop interior to the free surface, allowing radial material transport. The acceleration required for this transition is governed primarily by the yield stress, whereas elasticity controls the partition between recoverable deformation and spreading by regulating the extent and spatial distribution of yielded regions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“perform direct numerical simulations”（直接数值模拟）。；研究对象：弹黏塑性液滴在重力驱动下的铺展行为，具体为置于同种材料薄 precursor 层上的轴对称大液滴，材料流变学由 Saramito–Herschel–Bulkley 模型描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴铺展并非仅由局部屈服触发，而是需要屈服区域从液滴内部连通至自由表面，形成连续流体化通道，才能实现显著的径向物质输运；该转变所需的加速度主要由屈服应力决定，而弹性通过调控屈服区域的范围与空间分布来控制可恢复变形与铺展之间的分配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴铺展并非仅由局部屈服触发，而是需要屈服区域从液滴内部连通至自由表面，形成连续流体化通道，才能实现显著的径向物质输运；该转变所需的加速度主要由屈服应力决定，而弹性通过调控屈服区域的范围与空间分布来控制可恢复变形与铺展之间的分配。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于通过“可恢复/不可恢复变形分离”与“屈服区域连通性”分析，区分了局部屈服与整体铺展之间的因果关系，而非仅以屈服判据解释铺展起始。
papers.method_zh: 直接数值模拟（DNS），采用轴对称几何，先让液滴在重力 g 下平衡，再施加不同幅值的恒定向下加速度，待变形速率可忽略后撤去额外加速度，使液滴在纯重力下松弛，从而将总变形分解为可恢复与不可恢复两部分。流变模型为 Saramito–Herschel–Bulkley 模型。

papers.title: Quantum Circuit and Tensor Network Implementation of the 2D Acoustic Wave Equation
papers.abstract: We present a cohesive framework for simulating seismic wave propagation utilizing quantum computing paradigms and their classical tensor network equivalents. We detail a quantum circuit-based formulation for the explicit finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solution of the two-dimensional acoustic wave equation and map this quantum architecture onto a tensor train representation, namely for Matrix Product State (MPS). The MPS solver enables deterministic simulation of large-scale wavefield dynamics on classical high-performance computing systems. We demonstrate the MPS representation by computing 2D seismic wavefields on the Marmousi model. Our results indicate that the MPS representation is a viable direction for computing and scaling wavefield propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“quantum circuit-based formulation”“tensor train representation”“MPS solver”“classical high-performance computing systems”，属于数值模拟与算法实现。；研究对象：二维声波方程描述的地震波传播，具体在Marmousi模型上计算二维地震波场。属于经典波动现象在量子计算与张量网络框架下的模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MPS（矩阵乘积态）表示能够在大规模经典高性能计算系统上确定性模拟二维地震波场，且该表示是计算和扩展波场传播的可行方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MPS（矩阵乘积态）表示能够在大规模经典高性能计算系统上确定性模拟二维地震波场，且该表示是计算和扩展波场传播的可行方向。；创新点：将量子电路FDTD方案与经典张量网络（MPS）等价映射相结合，形成统一框架，并首次在Marmousi模型上演示MPS用于二维地震波场模拟，为大规模波场传播提供可扩展的经典替代路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子电路显式有限差分时域（FDTD）格式求解二维声波方程，并将该量子架构映射为张量列表示（即MPS），在经典HPC系统上执行MPS求解器。摘要未明确说明具体张量网络算法细节（如压缩阈值、时间步进策略等）。

papers.title: RAFT-DVC: Resolution-Aware Machine Learning-Based Digital Volume Correlation
papers.abstract: Digital volume correlation (DVC) provides three-dimensional full-field displacement measurements from volumetric images, but how the internal resolution of a machine-learning-based DVC model affects accuracy and operating range remains poorly understood. Here, we present RAFT-DVC, a resolution-aware family of recurrent all-pairs field transforms (RAFT)-based DVC solvers with encoder downsampling factors s = 2, 4, and 8. Using a matched design, we find that the three solvers localize displacement to approximately 0.017 feature-grid voxel, giving an empirical raw-volume error scaling of approximately 0.017s voxel. The solvers exhibit complementary operating regimes governed jointly by displacement reach and volumetric-texture compatibility. Synthetic benchmarks show that RAFT-DVC achieves errors of the same order as tuned classical DVC under fine-texture, small-to-moderate-displacement conditions and becomes competitive or advantageous under coarse-texture, large-displacement conditions. Frequency-swept tests quantify deformation spatial resolution, while tiled inference enables dense estimation on large volumes. Evaluation on confocal volumetric images acquired during indentation illustrates the importance of matching solver operating regime to deformation magnitude and image texture. Tests on micro-CT images of elastomeric foam, despite training only on particle-labeled synthetic data, provide evidence of cross-texture transfer. We also identify coordinate-order inconsistencies in three-dimensional RAFT correlation sampling and introduce a non-cubic impulse test to verify sampler geometry independently of network training. Correcting the sampler improves native-input accuracy and generalization to unseen volume dimensions. Together, these results establish RAFT-DVC as a fast, resolution-aware framework for dense DVC with characterized accuracy and operating regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于机器学习模型（RAFT-DVC）的设计、数值基准测试与算法改进，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：数字体相关（DVC）技术中的三维位移场测量问题，具体涉及不同纹理（细纹理/粗纹理）的体图像、压痕实验共聚焦图像、弹性体泡沫微CT图像等材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RAFT-DVC系列求解器（编码器下采样因子s=2,4,8）在特征网格上定位位移精度约为0.017体素，原始体素误差随s线性缩放（约0.017s体素）；不同分辨率求解器具有互补的工作区间，受位移范围和体纹理兼容性共同控制。修正三维RAFT相关采样的坐标顺序不一致性可提高原生输入精度和泛化能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RAFT-DVC系列求解器（编码器下采样因子s=2,4,8）在特征网格上定位位移精度约为0.017体素，原始体素误差随s线性缩放（约0.017s体素）；不同分辨率求解器具有互补的工作区间，受位移范围和体纹理兼容性共同控制。修正三维RAFT相关采样的坐标顺序不一致性可提高原生输入精度和泛化能力。；创新点：首次系统研究机器学习DVC模型内部分辨率（下采样因子）对精度和适用范围的影响，建立分辨率感知的求解器家族；发现并修正了三维RAFT相关采样中的坐标顺序不一致性，并提出非立方脉冲测试来独立验证采样器几何。
papers.method_zh: 基于RAFT（循环全对场变换）架构的机器学习DVC求解器，采用编码器下采样因子s=2、4、8的匹配设计；合成基准测试、频率扫描测试（量化变形空间分辨率）、分块推理（大体积稠密估计）；非立方脉冲测试用于独立验证采样器几何；训练数据为粒子标记合成数据，测试于共聚焦压痕图像和微CT弹性体泡沫图像。

papers.title: A greedy nearest-neighbor approach to quantify site revisitation: comparing two sympatric raven species
papers.abstract: A central challenge in movement ecology is to describe ecologically meaningful residence sites from raw tracking data due to heterogeneous sampling frequency and uncertain site boundaries. Here, we develop a greedy nearest-neighbor clustering approach with local reassignment and polygon-based site construction that generates timestamped sequences of site visits for each tracked individual, and apply it to nine years of GPS data from two sympatric raven species in the Dead Sea region---the Fan-tailed raven (\emph{Corvus rhipidurus}) and the Brown-necked raven (\emph{C. ruficollis}). Using the resulting visitation sequences, we quantify recursion patterns using the non-Markovian individual mobility model (IMM), which captures the balance between novel-site discovery $β$ and preferential return $α$. The inferred dynamics are consistent with IMM predictions and reveal clear interspecific differences: Brown-necked ravens continue to discover new sites at a higher rate (lower $β$), whereas Fan-tailed ravens show a steeper concentration of visits among top-ranked sites. Entropy analyses further separate the species, with Brown-necked ravens exhibiting higher site entropy and higher conditional entropy of site-to-site transitions. Together, these results provide a robust framework for describing interspecific differences in movement strategies that can be used to infer memory from GPS data and suggest distinct space-use strategies in two closely related sympatric species.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“develop a greedy nearest-neighbor clustering approach”、“quantify recursion patterns using the non-Markovian individual mobility model (IMM)”等关键词，核心是对GPS追踪数据进行算法处理和模型拟合，而非实验或纯理论推导。；研究对象：两种同域分布的乌鸦物种——扇尾渡鸦（*Corvus rhipidurus*）和褐颈渡鸦（*C. ruficollis*）——在死海地区的空间移动与重访行为。摘要未明确说明这是凝聚态物理体系，而是生态学中的移动生态学问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种亲缘关系密切的同域乌鸦物种表现出清晰的空间利用策略差异：褐颈渡鸦持续以更高速率发现新位点（较低的β值），而扇尾渡鸦对顶级位点的访问更集中（更陡的访问集中度）。熵分析进一步表明褐颈渡鸦具有更高的位点熵和位点间转移的条件熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种亲缘关系密切的同域乌鸦物种表现出清晰的空间利用策略差异：褐颈渡鸦持续以更高速率发现新位点（较低的β值），而扇尾渡鸦对顶级位点的访问更集中（更陡的访问集中度）。熵分析进一步表明褐颈渡鸦具有更高的位点熵和位点间转移的条件熵。；创新点：提出了一种能够处理异质采样频率和不确定位点边界的贪心最近邻聚类框架，可生成时间戳访问序列，并成功将其与IMM模型结合，用于从GPS数据中推断记忆效应和区分同域近缘物种的空间利用策略。摘要未突出说明该方法与已有重访量化方法的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 开发了一种基于贪心最近邻聚类、局部重分配和多边形位点构建的方法，从原始GPS轨迹中生成带时间戳的位点访问序列；随后利用非马尔可夫个体移动模型（IMM）量化重访模式，提取新位点发现指数β和优先返回指数α，并结合熵分析（位点熵、条件熵）进行物种间比较。

papers.title: Asymmetric optical transmission from broken interface-orientation symmetry in self-shadowed grating metallizations
papers.abstract: Reciprocal optical structures can transmit finite-angle illumination asymmetrically when the two illumination directions couple differently to the available diffraction channels. We realize this in a single overlay-free step: oblique metallization of a conventional diffraction grating, where ballistic self-shadowing grows a one-sided, louver-like silver profile. Electron microscopy and Ag mapping show the one-sided silver redistribution on oblique-coated films and its absence on a normal-incidence control. Full-wave Maxwell calculations on the ballistic-growth geometry predict broadband substrate-favored transmission, carried by the transverse-magnetic (TM) polarization in the diffraction regime (contrast up to 2.1) and polarization-independent and spectrally flat (1.5-1.9) deep in the geometric regime; the rejected power is redirected predominantly into specular reflection, and the deposition angle selects the magnitude and sign of the effect (optimum near $45^\circ$). Calibrated three-color sample-reversal measurements yield dark-corrected substrate-favored ratios that persist in both output-analyzer projections on a $45^\circ$-coated 1-$μ$m-period film (up to 1.8) and lie within the computed geometric-regime band on a 30-$μ$m-period film (1.5-1.8, with reference-normalized absolute transmittances).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Electron microscopy and Ag mapping”等实验表征手段，以及“Full-wave Maxwell calculations”全波电磁计算。；研究对象：自遮蔽（self-shadowing）斜角金属化制备的非对称银/光栅复合结构，具体为在常规衍射光栅上通过倾斜蒸镀生长单侧百叶窗状银薄膜，研究其光学非对称透射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在互易光学结构中，通过打破界面取向对称性（单侧银分布），实现了有限角度入射光的非对称透射：在衍射区TM偏振下衬底侧透射对比度最高达2.1，在几何光学区实现偏振无关且光谱平坦的1.5–1.9透射比；沉积角度可调控效应的幅度与符号，最优约45°。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在互易光学结构中，通过打破界面取向对称性（单侧银分布），实现了有限角度入射光的非对称透射：在衍射区TM偏振下衬底侧透射对比度最高达2.1，在几何光学区实现偏振无关且光谱平坦的1.5–1.9透射比；沉积角度可调控效应的幅度与符号，最优约45°。；创新点：在单一无覆盖层（overlay-free）步骤中，仅通过倾斜蒸镀在常规光栅上实现非对称透射，无需复杂多层结构或非线性/磁光材料；沉积角度直接控制非对称效应的符号与大小。摘要未突出说明与已有非对称透射方案（如光子晶体、超表面）的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用倾斜角金属蒸镀（oblique metallization）在光栅上制备银膜，利用电子显微镜和Ag元素分布图（Ag mapping）表征银的单侧分布，并以正入射蒸镀作为对照；光学测量采用校准的三色样品反转法（sample-reversal measurements），在两种输出分析器投影下测量透射比。计算上使用基于弹道生长几何的全波Maxwell方程数值模拟。

papers.title: $\mathcal{N}$-bein formalism for degenerate states in the parameter space of quantum geometry
papers.abstract: Recently, we introduced a geometric object analogous to an orthonormal frame in the Cartan formalism to study the parameter space of quantum systems; we called it $\mathcal{N}$-bein, with $\mathcal{N}$ being the number of parameters that characterize the quantum system. Acting as the ``square root'' of the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), the $\mathcal{N}$-bein allows us to define new tensors to improve our understanding of the structure beneath the parameter space of quantum mechanics. In this work, we extend this mathematical framework surrounding the $\mathcal{N}$-bein to analyze the parameter space of quantum systems with degenerate spectra. As in the non-degenerate case, we define a non-Abelian two-state QGT to identify possible transitions between degenerate states after two consecutive parameter variations. Additionally, using the Wilczek-Zee connection, we introduce a torsion-like tensor as the covariant derivative of the $\mathcal{N}$-bein. This torsion captures the noncommutativity of successive parameter variations and coincides with the antisymmetric part of the two-state QGT. We also present a geometrical formulation using differential forms and discuss the physical implications of the newly defined tensors. Furthermore, we construct several gauge-invariant observables from the $\mathcal{N}$-bein and its derivatives to highlight the utility of the new tensors. Finally, to illustrate the convenience and applications of this formalism, we apply the theoretical framework to a system of coupled harmonic oscillators immersed in an electric field. The coupling between the oscillators results in a degenerate system. Thus, using the new formalism, we found correlations among the quantum states quantified by the new invariants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mathematical framework、geometrical formulation、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子系统参数空间中的几何结构，特别是具有简并能谱的量子系统（如受电场作用的耦合谐振子系统）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将此前提出的 $\mathcal{N}$-bein 形式推广到简并量子系统，定义了非阿贝尔两态量子几何张量及挠率型张量，后者刻画连续参数变化的非对易性，并等于两态 QGT 的反对称部分；该形式可构造规范不变可观测量，用于量化简并态之间的关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将此前提出的 $\mathcal{N}$-bein 形式推广到简并量子系统，定义了非阿贝尔两态量子几何张量及挠率型张量，后者刻画连续参数变化的非对易性，并等于两态 QGT 的反对称部分；该形式可构造规范不变可观测量，用于量化简并态之间的关联。；创新点：将 $\mathcal{N}$-bein 形式从非简并情形扩展到简并谱情形，引入非阿贝尔两态 QGT 和挠率型张量，并构造了新的规范不变可观测量，为理解简并量子系统参数空间的几何结构提供了新工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建：基于 Cartan 形式类比，引入 $\mathcal{N}$-bein 作为量子几何张量的“平方根”；使用 Wilczek-Zee 联络定义协变导数与挠率张量；采用微分形式语言进行几何表述；最后以耦合谐振子在电场中的简并系统作为示例验证。

papers.title: Bilinear correlations in Fluctuating Gaussian States with anti-unitary symmetries
papers.abstract: We study bilinear order-parameter correlations in a general class of sign problem-free systems that are described by what we call Fluctuating Gaussian States (FGS) with anti-unitary symmetries, where the weight of each Gaussian measurement in the space-time path integral is positive-definite. Supported by Monte Carlo simulations on fluctuating Gaussian fermionic and bosonic examples, we argue that such systems generally exhibit two types of broken-symmetry phases: a \emph{saddle point phase} and a \emph{non-local contraction phase}, with the competition between the two determined by the stability of the fluctuation saddle point of FGS. Due to the Fermi liquid instability in fermionic FGS with anti-unitary symmetries, we also discuss the possibility of representing fermionic FGS with a particular Projected Entangled-Pair State (PEPS) ansatz, which we argue a certain construction provides an efficient description for the saddle point phase, but not for the non-local contraction phase. Finally, we discuss the potential implication of our result in non-equilibrium systems and stabilizing a target bilinear order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“Monte Carlo simulations”“path integral”“PEPS ansatz”等理论/计算方法关键词。；研究对象：具有反幺正对称性、无符号问题的“涨落高斯态”（Fluctuating Gaussian States, FGS）系统，涵盖费米子和玻色子两类量子多体系统，关注其双线性序参量关联与对称性破缺相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 此类系统一般存在两类对称性破缺相——“鞍点相”和“非局域收缩相”，二者竞争由FGS涨落鞍点的稳定性决定；此外，费米型FGS可用特定投影纠缠对态（PEPS）在鞍点相中高效描述，但在非局域收缩相中失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：此类系统一般存在两类对称性破缺相——“鞍点相”和“非局域收缩相”，二者竞争由FGS涨落鞍点的稳定性决定；此外，费米型FGS可用特定投影纠缠对态（PEPS）在鞍点相中高效描述，但在非局域收缩相中失效。；创新点：首次在具有反幺正对称性的无符号问题FGS类系统中，系统区分并刻画了“鞍点相”与“非局域收缩相”两种对称性破缺类型，并建立了其与FGS涨落鞍点稳定性的联系；同时提出特定PEPS构造对鞍点相的高效描述方案。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为FGS的时空路径积分表示（利用反幺正对称性保证权重正定）；数值手段为针对涨落高斯费米子和玻色子模型的蒙特卡洛模拟；另采用PEPS张量网络ansatz分析费米型FGS的可表示性。

papers.title: Numerical simulation of D-Wave's quantum advantage experiment with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Programmable quantum annealers can realize real-time dynamics of frustrated transverse-field Ising models on large, nontrivial graphs. Recent work by King et al. argued that the classical simulation of such experiments would require exponential computational resources for classical methods such as tensor networks and neural quantum states. Here, we numerically simulate the D-Wave spin-glass annealing protocol with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo (t-VMC) using a correlator state tailored to spin-glass dynamics. For the two-dimensional cylinder, three-dimensional dimer, diamond, and biclique instances considered, at annealing times of 7 and 20 ns, we show that systematically increasing the variational ansatz size enables t-VMC to approximate the final two-spin correlation errors of the quantum processing unit (QPU). We also perform an accurate large-scale simulation of a challenging biclique instance for which no other variational method is known to work, and we find close agreement with the quantum annealer. Through ablation studies, we identify poor Markov-chain mixing, high-variance local-energy estimators, and stochastic Runge-Kutta error estimates as the principal numerical failure modes. We address these numerical issues by using parallel tempering, blurred sampling and an importance-weighted differential equation solver, thereby clarifying the numerical requirements for stable, large-scale t-VMC simulations. Our results extend the frontier of classical simulation while providing a realistic assessment of the computational costs of simulating quantum dynamics at this scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“数值模拟”“time-dependent variational Monte Carlo (t-VMC)”等计算方法，无实验数据采集。；研究对象：D-Wave量子退火器上实现的阻挫横场Ising模型的自旋玻璃退火动力学，具体实例包括二维圆柱、三维二聚体、金刚石和双团（biclique）图上的自旋玻璃系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统增大变分拟设尺寸，t-VMC能够逼近量子处理单元（QPU）在7 ns和20 ns退火时间下的末态双自旋关联误差；对一个其他变分方法均失效的挑战性biclique实例，t-VMC实现了与量子退火器高度一致的大规模精确模拟，从而扩展了经典模拟的边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统增大变分拟设尺寸，t-VMC能够逼近量子处理单元（QPU）在7 ns和20 ns退火时间下的末态双自旋关联误差；对一个其他变分方法均失效的挑战性biclique实例，t-VMC实现了与量子退火器高度一致的大规模精确模拟，从而扩展了经典模拟的边界。；创新点：首次证明t-VMC配合合适的变分拟设可以系统逼近D-Wave量子退火实验的关联误差，并成功模拟了此前被认为其他变分方法无法处理的biclique实例；同时通过消融研究明确了大规模稳定t-VMC模拟的三个主要数值失效模式及其解决方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时变分蒙特卡洛（t-VMC）方法，使用针对自旋玻璃动力学设计的关联子态（correlator state）作为变分拟设；通过并行回火（parallel tempering）改善马尔可夫链混合，采用模糊采样（blurred sampling）降低局域能量估计方差，并使用重要性加权微分方程求解器处理随机Runge-Kutta误差。

papers.title: When Literature Data Mislead Artificial Intelligence in Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly treats scientific literature as a data source for building databases, training predictive models, and guiding discovery. Yet literature-derived datasets often assume that reported experimental values are internally consistent and directly reusable. Here, we analyze this assumption using solid electrolyte (SE) conductivity data as a representative materials-science case. By tracing values from source articles to curated datasets, we identify recurrent text-figure mismatches, ambiguous axis annotations, unit inconsistencies, and missing measurement context. These discrepancies are often numerically plausible and therefore difficult to detect through routine preprocessing, but they can propagate as structured label noise during database construction and machine-learning reuse. A cross-database example shows how ambiguous reporting can create a 100-fold conductivity error. Our analysis reframes data accuracy as an infrastructure requirement for artificial-intelligence-driven discovery and motivates traceable reporting, curation, and validation practices for reusable scientific data. Keywords: AI for science; Data reliability; Scientific databases; Structured label noise; Literature-derived data; Materials informatics; Solid electrolytes
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（数据科学/材料信息学分析，非传统实验或理论物理文章）。判断依据关键词：literature-derived data、database construction、machine-learning reuse、cross-database example。；研究对象：固态电解质（solid electrolytes, SE）的电导率数据，以及从科学文献到数据库/机器学习流程中的数据可靠性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 文献来源的材料数据存在系统性文本-图表不一致、坐标轴标注模糊、单位混乱及测量背景缺失等问题，这些误差在常规预处理中难以察觉，但会作为结构化标签噪声在数据库构建和机器学习复用中传播，甚至可造成100倍的电导率误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：文献来源的材料数据存在系统性文本-图表不一致、坐标轴标注模糊、单位混乱及测量背景缺失等问题，这些误差在常规预处理中难以察觉，但会作为结构化标签噪声在数据库构建和机器学习复用中传播，甚至可造成100倍的电导率误差。；创新点：将数据准确性重新定义为AI驱动材料发现的基础设施要求，而非单纯的数据质量问题；系统展示了文献数据中“数值上看似合理”的隐性错误如何作为结构化标签噪声影响机器学习，并呼吁建立可追溯的报告、策展和验证规范。
papers.method_zh: 对固态电解质电导率数据从原始文献到精选数据集的溯源追踪（tracing values from source articles to curated datasets），结合跨数据库对比案例，识别文本-图表不匹配、单位不一致等具体错误类型。

papers.title: Singular Weak-Field Thermodynamics of 2D Superconductors
papers.abstract: In a bulk 3D type-II superconductor, the lower critical field at which an isolated vortex becomes thermodynamically favorable is a size-independent material property. We show that the situation is different in 2D superconductors: the larger the superconductor, the weaker the field needed to create its first vortex. The lower critical field in 2D is always size-dependent. For a disk of area $\mathcal A$, the lower critical field $B_v(\mathcal A)$ scales as $\mathcal A^{-1}\ln(\mathcal A/\mathcal A_0)$ in the weak-screening regime and as $\mathcal A^{-1/2}$ in the strong-screening regime. We derive these results from an analytically tractable microscopic model that admits many-body wavefunctions for both the uniform and singly quantized vortex states in a magnetic field, and incorporate screening by coupling their long-distance 2D supercurrents to 3D Maxwell equations. These results motivate organizing the weak-field ground-state of a 2D superconductor in the $(1/\mathcal A,B)$ plane. The origin represents the zero-field thermodynamic limit and it is singular. Approaching the origin along the $B$ axis leads to an increasingly dilute vortex lattice, whereas approaching along the $1/\mathcal A$ axis yields the uniform vortex-free state. Our theory shows that every trajectory carrying fixed finite flux ultimately approaches the vortex-free state in the thermodynamic limit and provides a firm microscopic foundation for the weak-field thermodynamics of 2D superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically tractable microscopic model”“derive these results”“provides a firm microscopic foundation”，属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：二维超导体的弱场热力学性质，特别是下临界场（第一个涡旋出现的磁场）对体系尺寸的依赖关系，以及涡旋态与均匀无涡旋态在热力学极限下的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维超导体的下临界场总是依赖于体系尺寸：对于面积为 $\mathcal A$ 的圆盘，弱屏蔽区下临界场 $B_v(\mathcal A) \sim \mathcal A^{-1}\ln(\mathcal A/\mathcal A_0)$，强屏蔽区则 $\sim \mathcal A^{-1/2}$。在热力学极限下，任何携带有限总磁通的轨迹最终都趋向均匀无涡旋态，因此零场热力学极限在 $(1/\mathcal A, B)$ 平面上是一个奇异点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维超导体的下临界场总是依赖于体系尺寸：对于面积为 $\mathcal A$ 的圆盘，弱屏蔽区下临界场 $B_v(\mathcal A) \sim \mathcal A^{-1}\ln(\mathcal A/\mathcal A_0)$，强屏蔽区则 $\sim \mathcal A^{-1/2}$。在热力学极限下，任何携带有限总磁通的轨迹最终都趋向均匀无涡旋态，因此零场热力学极限在 $(1/\mathcal A, B)$ 平面上是一个奇异点。；创新点：首次从微观多体波函数出发，严格证明二维超导体下临界场的尺寸依赖性，并揭示弱场基态在热力学极限下的奇异结构——即沿不同路径逼近原点会得到截然不同的基态（稀涡旋晶格 vs 均匀无涡旋态），为二维超导体弱场热力学提供了微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个可解析求解的微观模型，该模型能给出磁场中均匀态和单量子涡旋态的多体波函数；随后将二维超导体的长距离超流响应与三维麦克斯韦方程耦合，以自洽地纳入电磁屏蔽效应，从而推导出下临界场的尺寸标度律。

papers.title: Understanding the superconducting proximity effect in semiconductors through quantum oscillations
papers.abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor hybrids host emergent states of matter and offer a platform for new qubits, but the superconducting metal shunts electrical transport, which rules out conventional semiconductor characterization and leaves the hybrid parameters to speculation. Here we determine density, mass, $g$-factor, mobility and subband occupation beneath the superconductor, from Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations of a buried InAs quantum well under Al, Sn, V, Nb, Ta and Re films, with a Dingle analysis that accounts for the shunt. Every metal adds an interface subband whose occupation falls into one of two classes, whereas the mass and $g$-factor of the buried well are unchanged to within 10\%. Within the uncertainty set by the transport mobility, no film shortens the quantum lifetime of the buried well, and Al and Sn lengthen it. Quantum lifetimes bound the hybridization of the interface subband to 2-4~meV. These measurements supply the normal-state parameters that tunnelling spectroscopy renormalizes but cannot measure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验测量（Shubnikov-de Haas振荡、Dingle分析），并涉及多种金属薄膜的制备与输运测量。；研究对象：超导体-半导体混合体系，具体为被Al、Sn、V、Nb、Ta和Re薄膜覆盖的埋藏InAs量子阱。研究聚焦于超导邻近效应下半导体层的正常态电子参数（密度、有效质量、g因子、迁移率、子带占据）及界面子带的杂化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过量子振荡测量，成功确定了超导金属下方InAs量子阱的密度、质量、g因子、迁移率和子带占据。所有金属均引入一个界面子带，其占据分为两类；埋藏量子阱的质量和g因子在10%以内保持不变。量子寿命对界面子带与超导体的杂化强度给出了2–4 meV的上限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过量子振荡测量，成功确定了超导金属下方InAs量子阱的密度、质量、g因子、迁移率和子带占据。所有金属均引入一个界面子带，其占据分为两类；埋藏量子阱的质量和g因子在10%以内保持不变。量子寿命对界面子带与超导体的杂化强度给出了2–4 meV的上限。；创新点：该工作首次在超导金属覆盖下，利用量子振荡直接提取半导体层的正常态参数（密度、质量、g因子、迁移率、子带占据），克服了超导金属分流对传统半导体表征的阻碍，并给出了界面杂化强度的定量约束。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用Shubnikov-de Haas（SdH）振荡测量，结合考虑超导金属分流效应的Dingle分析，对埋藏InAs量子阱进行表征。覆盖金属包括Al、Sn、V、Nb、Ta和Re，通过对比不同金属的效应提取界面子带参数。

papers.title: No source-free exchange-correlation magnetic fields in non-collinear spin DFT
papers.abstract: We show that the Maxwellian equation $\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}=0$, where $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}$ is the exchange-correlation (xc) magnetic field, is not an exact condition of non-collinear spin density functional theory: it violates global spin-rotation symmetry, the operation which turns the electron spins. How much does this matter in practice? To find out we impose the condition anyway, in the best way we can: we modify any parent xc functional so that the Kohn-Sham procedure yields a divergence-free $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}$ that is a functional derivative, stays exact for the homogeneous gas, and exerts the local torques a locally collinear functional cannot. Any non-physical result from the calculation must be due to the spurious condition, not the implementation. On Mn$_2$ with LSDA as parent, the source-free (SoF) construction and locally collinear (LoC) LSDA both give too short a bond and too large a bond energy, but differ on the magnetic exchange coupling and on the state itself: SoF finds the experimentally observed $^1Σ^+_g$ antiferromagnet, with a coupling of the right sign and roughly the right size, while LoC finds a high-spin $^{11}Π_u$ ferromagnet and the wrong sign. Despite this seeming success, breaking the symmetry has serious consequences: a rigid spin rotation of the magnetization changes $E_{\mathrm{xc}}$ by about 1 eV (it should not change at all), and the magnetization induced by a weak uniform field points perpendicular to the field (it should be antiparallel to it).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论非共线自旋密度泛函理论中的精确条件，涉及理论推导与数值测试，属于理论/计算方法研究。；研究对象：非共线自旋密度泛函理论中的交换关联磁场 \(\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}\)，具体测试体系为Mn₂二聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: \(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}=0\)（无源条件）并非非共线自旋DFT的精确条件，强行施加会破坏全局自旋旋转对称性，导致严重非物理后果（如刚性自旋旋转改变交换关联能约1 eV，弱均匀场诱导的磁化方向垂直于外场而非反平行）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：\(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}=0\)（无源条件）并非非共线自旋DFT的精确条件，强行施加会破坏全局自旋旋转对称性，导致严重非物理后果（如刚性自旋旋转改变交换关联能约1 eV，弱均匀场诱导的磁化方向垂直于外场而非反平行）。；创新点：提出了一种“最小破坏”地施加无源条件的具体构造方案（SoF），使得任何非物理结果可明确归因于该条件本身而非实现细节；首次在具体分子体系（Mn₂）上系统展示无源条件与自旋旋转对称性不可兼得的实际后果。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：从对称性角度论证无源条件违反自旋旋转不变性；构造“源自由”（SoF）修正方案，使任意母泛函的Kohn-Sham过程产生无散的 \(\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}\)，同时保持其为泛函导数、对均匀电子气精确，并能施加局域力矩；以LSDA为母泛函对Mn₂进行测试，并与局域共线（LoC）LSDA结果对比。

papers.title: First-principles optical response of shock-compressed LiF: Quasiparticle, excitonic, and ionic-temperature effects
papers.abstract: We investigate the refractive index $n$ of LiF using DFT+G$_0$W$_0$+BSE, with ionic-temperature effects included through QMD. We calculate photon-energy dispersions $n(ω)$ and $k(ω)$ at ambient pressure and $n(ρ,T)$ at 532 and 1550 nm under shock compression, where $ρ$ and $T$ vary together. Quasiparticle band structures at ambient and compressed conditions and the ambient-pressure orbital-projected density of states connect the optical response to the electronic structure. At ambient pressure, G$_0$W$_0$ yields a quasiparticle gap of 14.25 eV, close to the experimental 14.2 eV, while BSE reproduces the main excitonic feature at 12.5 eV, close to the observed 12.6 eV. Quasiparticle and excitonic effects are thus essential for accurate optical dispersion; the hybrid HSE functional does not reproduce the optical spectra. Along the principal Hugoniot up to 140 GPa, $n(ρ)$ agrees closely with shock data at 1550 nm and acceptably at 532 nm, and agrees better overall than earlier first-principles calculations. Above approximately 110-120 GPa, QMD produces a downturn relative to cold $n(ρ)$ curves, suggesting that ionic dynamics may contribute to deviations from the linear $n$-$ρ$ Gladstone-Dale relation. QMD-sampling and finite-k-grid uncertainties are estimated, and transition-peak broadening is assessed using a recently proposed criterion. The gap increases under pressure, with a transition to a $Γ\to\mathrm L$ indirect gap near 50 GPa. An exploratory calculation at approximately 1400 GPa finds a gap of about 24 eV, disfavoring gap-closure metallization. Structural and elastic benchmarks of the underlying models are also provided.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：First-principles（第一性原理）、DFT+G₀W₀+BSE、QMD（量子分子动力学）。；研究对象：冲击压缩下LiF（氟化锂）的光学响应，具体包括折射率n(ω)、消光系数k(ω)的光子能量色散，以及532 nm和1550 nm波长下沿主Hugoniot的折射率n(ρ,T)变化；同时涉及电子结构（准粒子带隙、态密度）与压力诱导的带隙转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在环境压力下，G₀W₀准粒子带隙为14.25 eV（实验14.2 eV），BSE激子主峰位于12.5 eV（实验12.6 eV），表明准粒子和激子效应对于精确描述LiF光学色散必不可少；沿主Hugoniot至140 GPa，计算折射率与冲击实验数据在1550 nm下吻合良好，在532 nm下可接受，且整体优于此前第一性原理结果。约110–120 GPa以上，QMD给出的n(ρ)相对冷曲线出现下行拐折，暗示离子动力学可能偏离线性Gladstone-Dale关系。压力下带隙增大，约50 GPa处转变为Γ→L间接带隙；约1400 GPa的探索性计算给出约24 eV的带隙，不支持压力致金属化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在环境压力下，G₀W₀准粒子带隙为14.25 eV（实验14.2 eV），BSE激子主峰位于12.5 eV（实验12.6 eV），表明准粒子和激子效应对于精确描述LiF光学色散必不可少；沿主Hugoniot至140 GPa，计算折射率与冲击实验数据在1550 nm下吻合良好，在532 nm下可接受，且整体优于此前第一性原理结果。约110–120 GPa以上，QMD给出的n(ρ)相对冷曲线出现下行拐折，暗示离子动力学可能偏离线性Gladstone-Dale关系。压力下带隙增大，约50 GPa处转变为Γ→L间接带隙；约1400 GPa的探索性计算给出约24 eV的带隙，不支持压力致金属化。；创新点：首次在G₀W₀+BSE框架下系统研究冲击压缩LiF的折射率，将准粒子与激子效应同时纳入并与QMD离子温度效应结合，揭示了高压下离子动力学对n-ρ线性关系的偏离，并排除了极高压力下带隙闭合金属化的可能性。摘要未突出说明与具体实验诊断手段的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT+G₀W₀+BSE（含激子效应的第一性原理方法）计算光学响应；离子温度效应通过QMD（量子分子动力学）纳入；同时使用HSE杂化泛函作为对比；给出了QMD采样不确定度、有限k网格不确定度估计，并采用近期提出的判据评估跃迁峰展宽；还提供了结构及弹性基准测试。

papers.title: A relational fabrication-to-modeling database for memristor devices
papers.abstract: Resistive random access memory (RRAM) devices, also known as memristors, are highly dependent on fabrication, location on the wafer, and measurement protocols. However, openly available large-scale memristor datasets remain scarce, particularly those that combine experimental metadata with electrical measurements and preserve explicit links across the experimental workflow. Here, we present a comprehensive relational database of automated electrical characterization data from oxide-based memristors. The database links 6,190 memristor devices across TiN/HfOx/TiN, Pt/TiOx/AlOy/Pt, and Pt/TiOx/Pt stacks to 161,006 validated experiments and over 169 million electrical point records. It integrates fabrication, wafer mapping, electrical characterization, and modeling to describe electroforming, current-voltage non-linearity, memory windows (R_off/R_on), switching dynamics, and short-term volatility. Released as a normalized and indexed SQLite database with schema documentation, graphical user interfaces, and examples of empirical modeling, this resource supports provenance-aware querying, statistical analysis, and data-driven applications for the development of future memristor technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验数据采集 + 数据库构建 + 经验建模示例）。判断依据：摘要提及“automated electrical characterization data”（实验测量）、“relational database”（数据基础设施）以及“examples of empirical modeling”（建模示例）。；研究对象：氧化物基忆阻器（阻变随机存取存储器，RRAM），具体材料体系包括 TiN/HfOx/TiN、Pt/TiOx/AlOy/Pt 和 Pt/TiOx/Pt 三种叠层结构。涉及的物理现象包括电致形成（electroforming）、电流-电压非线性、存储窗口（R_off/R_on）、开关动力学以及短时易失性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了一个包含 6,190 个忆阻器件、161,006 次验证实验和超过 1.69 亿条电学点记录的关系型数据库，将制造工艺、晶圆位置、电学表征与建模信息显式关联，为忆阻器领域提供了首个大规模、可溯源、支持统计分析与数据驱动开发的开放资源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了一个包含 6,190 个忆阻器件、161,006 次验证实验和超过 1.69 亿条电学点记录的关系型数据库，将制造工艺、晶圆位置、电学表征与建模信息显式关联，为忆阻器领域提供了首个大规模、可溯源、支持统计分析与数据驱动开发的开放资源。；创新点：该工作首次将实验元数据（制造信息、晶圆位置）与电学测量数据在关系型数据库中显式关联，并覆盖从制造到建模的完整工作流，支持溯源查询（provenance-aware querying），弥补了公开忆阻器数据集中缺乏大规模、结构化、跨流程关联数据的空白。
papers.method_zh: 自动化电学表征（automated electrical characterization）获取器件电学数据；数据库采用规范化且带索引的 SQLite 格式，并配有模式文档（schema documentation）、图形用户界面（GUI）以及经验建模示例。摘要未提及具体材料生长或表征手段（如溅射、ALD、TEM 等）的细节。

papers.title: Accelerating dynamic simulations of photoexcited materials and their evolution by electron-informed machine learning
papers.abstract: Nonadiabatic coupled electron-nuclear dynamics upon electronic excitation underpin the microscopic mechanism and rational modulation of diverse photoinduced functional phenomena in materials, yet their direct first-principles simulations remain computationally demanding. Here we develop a framework for nonadiabatic excited-state machine-learning molecular dynamics (EMLMD) simulations, where the nonequilibrium electronic information upon photoexcitation such as electron temperature is rigorously calibrated from high-precision real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) benchmark simulations, enabling accurate reconstruction of excited-state potential energy surfaces (PES). This framework natively incorporates the excited-state electron-phonon couplings and intrinsically captures photoinduced phonon anharmonicity, both of which are missing in standard machine learning molecular dynamics, thus delivering first-principles-level accuracy for excited-state atomic evolutions. Large-scale EMLMD simulations resolve time- and momentum-resolved phonon dynamics in photoexcited materials, directly uncovering the competition between photogenerated coherent phonons and thermal phonons during photoinduced phase transition of bismuth. It also simultaneously resolves elusive atomic-scale microscopic dynamics and global structural rearrangement for selenium photoamorphization. Balancing high accuracy and efficiency, EMLMD offers a versatile paradigm to tackle key challenges in the study of complex excited-state molecular dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“machine learning molecular dynamics (EMLMD) simulations”、“real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) benchmark simulations”等第一性原理计算方法。；研究对象：光激发材料（photoexcited materials）中的非绝热耦合电子-核动力学，具体包括铋（bismuth）的光致相变以及硒（selenium）的光致非晶化过程中的声子动力学与结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作发展的EMLMD框架能够以第一性原理精度重现光激发态下的原子演化，并首次在大尺度模拟中同时分辨出光致相变中相干声子与热声子的竞争，以及硒光致非晶化中原子尺度微观动力学与全局结构重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作发展的EMLMD框架能够以第一性原理精度重现光激发态下的原子演化，并首次在大尺度模拟中同时分辨出光致相变中相干声子与热声子的竞争，以及硒光致非晶化中原子尺度微观动力学与全局结构重排。；创新点：该框架弥补了标准机器学习分子动力学中缺失的激发态电子-声子耦合与光致声子非谐性，实现了激发态原子演化的大规模第一性原理精度模拟，并同时解析了时间分辨与动量分辨的声子动力学。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于机器学习的非绝热激发态分子动力学（EMLMD）框架，其中光激发后的非平衡电子信息（如电子温度）通过高精度实时含时密度泛函理论（rt-TDDFT）基准模拟进行严格校准，用于重构激发态势能面（PES）。该方法天然包含激发态电子-声子耦合及光致声子非谐性。

papers.title: Superconducting diode effect from field-induced $s+if$ pairing in Ising superconductors
papers.abstract: The in-plane critical field of Ising superconductors exceeds the Pauli limit by an order of magnitude because the Ising spin-orbit coupling locks the electron spins out of the basal plane. The same locking converts an in-plane Zeeman field into a source of equal-spin triplet Cooper pairs, so that the field-driven condensate acquires an $s+if$ character. We show that this conversion channel also generates Lifshitz invariants, the odd-in-momentum terms of the Ginzburg-Landau expansion responsible for the superconducting diode effect. When the basal mirror symmetry of the monolayer is lifted by a substrate or a gate, the field-induced triplets couple linearly to the Cooper-pair momentum, and an intrinsic diode response develops whose strength is set by the ratio of the Zeeman and spin-orbit energies rather than by the small ratio of the spin-orbit and Fermi energies familiar from parity-mixing mechanisms. We construct the symmetry-constrained two-component Ginzburg-Landau theory of the coupled singlet and triplet order parameters and derive all of its coefficients from the microscopic model of an Ising superconductor; the complete functional, including all gradient and quartic terms, is generated by a single pair-breaking function of temperature, field, and Cooper-pair momentum. An attractive triplet channel reshapes the diode response: at weak fields it suppresses the efficiency through destructive interference between the direct and the collective-mode conversion paths, while at strong fields it extends the diode regime well beyond the singlet-only critical field, with the maximal efficiency reached along the triplet-enhanced phase boundary. The diode effect thereby serves as a transport probe of a hidden triplet pairing channel and of the field-induced $s+if$ state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Ginzburg-Landau理论、微观模型推导、对称性分析。；研究对象：伊辛超导体（Ising superconductor）单层体系中的超导二极管效应，特别是面内磁场诱导的s+if配对态及其输运响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 伊辛超导体中，面内塞曼场通过等自旋三重态通道产生Lifshitz不变量，从而在基面镜面对称性被衬底或栅极破坏时产生本征超导二极管效应，其强度由塞曼能与自旋轨道能的比值决定，而非传统的自旋轨道能与费米能的小比值。吸引性三重态通道可重塑二极管响应，并在强场下将二极管工作区间扩展到纯单重态临界场之外。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：伊辛超导体中，面内塞曼场通过等自旋三重态通道产生Lifshitz不变量，从而在基面镜面对称性被衬底或栅极破坏时产生本征超导二极管效应，其强度由塞曼能与自旋轨道能的比值决定，而非传统的自旋轨道能与费米能的小比值。吸引性三重态通道可重塑二极管响应，并在强场下将二极管工作区间扩展到纯单重态临界场之外。；创新点：揭示了伊辛超导体中磁场诱导s+if配对态与超导二极管效应之间的直接联系，指出该效应可作为探测隐藏三重态配对通道和场致s+if态的新型输运探针；其强度标度关系不同于传统的宇称混合机制。
papers.method_zh: 构建对称性约束的双分量（单重态+三重态）Ginzburg-Landau理论，并从伊辛超导体的微观模型出发推导所有系数；完整的泛函（含所有梯度项和四次项）由单一的对破缺函数（温度、磁场和库珀对动量的函数）生成。

papers.title: Polar nanoregions and reentrant-like ferroelectric behavior in SrTiO$_3$
papers.abstract: Recent real-space imaging in quantum paraelectric SrTiO$_3$ [Nature 656, 54 (2026)] reveals that local polar textures do not continuously grow upon cooling, but reach a maximum intensity at intermediate temperatures around 60-65~K and weaken again toward the quantum paraelectric ground state. Such a reentrant-like weakening of local polar textures challenges the conventional paradigm in which ordering tendencies generally strengthen as thermal fluctuations are suppressed. Here we employ a self-consistent phase-field theory showing that this anomalous behavior naturally arises from the interplay between intrinsic polar and antiferrodistortiv (AFD) fluctuations. We demonstrate that flexoelectric-like coupling strongly hybridizes the polar and AFD modes. As the uncoupled polar and AFD modes cross near 52~K, their hybridization is maximized, driving the lower hybridized branch to develop a minimum on a finite-wave-vector shell. This finite-$q$ softening triggers a Brazovskii-type instability, strongly enhancing polarization correlations and producing nanoscale polar textures. Away from the crossing temperature, the two modes become increasingly detuned, weakening their hybridization and the associated finite-$q$ softening. These results reaveal the origin of the formation of polar nanoregions in SrTiO$_3$, naturally explaining the unexpected confinement to an intermediate-temperature window and providing a mechanism beyond the quantum-fluctuation-based interpretation suggested by experiment. Furthermore, we predict an unconventional reentrant-like sequence in weakly strained SrTiO$_3$, evolving from ferroelectric to paraelectric, polar-nanoregion, and eventually paraelectric regimes upon heating from zero temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“self-consistent phase-field theory”（自洽相场理论）进行理论建模与预测，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：量子顺电体SrTiO₃中的极性纳米区域（polar nanoregions）及其再入型（reentrant-like）铁电行为，重点关注极性（polar）与反铁畸变（antiferrodistortive, AFD）涨落之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SrTiO₃中极性纳米区域的形成源于极性模与AFD模的杂化：当两模在约52 K交叉时，杂化最强，导致下杂化支在有限波矢壳层上软化，触发Brazovskii型不稳定性，增强极化关联并形成纳米极性纹理；偏离交叉温度后杂化减弱，从而自然解释了极性纹理仅存在于中间温度窗口（约60–65 K）的异常行为。此外，预测弱应变SrTiO₃从零温加热时会出现铁电→顺电→极性纳米区域→顺电的非常规再入型序列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SrTiO₃中极性纳米区域的形成源于极性模与AFD模的杂化：当两模在约52 K交叉时，杂化最强，导致下杂化支在有限波矢壳层上软化，触发Brazovskii型不稳定性，增强极化关联并形成纳米极性纹理；偏离交叉温度后杂化减弱，从而自然解释了极性纹理仅存在于中间温度窗口（约60–65 K）的异常行为。此外，预测弱应变SrTiO₃从零温加热时会出现铁电→顺电→极性纳米区域→顺电的非常规再入型序列。；创新点：提出了超越实验所建议的“量子涨落”解释的新机制——即极性/AFD模杂化驱动的有限波矢软化与Brazovskii不稳定性，首次从理论上解释了极性纳米区域为何被限制在中间温度窗口，并预言了弱应变下的再入型相序列。（摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的具体差异。）
papers.method_zh: 自洽相场理论（self-consistent phase-field theory），包含极性模与AFD模的耦合，以及类挠曲电（flexoelectric-like）耦合项的引入，用于分析模杂化、有限波矢软化及Brazovskii型不稳定性。

papers.title: Cell size and confinement drive asymmetric cell division through a cortical instability
papers.abstract: Asymmetric cell division -- in which a mother cell divides into two daughter cells of unequal size -- is a fundamental problem in biology. It is believed that the asymmetry originates from the prior polarization of the mother cell. Here we show that division asymmetry can occur spontaneously even in unpolarized mother cells. Specifically, curvature-dependent active stresses in the cell cortex can lead to this symmetry breaking without any molecular polarity cue if the mother cell is confined within a restricted space. Either reducing the cell size or tightening mechanical confinement triggers the same spontaneous symmetry-breaking instability, in which the contractile ring slips off the equator to yield daughters of unequal volume. In the presence of a polarity cue, this instability cooperates with the cue to program the division asymmetry. The model prediction is compared with the imaging data of C. elegans embryogenesis, in which successive cell divisions in a confined eggshell lead to smaller and smaller cell sizes. The measured division asymmetry indeed increases as the cells shrink, and is further amplified when the embryo is mechanically compressed, both in agreement with the model prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/建模文章（结合实验数据对比）。判断依据：摘要中出现“active stresses”“model prediction”“instability”等理论建模关键词，并与C. elegans胚胎成像数据进行比较。；研究对象：不对称细胞分裂的物理机制，具体研究细胞皮层（cell cortex）中曲率依赖的主动应力导致的对称性破缺，以及细胞尺寸和机械约束（confinement）对分裂不对称性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使母细胞没有预先的分子极性，在受限空间内，皮层中曲率依赖的主动应力也能自发诱导不对称分裂（收缩环偏离赤道），且减小细胞尺寸或增强机械约束均可触发这一对称性破缺不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使母细胞没有预先的分子极性，在受限空间内，皮层中曲率依赖的主动应力也能自发诱导不对称分裂（收缩环偏离赤道），且减小细胞尺寸或增强机械约束均可触发这一对称性破缺不稳定性。；创新点：首次提出分裂不对称性可以完全由几何约束和皮层力学自发产生，无需预先的分子极性信号；并揭示细胞尺寸减小本身即可作为触发不对称分裂的力学因素，而非仅依赖生化极性通路。（摘要未突出说明与已有极性驱动模型的直接对比细节。）
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于皮层主动应力的曲率依赖性建立连续介质力学模型，分析收缩环位置的线性稳定性；实验对比：使用C. elegans胚胎发育过程中的活体成像数据，测量不同细胞尺寸和机械压缩条件下的分裂不对称性，与模型预测进行定量比较。

papers.title: Simulating Continuous-Rotation 3D Electron Diffraction: A Multislice and Bloch Wave Framework
papers.abstract: To improve the agreement between measured and calculated intensities of three-dimensional electron diffraction (3D ED) experiments, a simulation pipeline is needed to assess and quantify the influence of various structural and experimental parameters. We present a computational pipeline, built upon the abTEM Python package, to simulate continuous-rotation 3D electron diffraction data based on either the Bloch wave or the multislice formalism. Multislice calculations in arbitrary orientations are achieved through large supercells and windowing. We investigate the convergence of key simulation parameters and test their consistency, establishing suitable parameters for accurate and efficient simulations. The pipeline's applicability and robustness are demonstrated through case studies on cubic silicon as well as stretched and sheared variants, analyzing the influence of electron kinetic energy, sample thickness, orientation, and symmetry on simulated diffraction intensities. Finally, we investigate a representative selection of seven compounds, including cubic $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$, monoclinic $α$-glycine $\mathrm{C_2H_5NO_2}$, and triclinic kyanite $\mathrm{Al_2SiO_5}$ to validate the method. This framework for the simulation of 3D electron diffraction data establishes an approach to investigate the dependence of diffracted intensities on experimentally relevant parameters which are difficult to systematically investigate in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。关键词：simulation pipeline、computational pipeline、Bloch wave、multislice formalism。；研究对象：三维电子衍射（3D ED）实验的模拟方法，具体应用于立方硅（cubic silicon）及其拉伸/剪切变体、立方SrTiO₃、单斜α-甘氨酸（C₂H₅NO₂）、三斜蓝晶石（Al₂SiO₅）等七种化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该文建立了一套基于abTEM Python包的连续旋转3D电子衍射模拟流程，能够系统评估电子动能、样品厚度、取向和对称性等参数对衍射强度的影响，并通过多种晶体结构验证了方法的适用性和稳健性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该文建立了一套基于abTEM Python包的连续旋转3D电子衍射模拟流程，能够系统评估电子动能、样品厚度、取向和对称性等参数对衍射强度的影响，并通过多种晶体结构验证了方法的适用性和稳健性。；创新点：提供了一个完整的、可量化的3D ED模拟框架，用于研究实验中难以系统调控的参数（如厚度、取向、对称性等）对衍射强度的影响，并首次在统一框架下对多种晶系（立方、单斜、三斜）进行了验证。摘要未突出说明与已有模拟工具相比的具体算法改进。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bloch波或multislice形式主义，在abTEM Python包中实现连续旋转3D ED数据模拟；multislice计算通过大超胞和加窗（windowing）技术实现任意取向；系统研究了关键模拟参数的收敛性和一致性。

papers.title: Antiresonances of Wannier-Stark ladders in Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that Wannier-Stark ladders (WSLs) in one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains manifest as antiresonance signatures in the electron transmission. We study the quantum transport in the SSH chain in the presence of a periodic potential profile plus a uniform electric field. By employing the global matrix method with non-trivial matching conditions, we find that these WSL antiresonances correspond to states that are exponentially localized at the potential's incident boundary. These findings provide a robust, unified framework for identifying WSLs across diverse scales, ranging from electronic transport in trans-polyacetylene to classical-wave analogs in phononic crystals and surface water waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“global matrix method”（全局矩阵方法）等理论计算手段，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：一维 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链中的 Wannier-Stark 阶梯（WSLs），具体物理现象为电子在周期势场叠加均匀电场下的量子输运，以及 WSL 在电子透射谱中的反共振特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SSH 链中的 Wannier-Stark 阶梯在电子透射谱中表现为反共振（antiresonance）信号，且这些反共振态对应于在势场入射边界处指数局域化的电子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SSH 链中的 Wannier-Stark 阶梯在电子透射谱中表现为反共振（antiresonance）信号，且这些反共振态对应于在势场入射边界处指数局域化的电子态。；创新点：提出了一个统一框架，用于在不同尺度体系中识别 Wannier-Stark 阶梯——从 trans-聚乙炔中的电子输运到声子晶体和表面水波中的经典波类比。摘要未突出说明与以往 WSL 探测方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用全局矩阵方法（global matrix method），并引入非平凡匹配条件（non-trivial matching conditions），计算 SSH 链在周期势加均匀电场下的电子透射。

papers.title: Pole-Zero Geometry, Model Reduction, and Identifiability in Sensory Adaptation
papers.abstract: Sensory adaptation provides a concrete setting in which low-order system identification can fail qualitatively. We show that one fixed higher-order adaptive system composed entirely of real first-order relaxation modes can be reduced to opposite sides of the second-order pole boundary: low-frequency moment matching gives $ρ_{\rm moment}=4.50$, whereas finite-window fitting gives $ρ_{\rm window}=3.31$, and the inferred pole class changes further with sampling protocol. Thus the real-versus-complex classification of a reduced model is not itself reduction invariant. We then use the general two-state spectrum to connect stochastic identifiability to adaptation: for nontrivial coupling and one-state observation, cross diffusion drops out of the scalar spectrum when the hidden state has no self-relaxation. In the adaptive model, this condition is precisely the integral-memory limit that produces exact adaptation, while leaky memory restores spectral sensitivity. For the exact-adaptation model, the Gaussian path-space irreversibility nevertheless depends on the hidden cross-diffusion channel. Hence $\{H,S_x\}$ does not determine the irreversibility rate. Independently, for a specified all-even reduced two-state drift with $ρ<4$, the drift-only lower bound is $σ\ge τ_x^{-1}(4/ρ-1)$. Published \textit{E.~coli} and \textit{C.~elegans} responses provide biological examples of these limits. The distinction established here between transfer-function invariants, reduction-dependent properties, and hidden-state quantities provides a concrete framework for evaluating the limitations of low-dimensional models of adaptive biological dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“系统辨识”“模型降阶”“随机可辨识性”“路径空间不可逆性”等理论分析概念，未提及实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：感官适应（sensory adaptation）这一生物物理动力学过程，具体以大肠杆菌（*E. coli*）和线虫（*C. elegans*）的响应作为生物实例，研究低阶模型降阶与可辨识性的极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个由纯实数一阶弛豫模式构成的高阶自适应系统，在降阶为二阶模型时，其极点类型（实数或复数）依赖于拟合方式（低频矩匹配给出 ρ=4.50，有限窗口拟合给出 ρ=3.31），因此“实极点 vs 复极点”的分类并非降阶不变量；此外，在精确适应极限下，标量谱中交叉扩散项消失，但路径空间不可逆性仍依赖隐藏的交叉扩散通道，即 {H, S_x} 不足以确定不可逆率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个由纯实数一阶弛豫模式构成的高阶自适应系统，在降阶为二阶模型时，其极点类型（实数或复数）依赖于拟合方式（低频矩匹配给出 ρ=4.50，有限窗口拟合给出 ρ=3.31），因此“实极点 vs 复极点”的分类并非降阶不变量；此外，在精确适应极限下，标量谱中交叉扩散项消失，但路径空间不可逆性仍依赖隐藏的交叉扩散通道，即 {H, S_x} 不足以确定不可逆率。；创新点：首次在感官适应体系中系统区分了传递函数不变量、降阶依赖性质与隐藏态量三类不同层次的量，并证明“实/复极点分类”这一看似基本的模型属性在降阶过程中并不保持；同时建立了随机可辨识性与积分记忆极限之间的精确对应关系。摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体数学工具，但涉及系统辨识理论、传递函数矩匹配、有限窗口拟合、两态谱分析、随机路径空间不可逆性分析，以及漂移-扩散下界推导（σ ≥ τ_x^{-1}(4/ρ−1)）。未提及具体数值算法或实验手段。

papers.title: Inversion-symmetric topological insulators in cut-and-project binary chains
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic properties of binary tight-binding chains generated by the cut-and-project method for rational slopes $α=p/q$, leading to periodic and inversion symmetric chains with $n=p+q$ sites. The binary structure is encoded in two hopping amplitudes $t_a$ and $t_b$. For fixed $t_a \neq t_b$, the support of the energy spectrum as a function of $p/n$ gives rise to a "Cut-and-Project butterfly". We concentrate on insulators with $M$ filled bands among a total of $n$ bands and vary $t_a/t_b$. Inversion symmetry constrains the electric polarization $P$ to $0$ or $P_q/2$ modulo a polarization quantum $P_q = \gcd(M,n)/n$. A topological transition, between two insulators that differ by their quantized polarization, occurs if and only if $n/\gcd(M,n)$ is odd. When $n/\gcd(M,n)$ is even, the two insulating regimes have a vanishing polarization and no topological transition occurs, despite the gap closing at $t_a=t_b$. When $n$ is even and $M$ odd, we find an adiabatic path between $t_a>t_b$ and $t_a<t_b$ that maintains inversion symmetry and a gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“We investigate”“electronic properties”“tight-binding chains”等理论模型分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：由cut-and-project方法生成的一维二元紧束缚链，具有有理斜率α=p/q，形成周期且具有反演对称性的链，含n=p+q个格点。体系由两种跳跃振幅t_a和t_b编码二元结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反演对称性将电极化P约束为0或P_q/2（模极化量子P_q）。拓扑相变（两个极化量子化不同的绝缘体之间）发生当且仅当n/gcd(M,n)为奇数；当其为偶数时，尽管t_a=t_b处能隙闭合，两个绝缘区极化均为零，无拓扑相变发生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反演对称性将电极化P约束为0或P_q/2（模极化量子P_q）。拓扑相变（两个极化量子化不同的绝缘体之间）发生当且仅当n/gcd(M,n)为奇数；当其为偶数时，尽管t_a=t_b处能隙闭合，两个绝缘区极化均为零，无拓扑相变发生。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用紧束缚模型描述二元链，通过cut-and-project方法构造周期结构；分析能谱随p/n的变化形成“Cut-and-Project butterfly”；利用反演对称性约束电极化量子化，并研究能隙闭合与拓扑相变的条件；对n为偶数、M为奇数的情况构造保持反演对称性和能隙的绝热路径。

papers.title: Thickness-Dependent Orbital-to-Spin Torque Signatures in Cr/Gd/Co Thin Films
papers.abstract: We studied orbital-torque generation in Cr(10nm)/Gd($t_{\mathrm{Gd}}$)/Co(3nm)/TaO$_x$ and the inverted stack Co(3nm)/Gd($t_{\mathrm{Gd}}$)/Cr(10nm) with $t_{\mathrm{Gd}}$ from 0 to $5\,\mathrm{nm}$ by combining electrical harmonic Hall measurements with magnetometry. A detailed understanding of the magnetometric data is obtained by cross-sectional chemical composition mapping. The data show temperature-dependent magnetic compensation points, while elemental analysis provides evidence of pronounced intermixing, in particular of Gd and Co layers. From the harmonic Hall dataset we extract the damping-like (DL) and field-like (FL) torque efficiencies normalized to the applied electric field, $ξ_{\mathrm{DL}}^{E}$ and $ξ_{\mathrm{FL}}^{E}$, and interpret their dependence on the Gd interlayer thickness using two different descriptions: (i) a naive-layer model and (ii) an alloy model that accounts for interfacial mixing. Notably, upon reversing the stack order, the FL contribution changes sign, whereas the DL contribution does not change sign within the harmonic Hall measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“electrical harmonic Hall measurements”“magnetometry”“cross-sectional chemical composition mapping”等实验手段。；研究对象：Cr/Gd/Co 薄膜异质结及其反置结构 Co/Gd/Cr，具体研究 Gd 插层厚度（0–5 nm）对轨道转矩（orbital torque）产生与自旋-轨道转矩（spin-orbit torque）符号特征的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Cr/Gd/Co 与 Co/Gd/Cr 两种堆叠中，Gd 层厚度可调控类阻尼（DL）与类场（FL）转矩效率；反转堆叠顺序后，FL 贡献符号反转，而 DL 贡献符号不变。同时，元素分析显示 Gd/Co 层间存在显著互混，需用合金模型而非简单分层模型解释数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Cr/Gd/Co 与 Co/Gd/Cr 两种堆叠中，Gd 层厚度可调控类阻尼（DL）与类场（FL）转矩效率；反转堆叠顺序后，FL 贡献符号反转，而 DL 贡献符号不变。同时，元素分析显示 Gd/Co 层间存在显著互混，需用合金模型而非简单分层模型解释数据。；创新点：首次在 Cr/Gd/Co 体系中系统研究 Gd 插层厚度对轨道转矩符号与效率的影响，并揭示堆叠反转导致的 FL 符号不对称性；同时强调界面互混对转矩解释的关键作用，提出合金模型优于简单分层模型。摘要未突出说明与以往轨道转矩研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 电学谐波霍尔测量（harmonic Hall measurements）提取 DL 与 FL 转矩效率（ξ_DL^E、ξ_FL^E）；磁强计（magnetometry）测量磁化随温度与厚度的变化；截面化学组分映射（cross-sectional chemical composition mapping）分析层间互混；并用“naive-layer model”与“alloy model”两种模型对比解释厚度依赖。

papers.title: Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo applied to a simple fermionic model: A critical assessment of the method
papers.abstract: We investigate the Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo (SHDMC) method using a one-dimensional model with periodic boundary conditions. An inversion symmetry is introduced to mimic the antisymmetry property of fermionic wavefunctions, with the bosonic and fermionic sectors being modeled by the even and odd eigenstates, respectively. As in realistic fermionic systems, the nodal structure is only partially constrained by symmetry, making this model a non-trivial testbed for nodal optimization algorithms such as SHDMC. We show that the nodal evolution under SHDMC iterations can be cast into a dynamical system exhibiting both attractive and repulsive fixed points. In the standard formulation of SHDMC applied to this model, the fixed-node energy is found to increase upon iteration, and the node converges to a wrong value, indicating that SHDMC does not always converge to the correct solution. We further show that this problem is partially cured by modifying the nodal update criterion to give more importance to the nodal region. Achieving convergence in the general case very likely requires the use of a localized basis set, as is the case for this model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Diffusion Monte Carlo（扩散蒙特卡洛）、模型计算、迭代方法分析。；研究对象：一维周期边界条件下的简单费米子模型。该模型通过引入反演对称性来模拟费米子波函数的反对称性，其中偶宇称和奇宇称本征态分别对应玻色子和费米子扇区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标准SHDMC框架下，该模型的节点演化表现为一个同时具有吸引和排斥不动点的动力学系统；迭代过程中固定节点能量上升，节点收敛到错误值，表明SHDMC并非总能收敛到正确解。通过修改节点更新准则（更重视节点区域）可部分修复该问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标准SHDMC框架下，该模型的节点演化表现为一个同时具有吸引和排斥不动点的动力学系统；迭代过程中固定节点能量上升，节点收敛到错误值，表明SHDMC并非总能收敛到正确解。通过修改节点更新准则（更重视节点区域）可部分修复该问题。；创新点：首次在一个节点结构仅部分受对称性约束的非平凡一维模型中系统评估SHDMC的收敛行为，揭示了其存在错误收敛（吸引到错误不动点）的机制，并指出局部基组可能是实现一般情形下收敛的必要条件。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或材料的关联。
papers.method_zh: Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo (SHDMC) 方法，应用于一维模型；对节点演化进行动力学系统分析；对比标准节点更新准则与修改后的准则。

papers.title: An exact and fast solution of the inverse Regularized Optimal Transport problem
papers.abstract: Optimal transport describes the most efficient way to move mass between two distributions, given a cost matrix for moving mass between each pair of locations. Entropic optimal transport, solved via the Sinkhorn algorithm, is a widely used regularized version of this problem. Its inverse problem asks the opposite question: given an observed transport plan, what cost matrix produced it? This is difficult because the cost is identifiable only up to an additive gauge freedom. Here we show that this freedom can be fixed exactly by a single double-centering operation applied to the observed plan, yielding the true cost matrix in closed form, with no iterative optimization required. When a modest number of true cost entries are known, the same approach lets us jointly estimate the temperature parameter controlling the entropic regularization, together with a diagnostic for the reliability of this estimate. We further show that the method is not specific to the entropic optimal transport, but extends to a broader class of transport models defined by an invertible relation between cost and plan.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了数学证明（“closed form”）、算法（“Sinkhorn algorithm”）以及数值估计方法（“jointly estimate”），未涉及具体实验。；研究对象：最优传输（Optimal Transport）及其正则化版本——熵正则化最优传输（Entropic Optimal Transport）的**逆问题**。具体物理/数学对象是：给定观测到的传输计划（transport plan），反推产生它的代价矩阵（cost matrix）和温度参数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该逆问题中代价矩阵的“规范自由度”（gauge freedom）可以通过对观测传输计划施加**一次双中心化（double-centering）操作**来精确固定，从而以**闭式解**直接得到真实代价矩阵，无需任何迭代优化。此外，当已知少量真实代价条目时，该方法还能联合估计熵正则化的温度参数，并给出该估计可靠性的诊断指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该逆问题中代价矩阵的“规范自由度”（gauge freedom）可以通过对观测传输计划施加**一次双中心化（double-centering）操作**来精确固定，从而以**闭式解**直接得到真实代价矩阵，无需任何迭代优化。此外，当已知少量真实代价条目时，该方法还能联合估计熵正则化的温度参数，并给出该估计可靠性的诊断指标。；创新点：首次证明了逆正则化最优传输问题可以通过**单次闭式操作**（而非迭代优化）精确求解，并给出了温度参数的可辨识性条件与可靠性诊断。摘要未突出说明该方法与现有迭代逆OT算法在计算复杂度上的具体对比数值。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与算法设计。核心工具是**双中心化操作**（double-centering），用于消除代价矩阵的加性规范自由度。对于温度参数估计，采用已知代价条目作为约束的联合估计方法。该方法不限于熵正则化OT，而是适用于**代价与传输计划之间存在可逆关系**的更广泛传输模型类别。

papers.title: Intruder dynamics in granular media under localized surface loading
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate the dynamics of a spherical intruder driven horizontally at a constant force in a granular medium subjected to a localized surface overload. While intruder motion beneath a free surface exhibits constant acceleration in the quasistatic regime, the presence of a surface load induces a pronounced transient deceleration when the intruder passes below the loaded region. The magnitude of this deceleration increases with the applied overload and saturates at large overloads, while it decreases with intruder depth. Introducing a characteristic timescale and an overload-based Froude number, we show that the deceleration dynamics collapse onto master curves. We further develop a model incorporating stress transmission from the surface, which partially captures the intruder deceleration. In this approach, this deceleration is shown to depend on two parameters: the overload and the area on which this overload is applied. These results provide a framework to quantify how localized surface stresses influence subsurface intruder dynamics, with implications for locomotion, root growth, and underground transport in granular media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“experimentally investigate”，属于实验研究。；研究对象：颗粒介质中的球形侵入体（intruder）在局部表面过载条件下的水平恒力驱动动力学。具体物理现象为侵入体在颗粒介质中运动时，经过表面加载区域下方所受到的瞬态减速行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部表面过载会在侵入体经过其下方时引起显著的瞬态减速，该减速幅度随过载增大而增大并在大过载下饱和，随侵入体深度增大而减小；引入特征时间尺度和基于过载的Froude数后，减速动力学可塌缩到主曲线上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部表面过载会在侵入体经过其下方时引起显著的瞬态减速，该减速幅度随过载增大而增大并在大过载下饱和，随侵入体深度增大而减小；引入特征时间尺度和基于过载的Froude数后，减速动力学可塌缩到主曲线上。；创新点：首次系统研究了局部表面载荷（而非均匀载荷或自由表面）对颗粒介质中水平驱动侵入体动力学的影响，并提出了基于过载的Froude数作为无量纲控制参数，使不同条件下的减速数据塌缩到统一主曲线上。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：对颗粒介质施加局部表面过载，使用球形侵入体在恒定水平力驱动下运动，测量其运动学量（速度/加速度）随位置和时间的变化。理论建模：建立包含表面应力传递的模型，该模型部分捕捉了侵入体的减速行为，并表明减速取决于两个参数——过载大小及其作用面积。

papers.title: Tunneling characteristics of twisted double bilayer graphene heterostructures
papers.abstract: Electron tunneling between sheets of bilayer Bernal graphene twisted at different small angles was studied experimentally and theoretically.
