The current-voltage characteristics exhibit resonant peaks, steps, and regions of negative differential resistance, the origin of which is explained by the intersections of energy- and momentum-shifted electron dispersions of adjacent layers. A theoretical analysis of tunneling transport demonstrated that the key to understanding this phenomenon lies in the competition between two contributions: between like (conductivity-conductivity or valence-valence) and unlike (conductivity-valence) bands of parallel bilayer graphene sheets. A systematic evolution of the tunneling current patterns with increase of the twist angle is investigated. Polarization of electron wave function across graphene sublayers caused by displacement field within bilayer graphene is shown to strongly affect the tunneling probability, thus enhancing negative differential resistance due to Van Hove singularities at the band edges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“studied experimentally and theoretically”，包含实验测量与理论分析。；研究对象：扭转双层Bernal石墨烯异质结构（twisted double bilayer graphene heterostructures），即两层Bernal堆垛双层石墨烯以不同小角度扭转堆叠形成的体系，研究其层间电子隧穿特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 隧穿电流-电压特性呈现共振峰、台阶和负微分电阻区域，其起源可归因于相邻层间能量与动量平移的电子色散的交点；层间隧穿由同类能带（导带-导带或价带-价带）与异类能带（导带-价带）贡献之间的竞争主导。双层石墨烯内位移场引起的跨子层波函数极化会显著改变隧穿概率，并通过能带边缘的Van Hove奇点增强负微分电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：隧穿电流-电压特性呈现共振峰、台阶和负微分电阻区域，其起源可归因于相邻层间能量与动量平移的电子色散的交点；层间隧穿由同类能带（导带-导带或价带-价带）与异类能带（导带-价带）贡献之间的竞争主导。双层石墨烯内位移场引起的跨子层波函数极化会显著改变隧穿概率，并通过能带边缘的Van Hove奇点增强负微分电阻。；创新点：系统揭示了扭转角增大时隧穿电流图样的演化规律，并指出位移场诱导的波函数极化对隧穿概率及负微分电阻的调控作用。摘要未突出说明与已有扭转石墨烯隧穿研究的对比性创新。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量隧穿电流-电压特性曲线；理论上对隧穿输运进行分析，考察不同扭转角下能带色散的交点结构，并计算隧穿概率对波函数极化的依赖。摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如扫描隧道显微镜/输运测量装置）或理论方法（如紧束缚模型/连续模型）的细节。

papers.title: Multiple chiral Majorana states in proximitized magnetic topological insulator heterostructures
papers.abstract: Achieving robust topological superconductivity with multiple Majorana channels is a key step for scalable topological quantum computing. To this end, we investigate magnetically doped three-dimensional topological insulator heterostructures proximitized by an s-wave superconductor within a fully three-dimensional extended Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang framework that explicitly accounts for vertical confinement. We show that magnetic exchange coupling, orbital mixing, and bulk band inversion cooperate to generate effective equal-spin p-wave pairing channels supporting multiple chiral Majorana modes. The number of Majorana channels is determined by the confined modes in the vertical direction and the high-Chern-number phases of the normal state, which allows us to derive an analytical criterion for the emergence of the multiple-Majorana topological superconducting phases. The chiral Majorana modes remain robust against strong disorder and moderate symmetry-breaking perturbations. We also demonstrate that a superconducting phase difference defining a vertical Josephson junction acts as a tunable parameter that controls the hybridization, minigap, and effective multiplicity of the low energy Majorana channels. Our results establish magnetic three-dimensional topological- insulator heterostructures as a promising platform for engineering multiple chiral Majorana modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“investigate”“framework”“show”“derive an analytical criterion”等理论推导与建模关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：磁性掺杂的三维拓扑绝缘体异质结构，与s波超导体邻近耦合，研究其拓扑超导态及手性马约拉纳模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁交换耦合、轨道混合与体能带反转协同作用，可在该异质结构中产生有效的等自旋p波配对通道，支持多个手性马约拉纳模；马约拉纳通道数目由垂直方向的受限模式及正常态的高陈数相决定，并给出了多马约拉纳拓扑超导相出现的解析判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁交换耦合、轨道混合与体能带反转协同作用，可在该异质结构中产生有效的等自旋p波配对通道，支持多个手性马约拉纳模；马约拉纳通道数目由垂直方向的受限模式及正常态的高陈数相决定，并给出了多马约拉纳拓扑超导相出现的解析判据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用全三维扩展的Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang（BHZ）框架，显式考虑垂直方向的量子受限效应，对磁性掺杂三维拓扑绝缘体/超导体异质结构进行理论建模与分析。

papers.title: Interferometry reveals spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall edges in graphene
papers.abstract: The edge modes of spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall (FQH) phases are manifestations of multicomponent topological order and SU(2) spin symmetry. An archetype is the spin-unpolarized state at $ν$=2/3, whose edge is expected to host spatially coexisting yet counter-propagating charge and neutral spin modes. Despite efforts, its edge properties, including spin coherence and spin-charge separation, have remained elusive owing to the difficulty of resolving spins in FQH edge transport. Here, we develop a spin-sensitive probe of graphene FQH edges by using a p-n junction to interface a target FQH state with a probe integer quantum Hall (QH) state of opposite polarity. An Aharonov-Bohm (AB) interferometer forms along the interface, when the target and probe edge channels carry the same spin. We identify the spin-unpolarized and polarized edges of the $ν$=2/3 states at lower and higher magnetic fields, respectively, through spin-dependent interference. A novel multiparticle AB interference between two electrons of opposite spin emerges from spin-charge separation and recombination on the unpolarized edge, featuring a spin swap. Our results establish edge transport as a probe of spin-singlet topological orders, with implications for parafermion platforms in graphene-superconductor hybrids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“we develop a spin-sensitive probe”“We identify...through spin-dependent interference”，属于实验测量工作。；研究对象：石墨烯中自旋单态分数量子霍尔（FQH）态的边界模式，具体聚焦于ν=2/3自旋非极化态及其边缘的自旋-电荷分离、自旋交换等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自旋敏感的Aharonov-Bohm干涉测量，在较低磁场下识别出ν=2/3态的自旋非极化边缘，在较高磁场下识别出自旋极化边缘；并观测到由自旋-电荷分离与复合导致的新型双电子（相反自旋）多粒子AB干涉，伴随自旋交换过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自旋敏感的Aharonov-Bohm干涉测量，在较低磁场下识别出ν=2/3态的自旋非极化边缘，在较高磁场下识别出自旋极化边缘；并观测到由自旋-电荷分离与复合导致的新型双电子（相反自旋）多粒子AB干涉，伴随自旋交换过程。；创新点：首次实现对FQH边缘的自旋敏感探测，直接分辨了ν=2/3态的自旋非极化与极化边缘；观测到自旋-电荷分离引起的双粒子自旋交换干涉，为自旋单态拓扑序的边缘输运研究提供了新手段，并对石墨烯-超导体混合体系中的parafermion平台有潜在意义。
papers.method_zh: 利用p-n结将目标FQH态与相反极性的整数量子霍尔（QH）探测态耦合，沿界面形成Aharonov-Bohm（AB）干涉仪；通过自旋依赖的干涉信号区分不同自旋构型的边缘通道。

papers.title: Geometry-Controlled Magnetic and Electronic Landscapes in Anisotropic van der Waals Materials
papers.abstract: Electronic structure in van der Waals materials is commonly engineered through composition, strain, electrostatic gating and heterostructure assembly. Here we introduce geometronics, a concept in which substrate geometry locally reorients an anisotropic crystal, transforming homogeneous external perturbation into programmable magnetic and electronic landscapes. We demonstrate this concept using a bilayer of the antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrSBr transferred onto an inverted pyramidal nanoindentation, where the local crystal orientation with respect to the external magnetic field drives the coexistence of antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic phases within a single continuous crystal. The resulting magnetic landscape creates a switchable excitonic potential well of up to 10--12 meV, directly visualised by spatially resolved spectroscopy. More generally, geometronics provides a universal route for deterministically programmed electronic and magnetic landscapes without modifying the material itself. It therefore establishes substrate topography as a new design principle that exploits the intrinsic anisotropy of layered van der Waals materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate this concept using...”“directly visualised by spatially resolved spectroscopy”，属于实验验证与表征。；研究对象：各向异性范德华材料 CrSBr 双层膜，具体为反铁磁半导体 CrSBr 转移至倒金字塔形纳米压痕上形成的体系；研究其磁性与激子性质在几何调控下的空间分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基底几何形貌（倒金字塔纳米压痕）局部改变 CrSBr 晶体的取向，可在单一连续晶体内实现反铁磁与铁磁相共存，并形成可开关的激子势阱（深度约 10–12 meV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基底几何形貌（倒金字塔纳米压痕）局部改变 CrSBr 晶体的取向，可在单一连续晶体内实现反铁磁与铁磁相共存，并形成可开关的激子势阱（深度约 10–12 meV）。；创新点：提出“几何电子学”（geometronics）概念——利用基底形貌而非材料改性（如组分、应变、栅压或异质结组装）来编程电子与磁学景观，将基底拓扑结构确立为一种新的设计原则。摘要未突出说明与传统应变工程或图案化方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 将 CrSBr 双层膜转移至倒金字塔形纳米压痕上；利用空间分辨光谱（spatially resolved spectroscopy）直接观测激子势阱；通过外部磁场调控局域晶体取向与磁场的相对关系。

papers.title: Robust thermodynamics constrain disorder and pairing in far-overdoped Tl$_2$Ba$_2$CuO$_6$
papers.abstract: The physical origin of the suppression of superconductivity with hole doping in overdoped cuprates remains unclear. We measure the electronic specific heat of microgram-scale Tl$_2$Ba$_2$CuO$_6$ crystals and find sharp superconducting anomalies persisting far into the overdoped regime, with $Δγ(T_{\rm c})/γ_n\approx0.6$ for $T_{\rm c}=14$-$25$K. A weak-coupling BCS-like framework incorporating the known Fermi surface and cation disorder quantitatively reproduces the observed anomaly and its weak doping dependence. We conclude that the observed $T_{\rm c}(p)$ cannot be driven predominantly by increasing disorder and is instead consistent with a smoothly decreasing pairing strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模分析）。判断依据：摘要提及“measure the electronic specific heat”（测量电子比热）、“microgram-scale crystals”（微克级晶体），同时包含“weak-coupling BCS-like framework”（弱耦合BCS框架）进行定量拟合。；研究对象：过掺杂铜氧化物超导体 Tl₂Ba₂CuO₆（Tl-2201），具体关注其超导电性随空穴掺杂被抑制的物理起源，以及无序与配对强度对超导转变温度 T_c(p) 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远过掺杂区（T_c = 14–25 K），Tl₂Ba₂CuO₆ 仍表现出尖锐的超导比热异常，且 Δγ(T_c)/γ_n ≈ 0.6；该异常可由包含已知费米面和阳离子无序的弱耦合BCS框架定量重现，表明 T_c(p) 的下降主要源于配对强度平滑减弱，而非无序增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远过掺杂区（T_c = 14–25 K），Tl₂Ba₂CuO₆ 仍表现出尖锐的超导比热异常，且 Δγ(T_c)/γ_n ≈ 0.6；该异常可由包含已知费米面和阳离子无序的弱耦合BCS框架定量重现，表明 T_c(p) 的下降主要源于配对强度平滑减弱，而非无序增强。；创新点：首次在远过掺杂区（低至 T_c = 14 K）通过热力学量（电子比热）直接观测到尖锐超导转变异常，并用统一框架同时考虑费米面与无序，排除了无序作为 T_c 抑制主因的可能性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用微克级单晶的电子比热测量；理论上采用弱耦合BCS类框架，并结合已知费米面结构及阳离子无序效应进行定量对比分析。

papers.title: Autonomous discovery of new structure-plausibility laws for explainable and rapid crystal diagnosis and screening
papers.abstract: Crystal generators and tool-using agents propose structures faster than density functional theory (DFT) energy and phonon calculations or experiments can assess them. Deciding which candidates merit expensive assessment is therefore the bottleneck, yet most screens test little beyond atomic overlap and give no chemical reason for failure. Here, our agents generate, test and actively refute two million candidate laws, leaving eight Plausibility Rules for Inorganic Structures (PRIS). These laws encode five mechanisms: short-range repulsion, ionic contact and packing, electrostatic balance, bond-valence conservation and crystallographic site complexity. Experimental structures satisfy our law sets at 82--99%, but satisfy Pauling's rules 2--5 together at only 6.5%. The strictest set detects 87.9% of damaged crystal structures, whereas distance cutoffs detect only 1.6--3.2%. PRIS plausibility is linearly correlated with synthesizability, so the PRIS-derived synthesis score (PSS) explainably screens 83.7% of hard-to-synthesize structures while retaining 80.7% of experimental structures. In a property-conditioned inverse-design run, PRIS and PSS can reduce the DFT validation queue by up to 67.3% and keep 99.2% of the candidates whose DFT-validated bulk moduli reach the design target. Beyond screening, PRIS explains why GNoME remains enriched in rare low-symmetry structures and reveals how wrong-element assignments in falsified crystal reports hide behind plausible coordinates. PRIS moves screening from a pass-or-fail verdict to a chemical reason for failure, showing that autonomous agents can discover, by active refutation, physicochemical laws that guide calculations and experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（结合自主智能体与大规模规则筛选）。判断依据关键词：agents generate, test and actively refute、two million candidate laws、DFT validation queue。；研究对象：无机晶体结构的合理性（plausibility）判定与筛选，具体涉及晶体生成器与工具型智能体提出的候选结构，以及实验晶体结构数据库中的已知结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自主智能体主动证伪两百万条候选规则，提炼出八条无机结构合理性规则（PRIS），其判定能力远超传统距离截断和Pauling规则，且PRIS合理性分数与实验可合成性线性相关，可用于高效筛选难合成结构并大幅缩减DFT验证队列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自主智能体主动证伪两百万条候选规则，提炼出八条无机结构合理性规则（PRIS），其判定能力远超传统距离截断和Pauling规则，且PRIS合理性分数与实验可合成性线性相关，可用于高效筛选难合成结构并大幅缩减DFT验证队列。；创新点：将晶体筛选从“通过/不通过”的二元判定提升为给出化学失败原因的解释性判定；首次证明自主智能体可通过主动证伪发现指导计算与实验的物理化学规律；揭示GNoME中稀有低对称结构富集的原因，以及错误元素分配如何隐藏在看似合理的坐标中。
papers.method_zh: 自主智能体（agents）生成、测试并主动证伪候选规则；以DFT能量/声子计算和实验数据为基准；对比Pauling规则（规则2–5）与距离截断方法；构建PRIS-derived synthesis score（PSS）用于性质条件反设计筛选；以DFT验证的体模量作为设计目标评估筛选保留率。

papers.title: Dynamical phase transitions for single particles in the semiclassical and weak noise limits
papers.abstract: We present a unifying description of dynamical phase transitions in the unitary evolution of an isolated quantum particle and the dissipative relaxation of a classical Brownian particle, based on a dynamical generat- ing function. In the semiclassical and weak-noise limits, Fisher zeros of this function condense in the complex- time plane and reach the corresponding physical axes, producing dynamical phase transitions through a competition between return trajectories. This establishes a direct connection between quantum and classical (finite-time) dynamical phase transitions, where the semiclassical limit plays the role of the thermodynamic limit. In particular, the established link naturally provides a classical version of the Loschmidt amplitude and shows how dynamical quantum phase transitions, typically associated with isolated many-body systems, can arise in a single-particle quantum system. The dynamical phases are distinguished by a unifying, trajectory- based order parameter, realized as a classical correlation function and a sequential quantum weak value.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：unifying description、dynamical generating function、semiclassical and weak-noise limits、Fisher zeros。；研究对象：孤立量子单粒子的幺正演化与经典布朗粒子的耗散弛豫中的动力学相变，以及二者之间的统一联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半经典与弱噪声极限下，动力学生成函数的Fisher零点在复时间平面上凝聚并到达物理时间轴，通过返回轨迹之间的竞争产生动力学相变；半经典极限在此扮演了热力学极限的角色，从而在单粒子量子系统中实现了通常与孤立多体系统相关的动力学量子相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半经典与弱噪声极限下，动力学生成函数的Fisher零点在复时间平面上凝聚并到达物理时间轴，通过返回轨迹之间的竞争产生动力学相变；半经典极限在此扮演了热力学极限的角色，从而在单粒子量子系统中实现了通常与孤立多体系统相关的动力学量子相变。；创新点：建立了量子与经典（有限时间）动力学相变之间的直接对应关系，并自然给出了Loschmidt振幅的经典版本；展示了单粒子量子系统即可出现动力学量子相变，无需多体热力学极限。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于动力学生成函数（dynamical generating function）的解析分析，结合Fisher零点凝聚机制、半经典极限与弱噪声极限下的路径积分/轨迹竞争分析；引入基于轨迹的序参量（经典关联函数与顺序量子弱值）来区分动力学相。

papers.title: Layer-selective and magnetic-field-enhanced transport of topological kink states in rhombohedral multilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Topological valley kink states (VKSs), which are quantum valley Hall states emerging at the interfaces between adjacent domains with opposite valley Chern numbers, have attracted considerable interest in graphene-based systems. In this work, we investigate the quantum transport of VKSs in ABC-stacked rhombohedral multilayer graphene in the presence of Anderson disorder and a perpendicular magnetic field. Two prominent transport characteristics are revealed. First, in the absence of a magnetic field, the kink states exhibit strong layer polarization, with their wave functions predominantly localized and equally distributed on the outermost top and bottom layers. As a result, their transport properties are highly sensitive to the layer-selective disorder distribution. Second, under a perpendicular magnetic field, the layer-symmetric spatial distribution of VKSs is broken, leading to a significant reduction in the wave-function overlap between counter-propagating VKSs from opposite valleys. Consequently, intervalley scattering is suppressed, and the transmission of VKSs through disordered regions is substantially enhanced. Our results provide new insights into multichannel topological valley transport in rhombohedral multilayer graphene and demonstrates disorder-engineering and magnetic fields as effective approaches for manipulating the propagation of VKSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“investigate the quantum transport”“Anderson disorder”“transmission”等，属于输运性质的理论计算研究。；研究对象：ABC堆叠菱方多层石墨烯中的拓扑谷陈数边界态（valley kink states, VKSs），即相邻谷陈数相反畴界处的量子谷霍尔态，并考虑Anderson无序和垂直磁场的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VKSs在零磁场下具有强层极化特性（波函数主要分布在最外层顶/底两层），其输运对层选择性无序高度敏感；施加垂直磁场会打破VKSs的层对称空间分布，减小来自相反谷的相向传播VKSs之间的波函数重叠，从而抑制谷间散射并显著增强无序区透射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VKSs在零磁场下具有强层极化特性（波函数主要分布在最外层顶/底两层），其输运对层选择性无序高度敏感；施加垂直磁场会打破VKSs的层对称空间分布，减小来自相反谷的相向传播VKSs之间的波函数重叠，从而抑制谷间散射并显著增强无序区透射。；创新点：揭示了菱方多层石墨烯中VKSs的层选择性输运特性，并提出无序工程和磁场可作为调控VKSs传播的有效手段。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 量子输运计算（具体方法如格林函数或散射矩阵等摘要未明确说明），在ABC菱方多层石墨烯模型中引入Anderson无序和垂直磁场，分析波函数空间分布、层极化、谷间散射与透射率。

papers.title: Probing Nonlinear Interactions of Dipolar Interlayer Excitons in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: Interlayer excitons in transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers possess intrinsic out-of-plane dipole moments, providing a platform for investigating exciton-exciton interactions at high densities. Here, we use excitation-energy-dependent photoluminescence excitation (PLE) spectroscopy to probe the nonlinear response of dipolar interlayer excitons in chemical vapor deposition-grown MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers. By tuning the excitation energy across intralayer exciton resonances at fixed excitation power, we selectively vary the population injected into the interlayer exciton states. Resonant excitation drives the system into a nonlinear regime, leading to saturation of the interlayer exciton photoluminescence and an apparent broadening of the intralayer $1s$ resonances in the PLE spectra. At the same time, the interlayer exciton emission exhibits a pronounced blueshift, reaching approximately 2.5 meV at 4 K and 1 meV at 75 K. The blueshift increases systematically with the interlayer exciton population and is consistent with a net repulsive exciton-exciton interaction, with contributions from dipole-dipole repulsion in the density regime investigated. Our results establish PLE as a sensitive approach for accessing the nonlinear, high-density regime of interlayer excitons and probing their interactions in van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“photoluminescence excitation (PLE) spectroscopy”等实验手段，并给出具体温度（4 K、75 K）下的测量结果。；研究对象：化学气相沉积（CVD）生长的MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层中的层间激子（interlayer excitons），重点研究其高密度下的非线性激子-激子相互作用，以及由面外偶极矩导致的偶极-偶极排斥效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共振激发将层间激子注入非线性高密度区间，观察到层间激子光致发光饱和、PLE谱中带内1s共振展宽，以及层间激子发射的显著蓝移（4 K时约2.5 meV，75 K时约1 meV）。该蓝移随激子密度系统性增大，与净排斥性激子-激子相互作用（含偶极-偶极排斥贡献）一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共振激发将层间激子注入非线性高密度区间，观察到层间激子光致发光饱和、PLE谱中带内1s共振展宽，以及层间激子发射的显著蓝移（4 K时约2.5 meV，75 K时约1 meV）。该蓝移随激子密度系统性增大，与净排斥性激子-激子相互作用（含偶极-偶极排斥贡献）一致。；创新点：将PLE光谱确立为一种灵敏探测层间激子非线性高密度区及其相互作用的实验途径，能够在范德华异质结构中直接通过激发能量选择性调控激子密度，从而观测排斥性相互作用引起的蓝移与饱和效应。
papers.method_zh: 激发能量依赖的光致发光激发（PLE）光谱学。在固定激发功率下，将激发能量调谐穿过带内激子共振，从而选择性调控注入层间激子态的粒子数，并测量其发光强度、线宽及能量位移随密度的变化。

papers.title: Quantum antidipolar systems in two-dimensional geometries
papers.abstract: Particles with magnetic moment can be polarized, and rapidly rotated, employing a magnetic field such that the dipolar interaction among them changes sign, becoming antidipolar and thus isotropically attractive in a plane. Polar molecules can also be manipulated using microwave dressing fields to invert the sign of the dipole-dipole interaction. In this work, we study a two-dimensional system of antidipolar particles by calculating its equation of state and structural properties. The system behaves as a liquid even for scattering lengths significantly greater than the dipolar length. For large enough densities, the system transitions to a solid with one particle per lattice site via a first-order phase transition at a significantly smaller density than its dipolar counterpart. Moreover, motivated by the recent realization of a strongly axially trapped, bilayer geometry [Science 384, 546-551 (2024)], we study the properties of the bilayer liquid phase as the inter-layer distance is tuned, and provide the range of parameters where one layer can influence the properties of the other.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study”“by calculating its equation of state and structural properties”，属于理论建模与数值计算研究，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：二维几何中的反偶极（antidipolar）量子粒子系统，包括均匀二维液体/固体相，以及强轴向囚禁的双层几何结构中的液体相。具体物理现象为反偶极相互作用导致的各向同性吸引、液-固一级相变及层间耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反偶极粒子在二维中即使散射长度远大于偶极长度时仍表现为液体；在足够大密度下，系统通过一级相变转变为每格点单粒子的固体，且该相变密度显著低于其偶极对应系统。在双层结构中，通过调节层间距可调控层间影响，并给出了单层影响另一层的参数范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反偶极粒子在二维中即使散射长度远大于偶极长度时仍表现为液体；在足够大密度下，系统通过一级相变转变为每格点单粒子的固体，且该相变密度显著低于其偶极对应系统。在双层结构中，通过调节层间距可调控层间影响，并给出了单层影响另一层的参数范围。；创新点：首次系统研究二维反偶极（吸引性偶极）粒子的液-固相图，发现其相较于正常偶极系统在更低密度下发生一级液-固相变；并针对近期实验实现的强轴向囚禁双层几何（Science 384, 546-551 (2024)），定量给出层间距离调控下双层液体相中一层影响另一层的参数区间。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算：通过计算系统的状态方程（equation of state）和结构性质（structural properties）来表征热力学与结构行为；针对双层几何，通过调节层间距研究液体相性质变化。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如量子蒙特卡洛、扩散蒙特卡洛或超流变分等），仅描述为“calculating”。

papers.title: Nonmonotonic control of pattern formation by chemotaxis
papers.abstract: We investigate pattern formation in generic two-species reaction--diffusion systems with chemotaxis. We show that chemotaxis can give rise to a striking nonmonotonic dependence of pattern formation on its strength, opening the possibility of re-entrant transitions between patterned and homogeneous states controlled by chemotaxis. In certain regimes, chemotaxis also induces additional heretofore unexplored instabilities. Furthermore, varying the strength of chemotaxis can drive morphological transitions between spot and stripe patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We investigate”“We show”等理论推导性表述，研究对象为“generic two-species reaction–diffusion systems”，属于一般性理论模型分析，未涉及具体实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：具有趋化性（chemotaxis）的通用双组分反应–扩散系统中的斑图形成（pattern formation）现象，包括均匀态与斑图态之间的转变以及斑点（spot）与条纹（stripe）形态的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 趋化性强度对斑图形成具有显著的非单调控制作用，可导致由趋化性调控的“斑图态–均匀态”重入转变；在特定参数区间内，趋化性还会诱发此前未被探索过的新失稳模式，并能驱动斑点与条纹之间的形态转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：趋化性强度对斑图形成具有显著的非单调控制作用，可导致由趋化性调控的“斑图态–均匀态”重入转变；在特定参数区间内，趋化性还会诱发此前未被探索过的新失稳模式，并能驱动斑点与条纹之间的形态转变。；创新点：揭示了趋化性对斑图形成的非单调控制机制，首次提出趋化性可诱导斑图–均匀态重入转变；发现了趋化性诱发的新型失稳模式；建立了趋化强度与斑图形态（斑点/条纹）转变之间的直接联系。摘要未突出说明与具体生物或物理体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用通用双组分反应–扩散模型（含趋化耦合项）进行线性稳定性分析（线性失稳分析），通过解析或半解析方式考察趋化强度对失稳条件及斑图选择的影响。摘要未明确说明是否包含非线性数值模拟。

papers.title: Interfacial orbital torques excite nanoscale terahertz magnons
papers.abstract: Exchange-dominated magnons in nanometer-thick ferromagnets extend to the terahertz regime through thickness quantization of perpendicular standing spin-wave (PSSW) modes. While interfacial spin-orbit torques (SOTs) have been shown to enable the excitation of such modes, the microscopic origin of the interfacial driving torque remains unclear. In particular, the coexistence of spin and orbital currents complicates the understanding. Here, we develop and use an atomistic framework that explicitly resolves interfacial symmetries and separates spin and orbital torque contributions. Exploiting a trilayer geometry for a thin ferromagnet sandwiched between non-magnetic layers, where the symmetry-controlled polarity of the interfacial torque produces mode-selective magnon excitation as observed in the recent experiment of Salikhov et al. Nature Phys. 19, 529 (2023), we disentangle the different interfacial torque contributions. By decomposing the torque into magnetization-even (field-like) and magnetization-odd components, we identify the field-like torque as the dominant contribution responsible for the excitation. Crucially, isolating orbital and spin contributions reveals that the interfacial orbital torque provides the primary channel for the efficient excitation of exchange-dominated THz magnons in thin ferromagnets. Our results establish a microscopic basis for symmetry-engineered control of confined terahertz spin dynamics in magnetic multilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop and use an atomistic framework”（发展并运用原子级框架），以及“decomposing the torque”“isolating orbital and spin contributions”等理论分析手段。；研究对象：纳米厚度铁磁薄膜（夹在非磁层之间构成三明治结构）中的交换主导太赫兹磁子（垂直驻留自旋波模式，PSSW），以及界面自旋-轨道矩和轨道矩对其的激发机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面轨道矩（而非自旋矩）是高效激发薄铁磁体中交换主导太赫兹磁子的主要通道；其中磁化偶（类场）力矩是主导贡献，且力矩的对称性控制可实现模式选择性磁子激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面轨道矩（而非自旋矩）是高效激发薄铁磁体中交换主导太赫兹磁子的主要通道；其中磁化偶（类场）力矩是主导贡献，且力矩的对称性控制可实现模式选择性磁子激发。；创新点：首次在原子级框架中明确分离自旋矩与轨道矩对界面太赫兹磁子激发的各自贡献，并识别出轨道类场矩为高效激发的主导机制，为对称性工程调控磁性多层膜中的受限太赫兹自旋动力学提供了微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 原子级（atomistic）理论框架，显式解析界面对称性，将总力矩分解为自旋矩与轨道矩贡献，并进一步按磁化偶（类场）与磁化奇分量进行分解；结合三明治几何结构（铁磁层夹于非磁层之间）进行对称性分析，并与Salikhov等人的实验（Nature Phys. 19, 529 (2023)）对照。

papers.title: Pressure-regulated mechanochemistry at lithium metal-sulfide electrolyte interfaces
papers.abstract: Stack pressure is commonly treated as a means of maintaining physical contact in all-solid-state lithium-metal batteries, but it can also alter the chemistry of reactive solid-solid interfaces. Here, using pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics validated against DFT, we determine how pressure magnitude and loading geometry regulate interphase formation at Li||Li6PS5Cl interfaces. The response is nonmonotonic: compression at 1 kbar accelerates PS4 decomposition and Li2S-like ordering, whereas 10-100 kbar compression restricts structural rearrangement and long-range crystallization. Charge-resolved dynamics further identify sulfur-centered, lithium-rich early-interphase environments associated with subsequent Li2S-like ordering. Uniaxial loading accelerates interfacial reaction relative to isostatic loading at the same nominal pressure. Pressure also changes void closure and dead-lithium spreading in a defect-location-dependent manner. These results establish applied pressure as a mechanochemical process variable coupling interphase chemistry, ion transport and defect evolution, providing a mechanistic framework for interpreting pressure effects in sulfide solid-state batteries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“machine-learning molecular dynamics validated against DFT”（机器学习分子动力学，经密度泛函理论验证），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：锂金属与硫化物固态电解质 Li6PS5Cl 的界面（Li||Li6PS5Cl），具体研究外加堆叠压力（stack pressure）的大小与加载方式如何调控该反应性固-固界面的界面相（interphase）形成、缺陷演化及死锂扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力对 Li||Li6PS5Cl 界面化学的影响是非单调的：1 kbar 压缩加速 PS4 分解和 Li2S 类有序化，而 10–100 kbar 压缩反而限制结构重排和长程结晶；单轴加载比等静压加载在相同标称压力下更快促进界面反应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力对 Li||Li6PS5Cl 界面化学的影响是非单调的：1 kbar 压缩加速 PS4 分解和 Li2S 类有序化，而 10–100 kbar 压缩反而限制结构重排和长程结晶；单轴加载比等静压加载在相同标称压力下更快促进界面反应。；创新点：将外加压力确立为一种“机械化学过程变量”（mechanochemical process variable），系统揭示压力大小与加载几何（单轴 vs 等静压）对界面化学、离子输运和缺陷演化的耦合调控机制——而非仅将压力视为维持物理接触的手段。摘要未突出说明与以往计算工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 压力感知、电荷分辨的机器学习分子动力学（pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics），并用 DFT 进行验证；通过电荷分辨动力学识别界面早期环境特征。

papers.title: Trap Dynamics and Conductivity Changes in AlGaN/GaN Heterostructures Under Ultrasonic Loading
papers.abstract: AlGaN/GaN heterostructures are critical for high-power electronic devices but suffer from electron trapping at defects, limiting reliability. We investigate how ultrasonic vibrations affect electron transport in MOCVD-grown AlGaN/GaN heterostructures by combining temperature-dependent Hall effect and high-resolution X-ray diffraction measurements. Here we demonstrate that ultrasonic loading induces persistent acoustoconductivity and lattice parameter changes, attributed to acoustically driven rearrangement of metastable DX centers. This leads to increased carrier concentration and decreased mobility, reflecting defect state modulation by acoustic strain. These findings provide new insights into trap dynamics under dynamic deformation and suggest ultrasonic treatment as a potential approach to mitigate trapping effects, thereby enhancing the performance and reliability of GaN-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要提及“combining temperature-dependent Hall effect and high-resolution X-ray diffraction measurements”，即结合变温霍尔效应与高分辨X射线衍射的实验测量。；研究对象：MOCVD生长的AlGaN/GaN异质结构，具体关注超声振动加载下缺陷（DX中心）处的电子俘获与输运行为，以及声致电导率与晶格参数变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超声加载在AlGaN/GaN异质结构中诱导出持久的声致电导率（persistent acoustoconductivity）和晶格参数变化，其机制归因于声学应变驱动的亚稳态DX中心重排，导致载流子浓度升高而迁移率下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超声加载在AlGaN/GaN异质结构中诱导出持久的声致电导率（persistent acoustoconductivity）和晶格参数变化，其机制归因于声学应变驱动的亚稳态DX中心重排，导致载流子浓度升高而迁移率下降。；创新点：首次将超声振动加载与AlGaN/GaN异质结构中的陷阱动力学联系起来，揭示动态形变（声学应变）可调控DX中心亚稳态，并提出超声处理作为缓解陷阱效应、提升GaN基器件性能与可靠性的潜在新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：变温霍尔效应测量（temperature-dependent Hall effect）和高分辨X射线衍射（high-resolution X-ray diffraction），样品由MOCVD（金属有机化学气相沉积）生长。

papers.title: Statistical Language Competition Model with Dynamic Edge Weighting on a Random Network
papers.abstract: This paper presents a computational study of language competition dynamics on Erdős--Rényi random networks, extending the foundational Abrams--Strogatz model through two novel contributions: (i) a dynamic edge-weighting mechanism that reinforces social ties between co-minority speakers by an additive increment $Δ$, and (ii) a probabilistic agent-based framework governing language switching via a weighted majority rule. Phase boundaries separating the dominance and coexistence regimes are identified across a two-dimensional parameter space $(p, Δ)$, where $p$ denotes the network connectivity probability. We further characterise anomalous persistence zones within predicted dominance regions, attributing them to the formation of isolated minority speaker clusters. Scaling study across network sizes $N \in \{50, 100, 250, 500, 1000\}$ reveal that average cluster size decreases with $N$ and that phase boundaries diffuse with increasing stochastic noise. Finally, we discuss extensions to a tripartite bilingual model and heterogeneous prestige/volatility to more faithfully capture real sociolinguistic contact scenarios.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：computational study、agent-based framework、scaling study。；研究对象：语言竞争动力学，具体为在 Erdős–Rényi 随机网络上扩展的 Abrams–Strogatz 模型，属于社会物理学/复杂系统中的相变与群体行为现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维参数空间 (p, Δ) 中识别出主导态与共存态之间的相边界；在预测的主导区域内发现异常持续区，归因于孤立少数语言使用者簇的形成。平均簇尺寸随网络规模 N 增大而减小，相边界随随机噪声增强而扩散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维参数空间 (p, Δ) 中识别出主导态与共存态之间的相边界；在预测的主导区域内发现异常持续区，归因于孤立少数语言使用者簇的形成。平均簇尺寸随网络规模 N 增大而减小，相边界随随机噪声增强而扩散。；创新点：提出动态边权重机制（增量 Δ）以强化少数语言使用者之间的社会联系，并将 Abrams–Strogatz 模型推广到随机网络上的加权多数规则；识别了主导区域内异常持续区及其与孤立簇形成的关联。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于概率的智能体（agent-based）模拟框架，采用加权多数规则控制语言切换；引入动态边权重机制（对共少数语言者之间的社会联系施加增量 Δ）；在 N ∈ {50, 100, 250, 500, 1000} 范围内进行有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: Text-guided flow matching enables sample-efficient crystal structure generation
papers.abstract: Crystal generators can now propose periodic structures, but their control interfaces remain poorly matched to the mixed descriptors used in materials design. Text provides a compact way to combine composition, symmetry, prototype and property cues, yet it has not been clear whether such information can steer flow-based crystal generation. Here we introduce TFMat, a text-conditioned flow-matching framework that uses structured materials language as a semantic prior for a CrystalFlow generator. Across Perov-5, Carbon-24 and MP-20 crystal structure prediction benchmarks, TFMat improves one-candidate match rates over CrystalFlow and reaches a 92.04% MP-20 match rate with 20 candidates; in de novo generation, it improves element-count and density distribution alignment while retaining coarse property consistency in composition-selected outputs. These results position structured text as an inspectable control layer for translating human-readable materials intent into candidate crystals for downstream simulation and validation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据关键词：flow-matching framework、generator、benchmarks、match rates。；研究对象：晶体结构生成，具体涉及Perov-5（钙钛矿）、Carbon-24（碳同素异形体）和MP-20（Materials Project 20）三个晶体结构预测基准数据集，以及de novo（从头）晶体生成任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出文本条件化的流匹配框架TFMat，利用结构化材料语言作为语义先验，显著提升了晶体结构生成的成功率：在MP-20基准上20个候选时匹配率达92.04%，优于无文本条件的CrystalFlow基线；在de novo生成中改善了元素计数和密度分布对齐，同时保持成分选择输出的粗粒度性质一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出文本条件化的流匹配框架TFMat，利用结构化材料语言作为语义先验，显著提升了晶体结构生成的成功率：在MP-20基准上20个候选时匹配率达92.04%，优于无文本条件的CrystalFlow基线；在de novo生成中改善了元素计数和密度分布对齐，同时保持成分选择输出的粗粒度性质一致性。；创新点：首次将文本条件引入基于流的晶体生成模型，使人类可读的材料意图（成分、对称性、原型、性质等混合描述符）能够以结构化文本形式作为可检查的控制层，直接引导晶体结构生成，弥合了材料设计中的混合描述符与生成模型控制接口之间的不匹配。摘要未突出说明与已有文本条件晶体生成方法（如基于扩散或自回归模型）的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于流匹配（flow matching）的生成框架，具体为在CrystalFlow生成器基础上引入文本条件化（text-conditioning），使用结构化材料语言（structured materials language）作为语义先验来引导生成过程。摘要未明确说明底层晶体表示方法（如晶格矩阵+原子坐标的具体编码方式）。

papers.title: Exchange striction determines how fast antiferromagnetic insulators demagnetize
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets combine terahertz spin dynamics with insensitivity to stray fields, and how quickly their order can be manipulated sets the speed limit on device operation. Femtosecond optical pulses demagnetize antiferromagnetic insulators on timescales that span picoseconds to nanoseconds across compounds, and no material parameter is known that accounts for the spread or predicts where a new compound will fall. In a compensated antiferromagnet, no angular momentum needs to leave the spin system, so the rate is set by energy flow from the lattice into the spins. Time-resolved second-harmonic generation experiments show that Cr2O3 demagnetizes within 2 ps once the lattice is driven above the Neel temperature, two orders of magnitude faster than the structurally similar FeBO3. First-principles calculations trace the disparity to exchange striction: short Cr-Cr contacts make the exchange coupling tenfold more sensitive to atomic displacements and widen the phase space for phonon decay into magnon pairs. Spin-lattice simulations with ab initio parameters reproduce the order of magnitude of the measured ratio. The derivative of the exchange coupling with respect to the ionic displacement thus emerges as a computable parameter that predicts how fast an insulating antiferromagnet can be demagnetized. The results advance our understanding of ultrafast control in insulating antiferromagnets, and suggest a practical pathway to screen candidate materials for thermally assisted antiferromagnetic memory before synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算+自旋-晶格模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“Time-resolved second-harmonic generation experiments”“First-principles calculations”“Spin-lattice simulations with ab initio parameters”。；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体（具体为Cr₂O₃与FeBO₃）的超快退磁动力学，以及交换伸缩（exchange striction）对退磁速率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体的退磁速率由交换耦合对离子位移的导数（即交换伸缩强度）决定：Cr₂O₃的退磁比结构相似的FeBO₃快两个数量级，源于其短Cr-Cr接触使交换耦合对原子位移敏感十倍，并拓宽了声子衰变为磁子对的相空间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁绝缘体的退磁速率由交换耦合对离子位移的导数（即交换伸缩强度）决定：Cr₂O₃的退磁比结构相似的FeBO₃快两个数量级，源于其短Cr-Cr接触使交换耦合对原子位移敏感十倍，并拓宽了声子衰变为磁子对的相空间。；创新点：首次提出交换耦合对离子位移的导数（交换伸缩）作为可计算的单一材料参数，用于预测绝缘反铁磁体的退磁速率，并建议将其作为热辅助反铁磁存储器候选材料合成前的筛选标准。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨二次谐波产生（TR-SHG）实验测量退磁时间；第一性原理计算（具体方法如DFT类型未在摘要中明确）分析交换耦合对原子位移的敏感性；采用从头算参数的自旋-晶格模拟复现实验测得的退磁速率比值。

papers.title: First-Principles Electronic Structure Calculation of Crystals in Laboratory Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: External magnetic fields can qualitatively reshape the electronic structure of crystals, underpinning quantum Hall physics, Landau-level spectra and field-induced topological phases. Their first-principles treatment at laboratory-scale fields is, however, hindered by magnetic-flux quantization, which requires magnetic unit cells with areas inversely proportional to the applied field. Such cells contain a large number of chemical unit cells, rendering real-space and plane-wave calculations prohibitively expensive. Here we, for the first time, construct a magnetic Bloch basis built from linear combinations of gauge-including Gaussian-type atomic orbitals, which incorporate the magnetic-field phase factors required by magnetic translation symmetry. The framework requires far fewer basis functions than real-space or plane-wave representations of the same magnetic supercell and retains the sparsity of an atom-centred basis, together substantially reducing computational cost. We validate the framework by reproducing Landau-level spectrum of graphene from first principles. This approach provides a practical route to simulations of crystalline materials under experimentally accessible magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：“First-Principles Electronic Structure Calculation”（第一性原理电子结构计算）、“construct a magnetic Bloch basis”（构建磁布洛赫基）、“validate the framework”（验证框架）。；研究对象：晶体材料在外加实验室强度磁场下的电子结构，具体以石墨烯的朗道能级谱作为验证体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次构建了基于规范包含高斯型原子轨道的磁布洛赫基，使得在实验室磁场强度下对晶体进行第一性原理电子结构计算成为可行，且计算成本远低于传统实空间或平面波方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次构建了基于规范包含高斯型原子轨道的磁布洛赫基，使得在实验室磁场强度下对晶体进行第一性原理电子结构计算成为可行，且计算成本远低于传统实空间或平面波方法。；创新点：首次在实验室尺度磁场下实现了晶体的第一性原理电子结构计算，克服了磁通量子化导致磁超胞过大、传统方法计算不可行的瓶颈；新基组兼具原子中心基组的稀疏性和远少于实空间/平面波表示的基函数数量，大幅降低计算成本。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算框架，具体为：采用规范包含高斯型原子轨道（Gauge-Including Gaussian-Type Atomic Orbitals）的线性组合构造磁布洛赫基，满足磁平移对称性所需的磁场相位因子；通过重现石墨烯的朗道能级谱来验证该框架的正确性。

papers.title: Mass-conserving growth percolation in polymer gelation
papers.abstract: Polymer gelation involves the emergence of a system-spanning network from growing polymer-rich domains, yet conventional percolation models typically prescribe particle size independently of material consumption. We formulate gelation as a locally mass-conserving growth-percolation process in which Voronoi capture zones define finite material reservoirs for individual nuclei. Local depletion determines the evolving supersaturation and limiting particle size, while particle contacts generate a dynamic network whose first spanning cluster defines the gel point. Three mechanisms, namely, interface-, diffusion-, and polymer-blob-controlled growth produce distinct gelation kinetics while sharing the same accessible final state. Spatial fluctuations in nucleation further generate a distribution of gelation times. The framework separates gelation from saturation and naturally captures post-gel aging as continued growth and topological maturation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。摘要中未提及实验手段，核心为理论建模（“formulate gelation as a locally mass-conserving growth-percolation process”）与机制分析（“interface-, diffusion-, and polymer-blob-controlled growth”），属于理论框架构建与数值模拟范畴。；研究对象：聚合物凝胶化（polymer gelation）过程，具体为从富聚合物区域生长出贯穿体系的网络，涉及成核、粒子生长、接触成网及凝胶点判定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将凝胶化描述为局部质量守恒的生长逾渗过程后，三种生长机制（界面控制、扩散控制、聚合物团块控制）产生不同的凝胶化动力学，但共享相同的可达最终态；成核的空间涨落导致凝胶化时间分布，且该框架可自然区分凝胶化与饱和，并捕捉凝胶老化（继续生长与拓扑成熟）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将凝胶化描述为局部质量守恒的生长逾渗过程后，三种生长机制（界面控制、扩散控制、聚合物团块控制）产生不同的凝胶化动力学，但共享相同的可达最终态；成核的空间涨落导致凝胶化时间分布，且该框架可自然区分凝胶化与饱和，并捕捉凝胶老化（继续生长与拓扑成熟）。；创新点：将凝胶化建模为质量守恒的生长逾渗过程，突破传统逾渗模型中粒子尺寸与物质消耗无关的预设；引入Voronoi捕获区作为有限物质储库，实现局部质量守恒；区分凝胶化与饱和，并统一描述凝胶老化。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于Voronoi捕获区定义有限物质储库，建立局部质量守恒的生长逾渗模型；通过局部耗尽决定动态过饱和与极限粒子尺寸，粒子接触生成动态网络，以首个贯穿簇定义凝胶点。摘要未明确说明具体数值算法（如蒙特卡洛或动力学模拟），仅描述概念框架。

papers.title: Numerical study of the grain-growth-induced non-parabolic kinetics of a solid-state reaction
papers.abstract: Non-parabolic growth of reaction layers is frequently observed in solid-state diffusion couples, but the relationship between microstructural evolution and the resulting kinetics remains incompletely understood. This effect is commonly attributed to grain growth, which can progressively reduce the contribution of fast grain-boundary diffusion, causing the effective diffusivity of a polycrystalline product layer to evolve during reaction. This work develops a moving-boundary diffusion model to describe product-layer growth while accounting for the local grain-growth history of the continuously formed product, as well as both bulk and grain-boundary diffusion. Numerical simulations show that the reaction can pass through three distinct kinetic regimes: an initial approximately parabolic regime dominated by grain-boundary diffusion, a transient sub-parabolic regime associated with strong spatial variation of the effective diffusivity, and a subsequent approximately parabolic regime dominated by bulk diffusion. The magnitude and duration of the sub-parabolic regime depend on the relative grain-boundary and bulk diffusivities and on the kinetics of grain growth. The instantaneous growth exponent therefore evolves continuously and does not represent a unique kinetic constant. Nevertheless, fitting simulated layer-thickness data over finite experimental time intervals produces well-defined apparent exponents, demonstrating how a transient process can appear to obey a single power law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“moving-boundary diffusion model”“Numerical simulations”“fitting simulated layer-thickness data”等关键词，属于数值模拟与理论建模研究。；研究对象：固态反应扩散偶中多晶产物层的生长动力学，具体关注晶粒生长对反应层厚度随时间演化（非抛物线动力学）的影响，涉及体扩散与晶界扩散两种输运机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反应层生长可经历三个动力学阶段：初始由晶界扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段、由有效扩散系数强空间变化引起的瞬态亚抛物线阶段、以及后续由体扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段。瞬时生长指数连续演化，并非唯一动力学常数，但在有限实验时间窗口内拟合仍可得到表观幂律指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反应层生长可经历三个动力学阶段：初始由晶界扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段、由有效扩散系数强空间变化引起的瞬态亚抛物线阶段、以及后续由体扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段。瞬时生长指数连续演化，并非唯一动力学常数，但在有限实验时间窗口内拟合仍可得到表观幂律指数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于将局部晶粒生长历史与移动边界扩散模型结合，定量揭示了有效扩散系数空间不均匀性如何导致亚抛物线瞬态动力学，并解释了瞬态过程为何在有限时间窗口内仍可表现为单一幂律。
papers.method_zh: 采用移动边界扩散模型（moving-boundary diffusion model），在模型中耦合了连续形成产物层的局部晶粒生长历史，并同时考虑体扩散与晶界扩散。通过数值模拟求解模型，分析不同参数下的反应层生长动力学。

papers.title: Topological charges and parity selection at Floquet quasienergy degeneracies
papers.abstract: The quasienergy spectrum of a strongly driven two-level system as a function of the driving parameters exhibits conical intersections, which are enabled by hidden time-nonlocal symmetries. We show that each such crossing carries a quantized topological charge: the Floquet--Berry phase acquired along an adiabatic loop around a cone is equal to a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-valued charge. We further identify a second family of degeneracies that occurs at vanishing driving amplitude, when the level splitting matches $m$ energy quanta of the field. Along the Stark-shifted resonance line, the minimum quasienergy gap opens as $|A|^m$, and the charge is nontrivial only for odd $m$. We analytically derive both results from a perturbative reduction to a spin-$1/2$ in an effective two-dimensional magnetic field and confirm them numerically through the Bargmann invariant. Moreover, we propose a chirality-based protocol that cancels the dynamical phase to isolate the geometric one, and an ancilla-based Ramsey readout that renders the topological charge directly observable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及解析推导（perturbative reduction）、数值验证（numerically）以及理论概念（Floquet–Berry phase、Bargmann invariant），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：强驱动二能级系统的Floquet准能谱，特别是准能量简并点（锥形交叉）及其拓扑荷，以及驱动振幅为零时出现的简并族。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准能量锥形交叉点携带$\mathbb{Z}_2$值拓扑荷（由Floquet–Berry相位给出）；在Stark位移共振线上，准能隙随振幅按$|A|^m$打开，且仅当$m$为奇数时拓扑荷非平凡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准能量锥形交叉点携带$\mathbb{Z}_2$值拓扑荷（由Floquet–Berry相位给出）；在Stark位移共振线上，准能隙随振幅按$|A|^m$打开，且仅当$m$为奇数时拓扑荷非平凡。；创新点：揭示了隐藏的时间非局域对称性使准能量简并成为可能，并系统建立了简并点拓扑荷的奇偶选择定则（仅奇数$m$非平凡）；同时提出了可直接观测拓扑荷的可行实验协议。
papers.method_zh: 通过微扰约化将系统映射为有效二维磁场中的自旋-1/2模型，解析推导拓扑荷与能隙标度；利用Bargmann不变量进行数值验证；提出基于手征性的方案消除动力学相位以分离几何相位，以及基于辅助量子比特（ancilla）的Ramsey读出方案。

papers.title: Kibble--Zurek Mechanism and Defect Freezing in Imbalanced-Pairing Kitaev Models
papers.abstract: We investigate driven dynamics across critical and exceptional points in the one- and two-dimensional imbalanced-pairing Kitaev models using both the wave-function normalization approach and the biorthogonal framework. For a positive pairing imbalance parameter, the quasiparticle spectrum remains real, and a pairing imbalance neither shifts the equilibrium phase boundaries nor generates imaginary eigenenergies. In this regime, the defect density follows the conventional Kibble--Zurek scaling in one dimension and the extended Kibble--Zurek scaling, arising from a gapless manifold, in two dimensions within both frameworks. The corresponding scaling exponents are therefore governed by those of the Hermitian transition. For a negative pairing imbalance parameter, time-reversal symmetry is broken, the quasiparticle spectrum develops complex eigenvalues, and the gap closes at exceptional points. For ramps ending at an exceptional point, the defect density follows the modified Kibble--Zurek scaling in the wave-function normalization approach, whereas it obeys the conventional Kibble--Zurek scaling in the biorthogonal framework. When the ramp traverses the time-reversal-symmetry-broken region, a finite density of defects remains even in the adiabatic limit, leading to defect freezing in both frameworks. Although this frozen background indicates a breakdown of adiabaticity, the excess defects generated on top of this background continue to obey the conventional Kibble--Zurek scaling in one dimension and the extended Kibble--Zurek scaling in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：driven dynamics、wave-function normalization approach、biorthogonal framework、scaling。；研究对象：一维和二维非平衡配对（imbalanced-pairing）Kitaev 模型中的量子淬火动力学，特别是跨越临界点和例外点（exceptional points）时的缺陷产生与冻结现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当配对失衡参数为正时，缺陷密度遵循常规或扩展的 Kibble–Zurek 标度；当参数为负并穿越时间反演对称破缺区时，绝热极限下仍残留有限缺陷密度（缺陷冻结），但背景之上的额外缺陷仍遵循常规/扩展 Kibble–Zurek 标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当配对失衡参数为正时，缺陷密度遵循常规或扩展的 Kibble–Zurek 标度；当参数为负并穿越时间反演对称破缺区时，绝热极限下仍残留有限缺陷密度（缺陷冻结），但背景之上的额外缺陷仍遵循常规/扩展 Kibble–Zurek 标度。；创新点：揭示了非平衡配对参数的正负号对缺陷标度行为的根本性影响：正参数下体系保持厄米性，标度指数由厄米相变决定；负参数下体系出现例外点，且穿越对称破缺区时产生缺陷冻结现象——这一冻结背景标志着绝热性的失效，但叠加其上的额外缺陷仍保持常规 Kibble–Zurek 标度。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或材料的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：采用波函数归一化方法（wave-function normalization approach）与双正交框架（biorthogonal framework）两种途径，研究一维和二维非平衡配对 Kitaev 模型在临界点和例外点附近的驱动动力学，并分析缺陷密度的标度行为。

papers.title: Resolving unconventional gap structure in kagome superconductors with hybrid microwave circuits
papers.abstract: Unconventional superconductivity is a hallmark of exotic quantum matter, where determining the pairing symmetry is essential for uncovering its microscopic origin. Kagome superconductors provide a fertile landscape for emergent phenomena arising from strong electronic correlations and nontrivial band topology, yet their superconducting pairing symmetry remains elusive. The superconducting gap structure is commonly probed via electrodynamic response, but such measurements are inapplicable to thin flakes due to their small volume and delicate nature. Superconducting microwave resonators offer a coherent and highly sensitive platform for probing electrodynamic responses, with versatile designs that enable incorporation of diverse materials and geometries. Here, we integrate flakes into microwave circuits, enabling noninvasive access to the superfluid response through contactless coupling that preserves structural integrity. By engineering the device geometry to suppress parasitic two-level-system losses that dominate dissipation in microwave circuits, we isolate the intrinsic material response. Remarkably, the temperature-dependent superfluid density exhibits linear behavior at low temperatures, consistent with a nodal gap structure. Our approach establishes a noninvasive platform for probing electrodynamic response of fragile superconducting flakes while advancing hybrid microwave architectures for quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对材料进行集成、测量和数据分析的过程（“integrate flakes into microwave circuits”、“temperature-dependent superfluid density exhibits…”），属于实验研究。；研究对象：Kagome超导体（薄片样品），具体为利用超导微波谐振腔探测其超导能隙结构（配对对称性）与超流响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将kagome超导薄片非侵入式耦合到微波电路中，测得低温下超流密度随温度呈线性变化，表明其超导能隙具有节点结构（nodal gap），而非全开能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将kagome超导薄片非侵入式耦合到微波电路中，测得低温下超流密度随温度呈线性变化，表明其超导能隙具有节点结构（nodal gap），而非全开能隙。；创新点：建立了对脆弱超导薄片进行非侵入式电动力学响应探测的平台，克服了传统电动力学测量不适用于薄片（体积小、易损坏）的限制，并推进了混合微波架构在量子技术中的应用。摘要未突出说明与具体理论模型或此前实验的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 混合微波电路技术：将kagome薄片集成到超导微波谐振器中，通过无接触耦合（contactless coupling）探测超流响应；通过器件几何工程抑制寄生两级系统（two-level system）损耗，从而提取本征材料响应。

papers.title: Weisfeiler-Lehman subtree encoding for Bayesian optimization of atomic configurations
papers.abstract: The efficiency of Bayesian optimization (BO) of atomic configurations depends strongly on how configurations are encoded. We introduce the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) subtree kernel, which views configurations as element-labeled graphs and measures their similarity by how many local structural patterns they share, into Bayesian-optimization-based configuration search. Because this kernel is reproduced as the plain inner product of explicit features (L$^2$-normalized histograms of local topological patterns), introducing it reduces to introducing the corresponding features: the encoding enters existing BO frameworks as an ordinary descriptor. In a benchmark ground-state configuration search of cubic BC$_2$N evaluated with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential, the WL encoding reached the ground state almost immediately after a shared random initialization of 100 samples in every one of five independent rounds (108$\pm$5 evaluations on average), whereas the one-hot baseline required 280$\pm$122 evaluations; the WL-driven sampler first exhausted the degenerate ground-state group and then discovered the metastable degenerate groups from the bottom up, in order of increasing energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于算法（Bayesian optimization、kernel、encoding）与机器学习势函数（universal machine-learning interatomic potential）的应用，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：原子构型（atomic configurations）的优化搜索，具体以立方相BC₂N（cubic BC₂N）的基态构型搜索为基准测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将Weisfeiler-Lehman（WL）子树核作为原子构型的编码方式引入贝叶斯优化，可显著加速基态搜索：在BC₂N基准测试中，WL编码平均仅需108±5次评估即可到达基态，而one-hot基线需280±122次；且WL驱动的采样器能按能量从低到高的顺序依次穷尽简并基态组与亚稳态简并组。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将Weisfeiler-Lehman（WL）子树核作为原子构型的编码方式引入贝叶斯优化，可显著加速基态搜索：在BC₂N基准测试中，WL编码平均仅需108±5次评估即可到达基态，而one-hot基线需280±122次；且WL驱动的采样器能按能量从低到高的顺序依次穷尽简并基态组与亚稳态简并组。；创新点：首次将WL子树核引入基于贝叶斯优化的原子构型搜索，并利用其显式特征表示（L²归一化直方图）使编码无缝融入现有BO流程；同时展示了该编码在简并态结构发现顺序上的物理合理性（按能量从低到高穷尽简并组）。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于WL子树核的贝叶斯优化框架。该核将原子构型视为元素标记图，通过共享局部结构模式的数量衡量相似性；其显式特征为L²归一化的局部拓扑模式直方图，因此可直接作为普通描述符嵌入现有BO框架。势函数评估使用通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine-learning interatomic potential）。

papers.title: Beyond Panchromatic Absorption: Deciphering the Excited-State Maze from Light Absorption to Photocatalysis in Dye-Sensitized MOFs
papers.abstract: Metal--organic frameworks (MOFs) are promising photocatalysts whose visible-light absorption can be extended through linker functionalization; however, a red-shifted absorption edge does not guarantee enhanced efficiency. Here, we establish a multi-spectroscopic framework to decipher the photophysical fate of photoexcited states in diazo-sensitized UiO-66 using 2D photoluminescence (PL/PLE) mapping and wavelength-resolved continuous-wave X-band photo-EPR. By correlating visible absorption with photo-EPR and PLE action spectra, we distinguish a \textit{productive red shift} from a \textit{non-productive emissive red shift}. In highly active UiO-66-Anisole (97\% activity relative to \ch{TiO2}), photo-EPR tracks the new absorption band, confirming that excitation populates a charge-transfer pathway yielding persistent, spin-separated states. Conversely, poorly active UiO-66-$β$-naphthol (4\%) exhibits an extended visible absorption tracked by PLE but not photo-EPR. This reflects excitation trapping in a localized state caused by an \textit{ortho}-$\mathrm{OH}$ group forming a rigid intramolecular hydrogen bond, which locks the keto-hydrazone tautomer and disrupts the conjugated azo bridge. A new optical overlap descriptor ($S_{\mathrm{Exc}}$) quantitatively captures this trade-off across the series. We demonstrate that photosensitizer design must suppress rigid tautomeric traps and target specific charge-transfer manifolds ($λ\le 500$~nm) rather than merely maximizing apparent panchromatic absorption breadth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“建立多光谱框架”“使用二维光致发光（PL/PLE）映射和波长分辨连续波X波段光电子顺磁共振（photo-EPR）”等实验手段。；研究对象：染料敏化金属有机框架（MOFs），具体为通过重氮基团敏化的UiO-66系列材料（包括UiO-66-Anisole和UiO-66-β-naphthol），研究其光激发态从光吸收到光催化过程中的物理命运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文区分了“有效红移”与“无效发射红移”：高活性材料（UiO-66-Anisole，活性为TiO2的97%）中可见吸收对应电荷转移路径并产生自旋分离态；低活性材料（UiO-66-β-naphthol，活性仅4%）中可见吸收源于邻位-OH基团形成刚性分子内氢键，锁定酮-腙互变异构体并破坏共轭偶氮桥，导致激发态局域化陷阱。光敏剂设计应抑制刚性互变异构陷阱并靶向特定电荷转移通道（λ≤500 nm），而非单纯追求全色吸收宽度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文区分了“有效红移”与“无效发射红移”：高活性材料（UiO-66-Anisole，活性为TiO2的97%）中可见吸收对应电荷转移路径并产生自旋分离态；低活性材料（UiO-66-β-naphthol，活性仅4%）中可见吸收源于邻位-OH基团形成刚性分子内氢键，锁定酮-腙互变异构体并破坏共轭偶氮桥，导致激发态局域化陷阱。光敏剂设计应抑制刚性互变异构陷阱并靶向特定电荷转移通道（λ≤500 nm），而非单纯追求全色吸收宽度。；创新点：建立了将可见吸收与photo-EPR和PLE作用光谱相关联的多光谱框架，首次区分了“有效红移”与“无效发射红移”，并提出了定量描述符S_Exc来捕捉吸收红移与光催化活性之间的权衡关系。
papers.method_zh: 二维光致发光（PL/PLE）映射、波长分辨连续波X波段光电子顺磁共振（photo-EPR）、可见吸收光谱与photo-EPR及PLE作用光谱的关联分析，以及新提出的光学重叠描述符（S_Exc）。

papers.title: Cavity-control of Majorana bound states in superconductor-semiconductor heterostructures
papers.abstract: We theoretically study a hybrid superconductor-semiconductor platform hosting Majorana bound states coupled to a single mode photonic cavity. Starting with a one-dimensional wire coupled to a bulk $s$-wave superconductor embedded in a photonic cavity, we derive an effective light-matter Hamiltonian for such a platform. Assuming that the photonic vector potential is aligned along the tunneling between a wire and a superconductor, we find that the cavity coupling enters only in the effective superconducting pairing term. By solving the coupled electron-photon Hamiltonian using different approaches, such as exact diagonalization in case of zero or large number of photons, high-frequency expansion, and mean-field decoupling, we find that the phase boundary between the topological trivial phases is shifted to smaller values of the Zeeman energy compared to the uncoupled case. Cavity embedding has the strongest effect on the phase diagram in the semiclassical regime, corresponding to a large number of photons. In all cases, we find that at large values of the light-matter coupling strength the effective superconducting pairing is suppressed, driving the system into the gapless phase. We demonstrate that even small light-matter coupling strength allows for entering the topological phase at values of the Zeeman energy compared to the uncoupled platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We theoretically study”“derive an effective Hamiltonian”“solving the coupled electron-photon Hamiltonian”等表述，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：超导体-半导体混合异质结构中的马约拉纳束缚态，该体系被嵌入单模光子腔中，具体为一维半导体纳米线耦合体态s波超导体并置于光子腔内的平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔耦合仅进入有效超导配对项，使拓扑相边界向更小的塞曼能量方向移动；在强光-物质耦合下有效超导配对被抑制，系统进入无能隙相；即使很小的光-物质耦合也能在比无腔平台更低的塞曼能量下进入拓扑相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔耦合仅进入有效超导配对项，使拓扑相边界向更小的塞曼能量方向移动；在强光-物质耦合下有效超导配对被抑制，系统进入无能隙相；即使很小的光-物质耦合也能在比无腔平台更低的塞曼能量下进入拓扑相。；创新点：首次系统研究光子腔对马约拉纳束缚态相图的影响，特别是发现腔耦合仅修改有效配对项而非其他参数，并揭示半经典（大光子数）区域腔效应最强。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与多方法求解：从一维线-超导体-腔耦合模型出发推导有效光-物质哈密顿量；采用精确对角化（零光子与大光子数情形）、高频展开、平均场退耦等多种方法求解耦合电子-光子哈密顿量。

papers.title: Element priors and target support shape chemical transfer in materials graph networks
papers.abstract: Materials graph neural networks must often transfer to chemical regions weakly represented in training data. Such transfer can rely on predefined relations among elements or supervised evidence from target-containing structures, but these pathways are usually entangled. Here, held-out-element splits and incremental target support separate their roles. Without target-containing training structures, formation-energy errors depend strongly on the element representation, particularly for H, O and F. Matched perturbations show that representation-induced sharing matters beyond input dimension or numerical form, while a label-free similarity-graph prior reduces selected zero-shot errors. Adding a few target-containing structures sharply lowers errors and contracts differences among one-hot, k-hot and continuous inputs across ALIGNN and CGCNN. Calibration explains only part of this recovery, and freezing the initial element projection preserves most gains in five of six ALIGNN splits. Target support therefore shifts chemical transfer from reliance on static element relations toward learning from target-containing environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要围绕材料图神经网络（ALIGNN、CGCNN）的机器学习方法展开，属于计算/人工智能方法研究。；研究对象：材料图神经网络在化学元素空间中的迁移学习行为，具体关注训练数据中元素覆盖不足（弱代表）时，模型对含H、O、F等元素的化合物形成能的预测能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在没有目标元素训练结构时，模型对形成能的预测误差强烈依赖于元素表示方式（尤其对H、O、F）；而加入少量含目标元素的结构后，误差显著下降，且不同元素表示（one-hot、k-hot、连续输入）之间的差异大幅缩小，表明迁移机制从依赖静态元素关系转向从目标环境中学习。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在没有目标元素训练结构时，模型对形成能的预测误差强烈依赖于元素表示方式（尤其对H、O、F）；而加入少量含目标元素的结构后，误差显著下降，且不同元素表示（one-hot、k-hot、连续输入）之间的差异大幅缩小，表明迁移机制从依赖静态元素关系转向从目标环境中学习。；创新点：系统解耦了材料图神经网络中两种化学迁移路径（基于元素先验关系 vs. 基于目标结构监督证据）的贡献，并定量展示了目标支持如何改变迁移的主导机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用材料图神经网络（ALIGNN和CGCNN），通过留出元素（held-out-element）的数据划分和逐步增加目标元素支持（incremental target support）来分离两种迁移路径；使用匹配扰动（matched perturbations）控制输入维度与数值形式；引入无标签相似性图先验（label-free similarity-graph prior）；通过冻结初始元素投影（freezing initial element projection）和校准分析（calibration）检验误差恢复来源。

papers.title: Fourier Neural Operators for Composition-Driven Crystal Structure Discovery
papers.abstract: Crystalline materials discovery is essential for energy, electronics, and catalysis, but the vast chemical and structural space makes exhaustive screening infeasible. Existing voxel-based methods are limited by the local receptive fields of three-dimensional convolutional neural networks and the posterior collapse of high-dimensional variational autoencoders. Here, we develop a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)-based crystal-field solver that maps a prescribed chemical formula and lattice parameters to periodic number-density and electron-density fields. By operating on global Fourier modes, the solver captures long-range correlations in periodic crystal fields beyond conventional local convolutions. Building on this solver, we construct a coupled generation-solving framework in which a conditional variational autoencoder generates diverse candidate lattice parameters in a low-dimensional basis-coefficient space, followed by density-field prediction and atomic reconstruction through peak detection, position optimization, and weight optimization. The reconstructed structures are further screened using voxel-level filtering, machine-learning interatomic-potential relaxation, and first-principle calculations. The framework generates novel structures across 104 chemical formulas with competitive reconstruction accuracy, demonstrating high generative diversity and structural validity. By extending Fourier neural operators to periodic crystal fields and coupling them with composition-conditioned lattice generation, our approach provides a scalable route to crystal structure discovery from prescribed chemical compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及机器学习模型（Fourier Neural Operator、条件变分自编码器）、机器学习原子间势弛豫、第一性原理计算等计算方法。；研究对象：晶体材料的结构发现，具体为从给定化学式和晶格参数出发预测周期性晶体场（数密度和电子密度场），并重建原子结构，覆盖104种化学式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于傅里叶神经算子的晶体场求解器能够捕捉周期性晶体场中的长程关联，结合生成-求解框架可在104种化学式上生成具有竞争性重建精度、高生成多样性和结构有效性的新晶体结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于傅里叶神经算子的晶体场求解器能够捕捉周期性晶体场中的长程关联，结合生成-求解框架可在104种化学式上生成具有竞争性重建精度、高生成多样性和结构有效性的新晶体结构。；创新点：将傅里叶神经算子扩展到周期性晶体场，利用全局傅里叶模式替代传统三维卷积的局部感受野，并与成分条件化的晶格生成耦合，实现从指定化学成分出发的可扩展晶体结构发现路径。摘要未突出说明与已有生成模型在具体性能指标上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 傅里叶神经算子（FNO）晶体场求解器；条件变分自编码器（CVAE）在低维基系数空间中生成晶格参数；峰检测、位置优化和权重优化进行原子重建；体素级过滤、机器学习原子间势弛豫和第一性原理计算进行结构筛选。

papers.title: Large Exchange Magnetostriction in a Kagome Antiferromagnet at Room Temperature
papers.abstract: The pursuit of high-performance magnetostrictive materials is crucial for advancing technologies in sensing, actuation, and microelectromechanical systems. Although pronounced magnetostrictive effects have been observed in a few ferromagnets, a systematic exploration of magnetostriction across a broader range of antiferromagnets remains limited. Here, we report the observation of large magnetostriction in the kagome antiferromagnet YMn6Sn6. Under a magnetic field, the system undergoes a field-induced evolution from a helical magnetic ground state toward a collinear field-polarized state, accompanied by a large anisotropic lattice strain and a substantial volume magnetostriction exceeding 400 ppm at room temperature. Remarkably, the magnetostrictive response remains nearly fully reversible up to 9 T with nearly hysteresis-free behavior, effectively minimizing the energy dissipation commonly associated with domain-wall pinning. Combined experimental measurements and theoretical calculations reveal that the large, nearly hysteresis-free magnetostriction originates from the competition between intralayer ferromagnetic and interlayer exchange interactions. This exchange-driven magnetoelastic coupling further gives rise to a strongly direction-dependent lattice distortion pathway. This work establishes kagome helimagnets as a tunable platform for low-dissipation magnetoelastic functionalities and responsive magnetomechanical applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论计算结合的混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Combined experimental measurements and theoretical calculations”。；研究对象：Kagome 反铁磁体 YMn6Sn6，具体研究其在磁场下的磁致伸缩效应，以及从螺旋磁基态到场极化态的场致演化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，YMn6Sn6 在磁场作用下表现出超过 400 ppm 的体积磁致伸缩，且该响应在高达 9 T 的磁场中几乎完全可逆、近乎无磁滞，源于层内铁磁与层间交换相互作用的竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，YMn6Sn6 在磁场作用下表现出超过 400 ppm 的体积磁致伸缩，且该响应在高达 9 T 的磁场中几乎完全可逆、近乎无磁滞，源于层内铁磁与层间交换相互作用的竞争。；创新点：首次在 Kagome 螺旋磁体中系统观察到室温下的大磁致伸缩，且具有近零磁滞和低能耗特性，建立了 Kagome 螺旋磁体作为低耗散磁弹性功能材料的可调控平台。摘要未突出说明与已有磁致伸缩材料的定量性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用磁场下的晶格应变测量（各向异性晶格应变与体积磁致伸缩）；理论上结合第一性原理计算或相关理论模型分析交换相互作用驱动的磁弹性耦合机制。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法名称（如 DFT 等）。

papers.title: Independent Tuning of Surface Acoustic-Waves and Spin-Waves via Buffer-Layer Engineering in Co2FeGe Heusler Thin Films
papers.abstract: Understanding and controlling acoustic and spin-wave excitations in magnetic thin films is critical for the development of magnonic and spin-acoustic devices. We report on the use of Cr and W buffer layers to independently modify the acoustic and magnetic excitations in Co2FeGe full-Heusler thin films grown on MgO(001). Using Brillouin light scattering (BLS) spectroscopy and ferromagnetic resonance (FMR), we probed Rayleigh and Sezawa surface acoustic waves (SAWs) alongside Damon-Eshbach and perpendicular standing spin-wave (PSSW) modes. Our results show that acoustic dispersion depends strongly on the buffer material; W-buffered films exhibit a pronounced 16% reduction in Rayleigh SAW frequency compared to buffer-free films, primarily due to mass loading and acoustic impedance shifts. While the buffer layers significantly shift acoustic frequencies, they simultaneously modify the dynamic magnetic response (increasing spin-wave group velocity by ~34%) through different physical mechanisms. Finite-element simulations show excellent agreement with the experimental acoustic data. These findings demonstrate that buffer-layer engineering is an effective strategy for the independent tailoring of elastic and magnetic excitations, providing a versatile platform for hybrid spin-acoustic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用Brillouin光散射（BLS）光谱和铁磁共振（FMR）进行测量，并辅以有限元模拟验证实验数据。；研究对象：生长在MgO(001)衬底上的Co2FeGe全Heusler合金薄膜，重点研究Cr和W缓冲层对薄膜中声学（表面声波）和磁学（自旋波）激发特性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择Cr或W缓冲层，可以独立调控Co2FeGe薄膜中的声学与磁学激发：W缓冲层使Rayleigh表面声波频率降低约16%（归因于质量负载和声阻抗失配），同时使自旋波群速度提高约34%（通过不同的物理机制）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择Cr或W缓冲层，可以独立调控Co2FeGe薄膜中的声学与磁学激发：W缓冲层使Rayleigh表面声波频率降低约16%（归因于质量负载和声阻抗失配），同时使自旋波群速度提高约34%（通过不同的物理机制）。；创新点：提出并验证了缓冲层工程作为一种独立调控弹性（声学）和磁性（自旋波）激发的有效策略，为混合自旋-声学器件提供了可扩展的材料平台。摘要未突出说明与以往缓冲层研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用Brillouin光散射（BLS）光谱和铁磁共振（FMR）技术，分别探测Rayleigh和Sezawa表面声波模式以及Damon-Eshbach和垂直驻立自旋波（PSSW）模式；理论上采用有限元模拟对声学色散数据进行验证。

papers.title: Optimizing diffusion-limited transport, with applications to electrochemical systems
papers.abstract: Transport in certain systems fails when diffusion cannot replenish or remove material from a boundary rapidly enough, causing the boundary concentration to reach a critical minimum or maximum. Motivated by experiments in electrochemical systems that demonstrate this diffusion-limited failure of charge transport, we determine dynamic current protocols that maximize charge transfer subject to a prescribed concentration constraint. The optimal protocol has a "bang-ride" structure: the maximum feasible current is used until the boundary concentration reaches its critical value, after which the current is progressively reduced to maintain that value. For semi-infinite domains, we derive the optimal currents analytically and obtain system-independent upper bounds on their improvement over constant-current operation. We also extend the framework to finite and multilayer domains and show that the same formulation applies to both charging and discharging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：determine dynamic current protocols、derive analytically、framework。；研究对象：扩散限制输运现象，具体应用于电化学系统中的电荷传输失效问题，涉及半无限、有限及多层域中的边界浓度约束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优电流协议具有“bang-ride”结构：先以最大可行电流运行直至边界浓度达到临界值，随后逐步降低电流以维持该临界浓度，从而在给定浓度约束下最大化电荷转移量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优电流协议具有“bang-ride”结构：先以最大可行电流运行直至边界浓度达到临界值，随后逐步降低电流以维持该临界浓度，从而在给定浓度约束下最大化电荷转移量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于针对扩散限制失效问题给出了解析的最优动态电流协议，并证明了其改进上界具有系统无关性，且框架同时适用于充电和放电。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与优化框架：对半无限域解析求解最优电流协议，并推导出相对于恒流操作改进幅度的系统无关上界；同时将框架推广至有限域和多层域，并统一处理充电与放电过程。

papers.title: Metastable defects in III-Nitrides
papers.abstract: Metastable states in III-nitrides (AlN, GaN, InN and their alloys) are an important topic across materials science, device physics, and epitaxial growth because these compounds exhibit multiple competing crystal structures, defect configurations, and phase behaviors that strongly affect optical, electrical, and mechanical properties. The paper is a concise, structured review-style summary covering the main concepts, mechanisms, experimental signatures, theoretical approaches, and device implications. Actions that should be proposed to avoid effect of metastable defects in III-Nitride based devices are discussed. Avoiding metastable defect effects in III nitride devices requires preventing their formation (through growth and doping control), stabilizing their electronic configuration (by annealing or optical activation), and designing device architectures that minimize field- or temperature induced transitions. These combined actions ensure consistent carrier density, higher mobility, and superior optical and electrical reliability in GaN , AlGaN , and InGaN based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述型文章（review-style summary）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“concise, structured review-style summary”，属于理论/综述混合类型，非单一实验或计算研究。；研究对象：III族氮化物（AlN、GaN、InN及其合金）中的亚稳态缺陷（metastable defects），涉及这些材料中相互竞争的晶体结构、缺陷构型及相行为对光、电、力学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: III族氮化物中亚稳态缺陷会显著影响器件性能，需通过生长与掺杂控制、退火或光学激活稳定电子构型，以及优化器件结构以抑制场致或温度致转变，从而保证载流子浓度一致性、高迁移率及光电器件可靠性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：III族氮化物中亚稳态缺陷会显著影响器件性能，需通过生长与掺杂控制、退火或光学激活稳定电子构型，以及优化器件结构以抑制场致或温度致转变，从而保证载流子浓度一致性、高迁移率及光电器件可靠性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该文以简明结构化综述形式系统梳理亚稳态缺陷的概念、机制、实验特征、理论方法及器件影响，并提出避免亚稳态缺陷负面效应的具体行动建议。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算框架，仅提及覆盖“概念、机制、实验特征、理论方法”的综述性总结。具体方法（如DFT、MBE等）摘要未给出。

papers.title: Magnetic quantum defects in a uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulator
papers.abstract: Point defects have been successfully utilized in various quantum technologies, serving as quantum qubits for quantum computation, single-photon emitters for quantum communication, and nanoscale sensors for quantum metrology. However, their further development faces key challenges, particularly in discovering and exploring suitable defect-host systems that meet the necessary criteria for quantum applications. Here, using polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy and terahertz absorption spectroscopy, we discover three distinct chromium-vacancy-induced excitations in the uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulator, Cr$_2$O$_3$. These vacancy-induced excitations have an energy scale of a few tens of millielectronvolts and are twofold degenerate, and the lowest one at 64 $cm^{-1}$ is sharp and sensitive to the external magnetic field along the easy-axis direction, particularly close to the spin-flop regime around 6T, where the mode softens from 64 to 27$cm^{-1}$. Based on the defect supercell first-principles calculations, we interpret the mode at 64 $cm^{-1}$ as a local magnetic excitation of the local moment within the chromium vacancy state. Our results establish that the magnetic defect states in Cr$_2$O$_3$ have potential for quantum applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy and terahertz absorption spectroscopy”（实验手段），以及“defect supercell first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：单轴反铁磁绝缘体 Cr₂O₃ 中由铬空位（chromium vacancy）诱导的磁性缺陷态及其局域磁激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Cr₂O₃ 中发现了三种由铬空位诱导的、能量为几十毫电子伏特且二重简并的激发模式；其中能量最低的 64 cm⁻¹ 模式对沿易轴方向的外磁场高度敏感，在约 6 T 的自旋翻转（spin-flop）区域附近该模式从 64 cm⁻¹ 软化至 27 cm⁻¹，被解释为铬空位态中局域磁矩的局域磁激发，表明该磁性缺陷态具有量子应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Cr₂O₃ 中发现了三种由铬空位诱导的、能量为几十毫电子伏特且二重简并的激发模式；其中能量最低的 64 cm⁻¹ 模式对沿易轴方向的外磁场高度敏感，在约 6 T 的自旋翻转（spin-flop）区域附近该模式从 64 cm⁻¹ 软化至 27 cm⁻¹，被解释为铬空位态中局域磁矩的局域磁激发，表明该磁性缺陷态具有量子应用潜力。；创新点：首次在 Cr₂O₃ 这一单轴反铁磁绝缘体中系统发现并表征了铬空位诱导的磁性缺陷激发，并建立了其与局域磁矩激发的对应关系，为在反铁磁绝缘体中探索适合量子技术的缺陷-宿主体系提供了新平台。（摘要未突出说明与具体量子比特/传感器应用的直接集成演示。）
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨拉曼光谱（polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy）和太赫兹吸收光谱（terahertz absorption spectroscopy）用于实验探测缺陷激发；缺陷超胞第一性原理计算（defect supercell first-principles calculations）用于理论解释模式起源。

papers.title: Agentic programs: an emerging form of scientific software in computational materials science
papers.abstract: Computational materials science has traditionally delegated algorithmic tasks to computers while leaving scientific judgments to humans. We argue that recent LLM-based agent harnesses enable an emerging form of scientific software, agentic programs, that combine deterministic algorithms with bounded LLM-based judgment, task-specific verification, episodic maturation, and complete delegation in production. We illustrate this concept with DeMARS, an agentic program for constructing atomistic models from experimentally measured disordered crystal structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算/软件方法学文章）。判断依据：摘要讨论的是“计算材料科学”中的“科学软件”形式，属于计算方法论范畴，而非实验或纯理论物理研究。；研究对象：研究对象并非某一具体材料或物理现象，而是计算材料科学中的**科学软件形态**，具体应用实例为**从实验测量的无序晶体结构构建原子模型**（DeMARS程序）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要提出了一种新兴的科学软件形式——“agentic programs”（智能体程序），它将确定性算法与基于大语言模型（LLM）的有限判断相结合，实现任务特定验证、阶段性成熟和生产环境中的完全委托。摘要未给出具体的物理材料结论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要提出了一种新兴的科学软件形式——“agentic programs”（智能体程序），它将确定性算法与基于大语言模型（LLM）的有限判断相结合，实现任务特定验证、阶段性成熟和生产环境中的完全委托。摘要未给出具体的物理材料结论。；创新点：提出“agentic programs”这一概念，将传统上由人类完成的科学判断部分委托给LLM智能体，同时保留确定性算法的可靠性，并引入任务特定验证与阶段性成熟机制。这是对传统“算法归计算机、判断归人类”分工模式的突破。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架（agent harness），结合确定性算法、任务特定验证机制，以及“阶段性成熟”（episodic maturation）和“生产环境完全委托”的软件设计范式。具体实现为DeMARS程序，用于从实验测量的无序晶体结构构建原子模型。摘要未提及具体的第一性原理计算方法（如DFT）或实验手段。

papers.title: Anti-higher-order Weyl semimetal
papers.abstract: Higher-order topology extends the bulk-boundary correspondence by enabling corner or hinge localized states. Here we identify an anti-higher-order Weyl semimetal, a three dimensional topological phase in which the conventional boundary hierarchy is reversed. Unlike conventional higher-order Weyl semimetals where bulk topology enforces hinge Fermi arcs, this phase hosts anti-hinge states, meaning the bulk topology forces states to vanish at specific hinge orientations. Using a minimal two-band model, we show how Weyl points separate the Brillouin zone into quantum anomalous Hall and anti-higher-order topological insulating regions, with the latter characterized by a band-inversion surface enclosing two distinct high-symmetry points carrying opposite topological charges. Analytical solutions for Weyl points, Berry curvature monopoles, and slice Chern numbers are derived, with numerical simulations confirming the resulting anti-hinge behavior. Our work establishes anti-higher-order topology as a dual counterpart to conventional higher-order phenomena, further extending the exploration of topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Using a minimal two-band model”（使用最小二带模型）、“Analytical solutions... are derived”（推导了解析解）以及“numerical simulations confirming”（数值模拟验证），属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：三维拓扑相中的一种新类型——反高阶外尔半金属（anti-higher-order Weyl semimetal）。该体系中的外尔点将布里渊区分割为量子反常霍尔（QAH）区域和反高阶拓扑绝缘体区域，后者具有带反转表面（band-inversion surface）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作提出并论证了一种“反高阶外尔半金属”相，其体拓扑性质不是强制在棱上（hinge）产生费米弧，而是强制特定棱方向上的态密度消失（即反棱态，anti-hinge states），从而反转了传统高阶拓扑的边界层级关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作提出并论证了一种“反高阶外尔半金属”相，其体拓扑性质不是强制在棱上（hinge）产生费米弧，而是强制特定棱方向上的态密度消失（即反棱态，anti-hinge states），从而反转了传统高阶拓扑的边界层级关系。；创新点：首次提出“反高阶拓扑”（anti-higher-order topology）概念，将其确立为传统高阶拓扑现象的“对偶对应物”，扩展了拓扑相的分类框架。摘要未突出说明该工作是否与具体材料预测或实验建议相关。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为高阶拓扑能带理论；具体手段包括：构建最小二带模型（two-band model），解析求解外尔点位置、贝里曲率单极子以及切片陈数（slice Chern numbers），并通过数值模拟验证反棱态行为。

papers.title: Anti-higher-order topological insulators
papers.abstract: Duality is a fundamental concept in physics that connects complementary opposites like particles and holes. Similarly, while topological states in topological insulators localize at boundaries, the existence and nature of their dual counterparts remain unexplored. Here, we introduce anti-topological states as the dual of topological states, exemplified by anti-higher-order topological insulators. Unlike higher-order topological insulators, where states localize at corners, anti-higher-order topological insulators host states along edges but absent at corners, realizing an inverted distribution of states. We demonstrate this phenomenon in a bilayer Chern insulator with opposite Chern numbers, where the band inversion surfaces enclose distinct high-symmetry points. The topological invariant distinguishing these phases is given by the topological charges enclosed by band inversion surfaces. This work establishes anti-topology as a new paradigm, opening a chapter in topological research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们引入”“我们证明”等理论推导性表述，并讨论拓扑不变量与能带反转面，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法。；研究对象：反高阶拓扑绝缘体（anti-higher-order topological insulators），具体实现体系为具有相反陈数的双层陈绝缘体（bilayer Chern insulator）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“反拓扑态”作为拓扑态的对偶概念：与高阶拓扑绝缘体中态局域在角上不同，反高阶拓扑绝缘体中的态沿棱边分布但在角上缺失，实现态的反转分布。区分该相的拓扑不变量由能带反转面包围的拓扑荷给出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“反拓扑态”作为拓扑态的对偶概念：与高阶拓扑绝缘体中态局域在角上不同，反高阶拓扑绝缘体中的态沿棱边分布但在角上缺失，实现态的反转分布。区分该相的拓扑不变量由能带反转面包围的拓扑荷给出。；创新点：首次提出“反拓扑”这一新范式，将拓扑态与反拓扑态作为对偶概念引入，并具体构造了反高阶拓扑绝缘体这一实例，实现了态分布从角到棱边的反转，拓展了拓扑绝缘体的分类框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于能带反转面（band inversion surfaces）与拓扑荷（topological charges）的拓扑不变量分析，结合双层陈绝缘体模型（两层具有相反陈数）进行论证。摘要未提及具体数值方法或第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Classifying coherent peaks in nanoelectronic devices by the presence or absence of spin exchange
papers.abstract: Coherent peaks appearing in the differential conductance of quantum-dot single-electron transistors (QDSETs) and quantum point contact (QPC) devices are classified into two categories according to the scaling function onto which the temperature-scaled differential-conductance maxima collapse and the underlying spin dynamics. The zero-bias peaks (ZBPs) observed in QPCs and in the triplet state of the even-particle sector of QDSETs belong to the same category, whereas the ZBP in the odd-particle sector of a QDSET belongs to a different category together with all finite-bias coherent peaks observed in QPCs and in the even-particle sector of QDSETs. The spin dynamics of the former category involve spin exchange, a hallmark of Kondo dynamics, whereas those of the latter category involve only cotunneling of an up--down spin pair. Furthermore, for the former type of ZBP, the scaling temperature coincides with one-half of the full width at half maximum (FWHM), which corresponds to the Kondo temperature. In contrast, for the latter type, the scaling temperature does not coincide with the (1/2)FWHM-derived energy scale. To support these findings, the gate-voltage-dependent differential-conductance line shapes measured in the odd-particle sector of a QDSET are theoretically reproduced. The results demonstrate that the observed ZBP is a merging of two coherent side peaks generated solely by the cotunneling of up--down spin pairs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“theoretically reproduced”（理论重现），且涉及对实验线形的理论拟合与分类框架构建。；研究对象：纳米电子器件中的相干峰，具体包括量子点单电子晶体管（QDSET）和量子点接触（QPC）器件的微分电导谱，以及其中的零偏压峰（ZBP）和有限偏压相干峰。物理现象聚焦于自旋交换（Kondo动力学）与上下自旋对共隧穿两种自旋动力学机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相干峰可按其温度标度函数和自旋动力学分为两类：QPC中的ZBP与QDSET偶数粒子扇区三重态ZBP属于同一类（涉及自旋交换，即Kondo动力学），而QDSET奇数粒子扇区ZBP与所有有限偏压相干峰属于另一类（仅涉及上下自旋对的共隧穿）。前者标度温度等于半高全宽（FWHM）的一半（对应Kondo温度），后者则不符合该关系。QDSET奇数扇区观测到的ZBP实为两个由上下自旋对共隧穿产生的相干边峰合并而成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相干峰可按其温度标度函数和自旋动力学分为两类：QPC中的ZBP与QDSET偶数粒子扇区三重态ZBP属于同一类（涉及自旋交换，即Kondo动力学），而QDSET奇数粒子扇区ZBP与所有有限偏压相干峰属于另一类（仅涉及上下自旋对的共隧穿）。前者标度温度等于半高全宽（FWHM）的一半（对应Kondo温度），后者则不符合该关系。QDSET奇数扇区观测到的ZBP实为两个由上下自旋对共隧穿产生的相干边峰合并而成。；创新点：提出了一种基于标度函数塌缩行为和自旋动力学机制对纳米器件中相干峰进行普适分类的新判据，并揭示了QDSET奇数扇区ZBP并非Kondo峰，而是两个共隧穿边峰的合并——这一结论挑战了将此类ZBP简单归因于Kondo效应的传统认知。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值重现：采用标度函数分析温度标度的微分电导极大值塌缩行为；通过自旋动力学分类（自旋交换 vs. 上下自旋对共隧穿）；对QDSET奇数粒子扇区栅压依赖的微分电导线形进行理论计算与重现。

papers.title: Phase Switchable Photocatalytic Water Splitting via a Paraelectric-Ferroelectric Transition in Zr2Ge2S6 Monolayer: A Comprehensive Theoretical Insights
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting (PWS) is a promising technology for addressing the global energy crisis and producing renewable and clean hydrogen fuel. Although numerous 2D materials have recently been proposed as potential photocatalysts, effective strategies for regulating photocatalytic reactions and improving energy conversion efficiency remain limited due to performance regulation challenges. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the photocatalytic activity and energy conversion efficiency of a Zr2Ge2S6 monolayer can be effectively tuned through a paraelectric-ferroelectric phase transition. The Zr2Ge2S6 monolayer exhibits excellent structural stability, favorable mechanical properties, a suitable band gap, optimal band edge positions, and broad-spectrum light absorption. Moreover, the Zr2Ge2S6 monolayer exhibits a higher oxidation potential and a stronger driving force for photogenerated holes to promote oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in the ferroelectric phase. In contrast, the paraelectric phase provides photogenerated electrons with a greater reduction potential and driving force for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). The solar-to-hydrogen conversion efficiency is also strongly influenced by the phase transition, increasing from 7.71% in the paraelectric phase to 15.31% in the ferroelectric phase because of the improved carrier utilization. Our theoretical investigation not only highlights the crucial role of ferroelectric polarization in photocatalytic water splitting but also provides an effective strategy for tuning the photocatalytic properties of 2D ferroelectric materials through ferroelectric switching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：Zr₂Ge₂S₆单层材料，具体研究其顺电-铁电相变对光催化水分解性能的调控作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zr₂Ge₂S₆单层可通过顺电-铁电相变有效调控光催化活性与能量转换效率：铁电相有利于析氧反应（OER），顺电相有利于析氢反应（HER），太阳能制氢效率从顺电相的7.71%提升至铁电相的15.31%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zr₂Ge₂S₆单层可通过顺电-铁电相变有效调控光催化活性与能量转换效率：铁电相有利于析氧反应（OER），顺电相有利于析氢反应（HER），太阳能制氢效率从顺电相的7.71%提升至铁电相的15.31%。；创新点：提出利用铁电极化开关（顺电-铁电相变）作为调控二维铁电材料光催化性能的有效策略，揭示了铁电极化在光催化水分解中的关键作用。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），基于密度泛函理论（DFT）框架，用于评估结构稳定性、力学性质、能带结构、带边位置、光吸收谱、氧化/还原电位及太阳能-氢气转换效率。

papers.title: Process-Technology Co-optimization for 2D-FETs
authors: César Javier Lockhart de la Rosa
papers.abstract: We present the first experimental machine learning (ML)-enabled Process-Technology Co-Optimization (PTCO) framework for optimizing 2D transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) FET fabrication directly from statistically meaningful experimental data rather than pure simulation data.
