papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个非磁性动力学杂质可在s波超导体中诱导出亚隙束缚态；在弹性散射极限下，束缚态能量与振动子频率之间存在闭式解析解，且亚隙束缚态的主要特征不受亚THz区非弹性散射过程影响。此外，这类杂质会在实空间中导致隙峰之外的谱权重降低区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个非磁性动力学杂质可在s波超导体中诱导出亚隙束缚态；在弹性散射极限下，束缚态能量与振动子频率之间存在闭式解析解，且亚隙束缚态的主要特征不受亚THz区非弹性散射过程影响。此外，这类杂质会在实空间中导致隙峰之外的谱权重降低区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：首次指出非磁性动力学杂质（而非静态杂质或磁性杂质）即可在s波超导体中产生亚隙束缚态，并给出解析闭式解。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析：在弹性散射极限下推导束缚态能量的闭式解，并讨论非弹性散射（亚THz频段）对束缚态能量的影响；计算低频局域态密度中的亚隙特征及实空间谱权重分布。

papers.title: Magnetic frustration and non-collinear textures in layered Gd magnets
papers.abstract: Using scale-bridging simulations based on electronic structure theory and atomistic spin dynamics, we investigate the magnetic properties of skyrmionic GdRu$_2$Si$_2$ and GdRu$_2$Ge$_2$ layered rare-earth magnets and similar Gd-based compounds (GdAu$_2$Si$_2$, GdAu$_2$Ge$_2$, GdAg$_2$Si$_2$ and GdAg$_2$Ge$_2$). By studying the trends across this structural family, we confirm the importance of magnetic frustration and dipolar interactions for the stability of non-collinear and skyrmion phases. Furthermore, our calculations predict promising opportunities for chemical tuning of these magnets in terms of the balance between various exchange interactions and the character of the magnetic anisotropy. These changes lead to the formation of new types of skyrmions that are stable in a wide range of applied external magnetic field. In particular, we propose partial alkali-metal substitution of Gd in GdRu$_2$Si$_2$ leading to GdKRu$_4$Si$_4$, GdRbRu$_4$Si$_4$, GdCsRu$_4$Si$_4$ as well as GdYRu$_4$Si$_4$ compounds, and suggest that it is likely to result in an ordered layered structure, similarly to previously reported iron pnictides like CaKFe$_4$As$_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“scale-bridging simulations based on electronic structure theory and atomistic spin dynamics”，即基于电子结构理论和原子自旋动力学的模拟。；研究对象：层状稀土磁体GdRu₂Si₂和GdRu₂Ge₂及其类似化合物（GdAu₂Si₂、GdAu₂Ge₂、GdAg₂Si₂、GdAg₂Ge₂），以及通过化学替代预测的新化合物GdKRu₄Si₄、GdRbRu₄Si₄、GdCsRu₄Si₄和GdYRu₄Si₄。物理现象为磁阻挫、非共线磁结构及斯格明子（skyrmion）相的稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁阻挫和偶极相互作用对非共线磁结构和斯格明子相的稳定至关重要；通过化学调控交换相互作用的平衡和磁各向异性特征，可形成在宽外磁场范围内稳定的新型斯格明子。此外，部分碱金属替代Gd可能形成有序层状结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁阻挫和偶极相互作用对非共线磁结构和斯格明子相的稳定至关重要；通过化学调控交换相互作用的平衡和磁各向异性特征，可形成在宽外磁场范围内稳定的新型斯格明子。此外，部分碱金属替代Gd可能形成有序层状结构。；创新点：预测了通过部分碱金属（K、Rb、Cs）或Y替代Gd形成的新化合物（如GdKRu₄Si₄等），并指出这些化合物可能形成有序层状结构（类似于铁基超导体CaKFe₄As₄），为化学调控斯格明子材料提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用跨尺度模拟方法，具体包括基于电子结构理论的计算（如第一性原理方法）与原子自旋动力学模拟相结合，用于研究磁性质、交换相互作用和磁各向异性。

papers.title: Higher-Winding Fractionalization
papers.abstract: Higher-winding skyrmion textures can generate emergent magnetic fields with multiple flux quanta per unit cell. This opens an intriguing route toward fractionalization, allowing fractionalized quantum anomalous Hall states to arise even at integer filling of the microscopic unit cell. We show that, in this setting, increasing lattice-scale inhomogeneity of the emergent magnetic field drives a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition between a fractionalized liquid and a crystalline dielectric state. This transition carries a topological signature: under flux insertion, the many-body polarization defines a quantized winding number that is nonzero in the fractionalized phase and vanishes in the dielectric crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论拓扑纹理、涌现磁场、量子相变等概念，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法，属于理论物理分析。；研究对象：高绕数（higher-winding）斯格明子（skyrmion）纹理体系中的涌现磁场及其诱导的分数化量子反常霍尔态，以及该体系在分数化液体与介电晶体之间的BKT相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有高绕数斯格明子纹理的体系中，即使微观原胞处于整数填充，也能产生分数化量子反常霍尔态；随着涌现磁场的晶格尺度不均匀性增强，体系经历从分数化液体到介电晶体的BKT相变，该相变具有拓扑特征——磁通插入下多体极化给出量子化的绕数，在分数化相中非零而在介电晶体中为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有高绕数斯格明子纹理的体系中，即使微观原胞处于整数填充，也能产生分数化量子反常霍尔态；随着涌现磁场的晶格尺度不均匀性增强，体系经历从分数化液体到介电晶体的BKT相变，该相变具有拓扑特征——磁通插入下多体极化给出量子化的绕数，在分数化相中非零而在介电晶体中为零。；创新点：首次提出利用高绕数斯格明子纹理产生的多磁通量子涌现磁场，在整数填充下实现分数化量子反常霍尔态，并揭示由晶格尺度不均匀性驱动的BKT相变及其拓扑绕数特征。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法（如场论、有效模型、数值对角化等），仅提及BKT相变分析和磁通插入下的多体极化绕数计算。

papers.title: Temporal Signature of Bosonic Stimulation Induced by Dark Exciton in a Two-photon Pumped Polariton Condensate
papers.abstract: Strongly-coupled light-matter exciton-polaritons constitute an on-chip solid-state platform where the macroscopic quantum phenomenon of condensation is not only achievable at elevated temperatures, but can also be optically controlled, including through their interaction with inaccessible "dark" states. A recent study has shown that polariton condensation can be established under nonlinear two-photon pumping, paving the way towards dark state-condensate coherent control and highly-efficient terahertz (THz) lasing. In this letter, we show for the first time a temporal signature of dark exciton induced bosonic stimulation by investigating one- and two-photon pumped condensation with time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy. Our results show a clear difference in the detuning dependence of the buildup and relaxation rates of the condensate-induced blueshifts under one- and two-photon pumping. This difference is associated with the stronger exciton-fraction dependence expected for one-photon pumped condensation, where polariton-polariton stimulation dominates, compared with two-photon pumped condensation, where a 2p-exciton-to-lower-polariton THz transition can provide another stimulation channel, together with various spin-flip, electron-hole exchange and phonon-based mechanisms. These observations indicate the presence of a new dark state originated stimulation channel that could facilitate highly-efficient THz lasing in semiconductor microcavities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy”（时间分辨光致发光谱）作为研究手段，并报告了实验观测结果。；研究对象：半导体微腔中的激子-极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensate），具体研究在单光子泵浦与双光子泵浦两种条件下，暗激子（dark exciton）诱导的玻色子受激放大（bosonic stimulation）的时间特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次通过时间分辨光致发光谱观测到暗激子诱导的玻色子受激放大的时间特征：在单光子和双光子泵浦下，凝聚体诱导蓝移的建立速率与弛豫速率对失谐（detuning）的依赖存在明显差异，表明双光子泵浦中存在一个由暗态起源的新受激通道，可能有助于实现高效太赫兹激射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次通过时间分辨光致发光谱观测到暗激子诱导的玻色子受激放大的时间特征：在单光子和双光子泵浦下，凝聚体诱导蓝移的建立速率与弛豫速率对失谐（detuning）的依赖存在明显差异，表明双光子泵浦中存在一个由暗态起源的新受激通道，可能有助于实现高效太赫兹激射。；创新点：首次在时间域上揭示暗激子参与的玻色子受激放大通道的存在，该通道与双光子泵浦下2p激子到下极化激元的太赫兹跃迁相关，为高效太赫兹激射提供了新的物理机制。摘要未明确说明与已有工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨光致发光谱（time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy），对比单光子泵浦与双光子泵浦下的凝聚体动力学，分析蓝移的建立与弛豫速率随失谐的变化。

papers.title: Green-function Zeros Encode Competing Mott and Charge-ordering Scales
papers.abstract: While correlated insulators are devoid of low-energy quasiparticle poles, their Green functions retain clean momentum structure through zeros. However, precisely what zeros imply is not clear. By studying the extended Hubbard model both analytically and numerically, we establish a new paradigm for strongly correlated matter: the dispersion of Green function zeros is determined by both microscopic spin-spin correlations and defect kinematics. In fact, we find that the dispersion changes discontinuously across the transition between the Mott and the checkerboard charge-density wave phases as is expected for a first-order transition. This physics is robust to the inclusion of further neighbor hopping which simply fine tunes the spin-correlation or charge-defect kinematics. We conclude that it is the {\it dispersion} of the Green-function zeros that encode the physics of ordering resultant from the strong correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：analytically and numerically、extended Hubbard model。；研究对象：强关联电子体系中的扩展Hubbard模型，具体关注Mott绝缘体与棋盘型电荷密度波（checkerboard charge-density wave）相之间的竞争与转变，以及Green函数零点的色散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Green函数零点的色散由微观自旋-自旋关联和缺陷运动学共同决定，并且在该一级相变（Mott相与电荷密度波相之间）处色散发生不连续变化。因此，Green函数零点的色散本身编码了强关联导致的序的物理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Green函数零点的色散由微观自旋-自旋关联和缺陷运动学共同决定，并且在该一级相变（Mott相与电荷密度波相之间）处色散发生不连续变化。因此，Green函数零点的色散本身编码了强关联导致的序的物理。；创新点：提出了一个新的范式：Green函数零点的色散（而非仅其存在或位置）是理解强关联物质中序的关键量，并揭示了零点色散与自旋关联及缺陷运动学的直接联系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或材料的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 对扩展Hubbard模型进行了解析分析和数值计算（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如DMRG或QMC等），并考察了次近邻跳跃对结果的影响。

papers.title: Fermi-Level Metal-d Character of Group-6 Bis-Hexahapto Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in graphite intercalation compounds requires occupancy of a carbon-derived interlayer band filled by charge from an electropositive intercalant. Bis-hexahapto (eta6-eta6) coordination binds transition metals covalently to two graphene sheets with little charge transfer -- the mechanism that defines this chemistry removes the donation on which intercalated-graphite superconductivity rests. We ask, for group-6 Cr, Mo and W in bilayer graphene, whether Fermi-level states retain the interstitial, carbon-p character of ionic references, with bulk CaC6 and same-cell C12Ca/C12Li controls. Electron-phonon coupling is not computed. At one metal per gallery (C12M), the ionic controls retain 68 and 45 per cent, respectively, of gallery spectral weight in atom-masked interstitial regions at EF; the group-6 systems retain 15, 22 and 23 per cent. The contrast is compositional: group-6 galleries carry more absolute interstitial weight than C12Li, but projected density of states within +/-0.15 eV of EF is carbon p dominated in the ionic references and metal d dominated (~73 per cent) in all three group-6 bilayers. Every system studied is metallic; they differ in what carries the Fermi surface. Geometrically, eta6-eta6 coordination requires AA stacking and reverses the intrinsic Bernal preference by 400-600 meV wherever metal is present. Ordered phases are metastable against bulk metal (+2.9-5.0 eV per atom) but bound against isolated atoms (-1.6-4.1 eV); instability ordering (Cr least, W most) matches Cr > Mo > W reactivity. C12Cr is metallic; tungsten alone carries 0.65 muB. Bis-hexahapto intercalation delivers strong interlayer bonding and a definite AA registry, but not the interlayer-band character associated with superconducting graphite intercalation compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Electron-phonon coupling is not computed”（未计算电声耦合），并系统比较了投影态密度、几何稳定性与能量学，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：双层石墨烯中第6族过渡金属（Cr、Mo、W）的双六配位（bis-hexahapto，η6-η6）插层体系，并与离子型插层石墨化合物（CaC6、C12Ca、C12Li）进行对比，关注费米面附近的电子态特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 第6族金属的双六配位插层使费米能级附近的态密度以金属d轨道为主（约73%），而非离子型插层体系中占主导的碳p型层间带特征；因此这类体系虽为金属，但不具备超导石墨插层化合物所需的层间带（interlayer band）电子结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：第6族金属的双六配位插层使费米能级附近的态密度以金属d轨道为主（约73%），而非离子型插层体系中占主导的碳p型层间带特征；因此这类体系虽为金属，但不具备超导石墨插层化合物所需的层间带（interlayer band）电子结构。；创新点：首次系统揭示双六配位（η6-η6）配位化学对双层石墨烯费米面载流子轨道特征的调控作用，明确指出该配位模式虽能实现强层间键合和确定的AA堆叠序，但会消除超导石墨插层化合物所依赖的碳p型层间带占据机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的电子结构计算，包括投影态密度（projected DOS）分析、费米能级附近±0.15 eV窗口内的轨道成分分解、原子掩蔽（atom-masked）层间谱权重统计、AA/AB堆叠能量对比及有序相稳定性评估（相对于体相金属和孤立原子的结合能）。

papers.title: AutoXRD: Autonomous LLM Agents and Comprehensive Evaluation for Powder Diffraction Analysis
papers.abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is central to materials characterization, yet reliable end-to-end automation remains challenging. An XRD agent must interpret diffraction evidence, operate refinement software, manage coupled parameters in a defensible order, and distinguish numerical improvement from physical validity. In this paper, we propose AutoXRD, an autonomous large language model (LLM) agent framework that organizes powder-XRD analysis as stepwise refinement, grounds actions in observed evidence, and applies deterministic crystallographic and physical checks before accepting results. We further introduce XRDBench with two complementary tracks. XRDBench-QA contains 100 bounded diagnostic tasks that isolate scientific reasoning and decision-making, whereas XRDBench-E2E contains 34 executable workflows that test whether agents can compose these capabilities into complete analyses requiring file inspection, crystallographic-software execution, iterative refinement, evidence preservation, and reporting. We evaluate ten recent LLMs across 1,340 model--task runs. Models average only 57.8 out of 100, falling from 61.9 on XRDBench-QA to 53.7 on XRDBench-E2E. They perform best on refinement-history assessment and result acceptance, but remain substantially weaker on refinement-action selection, phase quantification, indexing, and Rietveld refinement. GPT-5.6 Sol achieves the highest overall score of 81.1, GPT-5.6 Terra the highest XRDBench-E2E point estimate of 81.0, and GPT-5.6 Luna the best score--cost trade-off. Ablations show that all six AutoXRD components consistently improve performance, supporting the framework design. Finally, execution-trace analysis reveals recurring failures in coupled-parameter control, quantitative reasoning, evidence preservation, and workflow termination, motivating stronger scientific constraints, uncertainty-aware decisions, and more efficient planning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算/方法学文章）。判断依据关键词：LLM agent framework、deterministic crystallographic and physical checks、benchmark evaluation、ablation analysis。；研究对象：粉末X射线衍射（powder XRD）数据分析的自动化流程，具体涉及物相鉴定、Rietveld精修、索引、定量分析等晶体学任务，而非特定材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有大语言模型在粉末XRD端到端自动分析上表现不足（平均57.8/100分），在精修动作选择、物相定量、索引和Rietveld精修等关键环节尤为薄弱；提出的AutoXRD框架通过逐步精修、证据锚定和确定性物理检查可稳定提升性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有大语言模型在粉末XRD端到端自动分析上表现不足（平均57.8/100分），在精修动作选择、物相定量、索引和Rietveld精修等关键环节尤为薄弱；提出的AutoXRD框架通过逐步精修、证据锚定和确定性物理检查可稳定提升性能。；创新点：首次将粉末XRD分析组织为LLM可执行的逐步精修流程，并在接受结果前强制施加确定性晶体学与物理约束；引入双轨基准（诊断性QA与端到端E2E）系统分离评测科学推理能力与完整工作流执行能力；通过执行轨迹分析揭示耦合参数控制、定量推理、证据保留和工作流终止的系统性失败模式。
papers.method_zh: 构建AutoXRD自主LLM智能体框架，包含六个组件（逐步精修、证据锚定、确定性晶体学/物理检查等）；开发XRDBench双轨基准（XRDBench-QA含100个诊断任务，XRDBench-E2E含34个可执行工作流）；对10个近期LLM进行1,340次模型-任务评估，并做消融实验和执行轨迹分析。

papers.title: Observable- and state-selective prethermalization and bounds on prethermal lifetimes
papers.abstract: Prethermalization describes long-lived intermediate regimes that precede equilibrium and can dominate experimentally accessible dynamics. Here, we show that a separation of spectral energy scales, despite giving rise to a hierarchy of dynamical timescales, does not by itself guarantee the appearance of a prethermal plateau. Under the same Hamiltonian, some observables may exhibit prethermal behavior, while others relax directly toward equilibrium. We uncover the mechanism governing this selectivity, showing that the emergence of a prethermal plateau depends not only on the Hamiltonian, but also on the observable and the initial state. Our results apply broadly to systems close to a fully permutation-symmetric limit and are illustrated with a long-range interacting spin model. We further prove that the Loschmidt echo provides a lower bound on the prethermal lifetime of any bounded observable whenever the prethermal and exact dynamics are unitary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, prove, uncover the mechanism，属于解析论证与一般性理论分析。；研究对象：预热化（prethermalization）现象，具体针对接近完全置换对称极限（fully permutation-symmetric limit）的量子多体系统，并以长程相互作用自旋模型为例进行说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 能级分离（谱能量尺度分离）本身并不足以保证出现预热化平台；在同一个哈密顿量下，某些可观测量会表现出预热行为，而另一些则直接弛豫到平衡态。预热平台的出现不仅取决于哈密顿量，还取决于所选择的可观测量和初始态。此外，作者证明了Loschmidt回声为任何有界可观测量的预热寿命提供了一个下界（在预热动力学与精确动力学均为幺正的情况下）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：能级分离（谱能量尺度分离）本身并不足以保证出现预热化平台；在同一个哈密顿量下，某些可观测量会表现出预热行为，而另一些则直接弛豫到平衡态。预热平台的出现不仅取决于哈密顿量，还取决于所选择的可观测量和初始态。此外，作者证明了Loschmidt回声为任何有界可观测量的预热寿命提供了一个下界（在预热动力学与精确动力学均为幺正的情况下）。；创新点：揭示了预热化平台出现的“选择性”机制——即预热化并非哈密顿量本身的普适属性，而是依赖于可观测量与初始态的联合选择；并首次证明了Loschmidt回声可作为任意有界可观测量预热寿命的通用下界。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析证明。具体包括：对谱能量尺度分离与动力学时间尺度层级关系的分析；揭示可观测量与初态选择性机制的论证；利用长程相互作用自旋模型作为示例进行说明；以及利用Loschmidt回声给出预热寿命下界的数学证明。摘要未提及数值模拟或具体计算方法。

papers.title: Depth-1 expanders on the unitary group and applications
papers.abstract: We construct a constant-degree and constant-gap quantum expander on $n$ qubits where each unitary can be implemented by a depth-$1$ and 1D circuit of Pauli or CNOT gates. We provide two applications of this expander. First, we use it to construct a family of frustration-free 1D Hamiltonians whose ground states obey the entanglement-gap relation $S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2})$; this is believed to be optimal, but achieving it had been open. Second, we use it to provide a streaming protocol that tests for closeness to a class of 1D volume-law entangled states. Moreover, we extend our quantum expander to a constant-degree and constant-gap expander on the unitary group where each unitary is a single $T$ gate, a single $T^{\dagger}$ gate, or a depth-$1$ Clifford circuit. This implies that a random sequence of unitaries from the expander yields a gapped walk on a dense subgroup of the unitary group. This improves upon previous work by Bourgain and Gamburd which did not control the dependence of the gap on the dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、quantum expander、Hamiltonians、protocol、proof/analysis（隐含于数学构造与间隙分析）。；研究对象：量子信息与量子多体物理中的抽象数学对象：n 量子比特上的量子扩展器（quantum expander），以及由其构造的1D无阻挫哈密顿量基态和流式量子态测试协议。不涉及具体凝聚态材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了常数度、常数间隙的量子扩展器，其中每个酉算符可由深度为1的一维Pauli或CNOT电路实现；由此得到满足纠缠-间隙关系 S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2}) 的无阻挫1D哈密顿量族（该关系被认为最优但此前未实现），并给出针对一类1D体积极律纠缠态的流式测试协议。此外，将扩展器推广到酉群上，每个酉为单个T门、单个T†门或深度1的Clifford电路，从而在酉群的稠密子群上产生有间隙随机游走。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了常数度、常数间隙的量子扩展器，其中每个酉算符可由深度为1的一维Pauli或CNOT电路实现；由此得到满足纠缠-间隙关系 S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2}) 的无阻挫1D哈密顿量族（该关系被认为最优但此前未实现），并给出针对一类1D体积极律纠缠态的流式测试协议。此外，将扩展器推广到酉群上，每个酉为单个T门、单个T†门或深度1的Clifford电路，从而在酉群的稠密子群上产生有间隙随机游走。；创新点：首次实现深度1（一维局域电路）的常数度、常数间隙量子扩展器；首次构造满足 S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2}) 的最优纠缠-间隙关系的无阻挫1D哈密顿量族；将扩展器推广到含T门的酉群情形，并明确控制间隙对维度的依赖（此前Bourgain-Gamburd工作未控制该依赖）。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与数学证明：利用深度1的Pauli/CNOT电路构造量子扩展器（常数度、常数间隙），并分析其谱间隙；基于此构造哈密顿量与流式测试协议；推广至T门/Clifford电路情形，并分析酉群上随机游走的间隙（改进Bourgain-Gamburd方法，控制间隙对维度的依赖）。

papers.title: Concentration of additive functionals of Stratonovich-type
papers.abstract: Additive functionals $\overline{J}_t=\frac{1}{t}\int_0^tU(X_s)\circ dX_s$ of Stratonovich-type recently attracted much attention in the context of inference of thermodynamic properties of complex systems from observations $U$ of individual fluctuating paths $(X_s)_{0\le s\le t}$, whereby $X_0$ is initiated from some general measure. Concentration results on $\overline{J}_t$, albeit desirable, are virtually nonexistent. They turn out to be significantly more challenging to prove than for classical Lebesgue-type functionals $\overlineρ_t=\frac{1}{t}\int_0^t V(X_s)ds$ because the tilt deforms the full second-order structure of the Feynman-Kac generator instead of contributing an additive potential. This renders the generator generally non-self-adjoint even under detailed balance. We overcome this by working with a symmetrized Dirichlet form with a new effective potential that now couples the observable to the non-equilibrium character of the dynamics. We prove concentration inequalities for $\overline{J}_t$ for any bounded, sufficiently smooth vector-valued function $U$ of a general geometrically ergodic diffusion process $X_s$, including explicit sub-gamma and Bernstein-type inequalities, and we obtain explicit upper bounds on ${\rm Var}(\overline{J}_t)$. Strikingly, under detailed balance the concentration of $\overline{J}_t$ is distinctively sub-Gaussian at all times and all deviations, with a variance proxy fixed by the noise alone and independent of the spectral gap, which has no analog for $\overlineρ_t$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数学证明、生成元、Dirichlet形式、不等式推导等理论分析内容。；研究对象：随机扩散过程的Stratonovich型加性泛函（additive functionals of Stratonovich-type），即形如$\overline{J}_t=\frac{1}{t}\int_0^tU(X_s)\circ dX_s$的路径泛函，其物理背景是从复杂系统单个涨落路径的观测中推断热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一般几何遍历扩散过程，证明了Stratonovich型加性泛函$\overline{J}_t$的浓度不等式（包括显式的sub-gamma和Bernstein型不等式），并给出了方差$\mathrm{Var}(\overline{J}_t)$的显式上界。特别地，在细致平衡条件下，$\overline{J}_t$的浓度在所有时间和所有偏差下均为sub-Gaussian型，其方差代理仅由噪声决定，与谱间隙无关——这一性质对经典Lebesgue型泛函$\overline{\rho}_t$不存在对应类比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一般几何遍历扩散过程，证明了Stratonovich型加性泛函$\overline{J}_t$的浓度不等式（包括显式的sub-gamma和Bernstein型不等式），并给出了方差$\mathrm{Var}(\overline{J}_t)$的显式上界。特别地，在细致平衡条件下，$\overline{J}_t$的浓度在所有时间和所有偏差下均为sub-Gaussian型，其方差代理仅由噪声决定，与谱间隙无关——这一性质对经典Lebesgue型泛函$\overline{\rho}_t$不存在对应类比。；创新点：首次给出了Stratonovich型加性泛函的浓度结果（此前该类结果几乎不存在）；发现细致平衡下$\overline{J}_t$的浓度具有独特的sub-Gaussian行为，其方差代理仅由噪声决定且独立于谱间隙，这与经典Lebesgue型泛函的浓度行为有本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：通过对称化的Dirichlet形式引入新的有效势，该有效势将可观测量与动力学的非平衡特征耦合起来，从而克服了倾斜（tilt）使Feynman-Kac生成元失去自伴性（即使满足细致平衡）的困难。推导了显式的sub-gamma和Bernstein型浓度不等式以及方差上界。

papers.title: Odd-viscosity-induced instability in shear flows
papers.abstract: Odd viscosity is a nondissipative component of the viscosity tensor that arises in fluids with broken time-reversal symmetry. Despite conserving energy, we show that odd viscosity can qualitatively alter hydrodynamic stability by generating exponentially growing modes that are absent in conventional fluids. For plane Poiseuille flow, we derive the odd-viscous generalization of the Orr--Sommerfeld--Squire equations and find a new instability that first emerges for spanwise perturbations and extends to oblique modes through the amplification of odd-viscous forces in critical layers. The instability originates from the non-normal dynamics of shear flows: conventional fluids support transiently growing disturbances through the lift-up mechanism, while odd viscosity provides a feedback between wall-normal velocity and vorticity that converts this transient growth into a self-sustaining exponentially growing mode. More generally, we show that an energy-conserving perturbation can destabilize a non-normal dynamical system only when the unperturbed system supports transient growth. Our results establish a direct connection between transient growth, non-normality, and instability induced by nondissipative forces, with implications extending beyond odd-viscous hydrodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及推导方程（derive the odd-viscous generalization）、理论分析（show, establish）以及一般性动力学论证，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：具有奇异性黏度（odd viscosity）的流体，具体研究平面泊肃叶流（plane Poiseuille flow）中的流体动力学稳定性问题。该体系为破缺时间反演对称性的流体，属于经典流体力学范畴，而非特定量子材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇异性黏度虽不耗散能量，却能通过将剪切流中非正常动力学（non-normal dynamics）的瞬态增长转化为自持的指数增长模式，从而在传统流体中不存在的条件下引发新的不稳定性。该不稳定性首先出现在展向扰动中，并通过临界层中奇异性黏性力的放大扩展到斜向模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇异性黏度虽不耗散能量，却能通过将剪切流中非正常动力学（non-normal dynamics）的瞬态增长转化为自持的指数增长模式，从而在传统流体中不存在的条件下引发新的不稳定性。该不稳定性首先出现在展向扰动中，并通过临界层中奇异性黏性力的放大扩展到斜向模式。；创新点：首次证明奇异性黏度（一种无耗散、保能量的输运系数）能够定性改变流体动力学稳定性，产生传统流体中不存在的指数增长模式；并建立了瞬态增长、非正常性与无耗散力诱导不稳定性之间的直接联系。该结论的适用范围超出奇异性黏度流体，具有一般性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导方法：对平面泊肃叶流推导了奇异性黏度推广的 Orr–Sommerfeld–Squire 方程，并基于线性稳定性分析研究扰动增长；同时采用一般性的非正常动力学系统理论框架，分析能量守恒扰动对瞬态增长系统的失稳条件。

papers.title: Quasi-normal-mode signatures of periodicity and hyperuniformity
papers.abstract: Hyperuniform materials occupy an intermediate regime between periodic order and conventional disorder, characterized by a suppression of long-wavelength density fluctuations, commonly quantified by the structure factor. This characterization, however, relies on the statistical properties of an extended configuration or supercell representation and does not directly describe the resonant response of a finite structure, as typically encountered in scattering experiments. Here, we introduce the quasi-normal-mode spectrum as a complementary framework for characterizing the wave properties of finite stealthy hyperuniform materials. We analyze the complex eigenfrequencies of both periodic and stealthy hyperuniform structures over a range of the stealthiness parameter ($χ$), and investigate how the spatial organization of scatterers is encoded in both frequency and spatial profiles of their quasi-normal modes. We find systematic changes in the quasi-normal modes spectrum as the degree of hyperuniformity is varied, revealing signatures that are not captured solely by the structure factor. In particular, the evolution of the resonant states provides a direct connection between structural correlations and the scattering response of finite systems. Our results establish quasi-normal modes as a real-space and open-system characterization of hyperuniformity and provide a unified framework for comparing discrete heterogeneous materials from the perspective of their scattering and resonant dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“分析复本征频率”“结构因子”“准正态模式谱”等理论计算概念，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：有限尺寸的隐身超均匀（stealthy hyperuniform）材料，以及周期性结构作为对照，重点研究其准正态模式（quasi-normal modes）所反映的波散射与共振响应特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着超均匀性程度（隐身参数χ）变化，准正态模式谱呈现系统性演化，揭示了仅靠结构因子无法捕捉的共振特征；共振态的演化直接建立了结构关联与有限体系散射响应之间的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着超均匀性程度（隐身参数χ）变化，准正态模式谱呈现系统性演化，揭示了仅靠结构因子无法捕捉的共振特征；共振态的演化直接建立了结构关联与有限体系散射响应之间的联系。；创新点：首次将准正态模式谱作为表征超均匀性的实空间、开放系统框架，为从散射与共振动力学角度统一比较不同离散异质材料提供了新途径；该框架能捕捉结构因子遗漏的共振信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算：通过求解有限结构的复本征频率（准正态模式谱），分析周期性和隐身超均匀结构中散射体的空间组织如何编码在模式的频率与空间分布中，并系统扫描隐身参数χ。

papers.title: A nonabelian anyon violates Haag duality
papers.abstract: We show that a superselction sector describing a single nonabelian anyon violates Haag duality, which is equivalent to the fundamental quantum-information theoretic principle of uniqueness of purifications. We provide a simple physics argument as well as a rigorous proof using sector theory, and instantiate our result concretely in Levin-Wen models. We also show that the associated ground state does not allow for quantum steering despite being a pure state. Finally, we show that this ground state violates approximate Haag duality, disproving the conjecture that all gapped ground states satisfy this condition. Our result implies that there are gapped phases of matter where Haag duality fails at every point in the phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorous proof”“sector theory”“Levin-Wen models”等理论推导与模型分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非阿贝尔任意子的超选择扇区，以及与之关联的量子基态（具体在Levin-Wen模型中实现）。物理现象涉及Haag对偶性、量子纠缠唯一性、量子转向（steering）以及有能隙物相中的局域量子场论结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个非阿贝尔任意子的超选择扇区违反Haag对偶性（等价于纯化唯一性原理的破坏）；该任意子对应的基态虽为纯态但不允许量子转向，且该基态违反近似Haag对偶性，从而否定了“所有有能隙基态均满足近似Haag对偶性”的猜想。这意味着存在某些有能隙物相，其中Haag对偶性在相空间的每一点都失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个非阿贝尔任意子的超选择扇区违反Haag对偶性（等价于纯化唯一性原理的破坏）；该任意子对应的基态虽为纯态但不允许量子转向，且该基态违反近似Haag对偶性，从而否定了“所有有能隙基态均满足近似Haag对偶性”的猜想。这意味着存在某些有能隙物相，其中Haag对偶性在相空间的每一点都失效。；创新点：首次证明非阿贝尔任意子违反Haag对偶性，并将其与纯化唯一性这一量子信息基本原理直接关联；同时首次给出有能隙基态违反近似Haag对偶性的具体反例，推翻了相关猜想。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用代数量子场论中的扇区理论（sector theory）进行严格证明，并辅以基于物理直觉的简单论证；具体实例化于Levin-Wen格子模型，通过构造该模型中的非阿贝尔任意子态来分析Haag对偶性及其近似版本的成立情况。

papers.title: Exceptional Points in Photonics: From Non-Hermitian Physics to Applications
papers.abstract: Open photonic systems provide a versatile platform for non-Hermitian physics, enabling control over complex spectra, transport, and light-matter interactions. Exceptional points (EPs), at which eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce and the governing operator becomes defective, play a central role because they combine branch-point spectral topology, nonanalytic perturbative response, and controllable eigenstate conversion. This Review provides a unified framework for EP photonics by systematically distinguishing exceptional degeneracies according to the underlying operator, spectral variable, boundary conditions, and experimentally accessible observables. We discuss Hamiltonian EPs, absorbing EPs associated with scattering zeros, real-frequency scattering-matrix and Jones-matrix EPs, Bloch and Floquet EPs, and Liouvillian EPs in open quantum systems. We review their spectral topology, static and dynamical encircling, higher-order exceptional structures, and coexistence with bound states in the continuum, together with applications in sensing, lasing, coherent absorption, directional scattering, polarization and wavefront control, nonlinear optics, optical storage, nonreciprocal photonics, and quantum photonics. We also critically assess the current limitations, practical challenges, and future perspectives of EP-based photonic technologies, with particular attention to robustness, noise, scalability, and experimentally measurable performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：摘要明确为“This Review”，系统分类讨论非厄米光子学中的各类奇异点（EPs），属于理论框架综述，而非实验或计算研究。；研究对象：开放光子体系中的非厄米物理，具体聚焦于**奇异点（Exceptional Points, EPs）**——即本征值和本征矢同时合并、系统算符变为亏损（defective）的特殊简并点。涵盖多种体系：哈密顿量EP、散射零点对应的吸收EP、实频散射矩阵与Jones矩阵EP、Bloch/Floquet EP、开放量子系统中的Liouvillian EP，以及它们与连续谱中束缚态（BIC）的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该综述为EP光子学提供了一个统一分类框架，按底层算符、谱变量、边界条件和可观测物理量系统区分各类奇异简并，并总结了EP在传感、激光、相干吸收、定向散射、偏振/波前调控、非线性光学、光学存储、非互易光子学和量子光子学中的应用，同时批判性评估了其鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性等实际挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该综述为EP光子学提供了一个统一分类框架，按底层算符、谱变量、边界条件和可观测物理量系统区分各类奇异简并，并总结了EP在传感、激光、相干吸收、定向散射、偏振/波前调控、非线性光学、光学存储、非互易光子学和量子光子学中的应用，同时批判性评估了其鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性等实际挑战。；创新点：摘要未突出说明单一创新点，但核心贡献在于**首次系统性地按底层算符类型、谱变量、边界条件和可观测物理量对EP光子学进行统一分类**，将哈密顿量EP、散射矩阵EP、Bloch/Floquet EP和Liouvillian EP纳入同一框架，并明确区分了不同EP类型的实验可观测特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架与分类学方法：基于非厄米算符理论（哈密顿量、散射矩阵、Jones矩阵、Liouvillian），结合谱拓扑分析、静态与动力学环绕（encircling）理论、高阶奇异结构分析，以及BIC共存条件的讨论。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法或实验手段。

papers.title: Chemotaxis-induced linear instabilities and pattern formation in a reaction-diffusion model
papers.abstract: We study linear instabilities and pattern formation in a spatially extended Selkov model for glycolysis with diffusion and chemotactic interactions between two species. Linear stability analysis reveals two distinct bifurcations: a zero-wavevector, finite-frequency Hopf bifurcation leading to spatially homogeneous oscillations, and a finite-wavevector Turing instability with a saddle-node bifurcation leading to stationary inhomogeneous patterns. The selected wavevector, $k_c$, depends sensitively on the nature and strength of chemotaxis and varies nonmonotonically with the chemotaxis parameters, allowing re-entrant transitions between homogeneous and patterned states. For sufficiently strong chemotaxis, when the two species mutually attract or mutually repel each other, an unusual instability emerges in which the preferred wavevector diverges as a finite threshold in chemotactic strength is approached. We complement the linear analysis with extensive direct numerical simulations (DNS) of the nonlinear partial differential equations in two dimensions. The DNS confirm the predicted instabilities and their nonmonotonic and re-entrant character, and also reveal spatially uniform oscillatory states for suitable parameters. The stationary patterns include spots and, unexpectedly, stable stripes. We further uncover transitions between spot and stripe morphologies controlled by chemotactic strength and diffusivity ratios. The stability of the striped states is consistent with linear amplitude equations, whereas the spot-stripe transition is attributed to nonlinear effects beyond linear stability. Our results demonstrate that chemotaxis can act as a nonmonotonic control parameter for instability selection, wavelength selection, re-entrant pattern formation, and nonlinear pattern morphology in reaction-diffusion systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：线性稳定性分析、直接数值模拟（DNS）、非线性偏微分方程求解。；研究对象：空间扩展的Selkov糖酵解反应-扩散模型，包含两种物种间的扩散与趋化相互作用，研究趋化诱导的线性失稳与斑图形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 趋化作用可作为反应-扩散系统中失稳选择、波长选择、重入斑图形成及非线性斑图形态的非单调控制参数；强趋化下可出现波矢发散的反常失稳，并发现稳定的条纹斑图及斑点-条纹转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：趋化作用可作为反应-扩散系统中失稳选择、波长选择、重入斑图形成及非线性斑图形态的非单调控制参数；强趋化下可出现波矢发散的反常失稳，并发现稳定的条纹斑图及斑点-条纹转变。；创新点：揭示了趋化强度作为非单调控制参数导致的重入转变（均匀态↔斑图态），发现强趋化下波矢在有限阈值处发散的新奇失稳类型，并在该反应-扩散体系中意外发现稳定条纹斑图及由非线性效应主导的斑点-条纹形态转变。摘要未突出说明与已有趋化-反应-扩散研究的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 线性稳定性分析（识别Hopf分岔与Turing失稳）、振幅方程（amplitude equations）线性分析，以及二维非线性偏微分方程的直接数值模拟（DNS）。

papers.title: Helium-Gas-Cooled Cryogenic Current Comparator Integrated with a Quantum Resistance Standard
papers.abstract: We report a cryogen-free cryogenic current comparator (CCC) system for precision resistance measurements. A helium-gas chamber was developed and installed on the 4 K stage of a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator equipped with a pulse-tube cryocooler. The CCC probe was housed in this chamber and was cooled through helium gas serving as a heat exchange medium. The metrological performance of this helium-gas-cooled CCC was evaluated through precision resistance-ratio measurements and found to be comparable to that obtained under liquid-helium cooling. A quantum Hall resistance (QHR) device was also integrated into the same refrigerator, enabling QHR/100~$Ω$ resistance-ratio measurements. The type-A uncertainty reached the 1~n$Ω$/$Ω$ level within an averaging time of 100~s, and the resulting resistance-ratio measurements agreed well with conventional liquid-helium-based measurements at the level of a few n$Ω$/$Ω$. The system provides this level of measurement performance while consuming less than 1~L of helium gas per thermal cycle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了一套实际搭建的低温系统（helium-gas chamber、CCC probe）并进行了测量（precision resistance-ratio measurements）。；研究对象：研究对象是低温电流比较仪（CCC）系统本身，以及与之集成的量子霍尔电阻（QHR）标准装置。物理体系为用于精密电阻测量的量子计量系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氦气冷却的CCC系统在无液氦稀释制冷机中实现了与液氦冷却相当的计量性能，并与QHR集成后完成了QHR/100 Ω电阻比测量，在100秒平均时间内达到1 nΩ/Ω量级的A类不确定度，与常规液氦测量结果在几个nΩ/Ω水平一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氦气冷却的CCC系统在无液氦稀释制冷机中实现了与液氦冷却相当的计量性能，并与QHR集成后完成了QHR/100 Ω电阻比测量，在100秒平均时间内达到1 nΩ/Ω量级的A类不确定度，与常规液氦测量结果在几个nΩ/Ω水平一致。；创新点：实现了无液氦（cryogen-free）条件下CCC与QHR的集成运行，用氦气替代液氦作为冷却介质，在保持计量精度的同时大幅降低氦消耗（每次循环<1 L），为量子电阻标准的无液氦化运行提供了可行方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：无液氦稀释制冷机（配备脉冲管制冷机）、4 K级氦气冷却腔体（以氦气为换热介质）、CCC探针、量子霍尔电阻器件集成，以及精密电阻比测量。系统每次热循环消耗氦气少于1升。

papers.title: Tangent fermions can restore vacuum stability of discrete-time Dirac models
papers.abstract: The Dirac quantum walk (a 1+1 dimensional space-time discretization of the Dirac equation) has a $2μ$ mass gap both at the center and at the corner of the quasi-energy-momentum Brillouin zone. Gupta and Short recently noted [Quantum 9, 1845 (2025)] that the Dirac vacuum can create a particle-hole pair at the zone corner with the release of an energy $2μ$ to the environment. They removed this vacuum instability at the expense of fermion doubling, the appearance of a second low-energy Dirac cone. Here we show that an alternative discretization scheme, with a tangent rather than a sine dispersion relation, offers stability while retaining a single Dirac cone. The key step is the Cayley transformation from the unit circle of Floquet eigenvalues $e^{-i\varepsilon}$ to the real line of unbounded energies $E=2\tan(\varepsilon/2)$. We compute the Schwinger effect (particle-hole pair creation in a uniform electric field) for tangent fermions and show that the pair-production rate agrees with the continuum result for a single Dirac cone. The zone corner is exactly decoupled if the scalar potential is coupled through the Hermitian generator of the quantum map. If it is coupled as a split operator, in order to preserve exact gauge invariance on the lattice, the corner does contribute - with a weight that vanishes quadratically with the lattice constants, in contrast to the Dirac quantum walk where the zone-corner instability survives the continuum limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论离散化方案、色散关系、Cayley变换等理论构造，并计算Schwinger效应，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：离散时间Dirac模型（Dirac量子行走）的真空稳定性问题，具体关注1+1维Dirac方程时空离散化后，在准能带布里渊区角点处的粒子-空穴对产生（真空不稳定性）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于正切色散关系（tangent dispersion）的替代离散化方案，通过Cayley变换将Floquet本征值单位圆映射到无界能量实轴，可在保持单一Dirac锥的同时恢复真空稳定性；该方案下粒子对产生率与连续统单Dirac锥结果一致，且区角点贡献随晶格常数二次方消失，而传统Dirac量子行走的区角不稳定性在连续极限下仍存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于正切色散关系（tangent dispersion）的替代离散化方案，通过Cayley变换将Floquet本征值单位圆映射到无界能量实轴，可在保持单一Dirac锥的同时恢复真空稳定性；该方案下粒子对产生率与连续统单Dirac锥结果一致，且区角点贡献随晶格常数二次方消失，而传统Dirac量子行走的区角不稳定性在连续极限下仍存在。；创新点：首次证明正切色散离散化方案能在不引入费米子加倍（即保持单一低能Dirac锥）的前提下消除Dirac量子行走的真空不稳定性，并系统分析了不同势耦合方式对区角点贡献的影响，指出其与Gupta-Short方案（以费米子加倍为代价换取稳定）的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：Dirac量子行走的Floquet理论、Cayley变换（从单位圆e^{-iε}到实能量E=2tan(ε/2)）、均匀电场中Schwinger效应的粒子对产生率计算，以及标量势的两种耦合方式（通过量子映射的Hermitian生成元耦合 vs. 分裂算符耦合）的对比分析。

papers.title: Topological charge switching in trapped polariton condensates
papers.abstract: Topological charges in photonic systems provide a robust degree of freedom with direct applications in optical information processing. Bound states in the continuum (BICs) in photonic crystal slabs inherently carry such quantized topological charges, yet they are topologically protected, making active reconfiguration fundamentally challenging. Here, we demonstrate topological charge switching in trapped BIC polariton condensates in a photonic crystal, where spatial modulation of the photonic crystals supports multiple confined states, each carrying a distinct charge. Trapped condensates within the Dirac bandgap are expelled into the leaky band via polariton blueshift, enabling single-mode selection by solely tuning the excitation power. This work offers a platform for optically controlling topological charges by harnessing polariton nonlinearity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we demonstrate”“trapped condensates are expelled”等实验性描述，以及“solely tuning the excitation power”表明有实际调控操作。；研究对象：光子晶体平板中的束缚态BIC激子极化激元凝聚体（trapped BIC polariton condensates），具体研究其拓扑电荷在非线性作用下的切换行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控激发功率，实现了光子晶体中束缚态BIC极化激元凝聚体的拓扑电荷切换——凝聚体从Dirac带隙中被排斥到漏泄带，从而实现单一模式（单一拓扑电荷）的选择。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控激发功率，实现了光子晶体中束缚态BIC极化激元凝聚体的拓扑电荷切换——凝聚体从Dirac带隙中被排斥到漏泄带，从而实现单一模式（单一拓扑电荷）的选择。；创新点：突破了BIC拓扑电荷的拓扑保护限制，首次（据摘要所述）在束缚态BIC极化激元凝聚体中实现了主动的拓扑电荷切换，利用极化激元非线性提供了一种纯光学调控拓扑电荷的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如光谱测量方式、样品制备方法等），仅提及：利用光子晶体的空间调制形成多个携带不同拓扑电荷的束缚态，并通过极化激元蓝移（polariton blueshift）将凝聚体从Dirac带隙推入漏泄带，以激发功率作为唯一调控参数实现单模选择。

papers.title: Information geometry of non-equilibrium quantum states: Mixed metric structures on an extended information manifold
papers.abstract: We discuss an information-geometric framework for characterizing quantum states in non-equilibrium dynamics. Using the transverse-field Ising chain model as a laboratory, we investigate the quantum Fisher information metric with particular emphasis on the mixed metric component $g_{ht}$ and related geometric observables, where $h$ is a controllable post-quench Hamiltonian parameter and $t$ is real time. The framework treats $h$ and $t$ as coordinates of an extended information manifold $(h,t)$. The geometric observables characterize the speed of evolution on the manifold and the alignment between the temporal and parameter-deformation directions. Correlations between these geometric quantities and two widely used measures of non-equilibrium dynamics, the entanglement entropy and the Loschmidt echo, are analyzed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要讨论“信息几何框架”“量子Fisher信息度量”“横场Ising链模型”，属于理论分析与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：非平衡量子态，具体以横场Ising链（transverse-field Ising chain）为模型体系，研究其淬火后非平衡动力学过程中的信息几何结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将后淬火哈密顿参数h与实时t作为扩展信息流形(h,t)的坐标，建立了非平衡量子态的信息几何描述框架，并发现混合度量分量g_ht及相关几何可观测量与纠缠熵、Loschmidt回声等非平衡度量之间存在关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将后淬火哈密顿参数h与实时t作为扩展信息流形(h,t)的坐标，建立了非平衡量子态的信息几何描述框架，并发现混合度量分量g_ht及相关几何可观测量与纠缠熵、Loschmidt回声等非平衡度量之间存在关联。；创新点：将信息几何方法推广到非平衡量子动力学，引入扩展信息流形(h,t)并系统研究混合度量分量g_ht，建立了几何可观测量与常用非平衡度量（纠缠熵、Loschmidt回声）之间的关联。摘要未突出说明与以往信息几何工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子Fisher信息度量（quantum Fisher information metric）及其混合分量分析；具体模型为横场Ising链，通过解析或数值方法计算几何可观测量，并与纠缠熵和Loschmidt回声进行相关性分析。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG或精确对角化）。

papers.title: Thermal screening and critical scaling of quantum energy teleportation in a harmonic chain
papers.abstract: We develop a finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation of quantum energy teleportation in the one-dimensional harmonic chain. For Gibbs states, the optimized measurement-feedback protocol reduces to thermal two-point functions. In the single-site protocol, the extracted energy is governed by a single correlator, which makes the thermodynamic and near-critical limits analytically tractable. At fixed finite temperature, the extracted energy is exponentially screened with distance and is controlled by a thermal correlation length for both critical and non-critical $α$. In the zero-temperature critical limit taken after the thermodynamic limit, we derive the exact asymptotic law $E_{\mathrm{ext}}\sim d^{-4}$. Numerical results confirm both regimes and resolve the crossover responsible for the apparent drift of the effective decay exponent at intermediate distances. We also analyze squeezed Gaussian measurements and show that they modify the extraction prefactor: $p-$squeezing enhances the extracted energy, whereas $q-$squeezing suppresses it, without changing the large-distance scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation、analytically tractable、derive exact asymptotic law。；研究对象：一维谐振子链（harmonic chain）中的量子能量远距传输（quantum energy teleportation），重点关注热平衡（Gibbs态）及近临界/临界条件下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定有限温度下，提取能量随距离呈指数衰减，由热关联长度控制（对临界与非临界参数α均成立）；在热力学极限后取零温临界极限时，提取能量满足精确渐近律 E_ext ~ d^{-4}。此外，p-压缩测量增强提取能量，q-压缩测量抑制提取能量，但不改变大距离标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定有限温度下，提取能量随距离呈指数衰减，由热关联长度控制（对临界与非临界参数α均成立）；在热力学极限后取零温临界极限时，提取能量满足精确渐近律 E_ext ~ d^{-4}。此外，p-压缩测量增强提取能量，q-压缩测量抑制提取能量，但不改变大距离标度行为。；创新点：首次在有限温度下对一维谐振子链的量子能量远距传输给出解析可处理的高斯态描述，精确推导出零温临界极限下的 d^{-4} 渐近律，并解析解释了中间距离处有效衰减指数表观漂移的交叉机制；同时系统分析了压缩高斯测量对提取能量的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有限温度高斯态形式化（finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation），将优化测量-反馈协议约化为热两点关联函数；对单点协议进行解析推导，并结合数值计算验证临界区与交叉区行为。

papers.title: Synchronization Pathways and Resilience in Power Grids
papers.abstract: Ensuring a sustainable energy supply requires maintaining power-grid stability. Rotor dynamics are governed by the swing equation, which takes the form of a second-order Kuramoto model with a correlation between power and total coupling strength. Yet the microscopic mechanisms that nucleate and propagate synchronized clusters remain poorly understood. Using a minimal model motivated by empirical grid data and the \Adhoc potential method, we reveal two distinct seed cluster types and propagation pathways: a population-driven seed cluster at the center of the power distribution propagating to its tails by rotor accretion, and, for a symmetric distribution, coupling-driven seed clusters at its tails propagating inward to the center by cluster merger. These differences generate distinct order-parameter patterns, while inertia controls whether the seed clusters persist with distinct angular velocities. The same propagation pathways also govern recovery following external disturbances. We further confirm that the same selection--persistence rule holds in data-derived annealed representations of European power grids. Therefore, our results can inform strategies for sustaining stable power-grid operation. More generally, our pathway-based framework reframes synchronization by emphasizing the dynamics of cluster formation and recovery rather than relying solely on static criteria.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：minimal model、Adhoc potential method、data-derived annealed representations。；研究对象：电力网络的同步动力学，具体为电网中转子动力学（由二阶Kuramoto模型/摆动方程描述）的同步团簇成核与传播机制，以及电网受扰后的恢复过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了两种不同的种子团簇类型及其传播路径：功率分布中心处的“种群驱动”种子团簇通过转子逐级吸附向尾部传播；对称分布下尾部出现“耦合驱动”种子团簇，通过团簇合并向中心传播。惯性决定了种子团簇是否以不同角速度持续存在，且相同的传播路径也控制外部扰动后的恢复过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了两种不同的种子团簇类型及其传播路径：功率分布中心处的“种群驱动”种子团簇通过转子逐级吸附向尾部传播；对称分布下尾部出现“耦合驱动”种子团簇，通过团簇合并向中心传播。惯性决定了种子团簇是否以不同角速度持续存在，且相同的传播路径也控制外部扰动后的恢复过程。；创新点：提出了基于路径的同步框架，强调团簇形成与恢复的动力学过程，而非仅依赖静态判据；区分了两种不同物理起源的种子团簇及其传播方向，并指出惯性对团簇持续性的控制作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于经验电网数据构建最小模型，采用Adhoc势方法（Adhoc potential method）分析同步路径；并在欧洲电网的数据派生退火表示（annealed representations）中验证了“选择—持续”规则。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal coherent molding and retrieval of pulsed signals in optical waveguides
papers.abstract: Optical waveguides are key elements for high fidelity, long distance optical communications. Coupled waveguide arrays allow for higher information density, steerting the propagation direction, and for encoding information. However, due to the mixing of relative phases for short pulses containing multiple waveguide-mode frequencies, a process for retrieving an encoded input state once these signals undergo coherent propagation remains elusive. A concept is presented to extract with high fidelity the phase-encrypted input signal from spatio-temporal propagated states. As a realization, an array of coupled waveguides is suggested with the retrieval mechanism being realized by local phase shifts that comply with the identified retrieval concept. Three dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations for broadband optical signals in coupled dielectric waveguides confirm the validity of the scheme and the high fidelity of information retrieval pointing to potential applications, for instance in ultrafast coherent coding and decoding of information imprinted on pulse sequences.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要提出“概念”（concept）和“方案”（scheme），并通过“三维全波电磁模拟”（three-dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations）验证，未提及实验实现。；研究对象：耦合波导阵列（coupled waveguide arrays）中宽带光脉冲的时空相干传播与信息编码/解码过程，具体涉及多波导模式频率下短脉冲的相对相位混合问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种能从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密输入信号的检索机制，并通过耦合介质波导阵列中的局域相位移动实现该机制；三维全波电磁模拟证实了该方案的有效性和信息检索的高保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种能从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密输入信号的检索机制，并通过耦合介质波导阵列中的局域相位移动实现该机制；三维全波电磁模拟证实了该方案的有效性和信息检索的高保真度。；创新点：首次提出针对短脉冲（含多个波导模式频率）在相干传播后相位混合问题的输入态检索方案，实现了从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密信号，指向超快相干编码/解码应用。摘要未突出说明与已有方案的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论概念设计与数值模拟：提出检索概念，用局域相位移动（local phase shifts）实现检索，采用三维全波电磁模拟（three-dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations）对耦合介质波导中的宽带光信号进行验证。

papers.title: Superconducting Flux Memory for Cryogenic Applications
papers.abstract: We report the development of flux memory for use with superconducting circuits. This technology stores persistent currents in superconducting loops on-chip to be used to provide flux biasing for superconducting circuits, like qubits. We developed three types of flux memory and draw comparisons among them for circuit design. We demonstrate the utility of flux memory by using an in-situ flux detector and characterize each approach and further demonstrate that once flux is set in a memory cell, benchtop DC control sources can be powered off, leaving the on-chip flux bias in place. We propose that flux memory can be arranged in a two-dimensional configuration to multiplex control signals and reduce how line counts scale (N^2 devices -> 2N control lines), and our experimental results pave the path to the proposed scalability. We demonstrate the use of flux memory to flux bias a transmon qubit and show the tunability of the qubit state to a target frequency which remained stable on-chip for 20 hours.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We report the development”“We developed”“We demonstrate”“experimental results”等表述，明确为实验研究。；研究对象：超导电路中的片上磁通存储技术，具体为超导环中存储持续电流以提供磁通偏置的“磁通存储器”，并应用于transmon量子比特的磁通偏置。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了三种类型的超导磁通存储器，并证明一旦磁通被写入存储单元，可关闭台式直流控制源，片上磁通偏置仍保持稳定；利用磁通存储器对transmon量子比特进行磁通偏置，量子比特态可调谐至目标频率并保持稳定达20小时。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了三种类型的超导磁通存储器，并证明一旦磁通被写入存储单元，可关闭台式直流控制源，片上磁通偏置仍保持稳定；利用磁通存储器对transmon量子比特进行磁通偏置，量子比特态可调谐至目标频率并保持稳定达20小时。；创新点：提出磁通存储器可按二维阵列排布，将控制线数量从N²器件对应2N条控制线，实现控制信号的复用与可扩展性；并首次展示了磁通存储器对transmon量子比特的实用化磁通偏置，且关闭外部直流源后片上偏置可保持20小时。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了三种类型的超导磁通存储器，使用原位磁通探测器（in-situ flux detector）对各方案进行表征与对比；将磁通存储器用于偏置transmon量子比特，测量其频率可调谐性与长期稳定性。摘要未明确说明具体材料体系（如铝或铌）或制备工艺细节。

papers.title: Efficiently classifying shocks in complex systems requires dormant reporters
papers.abstract: Many natural and engineered systems are large complex networks of interacting components, and external perturbations drive them along different dynamical paths. Identifying which perturbation occurred matters for diagnosis, control, and prediction. Yet often times only a few components can be jointly monitored. Which components should be monitored? Experimental practice usually favors placing reporters at the most sensitive sites, where perturbations produce the largest effects. Using a simple dynamical model for complex systems with heterogeneous connectivity, we ask how sparse reporter panels should be chosen to classify shocks from partial trajectories when repeated trials only approximately reproduce an ideal initial condition. Once that reproduction is imperfect, sensitivity ranked panels fall far short of optimal, and the shortfall grows with the noise. We find that the best panels mix two kinds of reporters. A promiscuous reporter responds to most shocks, so it separates them mainly by degree, and degree fluctuates from trial to trial. A dormant reporter responds to only a few shocks but strongly, and its answers do not scatter as much between trials. As noise grows, the cost of losing a dormant reporter rises to meet the cost of losing a promiscuous one. Panels of either kind alone classify worse than the mixture, and no property of the members collected individually explains the ordering. Most of all, we find that only a minuscule number of reporters are needed on a panel to accurately identify which shock hit the system. We implement an efficient algorithm to assemble such a panel. Together these results provide a low cost practical design principle for monitoring large complex dynamical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“simple dynamical model”“efficient algorithm”，属于建模与算法研究，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：大型复杂网络动力系统，具体为具有异质连接性的复杂系统中，外部扰动（冲击）的识别与分类问题。属于非线性动力学与复杂系统范畴，非传统凝聚态材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当重复试验无法精确复现理想初始条件（存在噪声）时，按灵敏度排序的监测器面板远非最优；最优面板需混合“广谱型”与“休眠型”两类报告器，且仅需极少数报告器即可准确识别冲击类型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当重复试验无法精确复现理想初始条件（存在噪声）时，按灵敏度排序的监测器面板远非最优；最优面板需混合“广谱型”与“休眠型”两类报告器，且仅需极少数报告器即可准确识别冲击类型。；创新点：揭示了在初始条件噪声存在下，传统“最灵敏位点优先”的监测器选择策略失效，并提出“休眠报告器”（对少数冲击强响应、试验间波动小）与“广谱报告器”混合的最优面板设计原则；同时发现所需报告器数量极小，并给出高效组装算法。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体模型方程，但提及“simple dynamical model for complex systems with heterogeneous connectivity”，并采用数值模拟与分类算法（“efficient algorithm to assemble such a panel”）来评估不同报告器面板的性能。未提及具体计算框架（如DFT、DMD等）。

papers.title: Separating perception from reasoning in vision-language models: a model-free render ceiling for crystal structures
papers.abstract: Multimodal evaluations cannot say whether a vision-language model misread an image or misreasoned about it, because every existing method for separating the two places a second model in the loop. We introduce the render ceiling, a model-free reference for benchmarks built by rendering known objects: inverting the frozen cameras and re-solving cross-view correspondence recovers exactly the answer the images support. We prove the ceiling fails only through an enumerable set of projection coincidences and certify that set empty on 2,160 rendered crystal structures, so every point of a model's deficit belongs to the model. Across fourteen vision-language models, supplying exact geometry as text lifts every model yet closes under half the gap for thirteen, while a supervised vision model with no language component reads the same images at 0.8952, above every vision-language model. The instrument exposes extraction-stage fabrication that downstream accuracy would misattribute to reasoning, yields camera-placement rules for benchmark builders, and transfers to any benchmark with an invertible forward rendering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（涉及模型评估与基准构建，包含理论证明与实验验证）。判断依据关键词：model-free reference、prove、certify、rendered crystal structures、fourteen vision-language models。；研究对象：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）对晶体结构图像的感知与推理能力评估，具体材料体系为2,160个渲染的晶体结构图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“渲染天花板”（render ceiling）作为无模型参考基准，可严格区分模型对晶体结构图像的“误读”（感知失败）与“误推理”（推理失败）。实验表明，即使向模型提供精确几何文本，十三个模型的性能差距仍有一半以上无法闭合，而纯视觉监督模型（无语言组件）的读数准确率（0.8952）超过所有视觉-语言模型，揭示感知阶段缺陷是主要瓶颈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“渲染天花板”（render ceiling）作为无模型参考基准，可严格区分模型对晶体结构图像的“误读”（感知失败）与“误推理”（推理失败）。实验表明，即使向模型提供精确几何文本，十三个模型的性能差距仍有一半以上无法闭合，而纯视觉监督模型（无语言组件）的读数准确率（0.8952）超过所有视觉-语言模型，揭示感知阶段缺陷是主要瓶颈。；创新点：首次提出无需第二模型介入的“渲染天花板”方法，将感知与推理误差严格分离；证明该天花板仅在可枚举的投影巧合下失效，并在大规模晶体结构数据集上验证其可靠性；该方法可迁移至任何具有可逆前向渲染的基准测试。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与计算实验结合：通过反转固定相机参数并重新求解跨视角对应关系，精确恢复图像所支持的答案；在2,160个渲染晶体结构上形式化验证投影巧合集合为空；对十四个视觉-语言模型进行系统评测，并对比纯视觉监督模型。

papers.title: Mudskippers use tail thrusting to help crutching to move on mud of various wetness
papers.abstract: At the water-land interface, amphibious fishes encounter wet flowable substrates made of granular solid-water mixtures, which can stay solid or flow like a fluid. As these substrates become wetter or drier, their yield strength (at which solid-fluid transition occurs) and cohesion (how sticky they are) both change, challenging locomotion. Despite substantial understanding of tetrapod locomotion on flowable substrates (mostly dry sand), we know little about how amphibious fishes cope with wet flowable substrates of various wetness. Here, we studied mudskippers on clay mud of controlled, variable wetness over the range where solid-fluid transition occurs. As mud became wetter, its strength decreased by 100-fold, leading the animal to sink deeper, with larger areas of body and fins contacting mud. By contrast, mud stuck most easily at intermediate wetness. The increased sinkage and contact and stickiness change caused more mud to stick to and pull against the animal on wetter mud. We also tested dry mud, which stuck to animal fins as its mucus dried. Despite these challenges, the mudskipper predominately used a conserved crutching gait on all except the wettest mud tested, with a modest performance reduction. When normal crutching became less effective, the animal assisted it with tail thrusting, by bending and straightening it to push downward and backward to generate additional thrust and lift, or even thrusting the tail to jump. These observations suggest that mudskipper's crutching motor program is well adapted to its native muddy substrates but inflexible, with most novelty in tail use.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了“we studied mudskippers on clay mud of controlled, variable wetness”，涉及对动物运动的直接观测与力学测量。；研究对象：弹涂鱼（mudskipper）在湿度可调的黏土泥浆（clay mud）上的运动行为，具体关注泥浆的固-液转变、屈服强度与黏附性对动物步态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弹涂鱼在除最湿泥浆外的所有湿度条件下均保持保守的“拐杖式”（crutching）步态，仅性能略有下降；当常规步态效率降低时，弹涂鱼通过尾部弯曲-伸直产生向下和向后的推力来辅助推进，甚至用尾部跳跃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弹涂鱼在除最湿泥浆外的所有湿度条件下均保持保守的“拐杖式”（crutching）步态，仅性能略有下降；当常规步态效率降低时，弹涂鱼通过尾部弯曲-伸直产生向下和向后的推力来辅助推进，甚至用尾部跳跃。；创新点：首次系统研究两栖鱼类在湿度连续变化的湿颗粒基底（而非干沙）上的运动适应策略，揭示其步态程序保守但尾部使用具有高度新颖性。摘要未突出说明与四足动物运动理论的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验控制黏土泥浆的湿度（覆盖固-液转变区间），测量泥浆的屈服强度（随湿度增加下降约100倍）和黏附性（中间湿度最易黏附），同时观测弹涂鱼的下沉深度、身体与鳍的接触面积、泥浆黏附量及步态变化，并对比干泥条件下的行为。

papers.title: Importance and methods to control, vary, and characterize mud strength for studying locomotion
papers.abstract: Animals and robots encounter mud at the water-land interface. Like sand, mud can stay solid or flow like a fluid. Unlike sand, the yield strength of mud at which solid-fluid transitions occur depends on not only the amount of solid relative to fluid (water in mud, air in dry sand), but also how much coarse grains and fine clay are within the solid. Despite understanding of locomotion on/within dry sand dominated by coarse grains with repulsive normal forces and friction, little is known for mud dominated by fine clay with strong cohesion. Here, we developed methods to prepare uniform mud of controlled, variable yield strength and characterize and track its drift from water evaporation. Compared to other flowable substrates, mud strength measured by upward force during penetration is weaker and can vary more, and mud sticks more during extraction to pull downward, making it more challenging for locomotion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“developed methods to prepare uniform mud... and characterize and track its drift”，属于实验方法开发与测量。；研究对象：泥（mud）——水-陆交界处的软物质体系，具体关注其屈服强度（yield strength）对动物及机器人运动能力的影响，并与干沙（dry sand）进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 泥的屈服强度不仅取决于固/液比例，还显著受粗颗粒与细黏土含量影响；与干沙相比，泥在穿透过程中测得的强度更弱且变化更大，且在拔出时因黏附产生向下拉力，使运动更加困难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：泥的屈服强度不仅取决于固/液比例，还显著受粗颗粒与细黏土含量影响；与干沙相比，泥在穿透过程中测得的强度更弱且变化更大，且在拔出时因黏附产生向下拉力，使运动更加困难。；创新点：首次系统性地针对以细黏土为主导、具有强内聚力的泥（区别于以粗颗粒、排斥法向力和摩擦为主的干沙）开发了可控屈服强度的制备与表征方法，并揭示了泥在运动力学上与沙的关键差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体仪器或表征手段，但涉及：制备均匀泥样并控制其屈服强度的方法、通过向上力（upward force）测量穿透过程中的泥强度、追踪水分蒸发引起的漂移（drift）的测量方法。具体设备（如流变仪、穿透计等）摘要未提及。

papers.title: Strong suppression of the photonic density of states in three-dimensional disordered silicon networks
papers.abstract: Photonic bandgaps can open not only in crystalline dielectric materials but also in amorphous structures. Self-uniform amorphous gyroid networks have been proposed as promising disordered photonic architectures. Motivated by numerical studies, we combine direct laser-writing lithography with advanced materials processing to fabricate these structures from high-refractive-index silicon. Spectroscopic measurements at mid-infrared wavelengths reveal pronounced transmission minima. To investigate the formation of photonic band gaps in amorphous structures, we develop polarization-resolved transmission spectroscopy that separates ballistic and multiply scattered contributions, enabling direct identification of the underlying transport regimes. We observe a strong suppression of diffuse transmission, providing direct experimental evidence for a breakdown of conventional diffuse transport associated with a strongly reduced photonic density of states. Together with large-scale numerical simulations, our results establish the presence of a deep photonic pseudogap in an amorphous three-dimensional dielectric material and open new opportunities for observing disorder-induced localization phenomena, including Anderson localization of light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“direct laser-writing lithography”“spectroscopic measurements”“polarization-resolved transmission spectroscopy”等实验手段，同时包含“large-scale numerical simulations”。；研究对象：三维无序硅网络（self-uniform amorphous gyroid networks），具体为高折射率硅制成的无序光子结构，研究其光子态密度及光子赝能隙（photonic pseudogap）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维无序硅网络中观察到漫透射的强烈抑制，直接实验证明了常规扩散输运的失效，对应光子态密度的显著降低，表明该非晶三维介电材料中存在深的光子赝能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维无序硅网络中观察到漫透射的强烈抑制，直接实验证明了常规扩散输运的失效，对应光子态密度的显著降低，表明该非晶三维介电材料中存在深的光子赝能隙。；创新点：首次在三维非晶介电材料中通过实验直接证实强光子赝能隙的存在，并利用偏振分辨光谱明确区分弹道与漫散射输运，为无序诱导的光局域化（如光的安德森局域化）研究提供了实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双光子直接激光写入光刻结合先进材料处理工艺制备高折射率硅无序陀螺网络；利用中红外波段的偏振分辨透射光谱，将弹道与多次散射贡献分离，以区分输运机制。数值上采用大规模模拟（摘要未明确具体方法，如FDTD或TMM等）。

papers.title: Mixture of Polyconvex Neural Potentials for Parametric Hyperelasticity: Towards Foundation Material Models
papers.abstract: Hyperelastic constitutive models enable modeling large deformations in elastic solids. In common practice, a strain energy density function is prescribed in advance and model-specific parameters are calibrated from experiments. However, many applications require constitutive models for a family of related materials whose mechanical behavior varies with composition. A fixed constitutive model-form may not capture the full range of behavior across the family, while fitting separate forms does not provide a direct way to predict the response of new compositions. Recent work has developed data-driven constitutive models that learn flexible strain energy functions while incorporating key physical constraints. In this work, we propose using mixtures of convex neural potentials based on input convex neural networks as a modular and data efficient approach to modeling material families. Each potential is convex and monotonic with respect to polyconvex strain invariants, while a conditioning network maps material descriptors to mixture weights. We compare the approach with a monolithic partially input-convex neural network using experimental data from PolyJet 3D-printed materials and a synthetic Gent-type benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the mixture architecture generalized better to material descriptors not seen during training. In the PolyJet experimental benchmark, we showed that the mixture architecture is less sensitive to model hyperparameters, while in the Gent-type benchmark it generalized more reliably with sparse data in the material-descriptor space. These results suggest that representing a material family through a small set of shared convex neural potentials provides a useful structural prior for learning descriptor-dependent constitutive behavior from limited data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“data-driven constitutive models”、“learning flexible strain energy functions”、“neural networks”等关键词，核心工作是提出并验证一种新的机器学习本构建模框架，属于计算与理论建模范畴。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是“材料族”（material families），即一组力学行为随成分（material descriptors）连续变化的弹性固体材料。具体实验体系为PolyJet 3D打印材料，并辅以合成Gent型超弹性材料基准测试。物理现象为有限大变形下的超弹性（hyperelasticity）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于多个凸神经势函数混合（mixture of convex neural potentials）的架构，用于参数化超弹性本构模型。该混合架构在预测训练中未见过的材料成分时，泛化能力优于单一的整体式部分输入凸神经网络，且对超参数更不敏感、在稀疏数据下更可靠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于多个凸神经势函数混合（mixture of convex neural potentials）的架构，用于参数化超弹性本构模型。该混合架构在预测训练中未见过的材料成分时，泛化能力优于单一的整体式部分输入凸神经网络，且对超参数更不敏感、在稀疏数据下更可靠。；创新点：将“混合专家”（mixture-of-experts）思想引入神经本构模型，用少量共享的凸神经势函数作为结构先验（structural prior），以模块化且数据高效的方式刻画整个材料族，从而提升对未见成分的泛化能力。摘要未明确说明与更早的“神经网络本构”工作的具体差异细节，但核心新意在于混合架构本身。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于输入凸神经网络（ICNN）的混合模型。具体而言，每个子势函数相对于多凸应变不变量（polyconvex strain invariants）是凸且单调的，同时一个条件网络（conditioning network）将材料描述符映射为混合权重。对比基准为单一的整体式部分输入凸神经网络（monolithic partially input-convex neural network）。验证数据来自PolyJet 3D打印材料实验数据和合成Gent型基准。

papers.title: Ghost-free higher-gradient Newtonian gravity from the Second Law of Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Higher-gradient modifications of Newtonian gravity remove the point-mass singularity, but their Lagrangian dynamics is haunted by the Ostrogradsky instability. We show that the same field equations follow from the Second Law of thermodynamics applied to a self-gravitating fluid with a weakly nonlocal state space, and that on this route the instability is absent by construction: the potential obeys a first-order relaxation equation that is a gradient flow, whose Lyapunov function is the entropy density, and whose relaxation spectrum is negative definite at every wavenumber precisely when the entropy is concave. The derivation also yields the pressure tensor and the energy current, an exact identity that reproduces Newton's force law without further input, and a dissipation-free cross-coupling to the bulk viscous pressure that no variational principle can produce. Regularity constrains the Yukawa-type corrections by an amplitude sum rule, $\sum_iα_i=-1$, so that laboratory tests of the inverse-square law bound the largest internal length below $4\times10^{-5}$~m, and identify the complex-root regime as a classically consistent Lee--Wick-like sector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论拉格朗日动力学、Ostrogradsky不稳定性、热力学第二定律、梯度流等纯理论概念，无实验或计算数据。；研究对象：高阶梯度修正的牛顿引力（higher-gradient Newtonian gravity），具体涉及自引力流体（self-gravitating fluid）的弱非局域态空间（weakly nonlocal state space），以及点质量奇点的消除与Yukawa型修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将热力学第二定律应用于具有弱非局域态空间的自引力流体，可以得到与高阶梯度牛顿引力相同的场方程，但Ostrogradsky不稳定性在构造上被消除——势满足一阶弛豫方程（梯度流），其李雅普诺夫函数为熵密度，且当熵为凹函数时弛豫谱在所有波数上负定。此外，正则性要求Yukawa型修正满足振幅求和规则∑ᵢαᵢ = −1，从而将最大内部长度约束在4×10⁻⁵ m以下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将热力学第二定律应用于具有弱非局域态空间的自引力流体，可以得到与高阶梯度牛顿引力相同的场方程，但Ostrogradsky不稳定性在构造上被消除——势满足一阶弛豫方程（梯度流），其李雅普诺夫函数为熵密度，且当熵为凹函数时弛豫谱在所有波数上负定。此外，正则性要求Yukawa型修正满足振幅求和规则∑ᵢαᵢ = −1，从而将最大内部长度约束在4×10⁻⁵ m以下。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有高阶梯度引力文献相比的独特创新点，但其核心新意在于：从热力学第二定律而非变分原理出发推导场方程，从而天然规避Ostrogradsky不稳定性；并导出了变分原理无法产生的无耗散体黏滞压交叉耦合项。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导框架：基于热力学第二定律的变分/弛豫方法，构建梯度流方程；利用李雅普诺夫函数（熵密度）分析稳定性；通过谱分析（波数依赖的弛豫谱）证明负定性；结合振幅求和规则与实验室逆平方律检验给出长度尺度约束。摘要未提及任何数值模拟或具体实验手段。

papers.title: Smoothed truncated Coulomb potential for periodic Gaussian-basis Hartree--Fock exchange
papers.abstract: Truncated Coulomb (TC) potentials reduce finite-size errors and accelerate thermodynamic-limit convergence in periodic Hartree--Fock (HF) calculations, but their use with Gaussian basis sets is complicated by the evaluation of electron repulsion integrals (ERIs), particularly for nonspherical truncation domains and all-electron calculations. We introduce the smoothed truncated Coulomb (sTC) potential as a systematically improvable approximation to a parent TC potential. A real-space Gaussian convolution smooths the sharp truncation boundary, and a single dimensionless parameter, $η$, controls the width of the smoothing window, which can be tightened to systematically approach the TC reference. The smoothing by sTC enables a dual-space algorithm for evaluating periodic Gaussian-basis ERIs that requires neither a large plane-wave basis nor new molecular integral kernels and is applicable to both pseudopotential and all-electron calculations, including the important Wigner--Seitz-cell truncation boundaries. Benchmarks spanning insulating, semiconducting, layered, metallic, and molecular-crystal systems show that sTC-based HF closely reproduces TC results in pseudopotential calculations and extends TC-quality calculations to all-electron settings. Across these systems, sTC substantially improves thermodynamic-limit convergence relative to the probe-charge Ewald method while remaining practical for all-electron calculations in which direct TC-based calculations are computationally challenging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于周期性Hartree–Fock计算中的电子排斥积分评估、算法与基准测试，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：周期性凝聚态体系中的Hartree–Fock交换能计算，具体涵盖绝缘体、半导体、层状材料、金属和分子晶体等体系，以及赝势与全电子两种计算设置。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入平滑截断库仑（sTC）势，可系统逼近截断库仑（TC）势，在保持TC势减小有限尺寸误差优势的同时，将TC质量的计算扩展到全电子体系，并显著改善热力学极限收敛性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入平滑截断库仑（sTC）势，可系统逼近截断库仑（TC）势，在保持TC势减小有限尺寸误差优势的同时，将TC质量的计算扩展到全电子体系，并显著改善热力学极限收敛性。；创新点：首次将TC势的平滑化处理与双空间ERI算法结合，使TC质量的交换能计算在无新分子积分内核的条件下适用于全电子体系及非球形截断域，并系统验证了其热力学极限收敛性优于探针电荷Ewald方法。
papers.method_zh: 提出sTC势（对截断边界做实空间高斯卷积平滑，由无量纲参数η控制平滑宽度），并开发了双空间算法用于周期性高斯基组电子排斥积分（ERI）评估，无需大平面波基组或新的分子积分内核，适用于赝势与全电子计算（含Wigner–Seitz胞截断边界）。基准测试对比了sTC-HF与TC结果及探针电荷Ewald方法。

papers.title: Higher anomalies, compressing SPTs and cohomology operations
papers.abstract: We explicitly compute and tabulate the suspension map for cohomology operations, applying it to the dimensional reduction of anomalies and higher group structures of generalised symmetries in quantum field theories and lattice systems. In a quantum system with a discrete $p$-form symmetry, we can restrict the symmetry defects to a codimension-$q$ subspace of spacetime, or equivalently confine the gauge field to a slab whose thickness approaches zero. This results in a $(p-q)$-form symmetry on the subspace. We determine the fate of two important properties of symmetries under this process. First, we compute the anomaly of the reduced symmetry, or the higher anomaly of the original symmetry, which acts as an obstruction to higher gauging and onsiteability. Second, for two symmetries forming a higher-group structure, encoded as a Postnikov class, we compute the reduced higher-group structure, which may or may not be trivial. Both cases are captured by the $q$-fold iteration of the cohomology suspension $Ω$, also known as the loop functor or transgression, in the cohomology of Eilenberg--MacLane spaces. Classical results state that $Ω$ is an isomorphism in a stable range and annihilates mixed anomalies. To calculate $Ω$ over a base ring which is not a field, we make use of small models for the chain DGAs of Eilenberg--MacLane spaces, pioneered by Cartan and Moore, whose results we review and extend. The critical added step is the improvement of a mod $p$ chain contraction to the $p$-local integers, obtained via a $p$-adic series. We automate the computations in a software package \texttt{emcm}, and provide extensive tables of the results. Finally, to make contact with explicit cochain formulations of cohomology operations, we demonstrate how to calculate cup products and certain cup-$i$ products in this framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：explicitly compute、cohomology operations、quantum field theories and lattice systems、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子场论与格点系统中广义对称性的维度约化（dimensional reduction），特别是离散 p-形式对称性及其高异常（higher anomalies）与高群结构（higher-group structures）在限制到低维子空间时的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过显式计算并列表化上同调中的 suspension 映射（Ω，即 loop functor 或 transgression），确定了对称性维度约化后两个关键性质的命运：约化对称性的异常（即原对称性的高异常，作为更高规范化和可局域化的障碍），以及两个对称性构成的高群结构（由 Postnikov 类编码）的约化结果。两者均由 Ω 的 q 次迭代完全刻画。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过显式计算并列表化上同调中的 suspension 映射（Ω，即 loop functor 或 transgression），确定了对称性维度约化后两个关键性质的命运：约化对称性的异常（即原对称性的高异常，作为更高规范化和可局域化的障碍），以及两个对称性构成的高群结构（由 Postnikov 类编码）的约化结果。两者均由 Ω 的 q 次迭代完全刻画。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的对比性创新点，但明确提到：经典结果仅表明 Ω 在稳定范围内是同构且湮灭混合异常，而本文在非域基环上完成了 Ω 的显式计算，并提供了系统化的表格与自动化软件包。
papers.method_zh: 利用 Eilenberg--MacLane 空间的链微分分次代数（chain DGA）的小模型（Cartan 和 Moore 开创），将模 p 链收缩改进为 p-局部整数上的结果（通过 p-adic 级数实现），并自动化计算于软件包 \texttt{emcm} 中，提供大量结果表格。此外，演示了在该框架下计算 cup 积和特定 cup-i 积的方法。

papers.title: Exploring thermal order in conformal theories with multiple scalars coupled to an $O(N)$ vector field
papers.abstract: We study thermal order in conformal field theories (CFTs) in $d=4-ε$ and $d=3$ dimensions where several scalars are coupled to an $O(N)$ vector field. In $(4-ε)$ dimensions, we consider models coupling a cubic model of $M$ scalars with $\mathbb{Z}_2^M\rtimes S_M$ symmetry (corresponding to sign flips and permutations of the scalars) to an $O(N)$ vector model. For any $M$, we find a window of $N$ in which two Wilson-Fisher-like fixed points exist. We show that the $\mathbb{Z}_2^M\rtimes S_M$ symmetry is spontaneously broken at arbitrary nonzero temperatures for $M=2$ and sufficiently large $N$ within this window, but it remains unbroken for $M>2$. Using the functional renormalisation group to continue these fixed points towards three dimensions, we find that they collide and move into the complex plane well before reaching $d=3$, suggesting that their continuation to $d=3$ does not yield unitary CFTs. We then work directly in three dimensions at large but finite $N$, with $M\ll N$, initially without assuming any permutation symmetry among the $M$ scalars. By studying the RG flow, we show that these models possess a conformal manifold up to the leading nontrivial order in the $1/N$ expansion of the beta functions (which is $\mathcal{O}(1/N)$). At each point on this manifold, the scalars split into two classes that are distinguished by how they couple to the $O(N)$ vector field. We then restrict to a subspace of the conformal manifold where there is an additional symmetry under permutations of the scalars within each class. We prove that in a domain of this subspace, all $M$ scalars acquire thermal expectation values such that the symmetry under sign flips of the scalars is spontaneously broken at all nonzero temperatures. This provides a novel class of large $N$ CFTs that exhibit a rich pattern of persistent symmetry breaking at nonzero temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：conformal field theories、functional renormalisation group、RG flow、1/N expansion、fixed points。；研究对象：共形场论（CFT）中的热序（thermal order）现象，具体为多个标量场与一个O(N)矢量场耦合的模型，在d=4-ε和d=3维度下的热力学行为与对称性破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在d=4-ε中，对任意M存在一个N的窗口，其中出现两个Wilson-Fisher型不动点；M=2且N足够大时，Z₂^M⋊S_M对称性在任意非零温度下自发破缺，而M>2时保持不破缺。在d=3大N极限下，标量场分裂为两类，且在子空间内所有M个标量在任意非零温度下获得热期望值，导致符号翻转对称性持续自发破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在d=4-ε中，对任意M存在一个N的窗口，其中出现两个Wilson-Fisher型不动点；M=2且N足够大时，Z₂^M⋊S_M对称性在任意非零温度下自发破缺，而M>2时保持不破缺。在d=3大N极限下，标量场分裂为两类，且在子空间内所有M个标量在任意非零温度下获得热期望值，导致符号翻转对称性持续自发破缺。；创新点：发现了一类新的大N共形场论，在非零温度下表现出丰富的持续对称性破缺模式（persistent symmetry breaking），且该破缺在任意非零温度下均存在，区别于通常仅在低温下破缺的热相变行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用ε展开（d=4-ε）分析不动点结构；使用泛函重整化群（functional renormalisation group）将不动点延拓至三维；在d=3直接采用大N展开（1/N展开至O(1/N)阶）研究RG流与共形流形结构。

papers.title: Guiding center quantization of a quantum Hall analog of Hawking radiation
papers.abstract: We revisit the quantum Hall analog of Hawking radiation in which a Fermi sea of electrons occupying half of a plane, subjected to a quadrupolar electric potential, gives rise to analog Hawking radiation of chiral edge modes. We show that the phenomenon is accurately captured by quantization of the classical guiding center theory, where the gyroscopic motion of the electrons is coarse grained and only the drift motion is resolved. The quantum dynamics takes place on a non-commutative plane, which requires an electron localized in the half-plane to be supported everywhere along the edge direction. This kinematical constraint on the quantum state leads directly to the radiation, which propagates in both directions away from the origin along the edge. The radiation is thermal with respect to laboratory time, which is equal (up to a constant factor) to the boost angle in the analog Minkowski spacetime in which the chiral edge modes propagate, so in fact it corresponds to analog Unruh radiation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantization、theory、analog。；研究对象：量子霍尔效应中的霍金辐射类比体系：半平面电子费米海在四极电势作用下产生的手性边缘模，及其在非对易平面上的量子化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该量子霍尔霍金辐射现象可被经典引导中心理论的量子化精确描述；辐射源于半平面局域电子在非对易平面上的运动学约束，且该辐射在实验室时间下呈热谱，实为类比Unruh辐射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该量子霍尔霍金辐射现象可被经典引导中心理论的量子化精确描述；辐射源于半平面局域电子在非对易平面上的运动学约束，且该辐射在实验室时间下呈热谱，实为类比Unruh辐射。；创新点：首次将引导中心量子化应用于该量子霍尔霍金辐射体系，揭示辐射的物理根源是半平面电子在非对易平面上的运动学约束（沿边缘方向非局域支撑），并明确指出该效应实为类比Unruh辐射而非严格意义上的霍金辐射。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为引导中心量子化（guiding center quantization），对电子回旋运动进行粗粒化处理，仅保留漂移运动；量子动力学在非对易平面上构建，并引入类比闵可夫斯基时空中的boost角分析。

papers.title: Regulating Free-scalar and Yang--Lee 5d CFTs on the Fuzzy Four Sphere
papers.abstract: Non-commutative sphere regularization of CFT has become a powerful tool for computing conformal data of 3d CFTs and was recently extended to 4d CFTs. In this work we further construct 5d free-scalar CFT and Yang-Lee CFT on a fuzzy 4-sphere. We observe a continuous phase transition and conformal towers in these examples. We obtain the first three scalar primaries of the 5d free-scalar CFT, furthermore, we compute the 5d Yang-Lee $Δ_φ,Δ_{φ^3}$ with $N_e=10$ fermions using exact diagonalization (ED) and $N_e=20$ fermions using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG), obtaining relatively good agreement with both $ε$-expansion and the Gliozzi truncated bootstrap result.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization (ED)、density matrix renormalization group (DMRG)、数值计算 conformal data。；研究对象：5维自由标量 CFT 和 Yang-Lee CFT，在模糊四球面（fuzzy 4-sphere）上的非对易正则化实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在模糊四球面上成功构造了5维自由标量 CFT 和 Yang-Lee CFT，观察到连续相变和共形塔结构；计算得到的 Yang-Lee 标度维度 Δ_φ 和 Δ_φ³ 与 ε-展开及 Gliozzi 截断 bootstrap 结果吻合较好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在模糊四球面上成功构造了5维自由标量 CFT 和 Yang-Lee CFT，观察到连续相变和共形塔结构；计算得到的 Yang-Lee 标度维度 Δ_φ 和 Δ_φ³ 与 ε-展开及 Gliozzi 截断 bootstrap 结果吻合较好。；创新点：将模糊球面正则化技术从3维/4维 CFT 推广到5维 CFT，并首次在模糊四球面上数值验证了5维 Yang-Lee CFT 的临界数据。
papers.method_zh: 非对易球面正则化方法（fuzzy sphere regularization）扩展到4维球面；对自由标量 CFT 提取前三个标量初级算符；对 Yang-Lee CFT 分别使用精确对角化（ED，N_e=10 费米子）和密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG，N_e=20 费米子）计算。

papers.title: Quantum Complexity Dynamics for Disjoint Subsystems
papers.abstract: Quantum complexity has emerged as a natural probe of chaos, thermalization, and the black hole interior on timescales long after local observables have equilibrated. However, its time evolution has been studied almost exclusively in subsystems confined to a single connected region. We show, using complementary tools from holography and random quantum circuits, that noncontiguous subsystems composed of multiple disjoint regions give rise to qualitatively new physics compared to the contiguous case. First, at finite temperature, a subsystem occupying less than half of the total system can carry high complexity at late times, even as the complexity of its larger complement remains low. This inversion of the usual hierarchy is intrinsically thermal: it vanishes in the infinite-temperature limit, which is the regime modeled by random quantum circuits. Second, if a subsystem's complexity equilibrates at an early time, then fragmenting it into $m$ disjoint components can further reduce this timescale by a factor of $m$, a phenomenon we exhibit in both holography and random quantum circuits. These results not only sharpen the correspondence between geometric and computational notions of complexity, but also motivate the search for novel complexity phenomena in quantum dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“holography”（全息原理）与“random quantum circuits”（随机量子电路）等理论工具，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：量子复杂度（quantum complexity）在由多个互不相连（disjoint）子区域组成的非连续子系统中的时间演化行为，涉及混沌、热化及黑洞内部等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非连续子系统展现出与连续子系统定性不同的复杂度动力学：1）在有限温度下，占据总系统不到一半的子系统可在晚时间保持高复杂度，而其更大的补集复杂度反而较低，这种层级反转在无限温度极限下消失；2）若子系统复杂度在早期达到平衡，将其分割为 m 个不相连部分可将平衡时间尺度进一步缩短约 m 倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非连续子系统展现出与连续子系统定性不同的复杂度动力学：1）在有限温度下，占据总系统不到一半的子系统可在晚时间保持高复杂度，而其更大的补集复杂度反而较低，这种层级反转在无限温度极限下消失；2）若子系统复杂度在早期达到平衡，将其分割为 m 个不相连部分可将平衡时间尺度进一步缩短约 m 倍。；创新点：首次系统研究非连续（多区块）子系统的量子复杂度动力学，发现其与连续子系统存在定性差异，包括有限温度下的复杂度层级反转及碎片化加速平衡现象，并展示了全息与随机电路两种框架下的一致性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：全息原理（holography，用于引力对偶描述）与随机量子电路模型（random quantum circuits，用于模拟无限温度极限下的量子动力学）。摘要未提及具体数值方法或解析计算细节。

papers.title: Classification of Rational $c=1$ Vertex Operator Algebras and Vertex Operator Superalgebras
papers.abstract: For mathematicians: In this first in a series of two papers, we give a mathematically rigorous classification of (sufficiently nice) $c=1$ vertex operator algebras (VOAs) and vertex operator superalgebras (VOSAs). We confirm the lore that any such VO(S)A is either a lattice VO(S)A $V_L$ associated to a rank-1 integral lattice $L$, or can be obtained as an orbifold thereof, i.e. a $G$-invariant subalgebra $V_L^G$ for some finite group $G$ of automorphisms. All such $G$ are known, allowing for an explicit enumeration of nice $c=1$ VO(S)As. A key ingredient in our approach is to establish a general criterion for nice VOAs, requiring knowledge only of the vacuum character, for testing when the simple modules with integer conformal dimension span a symmetric fusion subcategory which is braided tensor equivalent to $Rep(G)$. In our companion paper, we calculate the ribbon auto-equivalences of the representation categories of the nice $c=1$ VOAs, and leverage this to obtain the classification of nice bosonic and fermionic $c=1$ full conformal field theories. For physicists: We rigorously classify the chiral algebras that can arise in the holomorphic sector of a bosonic or fermionic rational $c=1$ conformal field theory (CFT) whose non-identity primaries all have positive conformal dimension. Thinking of chiral algebras as gapless boundary conditions of 3D topological quantum field theories (TQFTs), our result says that any such chiral algebra is either a holomorphic boundary of $U(1)_k$ Chern-Simons theory, or can be obtained by passing to the $G$-invariant states thereof for some finite group $G$ of symmetries. We explicitly enumerate these chiral algebras and also discuss their non-invertible symmetries. In a companion paper, we build on these results using techniques from the study of 3D TQFTs to classify full bosonic and fermionic rational $c=1$ CFTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确为“mathematically rigorous classification”（数学严格分类），面向数学家与物理学家，属于数学物理/场论理论工作。；研究对象：中心电荷 c=1 的有理顶点算子代数（VOA）与顶点算子超代数（VOSA），即玻色/费米有理 c=1 共形场论（CFT）手征（全纯）扇区中的手征代数。摘要未涉及具体凝聚态材料或实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任何“足够好”（nice，即非恒等初级场均具有正共形维数）的 c=1 VOA/VOSA 要么是秩 1 整格 L 对应的格 VOA/VOSA V_L，要么是其有限自同构群 G 的 orbifold（G-不变子代数 V_L^G）。所有此类 G 已知，从而可显式枚举所有 nice c=1 VOA/VOSA。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任何“足够好”（nice，即非恒等初级场均具有正共形维数）的 c=1 VOA/VOSA 要么是秩 1 整格 L 对应的格 VOA/VOSA V_L，要么是其有限自同构群 G 的 orbifold（G-不变子代数 V_L^G）。所有此类 G 已知，从而可显式枚举所有 nice c=1 VOA/VOSA。；创新点：首次给出 c=1 VOA/VOSA 的数学严格分类，严格证实了“格代数或其 orbifold”这一长期猜想，并给出显式枚举；同时建立了仅依赖真空特征标的通用判据，为后续（姊妹篇）利用 3D TQFT 技术分类完整 c=1 CFT 奠定基础。摘要还提及讨论非可逆对称性，但未给出具体新结果细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为顶点算子代数分类理论、张量范畴理论（对称融合子范畴与 Rep(G) 的辫子张量等价）以及 orbifold 构造。关键工具是建立仅需真空特征标即可判定“nice VOA”的通用判据，用于检验整数共形维数单模是否张成与 Rep(G) 辫子张量等价的对称融合子范畴。摘要未涉及数值或实验手段。

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence for reliable mechanistic reasoning for corrosion
papers.abstract: Corrosion accounts for approximately 4% of global GDP, and reliable prediction is essential for timely mitigation.
